events.desc: Signed earlier this afternoon in …, this landmark treaty officially abrogates any previous unequal treaties between … and … in favour of a new one negotiated between peers.
events.flavor: "The … of … and the … of …, being equally desirous of maintaining the relations of good understanding which happily exist between them, by extending and increasing the intercourse between their respective States, and being convinced that this object cannot better be accomplished than by revising the Treaties hitherto existing between the two countries, have resolved to complete such a revision, based upon principles of equity and mutual benefit."

options.name: A new dawn for …. Ratify the treaty.

events.title: The …-… …

events.desc: The Great Powers of … and … have mutually agreed upon a plan to "resolve long-running border disputes in Afghanistan". The proposed treaty makes demands for concessions from our nation.
events.flavor: The tone was that of a world-shaking document, one which would usher in peace in the region for centuries to come. Each concession from … was worded as a favor from one of the competing powers, the transfer of land claimed by one of the two to the people already inhabiting it. It was a wonder, the ambassador mused, that the … had been informed of the agreement at all.

options.name: We have no choice but to accept.
Object to this in the strongest terms we may.

events.title: The …-… Agreement

events.desc: The … has sent … response to the proposed …-… agreement - a firm denial. With the Afghan government unwilling to enforce the treaty in its present state, we may need to make alterations.
events.flavor: As he exited, the courier fully expected that the glares of the …'s companions would make the tails of his coat catch fire. He was backed by thousands of guns, millions of pounds, fleets of stately vessels - but none of that mattered in the now, far from any shore, with the nearest outpost miles away.

options.name: Back to the drawing board.

events.title: Afghanistan Rejects Proposed Agreement

events.desc: … has petitioned for our assistance in the reunification of Afghanistan. Securing a friendly Afghan state will be of use as a tool against our rivals in the region.
events.flavor:
The map was loosely defined at best. A selection of states born from the collapse of the Durrani Empire, representing the warring scions of the Barakzai and Durrani dynasties, as well as attempts at representing the areas of control of local tribes and rebellious provinces. The envoy placed the letter on the desk nearby, looking at the bespectacled staff officer he had walked in on.

"The … of …," he began, "that's the blue one, requests our assistance in 'subduing rebellious provinces and restoring legitimate rule to Afghanistan'. Is it worth a look, or should I draft a generic response?"

options.name: An excellent opportunity.
We have no interest in this.

events.title: Afghanistan Petitions for Assistance

events.desc: With the defeat of the last rebellious province, the civil wars unleashed by the fall of the Durrani Empire have come to an end. … is now the sole legitimate … of ….
events.flavor:
The wars had been the easiest part, … mused. Managing the loyalties of the tribes and … subordinates had always been more involved, and now … would have to do much the same on a national scale. If the government faltered, how long would it take for another wave of revolts? It was a rare … indeed who could win through both war and peace.

For now, however, it was time to celebrate. The people were joyous, and demanded a speech. … would give them one.

options.name: There is yet more land to reconquer.
We shall keep our country as long as we can.

events.title: Afghan Unification

events.desc: Our proposal for the Northern border of Afghanistan contradicts that proposed by the … negotiating team, to the extent that a compromise cannot be reached. One side must give for the negotiation process to move forwards.
events.flavor:
There were three lines drawn across northern Afghanistan, in different coloured ink. They diverged from one another wildly, meandering over the Torkestan mountains and the Amu Darya, the Turkmen desert and the southern Pamirs, the depressingly few overlaps appearing as rainbow-colored blots where the ink had bled through the paper completely.

"We had ought to try again," one of the representatives managed, and others nodded through clenched teeth.

options.name: We will accept the … proposal.
We will accept the … proposal.
We will accept the … proposal.
Our decision is final. The … must acquiesce.

events.title: Crossed Lines

events.desc: Our proposal for the Southwestern border of Afghanistan contradicts that proposed by the … negotiating team, to the extent that a compromise cannot be reached. One side must give for the negotiation process to move forwards.
events.flavor:
There were three lines drawn across northeastern India, in different coloured ink. They diverged from one another wildly, meandering over the Indus river and the Baluchi Desert, forming arbitrary shapes as they snaked crazily up through the rippling mountains of the Kakar ranges, the depressingly few overlaps appearing as rainbow-colored blots where the ink had bled through the paper completely.

"We had ought to try again," one of the representatives managed, and others nodded through clenched teeth.

options.name: We will accept the … proposal.
We will accept the … proposal.
We will accept the … proposal.
Our decision is final. The … must acquiesce.

events.title: Crossed Lines

events.desc: In a well-laden caravan from …, a foreign adventurer by the name of … has arrived. Bringing with him gifts of firearms and fabrics, he desires to set himself up as … of …, promising great riches and power to any who would follow him.
events.flavor: "My friend, in this world and age, he who would be a man must be a master. Providence did not afford me such privilege in the West, but through Empire I shall claim it here, in the deep valleys of the Hindu Kush."

options.name: Turn this ridiculous madman away.
Arms and fabrics you say?

events.title: The Man Who Would Be King

events.desc: Waves of chartered refugee vessels and merchant craft holding thousands of … deportees have departed across the Black Sea towards their destination. Outbreaks of disease and malnourishment have decimated the crowds.
events.flavor:
On the shore, thousands of people crowded together to share in the bare minimum of shelter and food. All of them were pale and hungry. The marks of pox and typhus wracked many of them. Dozens lay dying, on the brink of joining the piles of corpses which had been placed wherever there was space.

Off the coast, the decks of the transport vessels overflowed with the dying and already dead.

options.name: Another wave will soon replace them.
Permit the distribution of foreign aid.
We have other things to focus on.

events.title: Across the Sea

events.desc: … officials have approached the government, requesting permission to deport up to fifty thousand … people to our territory. Observers of … conduct in the Caucasus warn that the deportations may be much greater in scale.
events.flavor: "The proposed commission provides for the transportation of up to ten thousand families. Transportation at five roubles per head, two to be paid by the migrants themselves, with incentives to private actors." That was the Russian line. The official had his doubts, but he could not speak them. There was a war on to the North - not a formal one, but a war nonetheless. A far greater exodus was a certainty, and its conditions were certain to be much less orderly than was accounted for.

options.name: They would do well to populate our East.
This treaty threatens to be destabilizing.

events.title: … Requests Migration Treaty

events.desc: The flow of … deportees arriving on our Northern shore has spiraled into a humanitarian catastrophe. Local authorities have become overwhelmed by the number of refugees, many of whom are starving and diseased.
events.flavor: Dense masses of ragged men, women, and children covered the seashore. All looked wan and hungry. Many were all but naked. Several lay dying. Off the coast, more vessels approached, transformed into floating graveyards by the disease which had ravaged their human cargo. Occasionally, more bodies washed up ashore, rendered unrecognizable by the attention of crabs and seagulls. Some of the bodies had their hands tied.

options.name: Demand that the … government cease these atrocities.
There is nothing we can do.

events.title: An Ocean of Blood

events.desc: With the conclusion of our campaign in …, the entirety of the former Circassian territories have fallen under our control. The land is now available for settlement by the Don Cossacks.
events.flavor: "In this year, a deed has been accomplished almost without precedent in history: not one of the mountaineer inhabitants remains on their former places of residence, and measures are being taken to cleanse the region in order to prepare it for the new Russian population."

options.name: The deportations will continue until the land is clear.

modifiers.label: State North Caucasian Standard Of Living

options.name: Begin the process of integrating the Circassian peoples.

modifiers.label: State North Caucasian Standard Of Living

events.title: The Fall of Circassia

events.desc: With the defeat of the … armies on the field, we have finally achieved the dream of an independent and unified …. The inviolable sovereignty of … in the eyes of the world has been assured by our victory.
events.flavor: We have stood as one against the invader, burning with passion for the independence of our homeland, and we have returned to our homes triumphant.

options.name: Our strength has always come from our people, and always will.
A modern … will never again be threatened!
The time has come for our benefactors to make good on their promise.

events.title: Honor and Life

events.desc: With the occupation of … and the surrender or defection of many of the former Caucasian naibs, the leader of the Imamate has finally surrendered to the … army, upon the request of the wives and children of his last followers.
events.flavor:
"The whole world knows about your exploits, and their glory will not fade. If you, submitting to the power of fate, go out today to the commander-in-chief and surrender to the generosity of the sovereign …, you will save a thousand people who are alive and loyal to you from death. Complete your glorious deeds with an act of prudence and generosity, and the sardar will petition the sovereign to ensure the future of you and your family."

— Ivan Davidovich Lazarev

options.name: Peace has been found in Chechnya at last.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status
State North Caucasian Standard Of Living

options.name: There will be no peace whilst Shamil is still revered.

modifiers.label: State North Caucasian Standard Of Living

events.title: The Imamate's End

events.desc: The collapse of our rule in the … and … regions has led to the severance of the Georgian Military Highway, and the end of the ability of the … state to exert power in the southern Caucasus.
events.flavor: There is nothing left for us in these forsaken mountains but to be trapped between the Turks and the highlanders. Nothing is with us, any longer - God is high above, and the Tsar is far away.

options.name: Militarize the remaining garrisons, and hold at all costs!
Leave the region to the local warlords' mercy.
Withdraw in the face of the nascent Caucasian states.
Abandon the mountains to the Transcaucasian intelligentsia.

events.title: Catastrophe in the Caucasus

events.desc: The defeat of the … armies has enabled our liberation of all of … under the rule of the … …. The road lies open for the ultimate triumph of the ….
events.flavor: By the will of the Almighty, the Absolute Governor... the unbelievers have been scattered, the crown of their Emperor stained with the blood of his fallen hordes.

options.name: Begin efforts to convert and integrate our new Russian neighbors.
We must find a way to adapt to this new peace.

events.title: Holy Peace

events.desc: An incursion we have launched from … into the territory claimed by … has failed. The units dispatched have withdrawn, after suffering heavy losses amongst the rough Caucasian terrain.
events.flavor: "They were in the trees - they had to have been warned before we began. They waited for us to be engulfed in that damned forest, before opening fire on us... the Major fell first, and our horses were cut down. How are we to manage this, sir? How are we to take this land, when we cannot say we control any land outside that shadowed by our own feet?"

options.name: Cover the retreat with fire and cannon.
Withdraw the forces and quietly regroup.

events.title: Failed Incursion into …

events.desc: A convoy dispatched to provide needed ammunition and supplies to our forces in … has been ambushed by the forces of …. In the struggle, much of its cargo was lost.
events.flavor: By the time the relief force had arrived, the bodies had already begun to rot. Men and horses were entangled where they had fallen, their belongings stripped and carried away by enterprising hands. As they lay there, the highway was no longer a territory of Russia, nor of any man at all - for its subjects were maggots, and its sovereign the Lord of the Flies.

options.name: Seize resources from the locals to make up the deficit.
Hold fast, and wait for a better-protected convoy.

events.title: Caucasian Supply Convoy Raided

events.desc: An incursion we have launched into the territory claimed by … has succeeded, with several villages controlled by the mountaineers burnt to the ground, and the enemy fleeing.
events.flavor:
In the evening, the soldiers entered a town nestled between two mountains - humble, but prosperous, surrounded by fields of hardy crops.

In the morning, they left behind nothing but charred-black skeletons, surrounded by a desolate ring of ash.

options.name: Let none survive our scrutiny.
We have made them inclined enough to submit.

events.title: Successful Incursion into …

events.desc: Cowed by our forces and unwilling to fight any longer, a … tribe formerly loyal to … has sworn fealty to ….
events.flavor: I, the below named, promise and swear by Almighty God, on His Holy Gospels, that I am in awe of, and bound to his Imperial Majesty, my true and innate most gracious great sovereign Emperor …, Autocrat of All the Russias, and to His Imperial Highness' lawful heir to the throne of All the Russias.

options.name: It is a pity that they did not decide this sooner.
Permit their settlement in our controlled territories.

events.title: … Tribe Swears Fealty

events.desc: The newly-promoted Lieutenant General … has issued a memorandum to the Tsar, speaking in favor of expelling or exterminating the entire … population of the Caucasus.
events.flavor: "The fulfillment of this thought would have a triple or fourth goal: firstly, to rid the Caucasian plateau of the always hostile population and thereby open beautiful and fertile places for our Cossack population; secondly, to give the natives themselves a better position, to ensure their future, which they now do not have, because, as they arrived in Turkey, they were left to fend for themselves..."

options.name: Endorse the memorandum, and escalate the expulsions.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: This measure will make the mountains forever ungovernable.

events.title: The … Memorandum

events.desc: The multi-national nature of …'s imamate has proven irresistable to many of our subjects in …. Officers and landowners alike have reported numerous defections to the Imamate.
events.flavor:
"The mistreatment of our military deserters by the Chechens kept many unreliable soldiers, and especially the Poles, from running away; but if now they find out that Shamil gives freedom to deserters, then I'm afraid that the runs will increase. I would think to keep the soldiers from escaping the first captured deserters to be shot. I, together with this, ordered all private commanders to aggravate supervision of unreliable soldiers and report to me immediately about those who make an escape."

— Melenty Yakovlevich Olshevsky

options.name: Tighten security in the region, to avert further defections.
We will not build further bad will amongst the people.

events.title: Defections to the …

events.desc: With full-scale invasion by the … state becoming a near certainty, a … national parliament has been assembled in …, in order to elect a single ruler and coordinate the unified resistance of all Circassia.
events.flavor: Even if we lose many of our brave warriors, we have men and young boys to replace them! Worst case, we will be unable to use our rifles because we have no gunpowder and ammo. Even so, we will fight with swords and daggers in hand! We will never obey the enemies! Even if the whole world abandons us and we are cornered to the last point of our homeland, it will still be seen what the Adyghe are capable of. If necessary, we will have to mercifully take the lives of our women and children with our own hands so that they do not fall into the hands of the enemy and be met by various worse pains. And then, to avenge them, we too must perish.

options.name: It is by our spirit that we will resist to the end.
We must appeal to foreign powers to assist our struggle.
We will forever stand alongside our Eastern brothers!

events.title: The Parliament of Independence

events.desc: The small Caucasian proto-state of …, which has been embroiled in a long conflict with …, has sent a request for military aid to our nation. Promising recognition of their struggle could assist in weakening Russian control over the region.
events.flavor: These lands are ours, and we want to rule them with absolute justice. We strive to administer our country fairly, therefore we treat our people fairly and respect the lives and property of those who visit us.

options.name: We will regard this conflict with interest.
We have no reason to involve ourselves.

events.title: The Circassian Call

events.desc: With the death of our former … and on the request of many of the …, the … has dispatched a particularly distinguished naib to further ties between our nations, and lead … in its struggle.
events.flavor: Upon the third month of hearing our calls to the East for a teacher to light our way, he arrived, his presence like a titan, and his will like a storm of fire.

options.name: We will be honored to unite with our brothers in Islam.
Our struggle is first and foremost a national one.

events.title: The Imamate's Emissary

events.desc: A detachment of largely … and … volunteers from … … have traveled to … aboard the steamship Kangaroo, seeking to aid in our struggle as volunteer soldiers against the … invaders.
events.flavor: "In a person's life there are some premonitions and desires, which, despite all their seeming improbability, sometimes come true. I experienced it first hand. When I emigrated in, I had an obsessive idea to go to the Caucasus. I was then not yet more than twenty-two years old, and the almost romantic legends of Shamil and the mountain heroes who resist the gigantic power of Russia in such small numbers made a deep impression on me. I was looking for means to connect with them, and wherever I was - in Germany, England or France, I tried to find an ally for this idea and arouse interest in it. I was considered a reckless dreamer and set up as an example to me some of my countrymen and a few desperate daredevils of the English..."

options.name: Grant their leader a role as commander, and send him to the front.
We would be well served by training in … tactics.

events.title: The Kangaroo Expedition

events.desc: Through intrigue, deft diplomacy, and decisive warfare, we have brought the Great Game to a favorable conclusion. Our victory has brought … glory, and … humiliation on the world stage.
events.flavor:
Even the … newspapers were saying it, now. The headlines that once spun even great setbacks into subtle victories and bouts of revanchism seemed subdued, solemnly reporting on foreign affairs as if … hegemony had been something that had always existed. The Ambassador looked at the spread of papers, and turned to a clerk who was barely repressing his own excitement.

"Get me a copy for myself," he said, "I'd like to put that one on my wall."

options.name: A jewel in our crown to match none other.

events.title: The Great Triumph

events.desc: Decisive … victories across the fields of the Great Game have caused … immense humiliation on the world stage. The conflict is over, and it has ended with our defeat.
events.flavor: "We spent the past decades in a magnificent daydream, aimlessly blundering from one artless interference to another. With one hand we swiped at goals held just out of our reach, and with the other alienated those who were once receptive. The Great Game could never have been won - our early failings had crippled us long before we saw them for what they were, before we were even aware that we were playing."

options.name: Have our halcyon days passed?

events.title: A Great Defeat

events.desc: Despite enormous expenditures in the battle for international influence, neither … nor … has achieved a decisive victory in the Great Game. Both sides have emerged from the conflict bruised and unable to best the other.
events.flavor:
Even before the Game was halfway through, there had been tell-alls published about it. Explorers' journals, musing about what they had seen in Bukhara or Kabul. No consensus had ever been reached, though there were periods where some ephemeral triumph had made it fashionable to proclaim a British or Russian advantage.

One was being reached now, however, and it was one that neither nation was proud of. The Great Game as a folly. From there, it would only be one short step towards a new game, one of finding a politician to blame.

options.name: Far too little to gain.

events.title: Stalemate

events.desc: The Great Game which once treated our homelands as a playing-field between foreign powers has been brought to an end. The last … and … forces have departed Central Asia, forced out not by the other's machinations, but by our own hands.
events.flavor: In this day, newspapers were easier to come by. The minister had accumulated quite a collection - the Times of …, the … Record, the Correspondent from Paris. Last week, they had reported on the return of a military expedition. This week, on the resignation of his counterpart in the …. A dozen minor stories which hinted at their painful reality. They had failed, and were trying to save face. They, ever-haughty, may be unwilling to say it outright - but he knew nonetheless, and he expected their own people did as well.

options.name: They will address us as equals, now and forever.

events.title: No More Games

events.desc: Rebellious representatives of the Kazakh Zhuzes have proclaimed the restoration of a unified …, under the Khan …. The uprising threatens our interests across the entire Central Asian steppe.
events.flavor:
Twenty thousand men from three hundred tribes stand astride their horses in the East, prepared to ride against their invaders.

And at their head, the Khan Kenesary, raised upon white felts by his loyalists in three Zhuzes, pledges that he shall never return to his home whilst the Tsar dares call his lands his property.

options.name: Rally the loyal sultans, and crush this revolt!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: The Kazakh people will never submit to invaders!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Kazakh Revolt

events.desc: A Cossack-escorted caravan moving across the steppes of … has been assaulted by a large and well-trained band of Kazakh rebels, led by the aristocrat ….
events.flavor:
They came in the night, descending upon the camp from all sides, a contingent of horsemen hundreds strong and so sudden in appearance that it was as if they had been birthed from the seas of grass which surrounded the tents. They slaughtered the pickets within moments, blades clashing and gunshots exchanged between standardized muskets produced in the weapon shops of Tula, and a bewildering array of firearms sourced from half of a continent's leftovers.

It only took moments for the cacophony to fade and the riders to vanish, leaving behind only smoldering cloth, and two dozen scarred survivors.

options.name: Place the border lines on alert.

events.title: The Ride of …

events.desc: With the pacification of the rebel Khanate and the execution of Kenesary Khan, the … state may now uncontestedly project power through the entirety of the Kazakh lands.
events.flavor:
Stones, weep! Silence, dawn!
Collapse, proud cliffs!
Be still, merry song of the brook!
There is no Kenesary, the messenger of heaven-
He is dead, now.

options.name: We must drive ever further into Turkestan.
Consolidate our gains here, before proceeding.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Silent Steppes

events.desc: A detachment of Siberian cossacks in … has been ambushed and slaughtered by a band of rebel Kazakh horsemen flying the banner of ….
events.flavor: "Everywhere, there is disorder. It comes partly from an unforgivable oversight and partly of the cowardice of the Cossacks, who vainly try to inflate the warring forces in words, to justify to some extent their condemnable carelessness."

options.name: Provide recompense to the … for the caravan.
It is the responsibility of the Kazakhs to secure their own lands.

events.title: Cossack Patrol Attacked

events.desc: One of our fortresses in the steppes of … has been raided by a group of Kazakh rebels under …. After capturing the fortress and scattering the garrison, the rebels have mercilessly razed the nearest Russian settlements.
events.flavor:
As the scout's horse sidled up to what had been the gate, he beheld what was left behind. A layer of ash still covered the ruin, deposited by the fire that had charred and blackened the timbers and earthworks that formed the walls. There had been no rain since the fortress had been burned, leaving the ash to preserve what was left.

Where there had been a fortress, there was now a tomb. Where there had been a garrison, there was now only the enduring stench of smoke.

options.name: The locals are solely responsible for this disaster.
We must dedicate more resources to protecting our interests.

events.title: Border Fortress Raided

events.desc: The rebel forces of … have raided a group of loyal auls in …, spreading terror amongst those Kazakh people who remain loyal to Senior Sultan …'s administration.
events.flavor: "How are we to claim loyalty to you, who pockets the Russians' coin, hiding behind Russian guards, in a town built by Russians? Why should we feel the fear that you so rightfully do?"

options.name: He brings desolation upon his own people.
We must request further assistance from the ….

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: Loyal Auls Slaughtered

events.desc: The would-be Khan of the Kazakhs, …, has sent a correspondence to …, requesting an alliance with … against his rivals in Russia and Kazakhstan.
events.flavor: "Time after time, I have requested peacefulness and friendship from the Russian Tsar and his subjects, and yet they have demonstrated no pure intentions. Their desire to dominate our homes grows year by year - for this year it will be Russian fortresses on the river Irtysh, but the next it will be the Sarysu."

options.name: The Russians and their vassals are a threat to us all.
We will not have a part in his struggle.

events.title: The Khan's Correspondence

events.desc: A Kazakh insurgent force loyal to … has attempted to launch a raid on a … fortress in …, before being repelled by the local garrison.
events.flavor:
When the riders crested the horizon, the garrison was already in position. In disciplined rows atop the walls, a hail of musket fire met the devastating initial charge, and cossack horsemen joined the lethal dance in its wake.

When the terror was over, men and horses alike were left screaming, the steppe grass watered with the blood of its sons.

options.name: Commend the soldiers for their brave defense.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

options.name: General … deserves the credit for his actions.

events.title: Kazakh Raid Repelled

events.desc: South of the Kazakh steppe lies the khanates of Central Asia, the next set of barriers arresting … power projection into India and the Middle East. By any means necessary, the …'s government intends to bring them into our fold.
events.flavor: "It is neither ambitious plans and nor selfish calculations that guide Russia in its forward movement into Central Asia, but only the desire to pacify that region, give an impetus to its productive forces, and open the shortest route for the sale of the products of Turkestan to the European part of Russia."

options.name: It is best to take a more honeyed approach.
Turkestan must submit to the …, by peace or by war.

events.title: The Conquest of Turkestan

events.desc: With the opening of Central Asian trade avenues to … India and the Middle East, these routes remain impeded only by the state of …. Several hawkish figures in the … have proposed the state as a potential protectorate.
events.flavor: It is my fear that the acquisition of these vast lands will only spur more terror into the hearts of the …, and that yet more wars may be ignited over those nations which cling to their status as buffers between our empires. Peace between us must be reached - but it by treaty, or by their total capitulation.

options.name: Kabul, too, will be … one day.
We would better be served by a more subtle approach.

events.title: The Great Game

events.desc: Despite the general recognition of our suzerainty over Turkestan by most peoples in the region, … tribes to our south continue to raid our lands without fear of reprisals and refuse to submit to our authority. To rectify this injustice, … … has announced the start of a great expedition into Turkmen lands.
events.flavor: Jabbing his finger at the map laid out on the table between them all, the general sneered. "There!" he thundered, "There is where we strike! That nest of robbery and destruction! It has been a hindrance to our ambitions and our grace for far too long." He waved towards the mass of men and guns just beyond the fabric walls of the tent. "Prepare the horses. We move at dawn's light tomorrow."

options.name: Let us show these raiders Russian steel.

events.title: The Turkmen Scourge

events.desc: … inspired by the philosophy of Donghak have begun to organize across …. Their calls for social equality, religious tolerance, and the expulsion of foreign influence have become more and more difficult to ignore.
events.flavor:
Moving to the year of Xinyou, scholars from all directions approached me, asking, "With the divine spirit descending, master, what does this mean?"

I replied, "It embraces the principle of inexhaustible return."

"Then, by what name do we call this way?"

"It is the Way of Heaven."

"Is it different from the Western way?"

"Western learning has its differences, like incantations without substance. Yet, the movement is the same, the way is unified, but the principle is not."

options.name: Does another peasant war loom?

events.title: Donghak

events.desc: Discontent amongst the … has spiraled into the beginnings of open conflict. Across …, peasants have used Donghak infrastructure to organize themselves for revolution.
events.flavor:
The orders had been circulated to everyone in the town. They were to drive to … as quickly as they could, expel the foreigners, and kill every member of the … family.

This was to be a merciful march, sparing innocents and their property, paying for their supplies, and demonstrating their loyalty and piety to all who saw them. It was as far from the conduct of the government soldiers as could be.

options.name: Call up troops, and prepare for battle.

events.title: The Donghak Rebellion

events.desc: A new doctrine, Donghak, has emerged in the province of …, advocated for by …. It calls for equality for all and the establishment of paradise on Earth.
events.flavor: "With the West's victories and conquests, success seems inevitable, yet it brings about the destruction of all, a lament of inevitable downfall. How can we then secure the nation and bring peace to its people? Alas, in this era, people are unaware of their fortunes; hearing these words, some may enter in agreement while others may dissent, discussing in alleys, a fear stemming from a lack of virtue."

options.name: A balm for the people's woes.
A deceiver and a danger to the world.

events.title: Eastern Learning

events.desc: Donghak believers have petitioned the government of … … for a slate of reforms. They include religious tolerance, expulsion of foreigners, and execution of corrupt officials.
events.flavor:
The … had become familiar with the followers of Donghak through reports of their organizing in the countryside and the innumerable small petitions and letters that had been sent to both … and … officials. All of them trended in the same way - statements of nothing but the utmost loyalty to …, followed by explanations of their requests.

It was not the first of its kind, … mused, but it was certainly the most high-profile. His options were twofold. Alienate the newly organized peasantry, or draw the ire of his own court?

options.name: Threaten reprisals if they do not disperse.
The … will hear this petition.

events.title: Gg Korea 4

events.desc: Through careful reform and cooperation with the …, we have successfully mollified the Donghak movement. … shall stand isolated from the world, but it shall do so in harmony.
events.flavor:
The last ships were gone from the ports, and the gates had been drawn shut. Somewhere over the sea, some European merchant had surely entered a state of shock, and was sending letters to every government official that he knew. The Westerners would return - that was a certainty, and it was equally certain that they would return heavily armed.

There was something new about the people of …, though, a sort of invisible energy that followed them as they went about their day. They were no longer afraid of the ships and guns, and they no longer considered one another their greatest threat. When the Westerners returned, there would be no internal fracture to leverage - and what expeditionary force could conquer a reserve army of millions?

options.name: We have enforced justice and fellowship.
We will build Heaven amongst the mountains.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: Heaven Through Patience

events.desc: After an unacceptable amount of time waiting for promised reforms, the patience of the Donghak movement has run dry. The attitude of the … is now one of betrayal, and budding revolt.
events.flavor:
They had lost another messenger. Despite the hopes of his family, the inspector suspected that they would never see him again. Tax collectors, census-takers, messengers, policemen - all of them had begun to disappear in this region, if they strayed too far from the roads. It was never all of them, but it was enough - the atmosphere within the barracks had transitioned from cool indifference to terror, and that did not seem as if it would change.

Rather than a unified country, … had begun to seem like an archipelago of cities linked by the thinnest of webs, surrounded by a vast and terrible sea of contempt.

options.name: We must live with the consequences.

events.title: Out to Dry

events.flavor: Once the telegram had arrived, the entire room had sprung into motion. The report from … was long and painful - in ordinary circumstances, those who read it would have felt like the air was being sucked out of their lungs. Not now, however. They knew that they were not the only ones reading it, and that on the other side of the East Sea, their rivals were making precisely the same preparation. Whether by land or by sea, it was now a game of who would mobilise fastest.

options.name: The … government must be upheld.
The rebellion will further our interests in victory.
We have no interest in this.

events.title: Gg Korea 7

events.desc: Our defeat of the rebellion in … has given us opportunity to dictate a favorable post-war order. Demanding that … officially recognise …'s independence will allow us to consolidate influence in the region much more effectively.
events.flavor:
"The Yangban are hopeless, by and large, but some ministers are receptive to more modern sensibilities."

"Who?"

"…, …, possibly …. We have plenty of candidates for an emergency cabinet. They'll be overjoyed to get a chance to enact what they please."

options.name: Send the demands.
We should not compromise our relationship with ….

events.title: Opportunities in …

events.desc: The … government has sent us a list of demands, chiefly among them our withdrawal from …. Their demands are backed by their remaining forces in the Korean peninsula, which have refused to withdraw following the defeat of the rebellion.
events.flavor:
The printer regarded the edict with some dread. It represented a rolling bank of smoke, each line becoming more and more ominous. Events building to a dark crescendo, chaos spiraling into revolt. The … were condemned in the strictest of terms, their transgressions laid out like the rifles in a firing squad.

"Difficult to rationalize", "unprovoked", "lack of satisfactory explanation". The tortured euphemisms of a distressed government. One which, barring a sudden change of course, was inexorably drifting towards war.

options.name: Korea is a liability we would be glad to rid ourselves of.
We will not accept another foreign concession.

events.title: … Demands Withdrawal from …

events.desc: Despite his young age, … … has been struck by a bout of severe illness. … rapid deterioration has sparked fears that … is not long for this world.
events.flavor: It had not been the first bout of illness he had faced, or even the fifth. The state of the King had come to mirror that of the country from the moment he took the throne - as it was wracked by floods and monsoons, so was he by spells of disease, or reports of corruption and treason within the court. Sometimes, he feared he would leave no legacy, that a reign spent solely combating crisis was one that his successors would regard as a waste. He may have been wrong, he thought, for perhaps he would not have any successors at all.

options.name: The line of Jeongjo has come to an end.
… doctors must know of some treatment.

events.title: The Ailing King

events.desc: The deaths of every one of …'s male children and a lack of close relatives to claim the throne has left the sickly …'s succession uncertain. The Andong Kim clan has nominated … as … successor.
events.flavor:
"Bedridden again, without an heir. Is there any hope at all?"

"He does what he may, but our hopes may be misplaced. Did you hear of the other day's occurrence, with the magistrate?"

"I have not. Tell me."

"He had to remind the King of who he was, and begged him to preserve his rule. I was angry at first - but now, I cannot blame him at all."

options.name: The House of Yi will endure.

events.title: The Empty House

events.desc: …, the politically outspoken official wife of … …, has carved a strong position out for herself in the … court. Her patronage will strongly benefit the ….
events.flavor:
"On each occasion I was impressed with the grace and charming manner of the Queen, her thoughtful kindness, her singular intelligence and force, and her remarkable conversational power even through the medium of an interpreter. I was not surprised at her singular political influence, or her sway over the … and many others. She was surrounded by enemies, all embittered against her because by her talent and force she had succeeded in placing members of her family in nearly all the chief offices of State.

Her life was a battle. She fought with all her charm, shrewdness, and sagacity for power, for the dignity and safety of her husband and son, and for the downfall of those who opposed her."

options.name: Her patronage will be instrumental to modernization.
She should focus on her courtly duties.

events.title: Queen Min

events.desc: With the eastern borders of … restored in full, … … has overseen the final righting of a great historical wrong.
events.flavor: From the fertile oases of Chorasmia, through Khorasan's ancient cities, to the Turanian heartlands across the Oxus: Persia's ancient eastern provinces once again answer to their rightful master.

options.name: The great wealth of the east shall fuel our progress.
Let these ancient intellectual centers flourish once more.
Ya Ali! The west tremble at the lion's roar.

events.title: Land of the Rising Sun

events.desc: In spite of stiff Afghan resistance and the machinations of foreign powers, the great city of … has fallen to … might at last.
events.flavor:
"Consider this world an ocean,
And Khorasan an oyster within.
And the city of Herat,
The pearl in its midst."

options.name: The gate to the East have been breached. Now press on.

events.title: Pearl of Khorasan

events.desc: For too long have the … tribes to our north been allowed to raid our lands without fear of reprisals. To rectify this injustice, … … has announced the start of a great northern pacification campaign.
events.flavor:
In pained rhythmic steps, the chained make their way across the Karakum desert; its great silence broken only by the occasional jeer of their Turkmen captors, and their own plaintive cries; 

"The alaman have taken us,
Poor, poor Qizilbash!
And carry us, and carry us,
In iron and chains, in iron and chains
To Gurgench and Bokhara."

options.name: Let us show these raiders Persian steel.

events.title: The Turanian Scourge

events.desc: The government of … has requested we dispatch a military mission to help modernize their army, offering certain diplomatic and extraterritorial consessions in return.
events.flavor:
"A dozen guns, some thousand rifles, as well as enough shot and cartridges for five years of regular use?
"That's right, sir."
"I see. And the second set of luggage?"
"Fife, drum, and brass, sir. We'll have them trotting along to the … in no time."

options.name: This serves our interests. Dispatch a mission post-haste.
Politely decline their request.

events.title: Persia Requests Military Mission

events.desc: With the capture of …, we have encountered large numbers of … slaves. Their relatives clamor for their freedom, but manumission will likely result in their current Turkic masters' anger.
events.flavor:
"Agha, years back, while on assignment, I stood in a Bukharan bazaar observing the sale of a young Persian girl—lost in grief and treated with the grossest brutality by her master.

Then I was powerless. A stranger in their lands, without the means to ransom her. My heart burned, and I became nothing. 'Inshaallah' I swore, 'a day will come'."

options.name: Bismillah, unshackle every Persian found.
Free them, and facilitate their relocation.
Leave them in place, they are not worth the trouble.

events.title: The Slaves of …

events.desc: The strategically located city of …, named the 'Key to India' by some in our administration, has been captured by troops belonging to … … of ….
events.flavor: "It is of the opinion of I, your humble servant, and of the other gentlemen present, that should an enemy power attempt an invasion of India from the West, it would do so by way of Persia and therefore Herat. Thus, we urge you to consider the option of demanding an immediate Persian retreat from the city, under the threat of an armed response."

options.name: Threaten the Persians with war if they do not vacate Herat.
That city is not worth the bones of a single British grenadier.

events.title: … Occupies Herat

events.desc: Once more the bazaars of … bustle with activity, echoing the city's glorious past. With wealth now pouring into the oasis once again, the administration must decide how to best utilize it.
events.flavor:
"In that delightful Province of the Sun
The first of Persian lands … shines upon
Where all the loveliest children of … beam
Flowerets and fruits, blush over every stream
And, fairest of all streams, the Murga roves
Among Meron's bright palaces and groves."

options.name: Use it to restore the great dams on the river Murghab.
Merv's palaces and gardens shall be rebuilt, twice as splendorous.

events.title: Merv the Great

events.desc: An emissary from … has informed us that should … refuse to vacate …, they will consider it an act of war.
events.flavor:
In halting, yet clear Persian, the British delegate read out his government's demands to the gathered assembly. Persia was to withdraw from Herat within three months. Additionally, she was to relenquish all pretensions of sovereignty over the territory and the city of Herat, and never again to demand from her chiefs any mark of obedience such as coinage or tribute.

Behind the emissary, courtiers shuffled anxiously around. They did not know what the …'s response would be. But no matter what, they knew it would mean trouble.

options.name: Let these Farangi come if they dare.
Back down, we can not afford war with the ….

events.title: Britain Demands Withdrawal from Herat

events.desc: Abolitionist thinkers from across the nation have come together to propose that simply abolishing slavery is insufficient in extending freedom to those once in shackles. They propose a plan of desegregation and reparations to mend the gaps between the races.
events.flavor: Though the chains of slavery have been broken in this fine nation, there are still shackles which bind our people. Centuries of subjugation have meant that our Afro-American citizens live eternally in the shadow of the plantation, without power over their own destinies. Only through active state efforts to mitigate the mistakes of the past can we hope to create a true nation of equals and form an even more perfect union.

options.name: They have bootstraps with which to be lifted, do they not?
These problems cannot be solved without redistribution of political and economic power.

events.title: A More Perfect Union

events.desc: With the finalization of the last Neo-Absolutist reform, … stands poised to enter a new golden age. Its peoples, forsaking factional nationalism, instead rally beneath the banner of enlightened and judicious governance.
events.flavor:
"The welfare of the individual is grounded in the welfare of the whole: but the welfare of the whole also rests on the welfare of the individuals."

— Joseph von Sonnenfels

options.name: Hail! Hail the …! Long live … enlightened rule!

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: … endures through the wisdom and duty of her devoted bureaucrats.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction
Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Rule of Quill and Bayonet

events.desc: The patience of the … establishment has run out. Frustrated by the perceived mismanagement of the Neo-Absolutist faction, they demand the immediate granting of a constitution.
events.flavor: The sharp clacking of boots echoed through the halls of the Hofburg, where ministers and bureaucrats moved with mounting urgency. Doors swung open and shut in rapid succession, and hushed discussions swelled into heated arguments. Disorder in the outer administrative circle had long been a common feature of the Austrian administration. But the inner? This was outside the norm. Outside the norm, and dangerous.

options.name: Accede to their demands. The stability of the Empire comes first.
They demand? Threaten to charge them with treason.

rewards.name: Unrest in the Ministry of Finance

events.title: No Constitution, No Money

events.desc: The independence of … has unleashed a wave of ethnic unrest across our nation. Inspired by the developments in …, nationalists all across … have risen against ….
events.flavor:
Of the four garrisons under his command, only one had preserved its honor and remained fully loyal. The rest had either scattered like cowards or, worse, turned traitor.

Mutineers. Dogs. He would hang them all if given the chance.

"Herr Feldmarschall! Your command?"

The words snapped the general from his thoughts. He exhaled sharply. "These uprisings are nothing new. The Empire has survived greater threats. Set up a perimeter and bring me a courier, I will have my orders from … without delay."

options.name: The periphery is lost, pull back to the Erblande.
Retreat from Hungary, but not an inch further.

events.title: Crisis on the Danube

events.desc: A compromise has been reached. As per the agreement, … is to be restructured into the Dual Monarchy of …-…, divided into a Transleithanian territory ruled from … and a Cisleithanian one ruled from ….
events.flavor:
Standing among his peers, the count watched as … …, in full regalia, rode forward toward the artificial coronation hill, its soil drawn from every corner of his native Hungarian land. He had come out of duty, not devotion, yet as the … reached the summit, there was a weight to the moment that he had not expected.

As the … raised … sword, slashing once in each cardinal direction while loudly swearing to protect the kingdom and all its subjects, something stirred in him. It was not loyalty, he thought. Perhaps respect.

options.name: Establish Transleithania.
Establish Transleithania in full union with the Triune Kingdom.
Keep the Triune Kingdom under direct … control.

events.title: Ausgleich

events.desc: With the government's abandonment of the Neo-Absolutist project, its erstwhile supporters now find themselves discredited in the eyes of the nation.
events.flavor:
With a practiced hand, the minister put his signature to the document. For the final time? The thought lingered. He sighed. The crises had been to many, the rot too entrenched. If they only had been given a decade more, perhaps two, then the brilliance of their work would become apparent to all.

As he handed the document to his secretary, his fingers hesitated, his grip tightening. For a moment, his hand resisted, unwilling to let go of the paper.

Then he let it slip.

options.name: Their ideas may have been wrong, but their methods had merit.

rewards.name: Legacy of the Rule by Quill

options.name: Leave them in place in the security services.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

rewards.name: Legacy of the Rule by Bayonet

options.name: Publicly distance ourselves from them.

events.title: Relics of a Bygone Age

events.desc: With the formal joining of Buda, Pest, and Óbuda into one, the new metropolis of Budapest is experiencing a boom unlike any before in the history of …, with capital and know-how flowing into the city.
events.flavor:
"The capital will only be powerful if it has a governing power, it will be prosperous in its life, if it is guided by one soul, one will in its pursuits, it will only be happy if the separate interests melt into a common interest."
—Bertalan Szemere

options.name: Pannonia is our bread-basket, and Budapest its beating heart.
Borúra derű, may Budapest guide the path for our nation.

events.title: Pearl of the Danube

events.desc: Following an assembly in Sremski Karlovci, representatives of the … nation in … have risen in revolt, intent on carving out a Serbian-ruled realm north of the river Sava.
events.flavor:
"Scattered in a hundred directions—on a hundred sides, everyone could rule over us, while we could not even rule over ourselves, as if we had never governed our own fate!"
—Nikanor Grujić

options.name: Mobilize the army and strike these Viennese lapdogs down.
For the Honored Cross and Golden Liberty!
Recognize … … as our local governor.

events.title: Serbian Uprising

events.desc: From their assembly in Myjava, the … National Council has declared their intent to separate from …, calling for a general Slovak uprising.
events.flavor:
"We have long served as a plaything of devilish politics, which deliberately divided us and constantly incited conflict among us so that we would fall by our own fault... We have matured, we have recognized our rights, and we want to defend them bravely."
—Ľudovít Štúr

options.name: Our army will make short work of these traitors.
Sláva! Šetkým Slovakom!
Promise the Slovaks autonomy for fealty.

events.title: Slovak Uprising

events.desc: In a bold move, the … Diet has proclaimed the Union of … with Hungary. However, the approval of the Diet in … is needed for the union to enter into effect, causing pro-Union … and … delegates to scramble to secure the required votes.
events.flavor:
If God had intended him to work today, He wouldn’t have sent such a ruckus his way, Ioan thought. Looking up from the ledger once more, he picked up his pipe, took a puff, and gazed out the window.

Outside the Reduta Palace, the crowd had grown even larger. Made up mostly of local Szeklers and Hungarians, some of whom Ioan recognized, their cries of 'Union or Death!' reverberated through the streets.

Bad business, he thought. Bad for business too. His hot-tempered son, along with two of his apprentices, had already left the city for some 'national gathering' in Blaj of all places. No, Ioan thought, chewing on his pipe, this will not end well at all.

options.name: Igen. The Diet votes for unification.
Nem. The proposal is rejected in a close vote.

events.title: Hungary Calls for Union

events.desc: Following a vote in the regional Magyar-dominated Diet, Transylvania has elected to join … in a union.
events.flavor:
'Union or Death' they had declared the week before. Suicide by vote, he thought, they should have shouted 'Union and Death' instead. Was it just? Perhaps. Was it legal? Arguably. Was it sensible? Absolutely not.

Knowing his luck, the combined ire of both … and Vienna would now come crashing down on his little corner of the world, and there was nothing he could do to stop it.

options.name: Transylvania is an inalienable part of the Hungarian Crown.
Allow the retention of local privileges, for now.
Very well. Accept the decision of the Diet.
They are out of line! Demand the immediate evacuation of Transylvania.

events.title: Transylvania Ratifies Union with Hungary

events.desc: Threatening military action, the government in … has unlawfully and unilaterally annulled our recent reforms and now demands we fall back in line.
events.flavor:
Having read the missive from … aloud, the Austrian envoy clacked his boots together and bowed to the assembled Hungarian dignitaries.

The demands were clear: the time for negotiations had passed. Either the Hungarian Diet would undo the reform, or the Austrian army would undo it for them.

options.name: This is the final straw. Magyars, to arms!
We have no choice but to accept.

events.title: An Austrian Ultimatium

events.desc: The bugle sounds across the … realm with thousands of volunteers flocking to newly established recruitment offices. As regimental lists fill up, newly promoted generals bicker among themselves over how to best utilize them.
events.flavor:
Where our grave mounds lie,
Our grandchildren will kneel,
And with blessing prayer,
Recite our sainted names.
By the God of the Hungarians
We vow,
We vow, that we won't be slaves
any longer!

— Sándor Petőfi, Nemzeti dal

options.name: It is for the homeland we fight, it is there we shall shed our blood.
Who dares, wins. We must take the fight to the enemy.

events.title: On Your Feet, Magyar

events.desc: Deeply displeased with the unification of Transylvania and …, thousands of … notables and commoners have gathered in Blaj and declared their intention to take up arms against ….
events.flavor:
Mihai pulled a small field glass from his coat and adjusted the lens. From his vantage point on the Hill of the Vineyards he could see the great host of men that had gathered in and around the town. Thousands, at least, and if their garb was any clue, hailing from all over Transylvania and beyond.

The sound of a branch snapping interrupted his observations. Steps? Looking over his shoulder, he saw none of the moți bruisers who had given him trouble earlier that day. Those bastards could not ambush a lame sow, he thought, as the cudgel came down and split his skull open.

options.name: Curse these traitors. Dispatch the army.
Libertate sau Moarte!
Reaffirm Transylvania as an autonomous crown land.

events.title: Transylvanian Revolt

events.desc: In a shocking move, the progressives-dominated Diet of … has put a series of laws into effect, whose radical nature threatens to undermine our rule of the nation.
events.flavor:
The details of the news coming out of … varied as much as the reactions of those who received them. A great leap toward a liberal future, or a stumble into chaos and anarchy? An act of sedition, or an inspiration for the rest of the Empire? A defiant declaration, or a cowardly stab in the back?

He himself knew not, but he feared the reaction from the Hofburg would be anything but cordial.

options.name: We have more pressing matters to worry about.
Declare the laws illegal, and demand their immediate revocation.

events.title: Hungarian Spring

events.desc: With the ascension of … as … of …, … predecessor's perceived lax stance towards … has been called into question. Many now urge the new … to revoke the recent laws passed by the Hungarian Diet.
events.flavor:
Is approval given under duress truly approval at all?
Is the monarch bound by the foolish oaths of his predecessor?
Is he beholden to laws enacted without proper imperial authority?

In the eyes of … …, these were not true conundrums at all. The only question was: how far was he willing to go to see his vision through?

options.name: Revoke the laws and formally abolish the Diet of Hungary.
Let us not rock the boat.

events.title: The Matter of Hungary

events.desc: The … Revolution has been a resounding success, with the impact of its economic and political reforms felt around the country.
events.flavor:
Here Freedom's blood-stained flag has waved
above the Magyar head;
and here in age-long struggles fell
our best and noblest, dead.

In spite of long calamity
and centuries of strife,
our strength, though weakened, is not spent;
our country still has life.

— Szózat, Mihály Vörösmarty

options.name: Long live Hungarian freedom!
Long live the homeland!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Country of Countries

events.desc: With … independence secured at last, and with the term of the provisional government under … coming to an end, the time has come for the Diet to settle the status of the monarchy once and for all.
events.flavor:
What would become of the vacant Throne of St. Stephen? The debate had raged all afternoon, and the council was barely a step closer to a resolution. Pragmatic monarchists, ardent republicans, and every manner of Franco-, Anglo-, and Russophile had been at each others throats for days on end now, attacking each other in scathing newspaper editorials, loud exchanges, and in at least one case, in person.

But as pragmatic sensibilities chip away at conviction, once strong dividing lines are muddled, and new alliances made. And by the end of the final deliberation, a decision had been made.

options.name: Habsburgs no more. Hungary shall be a ….
A Magyar noble shall take the throne.

rewards.name: Restored the Throne of St. Stephen

options.name: Invite a … … to ….

rewards.name: Restored the Throne of St. Stephen

options.name: Good relations with … is paramount.

rewards.name: Restored the Throne of St. Stephen

options.name: A … princeling will assume the throne.

rewards.name: Restored the Throne of St. Stephen

events.title: The Crown of St. Stephen

events.desc: Building on a perceived common enmity to …, pro-… associations have become commonplace within the patriotically inclined ….
events.flavor:
The assembled gentlemen thoughfully nodded along to the words of the speaker. As long as … remains a threat, no asset to be utilized against her remains unwelcome.
For every … effort undertaken at the expense of …, is one less effort they would have to undertake themselves.

options.name: Encourage them, …'s cause is ours!
The … are entitled to their opinions.
Our relations with … must take precedence.

events.title: Enemy of My Enemy

events.desc: Looking to the … system of … with a great sense of admiration, members of the … have been flocking to pro-… societies as of late.
events.flavor: "When I speak '…', alas, the first matters that springs to the minds of many of our dear countrymen will be those pertaining to foreign politics and not domestic. However, it is to the former, and not the latter we must look for the foundations of a true and strong bond between our two nations."

options.name: There is some merit to the … system.
Mob rule has no place in ….

events.title: Lighthouse of Progress

events.desc: Within the …, … is being increasingly hailed as an example of absolutist rule exercised properly, with a near cult of reverence forming around its… … ….
events.flavor: While few of the club's members, if any, would want the … … … to rule from … under the present circumstances, they found in … a source of inspiration—a model for what … could have been, had only fate willed it differently.

options.name: We shall pay close attention to these developments.
The … have nothing to learn from this … brute.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Absolutist Ideal

events.desc: Deeply impressed with the current state of the … …, key figures within the … … have alligned with the ….
events.flavor: In the many officer clubs of …, the … … had long been respected and dreaded in equal measure. Looked to for inspiration and planned against in war games, it was not to be underestimated under any circumstances. As an adversary, it could spell ruin. But as an ally?

options.name: We have much to learn from the … ….
The loyalties of the … should lie with … alone.

events.title: The … Model

events.desc: Impressed with the … implementation of …, the …, strong pro-… sentiments have entrenched themselves within the ….
events.flavor:
"Workers, comrades. A beacon has been lit in …, burning bright for all those seeking the light of socialism, wherever they may be found.
A beacon that the forces of reaction will spare no effort in attempting to extinguish.
A beacon that we, as friends and members of the working class must shield with all our might."

options.name: Foreign, yet friend. The … worker salutes you, Comrade …
Far too willingly do our citizens lap up this poison.

events.title: Comrade …

events.desc: Viewing … ownership of … as a crime against the … nation, the … have put their weight behind the ….
events.flavor:
"There is no greater oxymoron than … …. No greater crime than the fettering of that great land to her current masters.
As long as the iron fist of … rests squarely on …, none of her inhabitants will be truly free."

options.name: Their patriotism sets an example to be followed.
We should not jeopardize our relations with ….

events.title: … is …!

events.desc: Fearing the domestic ramifications of a socialist regime in …, the … have flocked to the ….
events.flavor: "While the men of … may whisper sweet nothings of equality and liberty, the true implications of their rule is nothing but dreadful despotism. The … citizen would do well to heed this warning, lest he follow their example, and shackle himself in the name of freedom."

options.name: On this matter, the government is thoroughly alligned with the ….
Political realism, not ideology, define our international relations.

events.title: Red Peril

events.desc: The recent aquittal in … of a prominent writer charged with blasphemy and indecency has caused wide outrage in …. The … is now charging the … court system with failing to uphold the moral and religious order of the … world.
events.flavor: "The publication of this scandalous, blasphemous, and profane libel of our faith, as well as its tacit acceptance in … society, has once and for all revealed the true nature of that godless nation. I implore all upstanding citizens of faith to do your utmost in countering its malign influence on the … world, by any means necessary."

options.name: With each passing day, the … stray further from the light.
The internal affairs of … is no business of ours.

events.title: The Foundations of Tradition

events.desc: Opposed to the arbitrary and illiberal rule of the … of …, the … have fallen in with the ….

In no country is the indomitable right of every soul to strive towards its own destiny obstructed as it is in …, and in no country is a greater threat found to our own liberty than in ….
… must fall, for if it does not, we will fall in her place."

Some times, a firm hand is needed to govern well.

In any case, as the … workers unfurled their banners and marched down towards the ambassadorial quarter, their cries for the overthrow of … … reverberated through the city like they never had before.

options.name: As long as their anger is focused abroad.
Temper their rage with diplomatic action.

… needs their continued support.
… needs their continued support.

options.name: Well said! The … surely no longer needs their support.
What is so exemplary about …?

options.name: The … will benefit from their support.
The … does not need their support right now.

Excellent. The …'s will make powerful friends.

events.title: Impressive Tax Reform

The … has calculated, with utmost mastery, the dissemination of materials to secure a foothold in both the political world and the public's imagination.

With great satisfaction, a lobbyist comments: "There is no denying that the number and reach of newspapers is ever-expanding. This approach is sure to reach influential lawmakers to favor our scheme."

This is ingenious!

events.title: Ever-Increasing Influence

The facts do not call for any action to intervene.

The … send a representative on behalf of the … to converse with the newspaper editors. The representative steers the conversation away from the leaked correspondence: "Surely with the remarkable speed of the printing press another essay can be authored and distributed."

In the backdrop, the loud thrum of the printing press's cylinders carry on, indifferent to the machinations of the men who puppeteer them.

options.name: The damage is already done.
These letters should not be circulated further.

events.title: Contradictory Correspondence

… commands the attention of all in attendance. Leaders of the … welcome …'s political acumen.

… is very knowledgeable.

options.name: As long as everyone is discreet, there is no harm.
We need to restore the public's confidence.

events.title: Problematic Policing

The committee leading the investigation gather to consider the facts collected. They argue over the scandal.

options.name: The … is responsible for the agent they hired.
Perhaps it was just a clerical error.

events.title: A Disreputable Bookkeeper

events.flavor: A lobby member that has recently returned from touring … and speaking with … doctors shares more about the experience: "The medical accomplishments of … are quite spectacular. Should we take after their example, it would only improve the standing of …."

options.name: Send some of finest to study medicine in ….
Research their methodology immediately.

events.title: Advancement in Medicine

events.flavor: The official leading the investigation details his findings: "Does … have no integrity? Among the gifts sent the following was found - a half dozen parcels of cloth, a carving knife, a pocket knife, five pairs of gloves, twenty-three barrels of salt, and a dozen bottles of …'s finest cologne water. Is this not bribery in support of …'s cause?"

options.name: The … has done nothing suspect.
Perhaps their leader should step down.

events.title: Gifts Among Friends

events.desc: A man employed by a powerful member of the … is delivering lectures and pamphlets addressed to targeted constituencies in ….

options.name: Make it clear lobbies are responsible for the emissaries they hire.
Any concerns about the emissary's behavior are unfounded.

events.title: Lobbyist Lectures In …

events.desc: Private correspondence exchanged by members of the … have been published in pamphlets. The letters praise …, contrary to the intentions of the ….
events.flavor:
Frustration brews at the gathering of all the … members. Many are quick to blame the … for this mishap with the series of pamphlets distributed without their sanction.

One member challenges the fervor of the group: "Yes, this was not our intention. But is this not one minor set back in our grand undertaking?"

options.name: Good press for … is harmless.
The … should pull any remaining pamphlets.

events.title: Accidental Good Press For …

events.desc: The influx of … lobbying money into … politics has raised domestic tensions significantly. Rumors and accusations of certain politicians being … agents have become commonplace.
events.flavor:
"I often feel like it is impossible to get anything done, nowadays. I was asked about a purchase made by a cousin of mine - a woman who I have met a total of once."

"Who asked?"

"One of the Treasury's men. I told him precisely what I am telling you now."

"They seem to be on edge as of late. I'm inclined to blame that fool downstairs. Silverware from …, and he used it for a meeting with the Minister? We let him into a good thing, and he's completely ruining it for the rest of us."

options.name: Are you …, sir, or are you …?
Who's ever heard of an honest politician?

events.title: A Web of Distrust

events.desc: An anonymous author affiliated with the … has written a polemic attacking the …'s affiliation with the …. The document accuses them of being foreign agents sponsored by the … secret service.
events.flavor:
"We are inclined to assume the best, and this is an attribute which we are the last to condemn. Let us imagine a world where there is no …, and thus no …. In this world, we believe that … …'s conduct would be thoroughly righteous.

… is entitled to a good first impression. However, it is also our responsibility to be objective, and to report deficiencies where we find them. Because of this, for every coin … accepts during … visits to the … embassy, we must adjust this good first impression accordingly..."

options.name: These smears have no place in civil society.
It's true, you know.
We have investigated ourselves, and found no wrongdoing.

events.title: Accountable to Whom?

events.desc: Reports of … money arriving in the hands of domestic actors amicable to them has caused the … to issue a flurry of condemnations directed at its opponents.
events.flavor:
Vindication was a feeling that … had been feeling more and more often as of late. The reports strewn across … desk confirmed what … had been warning against for what felt like years - the penetration of … influence into the highest levels of governance. … rivals could all be said to be suspects, and … allies painted as savvy insiders.

It would take work, of course. These same confirmations would be flowing to groups other than …, and others were certain to have the same idea. It was a race, now, and he who started earliest was nearly guaranteed to finish first.

options.name: They have established themselves as a sort of authority.
Even a broken clock is occasionally right.

events.title: Proven Right

events.desc: …, a prominent ally of the …, has recently been sighted living significantly above … means. … detractors claim that … lifestyle is enabled by … "donations".
events.flavor:
One could identify …'s new residence immediately. Its freshly polished stucco was unlike the weathered facades of … neighbors, all of which transmitted a sort of timeless, quiet dignity. There was none of that in … facade, and there was none of it inside. It hosted a lavish party which seemed to blur between days without ever stopping.

The sight of it posed a question to all of who observed. It lingered in the air, palpable and pressing. How?

options.name: Order an investigation into the source of this wealth.
Perhaps … simply made some good investments.
Why would one ever choose to be poor?

events.title: Above One's Means

A fraction of them made excuses. A smaller fraction of them made good excuses, essays that presented lines of logic which sprawled out over hundreds of pages. Most of them did not. They claimed that their choice was informed by their friends, or by the atrocities of …'s enemies, or by their unerring sense of justice.

But why, then, said their critics, did they only come to this epiphany now? Why not when their coffers were lean, and all they had to their names were their principles?

None of them could think of an answer.

options.name: They had ought to be ashamed of themselves.
It is best to assume they have a better reason than that.
If an opportunity presents itself - seize it!

events.title: Unabashed Opportunism

options.name: Locate lobbies.
Manually launch a catalyst.
Manually create a lobby.
Manually create an overlord lobby.

events.flavor:
"We have allied ourselves in order to fight Communism," … said, "because they have cast themselves as enemies of democracy. Without democracy, there is no freedom. Violence, no matter who is using it, is always reactionary."

The response was anemic, applause scattered enough that one could identify the individual participants. But it was more than … had ever received from this crowd - much more.

options.name: Their patriotism sets a good example.
Their patriotism sets a good example.
They should avoid these foreign entanglements.

events.title: The Revolution Betrayed

events.flavor:
"Even they may find forgiveness, yes, but such a thing requires repentence, and the … government is the very definition of unrepentent arrogance."

"How merciful."

"And yet I show far more than their … ever did!"

He was on the warpath - that was plainly obvious to the beleaguered attaché. And if he had his way, the nation would soon be as well.

options.name: When words fail, we must bring the sword.
When words fail, we must bring the sword.
They wish to cause an international incident over this?

events.title: Our Oppressed Siblings

events.flavor:
"By our standards? With the methods they employ in their manufactories, they often find themselves saving half a man-hour per worker to produce the same output we do. The building I toured had quite an innovative lighting system, as well. Imagine, if you will, shifts being able to extend up to an hour more per day..."

His mustachioed compatriot was already pulling out a paper, drawing a line between disparate sets of calculations. When two sums were placed next to one another, he let out a low whistle.

options.name: We will make great strides together.
We will make great strides together.
Our creations far outstrip those cheap … toys.

events.title: Technical Talents

events.desc: The defeat of the … … in a revolution has broken the …'s interest in upholding the …. They have halted their advocacy for closer ties with ….

A discreet visit confirmed their worst suspicions - the building they once owned had been seized, and now housed an apathetic-sounding lawyer, his practice, and his extended family. This new man was a friend of a minister - one who had just fought for his position in a very literal sense. A moment's glimpse of the bullet holes that still speckled the facade served as a definitive statement that recompense would not be provided.

options.name: All of their work, gone in an instant.
It seems they're only the first of many.

events.title: No Longer the Same

events.flavor:
"Does the increased volume not permit for more risk?"

"Quite the opposite. When a deluge of money enters one's pockets, one becomes predisposed to mania. An extra coin to a waiter, a formerly shocking fee paid off with a smile. If one is not careful, one ceases to look at their ledgers. They pay more than they ever did - and this is the road to ruination."

"An excellent point. Will it justify the deployment of warships?"

"It had better. If it does not, perhaps a donation will."

options.name: A toast to our prosperity.
A toast to our prosperity.
Our relationship should remain strictly transactional.

events.title: Capital Interests

"In the span of months, the Communists have snuffed out the very spirit of the … nation. They have uprooted an ancient social order, and torn down monuments to culture. Our men in … were barely able to escape alive."

The attaché could believe it. The man's words seemed to carve the air itself into images of red flags, of bayonets, of smoke billowing from an embassy chimney.

"I see," he said, his tone tinged with practiced deference. "I'll assemble the board at once."

options.name: This should come to no surprise.
Could we contain the scope of this defection for now?

events.title: Former Friends

events.flavor:
"The Communists disdain to conceal their views and aims. They openly declare that their ends can be attained only by the forcible overthrow of all existing social conditions. Let the ruling classes tremble at a Communistic revolution. The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. They have a world to win.

Working Men of All Countries, Unite!"

options.name: Solidarity forever!
Their true loyalties reveal themselves.
Do what they will, we will not hear them.

events.title: Proletarian Solidarity
