events.flavor:
"I've considered the risks, and I'm willing to push it forwards. The fact of the matter is that voters do not, and have never, cared for anything outside of our borders. Even if the climate shifts heavily against … in the coming months, we may still run on our internal policy without compromising our more wide-ranging principles."

"I see the rationale. Nonetheless, I would like to know more before committing to a side. The stance our nation takes must not be informed by the whims of ideologues, but rather hard necessity."

options.name: The party stands together on this.
And be accused of foreign puppeteering?
This could benefit the party's campaigning.

events.title: Falling in Line

events.flavor:
The reports from … had been passed around the room so many times that the edges had already started to become soft. Some attendees were in awe, others more measured in their opinion. Some simply refused to believe what was written.

"I believe," said the officer at the end of the table, "that if they can manage it, so can we. Until we can, however, we had ought to take measures to make sure those guns aren't pointed at us."

options.name: The … model is one worth following.
The … model is one worth following.
They had ought to be less easily impressed.

events.title: Use of Weapons

events.desc: The … have acquired a fascination with …, regarding it as a model for modernizing the … state. Analysis of … laws and technologies fills their publications.
events.flavor:
… had developed a vision. Rail lines from … to …, planned cities with wide, gas-lit boulevards, a healthy and professional bureaucracy. The Westerners and their allies had all of this, among multitudes of other things. … could have this as well - there was nothing stopping them.

But that was not the full truth, and … was well aware of this. Every invention imported carried baggage with it, the risk of becoming a … province. How was … to strike the balance?

options.name: We have much to gain from closer ties to the West.
We have much to gain from closer ties to the West.
Their obsession threatens our sovereignty.

events.title: Foreign Inspiration

events.flavor:
"Those damnable fools! I had investments there! Does their … think … to be Napoleon? Who will be next to take advantage?"

"The Danes, I expect."

"Yes, yes, the Danes... I suppose so. Regardless, you know what to do, now."

He departed with a slammed door and a scowl. The secretary, left behind, had already prepared an envelope addressed to …. With luck, it would arrive within the month, and permit something to be salvaged of this mess.

options.name: … had every chance to choose differently.
… had every chance to choose differently.
It will take far more to atone for their mistake.
How quickly they turn tail.

events.title: The Concert Interrupted

events.flavor:
… Impressionism. The words now seemed to fit together seamlessly as French wine or Chinese silk, acquiring a meaning greater than the sum of their parts. He could spend the rest of his life in this gallery, import enough masterworks to coat every wall in his home, and yet remain just as enraptured as he was when he first laid his eyes on it.

Each painting was a window into a culture he could spend a lifetime attempting to comprehend, each brush-stroke driven by a vigor which had grown from a foreign seed. How much could he understand about … through these, if he merely had the time and ability?

options.name: What culture!
What culture!
What culture?

events.title: Artistic Inspiration

events.desc: The populist base of the … has turned against supporting foreign entanglements. Pressure from within has led the group to distance themselves from the ….
events.flavor:
… Needs First

The people say - NO to foreign entanglements, and NO to foreign treaties!

PROSPERITY at home, or CHAOS abroad? NO FOREIGN POWER could successfully attack a fortified …!

options.name: It was a mistake to rely on them.
They must steer clear of these populist tides.

events.title: The Fickle Crowd

events.flavor:
They had been in and out of the foreign minister's office all morning. Men of wealth and status, all known to the ministry, all reciting the same complaints. "The … trade war", "impediment of the free movement of goods", and "seizure of unrealized gains".

Just as he stood to flick the lock closed for the day, another knock rung out. The energy flowed out of him all at once, nearly driving him to fall onto the carpet. With a grimace, he forced himself to take another step forward, and fling open the door.

"Yes, sir. If you would have a seat..."

options.name: It is only understandable.
We will not shift our stance on command.

events.title: Buy or Else

events.flavor:
"They build all of their factories from cardboard and lead chips, and their steel is fit only for razor blades. And even then, if you use them, they're liable to give you bruises!"

The circle of men at the table roared with laughter. The man with the red cravat gave a knowing smirk, and continued with his pitch. "If we let them buy up our land, there'll be a … spy in every dormitory within the year. I know them well. I spent a month in …, you see..."

options.name: What is to be done?
A collection of paranoid children.

events.title: Good, Not Foreign

events.desc: The outbreak of armed hostilities between … and … has had disastrous effects on the …. Spearheaded by the …, its once-stalwart supporters have begun an exodus from the lobby.
events.flavor: The first shots had been fired whilst they slept, and they awoke to a world alien to the one that they departed. Within a week, all solidarity between the sides had vanished, and they began to attract nasty looks on the street whenever they approached their office. After the third hard-faced policeman who had come by to ensure they were "compliant with fire regulations", even the most stalwart of them had cracked. Cabinets were emptied and briefcases filled, and seats were left askew.

options.name: They ought to flee while their reputations remain intact.
It is best to prepare for the day this war ends.

events.title: Hard to Love

events.desc: With the attitudes of the … towards … growing more apathetic, their leadership has begun to discuss reassessing the group's support for the ….
events.flavor:
It was more difficult to get appointments at the foreign ministry, these days. The initial interest that they had inspired had long since waned, the lobby's activities falling into …'s background noise. The … were the first to lose interest, their representatives initially disheartened by an absence of news, and then no longer inclined to read the papers when they arrived.

"What reason do we have to care for happenings in …?", their younger members challenged. The elders did not know how to respond.

options.name: It is time for a change in course.
Why change something that works?

events.title: Whichever Way Forward

events.flavor:
"It is indisputable that … possesses a distinctly … character. In fact, this region belonged to several of the precursor states of whom we embody the legacy. Firstly..."

The officer sat politely as the man at the front of the lecture hall presented his dissertation. When he held up an ancient coin he claimed had been found beneath …, the audience exploded into cheers. He clapped along, but it was a solely mechanical gesture. His mind had already departed from the age of swords and sails. To retake … was a matter of the present, of gunsmoke and cannon shot. All else could be argued over afterwards.

options.name: … is rightfully …!
We firmly reject this sabre-rattling.

"All is well to be filled with dread. There is no shame in it. Their reach extends across the world like a sea monster, and devours whatever lies vulnerable before it. They achieve without fail, and menace us from seemingly every direction. We have not fallen yet, however, and there is a reason for this."

It was a frail hope indeed. … could only think of a single blade of grass left after a wildfire.

"We must look to those reasons, and wield them as a weapon. We require time to do so, and you must buy it for us."

options.name: They are right to be wary of the … threat.
Hostility could provoke just the response they fear.

events.title: Clouds on the Horizon

events.flavor:

For the man who sat across from him, the world was beginning to spin. "You're certain?"

"And one thousand two hundred for work-related travel expenses."

"...excuse me," he managed. "Could I have a copy of the manifest? I need to meet with my colleagues at once."

options.name: There is no reason to remain in the ….
Membership in the … is no longer useful.
Abandoning either would be unwise.

"I fear that it may appear as if we are using our own nation as a piece on a chessboard, for the sake of a foreign power. What would you say if pressed?"

"A circumstantial alignment will not subordinate us. In this case, … interests happen to be … interests. It is as simple as that."

options.name: We will look into this.
This is not in our interests.

events.title: … Demands Action

events.desc: The … has requested that we … …. Successfully acting on the proposal will gain our government significant goodwill from the lobby.

"And to those who would refuse, and prefer preserving the status quo?"

There was no hesitation. His response sounded well-rehearsed, because it was. This was a proactive man, one who spent hours pacing his chambers and anticipating attacks to come.

"My reply would be that we should never have allowed them to become so close to us in the first place. A friendship built upon deceit is nothing at all, and the good will gained from it illusory."

options.name: We will look into this.
This is not in our interests.

events.title: … Demands Action

events.desc: The … has offered us an opportunity to … …. The lobby has offered to use their connections to smooth the negotiating process.
events.flavor: The negotiations, done under the table with a representative of the … government, had been long and arduous. The … representative knew they were dealing with a group without power to match theirs, and had adjusted their strategy accordingly. Nonetheless, they had come to an agreement. Nothing in writing, but that was hardly important. When the government sent the official copy - if they did - they would find that there was already a drafted response waiting in ….

options.name: We would be happy to pursue this.
This is not in our interests.

events.title: … Offers Opportunity

events.desc: The … has offered us an opportunity to … …. Their proposal, if accepted, is intended to counter … interests.
events.flavor:
It was a veiled sort of aggression, one which could, in theory, appeal to both ardent jingoists and those who preferred to mitigate losses. It would force the enemy to respond, possibly drive them towards a reckless confrontation in response to a seemingly benign maneuver.

"A plan to fight … to the last …," one minister remarked. The representative flushed. He had practiced responses along both lines, but none of them quite fit.

options.name: We would be happy to pursue this.
This is not in our interests.

events.title: … Offers Opportunity

events.desc: Because the health of … … has been in decline, … has convinced … to abdicate in favour of … heir, ….
events.flavor: … kneels before the … and requests a blessing before … occupies the … throne. … regards …  successor and lays both hands on … head. With the sign of the Holy Cross, … rises. A new chapter for … begins today.

options.name: May … Imperial and Royal Apostolic Majesty's reign be a success.

events.title: … … Abdicates

events.desc: The wife of … … has birthed an Heir to the … throne.
events.flavor: The birth of the much longed-for heir is cause for celebration across all of …. … will be raised as the future … of …. This child will carry the … legacy forward.

options.name: The future of … is bright.

events.title: The Birth of an Heir

events.desc: … has been found dead with … lover at … hunting lodge.
events.flavor: With fervor and haste, police seal off the gruesome scene at the hunting lodge and launch an investigation into the circumstances of …'s death. All evidence and the dossier on the investigation must be submitted directly to the Minister for Police before it is deposited in the state archives.

options.name: Cover up the circumstances of … death at all costs.
Implicate …'s lover.

events.title: Tragedy in the Woods

events.desc: … will be hosting a Grand Exhibition in …. Advisors encourage …'s participation in this great cultural and economic exchange to establish diplomatic relations between our countries.
events.flavor:
The spokesperson spearheading the cultural affairs committee speaks with great enthusiasm about the benefits of …'s participation in the … exhibition.

"These Grand Exhibitions have been advantageous for the prestige and growth of other nations. This could very well be the first of many exhibitions in which our government officially participates. Surely all of … will benefit. Think of the advancement of our country."

options.name: Send representatives to ….
We have no time for such frivolous affairs.

events.title: The … Grand Exhibition

events.desc: …'s participation in our Grand Exhibition is sure to contribute to the success of our venture. The construction of the … Pavilion is now well underway.
events.flavor:
The dome roof of the Grand Exhibition's main venue glimmers with intricate, handcrafted decor. A shrine and a … garden are being built on-site. A wooden torii gate, shrine, and curved bridge have also been arranged in the pavilion.

Samples of something called soy sauce are being distributed along with eye-catching … art and high-quality products brought by …'s representatives for inclusion in the exhibition.

options.name: Excellent.
… artists and entrepreneurs will greatly benefit from this.

events.title: Austria Events 34

events.desc: A proposal to expand city centre has been brought forth. The effort would require several phases of construction but would transform … as we know it.
events.flavor:
"It is My Will that the expansion of the inner city of Vienna be undertaken at the earliest possible moment, with due consideration to an appropriate link with the suburbs. In so doing, thought should be given to the regulation and beautification of My Residence and Imperial Capital. To this end, I approve the dismantling of the surrounding walls of the inner city as well as the dry moats around them."

— Franz Joseph I

options.name: Begin work immediately!
Such an undertaking is unsound.

events.title: Expanding City Centre

events.desc: The first phase of construction has completed with an art and natural history museum now situated off Ringstrasse. The advancement of culture and learning in … will be indisputable.
events.flavor: "With regard to the city of Vienna, she is at the present time in what may be termed a transition state owing to the destruction and pulling down other fortifications, and the erection of boulevards in their stead, not inferior to those erected in Paris by Baron Haussmann during the existence of the Napoleonic dynasty. In truth, Vienna may be likened to a second Paris in miniature, with the Danube in lieu of the Seine. And should the Austrian Empire remain intact, of which there is every apparent probability, she may boast of the possession, within twenty years, of one of the best-planned and best built cities in Europe."—By An Australian Colonist

options.name: This will be part of the …'s legacy.

events.title: Cultural Clout

events.desc: Construction along the Ringstrasse has greatly improved transportation of goods and people in …. The importance of the project is of no insignificance. Many are eager for the next phase of development to begin right away.
events.flavor:
Now that the city centre is linked to the suburbs in the west, traffic flows steadily through the heart of …. The new pavement has lightly muted the noisy bustle of increased traffic that passes through.

Within the refurbished walls of the complex, the … expresses … satisfaction to the architect, "The development of Kaiserforum is coming along quite nicely. Now tell me, what more is left to install?"

options.name: The progress on Kaiserforum is a credit to the … and …'s diligence.

events.title: Changing Landscape

events.desc: In this final phase of development, one last question remains: Will the trademark imperial yellow of … be used in this expansion of the … metropolis?
events.flavor:
The golden ochre of the Schönbrunn Yellow’s soft hues paints a majestic vision.

"The enduring trademark certainly leaves a lasting impression," one painter exclaims whilst appraising the color.

Another artist looks on with skepticism and counters: "But do we want to cling to such echoes of the past?"

options.name: This can be left behind in the city's past.
We must paint the forum in gold ochre!

events.title: Schönbrunn Yellow

events.desc: After many years of development, the vision for the forum has been fully realized. The splendor of the transformative design is striking. Construction in the city centre of … is now complete.
events.flavor:
"Art cannot be modern. Art is primordially eternal."

—Egon Schiele

options.name: The benefits of our endeavor will be long-lasting.
Our architectural feat will be well-regarded.

events.title: Buildings of Splendor

events.desc: The expansion of suffrage in … has provoked a sharp reaction amongst the traditionally conservative …. Many … have come to view … as a liability to the stability of the Empire.
events.flavor:
"The politicians seek to make the Empire into a farce," began the Colonel. "Every expansion of the vote renders … more and more unmanageable. They spend their time stirring confusion and delay, and every delayed act places a new blemish upon the Crown."

He saw nods all around. Each of the men at the table had felt budget cuts made in the name of securing the support of some provincial Diet. He continued.

"Our Empire has entered its twilight years, and it is this ruin that we stand amidst. If this continues - if it is allowed to continue - I fear that we shall all be swept into oblivion."

options.name: Their words threaten dictatorship.
Can we truly say they're wrong?

events.title: To Save the Empire

events.desc: Inspired by discontent towards … parliamentary democracy, the traditional classes have begun to orient themselves towards the …. Their platform invokes … social teachings and the pacification of the labor movement under a ….
events.flavor:
"We are also united by a second thing, a shared practical goal: to want the best, to bring the human community to its most pleasant condition.

The one who stands on the right who sees in the actions of the left-wing socialists nothing but destruction, just as the one on the left sees in the actions of the right-wingers only dark disaster—they all may and must grant one another the conviction that the same noble striving guides them."

— Othmar Spann, The True State

options.name: This is the future of conservatism.
We now find ourselves facing the blackest reaction.

events.title: The New Conservatives

events.desc: The efforts of … and the … have successfully transformed … into a …. With the labor movement silenced or co-opted, a sense of social peace has been established at last.
events.flavor:
"The highest desire of the working class is the right to work for God and Country. That is precisely what the communists are most afraid of."

The Front recruiter with the slicked-back hair paced back and forth as he spoke. … stood at attention, his classmates at his sides. Forty-eight eyes followed his every movement.

"Their weapon is sabotage and division, and they sow it wherever they go. This is what you will combat. You entered this hall as students, ones at the top of your class. You will leave it as stormtroopers."

options.name: Österreich!
The Front's will shall be law.

events.title: Austria Awakened

events.desc: The … has failed to seize control of …. Whilst the spectre of radical nationalism is sure to remain, the vision of the Ständestaat has faded into history.
events.flavor:
… seemed to be breathing easier, these days. The hard-eyed youths in uniform had faded from the street corners, and wheat-pasted trade-union posters had once more become a common sight. From his position on a coffee-house veranda, … looked over a group of workers passing by. There was a flash of a face he recognized, in the center.

"Mr. …?" wagered the man sitting across from him. "I think I saw him on a leaflet."

"Whose leaflet?"

"Nobody important, I imagine. I can't remember the last time I saw them around."

options.name: … is saved!
Where may we go from here?

events.title: Just a Dream

events.desc: The radical government has imprisoned … … and hastily organized a trial. The expected outcome is a guilty verdict followed by public execution.
events.flavor: "Citizen …. The … nation accuses you of having committed a multitude of crimes to establish your tyranny, to destroy her freedom. Most egregious among these charges include conspiring with foreign powers, aristocratic corruption, and causing the blood of the people to flow. How do you plead?"

options.name: Guilty! Long live the Republic! Long live …!
This is not justice!

events.title: The Trial of … …

events.desc: … has successfully maintained a republican form of government for many years now. There are few who still remember the old monarchy with any fondness.
events.flavor: "The days of highborn kings ruling over the meek peasantry atop a gilded throne are over. Let them pass into the realm of story books and fairy tales where they belong, and let nostalgia for those days become an idle fancy, not the grim face of reaction."

options.name: We must put the past behind us.
There is no harm in nostalgia.

events.title: The Last Monarchists

events.desc: The radical government has drafted a new constitution that guarantees …. … and … supporters are demanding that the constitution be immediately signed into law.
events.flavor: "The principle of liberty shall be the bedrock of the … nation. For every man, a vote. And every vote shall be counted equally. It is not by right of wealth or land that we will choose our governors, but by the shining mandate of democracy."

options.name: Liberté, égalité, fraternité!
Trust in the legal process.

events.title: The … Constitution

events.flavor: "The people of the … nation have a right to rule themselves, free from the clutches of kings and aristocrats who hoard hereditary power. We have made our demands clear; they will be met, or we shall take to the streets. We will win our freedom with the blood of martyrs if we have to."

options.name: Support the conservative establishment.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: Support the radical movement.

events.title: The Springtime of the Peoples

events.desc: The radical movement is becoming popular, uncontrollable, and violent. Calls for revolution echo in the streets. Extreme measures may be necessary.
events.flavor: "Blind, ignorant fools. They want to be treated as equals when they most certainly are not. It would be so much easier if they could just accept their place, but instead they cling to their useless pride, taking to the streets to protest their obstinate cause. If they insist on using violence, we have no choice but to respond in kind."

options.name: Secret Police will provide a discrete solution.
We need the National Guard.
Tyranny is not the answer.

events.title: Radicals at the Gates

events.desc: The … have sown terror throughout the ranks of the radicals. Already we are seeing how effective such a force can be, in the responsible hands of the state.
events.flavor: "Let them hate us, so long as they fear us. Dissenters of their insidious kind cannot be tolerated. Like vermin they gnaw at the very bones of the … nation."

options.name: Round up the ringleaders.
Strike with our full force.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Effective, and efficient.

events.title: Extreme Measures

events.desc: Unhappy members of … are frustrated that the state refuses to give them access to any organs of government, and will not humor them at all. … in particular has begun escalating … anti-government rhetoric, with some surprising ideological thoughts baked in.
events.flavor: "This government is unmatched in the extent of its perjuries! Its determination to extinguish the voice of the people has been accompanied by a succession of criminal acts, comprising robbert, destruction of property, murder, maining, and far too many more to name. Humanity will shudder when reading this disgraceful page of history!"

options.name: Refuse to bend to these loudmouths.
Let them petition the government, at least.

events.title: Growing Frustration

events.desc: A growing deficit and high taxes have contributed to a collapse in fortunes. The … specifically have been hard-hit by this slump, and … is demanding relief from the government.
events.flavor: "Some say that these hard times will make us hard men, toughened by our travails and wiser for our experiences. I am impelled to humbly ask these educated men if they submit themselves to these same austerities, to grow and learn?"

options.name: The … can fend for themselves.
We can alleviate the plight of the … some.

events.title: Financial Squeeze

events.desc: The ongoing crisis in … has led to the … to speak on behalf of the area and become sharply critical of the government.
events.flavor: "This is obscene! If the government can't even feed its own people, what can it do?"

options.name: The complaints of the … will not guide our actions.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: We can provide some of their suggested relief.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: The Crisis of Bread

events.desc: The …'s heir, …, has caused a scandal by declaring … love for a young … ….
events.flavor:
It is the opinion of this author that our vivacious … may be truly, impossibly, uncomfortably in love. This news has undoubtedly distressed the ton’s aspiring …, but I imagine it must bring a new glimmer of hope to the eyes of … people far and wide. 

 "Can you believe it, Lady Hill? And … didn't even have the decency to be quiet about it!"
"What of the bloodline, Lord Dawson?"
"Yes! What of the children, Lord Dawson? Will no one think of the children?"
"Don't fret, Lady Annesly. The … will surely intervene."

options.name: The … will act according to … station.
Unfortunately the young … has disappeared.
We must let love be love.

events.title: Forbidden Love

events.desc: While formally under the administration of …, the region of … has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic … settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action against ….
events.flavor:
"This is the deal: you will take your family and a handful of retainers, and stake claims in the area. Squat on it if you must, but Acre is of paramount importance."

"And what I take is mine?"

"Yes, within reason."

options.name: Acre is rightfully …

events.title: The Acre Dispute

events.desc: While formally under the administration of …, the region of … has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic … settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action against ….
events.flavor:
"This is the deal: you will take your family and a handful of retainers, and stake claims in the area. Squat on it if you must, but Acre is of paramount importance."

"And what I take is mine?"

"Yes, within reason."

options.name: Acre is rightfully …

events.title: The Acre Dispute

events.desc: … has emerged victorious in the dispute over …. … settlers are ready to make the state their own.
events.flavor: One pen swipe later, and it was done. Acre was now the mandated responsibility of …. Rivals—hopeful claimants and the prior caretakers alike—seethed at the … delegates’ naked glee.

options.name: Victory for …!

events.title: The Ten Thousand Acre Wood

events.desc: Our efforts to seize the state of … have failed, and the opportunity has passed. … can no longer claim sovereignty over the state.
events.flavor: The consul to Acre shoved open the doors to his office. Paintings rattled on the walls. A maid shrieked before scurrying out of the room. He made a note to apologize to her later; his ire was on another kind of miscreant. For now, his reprieve was a half-decanter of rum. Reporting this failure to the … would take the second half.

options.name: A blow to our prestige.

events.title: An Unfavorable Resolution

events.desc: An ardent abolitionist writer died in a firefight against a pro-slavery mob which had gathered in front of his house. The story has gone national, and radicalized previously apathetic individuals high and low.
events.flavor:
His friend sighed. The funeral had been small, lest the mob appear again in force. The gravestone itself was simple, not calling attention to itself. The only embellishment that had been allowed was a simple inscription:

"Here lies a brave man: now spare his grave."

options.name: Ghastly! The violence of slavers must be resisted.
This abolitionist agitation must be stopped!

events.title: The Abolitionist's Martyrdom

events.desc: A slave belonging to … has escaped … estate and fled to a northern free state. … has demanded his return, but abolitionists are calling for … demands to be ignored.
events.flavor: "There are few things that I care more about than justice. If a man loses his jacket, it's only natural that it would be returned to him, right? I simply ask that what's mine be returned to me. Why is this causing such an uproar?"

options.name: We shall find and return …'s fugitive slave.
Free soil makes anyone free. … will get no help from the government.

events.title: The Fugitive Slave

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has proposed outright prohibiting slavery in all our new western territories. Some opponents demand simple moderation, but others are demanding legalization of slavery in all new territories.
events.flavor: "This intolerable institution cannot spread its influence any further! A free nation needs free soil if it is to thrive!"

options.name: Reject the proviso, this remains a state-by-state issue.
Accept the proviso, and abolish slavery in the West.
Reject the proviso, and expand slavery in the West.

events.title: The … Proviso

events.desc: Abolitionists and proponents of slavery have been pouring into …, hoping to shape the territory's government to their liking. Paramilitary groups have begun committing acts of violence against each other and civilians.
events.flavor: "Before God and in the presence of these witnesses, from this time, I consecrate my life to the destruction of slavery. The crimes of this guilty land can never be purged away but with blood."

options.name: Border ruffians cannot dictate law! … must be a free state.
Jayhawkers do not decide what is right! … will be a slave state.

events.title: Bleeding …

events.desc: …, an outspoken abolitionist, has been beaten with a cane by …, a slave owner. …'s injuries compel him to convalesce and retire from public office, while … still currently walks free.
events.flavor: "Such barbarism! I sadly do not see how two such disparate communities can still constitute one state."

options.name: … was just defending his honor. We will do nothing.
… assaulted a citizen! He must be removed from office and arrested.

events.title: The Caning of …

events.desc: Anti-secessionist agitators in … have rallied support and declared the establishment of a unionist government.
events.flavor: "In defiance of the secessionists, we, by resolution of the people, do secede from these traitors and declare ourselves Free and Independent, loyal still to the …."

options.name: A show of strength will bring them to heel.
We cannot afford to move against them right now.

events.title: The Free State of …

events.desc: Enemy raiders have successfully stolen a locomotive and wrecked miles of track and telegraph lines in … before being stopped.
events.flavor: The wisps of smoke grew more and more feeble with each huff of their tired locomotive, the …. The raiders had run out of fuel miles back, and the rails they had torn up hadn't been enough to save them. In the distance, plumes of smoke from their pursuers grew ever-closer. The chase was coming to an end.

options.name: Damn everything else, rebuild those tracks and lines now!
Keeping troops on our trains will slow them down, but make them safer.
Next time, we'll capture the raiders before they start.

events.title: The Great Locomotive Chase

options.name: A triumph for the natural order.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Immediately pass legislation to re-open the slave trade.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.desc: A sympathizer of the recent rebellion has taken the life of …. Although he was captured after the deed and his co-conspirators were exposed, the death of … remains a somber end to this tragic era in American history.
events.flavor: "… went at the call of duty to the post of danger, and although wrecked, … life is by no means lost. The great blot upon our country, the great stain upon our national character, the great source of strife and contention among our people, by … courage and fortitude, has been wiped out and removed. …'s name has become historic."

options.name: The nation shall mourn this day.

events.title: The Attempt on …'s Life

events.desc: A sympathizer of the recent rebellion has attempted to assassinate …. He was caught attempting to break in, and his plot and co-conspirators exposed. … has taken the opportunity to rally the populace once again to … cause.
events.flavor: "How can those fools think they can ever rise again, when they can't even fire one shot off right?"

options.name: A tragedy averted!

events.title: The Attempt on …'s Life

events.desc: A sympathizer of the recent rebellion has attempted to assassinate …. The effort did not go as planned for the assassin.
events.flavor: … heard the floorboards creak behind …. Before … assailant could even finish pulling out the derringer, … was upon him. "Fiend! Cur! Have you no decency?" … cried, every word punctuated by another blow to …'s would-be assassin with … bare fists.

options.name: Thus always to assassins!

events.title: The Attempt on …'s Life

events.desc: In the war against the secessionists, many enslaved people believed that once they were freed, they would have the right to own the land they had been forced to work on as slaves. People in … have pressed the issue with local authorities, who are turning to us for direction.
events.flavor: "Land! Land is what we need! I can't feed myself with a ballot box—give me the plot of land I've already been working on so I can feed my family."

options.name: Authorize the limited redistribution of land.
Economic measures are liable to cause trouble.

events.title: Forty Acres and a Mule

events.desc: Violence between white rioters and black freedmen has caused significant tension in ….
events.flavor: "The rioters stomped, kicked, and clubbed others mercilessly. The streets grew slick with the blood of innocent men. Emptied revolvers clattered on the ground as attacks grew too frenzied to bother with reloading anymore. It was only when martial law was declared and troops marched in that even a pretense of order could return."

options.name: Use the full might of the government to protect freedmen.
We cannot alienate local leaders with the use of troops.

events.title: Supremacist violence in …

events.desc: A coalition of former Confederates and Confederate sympathizers have won control of …'s state government through means fair and foul, threatening the ongoing process of Reconstruction.
events.flavor: "Draw a line one side of which you see intelligence, virtue, self-respect, and democracy; and on the other the absolute unchecked political supremacy of brute force and terror, and there you will behold not one attribute of free government, but the saddest tyranny of the Old South desperately clawing back power that ever cursed this earth."

options.name: Reconciliation demands an accord with these men.
Arrest these men and install a new state government.

events.title: Redeemers

events.desc: Political groups opposed to Reconstruction have organized militant units to intimidate voters in … and restore themselves to power.
events.flavor: "While I understand that our organization causes consternation among some elements of the population, I can assure you that our bayonets and our rifles are purely for display purposes only."

options.name: A loyal state government is all that matters.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Horrendous! Disband these units at once!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Paramilitary Intimidation

events.desc: Northerners in the state of … have been targeted by locals who denounce them as troublemakers and exploiters. Writers and orators in …, however, have demanded that the government protect these Northerners.
events.flavor: "I came here to help build something better after toppling slave power, and sure I didn't mind making something for myself in the process, but what have I gotten? I'm here empty-handed, with nothing but a litany of slander and threats thrown at my name."

options.name: Let the people of … do what they will.
We must protect all Americans, even if it angers some.

events.title: Carpetbaggers

options.name: A house divided against itself cannot stand. For the Union!
I would rather call our cause one of states' rights.

events.desc: While the military fight has finished, the fight for the nation's soul has not. The … must rebuild itself after being split in two.
events.flavor: "I do not expect this nation to fall. Welcome or unwelcome, whether it becomes all one thing or all the other, this nation shall cease to be divided in body and soul."

options.name: A house divided against itself cannot stand. For the Union!

events.title: Reconstructing the Nation

events.desc: Our nation has rebuilt itself, making something distinct, something new, and most importantly, something united.
events.flavor: "For all our faults, we have reforged our nation, and have built ourselves a government that shall not perish from this earth."

options.name: We stand united once more.

events.title: The Nation, Reconstructed

events.desc: With the supporters of slavery in rebellion, we can issue a proclamation to free all slaves in rebellious territories. This is the first but most significant step in total abolition.
events.flavor: "By virtue of the power vested in me in this time of actual armed rebellion, I do order and declare that all persons held as slaves henceforward shall be free. Upon this act, I invoke the considerate judgment of mankind, and the gracious favor of Almighty God."

options.name: By this stroke, we shall save the Union!
We refuse to emancipate outside of conventional means.

events.title: The Emancipation Proclamation

events.desc: A notorious gang of outlaws have been terrorizing the respectable settlements of ….
events.flavor: The rough man holstered his resolver, kicking the deputy's body to the side. "I told them," he guffawed, "I told them that if I ever got free, the … would show them all what bad #Sreally means."

options.name: Let the local sheriff sort it out.
Hire the Pinkertons—they know how to be rough.
The guns of the national guard will stop the outlaws.

events.title: Outlaws in …!

events.desc: Native raids have been increasing in frequency, with railroads becoming a very common target. Citizens in … are demanding action from the government.
events.flavor: "We built that line across untouched land, but they've come out to attack us anyways! How are we supposed to get anything done while the trains keep being attacked and the rails keep getting torn up?"

options.name: Send in the army!
We can't spare anything to help.
Let's talk with … leaders and make a deal.

events.title: Raids on the Iron Horse

events.desc: Lawmen in … have engaged in a shootout with several cowboys. The following investigation has revealed that the gunfight was likely due to a personal feud between American marshals and the citizens involved, rather than a pursuit of the law. People are demanding justice—against the lawmen.
events.flavor: "Come on, does anyone else want to try their luck? See this badge? It means I'm in charge here! I'm justice! Now get moving, there's nothing to see here."

options.name: The Lawmen are the Law, and we cannot stop the Law.
Recall the marshals from … temporarily.

events.title: Gunfight at the Corral

events.desc: …'s growing colonial empire in Africa along with new means to prevent malaria has made us a serious contender for colonial control of the continent.
events.flavor: "When I see this continent, I see a raw, unworked material from which anything could be carved. But, as often when working with rough materials, mishaps are inevitable. Something breaks, blood is spilled. … isn't so squeamish as to let a bit of blood get in the way of ambition, are we?"

options.name: Bring out the maps and the straightedges!

events.title: Joining the Scramble for Africa

events.desc: Our colonial efforts in Africa have borne fruit, claiming a sizeable part of the continent for our own designs.
events.flavor: "Some may yet dispute the exact reach of our colonial empire, but none can dispute its presence. To those who want to argue over borders, I say what I have always said: History, now as before, it written by the cartographers."

options.name: This is only the beginning of the … empire!

events.title: Our Place in the Sun

events.desc: A group of Christian missionaries want to bring the salvation of the Gospels to our colony in ….
events.flavor: "I do not believe that everyone entitled to salvation, because we must be free to reject it, but I do believe everyone is entitled to the choice! We must not, cannot, sit idle in … while there are yet unenlightened heathens in this world. If the colonial project is truly a moral one, as you claim, then surely all moral instruction must begin with this choice."

options.name: Spreading the true faith is a vital part of the colonial project!
We are there for the glory of …, not the glory of God.

events.title: Mission to Africa

events.desc: …, leader of the … and a well-known opponent of the global slave trade, argues that our colonial ambitions in … should be leveraged towards ending the practice on the continent.
events.flavor: "Ending slavery within our own borders is a meager victory in the grand perspective of human history. As long as there are countries in this world willing to sell slaves, there will be countries coming to buy them, and vice versa. The concept must be stamped out wherever it can be found, so that eventually, it can be stamped out in the human soul itself."

options.name: We have a duty to end slavery wherever our power reaches!
Practical diplomacy must supersede such moralist sentiments.

rewards.name: Refused Pledge to End Slave Trade

options.name: The local slave trade could be a good source of workforce for our local projects!

events.title: Ending the Slave Trade

events.desc: Despite our proclaimed goal of ending the slave trade in Africa, recent reports suggest that laborers in … are, in all but name, slaves under our own colonial administration.
events.flavor:
The young man, who had been scribbling furiously, suddenly seemed lightheaded and gestured to the interpreter to stop.
"You will have to excuse me. This must all be documented, but being new to the continent, I am not accustomed to hearing of such savage behavior."
The interpreter seemed confused for a moment and turned back to explain the interruption. The old local man he was interviewing responded and the interpreter turned back to the young man:
"He says he was not accustomed to it either, until your countrymen arrived."

options.name: This is utter hypocrisy. These abuses must end!

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: It may seem similar, but the hard work we provide builds character.

events.title: Slavery and Colonial Labor

events.desc: Intellectuals from … are visiting our capital, arguing the case that their home country is far more civilized than we make it out to be and that our colonial designs on them are unjustified.
events.flavor:
"It is quite baffling, I must say, to hear you speak of being robbed, when … brings you the greatest gift of all—the gift of civilization!"

The … gentleman leaned in and responded bitterly.

"I have seen the ships that arrive at our shores and I have seen the ships that leave. This civilization you are bringing must be very light, but the price we pay for it seems to be quite heavy indeed."

options.name: It's all affectations and lies. Send them back immediately.
Perhaps there is some value in hearing their perspective.

events.title: Visitors from the Colonies

events.desc: An officer in our African colonies has intentionally provoked a confrontation with …, despite instructions to keep the peace. We can either save face by going along with the officer's plot, or recall him, admit that we lost control of the situation, and upset the jingoists.
events.flavor: "Nevermind the missives of weak-minded fools in the capital! Everything I have accomplished during these campaigns was done in spite of the ministry, not because of it."

options.name: We have no choice but to attack ….
Recall the officer and end this madness!
I like this guy! Continue the attack and promote the officer.

events.title: Insubordinate Jingoist

events.desc: A patriotic explorer and partisan of the … has been surveying land in … and signing treaties with local leaders on behalf of our nation, but … has already established a presence in this area. If the explorer's claims are recognized, … will be furious with us.
events.flavor: "This man is a maniac! We're trying to play a careful, delicate game over here, and that man has to upturn the table and cause a headache for us all, and for what? The nation? Please! Does that man not realize the damage he's doing?"

options.name: Accept the claim on … and upset ….
Reject the explorer and upset our own jingoists.
This man is a rolemodel! He ought to go into politics!

events.title: The Rogue Imperialist

events.desc: A … expedition in … has encountered our own troops, suggesting their colonial ambitions in the region are in conflict with our own.
events.flavor:
"It was not remotely a hostile encounter. On the contrary, they seemed quite happy to meet some other people in, well, I suppose you could call it the same business."

"Business! Have they forgotten that they are soldiers? Do they believe the colonization of the African continent is a collaborative effort? If our armies meeting on contested territory does not constitute a hostile encounter, our diplomats over in … shall have to be twice as hostile to make up for it!"

options.name: They must turn back at once!
There is enough land for everyone in …!

events.title: A Brazen Expedition

events.desc: One of our colonial expeditions in … has encountered … troops in the region. … demands we turn back and abandon our designs on ….
events.flavor:
Until instructions arrived from … and …, they seemed determined to maintain a jovial mood despite the nominal standoff. The … officer uncorked a bottle of … and proposed a toast. Reluctantly, the … commander took the glass.
"The things I do for …," he thought to himself as he downed it.

options.name: … will not be deterred!
They have soldiers. We only have arguments.

events.title: Colonial Clash

events.desc: Colonists having moved to … hoping to build a new life in …'s new African territories are struggling to survive in the unfamiliar environment.
events.flavor: "If it was only the temperature and the weather, we would manage! If it was not also the flora, the fauna and the soil which were so wholly alien to our customs! We knew we would be on the frontier of a new chapter of … history, but if there is to be anything more than a footnote, the assistance we have received thus far is woefully lacking."

options.name: We will supply them with what they need.
The colonial administration should assist them.
The African colonies are for survivors, not charity cases!

events.title: Continent of Opportunity

events.desc: … appears to be disregarding our Claim on colonial projects in …. If given a stern enough reminder, they may be convinced to cede it to us.
events.flavor: "Perhaps they believe that so far away from …, we would not notice. Or that these are simply plans we have made, but would readily adapt to avoid a diplomatic conflict with someone who arrived there first. Whatever their reasons, they must think we can be fooled out of our rightful share of the African continent by fast ships and bold moves. What shall the world think of … if we prove them right?"

options.name: The maps are clear. The colony is ours!
Let's not make an incident out of some lines on a paper.

events.title: Disrespecting Our Maps

events.desc: … has taken notice of our colony in …, attempting to enforce their Claim on the region by demanding we cede the colony to them.
events.flavor: "The … have a tendency towards the theoretical, don't they? Whereas … people have always been pragmatic. We saw an opportunity and took it. Now we must suffer the whining of those who would rather talk about which opportunities they plan to take in the future and begrudge us what is already ours. Unfortunately, the whining is growing quite loud."

options.name: What does a claim matter when we got there first?
A simple misunderstanding! They shall have it.

events.title: A Dubious Claim

events.desc: Road traffic in … has been halted as … drew a crowd into a major avenue and rambled at nauseating length about the government's proposal for …. The blockage has prevented the legislature from reaching quorum.
events.flavor: "Furthermore, in the context of the fourth paragraph pertaining to the legal definition of 'stroke,' the current legal copy does not specify as to which stroke is defined. Many may confuse the stroke of a brush or hammer for the stroke suffered by the elderly and unfortunate alike."

options.name: Perhaps it is time to legalize gag laws.
Smear the talkative fool. Publicly.

events.title: A Rant for the Ages

events.desc: Through clever use—or plain abuse—of gag motions, sympathizers of …'s cause have stalled any further discussion on the motion for ….
events.flavor:
"I call for the representative at the podium to be gagged with a division to follow."

"If it'll keep me from eating another mouthful of my in-laws' ghastly slop, then it's a vote. All of those in favor of gagging the representative, be seated on my left."

options.name: Perhaps it's time to discard those gag laws.
Order a bridle from Paris, for their pleasure.

events.title: Speaker's Gag

events.desc: A lengthy speech by … took a wild turn after consuming a tainted drink. With … incapacitation, the government has lost one of its most effective advocates for ….
events.flavor: A page was dispatched shortly after the speech began, and he arrived with a sandwich and the fateful drink. Everyone in the audience could see the long-winded speech became a battle to put down a revolting stomach. Indeed, had the speech stopped, the speaker's dignity would have ended with it. Had it not stopped then, people might have demanded an assassin's head.

options.name: Wish … a speedy recovery.
Scour the vicinity for any assassins, on the double!

events.title: Sick Leave

events.desc: Difficult points raised by supporters of … have led to the government searching for technical experts to give their impressions on the … law.
events.flavor: "I should be entirely frank, the decision to enact without consulting a professor of the field has left this law dangerously incapable of addressing the very issue for its being. Who among you would produce this expert, or shall I do it for you?"

options.name: Collaborate to find an expert.
See if … will walk the talk.
Find one from our finest university.

events.title: Get the Expert

events.desc: Thunder has struck the legislators as an article published by … accusing a member of the … of sleeping with a mistress comes to light. Conveniently, in the middle of debates for the … law.
events.flavor:
"Order! The delegates will be seated! I said, 'order,' damn it!"

No matter how hard the gavel struck the sounding board, all sense in the chamber was lost. Accusations, rebukes and rebuttals flew from everyone's mouths as fast as their spit. Before long, the journalists had every blessed word scratched in their books.

options.name: Our government must be held to the highest standards.
Stay focused on the law.

events.title: Scandalous!

events.desc: … has encouraged "all principled people" to agree on a platform of non-compliance for the … law. Sympathizers in the … have halted further debate.
events.flavor: It's as simple as not raising a hand, you see. Funny thing, that wave. That little, forgotten greeting on the street, or that wide sweep to get someone's attention. It's truly amazing what can be done with but a simple flick of the wrist. And in this case... how not doing one can cripple a nation.

options.name: As is their right. They will think better soon.
Hand their names, their offices and their staff to the papers.
Order intermediaries to stand in their places.

events.title: Non-Compliance

events.desc: The …'s members have set against each other on the … law. This infighting has been blamed on a campaign of harassment by supporters of ….
events.flavor: It was a simple matter: don't discuss this topic in the halls, any offices, or even soirees. Out of sight, out of mind, and out of each other's interests. And yet, the matter now was out and the floor was alight. Oaths and agreements now meant nothing before this contentious issue, picked out and split by another caucus.

options.name: Find a compromise between the factions.
Return to the matter at hand.
Find a weak link in their ranks and pick at their seams.

events.title: Wedge Politics

events.desc: Once on the fence with the issue, the …'s views on … changed overnight. … names … as the architect of a hidden deal.
events.flavor: Backroom deals were all too common. Funding for this project, contracts to friends-of-friends, a 'special advisory committee' on that endeavor: it's all the same, really. Grease the wheels of imperium so it all runs a bit smoother. Sometimes, however, one gets the idea to profit from the greased wheels, and then the public catches on. After that, nobody gets what they want.

options.name: Send word to the presses. Tear the corruption out, stem and root.
Stay focused on the law.
Corruption is a tool like any other.

events.title: Backroom Deals

events.desc: A few pointed comments from … have left … scrambling for a simple price: a loaf of bread. The debates on … have since stalled.
events.flavor: A portion of milled wheat determines a meal. Three of those a day, seven days a week is the crux of a wage. Give a worker their bread and their roof, plus 10%, and it's a year's living. And yet, some will tell them to eat cake... unaware that cake is made from wheat.

options.name: Reputation takes time to heal.
Keep the issue focused on the law.

events.title: Rabble Rousing

events.desc: A ploy by the … backfired, with a backbencher taking the fall for a power brokering ring. Opponents of the law inspired by …'s tactics have called for immediate censure, halting debate on the … law.
events.flavor: "This deplorable state of affairs is beyond the dignity of this body. A censure must be called on this gangrenous blemish on our honor, or we will all suffer the consequences."

options.name: Join the censure motion, and pass it quickly.
Find some skeletons in the …'s closet.

events.title: Thrown the Book

events.desc: While debates continue over the … law, a polemic by … has publicized a simple and catastrophic flaw in the proceedings. A redraft is underway.
events.flavor:
"Really? The law required that nobody flies a kite in a public space if it so bothered another person at all? No wonder it was dragged down."

"Sounds bloody pitiful when you say it like that."

options.name: Find an acceptable compromise, whatever that looks like.
Let them take the bait. Push another matter.

events.title: Good Point, Actually...

events.desc: The proposal for … has sat in a deadlock. The … have advocated for enlisting …'s assistance in rallying the … in favor of the government.
events.flavor: There, upon the cusp of a division, everyone sees that nobody has a majority yet. One by one, it dawns on them: the loose cannons, led by the most rabid dog of the bunch, have the votes they need. But who among them would be the first to climb off their ivory tower to win their favor?

options.name: Make overtures to the undecided.
Slander the opposition into oblivion.
Forge ahead without them. We can win.

events.title: Desperate Allies

events.desc: The … have issued a stern ultimatum to … about toeing the group's line on opposing …. … is determined to resist.
events.flavor: The matter wedged the caucus, and it was by their own making. Meanwhile the issue at hand has given way to this fallout. Sheer stubbornness is what fuels it, with pride wagered in this gamble. Nothing will proceed without a timely resolution to this.

options.name: Never interrupt an opponent while they make a mistake.
We will welcome any dissidents within the ….

events.title: An Ultimatum

events.desc: Debates have raged on the … matter for several days. …'s supporters in the … have dissidents among them, but each of them has their own views regarding this law.
events.flavor: A new day of debate on the same issue, and each representative could only muster a laggard shuffle back to their seats. The air was ripe with torpid vapors. This matter had to be put to rest tonight, or it would strangle the government even further.

options.name: Broach the … about a concession.
See if the … will compromise.
Let them score points on one another.

events.title: Standstill

events.desc: Printers and gazettes affiliated with the … have sensationalized the … law, and the public has misconstrued it since. … has taken advantage of the public confusion for … own agenda.
events.flavor: A few misunderstood words was all it took to plant the seeds. After that, a few honest mistakes for want of a thesaurus. By the end of the week, the law had changed into something else. The public now debated a matter that was barely pertinent to the regime.

options.name: Send a correction to the printers.
Ram the law through.
We would be remiss not to listen to our constituents.

events.title: A Day at the Printers

events.desc: As the debates around the … law stall, … has motioned to pass the proposal to a commission of experts to break the deadlock.
events.flavor: One caucus' opinion is a token. Two is a minority. Two caucuses representing the aggregated opinion of most people is still a minority. Especially when those caucuses come with a lack of life or professional experience.

options.name: Can the treasury bear such an expense?
Put an open callout for any experts.
See if our universities will provide.

events.title: A Third Opinion

events.desc: Though the … law sees agreement in principle, there are two mutually exclusive clauses. … and … want the law to favor them, while … chastises both of them for opportunism.
events.flavor: The essence of leadership, so they say, is compromise. An interesting paradox, then, is compromise as weakness. Not compromising is as much the failing as always compromising. This, as in all things, lies in balancing the ends.

options.name: Strike a clause. The law needs passing.
Time for a fresh barrel of ink...

events.title: Mutual Exclusivity

events.desc: Regardless of the governing caucus' stance, the fiercest debates on … come from these two: the … and populists stirred by …'s movement. The end is nowhere in sight.
events.flavor: Once in a blue moon, the government sees a minor issue to appease an ally or placate an enemy. Invariably, it crosses someone else's line. Some might call, 'Enemy of my enemy,' and expect an alliance of convenience. Others, often rightly, expect a velveteen fist.

options.name: Let them bicker.
Take advantage of the populist pressure.
Back the ….

events.title: The Minor Interests

events.desc: … and … are split over the semantics of a clause regarding …. … has published articles designed to drag the public into this bickering.
events.flavor:
"I would call to attention the statute forbidding the bearing of armor within this mighty institution."

"What's the issue this time?"

"The wording does not specify whether one is only wearing armor, or if one possesses it within the premises. One might simply be carrying an ornament, and thus in breach of a law!"

options.name: Favor …'s interpretation.
Promote …'s stance.
Bring … to account for encouraging this behavior.

events.title: Without a Clause

events.desc: A horrendous first-draft of … has every faction clamoring to ram in their desired changes. … has whipped up immense public discontent in favor of a rewrite.
events.flavor:
"Double pay on Saturday? Do they think we bathe in money?"

"And 15 minutes for a... 'smoke break?' Preposterous!"

"Assured sickness leave would help blunt tuberculosis outbreaks..."

Pages brought fresh inkwells for every half-interested notetaker in the chamber. It was already a long day, and promised to be a longer evening. Many more inkwells would be needed before this unruly child was put to bed.

options.name: Stay the course, and clear up any errors.
Hear out …'s supporters.
Take some of the …'s suggestions.

events.title: Gone to the Dogs

events.desc: Though previously opposing the … laws, … has considered the …'s political position and instead offers support.
events.flavor:
"While speaking with constituents on matters of law, one must first master the art of appearing to do nothing."

"While you do everything behind whispers and masked men?"

"Indubitably."

options.name: Welcome their support.
Keep a sharp eye. They're up to something.

events.title: The Art of Doing Nothing

events.desc: …'s arguments have been publicly defeated, forcing … to turn … gaze to more advantageous things. A faction in the … have thrown their weight behind the … law.
events.flavor:
"Oh, very well. I dare say you shall be the death of me, you silver-tongued devil."

"Just like that?"

"Just like that. As it is useless to fight a river's current, so it is with wise counsel."

options.name: Celebrations are in order.
Run a line to the papers, now!

events.title: Defeat Admitted

events.desc: Just as the … law looked ready to topple, the … found itself rallying with the assistance of …. It now has the support it needs to pass without compromise.
events.flavor: When support was called, the unlikeliest hand in the audience rose. Another hand lifted, and a third behind them. The faction with the least to gain from its passage, yet nothing to lose either way, assents. Cheers of exuberance followed howls of defeat as the law charged on ahead.

options.name: Welcome their support.
Tally this favor. They certainly will.

events.title: Allies of Convenience

events.desc: Seeking support amongst … sympathizers, … has organized a boycott against the … law. On the day it was to begin, there was barely any sign it had been declared at all.
events.flavor: Some had taken due lessons from the Third Estate: quantity was a quality of its own. If you had enough bodies to support whatever your cause was, nobody could stop you. Unfortunately for a few, there was a lesson they hadn't learnt: people needed to either like you, or like your cause.

options.name: Inform the printers about this blunder.
Everyone has a price for fealty.

events.title: Botched a Boycott

events.desc: Seeking to discredit … during a speech on …, a heckler inspired by … inquired about bread prices. … asked a nearby grocer.
events.flavor:
"Regarding the law that you say is for the betterment of the common man, what's the price of- Are you even listening?"

"The grocer here says it's two pence for a loaf of bread. As for your question, it's a rather insipid one, no? A vulgar gambit to shock and discredit me, rather than offer anything of substance to the discourse. Next?"

options.name: Shock tactics are unbecoming of this nation.
We should peruse the law for faults.

events.title: A Common Cost

events.desc: Whilst the government debates the merits of …, several newspapers have published polemics by … trying to invoke an obscure law against it. Lawyers affiliated with the … pointed out said law is invalid.
events.flavor: An example of an obscure, debatably redundant, law is that a hat must be worn while making a point of order. This law does not specify which hat to wear, only that it be worn and the point of order made. Thus, it would be very good form to wear a dunce cap when making an invalid point of order.

options.name: Strike this useless law.
Modernize this alongside ….

events.title: Hat Trick

events.desc: In an obscure meeting, … and a proxy of the … rambled at length about the positives of …. One was cognizant enough to take minutes.
events.flavor:
"Well that's the problem with the new law. If you don't remove those other supporting laws, someone can exploit those loopholes and escape its reach."

"Unless you count the two laws about evasion without plausible doubt. Then you have a crafty seal that catches those rogue actors."

options.name: Commend them for their good work.
Matters of governance are for government, not dens of sin.

events.title: Over a Drink

events.desc: The … and … are jockeying for minor but favoring concessions regarding …. Supporters of … are calling for a resolution without concessions.
events.flavor: A pair of bickering children: the bane of swift and firm decision-making since time immemorial. Regardless of age or pretense of education, the beats rhyme every time. Two groups want something, and will make it someone else's problem until they get it. The problem then is which baby to hand the bottle to.

options.name: Let them bicker.
Throw one a bone if it will silence them.

events.title: A Clause Is Coming to Town

events.desc: In …'s body of published works is a popular, new book with a vision of what … might look like. Lawyers affiliated with the … say the contents are legally sound.
events.flavor: Most of the time, fiction is merely that: something to pass the time. Sometimes, a true vision of possibility creeps through. Once in a blue moon, well-written fiction can change how people think. Every so often from there, however, it might be mistaken for divination.

options.name: Canvass the public about this light reading.
Procure a copy, with our compliments to the author.
Fiction should remain entertainment.

events.title: A Novel Solution

events.desc: … was on everyone's lips in every coffeehouse. Afterwards, … was ready to cross the … to help pass the law.
events.flavor: Wise counsel advises against conflating the voice of the people with the voice of God. Wiser counsel calls the voice of the people mad. The wisest counsel understands that genius and madness are two sides of the same coin. It's a matter of knowing when to listen.

options.name: Welcome this change of heart.
Shield … from any …'s blowback.

events.title: Coffee Talk

events.desc: In a gesture of solidarity with the …, … has encouraged … supporters to vote for it in the ongoing election.
events.flavor: For the interest of all principled people - … has a consistent record of excellence. I cannot speak higher of those brave men and women moving … forwards under their name.

options.name: … has our thanks, certainly.
This endorsement would best be more specific.

events.title: Fruitful Endorsements

events.desc: Whilst carrying out work in support of the … in …, … has come across …, representing the …. A fiery debate has broken out between them.
events.flavor:
Straightening … impressive coattails, … stepped forwards, regarding … newfound opponent with a look of begrudging respect.

"I'll have you know..."

options.name: … is far more convincing.
The better arguments clearly belong to ….

events.title: An Unplanned Debate

events.desc: … has issued a condemnation of the … electoral system, endorsing abstention from voting in what … calls a sham put on to placate the people.
events.flavor: In the dictatorship of the reactionary, of the rich and powerful, obscured from the view of the people by a facade of democracy, the best thing one may do is demonstrate the futility of such a guise, so that the people may be spurred into action regardless of concession.

options.name: The government must know that we see through their system.
Discrediting the system is the next step towards revolution!
Their supporters aren't voting? Ours certainly are.

events.title: False Democracy

events.desc: …, following an address where … condemned the …, has begun to mobilize dedicated partisans to oppose it in the election.
events.flavor:
"An unprincipled morass,"
"Best served not in …, but in prison,"
"Devoid of positive achievement,"
"A collective self-parody,"
"An embarassment to the … nation,"
"Down with the …!"

options.name: There's certainly a better alternative.
A pack of miscreants, indeed!

events.title: Aggressive Campaigning

events.desc: … has criticized numerous decisions made by the leadership of … own …, calling … excessively cautious and unwilling to address critical issues.
events.flavor:
"I often wonder, looking at the activities that we carry out - specifically those which are most crucial to expanding our pool of supporters - whether … is authentically aware of, or dedicated to, their success. Our fundraising is generally acceptable - the coffers of the party are without complaint, and neither are our accountants - but such resources have yet to be mobilized in a way that benefits the common good."

"And, so, my thesis is this - what does … intend, and how best to change … mind on the matter?"

options.name: It would be best to simply do as … wishes.
Make a point of improving the vigor we put forward.
Freeze … out of meetings until … apologizes.

events.title: Misplaced Moderation

events.desc: The advocacy of … has led to the … gaining greater electoral popularity among women, who have rushed to exercise their new-found voting rights.
events.flavor:
As we come marching, marching, in the beauty of the day,
A million darkened kitchens, a thousand mill-lofts gray
Are touched with all the radiance that a sudden sun discloses,
For the people hear us singing, "Bread and roses, bread and roses."

As we come marching, marching, we battle, too, for men—
For they are women's children and we mother them again.
Our days shall not be sweated from birth until life closes—
Hearts starve as well as bodies: Give us bread, but give us roses.

options.name: For the election of the …!
For the strengthening of … democracy!

events.title: The Rising of the Women

events.desc: In collaboration with the …, … has secured a deal for cheap and quickly distributed pamphlets in support of the party.
events.flavor: The interior of the carriage held a pleasant surprise - a crate of several thousand pamphlets, printed on an industrial scale, each with instructions on the voting process and a cheaply copied logo of the …. They made a hefty weight - and, … hoped, would turn out to be an equally sized benefit.

options.name: Bury our opponents in a sea of paper!
These connections could be used later.

events.title: Production and Agitation

events.desc: The wing of the … affiliated with the … has raised complaints about …'s choice of endorsements leaving their supporters neglected.
events.flavor: "I must levy a concern, now that it has come to my attention. Whilst …'s actions are undoubtably well-intentioned, the recommendations contained thereof seem to exclude certain members of the party who have demonstrated more than sufficient vigor, good will, and surety of purpose."

options.name: Listen to their concerns, and appease the ….
Appeasement? Don't they know that was fully intentional?

events.title: The Party Favorites

events.desc: In a pro-suffrage gesture, … has released a positive endorsement of the … for its stalwart support of voting rights in ….
events.flavor: "There is no issue in our … greater than that of the franchise - that method through which the people may decide any future issue which comes their way. With this in mind, my endorsement should come to no surprise..."

options.name: The … is the guardian of … franchise!
Perhaps some party members more than others.

events.title: Democratic Solidarity

events.desc: Whilst campaigning for the … in the turmoil-wracked …, … has been attacked and brutally beaten by a group of unknown assailants.
events.flavor: When the crowd cleared, and the screaming stopped, all that was left in the street was … prostrate form, bruised, cut, and barely recognizable as the titan … had represented not five minutes before.

options.name: Some rest and recuperation would be best.
Get back to the trail right away.
Of course we know who it was. It was us.

events.title: A Tumultuous Campaign

events.desc: The particularly effective agitation that … has been carrying out in … has raised questions about the ultimate goal of the … in this election cycle.
events.flavor:
"It is the foremost task of the Communist Party to advance the working class to the revolutionary struggle for power. In determining its line of tactics, it must take into account the concrete internal and external situation, the co-relation of class forces, the degree of stability and strength of the bourgeoisie, the degree of preparedness of the proletariat, the position taken up by the various intermediary strata, etc., in its country. The Party determines slogans and methods of struggle in accordance with these circumstances, with the view to organising and mobilising the masses on the broadest possible scale and on the highest possible level of this struggle."

— Programme of the Communist International, 1929

options.name: The …'s election is the prelude to revolution.
Workers' power will be achieved through a … parliament.
The … does not represent the working class.

events.title: Ballot or Bullet

events.desc: With the …'s campaign funds well-established, … has proposed to the party leadership that a quantity of these funds may be repurposed for the party's more clandestine activities.
events.flavor: "We, as the party of the proletariat, are bound to follow the course that will lead to the realization of socialism in …, and eventually the world. The upper class will not simply step aside peacefully - even if we must follow this parliamentary course, we must develop forces to avert the inevitable coup that will follow our victory."

options.name: The funds may be repurposed on training for our Red Guards.
The risk of being implicated in a scandal is too high.
All available resources must go to fostering revolution.

events.title: The Revolutionary Line

events.desc: … organizers led by … have traveled to the countryside, in order to build class consciousness amongst the … peasantry.
events.flavor:
Here, lost in the vast expanse between smoke-seared enclaves, lay those whose lives had not changed for five hundred years.

Scratching at the soil, sowing seeds to achieve the barest sort of survival and surrendering all surplus to their feudal landlords, they looked only to their present station, unaware of the red-tinted sun that would crest their gentle hills the very next morning.

options.name: A bold step to advance the worker-peasant alliance.
Focus their efforts on organizing against landlordism.

events.title: Walking Among the People

events.desc: A massive rally led by … in support of the … has been held in …, drawing supporters of the communists from across the region. The rhetoric used at the rally has raised concerns of imminent violence.
events.flavor: …, at the head of the crowd, looked to the thin line of blue and black at the end of the street, and then back to the vast red-tinged mass behind …. … did not hesitate. With the gravitas of one fearlessly claiming the abyss for their own, … took another step forward into the wild melee.

options.name: A wonderful day for the people of …!
We will show the Reds what violence looks like.
The …'s partisans will handle these miscreants.

events.title: Communist Rally in …

events.desc: The ascendance of the … in the recent … elections has led … and the leadership of the … to propose a united front amongst the leftist and liberal parties against fascism.
events.flavor:
And just because he's a human,
a man would like a little bite to eat;
he wants no bull and a lot of talk
that gives no bread or meat.

options.name: Anything is better than the …'s vision.
Social democracy is simply the left wing of fascism.

events.title: The United Front

events.desc: Viewing the … as a major threat to the … nation, … has encouraged supporters of the … to organize into groups and attack suspected communists on the streets.
events.flavor: "There are those in our very own government who believe that the … is a party like any other. It is not! This cabal is not truly a political party, but a front for a secret society, admitting within its ranks aliens, spies, and minors. Its attempts to nestle itself into the dark corners of our cities must be met with the only thing these animals understand - the force of good, … fists!"

options.name: Accost communist partisans wherever they may appear.
Target the communists' leaders, to crush the masses' morale.
This violence will be the death of democracy!

events.title: Practical Opposition

events.desc: To secure additional support for the …, … and several high-ranking party members have approached the … to promote policies designed to ensure collaboration between capital and a … government.
events.flavor:
"Fascism should more properly be called corporatism, because it is the merger of state and corporate power."

— Benito Mussolini

options.name: The … will prove to be excellent allies.
The … do not need their assurances.

events.title: Collaboration and Capital

events.desc: Pointing to the clear and present danger presented to the … nation by "communists and communist-sympathetic groups", … has called for a campaign of national unity to defeat communism, organized behind the ….
events.flavor: "In these times, we, as loyal citizens of the … nation, must come together as one, and remain ever vigilant. There exist enemies of government within our borders, foreign agents who wish to tear down everything which makes our country great. But they are small in number, my friends, and we are many..."
