options.name: The Red threat must not be permitted a foothold here!
National unity, certainly, but not behind the ….

events.title: For National Unity

events.desc: In a recent speech, … has directly pointed to the state of … as an example of what awaits … society if the … does not come to power. According to …, only … can save the nation from communism.
events.flavor:
"There has been talk amongst certain circles of a strike - an attempt by the Communists to seize power, to transform … into a blood-Red nightmare! Well, let me remind you of what they want. In …, they've made women into state property! They've burned priests alive! They've assaulted banks and small businessmen!

We shall not allow the communists in this nation to replace us, to rule our affairs. This is …, not …!"

options.name: The whole nation must unite against the … menace!
Perhaps … should focus … rhetoric more domestically.
This is nothing but scaremongering nonsense.

events.title: The Red Terror Abroad

events.desc: Partisans affiliated with the … have committed a series of violent and humiliating acts against … people in …. Opponents of the … have accused … of inspiring the attack through … extreme rhetoric.
events.flavor:
Broken glass and ash, crunched underfoot. Signs marred with the symbols of fascism. Bodies blackened by flame, still lying where the paramilitaries had cut them down. The inspector knew that they would never be identified satisfactorially to press charges.

As he sat down on a nearby bench, surveying the scene, an acidic thought passed through his mind. Of the men charged with solving this case, how many of them had seen it firsthand, through black masks?

options.name: The … are vile purveyors of baseless hatred.
Can anyone truly prove … called for this action?
… is a true defender of …, and the … are its enemies.

events.title: Hatred in Action

events.desc: On behalf of the …, … has embarked on a tour of various rural and remote regions in …, seeking to enroll voters and ensure ballots are collected in difficult-to-reach communities.
events.flavor: "Nestled in at the tops of mountains, in the hearts of dark forests, surrounded by empty plains, unmarked on any map... it is here that people are found, nonetheless. It is our duty to empower every one of them."

options.name: Everyone should hear of the …'s mission!
One man, one vote - no matter how remote!

events.title: Franchise for Farmers

events.desc: The …, spearheaded by the organizing efforts of …, has begun a popular campaign focused on their desired preservation of rural values in an age of rapid and frightening change.
events.flavor: "You may say that it is new and better, that it will give us more to buy, or enrich our children. But what matters is that it is strange and different, it puts us out of work, and we did not ask for it."

options.name: Stand by your community - vote for the …!
We must build a broader coalition against these alien tendencies.

events.title: Rural Values

events.desc: An argument about the people's role in military command between … and … has prompted a spat between the … and the ….
events.flavor: "The esteemed … has, respectfully, no knowledge of what … speaks. There is a reason that the … are able to handle their own affairs - we are specially trained to do so, and the common people simply cannot be expected to hold the same level of knowledge."

options.name: Yes, the people know!
Military matters are best left to the generals.

events.title: Swords and Plowshares

events.desc: An unexpectedly popular campaign of agitation by … against the … government's colonial policies has led to greatly increased public interest in the …'s platform.
events.flavor:
Out of all of the displays, it was by far the depictions of distant atrocities that drew the most spectators. Grown men stood wide-eyed as their gaze traced the origin of rivers of red, and children hid behind their mothers to evade the accusing eyes of the bayoneted men.

It was not any complex slogan that won the day, or clever turn of rhetoric - it was this, the only phrase that one needed upon seeing such things.

"How can we stop it?"

options.name: Channel this energy to support anti-imperial policies.
Only the … stands against senseless war!

events.title: Anti-Imperial Advocacy

events.desc: Following the recent expansion of industry into rural communities in …, … has begun a local campaign for the …, stressing desired solutions to the unpleasant smog now common around the region's factories.
events.flavor:
The pall of smoke that obscured the sky seemed to be reflected in the eyes of the villagers, as … rode by. Rather than the bright, sunny day that … had anticipated, this speech would be accompanied by the everpresent gloom.

It was no matter. As … looked up at the sky, and envisioned the cloud obscuring the hearts of men, a vision for a new sort of rhetoric crossed … mind. Whilst the workmen began to raise the stage, … picked up a pen, and started to write.

options.name: The … will bring back the sun!
They stand for nothing but opposition to progress.

events.title: Votes for Clear Skies

events.desc: As a major part of their electoral platform, … and the leadership of the … have begun an aggressive campaign to distance themselves from the revolutionary socialist ideology of the ….
events.flavor: "Communism is the death of peace, and the death of liberty."

options.name: We must present an attractive alternative to the people.
Focus our campaign on combating the Communists.

events.title: Against Extremism

events.desc: … has embarked upon a dedicated campaign to organize the poor urban workers in …, shaping them into a cohesive and powerful pro-… voting bloc.
events.flavor: "If any man, woman, or child is neglected, abandoned, and left with no voice or hope... how can we say that the … nation is truly civilized?"

options.name: The people of … are awakened.
This strategy should be repeated nationwide.

events.title: Engaging the People

events.desc: Utilizing …'s connections in the …, the … has gained a much greater share of dedicated and ideologically committed union voters.
events.flavor:
Stacks of posters exited the printer's shop, each bearing the logo of the …, and a slogan. Men with hammers, calls for solidarity, and red ink by the pail splashed across the papers, ready to be pinned up around the city by a veritable army of partisans.

He took a moment to look with pride at a draft sitting on a workbench, studying the shapes printed on the paper, at the vibrant reds, blacks, and whites. And then, most of all, to the bottom right corner, where that crucial sigil made its appearance:
"Produced with Union Labor".

options.name: Mobilize the union vote for the …!
Strong … will serve us for many years.

events.title: The Union's Campaign

events.desc: To avert the fears of the upper class with regards to a potential … government, … has carried out a series of meetings with wealthy influencers, stressing the importance of reform still adhering to … values.
events.flavor: "It is simply the case that if there are no reforms to … society, there will be a social revolution. I do not embrace this. In fact, I hate it like sin. But this is reality - you must see this as clearly as I do. And so the question comes to this - how do we avert this?"

options.name: Reform against revolution!
Try as they might, they will always be Reds.

events.title: Bourgeois Fears

events.desc: … has begun a campaign emphasizing the …'s pro-franchise platform, promising greatly expanding voting rights for all segments of society if the party is elected.
events.flavor: "My esteemed colleagues! What do you have to fear from an empowered people? Can you say that you embrace the people looking upon what you have done, and being as proud as you are?"

options.name: Form an electoral coalition with other pro-franchise candidates.
Only the … can truly serve the people!

events.title: Fight for the Franchise

events.desc: A minor scandal has buzzed around the …, as a piece of reformist fiction written by … in … youth has begun to circulate once more. Whilst enthusiastically written, that is the work's only merit.
events.flavor: The "plague of superstition and dogma" was the end of …? If it is so, why are the trains still running? How could they possibly have acquired the coal to fuel it? Your propensity to butcher your characters for cheap tragedy is nothing short of shameful. And to make matters worse... why would …

options.name: A tragic tale, but there is no reason to harass ….
This is …'s problem, not the party's.
The quality is reflective of... the conservative repression of arts.

events.title: Authorial Intent

events.desc: … delivered a speech on behalf of the … to a crowd of hundreds in one of …'s parks. By the end of it, the crowd had soured against any notion of slavery.
events.flavor:
"Dozens, if not hundreds, brought upon ships from their homes. Taken in the dead of night or sold to appease a debtor, it does not matter. Then they are arrayed, as if you would stack carpets or chairs, in the holds for months."

A lady brought a handkerchief to her cheek. Her husband's lip stiffened.

"Avert your eyes all you wish, but your hearts know the truth."

options.name: The people chose before; they will choose now.
Bring the matter to the table at once!

events.title: The Curse of Shackles

events.desc: While meeting to discuss ideas, … and … enjoyed a civil and enlightening conversation. Most expected a brawl.
events.flavor: Some say opposites attract, and others say opposites repulse. A few understand that one of the natures of opposites is change: fire and water to steam, spark and gunpowder to explosion, heat and ore to metal. And so it is with a good-faith debate: a leap in thought to form fresh ideas.

options.name: Liberal civility is the way forward.
…'s conduct ought to be commended.
Even the Opposition should be heard.

events.title: A Rational Discussion

events.desc: Seeking to turn the tide of nationalism to the favor of the …, … held a patriotic speech in one of …'s parks.
events.flavor: Nationalism is the often assumed and unearned superiority of one's place of birth. It is easily mistaken for something approaching the lines of patriotism, but a sharp eye can spot the different. A sharper mind knows how to use it as leverage.

options.name: Truly, a hero for the people.
We should ensure the laws are properly secured.
Cease this shameless pandering!

events.title: Our Great Nation

events.desc: Today's speech from … focuses on the …, and the efforts of the … to secure it. A crowd has flocked from all corners to hear it.
events.flavor: "No true discussion may be had while the law binds us to silence! How is it that we may call ourselves 'great' and 'enlightened' whilst we fear reprisal from the law itself? And for what? Our very words? 'Great' and 'enlightened...' a falsehood, I say! A lie! A travesty! A shameful display!"

options.name: … has a point...
Fetch the paper and the ink. There's a law to draft!
Those who wish to speak should know how and when, first.

events.title: Speaking on Speech

events.desc: … and … were spotted in discussions about the coming election. Preachers the next day were extolling virtues of the ….
events.flavor: The First Estate and the Second Estate hand-in-hand since the oldest glories of imperium. A more modern appellation of the holy marriage is 'hearts and minds'—a glorious leader to capture their hearts, and a magnificent god to occupy their minds.

options.name: The … are beyond our reach.
Let us hope they do not decide the election.

modifiers.label: Political Strength from the Votes of Clergymen

options.name: Never trust a true-believer on worldly matters.

events.title: Birds of a Feather

events.desc: … has fallen to a revolution amongst the …. In the campaign materials of the …, … has immediately denounced the … here, preempting a similar revolt.
events.flavor:
"You would name me a traitor?"

"Of that, I'm certain you are. Many abroad in … would think similarly to you. What's to say you're not a traitor already? Plotting sedition with the members of your book club?"

"You've gone mad!"

options.name: Someone must stand against the revolutionary tide!
… is far away, and this is here.
The revolution will not be villainized!

events.title: The Defender of Decency

events.desc: When invited to give a speech on behalf of the …, … began extolling the virtues of a strong home, strong borders, and strong men. The public reception was mixed.
events.flavor: "Truly, I dare say, the men are no longer men! They are coddled with books, as if they are any substitute for a real adventure! Their mothers swaddle them in cotton and silk, only for them to be henpecked by their wives! And heaven forbid they take a pint of beer: one sip, and they need their fathers to carry them home!"

options.name: Won't someone think of the children?
Won't someone think of the children?
Old ways for older times, and even older fools.
Rhetoric cannot disguise what … wants.

events.title: The Good Old Days

events.desc: … has made overtures to the … for electoral support to the …. … has, at least, acknowledged the talks.
events.flavor: Appeals for 'natural allies' makes for a gamble on long odds. Receptive ears to 'natural allies' are often already of like mind. Those who aren't of like mind would, politely, continue on their own way. Impolitely, they might laugh, scoff, or, if they are truly devious, turn the gambler into their own useful idiot.

options.name: Old minds think alike.
Grass tends to grow as it pleases.

modifiers.label: Political Strength from the Votes of Farmers

options.name: They should beware …'s shrewdness.

events.title: The Levies

events.desc: At a soirée for the …'s wealthiest supporters, … began a long-winded rant about the merits of slavery and discrimination.
events.flavor:
"As you can plainly see, the development of the skull is directly tied to the civility of a man. One can assuredly determine his fitness for good society by the proper measurement of his circumference-"

"And how do you intend to prove that a man does his thinking with his bones?"

"As I said, you can determine a man's fitness for good society by properly measuring his skull.

options.name: People are entitled to their opinions, even if they are wrong.
Civilisation is the means of our equality.
One wonders if … has ever been flogged before...

events.title: Bishop Takes Black Pawn

events.desc: The … have formally censured … over an unconventional article in a … newspaper advocating for disruptive social policies.
events.flavor: "I would like to express my sincerest apologies for my article in the gazette on Thursday. At the time, I had been speaking with several fellows about the deplorable state the renting situation has become in …. Perhaps it is forever too soon to suggest polygamy as a viable solution for the working class."

options.name: The sanctity of marriage must be protected!
Anything to make renting more bearable...
You could just give them money.

events.title: Rent in This Economy?

events.desc: … …'s desperation for the approval of … subjects has inspired … to further the …'s views.
events.flavor: "Look now at this failed ruler! This appointee of God! A man who barely knows what day it is, let alone how to tie his own shoes. Attended for his every whim by you, you bakers and cobblers, you tailors and butchers. And now, he rewards his favorite flatterers with the sweat of your brow. Your very lives! If God appointed him, then I say God is a fool! No, no, I say... I say God is dead!"

options.name: Rally the people in the city squares.
Address the …'s loyal 'thinkers.'
Enlighten the faltering … directly.

events.title: Popularity Contest

events.desc: … has taken to the streets, encouraging … people to take less conventional means of democracy in order to support the ….
events.flavor: A riot may be the voice of the unheard, but it is one of many tools to be heard. The simplest of which is a kind word over a drink. Next is art. Many who do not appreciate art often forget how powerful a well-crafted poster is. Of course, there is always the option of a kind word and a gun in a dark alley. The choices are endless when you put your mind to it.

options.name: And they will be heard when the time is right.
Any malcontents ought to be jailed.
No democracy is true without everyone's voice.

events.title: The Other Voting Methods

events.desc: … has taken a fiery stand against the …'s case for democracy by the enlightened few. Though simple, the case was an effective endorsement of the …'s stance on ….
events.flavor:
"The conventionalities of democracy make it impossible for any but the enlightened men among us to vote. I should put it to anyone to disprove that natural course of democracy."

"Ahem. I shall offer a simple refutation. Could any man or woman not in present ownership of property raise their hand if they agree: a child ought to learn to read and write when able."

Every hand rose.

"And now you have participated in democracy."

options.name: Simple and true. Remarkable!
There's more to lawmaking than this.
And what about the women?

events.title: Rights for Me, and for Thee

events.desc: … has ambushed a royal appearance in … for a simple announcement: the … are wholly committed to the establishment of a republic.
events.flavor: The divine right of kings is one such justification that the monarch in question should never be questioned. Another is the Mandate of Heaven. Second verse, same as the first, it is the same in principle: do not question the monarch. The funny thing is, once God is dead, who then assures the divine right?

options.name: The … must demonstrate … connection to the people.
Sedition cannot be tolerated.
Our allegiance is to a republic, to democracy!

events.title: To Decapitate a Serpent

events.desc: … has thrown a soirée for the cream of the …. Bribes, ill-disguised as donations, traded hands into the ….
events.flavor:
"With your help this coming election, we'll make sure that those machines of yours stay greased and those ports stay open!"

Only two hundred hands were in attendance, yet each clap was a thunderstrike to herald the passage of a thousand ships.

options.name: They're likely to spend it all on champagne.
Someone ought to inquire about those donations.
Can't we put this corruption money to better use?

events.title: Rich Get Richer

events.desc: While campaigning for additional support, … pointed to … as an example of how the … would strengthen foreign ties.
events.flavor: The essence of trade is simple: one party has something the other party needs, and will give it on the basis of mutual exchange. Most commonly, a book for a book, a meal for a meal, a favor for a favor. Less commonly, and arguably more perilous, is the trade by which nations make: human life for material wealth. Otherwise known as economics.

options.name: We welcome our friends from ….
… must have a factory there.
If … loves … so much, … should live there!

events.title: Friends Abroad

events.desc: Election tensions between the … and the … have run high as … accused the … of flagrant warmongering behavior.
events.flavor:
"General! I would have words with you and your saber-rattling tin-men. You and your bully boys have been conspiring to wage war in the very near future. What say you?"

"How else will we use the bullets and the bandages you supply us with, sir? A war makes for greater demand in your wares."

"That's... that's beside the point! Our factories are in the firing line!"

options.name: The … have been privy to too many decisions.
… should concern … strictly with the …'s matters.
Perhaps a newly raised regiment will ease …'s woes.

events.title: Saber-Rattling Soldiery

events.desc: …, in … campaigning for the …, has promoted ideals of … and …, that others may share in … success. … has accused … of exploiting immigrants.
events.flavor: A truism for anywhere you go: always read the fine print. Anyone unscrupulous enough can swindle you out of anything: your clothes, your bank account, your horse, your house, your land, and even your very life. And especially read the fine print if it seems like someone's offering you everything you need.

options.name: We patrol our borders for a reason.
…'s successes are for all to share.
All immigrants should be educated at the gates.

events.title: Free Trade, Freer Labor

events.desc: An audacious move by … saw a crowd publicly divided on a matter close to home: the …'s explicit support of child labor.
events.flavor: "Step right up kids, and enjoy a day in the sun! That's right, you get five bob a day to pick fruit and play in the grass. And you get the time outside your parents are always nagging you about! Get away from them, get out in the sun, and build those strong muscles and birthing hips you'll need for your own families. Help out Old Man Jenkins today!"

options.name: So long as they're kept out of truly dangerous jobs.
Don't listen to …, kids. Off to school.
Perhaps … would like to send a delegation to …'s workplaces

events.title: Get Experience Early!

events.desc: …'s rhetoric has drawn negative attention to the representatives of the …, who he has condemned for obstructing the passage of ….
events.flavor: "The …! A conglomeration of rats, sitting in their gilded seats and claiming to serve the interests of the people. And yet the people have spoken, and it is the demand of those very people that they cease and desist!"

options.name: Pressure the … into cooperating for now.
We will not harm our relationship over one law.

events.title: Obstructionism in the …

events.desc: … and … supporters have publicly petitioned at a prison in … for the release of a pro-… protester held there on charges of disorderly conduct.
events.flavor:
The prisoner sat in his lightless cell, staring listlessly at the wall. The voices were beginning to carve through his mind again, repeating his name over and over again, giving voice to his torment.

He closed his eyes, and covered his ears, bidding it to stop. Only when blissful silence finally fell over him did he realize that the chants were not coming from within his head at all.

options.name: His imprisonment has already achieved its goals.
Justice will not be overturned by the dictate of the mob.

events.title: Political Imprisonment

events.desc: The successes that … have seen with its policies of … have been noticed by supporters of …, who point towards it as an example of ideal government.
events.flavor:
… held up the newspaper with an expression of amusement on … face

"You see this? This is an admission of victory. It may call us spies, agents of foreign powers, but it also concedes that the change we desire it not, indeed, something alien, without precedent..."

options.name: What succeeded in … will succeed in ….
… is not ….
Why not use the relevant … law as a template?

events.title: Foreign Emulation

events.desc: Representatives of the … in the government have demanded several compromises in the enactment of …. These measures have already been condemned by supporters of … as corrosive to the reform as a whole.
events.flavor: "The word of a mob in the street will not change the nature of the national interest. We have chosen to stand by our principles, and avert this government from making a terrible mistake. That is all, and that is all there ever will be."

options.name: The support of the … is not worth the damage done.
… will complain, but we will act.

events.title: Compromising the People

events.desc: Supporters of … among the …, headed by …, have questioned the government publicly on the amount of time that is required in order for the law to pass.
events.flavor: "The government is, at this time, carrying out an atrocity through cold bureaucracy. It favors procedure over lives, paperwork over hunger. How many people need to suffer for the sake of the feelings of some government functionaries who have never felt a speck of hunger in their lives? Documents can wait, ladies and gentlemen—but the people's suffering cannot!"

options.name: The bill will be passed when the process is completed.
Documents can wait. The people cannot.

events.title: Confusion and Delay

events.desc: The activities of … have stirred up significant public opposition for the enaction of …. Certain figures in the … are concerned as to how this could affect their support amongst the people.
events.flavor:
A sea of papers blanketed the walls of the capital, regardless of the sanitary services' valiant nightly attempts to remove them. … stabbed a finger at a building at random.

"Do you see that? How am I supposed to arrange support for the measure if it could be my home being vandalized next?"

options.name: Open a dialogue with the opposition.
The …'s concerns are wholly unfounded.

events.title: The People's Opposition

events.desc: The public agitation that … has inspired against … has led the … to refuse to support the law in its current state.
events.flavor: "We regret to inform you that our mind is set on this matter. It is clear that popular support is viciously against the law in its current form, and we have no interest in siding with a proposal that has been demonstrated to be toxic in totality."

options.name: Amend the law to make it more palatable to support.
Make it clear to the … that they are unnecessary.

events.title: Despicable Neutrality

events.desc: … has launched a vicious series of insults against … for his support of …. The … have demanded the government act to defend … honor.
events.flavor:
"… has the mentality of a particularly slow child. This is simply the reality of … situation. I severely doubt that … fully understands the implications of what he claims to desire. Rather, it is my suspicion that … nasally excretions, recognized as speech by some unfortunate translator, has simply been equated by default to the worst possible opinion."

"It is unsurprising that such a sentiment passed through … lips, however, for one must recognize that … simply lacks the mental faculties to participate in good-faith politics..."

options.name: … must learn to grow a thicker skin.
Remind … of our laws against slander.

events.title: A Torrent of Abuse

events.desc: Several-year-old journal articles and statements by present government officials opposing … have been dredged up by newspapers sympathetic to …'s cause. These revelations have led to accusations of opportunism from both opponents and supporters of the law.
events.flavor: "We must now address the matter of past stances on this matter. No less than three years ago, one of the bill's co-sponsors published an editorial condemning this very proposal as a "hopeless waste of time", an "ill-conceived and irrelevant matter", and other harsh testimonials. Yet, in recent days, no doubt with assistance from significant sums of money, the allegedly honorable gentleman seems to have reversed his opinions entirely..."

options.name: What indolent lack of principles!
People can change their views with time.

events.title: Antiquated Words

events.desc: Following the arrest of a prominent opponent to …, … has begun a public letter-writing campaign to demonstrate support for them.
events.flavor:
"I hope that you have been well..."

"We are praying for your swift release..."

"This injustice is one that has been mercilessly exposed..."

All of these and more shuffled inside the mail bag, as the courier neared his destination.

options.name: The letters must flow freely.
Ensure that none of this drivel reaches the prison.

events.title: Letters to the Condemned

events.desc: A social club popular with the educated class has held a salon in …, with … speaking in favor of … as an honored guest.
events.flavor:
"That is, indubitably, the case. But have you considered what the reception of such a thing would be?"

… nodded towards the speaker, then back around the wood-paneled room. … put down … cup.

"I have spent some time thinking of it—we must, in all things, consider the thoughts of those who behold a thing for the first time. A first viewing is carried out with the eyes of an innocent, with mind open for new possibilities..."

options.name: They seem like the sort to know what is best.
Encourage the further development of these salons.

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living from Literacy

events.title: The … Citizens' Assocation

events.desc: A popular … newsletter has released a statement by …, endorsing several poets known for their sympathies to the …'s interests.
events.flavor: "The ideals of love and comradeship are present therein, but when one looks beyond the surface, one is faced with the precise conditions for such a thing. Those things which foster the highest ideals, and can be made manifest in one's daily life..."

options.name: The idols of the … culture stand behind our reforms.
The loyal support of the … should be rewarded.

events.title: Artistic Expressions

events.desc: … has embarked upon a week-long tour of the countryside, to spread awareness of the need for … amongst the ….
events.flavor:
"Happy is it, indeed, for me that my heart is capable of feeling the same simple and innocent pleasure as the peasant whose table is covered with food of his own rearing, and who not only enjoys his meal, but remembers with delight the happy days and sunny mornings when he planted it, the soft evenings when he watered it, and the pleasure he experienced in watching its daily growth."

— Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, The Sorrows of Young Werther

options.name: A noble cause—and, with luck, a popular one as well.
As … reaches out to the people, so to do they reach out to ….
Why care for an outsider who offers nothing but words?
Remind … that he is unwelcome outside … city!

events.title: Popular Outreach

events.desc: …'s attendence at a bourgeois fund-raising banquet in … has led to an uptick in funds promoting ….
events.flavor: As the organizer, at the end of the table, stood to give a toast to the clear wisdom of Reform, he could not help but think of how closely the sound of his fork on the glass represented a coin falling into a bank, or a spent cartridge hitting the ground.

options.name: Nourishment for the body and the budget.
Vast sums of money flowing into politics, you say?

events.title: A Campaign of Banquets

events.desc: The Voice of …, a popular newspaper read by the … class across …, has published an article by … advocating for the enaction of ….
events.flavor:
"Putting out a newspaper without promotion is like winking at a girl in the dark—well-intentioned, but ineffective."

— William Randolph Hearst

options.name: Who are we to counteract the voice of the people?
Offer our thanks to the publisher.

events.title: Media Endorsements

events.desc: A narrowly-disguised polemic against … written by … has appeared in a popular opposition newspaper published across ….
events.flavor:
"You had ought to see the morning paper, sir. It's..."

"Yes?"

"Well, there's a … article in it. On the third page."

The functionary reached up, and put a hand on his temple. And with that, he knew that he was about to read something that may take years off of his life.

options.name: … is a scourge, as always.
Encourage our supporters to publish opposing articles.

events.title: Opposition in Print

events.desc: In a scandalous tip by a former newspaper publisher, it has been revealed to the government that a wave of recent anti-… articles have, in fact, all been written by … using different names and styles.
events.flavor:
"We hold that no person or set of persons can properly establish a standard of expression for others."

— William Randolph Hearst

options.name: It seems the opposition is both more and less monolithic than it appears to be.
The public would love to know more about this story.

events.title: Planted Grassroots

events.desc: In a display of disunity amongst opponents of the government, … has openly published the names of certain rival opposition figures in one of … pamphlets. The reveal of these identities gives the police a welcome opportunity.
events.flavor:
"Without a strong organization skilled in waging political struggle under all circumstances and at all times, there can be no question of that systematic plan of action, illumined by firm principles and steadfastly carried out, which alone is worthy of the name of tactics."

— Vladimir Lenin

options.name: How convenient.
We will not indulge … infantile plotting.

events.title: Thinning the Opposition

events.desc: In the process of his education at … …, …'s son has begun espousing sentiments that echo those encouraged by …'s supporters.
events.flavor:
"Well, actually, the professor talked about the most fascinating thing in class today..."

As he talked on and on, seemingly oblivious, …'s fist clenched tighter and tighter under the dinner table.

options.name: Families must respect others' opinions at the table.
Knock some sense into the insolent brat.
Perhaps he should be attending a different kind of school.

events.title: Family Matters

events.desc: An associate of … has approached a major … newspaper, requesting an original poem subtly indicating opposition to the enaction of … be published in its pages.
events.flavor:
"It's one of my father's, sir, from before he passed away. He was very committed, you see...

"No, no. When he says that, he's not talking about now. He's referring to the last time such a thing was- was attempted, you see, it's about cyclical... patterns in history. Not the act."

options.name: Absolutely not. We all know the true author.
Who are we to turn down a quality work?

events.title: Original Discontent

events.desc: … has issued a particularly convincing public address in support of a …, disseminating egalitarian ideals and citations to anti-royalist literature in equal measure.
events.flavor:
"If we want the Republic to be solid, we must first build its foundation. We need not look abroad for this foundation; we should seek it in the hearts of all the people of the nation."

— Sun Yat-Sen

options.name: A magnificent display!
No words may overthrow the divine order.

events.title: The Legacy of the Enlightenment

events.desc: In … agitation against the institution of the monarchy, … has made numerous comments that have been construed as lèse-majesté. Supporters of the … have demanded … prosecution.
events.flavor:
"And as far as the matter of the … goes..."

The crowd held their breaths, sensing that something fantastic was coming.

"I see no reason to pretend to respect somebody whose position is earned solely by having blood more inbred than the rest of us! Were heaven to send someone who was worthy of the title of ruler of …, it would certainly not be someone whose veins are filled with water!"

options.name: … behavior has finally crossed the line.
Dare we risk angering … supporters?

events.title: A Bout of Lèse-Majesté

events.desc: The activities of … have led to a prominent alliance between republicans and those in favor of greater franchise. Those who support a more democratic …, rather than a Republic, are rapidly become marginalized.
events.flavor: "The Republic must be one assembled and sustained by the whole people, lest it be sickly from its birth to its soon and ignominious death."

options.name: A coalition that shall shake the world around them.
The … must show that … can rule in a democracy.
All liberals will betray the crown and the nation eventually.

events.title: Democratic Republicanism

events.desc: Close associates of … have been spotted in the company of several reform-minded military officers, including …. These activities raise concerns of a forced coup against the ….
events.flavor: "Regardless of any reason that … may conjur, … presence in the company of that hateful individual is evident of certain hazardous inclinations. I have given you all that I could assemble on the matter. For the sake of the integrity of the Throne, I beseech you to assess this with all due haste."

options.name: Make an example of … for sedition.
We cannot thin the ranks of the military on mere suspicion.

events.title: A Soldier's Republic?

events.desc: The agitation of … has led to a march in …, stating support for greater franchise and expanded political rights for the people.
events.flavor:
The march carried on for more than a block, a procession of bright eyes and feverish hearts that seemed to fill the city with a peculiar energy.

In front of the column, … stood, larger than life, conducting it with airs constructed of boundless hope.

options.name: A show of support for a magnificent bill.
Withdraw … license to speak, under pain of arrest.

events.title: The March of the Masses

events.desc: During a speech to a reformist salon in …, … has issued a particularly fervent speech condemning the … as opponents of democracy, and the people as a whole.
events.flavor: "I must now address the character of certain individuals who have proven themselves wholly devoted to the repression of the whole people. They are cruel and indolent beings, their whole existences marinated in privilege, relics of a stagnant era whose minds revolt at the prospect of a nation where their power is challenged."

options.name: Down with the enemies of Liberty!
The people will always require the supervision of their betters.
We all know the "privileged" that … was really referring to.

events.title: The Enemies of the People

events.desc: The attendance of … at a radical pro-reform association's meeting in … has raised public awareness of the association, and made police action against it significantly harder.
events.flavor:
The official looked at the document on his desk with some shock, looking at the name of the group which had proudly claimed to sponsor the last demonstration. That hateful and most certainly suppressed group, paired with the name of that bothersome … who had been responsible for so many difficulties over the past years. He frowned, and turned to his neighbor.

"Did we not already make the warrant against these people public?"

options.name: Perhaps it is time to grant them our sanction.
The view of the public is not an excuse.

events.title: Controversial Friends

events.desc: Under the guise of a particularly stuffy romance novel, … has managed to get a subtly anti-government text through the censorship board. The novel's subtext advocates for freedom of speech and rejection of what it deems "despotism".
events.flavor:
"Isn't that always the way it is? If a person's inclined to look for something, he finds it wherever he looks. Even if there's no trace of it at all, he still finds clear evidence. Even if there's not even a shadow, still he sees not only a shadow of what he's looking for but everything he's looking for. He sees it in the most unmistakable terms, and these terms become clearer with each new glance and every new thought."

— Nikolai Chernyshevsky, What Is To Be Done?

options.name: We will not re-examine a five hundred page book on a whim!
Recall the novel, and require existing copies be turned in.

events.title: Romance in the Censorship Office

events.desc: An anonymous figure within the police force has submitted a list of officers who allegedly sympathize with …'s cause. According to the letter, these officers have quietly refused to carry out censorship duties.
events.flavor:
"...yes, him. Did you hear about what he said, after we passed him that novel?"

The clerk followed the informant's pointed thumb, oriented towards an unaware man eating his lunch.

"No. Enlighten me," he said, face neutral.

"Well, it was something along the lines of "the Board is half dead already..."

options.name: Why bother? Censorship is on its way out, anyway.
We will enforce this law until the instant it is repealed.

events.title: A Lack of Enforcement

events.desc: A popular …-aligned newspaper has published an audacious article by …, calling for the abolition of censorship. The popularity of the newspaper amongst even supporters of the government makes banning it a risky affair.
events.flavor:
As the supervisor entered the office, eyes bleary from a restless night's sleep, he rapidly came to be aware of the pained expressions on the faces of his staff. A look at the pinboard immediately explained their discomfort - spelled out in bold-face newsprint.

"FOR YOUR CONSIDERATION: A CASE FOR FREE EXPRESSION"

options.name: Even some of us agree that they have a point.
If we blink here, it will only get worse.

events.title: A Game of Chicken

events.desc: … has made us an offer for the purchase of ….

options.name: The land is worthless, let the …s have it.
… may hide riches yet.

events.title: An Offer for Alaska

events.desc: … has agreed to our terms. A treaty for the purchase of … has been drafted.
events.flavor:
"Tomorrow, if you like, I will come to the department, and we can enter upon the treaty."
"Why wait until tomorrow, Mr. Stoeckl? Let us make the treaty tonight!"

options.name: What riches do these vast territories hide?

events.title: The … Purchase

events.desc: Negotiations with … over the purchase of … have failed.
events.flavor: "We see, therefore, that War is not merely a political act, but also a real political instrument, a continuation of political commerce, a carrying out of the same by other means."

options.name: We will continue diplomacy through other means.
It was worth an attempt.

events.title: Failed … Purchase

events.desc: … finds itself unable to protect its North American colony of …, and appears willing to sell the territory to us for an affordable sum.
events.flavor: "The representative of … agrees to pay at the treasury in …, to the diplomatic representative or other agent of … Majesty the … of all …, seven million two hundred thousand dollars in gold."

options.name: Make the necessary arrangements.
We cannot afford such an expense right now.

events.title: An Offer for Alaska

events.desc: Standing on the deck of the …—flagship of the Mediterranean squadron—… … announces the end of large scale military operations in Algeria.
events.flavor:
The colorful procession of troops slowly snakes its way along Algier's waterfront. Brighly clad Zouaves march lockstep towards the anchored … vessels lining the harbor, carrying the torn battle standards of vanquished Algerian regiments. Behind them, lancers, regulars, and native Tiralleurs follow suit.

As … gazes out on the vast assembly of … military might from … position on the aft deck, … thoughs are interrupted by the gentle clearing of a throat. "It's the governor, sir. He wants to know what's next on the agenda."

options.name: Today we salute the heroes of Africa!
Subsidize companies to acquire farmland for European settlers.
The rule of the saber is at an end. Contact the Sheikhs.

events.title: The Proclamation of Algiers

events.desc: Sympathetic to their plight, …, leader of the …, has proposed the granting of … citizenship to Algeria's native … population.
events.flavor:
No. 136. - Declaring the indigenous Jews of Algeria … citizens.

The indigenous Jews of the departments of Algeria are declared … citizens; therefore, their actual status and personal status will, after the promulgation of this decree, be settled by … law, any rights acquired to date remaining inviolable.
Any legislative provision, decree, regulation or ordinance to the contrary is abolished.

Done at …
Signed …

options.name: Approved. God knows we could use some goodwill in the region.
Denied. This will rock the boat too much.

events.title: The … Decree

events.desc: With the loss of the last … foothold in Algeria, the grand colonial project started in 1830 has come to an inglorious end.
events.flavor:
The knocking on …'s study door grows more intense by the minute—each thud reverberating through the General's head as if they were physical blows.

In front of …, a small mountain of reports, each and every one of them somehow more damning than the last.
"Incompetence." "Humiliation." "Disaster."
Many were the times when … had pondered his legacy. Well now … knows. … is the … that lost Algeria.

The thuds grow ever louder.
They will expect a statement soon.

… might as well give one to them.

options.name: With a trembling hand, … lifts the gun to … temple.

events.title: The Algerian Fiasco

events.desc: Decades of hard labor has borne fruit. Where farmers and slaves once toiled under the boot of oriental despots, the illuminating torch of … civilization has revealed a new land: Our land.
events.flavor:
O regrets for Algiers and for its stores,
Their traces no longer exist!
Such iniquities committed by the accursed ones!
Al-Qaisariya has been named Plaza
And to think that holy books were sold and bound there.
They have rummaged through the tombs of our fathers,
And they have scattered their bones
To allow their wagons to go over them.

options.name: Civilization has come to the Barbary Coast.
Algeria shall become as French as Champagne.
What … demands, Algeria shall provide.

events.title: A French Algeria

events.desc: Marauders flying the flag of … have raided our settlements in …, slaughtering both a … garrison and several high-profile collaborators.
events.flavor:
"It was a feint, sir. We thought we were chasing a small raiding party, as only some cattle had been reported as stolen, but the moment we entered the ravine a cacophony of shouts and gunshots erupted. The captain was the first to fall, and everything went to hell thereafter.

From there on it's just a haze of butchery and fire, sir."

options.name: Rebuild. Their day will come.
… … is responsible, call up a tribunal.

events.title: … … Raided

events.desc: Building on experiences made during the pacification of Algiers, … … has requested the creation of a bureau staffed by ethnographers, orientalists and intelligence officers, to aid colonial authorities in their interactions with the native population.
events.flavor:
"Two years ago you went into the interior, looking for a better way to tame the land. Now you return, saying we must confine the Europeans and not the natives?
My friend, you have spent far too much time outside the city walls, the sun must have frazzled your brain."

options.name: Their skills will be instrumental in pacifying the land.

Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Better understanding equals better exploitation.
Abolish this initiative, it would only impede our settlers.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Arab Bureaux

events.desc: With the invaders banished from Algerian shores and order restored across the land, … … ponders … next move. What shall become of …?
events.flavor:
… … dismounts … horse in front of the Dey's old palace, its crumbling walls pock-marked with shot and bullet holes—some recent, some older than even … ….
Just past the gate, a group of … regulars can be seen hauling captured French cannon onto carts, supervised by a dour-looking captain shouting orders in a thick Turkish accent, while a group of Kabylian warriors are rolling dice in the courtyard, playing for what seems to be an officer's pocket watch.

options.name: Restore the Deylik of Algiers.
Restore the Deylik, and resubmit to the High Porte.
I orient my face towards Him, who created the heavens.
The age of Arabs is over. The time of the Berber has come.
Out with the old. We shall build a new Algeria.

events.title: The Sand Settles

events.desc: With the erection of a permanent Legionary … in …, dubbed the Quartier Viénot, the … Foreign Legion has been established as a premier fighting force in Africa.
events.flavor:
"You came before me as Spaniards, as Germans, as Italians. Some driven by glory, others by duty, others still by a call for adventure. But all with a willingness to shed blood for a cause that was not your own.

And what stands before me now? Legionaries! Men with iron wills forged under the scorching African sun. Men that would sooner lose their lives than their courage, even in the face of insurmountable odds. Men that embrace our motto not merely as a symbol, but as a way of life."

options.name: Honor and fidelity.
The legion is our country.

events.title: The French Foreign Legion

events.desc: Workers on the … in … are dying in droves due to the harsh malarial conditions and the extreme demands placed upon them.
events.flavor: "Every mile is marked with gravestones, every track laid in blood. Malady and the scorching heat blister our bodies. We pave the road to hell with our lives."

options.name: Full steam ahead!

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Construction

options.name: This is too high a price to pay.
Tighten safety standards.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Construction

events.title: The Devil's Railroad

events.desc: Workers at the … in … are being severely mistreated. Mutilation has become a common punishment for perceived failures.
events.flavor: "They went on to declare, when asked why they had fled, that they had endured such ill-treatment at the hands of the Government officials and the Government soldiers in their own country that life had become intolerable, that nothing had remained for them at home but to be killed for failure to bring in a certain amount of rubber or to die from starvation or exposure in their attempts to satisfy the demands made upon them."

options.name: We cannot slow down production.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed on Plantations

options.name: Launch an inquiry into conditions at the plantations.
The perpetrators will pay for their crimes.

events.title: Hell on Earth

events.desc: Returning from a safari expedition, … was marooned on a small island in the …. There … was hunted like an animal by the … aristocrat ….
events.flavor: "Splendid! One of us is to furnish a repast for the hounds. The other will sleep in this very excellent bed. On guard, …."

options.name: Barbaric!
… had never slept in a better bed.

events.title: The Most Dangerous Game

events.desc: Currently in our possession are vast tracts of pristine, undeveloped Amazonian lands. While some laud its wild beauty, others see naught but an untamed frontier overflowing with …—longing for the gentle touch of progress and capital.
events.flavor:
"Take this down: we stand upon the edge of what could be the very lungs of the planet itself. The terrible wonders that might be inside are ours to behold, to conquer, and to subjugate. As Darkest Africa has yielded to-"

"Eh, sir, I believe I forgot my pen. Perhaps I could dictate when we return to camp?"

"Imbecile. Bah, use mine. Now, from the top, and do not interrupt!"

options.name: Fortune smiles on the brave...

events.title: Taming Amazonia

events.desc: After intense deliberations, an agreement has been reached between the … and the … delegations, delineating the border between our two nations in … and resulting in large tracts of lands being ceded to ….
events.flavor:
And with the final flourish, the treaty now stood binding and resolute. New maps were commissioned as fast as the … and … governments could bark the orders. A fresh border erected along the lines of the Amazon Basin.

Of course, while they agreed in theory, nobody quite knew where the Amazon Basin began. That would be for the municipalities to decide. Surely common sense would prevail in their disputes.

options.name: In the name of the Holy Trinity, sign.

events.title: The Treaty of Ayacucho

events.desc: After intense deliberations, an agreement has been reached between the … and the … delegations, delineating the border between our two nations in … and resulting in large tracts of lands being ceded to ….
events.flavor:
"South of Tabatinga and across the Javari. North of there, the confluence of rivers Apaporis and Japurá. You'll find it a fair deal, ambassador."

"And what about those bordering cities? Surely you don't claim to speak for two countries now, do you? A catastrophe nobody would need, I say."

"Well, of course! I would never dream of speaking for another. But perhaps that would be your next wisest move, no?"

options.name: In the name of the Holy Trinity, sign.

events.title: The Treaty of Bogotá

events.desc: Fuelled by profits from the developing … industry, the city of … in … has emerged as a major commercial center, sporting facilities and amenities yet unheard of in the rainforest.
events.flavor:
Sap Makes …' World Go Round
The burgeoning rubber trade, bled from the very trees of the Amazon Rainforest, have given … a stable economic crutch. While coffee and milk are the center of other parts of …, the utility of rubber has allowed other industries to flourish. Cobblers, toolmakers and hospitals alike are performing new miracles with this sticky new substance... (cont'd pp. 68-9)

options.name: It shall be the cornerstone of our … Empire...

events.flavor: In … every luxury is present. The rubber barons are a competitive sort and any new fancy or fashion becomes an arms race of excess. When walking the streets one could almost imagine that they are in Paris, save for the heat.

events.desc: Nested within the rainforests of …, the erstwhile sleepy village of … has grown into a major hub of … extraction and transportation.
events.flavor:

"But I am Señor Ramirez, and I am still ordering his-"

"Do not speak that name, boy. Never again. Do not bring those men to us... whoever's left."

options.name: ... and the rubber 'barons' require more labor.

events.title: An Outpost of Progress

events.desc: Like pearls on a string, cities and … entrepots now line …'s rail and riverine networks, bringing the blazing torch of civilization to the jungle in exchange for its rich bounties.
events.flavor: "You've remembered your pen this time? Yes, take everything down. Ahem. The Amazon, as I have predicted, has yielded like Darkest Africa before it. No thing of bark or magma borne will halt the wheels of progress. In this mighty- My God, man, did you note me asking about your pen? No, don't take that down! Stop!"

options.name: We are the harbingers of order...

events.title: Pearls in the Rough

events.desc: … barons, local authorities and elements of the … are divided on the best direction to shape the … peoples of …. Every argument, however, is rooted in self-interest.
events.flavor: Both her husband and her son's hands were struck red. Priests and nuns had brought canes upon the boy for dancing in the halls and reciting the old stories. The patron's enforcers believed the man had adulterated the rubber he tapped. If the men of the lash did not work them to death, she thought, the men of the single god would drive their souls to death.

options.name: Education is a distraction, their hands are for labor, not writing.
