events.title: Little by Little

events.desc: Anarchists have claimed responsibility for the bombing of a gentlemen's club frequented by members of the …. The body of … has been found amongst the rubble.
events.flavor: "War, class war, and you were the first to wage it under the cover of the powerful institutions you call order, in the darkness of your laws. There will have to be bloodshed; we will not dodge; there will have to be murder: we will kill, because it is necessary; there will have to be destruction; we will destroy to rid the world of your tyrannical institutions."

options.name: No more than these reactionaries deserve.
We cannot condone terrorism.

events.title: Propaganda of the Deed

events.desc: As … moves towards …, the … are calling for the disestablishment of state institutions.
events.flavor: "How can we call ourselves an anarchist society while we still uphold the tyranny of the state? The perpetrators of state violence still run rampant among us; police, conscription officers, colonial administrators—all class traitors. They steal the product of our honest labor and use it to fund our own oppression!"

options.name: Down with the police!
The state has no right to control us!
Colonialism is a blight upon mankind!
The state will slowly wither away.

events.title: Dismantling the State

events.desc: Anarchists are creating communities that eschew profit and embrace mutual responsibility for the care of their fellow human beings. …, the new leader of the …, has been encouraging the establishment of cooperative farms.
events.flavor: "We have no need of landlords, of bosses, or even of the state. Working together we can provide all we need, living free and equal, each of us being both dependent on and responsible for the wellbeing of our community."

options.name: We are stronger together.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: They have a fascinating approach to agriculture.
This will make great propaganda.

events.title: Mutual Aid

events.desc: The expedition spots the twin volcanic peaks of Erebus and Terror on the horizon. When they were first discovered by James Clark Ross, Erebus was observed to be in eruption. Thankfully we find the mountains at peace.
events.flavor: "They rose grimly into the western sky; allowing us to distinguish various bare, bleak, blackish summits, and to catch the curious sense of phantasy which they inspired as seen in the reddish antarctic light against the provocative background of iridescent ice-dust clouds."

options.name: We should move on quickly.
Collect geological samples.
Ascend Mount Erebus. We will be the first to reach the crater!

events.title: At the Mountains of Madness

events.flavor: "The temperature of the hut is low, of course, but in every other respect we are absolutely comfortable. There is an unlimited quantity of biscuit, and our discovery at Pram Point means an unlimited supply of seal meat. An empty kerosene tin and some firebricks have been made into an excellent little stove, which has been connected to the old stove-pipe. Already we can regard it as a temporary home."

options.name: This hut shall stand the test of time.
The hut need only last until our return.
We should rest and resupply before moving on.

events.title: Halfway Hut

events.desc: The expedition has realized that they have overshot on their route towards the next supply depot.

options.name: We need those supplies. Turn back.
Push on, we can do without the supplies.

events.title: Missed the Mark

events.desc: The expedition is doomed. Utterly exhausted, frostbitten, and out of supplies, all that is left to do is await the cold embrace of death.
events.flavor:
"Every day we have been ready to start for our depot 11 miles away, but outside the door of the tent it remains a scene of whirling drift. I do not think we can hope for any better things now. We shall stick it out to the end, but we are getting weaker, of course, and the end cannot be far. It seems a pity but I do not think I can write more."

"For God's sake look after our people."

options.name: I am just going outside and may be some time.

events.title: The End Is Near

events.flavor:
"The Pole. Unsullied, immaculate. The air glistened as if the snow possessed a light of its own; under our frozen feet must have laid a secret sun.

"It's here." And we took measures, we registered every possible anomaly, "it's here, move the beacon," and then it was here, right before my eyes, and then it was there, closer to the sleds, but it was here. It was finally here, and its reflected pallor illuminated our tired faces. "Gentlemen, now we can rest."

It is here."

options.name: Success! But now the hard journey north begins...
Damnation! And now the hard journey north begins...

events.title: The South Pole

events.desc: Supplies are running low for the Antarctic explorers. The crew debates the merits of killing some of the sled dogs, and dividing the meat between the men and the remaining dogs to increase their odds of survival.
events.flavor:
"One cannot calmly contemplate the murder of animals which possess such intelligence and individuality, which have frequently such endearing qualities, and which very possibly one has learnt to regard as friends and companions."

"We have agreed to shrink from nothing to achieve our goal! And besides if we do not do this, the dogs will surely die from malnutrition or exhaustion regardless."

options.name: It is the practical thing to do.
We will not stoop to such barbarism!

events.title: Dog Meat

events.flavor: "Glory. Victory. Cheers and parades. Absurd sums of money. Kind words. The repetition of the hero's shadow over one's own name. The crew. That precious group of indomitable bastards. Home. Days. Nights. How much I had missed the days and the nights, their calculated succession. The boredom of the routine. Waking up on my bed. Hot chocolate. Coffee. Tea. My favorite tartlets. How much I had missed the noise from this street."

options.name: We will succeed next time.
They are a credit to their nation.

rewards.name: First to Reach the South Pole

events.title: Homecoming

events.desc: Broken pieces of sea ice start to cover the surface of the water as the expedition approaches its destination. The ship's hull tries to make its way through the cold mass by ramming and crushing, but the ice becomes stronger as they advance.
events.flavor: "It wouldn't be sound to confess that such a peril intrigued me, but the imminent arrival of our final goal, announced by the increasing sea ice that surrounded us, could not but terrify and fascinate me at the same time. The snow cover that extended over it had prevented the sea from reflecting our silhouettes or our ship's—there was nothing else to see: it was just us, and the pole."

options.name: Onwards!
We have to trust …'s expertise.

events.title: Pack Ice

events.flavor: "The cold had reached us. The planks of antique oaks were now shyly hidden behind snow-laden layers of white, and the whole ship would have seemed deserted if it wasn't for the tremulous lights that we had managed to keep lit. The ice was engulfing us, and with its natural grace started to stab our precious shelter."

options.name: We'll blast through the ice!
Abandon ship.

events.title: Icebound

events.desc: … has successfully led the expeditionary crew to a whaling station on South Georgia, braving the journey from Elephant Island in an uncovered lifeboat with meager supplies. Tales of …'s heroism resound throughout the nation despite the failure of the expedition.
events.flavor:
"During our last night camping under the ruthless white, our cook had asked me if it had been a tough decision, "going back," he had said, "after making it so far, wasn't it hard?". No, I wanted to say. No, it wasn't.

What joy could the pole bring to a man, trapped between the sea and the mountain ranges, a starving silhouette of fog and cold? If the dry air had blown slightly stronger, we would all had dispelled, like diaphanous flakes of snow."

options.name: Three cheers for …!

events.title: Whaling Station

events.desc: As the expedition's ship turns to the side, the crew witnesses in awe a high, perpendicular face of ice; their only entrance to the continent.
events.flavor: "And there it stood. If it had a face, I know it'd be laughing at us. That ridiculous cracking sound—the ice breaking. And there it goes, there, a block falls into the sea. Threatening. Fatal. It's in the direction of our ship. This moment had haunted our minds since when we left the last harbor. Sailing had been difficult, but going into that uncharted continent would be like descending into the depths of a frozen hell."

options.name: We must climb it!
We should make a detour around the fissures.

events.title: The Great Ice Barrier

events.desc: The expedition has advanced through eternal days of snow marching until finding the impenetrable sight of the Transantarctic Mountains. A new challenge awaits, as their routes have been scarcely documented.
events.flavor:
"The ever-gray sky had left us in a state of cruel anesthesia, incapable of discerning the line that separated snow from atmosphere, snow from footprints, snow from us. A sharper gray was laid before us, and in its numbness resided a familiar comfort.

The wall of stone was covered in white, and it took us most of the day to understand that it was no vertical sky, no heaven falling upon us, the final chant, the doomed trumpets, a mirage. Those were mountains."

options.name: We'll find a new route.
We'll be taking a known approach.

events.title: The Transantarctic Mountains

events.desc: During the expedition's advances through the snow a strange rock with unknown marks has been discovered, partly buried under their feet.

options.name: Stop and study it.
Ignore it.

events.title: Strange Marks

events.desc: The Antarctic Continent remains almost entirely unexplored. An expedition to this vast frozen waste would be expensive and fraught with peril, but the glory of being first to the Pole would be immense.
events.flavor: Murmurs and whispers soon fill the halls of the world's most prestigious science academies, as the prospect of reaching the final geographical discovery becomes much more than a fever dream.

options.name: I know just the man for the job.

events.title: Expedition to Antarctica

events.desc: We must choose a leader for the upcoming expedition to the Antarctic Continent. A few promising candidates have distinguished themselves.
events.flavor: Few people are capable of rightly appreciating this heroic deed, this brilliant proof of human courage and energy. These men will sail right into the heart of the pack ice, which all previous explorers have regarded as certain death. These men are heroes—heroes in the highest sense of the word.

options.name: … is an experienced polar explorer.
… will lead us to glory.
… has never let us down before.
… is the most prepared one.

events.title: A Polar Explorer

events.desc: A shocking exposé published in the … … has revealed astonishing depths of corruption within our nation's religious institutions. Public opinion has swung decisively against … clergy.
events.flavor: "Is it the soul of a man or the wallet of a man that our priestly class truly cares about? Is their gold destined for a higher calling or a baser purpose? How can men work in such offices and not become ensnared in a web of immorality they themselves preach against?"

options.name: Even faith is corruptible!
Ghastly! Perhaps it's time for a change of heart.

events.title: Religious Corruption Exposed

events.desc: The state's efforts to curb the power of the clergy has provoked a backlash among the …, who are demanding the end to these anti-clericalist policies.
events.flavor: "The nation needs a faith to tie it together. To abandon our ways would lead to us embracing a system full of errors and sophisms! Why, it'd... it'd subvert the social order by destroying the very foundations of all we hold dear!"

options.name: Anti-Clericalism is necessary.
We should reconsider our planned policies.

events.title: Anti-Anti-Clericalism

events.desc: A fiery … preacher has shown up in the capital, provoking fights with guards and yelling the most incendiary rhetoric. He is clearly attempting to be arrested and make himself a 'martyr' for the faith.
events.flavor: "This government is antithetical to the natural faith of all men! Its concept of society itself is utterly foreign to spiritual truths. It believes there is an insoluble opposition between our faith and the … worldview—and believes that it somehow can decide the fate of our souls. Ridiculous! This government is an obscene farce blaspheming against everything good."

options.name: Charming. Arrest that man.
Indeed? Leave him be.

events.title: The Martyr

events.desc: Reliable sources inform about an internal plot to end the life of …. If we don't act in time, the stability of the nation will not be guaranteed.
events.flavor:
Maybe it's their tone, perhaps the inevitable anxiety that comes with power. A dark, sweet kindness so disingenuous that makes even traitors dread a last supper.

"People talk, and some of them wish for … to talk no more."

Thirty pieces of silver, a symbolic price. Today, maybe tomorrow—if we're lucky.

options.name: We shall find and hang them!
Perhaps this would not be such a terrible thing.

events.title: The Invisible Men

events.desc: A clandestine meeting organized by members of the … has been discovered. While they swear that the purpose was purely financial, many are those who suspect their connection to the assassination plotters.
events.flavor:
The voices reach the street remarkably clear, considering their intentions. The sound of glass can only be heard from the interior, however. Their faces lose clarity when reflected on the wine.

"They've been there all day," a florist says, her callous hands pointing with disdain, "saw them coming when I was opening the shop, they didn't even come out for lunch."

options.name: It just looks like a party.
Rather suspicious, indeed.
Worse things have been said about ….

events.title: The Invisible Men: An Empty Seat

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has come to us with an alarming warning. … is accusing the … of being the ones planning the assassination of ….
events.flavor: "You know how I'm an honest …, I would never try to go against an equal, a gentleman, a true lady. But these are not noble people. They feast upon words of envy and treachery, they can't even keep their tongues inside their mouths for they are deeply rotten."

options.name: This isn't really a surprise.
Can we really trust a rival?
Curious... because we've also been hearing rumors about ….

events.title: The Invisible Men: An Inside Tip

events.desc: The most illustrious members of society spend now their days accusing each other of being part of the assassination plot, and this time all the eyes are on the ….
events.flavor:
"Dear diary, today was such a lovely day. I accompanied mother for dinner and we visited some of her country friends, who have come to town for the season.

Alas, they were all talking about that nonsensical assassination, saying that this and that gentleman were seen with this and that other one. Thank … that little Pincher grew quite fond of me and we spent most of the evening playing in the salon! Such a lovely young man!"

options.name: Sounds suspicious enough.
Who is actually saying this?
If the information got so easily spread, we have worse problems.

events.title: The Invisible Men: Accusations

events.desc: … … has been assassinated by an individual associated with the …. Authorities were aware of a plot but unable to stop it.

options.name: A tragedy!

events.title: Assassination!

events.desc: The assassination plot has come to an unexpected end. With … not being the head of the nation anymore, their efforts have been completely stopped.
events.flavor: "Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose. Sometimes you need to lose in order to win."

options.name: Well, at least there was no assassination.

events.title: Assassination—or Not

events.desc: The treacherous intentions of the … have finally been unveiled. Members of the authorities have found enough evidence to prevent the assassination plot.
events.flavor:
… gets … breakfast at 8:00 from Monday to Friday, and at 8:30 on the weekends. After lunch, … likes to take a walk in the gardens, rarely is … escorted.

A list of names follows after, listing all the men that … invites over to play cards with. … cook, the maidens, a couple of government employees.

options.name: A day to be proud of!

events.title: Assassination Stopped

events.desc: The assassination plot has come to an unexpected end. With … having died of unrelated causes, their efforts have come to a stop.
events.flavor: And so, evermore, after death there comes a resurrection. Out of the passion of this present hour, there comes joy. And let us trust the nation shall never more know death!

options.name: May … rest in peace.

events.title: Assassination—or Not

events.desc: … in … have issued complaints that the … do not protect them enough. The name of their most dreadful nemesis: Dromaius novaehollandiae.
events.flavor:
"Remind me again why we're loading in this much shot for a glorified duck hunt."

"Ducks? You think we're hunting waterfowl? Wash your ears out, you drongo. God help you if you get snagged on the wrong end of those talons. And if you do, I ain't stuffing your guts back in."

"Alright, alright, jeez, mate. Just seems excessive is all I meant."

options.name: Alright, send someone out there.
Shall we draft them a formal declaration of war, too?

events.title: The Emu War

events.flavor:
"From this point of view, then, it is not a question of the "downfall", but of the reorganisation, of a rebirth of …. If only all those who sincerely care for this empire could, even in their dark longing, become fully aware of the right way forward. Firstly, it is not true that only independent national states have a right to exist. Switzerland, the much and rightly cited example, is the type of a mixed-national polity, and no one would reasonably want to deny it the right to exist. In fact, in our empire, the historical process is merely struggling for a modern form of national-state relations that corresponds to its newly awakened needs."

— Aurel Popovici, The United States of Greater Austria

options.name: This is the reform … needs.
We cannot hope to manage this now.

events.title: The … Proposal

events.desc: The declaration of the … has established the a-national union as a solid alternative to the prevailing nation-state model. Where others may draw legitimacy from shared blood, we will draw our strength from the dynasty and the diversity of our peoples.
events.flavor:
"Joy, thou shining spark of God,
Daughter of Elysium,
With fiery rapture, goddess,
We approach thy shrine!
Your magic reunites those
Whom stern custom has parted;
All men will become brothers
Under your protective wing."

— Friedrich Schiller, "Ode to Joy"

options.name: The Empire unites all its peoples.
Three cheers to the people's Emperor!

events.title: The Other Course

events.desc: For hundreds of years, the lands of the former Bohemian Crown have been inhabited by both … and … populations. If a … state within the Federation is to be established, the question of the Bohemian and Moravian Germans must be resolved.
events.flavor:
"Why does the map look like that? It's an odd shape, isn't it?"

"The Bohemians invited them in, some hundred years ago. Back then, it didn't matter if one was German or Czech, all were equal under God and King. If you ask me, they should both be blaming the Protestants."

options.name: The Bohemian and Moravian Germans must have their states.
Bohemia will be unified, with the Germans as equal citizens.
If the Germans may have autonomy, the Czechs may have Slovakia.
Czechoslovakia will be united, without any reservations.

events.title: The Bohemian Question

events.desc: The lands inhabited by the … people have long been entangled with Hungary. To entertain the thought of splitting … from Hungary is certain to anger … nationalists, yet may secure the credibility of our project with the other West Slavic peoples.
events.flavor:
"It was the Hungarian capital. You should really tread carefully on this matter."

"And did the Slovaks ask for it to be the Hungarian capital? Why should they be deprived on Hungary's account? We should consider the opinions of those who live in the region, and them alone. I'm growing quite sick of realpolitik."

options.name: Organize a … state.
Condition a … state on autonomy for the Zipser Germans.
Slovakia will be retained as a part of Hungary.
Endorse a shared state for Czechs and Slovaks.

events.title: The Fate of Slovakia

events.desc: The region of Galicia represents …'s spoils from the Polish Partitions. Whilst the territory has traditionally been dominated by … aristocrats, much of its East possessses a … majority. To secure … support, we must arrange a favorable partition.
events.flavor:
"What do you think? Where do we draw the line?"

"The Ruthenes have lower expectations than the Poles. A neat separation of the East from West will please them, yet anger the Poles, who naturally expect more. Hand Lemberg to the Poles, and the Ruthenes may still be willing to indulge us in return for some other concession. I do not envy your task, but it may well prove feasible."

options.name: Limit the … state to West Galicia.
Partition Galicia, with Lwów under … authority.
Retain the whole of Galicia as a … state.

events.title: The Future of Galicia

events.flavor:
"I often worry that this plan is unworkable. Won't the Hungarians revolt?"

"A Chinese general is delayed by the rain, and asks his attaché what the penalty for being late is. "Death", he replies. And then he asked the penalty for revolt - the same, of course. And that is how the Dynasty fell. The situation we have with the Hungarians is quite the same. If they'll revolt at the smallest concession, why shouldn't we push the largest?"

options.name: Preserve historical Hungary within the Federation.
The … must only give up Slovakia.
Partition Croatia and Transylvania from Hungary.
Reduce Hungary to the Hungarian-majority lands.

events.title: The Partition of Hungary

events.flavor: "Now, if you look at the coast, you'll see that the South is largely Croatian, and the North is Italian. The Slovene part is somewhere in the middle. It's a bit of a knot, but I imagine we can untangle it before lunch. Sistiana is a good enough port, isn't it?"

options.name: The Slovene state will extend to the sea.
Favor Croatian and Italian claims to ….
Create a Slovene state in ….
There are already enough Slavic states in our Empire.
Grant a Slovene-Croat union, without German and Italian lands.
Endorse a state for all South Slavs within the Federation.

events.title: The Slovene Lands

events.flavor: The question of the South Slavs was difficult enough to provoke an ulcer. Hungary had been a thorn in …'s side for long enough for the surveyor to be hesitant about suggesting another powerful administration. But the prospect of an Illyria both powerful and unfalteringly loyal... perhaps. Perhaps, if everything went exactly right.

options.name: Limit the Croatian state to … Croatia.
Preserve the existing Triune Kingdom within the Federation.
Unify the Croat lands under a Triune Kingdom.
Organize a union between the Slovene and Croat lands.
Endorse a state for all South Slavs within the Federation.

events.title: The Triune Kingdom

events.desc: The crownlands inhabited by the … are some of the most diverse in our Empire. The establishment of any … territory at all is certain to alarm … nationalists, and pockets of … people throughout the region worry over autonomy.
events.flavor:
"We'll need at least three autonomies, here. Possibly more. Where did all of these Germans come from?"

"We settled them here—quite recently, after the last war with the Turks. They're coming back to haunt us one last time, it seems."

options.name: Grant the Romanian state Banat and all Transylvania.
Grant the Romanian state everything except for Szekeler Land.
Transylvania is Romanian, but Banat is German.
Reduce the Romanian state to the South of Transylvania.
All of Transylvania is irrevocably Hungarian.

events.title: Beyond the Forest

events.flavor:
"I've received a letter from the Navy. It asks me to be generous to the Italians, in the name of recruitment numbers."

"I'm not surprised. They're quite an Italian institution."

"I've also received a letter from Palermo. That one asks me to... well, I won't repeat it here."

"I hate to say it, but that's even more Italian."

options.name: Trento and Trieste shall both be Italian.
Trento shall be Italian, but Trieste is Slavic.
Trieste is sufficient on its own.
Lombardy-Venetia is representation enough.
Such tiny populations do not warrant their own states.

events.title: The Western Fringe

events.desc: The … population of … has, since the days of the Commonwealth, been ruled by … elites. The largely-… population of the city of … has requested autonomy under a … state. To accept would appease the …, yet deny the … state a vital economic engine.
events.flavor: "Galicia? There's a peculiar dynamic, there. The aristocrats loathe the …, but the peasants adore …. The last time the aristocrats—Poles, mostly—tried to revolt, the peasants stormed their manors and strung them up. We were obliged to send in the Army to protect the would-be rebels. If one were to ask me, I would say that earned the Ruthenes their state, right then and there."

options.name: Grant the Ukrainian state all of East Galicia.
Create a Ukrainian state in East Galicia, with Lwów under Polish authority.
Offer the Ukrainians Bukovina in return for a Polish Lwów.
All of Galicia is Polish territory.

events.title: The Borderland

events.desc: The state of … has long served as a centre of the … culture. The … population of the region has requested the formation of a … state with its capital in …. The proposal has been met with opposition by the local … and … communities.
events.flavor:
"When you release the proposal, remember that only Hungarians call it Újvidék. Everyone else calls it Novi Sad. Neusatz, for us."

The surveyor crossed out the name. "A rather messy region, isn't it?"

"More than you could ever know. They once called that city the Serbian Athens—if we decide in their favor, it can be again."

options.name: Partition … off from Hungary as a Serbian state.
… must remain within Hungary.
Endorse a state for all South Slavs within the Federation.

events.title: The Serbs of …

events.desc: The government of … has officially endorsed a proposal to reorganize the Empire into a federal state. If successfully enacted, this would mean the end of …'s current autonomy, and a possible loss of our historic territories.
events.flavor:
"From this point of view, then, it is not a question of the "downfall", but of the reorganisation, of a rebirth of …. If only all those who sincerely care for this empire could, even in their dark longing, become fully aware of the right way forward. Firstly, it is not true that only independent national states have a right to exist. Switzerland, the much and rightly cited example, is the type of a mixed-national polity, and no one would reasonably want to deny it the right to exist. In fact, in our empire, the historical process is merely struggling for a modern form of national-state relations that corresponds to its newly awakened needs."

— Aurel Popovici, The United States of Greater Austria

options.name: There is a place for … in the Federation.
If we must defend our sovereignty, so be it.

events.title: A Federal Empire

events.desc: Our independence from … has forever put an end to the risk of meddling from …. Whether the … government continues its project or not, we shall not be a part of it.
events.flavor:
… had begun to change. It was far deeper than the new flags and confetti in the gutters—… could see it in the café menus, the posted pamphlets, the conversations … heard on the streets. On his daily walk, he had come across a team of workers painting a Ministry building, burying the old schönbrunn yellow under a new coat of rust-red.

"This was a Habsburg city", it had seemed to say, and so they had taken care of that. He wondered if they would come for the blue doors, too.

options.name: Long live the independent …!

modifiers.label: Radicals and Loyalists from Standard of Living changes

options.name: We may offer forgiveness from afar.

events.title: Off the Sinking Ship

events.desc: The government of … has pledged their full cooperation with our plan to federalize the Empire. Much of our … population stands behind their decision.
events.flavor:
"The Minister was smiling, earlier. Did you hear?"

…'s voice was barely louder than the clicks of his neighbor's spoon on porcelain. One of his colleagues looked over, raising an eyebrow at the comment.

"I almost don't believe it," he said. "Where'd you hear that?"

"I saw it myself. He was in the lobby, with some Colonel or another."

"The …, I'd wager," said the man at the end of the table. "A coach came from …, last night, and they wouldn't say who was aboard. Something exciting's afoot."

options.name: The spirit of friendship blooms on the Danube.
Their input is not necessary.

events.title: … Government Pledges Cooperation

events.desc: The government of … has pledged opposition to our plan to federalize the Empire. Much of our … population is likely to stand behind them.
events.flavor:
The letter was full of the usual talk. National sovereignty, the overreach of the …, the ancient rights and privileges of the … lands. It was not the first such letter to be sent, and it would likely not be the last, yet it was the most inconvenient by far. A torpedo in the side of the Government's grand plan. The official placed it in the tray to be sent to the Minister.

His gaze settled on his colleague, sipping coffee on the other side of the room. "Do we have another plan?"

"I couldn't say."

"Because you don't know, or because it's a military secret?"

"I couldn't say."

options.name: We will need to make do without them.

events.title: … Government Rejects Integration

events.desc: The … in … has issued a manifesto in support of establishing a … kingdom. To establish this kingdom would require compromising the integrity of the … crownlands, and diminish our relative status in the Empire.
events.flavor:
The messenger hammered on the door of the Speaker of the Diet, only stopping once a secretary emerged. He clasped a sheaf of papers in one hand, and rested the other against the doorframe to keep his balance. Between gasps, he managed to issue his first sentences.

"I've just got the news. The …-"

"The …, you mean?"

"Oh, yes. The … wants to dismember us."

options.name: Veto this insult to ….
Let our mistakes be avenged. Sign the manifesto.

events.title: … … Issues Trialist Manifesto

events.desc: The government of … has vetoed the …'s manifesto promising a co-equal monarchy for the … people. …'s refusal has sparked discontent amongst the South Slavic population of both halves of the Empire.
events.flavor:
A great sigh passed through …. They had no reason to be optimistic - yet, somehow, it had seemed so close. For a moment, they had allowed themselves to hope, only to be firmly corrected.

There was a solution, of course, one that none of them dared to voice in the moment. It was only in the evening, when their thoughts would turn from disillusionment to vengeance, that such a thing could be expressed. … had veto power, but … had heavy artillery. Would they dare to hope again?

options.name: We have done all that we reasonably can.
Mobilize the Army to enforce its terms.

events.title: … Vetoes Trialist Manifesto

events.flavor:
"When the papers caught word of the manifesto," the official began, "there were two parades in …. The first one to celebrate the end of the Dual Monarchy, and the second to usher in the Triple. I suppose that's as clear a message as any."

"You said that you were present for the first. Were you ever worried that it would spiral out of control?"

"I thought about it, I must admit. Such things are depressingly common. But they could point fingers at the Hungarians. Rather than being their oppressor, we made ourselves their heroes."

options.name: Keep … limited to historical … lands.
Give it stewardship of a portion of the … lands.
… shall be a kingdom for all South Slavs.

events.title: The Triune Kingdom

events.flavor:
"You must understand", said the Prussian delegate, "that the people fear. They fear that the some forty millions of former Austria will dilute the character of our nation, and they fear that their inclusion will render Germany nothing more than a Greater Austria."

The Austrian shook his head. "They are good Catholic subjects, docile unless stirred by foreign agitation. I assure you that these fears are entirely unfounded."

"That is the trouble, no? This is not the Catholic Empire."

options.name: Grant the non-German regions independence.
Release the non-German regions as dependencies.
Stay the course of the Seventy Million Plan.

events.title: The Seventy Million Reich

events.desc: The state policy of Religion, Autocracy, and Nationality has become the ubiquitous ideology of the … people. There are few who dare to question the absolute authority of the ….
events.flavor: "In a state where love for …s and devotion to the throne are based on the native characteristics of the people, where there are laws of the fatherland and firmness in administration, all efforts of the evil-intentioned will be in vain and insane."

options.name: All hail the …!
The … people are supreme.
The … shows us the way.

events.title: Official Nationality

events.desc: Clandestine groups of academics in … are plotting against the state to advance the misguided cause of the ….
events.flavor: "We have found your blasphemous and treasonous books. Your pamphlets. The shops you used to run as a front. Your houses. The meeting places you thought you had kept secret. We have set them all to flame. All that is left now is your confession."

options.name: Leave them be, they pose no threat.
Dissent must be punished.

events.title: Secret Societies

events.desc: The … in … are assuring … that despite the harsh conditions of their lives, they are serving the greater good of the … nation. Serfs shall be rewarded in the hereafter for their service.
events.flavor:
"Blessed are the meek,
for they will inherit the earth,
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
for they will be filled,
Blessed are the merciful
for they will be shown mercy." 

–Sermon on the Mount, Matthew 5: 5-7

options.name: Imbue them with loyalty to the state.
Absolve yourselves of impure thoughts.

events.title: Blessed Are the Meek

events.desc: The stability of the … parliamentary order has led to the royalists abandoning their hopes of a restored absolutism. A constitutional monarchy has been established as the new status quo.
events.flavor: "The Parliament is that supreme and absolute power, which gives life and motion to the government. It directs and actuates all its various procedures, as the parent of our peace, defender of our faith, and foundation of our properties; and as the Constitution of this great spring, and primum mobile of affairs, is in strength and beauty, so will also all acts and performances which are derived from it, bear a suitable proportion and similitude."

options.name: A toast to …!
… save the …!

events.title: Responsible Government

events.desc: … has gained renowned not merely for utilizing aircraft in battle, but for even flying one …self over the skies of ….
events.flavor: "The papers are calling … the '… …'! …'s astounding—I can't tell if it'd be better to parade … around at home or keep siccing … on everyone in …."

options.name: Hero-worship will help domestically.
War heroes need to stay in the war.

events.title: The Ace Officer

events.desc: We have been offered the opportunity to become a member of the … alliance against the …. A unified army with a singular purpose may be the only means to banish them from the region once and for all.
events.flavor:
"Gentlemen! The opportunity is nigh to grasp. This might be our only chance to retribute the grand debt of our forefathers. Let this brotherhood stand as one for countless centuries when the day of our collective triumph is here."

The committee stood up and clapped. It was as if the victory had already been achieved, despite the weasels in the room.

options.name: … will answer the call.
This is not the solution.

events.title: The Balkan League

events.desc: It is done. … has finally been driven out of the …, with its former territories now belonging to their rightful owners. The Balkan League has proven to be a successful initiative.
events.flavor:
"Mother! Mother! The bell is ringing. Let us not be late!"

The little boy, dressed in newly tailored local attire, was having the most exciting day of his life. The parade that was supposed to travel to the capital was about to march through the village center.

It had been a while since the news of glory reached them, but saluting their veteran heroes was a feeling like no other.

options.name: At last, our lands belong to us!

events.title: End of an Era

events.desc: Thralldom has taken the place of our thirst for glory. Our subjugation by the … has ended our capacity to align with any strategic coalition.
events.flavor:
According to local legends, there once was a supreme leader who asked his advisor to teach him a piece of wisdom worth a lifetime.

"Tell me, old man. What would be the one thing you advise to a ruler with the potential to be on top of the world, and the exact opposite?"

options.name: "This too shall pass."

events.title: Freedom Undone

events.desc: With the fall of the Balkan League, there is no longer a force strong enough to make a stand for the cause. Any hope that may have existed for the reclamation of our territories has been lost.
events.flavor:
Life succumbed to monotony once again for the fair folk of the Balkans. They seem deceived and broken for the promises made by leaders without foresight and expertise.

Certainly, in a world full of imperialistic juggernauts, an alliance that is separated by borders in these savage lands is a daydream now, rather than a unifying ambition.

The struggle persists, bleaker than before.

options.name: One day...

events.title: Broken Alliance

events.desc: We have willingly resigned from the Balkan League. If we wish to build a solid future, showing our teeth to the … must be the least of our concerns.
events.flavor:
A sense of mutiny was in the air when the declaration was given directly by …. It revolved around the idea that perhaps, it is wiser to stay content and not make any tempered choices to prevent grander catastrophes by pursuing delusive ambitions.

The audience seemed to be more and more persuaded as the speech neared its crescendo.

options.name: We shall have no part in this.
If we can't beat them, we must join them.

events.title: Disposable Loyalty

events.desc: We have failed to achieve our goal of kicking … out of the …, but we have still retained our independence.
events.flavor:
Mothers and wives have shed tears and lamented for piles upon piles of young dead men. They left their villages to pursue greed and blood in the name of expansionism for politicians. All that is left now are monuments and mass graves. Inanimate objects of national shame.

"Hard walnut is a strange fruit, you broke it not, it broke your teeth!"

—Petar II Petrović Njegoš, Gorski vijenac

options.name: Still, the future is brighter than the past.

events.title: Failed Ambitions

events.desc: We have decided to draw a little more from the coffers. This will allow us to realize an increase in conscription for our struggle against the ….
events.flavor:
Awestruck by standing next to a pair of professional guardsmen, the youngster took a deep breath before entering the hall.

It has been hours of waiting in line since the early hours of the day, just to receive a uniform. One that will probably not fit anyway, calling for the tradition of a recruit's first trade.

This is usually when you meet your first comrade before turning into a detail among hordes of men.

options.name: Let us not go overboard with this.
Arm whoever is available.

events.title: Local Draftees

events.desc: Our general, …, has been sent abroad to exchange knowledge and experience with peers as part of our military research funding.
events.flavor:
Well protected, on an express with a band of commanding officers, the man in charge was taking in the beautiful scenery. The soothing change of pace from all the usual formalities made him discover what life is all about once more.

Despite the shaking table, he proceeded to ink his pen. There was still a pile of reports to finish.

options.name: Without patience, there is no discipline.
He should learn more about the art of assault.
Every battle is won before it is fought.

events.title: A Student of Strategy

events.desc: …, aided by locals, has been driving … people out of their homes in …. This may easily turn into bloodshed if unchecked.
events.flavor:
Neighbors of old are actively seeking opportunities to target unguarded Turks at every turn. In the absence of the …'s forces, vulnerable communities are enduring daily harassment and hostility.  

Escalating tensions have led to the alarming disappearance of several family members in certain villages, with authorities showing blatant indifference. Predictably, some officials are even complicit in these raids.

options.name: Create a corridor.
Leave soldiers and locals to themselves.
Encourage the soldiers.
They lived here for centuries, this is not right.

events.title: Caught in the Middle

events.desc: There has been a surplus from this year's fund expenses in …, and the administrators are asking where to funnel it.
events.flavor:
Amidst the chaos, it would've been rather easy to make a 'mistake' on the accounting reports. Despite the temptations, that did not seem to be the case. This is a clear sign of nationalistic ambition towards a common goal and a show of true character.

The people who are involved with the movement of capital take the biggest risk against themselves. Nations arise on the shoulders of such individuals who do not stray from the straight path of truthfulness.

options.name: Turn an unused building into a barracks.
It should go to those who make the calls.
Men on duty need it the most.

events.title: Surplus Management

events.desc: An alliance of our former subjects in the …, the Balkan League has officially declared to rise against us. If they win the upcoming war, we will lose all our lands in the region and new nations will be formed.
events.flavor:
The old imam turned around to face believers on the steps of the minbar, and started delivering the khutbah.

"O believers!

Know that this day, as in the days of our forefathers, the Ottoman Sultan, the shadow of God on Earth, commands us to rise in defense of our faith, our lands, and our honor. This war is not merely a conflict of men, it is a test from the Almighty, a struggle in the path of truth against tyranny and oppression!"

options.name: They will come to rue the day.

events.title: Chaos in the Balkans

events.desc: On behalf of all Balkan League members, … has officially announced a preparation of war to reclaim all … lands in the ….
events.flavor:
Guarded by a handful of mercenaries, the bellman's proclamation was received with mixed feelings among the villagers of all walks of life.

"Hear ye, children of …!

By the explicit order of the honorable … …, our army is preparing for a sacred campaign against a common enemy. Let it be known to all; in the following months, brave new men of these lands shall be recruited, maybe to fight one last time to cleanse what used to be our villages, towns, cities, meadows, mountains and claim what is ours by right..."

options.name: It is time.

events.title: The War Begins

events.desc: We have lost all lands in the … after a successful campaign led by …. Having fulfilled its purpose, the Balkan League is no more, and new nations have sprouted from its ashes.
events.flavor:
"We had struck a slap across the face of truth,
We had stood defiant against the rule of conscience.
We had built a bridge over the flames of Hell,
The craven’s bridge—swept away by the flood.

Hey, Rıza! This spilled blood was ours...
The beloved, now a servant to foes, was ours...
The land of Rum!... That cherished homeland was ours—
But we deemed it unworthy, and another claimed it."

—Rıza Tevfik, "For Rumeli"

options.name: We must recuperate.

events.title: The Cataclysm

events.desc: Our spies have learned that several nations, all old … subjects, have formed an alliance. If one were to support our independence, we could join their upcoming war.
events.flavor:
"But uncle, they're a different people, wanting their own lands. Can we trust them?" 

 "I don't care where they're from. I don't care what they believe in. I don't care what valleys they claim. As long as they hate these … tyrants half as much as we do – as long as their war might lead to our freedom – I'll gladly bleed beside them."

options.name: They deserve our support
Our place is with the Ottoman Empire

events.title: Rumors of a Balkan League

events.desc: Having successfully steered the country through its tumultuous early years, … … has now established himself as a capable statesman at the helm of a stable government.
events.flavor: Sipping his coffee, … … looked over his morning correpondence. Reports of roadside brigands, corruption scandals, and factional disputes, as per usual. But among the usual dreary reports were also hints of change. The effects of the recent changes in policing policy, the establishment of intellectual institutions, and the stirrings of a modern bureaucratic apparatus. Much remained to be done, but year by year the … found his morning work just a touch more enjoyable.

options.name: A new Pericles!

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: A new Alexander!

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

events.title: Civilizer-King of the Hellenes

events.desc: Fed up with the Bavarian clique, a popular insurrection has broken out in … and deposed … …, last seen boarding a foreign schooner bound northwards. With the old … gone, the people has been asked by the provisional government to vote on his successor.
events.flavor:
"No printed ballot papers? Is this some sort of joke?"

"No, sir. You will merely write the name of the man you would like on the throne and submit it to me within the hour."

options.name: A Prince of Denmark
A Republic
A British Prince
A French Prince
An Imperial Prince of Russia
Garibaldi

events.title: The Downfall of King Otto

events.desc: With the construction of the Eiffel Tower, the Parisian public is divided. While some argue that the building shall become their most notorious landmark, others refer to it as "the giant radio tower".
events.flavor: "We, writers, painters, sculptors, architects and passionate devotees of the hitherto untouched beauty of Paris, protest with all our strength, with all our indignation in the name of slighted French taste, against the erection of this useless and monstrous Eiffel Tower."

options.name: They're wrong! This building is Paris itself!
Now that they say it...
It'll be demolished in less than ten years anyways.

events.title: The Eiffel Tower

events.desc: The spread of a new artistic style inspired by nature, imitating the sinuous curves of plants through robust iron and glass to convey the contradictions of progress, has reached …'s higher spheres.
events.flavor: "Well, you know, I just painted on. I went on—without design or sketch, it grew as I painted. And toward the end I reached such a point of perfection—putting in every touch with such freedom—that when I came round to the corner where I started, why, I had to paint part of it over again, as the difference would have been too marked. And the harmony in blue and gold developing, you know, I forgot everything in my joy in it."

options.name: This new style is truly mesmerizing.
And they say they paint without a design. Well, it shows.

events.title: Art Nouveau

events.desc: After the successful publications of the Symbolist movement, … has decided to follow his path and embark in a literary journey of … own, a source of concern for the ….
events.flavor:
"And yet
to wine, to opium even, I prefer
the elixir of your lips on which love flaunts itself;
and in the wasteland of desire
your eyes afford the wells to slake my thirst."

options.name: They deserve to have a private life.
This is unheard of! A poet politician!
… will have to step down.

events.title: Forest of Symbols

events.desc: The opening of a luxurious cabaret at the foot of the Montmartre hill has made the nightlife of Paris considerably lively. Attracting, of course, the attention and suspicions of the conservatives.
events.flavor:
The woman sighs throughout the report in a smoke induced room. Incense and cigarettes are indistinguishable—so is vapor, even though it's impossible to know where it's coming from. The music is muffled here, thick as syrup.

"Thank you for the company on these cold nights," she purrs, tossing the document into the fire, "we were in much need of some extra fuel."

options.name: That place has it all!
This immoral joint shall be shut down at once.

events.title: Belle Epoque Events 4

options.name: Humanity earns another triumph over pestilence.

events.flavor: The audience, investors and entrepreneurs all, watched in fascination as the images unfolded on the screen. The executives exited first, followed by the women employed at the factory, and the common laborers following after. Forty-five seconds felt like far longer as the tableau expanded across the cloth screen, dust particles in the rays of light from the projector hovering in the air in equal anticipation to the audience.

options.name: The twentieth century will be shown on film!
Cinema has no commercial future.

events.title: Belle Epoque Events 6

events.desc: The inventor Raoul Grimoin-Sanson has developed a device entitled the "photoachygraphe", a device which projects moving pictures on multiple surfaces at once. With this device, he has succeeded in creating a simulated hot air balloon fair ride using footage of Paris from above, entitled Cinéorama.
events.flavor:
The poster fluttered as a breeze ran over it, further disturbing the partially loosened tack holding it in place. Before it rose the great dome that had been constructed for the event, a vast crowd surrounding it.

"La Grande Attraction Nouvellae: Ballon Cinéorama! Projections panoramiques animées de GRIMOIN-SANSON!"

options.name: The photoachygraphe shows limitless potential!
Limitless potential, perhaps, but also limitless risk of a fire.

events.title: The Cinéorama

options.name: These machines will drive the growth of our cities.
Taxing mechanical vehicles will provide needed revenue.

events.desc: The development of vehicles propelled by the internal combustion engine has inspired various … automobile producers to hold an exhibition in the form of the Paris-Rouen Horseless Carriages Contest.
events.flavor:
The vehicles lined up in groups of five, each one different in form, propelled by petrol and steam.

At the wave of a flag, their engines released a cacophony of rattling and hissing as they set forth down the street, traveling at a pace that far exceeded that of the onlookers on foot. Before long, the course curved out of the sight of the starting line, and cheers replaced the sound of engines.

options.name: And they're off!
What a ghastly display!

events.title: Paris-Rouen

options.name: A place to take ladies; but never one's wife.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Upper Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: A new world; material without being real.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Upper Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: A spot of well-needed whimsy.

modifiers.label: Urban Center Employee Standard of Living

options.name: An easy way to forget one's demons.
Another step towards a city of tomorrow.
A new symbol of our nation's progress.

events.desc: An exhibition displaying the wealth of our colonies across the world has been held in …, drawing in visitors with displays of exotic animals, natural resources, and ethnological expositions of … peoples in a simulated native village.

options.name: Astounding, and educational!
Perhaps these human displays are excessive.

events.title: Colonial Exhibition in …

events.flavor:
"Why would you possibly request so much money for a mere garment? What happiness could it bring you?"

"As much as your gold watches and sabers, and perhaps far more so."

options.name: Regardless of borders, both of our nations celebrate beauty as equals.
The … must not outdo us!

events.title: Belle Epoque Events 14

events.flavor:
The process that had become common in recent days brought no lack of amusement to the conductors of the … station. Women with anxious eyes and full pocketbooks would arrive from trains hailing from … stations, and depart several weeks later in magnificent gowns and purses several pounds lighter.

On the platforms, both groups mingled, apathetic husbands averting their eyes whilst their wives complimented one another's good sense, and pledged to meet again.

options.name: … shall be the fashion capital of the world.
It is the designers and workers who make such things possible.

events.title: Belle Epoque Events 15

options.name: To the new century!
...and away with the old!

events.desc: With the coming end of the century, a literary and artistic movement expressing pessimism and fear of societal degeneration has swept through ….
events.flavor:
"I hope tomorrow will be a fine day, Lane."

"It never is, sir."

"Lane, you're a perfect pessimist."

"I do my best to give satisfaction, sir."

— Oscar Wilde, The Importance of Being Earnest

options.name: The world is getting better - have they not seen our GDP figures?
There is a seed of pessimism inside all our hearts.

events.title: Belle Epoque Events 17

events.desc: Artists and authors affiliated with the … have begun taking artistic inspiration from Joris-Karl Huysmans's "Decadent" novel "À Rebours", detailing the experiences of a man who retreats into hyper-aesthetic sensory experiences and idealistic artistry to escape the world.
events.flavor: "There is not one of her inventions, no matter how subtle or imposing it may be, which human genius cannot create... There can be no doubt about it: this eternal, driveling, old woman is no longer admired by true artists, and the moment has come to replace her by artifice."

options.name: The very guidebook of decadence.
A poisonous, corrosive text.

events.title: Decadence in …

events.desc: Following in the footsteps the Decadent movement, the poet Jean Moréas has published an artistic manifesto detailing an artistic tendency which focuses on attempting to express exotic ideals through extravagant analogy and oblique references.
events.flavor: "Rhythm: the ancient metric enlivened; a chaos learnedly ordered; the rhyme illucescente and beaten as a buckler of gold and bronze, to rhymes of unintelligible fluidity; the alexandrine with numerous and mobile stopping; the job of first certain numbers – seven, nine, eleven, thirteen – bold in the various rhythmic combinations of which they are the price."

options.name: Let us dare to live!
Any renovation is madness!

events.title: The Symbolist Manifesto

options.name: The bold rooster, the enduring symbol of ….
The majestic lion, symbol of strength the world over.
The bold rooster, enduring symbol of the … nation.
The noble tiger, from the hills of … India.
The resilient brown bear, from the … taigas.
The mighty bison, from the great plains of ….
The fierce manul, from the mountains of ….
The elegant serow, from the forests of ….
The soaring golden eagle, from the heights of the … Pyrenees.

events.desc: Rudderless and without the support of its colonial overlord, the … is on the verge of collapse. It seems that … rule is at an end.
events.flavor: "Abandoning our post? What post, what army? In a few hours this place will be swarming with Hindus, or on fire, or both. Now stop complaining and pick up that sack. Take anything of value that isn't nailed down, and I'll secure passage to London."

options.name: India will be divided between the Princes.
This is the birth of an Indian nation.
British rule must be maintained at all costs.

events.title: The End of British Rule?

events.desc: Furious with the growing foreign presence in …, … subjects are organizing into anti-foreign militias, bent on driving the "barbarians" back into the sea. Many now urge … … to back the movement, lest their zeal is turned against … rule.
events.flavor: "When the foreign barbarians preach their religion, they say that they are urging men to do good, but in fact, they are disrupting our government, creating turmoil in our system, destroying our customs, and deceiving our people—that is to say, they want to turn the people of China into barbarians."

options.name: Revive the Qing! Destroy the foreigner!
These fanatics would spell our doom.

events.title: The Yihetuan Movement

events.desc: Once more, the Yellow Dragon Flag soars from the rooftops of all the Middle Kingdom’s cities. From the shining pearls lining the Southern Delta to the great metropolises along the East Sea, the stain of imperialism has been washed away from our shores.
events.flavor:
"When at last all the Foreign Devils

Are expelled to the very last man

The …, united, together

Will bring peace to this our land."

options.name: May … … reign for ten thousand years!
May … endure for ten thousand years!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Mandate of Heaven

events.desc: Where zealous cries of "Revive the Qing" once rang, anti-… slogans have now replaced them. Our failure to see the Boxers’ vision through have irreparably severed our bonds with our … subjects.
events.flavor: "I do not begrudge repeating over and over again that internally we are slaves of the Manchus and suffering from their tyranny, externally we are being harassed by foreign powers, and we are doubly enslaved."

options.name: Will these humiliations ever end?
The … garrison revolts and storms the Forbidden City.

events.title: The Qing and the Han

events.desc: With the stroke of a pen, two millennia of imperial rule has come to an end. As the last … emperor is escorted out of the Forbidden City, the world shifts its gaze to the East. What does this new age hold for …?
events.flavor: "To restore our national independence, we must first restore the Chinese nation. To restore the Chinese nation, we must drive the barbarian Manchus back to the Changbai Mountains. To get rid of the barbarians, we must first overthrow the present tyrannical, dictatorial, ugly, and corrupt Qing government."

options.name: The … yoke has ended at last.
Now is the time for reconciliation.

events.title: The Fall of the Qing Dynasty

events.desc: On behalf of our …, … … reminds the government of the importance of maintaining … sea power. We must strive to be the foremost naval power in South America, and among the greatest in the world.
events.flavor: "My …, I would urge you to consider more than your domestic state. Land armies win battles, indeed, but it is your naval vessels that win you empires. Britain's very success depended upon such a stern armada. And you won't find a stern armada amongst the remnants of our father's sorry vessels. Why, it's barely even firewood! And your captains deserve better ships than rotting hulks of driftwood."

options.name: The navy protects our wealth and cares for our people.

events.title: Brazilian Naval Power

events.desc: In a scathing critique of the government, … … has made public the Admiralty's disappointment that our navy is eclipsed by such unworthy powers as …. This is a national humiliation for our ….
events.flavor: It's an outrage, man, an outrage! These pompous … fools would mock Brazil, and debase your men. Surely our … is one of respect, … …! Take it back from them!

options.name: We must do better.

events.title: Contested Waters

events.desc: … … has appeared before the government to report that the … Navy is large and modern enough to be ranked among the greatest in the world. This has become a point of pride for our ….
events.flavor:
"This ship, this steam frigate, Admiral... what you say is true?"

"Of course. What with its timely rescue alone, it's the only choice for your navy. A squadron of these, and I dare say I could thrash any fleet in open water."

"Ah. I see a future for these ships. Return to Liverpool. I would have a second."

options.name: Glad to hear it.

events.title: Full Speed Ahead

events.desc: … has cemented itself as one of the greatest naval powers in the world. … credit our success to the prudent governance of … ….
events.flavor: A parade greeted the … as … rode through the city thoroughfares. Green and gold leaflets flitted down the streets, as ten thousand sailors and officers stood at attention by the road. Admiral … ushered them through a series of stairs to a great overlook. At the balustrade, they saw it: dozens of warships and merchantmen in the bay. Dozens more at sea, called for one mission or another.

options.name: Splendid!

events.title: Sovereignty at Sea

events.desc: Victory! Not only have our valiant troops fought off the … 'caramurus' on the field of battle, but have also managed to free our … brethren in the … from the wretched yoke of ….
events.flavor:
Among the trophies and souvenir trinkets captured from the battle, he spotted a pair of rag dolls lying face-down in the mud. The captain knelt beside the puddle.
Turning them over, he recognized the facsimile: the men of House Bragança. Whoever they belonged to were long gone now. He tossed them into the nearest fire, to the cheers of his men.

options.name: Long live the "Free and Independent" Catharinense Republic!
They have earned their freedom, as we have ours.
Unfortunately, the present situation leaves no room for idealism.
Onwards, to …!

events.title: The Gaucho Yell

events.desc: Despite the capitulation of the main Cabano government in …, countless rebels continue to resist our rule upstream. Hardened by years of brutal conflict, the … army has taken an especially harsh attitude towards the rebel bands, mainly comprised of free … and … fighters.
events.flavor:
"Men! I need not tell you what a great victory this is.
But the dreams of your beautiful wives and little sweets must wait. The rebel has escaped upstream, and he will fight until old age takes his fingers. Our new orders are thus:
should they hide behind trees, we will burn them down.
Should they hide behind tall walls without toe holds, we will pile their dead and climb them.

Leave no stone unturned, no grass untrod. In the name of God and House Bragança, onwards!"

options.name: No mercy for traitors. Burn the rabble out.

events.title: The Crushing of the Cabanagem

events.desc: With the defeat of the Riograndese Republic's field army, General … has proposed the granting of amnesties and extensive concessions to bring … back into the fold, and to avoid prolonged guerrilla fighting.
events.flavor:
"General, my men have fought hard and bravely. But they are only men now. Far be it for us to treat each other like Frenchmen with British prisoners. And if you must, then allow them a dignified death."

"Were it left to me, coronel. I can only guarantee that I shall speak to the ones who can spare them. If they have sense, they’ll see what I see: farmhands, traders, and artisans."

options.name: Offer concessions, full amnesty, and the paying off of war debts.
If they wanted leniency they should have surrendered back in 1835.

events.title: The Green Poncho Treaty

events.desc: … has won its independence from …, though at great cost and through bloody struggle. Those still standing rejoice in victory and toast the fallen.
events.flavor:
Among the trophies and souvenir trinkets captured from the battle, he spotted a pair of rag dolls lying face-down in the mud. The captain knelt beside the puddle.
Turning them over, he recognized the facsimile: the men of House Bragança. Whoever they belonged to were long gone now. He tossed them into the nearest fire, to the cheers of his men.

options.name: Offer concessions, full amnesty, and the paying off of war debts.

events.title: Victory in the North

events.desc: With the … ban on the slave trade now enforced by local authorities in deed as in name, the South Atlantic Slave Trade has received its final, mortal blow—much thanks to the unceasing efforts of the ….
events.flavor:
Crew, at attention. Dispatches arrived earlier this morning.
The Aberdeen Act is no longer in force. Brazil has finally capitulated on the matter of the slave trade.
As of now, we may return our attention to real matters. To mark the occasion, you're all receiving a double ration of rum tonight.

options.name: Rule, Britannia! Britannia rules the waves!
Britons never, never, never shall be slaves.

events.title: The Last Voyage of the Andorinha

events.desc: Following a short pursuit, the … warship … has captured the … slaver …. Discovered in her hold were hundreds of shackled African souls, destined for the slave markets of ….
events.flavor:
"Manifest said livestock. I don't see a single cow, goat, or chicken in any of your holds. You uh... how should I say this, chum? You seem to have livestock of the two-legged, God fearing kind."

"Livestock is exactly what we have here, sir. Many coffee farms depend on these livestock."

"Get the manacles off 'em. And give 'em some air, for God's sake. At least 'till I figure out what to do about you, 'coffee farmer.'"

options.name: Try the crew as pirates, condemn the ship, and free any slaves found.
Free the slaves, but leave the crew and ship unmolested.

events.title: … Slaver Seized off …

options.name: Perfidious Albion.
They knew the risks such a voyage would entail.

events.desc: The notorious … slaver … has been spotted by the warship … just as it was entering … territorial waters. The captain wants to continue the pursuit, but voices aboard caution against blatantly violating …'s home waters.
events.flavor:
"Captain, we might want to let this one go, eh? They'll be in their waters soon enough. It's not worth tangling with their entire fleet."

"Well, it's a very good thing you're a marine and I'm the captain. They're traveling heavy, and I've yet to see any animal dung being washed aboard. And there are far too many supplies aboard for livestock. We'll catch them before long. Prepare your men for boarding within the hour."

"Aye, captain. God willing, we won't have to scrap with more ships than that one."

options.name: Seize it. The waters of Brazil are the waters of a hostile power.
Respect their waters for now. Order the captain to stand down.

events.title: Slaver Spotted in … Waters

events.desc: In the pursuit and capture of a …-flagged slaver near …, a … warship has violated the territorial integrity of …. Plantation owners and citizens alike are in uproar, calling for immediate action to be taken by the Brazilian government.
events.flavor:
Britain Strongarms Sovereign Ship!
In a perverse display of power, the British Royal Navy ship, HMS …, has seized a trade ship off the coast of Brazil. This shocking breach of imperial sovereignty cannot be left unanswered. The terms of this distasteful law, the Aberdeen Act, dictate that any British ship may arrest and trial our own citizens under British Law. Why does our... (continued, pg.2)

options.name: First they disrespect our flag, now our waters?

rewards.name: Weakness in the Face of Albion

options.name: Rattle our sabers at these insolent Brits.

rewards.name: Weakness in the Face of Albion

events.title: … Seizes Slaver in … Waters.

events.desc: With the … slave trade banned and suppressed at last, the mandate—be it real or imagined—of the … to harass our shipping has passed, drastically improving the diplomatic relationship between our country and ….
events.flavor:
Attention all seamen. Our most magnanimous … and the Cortes have ratified a new law forbidding the importation of new slaves.
We have proven today that we are every bit the equal of Britain. As such, they no longer have authority to play the schoolyard bully upon our vessels.
To mark this big day, every man may have double rations of rum tonight.

options.name: The end of an era.

events.title: The Last Voyage of the Andorinha

events.desc: While …'s 'peculiar institution' has seemed untouchable at times, the institution can now at last be considered laid to rest for good. While its impact is surely to be felt for centuries to come, this day calls for celebration, as the Pope himself has bestowed upon … a golden rose in reverence of …'s achievement.
events.flavor:
A Golden Rose for A Golden Act
The sun rises on a new day in a now slave-free Brazil. As word has traveled to Rome and back again, the Pope himself has bestowed two golden gifts upon …: an auspicious title, and a single, golden rose to commemorate the Lei Áurea. With slavery now ended... (cont'd pg. 2)

options.name: Onwards, from a golden law, to a gilded age.
We are one nation, one people.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Golden Law, Golden Rose

events.desc: Citing abysmal working conditions and mistreatment at the hands of their master, a group of slaves working in the … … have fled their stations, offering to return only should guarantees of better working conditions be offered.
events.flavor:
"Among other conditions we demand before our return to work, our quotas will not exceed more than five buckets of coffee beans per head for the men. Both men and women in the field are to be overseen by those we elect.

Additionally, we demand two days reprieve from labor so that we may plant more crops of rice and fish in the nearby river. We also demand that you give the less wholesome tasks, like crabbing and shell fishing, to the other slaves who came from the coast."

options.name: Offer some concessions, the goods must flow.
Negotiation is a privilege reserved for the free. Denied.
No matter, they can be replaced.

events.title: Slaves Refuse to Work in …

events.desc: Serious slowdowns of work have recently been plaguing the … …, its managers placing the blame on intentional sabotage committed by discontent slaves.
events.flavor:
Some things are beyond human control: the sun's heat, the changing of the seasons, and how much a plant can yield in its life. What can be controlled—the soil's nutrition, and how much to harvest—are never scrutinized so heavily as a slave's work.
And so, when the body inevitably fails, the driver reaches for a whip as the only answer.

options.name: Lashings will be issued until morale improves.
They will fall in line. Eventually.
A free labor force would be better motivated.

events.title: Slaves Suspected of Workplace Sabotage

events.desc: More and more slaves have disappeared from the … in … as of late, suspected by overseers of fleeing inland to yet undiscovered quilombos—ex-slave settlements existing outside the reach of the law.
events.flavor:
"Senhor, we're missing slaves. Seven did not report for headcount. Nobody's seen them. Three men, two women, and a boy and a girl."

"Anyone I care to know? Meat is meat. It can be replaced."

"One of the strongest pickers. And one woman was someone your wife fancied. Should I round up some trackers?"

options.name: Assemble hunting parties, promptly.
Enact 'security measures' to ensure this does not happen again.
Thank the Lord for the slave markets of ….

events.title: Slaves Escape from … Plantations

events.desc: Outraged by the failure of … to outlaw the …, … has committed to enforcing the Aberdeen Act. British vessels will routinely patrol Brazilian shipping routes to disrupt trade.
events.flavor: 'A man is only as good as his word,' so the old saying goes. An obligation, no matter how small or seemingly insignificant, remains a promise. The breach of trust can, therefore, invite calamity. And here, now, a broken promise has roused a dragon to cripple a giant.

options.name: Slavery is an abhorrent practice.

events.title: The Aberdeen Act

events.title: The Aberdeen Act

events.desc: With the victory of the … slaver lobby, the ban on the … is formally repealed, legally enshrining the already widespread practice in the face of international protestations.
events.flavor: "Why should foreign whims dictate the Brazilian reality? Should … decide that slavery does not suit her, then so be it, but does that automatically make the same hold true for Brazil? Are we beholden to the laws of the … … or is it yet … … who rules these lands?"

options.name: Once more, our position is thoroughly identified with slavery.

events.title: A Peculiar Institution

events.desc: The … in … has issued directions for us to increase the number of … in ….
events.flavor:
For the eyes of … …,

I have the honor to inform you, for the information of the Right honorable the …, that, following a period of discussion with the …, the … has issued the following compendium of directives to make clear its present priorities in India. Please consult the enclosed directives for further information on this matter.

Signed,
…
…

options.name: We will begin at once.
This is not within our present means.

events.title: … Dictate

events.desc: Given the present state of war faced by …, the … has issued directions for us to expand the size of our standing army.
events.flavor:
For the eyes of … …,

I have the honor to inform you, for the information of the Right honorable …, that the … has issued the following compendium of directives to make clear its present priorities in India. Please consult the enclosed directives for further information on this matter.

Signed,

This is not within our present means.

events.desc: The … in … has acquired an interest in reforming our administration over India. They have issued directions for us to enact ….
events.flavor:
For the eyes of … …,

I have the honor to inform you, for the information of the Right honorable …, that the … has issued the following compendium of directives to make clear its present priorities in India. Please consult the enclosed directives for further information on this matter.

Signed,
…
…

options.name: We will begin at once.
The …'s demands outweigh the need for ….
Now is not the best time for this.
We cannot, in good conscience, support this measure.

events.desc: The … in … has issued directions for us to improve the quality of the … system in each of our Presidency cities.
events.flavor:
For the eyes of … …,

I have the honor to inform you, for the information of the Right honorable …, that the … has issued the following compendium of directives to make clear its present priorities in India. Please consult the enclosed directives for further information on this matter.

Signed,
