This is not within our present means.

events.title: … Dictate

events.desc: The rule of the … has ended, and the … government will now take a greater role in Indian affairs. History shall mark this day as the inception of the British Raj.
events.flavor: "As long as we rule India, we are the greatest power in the world. If we lose it, we shall drop straight away to a third-rate Power. Only through despotic methods can we extract from India what the Empire requires."

options.name: Good riddance to Company rule.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: The Jewel in the Crown

events.flavor: At one PM sharp, the Resident entered. At five past one, tea was served to the the … and … interpreter. At ten past one, the dictate was served. At fifteen, there was no more …, and no more …. The Resident departed, steam still rising from his untouched cup.

options.name: There is no way that we might resist.
Summon our army, we make our stand here.

events.title: Doctrine of Lapse Invoked

events.desc: Due to proscriptions in the … faith against crossing seas, soldiers have been allowed an exemption from overseas service in the past. Some administrators now argue that this exception should be removed.
events.flavor: "While it may seem convenient to demand overseas service of every soldier, this has already been the cause of conflict in the past. In '24, several regiments in Bengal staged a mutiny over a planned march to Burma, fearing they would be sent by sea. If we want to recruit from the higher castes, we must understand how seriously they take this taboo."

options.name: It is necessary to account for these local traditions.
They must serve wherever they are needed!

events.title: Kala Pani

events.desc: The presence of … Clergymen in … has caused some locals to suspect that … is planning to attempt converting people to Christianity.
events.flavor: "That the Company seeks to impose their own ideas of civilization on us is well known. Who is to say the next step is not mass conversions? They pretend to respect our faith to keep the peace, but have they not all along painted it as merely another cultural element inferior to their own? Surely they are just biding their time for the eventual project of forcing us all to adopt their beliefs."

options.name: It couldn't be further from the truth.
If they are there to promote their faith, they may do so.

events.title: Suspected Proselytism

events.desc: The rule of the … has ended, and the … government will now take a greater role in Indian affairs. History shall mark this day as the inception of the British Raj.
events.flavor: "As long as we rule India, we are the greatest power in the world. If we lose it, we shall drop straight away to a third-rate Power. Only through despotic methods can we extract from India what the Empire requires."

options.name: The Company is over, but the Empire lives on.

events.title: End of the Company

events.desc: The other nations, awed by the size and strength of our army, know us as the "Prussia of the Balkans". All that remains is to choose where our soldiers should march.
events.flavor:
"Even if they cut off my head, I will still shout, 'Long Live Bulgaria!'" 

 –Nikolay Haytov

options.name: To Tsarigrad, we march!
Only in a unified Yugoslav nation can we be truly free!
This is the beginning of a Bulgarian Renaissance!

events.title: Prussia of the Balkans

events.desc: Bulgaria has at last become an independent nation. Who should rule us through the turmoil of change into a prosperous future?
events.flavor:
"Prince Ferdinand, who was a Coburg, was a cousin of my father's, and I remember the latter saying, when we got back to the hotel, that being the youngest of his family he was naturally looked upon as a fool. 'But,' said my father, 'for the fool of the family he has not done so badly for himself and I should not be surprised if he did not prove them all wrong.'" 

—Lady Helena Gleichen

options.name: Support the Tzar's nephew.
Support Ferdinand.
No kings, we will choose a man of the people.
An untainted and unknown voice will lead the choir.
A prince must come forth from the nobility.

events.title: Free at Last

events.desc: Newspapers across the world are reporting about war crimes committed by our soldiers during our recent conflict with the … rebels.
events.flavor:
The number of children killed in these massacres is something enormous. They were often spitted on bayonets, and we have several stories from eye-witnesses who saw the little babes carried about the streets, both here and at Olluk-Kni, on the points of bayonets.

—J. A. MacGahan, The Daily News.

options.name: These are horrific lies!
Publicly hang … for these crimes.
Our contacts in … will vouch for us.
The next rebels will get much worse.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

events.title: … Horrors

events.desc: The civil service, currently led by the …, are deliberately stalling the government by creating unnecessary paperwork. They demand that their jobs be protected under the … law.
events.flavor: "I'd be happy to assist, but unfortunately this requisition form has only been stamped twice. You'll have to file a complaint with the regional ombudsman, who is currently very busy optimising our new filing system. You can expect a prompt response within six to eight months."

options.name: Current civil servants can keep their positions.
Unacceptable! Get back to work.
The secret police will keep them in line.
Use this opportunity to train their replacements.

events.title: Red Tape

events.desc: A new guard of … bureaucrats are outshining the … in every aspect of their work. This is a very encouraging omen for the efficacy of ….
events.flavor: "They think that just because they were born with a silver spoon in their mouth that they deserve the most important positions. But their privilege and entitlement make them lazy, nepotistic, and arrogant. We, by contrast, have had to work for all we have, and there are real consequences for failure. Advancement should be based only on merit, not on birth."

options.name: Clearly … is the correct policy.
The … have done a shoddy job.
Encourage the … to join the civil service.

events.title: Meritocracy

events.desc: Our efforts to pass the … law have run into several classic bureaucratic hurdles. Debates rage around such lofty matters as the correct shape of filing cabinets.
events.flavor: "Good, fast, cheap. You get two."

options.name: We will spare no expense.
This will take as long as it takes.
Let's just get it over with.

events.title: The Bureaucratic Struggle

events.desc: The interest in photographic arts throughout … has spawned many new artistic movements experimenting with the technology.
events.flavor: "It can perhaps seem too harsh to capture reality as the human eye perceives it, without any of the love or mercy of the human heart softening the image. However, by moving that responsibility from the artist to the observer, we hope to make people more aware of the contents of their own hearts."

options.name: This should be the new tool of news reporters everywhere!
It should be used to capture the beauty of ….
We should put our efforts towards making these pictures come alive.

events.title: Captured Light and Shadow

events.desc: The acquisition of film recording equipment and establishment of movie theaters throughout … has led to a fledgling film industry taking root.
events.flavor:
When she was a young girl, she had once been allowed to borrow a phenakistiscope and found herself transfixed by the spinning disc, by the dancing couple seemingly turning round and round on it. Years later, she had thought it a child's fancy, a simple illusion for a malleable mind. 

However, as she saw the projection of the train entering the station, she felt herself transported back to that moment. The magic was real again.

options.name: Film is the perfect tool to capture the harsh reality of our age.
Cinema shall be the frontier of storytelling!
What political uses could we find for such an evocative medium?

events.title: The Moving Picture

events.desc: … … has signed into law the confederation between … and …. This marks a great victory in our goal of unifying all of Canada.
events.flavor: With every document signed and stamped, we come one step closer to building a nation. The colonies haven't always seen eye-to-eye, but the people of Canada are resolute in their determination to see this through.

options.name: God save the …!

events.title: Confederation with …

options.name: God save the …!

events.title: The Unification of … and …

events.desc: The ink had not even dried on the bill of unification before our bureaucrats and politicians set to work on integrating …. With the blessing of … …, we are one step closer towards the Federation of Australia.
events.flavor: The bureaucracy, as they say, expands to meet the needs of the expanding bureaucracy. At least in this instance it serves a noble purpose; the emergence of an Australian nation is imminent. Backed by the Colonial Office, the local administrations, and above all else by the will of the Australian people, we cannot fail in our quest.

options.name: God save the …!

events.title: Confederation with …

events.desc: The ink had not even dried on the bill of unification before our bureaucrats and politicians set to work on integrating … with …. With the blessing of … …, we are one step closer towards the Federation of Australia.

Backed by the Colonial Office, the local administrations, and above all else by the will of the Australian people, we cannot fail in our quest.

options.name: God save the …!

events.title: The Unification of … and …

events.desc: The unification of Canada is complete. The various colonial governments have been integrated into one, under the administration of … and with the enthusiastic approval of ….
events.flavor: The dream of a united Canada has finally been achieved. From humble beginnings as a small colony in the vast and unknown north, the settlers have grown and adapted. They have become a people. They have forged a nation.

options.name: The True North strong and free!

events.title: Canadian Confederation

events.flavor: The dream of a united Canada has finally been achieved. From humble beginnings as a small colony in the vast and unknown north, the settlers have grown and adapted. They have become a people. They have forged a nation.

options.name: The True North strong and free!

events.title: Canadian Confederation

events.desc: The colonies of Australia have been consolidated into a single government under the direction of …. The … of … has formally congratulated the Australian people.
events.flavor: Today marks the beginning of the Australian nation. The Land Down Under was a great challenge for its first settlers, fraught with ferocious flora and fauna, malevolent and hostile. But through ingenuity, determination, and faith we have tamed this rugged land.

options.name: Advance Australia fair!

events.title: Australian Federation

events.desc: The colonies of Australia have been consolidated into a single government under the direction of …. The … has formally congratulated the … of … for leading the integration efforts.
events.flavor: Today marks the beginning of the Australian nation. The Land Down Under was a great challenge for its first settlers, fraught with ferocious flora and fauna, malevolent and hostile. But through ingenuity, determination, and faith we have tamed this rugged land.

options.name: Advance Australia fair!

events.title: Australian Federation

events.desc: After having completed our survey of the Isthmus, we should now approach about the possiblity acquiring land in Sinai for constructing a canal.
events.flavor: "Think about it, if we manage to make a canal through the Suez we would no longer need to sail all the way around the Cape of Good Hope to reach the colonies and countries in the far east."

options.name: Offer to build the canal.

events.title: Request Land in Sinai

events.desc: Ambassadors from … have approached us about the possibility of them acquiring land in Sinai in order to begin construction of a canal.
events.flavor: "Linking the Red Sea to the Mediterranean would be extremely beneficial for not just us, but the rest of the world as well. Think about it, no longer would anyone need to sail around the whole of Africa to get to the east, and we would be right at the center of all the trade."

options.name: None of the cost and all of the benefit.
We will not give away an inch of our land.

events.title: Bridging the Seas

events.desc: The … Government has accepted our request to acquire land in Sinai in order to start construction on a canal.
events.flavor: "Finally after a year of surveying, planning and negotiating we now have the opportunity to start construction. Soon we will be able to trade with the East Indies without needing to send ships around the Cape of Good Hope."

options.name: Time to start building.

events.title: … Accepts Our Deal

events.desc: The … Government has rejected our request to acquire land in Sinai.
events.flavor:
"How can they reject such an offer? We practically offered to build it for them, and after we spent all the time surveying the area. How could they be so blind to the potential of this project?"

"You know what they say, when diplomacy fails, bring out the stick."

options.name: Diplomacy has failed us this time.

events.title: … Rejects Our Deal

events.desc: After having completed our survey of the Isthmus, we should now approach about the possibility of acquiring land near Panama City to build the canal.
events.flavor: "Creating a shortcut between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans will be a historic event. No longer will we need to travel around continents to get to the other side of the Americas, we will be able to go straight through to either ocean."

options.name: Offer to build the canal.

events.title: Request for a Land in Panama

events.desc: Ambassadors from … have approached us about the possibility of them acquiring land near Panama City to build a canal.
events.flavor:
"We should at least let them try. They have already put in the effort to scout the area. Whose to say they won't just attack us also if we say no."

"The mere question of if we would give up any of our land to foreigners should not even be entertained by this government. If they want our land, they will have to take it from us by force."

options.name: None of the cost and all of the benefit.
We will not give away an inch of our land.

events.title: Connecting the Oceans

events.desc: The … Government has accepted our request to acquire land near Panama City. We can now begin construction of the canal.
events.flavor: "Finally after over a year of surveying, planning and negotiating we now have the opportunity to start construction of the canal. Soon we will be able to sail between the Atlantic and the Pacific Oceans through the continents, no longer around."

options.name: Time to start building.

events.title: … Accepts Our Deal

events.desc: The … Government has rejected our request to acquire land to build a canal that can connect the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean
events.flavor:
"How can they reject such an offer? We practically offered to build the whole canal for them, and after we spent all the time surveying the area. How could they be so blind to the potential of this project?"

"You know what they say, when diplomacy fails, bring out the stick."

options.name: Diplomacy has failed us this time.

events.title: … Rejects Our Deal

events.flavor: "There has been a long held belief that the water levels on either side of the Suez Isthmus differed greatly. We have now proven that is not the case."

options.name: We will make a suitable offer.
Coercion is the simplest form of persuasion.
We will build the Canal!

events.title: Suez Isthmus Surveyed

events.flavor: "A faster route between the Atlantic and Pacific has long been sought, but now we shall make it ourselves."

options.name: We will make a suitable offer.
Coercion is the simplest form of persuasion.
We will build the Canal!

events.title: Panama Isthmus Surveyed

events.desc: … has amassed his forces, and is calling for one strong, concentrated push towards the capital. The Cristinos, expecting his assault, have made ready. The future of Spain will be decided here and now, at the gates of ….
events.flavor:
The column stretched for as far as Javier could see, snaking between fallen boulders and scraggly bushes. The suffocating cloud of dust kicked up by ten thousand trudging feet had stained all their uniforms grey, washing out the last scraps of blue and white amongst them. At the rear of the column rode the priests and the ojalateros, with their ravenous appetite and everlasting stock of complaints. Ahead of them lay the Liberals, and all of the steel and gunpowder they could muster.

He had checked his bandolier in the morning, and found five cartridges remaining. All he could hope was that the Liberals had only four.
events.title: The Royal Expedition

options.name: Without a moment's pause.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.desc: Turned into a mere province by the government of Maria Cristina, and occupied under martial law by her forces in 1833, the Basque Country quickly turned into a stronghold of Carlist cause. With the throne of Don … secured, the time has come to fulfill his promise to restore the traditional privileges of the Basque people.
events.flavor:
Javier's hand shook as he grasped the door's handle, and threw it open. She was there - sitting on the bed, legs crossed, lap and hands occupied by a rented hand-loom. She looked up at the sound, pushed the loom to the side, and ran to him.

The last time he was here, he thought, it was as if there was a presence lurking in the corner of the room, a gold-clad spectre that had driven him to take up arms. It was gone, now. Baldomero Espartero, the demon of Navarre, banished forevermore by an errekete's well-placed round. He wrapped his arms around her waist, and allowed the tears to flow at last.

options.name: The … respects all his subjects
Perhaps we shouldn't agitate the Liberals further...

events.title: The King and the Fueros

events.desc: A brutal onslaught of policies enacted by the more radical elements in the Isabelline administration had led to a series of humiliations for the Church. From the seizure of Galician minifundias to the burning of churches in Zaragossa, nothing was spared, and nothing was sacred.
events.flavor:
The priest, clad in mourning robes, stalked back and forth across the foyer. At last, he turned his head towards the waiting officer.

\"Toreno and Mendizábal- that heathen- have stolen the tithe, repossessed our lands and expelled the Jesuits. Someone must put an end to this insanity! I beg of you, send me to Madrid, and I will visit the wrath of God upon them. The dogs of the heretic Cortes... I remember their names and faces. Each and every one of them.\"

options.name: Only restitution can wash away these sins.
A large donation should suffice.
You see, the war has taken a heavy toll on the royal coffers...

events.title: All That Is Holy

events.desc: Thus far, all prior attempts at conquering the vital port of Bilbao have failed. As the war is ramping up to its zenith, we may only have one more chance to force a victory here. A decisive strike on liberal garrison in Bilbao would not only improve morale, but also open up a new, vital supply route to our foreign backers.
events.flavor: "It is here where Zumalacárregui bled for the King. Perhaps it is here where we can turn the tide once more."

options.name: Prepare the cannons!
We cannot afford another siege.

events.title: The Siege of Bilbao

events.desc: While Andalucía may be far away from the main theater of the war, its poverty is a constant source of tension behind the Cristino lines. The rampant banditry and lawlessness may be exploited to our advantage.
events.flavor: "Merely a group of roving bandits? Perhaps. But a highly useful distraction nonetheless."

options.name: Send a small detachment to help create chaos.
This is a waste of time. The King has no allies here.

events.title: Carlism on the Frontier

events.desc: Sidelined by the court in favour of … …, and ordered into exile by his late brother King Ferdinand, Don … has defied his brother's testament, and set out to claim the throne. The … cause is joined by traditionalists and those resentful of the government's centralizing tendencies.
events.flavor:
Javier Larrañaga sat with his face to the sun. On each of his flanks, a line of tents ran along the ridge-line. Scattered around them were his brothers in arms - building fires, swabbing muskets, drying themselves after a dip in the mountain stream. The report of gunfire echoed in the distance. New volunteers, still wet behind the ears, handling a weapon for the first time in their lives.

A whistle sounded. He levered himself to his feet with his carbine's butt, and looked to the South. There, beyond the Ebro, was his King's prize. Thirty thousand of his countrymen stood in arms to claim it. Let God's mercy carry them to victory, for the Queen-Pretender would spare none.

options.name: Spain's future will be decided on these hills.

events.title: The Carlist War

events.desc: Tension between castes has been more pronounced since a recent census revealed the disproportionate representation of Brahmins in government jobs and highlighted the limited qualifications for Non-Brahmins.
events.flavor:
Praveen's resume, his two masters in economics and law, crumpled in his hands as he stormed away furiously from another rejection.

He knew he shouldn't be so angry or so surprised. He knew that when he moved to …, he would be far from the support of his forward-thinking university, and yet the blatant segregation shocked him. Despite his qualifications he was struggling to feed himself, while others, equally educated, enjoyed chai in manors. What infuriated him most was how the guards barred the way for him. As if they were any better than him in the eyes of the lords they so dearly guarded.

options.name: The … will champion for change.
… has their reasons to support this.

events.title: Unequal Opportunities

events.desc: The success of the Dravidian Movement's agenda has overseen the enactment of a new law and improved quality of life for non-Brahmins.
events.flavor:
The battle was far from over, this Praveen Pallar knew. Yet he could not help but smile as he took his seat in the simple government office, the fan above him gently cooling the sweat of his back.

Across from him he saw a Mr. Iyer, and to his left sat a Mr. Agastya. High caste Brahmins both. And here he was, a Pallar, holding the same position and pay as them. Neither seemed to meet his eyes. Yes, there was still work to be done, but for today, this would do.  He thanked his allies who had marched and protested with him and flipped open his first file.

options.name: The … has proven their competence.

options.name: The future for non-Brahmins is bright.

events.title: Equality at Last

events.desc: The Non-Brahmin Manifesto has been circulating in …, causing tension between the … and the ….
events.flavor:
The two party leaders sat across from each other, and their aides listened intently as the two minds battled for the second hour now.

"Please, you must make the Justice Party see reason," … pleaded. "We must fight together, or we will fail!"

"You will have us face the British lathis by your side, but tell me, when tomorrow comes, will you also have us govern by your side? The British have done me no more wrong than you have. Indeed, much of their deeds have been guided by your hands."

options.name: That manifesto is unpatriotic!
Perhaps the manifesto makes valid points.

events.title: The Non-Brahmin Manifesto

events.desc: To assert their rights, the Dalit community drank from a public water tank that they had been denied access to. This nonviolent protest was led by … and, in turn, met with a protest by Brahmin priests.
events.flavor: The young Dalit girl, Meena, watched the procession from afar, hidden behind a large tree. She had come here the day before with her mother, and they had drank from the water tank. It had seemed like a big event, though she had just been to skip work that day. But what she saw now horrified her, these priests were pouring cow urine and dung into the water. Had Meena drunk cow urine water? Either way, she would never drink from this polluted tank again.

options.name: The actions of the priests are unacceptable.
Let them keep each other distracted.

events.title: Untouchables and Outcasts

events.desc: Following … independence from Spain, a power vacuum was left in place of the colonial government, which was quickly filled by charismatic … leaders. These "caudillos" have come to define much of South American politics.
events.flavor:
There was, once, a decree that all colonies would submit to the rule of their mother country. That all its goods and words would pass through her doors, and that she would judge them fairly. That she alone would be all they needed.

Then there was Bonaparte, and the mother country made his puppet. Perhaps time had come for the children to fly. And fly they would, under a father's mailed fist. But this tale is yet to end.

options.name: Might makes right.

events.title: The Age of Caudillos

events.desc: The age of caudillo politics is, at long last, at an end in …. The … have assumed their rightful place of service to the legitimate government.
events.flavor: And so the father has become, like all men, too old and too tired to continue. Now, dear child, the country is ready to take its first, true steps forward. We live without our mother's eye, and without our father's switch. Everyone makes their choices today. And your grandchildren will look at us and say, 'and they lived happy and ate partridges.'

options.name: A great day for order and discipline.

events.title: The Last Caudillos

events.desc: … has become fully immersed in caudillo politics. The fate of the nation is governed by the whims of the most influential members of the ….
events.flavor:
"But mama, what about the parade in …? Will we be there in time to see Alfonso?

"Seems I'll never finish the story. Fine, yes, I promise we will be there on time. But what will you do if you cannot march with your brother when you grow up? Milk cows?"

"Mama, I know … will have me. I'm going to be strong for …!"

options.name: The sword is mightier than the pen.

events.title: The Fist Clenches

events.desc: According to the … Constitution, …'s term is over and a new … must be appointed. Of course, the Constitution can always be ammended, or perhaps the role should go to … protégé ….
events.flavor:
"Your term in office is over. The laws of …-"

"I am the law in …!"

options.name: Extend the …'s term.
The … must step down.
A chance for … to show … quality.

events.title: Continuismo

events.desc: As leader of the …, … must decide whether the military will back the … or the ….
events.flavor: Supplicants. That was the word … thought when the representatives addressed …. Flattery, gifts, appeals to family, veiled consequences: as much in lockstep as … parading troops. But the question was this: which served him best?

options.name: The army protects the interests of the elites.
Reform will come at the barrel of a gun.
The army will struggle alongside the people.
The military stands for order above all.

events.title: Kingmaker

events.desc: … …, a prominent military commander, has begun to challenge the civilian leadership of the … under …. The …'s ambitions threaten to expand caudillo rule to yet another sector of society.
events.flavor:
New Martial Offensive: Civil Offices Under Fire! 

A peculiar clarion sounded this morning as … … announced … intentions to introduce sweeping reforms amongst the current polity under …. Whispers from …'s streets about …'s leadership have become cries to step down, rising in chorus with denouncements against … …. (Cont. Pg. 3)

options.name: Trust in the heroism of … ….
The … must remain under civilian control.

events.title: Leadership Challenge

events.desc: Despite hundreds of years of searching, the source of the Nile still eludes us. Shall we send an expedition to attempt to plot the course of the river?
events.flavor: "Gentlemen, I put before you an incomplete map. Many of you nautically inclined fellows may recognise this delta. It is one of the very cradles of civilization as we know it, yet we know too little. What I propose is simple: we shall strike deep into the heart of Africa and find the secret many others have searched for."

options.name: I know the person for the job.

events.title: The Nile Expedition

events.desc: A group of strong candidates have expressed their interest in leading the expedition. However, this is not a decision we should make lightly.
events.flavor: The first to arrive was a well-dressed, fresh-faced, almost young gentleman whose keenness to impress was only matched by his willingness to oblige. His smile, as wide as one can imagine, was fashionably put together: "If I may...," he politely said, presenting his credentials.
events.title: Choosing a Leader

events.desc: After a few weeks of preparation and travel, the expedition led by … has arrived in Zanzibar. From here they will begin their journey to discover the elusive source of the Nile river.
events.flavor:
"The coast was less arenaceous than expected. Up the hill that led to the city, a group of locals had congregated to watch our expedition, more amused than intrigued. In a language that we could not understand, they shouted at us. One of our men gestured back and, with a shot to the air, the dispute was settled.

At the other side of the sea, the sand glistened—a layer of polished sunlight."

options.name: Onward!

events.title: The Expedition Embarks

events.desc: … has returned triumphantly, the source of the Nile River has been discovered. It turns out that the source is the great lakes of Africa.
events.flavor:
"The roaring sound of the water reminded me of my childhood. A distant and blurry line impossible to cross ever again. In my nightmares, I used to drown. The torrent kept going and going, like an open wound—bleeding out. The heart of Africa exposed before us, the dissection of a continent with meticulous care.

In my nightmares, I still drown."

options.name: Excellent news!

rewards.name: Found the Source of the Nile

events.title: Successful Expedition

events.desc: After not receiving any reports for many months, it has become clear that the expedition to the heart of Africa has failed and … has been lost along with it.
events.flavor: "We sat on the top of a mountain. Briefly we stopped. The water was running low, and so was the food. The jungle couldn't possibly end; it wasn't in its nature. Monstrous trees bit the last fragments of sky. We were so tired. So tired."

options.name: Damnation!

events.title: Failed Expedition

events.desc: A local ruler has requested that you pay an extra 'Hongo', a type of tax, for passing through their land.
events.flavor: "Every single bit of territory we pass through, we must pay another tax. If we pay one ruler extra tax, we will have to pay them all. If we don't pay... well, things might turn sour."

options.name: Pay the tax.
Don't pay.

events.title: Local Tax

events.desc: One of the pack mules we brought has wandered off into the undergrowth. We could spend some time tracking it down or simply move on.
events.flavor: "Good God, the mule's gone! Scatter and find it, but stay out no later than the hour. If we don't find it, we might hope that some of the locals will ransom the beast back to us. And stay within earshot of our whistles!"

options.name: Spend some time looking for the mule.
It's just one mule, leave it.

events.title: Lost Mule

events.desc: A rhinoceros has been sighted nearby, we could stop the expedition for a short while to try and claim its horn as a prize.
events.flavor:
"The beast was almost bent over: its wrinkled body and slow movements resembled those of an old man.

"If we get it now, imagine the fortune they'll pay us back in …. It's completely alone."

As the sky darkened towards the evening, a perfect, immaculate shine remained, reflecting the pallor of its horn."

options.name: We shall hunt it.
Let us not get distracted.

events.title: Rhinoceros Sighted

events.desc: We successfully hunted the rhinoceros, bringing back its horn as a trophy.
events.flavor: "Despite the success and great sport, none of the locals would eat the flesh of rhinoceros. I do not understand why, it seems a shame to waste it."

options.name: We shall continue.

events.title: Rhinoceros Hunted

events.desc: A member of the expedition was hurt in the failed rhinoceros hunt and some time will need to be spent getting them back to good health.
events.flavor: "Unfortunately, my rifle failed to fire at the key moment and one of the hunting party was... well, I suppose skewered is the correct terminology. Poor bastard will need a few days to recover."

options.name: What a disaster.

events.title: Failed Rhinoceros Hunt

events.desc: A beetle has crawled into the ear of …. Without immediate medical help this could impede the expedition's progress.
events.flavor:
"A buzzing noise, the itching wouldn't stop growing. "OUT. OUT. OUT." I shook my head and screamed in pain. "GET IT OUT. OUT." I could feel its wings moving inside my ear, trying to crawl deeper. "…!," one of the expedition members tries to grab my hand when I reach out for the knife.

"OUT! OUT!!""

options.name: We shall stop and get proper help.
We cannot stop, give … the knife.

events.title: A Beetle in Hand Is Worth Two in the Ear

events.desc: … is demanding that we halt the expedition and wait for more supplies of … to come in.
events.flavor: "Well you didn't hear it from me, but … tore apart half the camp looking for some more …. When … couldn't find it, … insisted we send for some. No matter how long it takes."

options.name: We will stop and wait for more to arrive.
We will go on without it

events.title: … Supplies Run Low

events.desc: It has been suggested that we stop and undertake a geographical study of the area to increase our local knowledge.
events.flavor:
"The first rays of sun fell from the sky in a perpendicular manner over the dry, half-lighted soil. They flickered over the river's surface, moving the water as the brittle branches of an ill tree.

The almost-shimmer seeped into the rocks; a whimsical landscape where life seemed so distinct, so alien—so vivid."

options.name: Good idea.
We don't have the time.

events.title: Geographical Study

events.desc: The dissident states that so foolishly abandoned … unity have been brough back into the fold. The nation is once again united.
events.flavor: "The days of the Spanish crown are no more. We are free to pursue our own destinies now, yet we trample each other in a stampede to our ends. And all around us, our enemies unite into greater wholes. If greater machines, greater bodies, and greater scopes are our future, let us embrace it. Let us embrace each other. Let us offer each other the sign of peace. Let us seek our greater destinies together."

options.name: Here's to a more stable union.

events.title: Central American Reunification

events.desc: The remaining states of the union have declared their independence. It has become clear that the union of … is over, and that … must fend for itself.
events.flavor: "It is reclaiming the ownership of our country, or bowing down to them. It is forgetting the names of our parents, or learning the enemy's ancestors. It is sowing our own land, or seeing them ravage it. It is freedom, or it is war!"

options.name: We must accept our fate.
We will not abandon the union so lightly.

events.title: The Dissolution of Central America

events.desc: … has declared its secession from …. This has prompted further instability and turmoil in the remaining states of our fragile union.
events.flavor: "The … signed a decree allowing the remaining states to secede, but this was nothing more than a formality; the dissolution of our confederation was already a reality. But perhaps what was may come again, given time for the wounds of division to heal."

options.name: Let them have their independence.
They will regret this betrayal.

events.title: … Secedes

events.desc: … has offered to spend some of their personal wealth to fund the creation of a University in …. Though this will likely give the … some influence.
events.flavor: "The … University will be a proud bastion of learning in these times of rapid progress, where knowledge truly is power."

options.name: A wonderful idea.
No, we can't give them a platform.

events.title: A Donation of Knowledge

events.desc: … has challenged … to a duel to the death.
events.flavor:
The aura surrounding their two figures is like something out of a romantic novel. … smiles. … has been rehearsing this moment before falling asleep.

"…, …"

"Your insults cannot go unanswered, pick a weapon of choice and we shall meet tomorrow."

options.name: Let them fight.
We should stop it.
We should ban dueling.

events.title: The Duel

events.desc: It has been revealed that … of the … has been having a secret affair with a member of the clergy. … resignation is being demanded.
events.flavor: "The very fact that this sneaky bastard thought … could get away with such a gross misuse of … power, shows everything wrong with the leadership of the …."

options.name: Force … to step down.
"Let he without sin cast the first stone."

events.title: Devout Scandal

events.desc: A statue of … … was commissioned and it has been suggested that it be displayed proudly in ….
events.flavor:
"… is how you would describe the look on the face of the statue when it smiles down on you. Eyes that flicker in the opposite direction of the sun.

Though maybe you are just imagining it?"

options.name: A monument worthy of the ….
Perhaps not everyone wishes to be reminded of the ….

rewards.name: Disapproves of Monarch Statue Not Being Raised

events.title: Monument to the …

events.desc: A statue of the old monarch stands in …. Some are suggesting it should be torn down.
events.flavor: "It looks down on us it does, laughing, gloating, mocking. Tearing it down is the only way to be free of it."

options.name: Tear down the symbols of the old world.

rewards.name: Approves of Monarch Statue Being Removed

options.name: It is important we don't forget our history.

rewards.name: Approves of Not Removing Monarch Statue

options.name: We shall relocate it to … to keep an eye on it.

events.title: Statue of History

events.desc: Due to the inhuman conditions that children face in their workplaces, many families in … have chosen to hide their offspring in the hopes of them not being sent to work.
events.flavor: "They told us to stay quiet, sir, so that's what we did. My brother and I stood there, quiet as a tomb, you see, I held my breath as much as I could, but it was too dark, so I figured they had already left. They wouldn't find us here, you see, that's what mama said, but it was too dark, sir, and it was cold."

options.name: Children? What children?
It'd be a shame if they were to hide in these abandoned houses...

events.title: The Invisible Cry

events.desc: Given the low wages that workers in … are receiving, more and more parents are pushed to send their children to work to help sustain their families.
events.flavor:
"This is madness! How are we supposed to help these people if they themselves are forcing their children to work?! We must do something! Put an immediate halt to this barbaric decision!"

"Well, it seems quite obvious that this is not something that they would want for their own children, if they had other options, right? Judging these poor people based on their survival decisions won't help them either."

options.name: We must stop this.
They do what they need to do.

events.title: A Sour Truth

events.desc: With the government push for …, adult men have been pressed to cover the gap they would leave behind. However, their bodies are too large and their fingers too wide for it and industrial accidents have been increasing.
events.flavor: "Their screams filled the factory, their blood covered the machines as if they had a heart of their own. It's the tenth time in a week that a man cuts his finger trying to operate some tiny machinery, previously manipulated only by the slender hands of a child. The protests have been rising: "If not them, then it's us.""

options.name: No one should be doing this kind of work.
Children aren't coming back, so they better get used to it.

events.title: Unavoidable Injuries

events.desc: In our progress towards the enactment of …, ragged schools have been avidly suggested throughout the country. These charitable organizations would provide food and education to our society's most destitute children.
events.flavor: "There's only one way that these poor children, without connections or family, can make a way through society: education. If they don't know how to write their name, we'll teach them how to sign; if they don't know how to read, we'll teach them how to stay informed; if a kid like this cannot get food, we'll get him a job."

options.name: Such a pious matter must be handled by the ….
A wonderful initiative that should be handled by teachers.

events.title: Ragged Schools

events.desc: The enactment of … has come to a halt due to some public protests. Many are the families that lack the purchasing power to meet the expenses that buying new school supplies imply, thus preventing their children from scholarization.
events.flavor: "Listen, no parent would try to stop their children from getting a better future than the one they'll be getting here, but if I need to make a decision and that decision is between buying bread and buying some pen and ink I'd say that ain't no fair decision."

options.name: Wealth cannot be a prohibiting factor.
We cannot devote even more public funds.

events.title: Pen and Paper

events.desc: Some members of the … have raised their concerns about the enactment of …, since they believe that it would affect employment and promote agitation among the lower classes.
events.flavor:
"Everyone has their own place, right? I think we can all agree on that. If we teach these kids the same things we're teaching our own children, then who's stopping them from wanting the same jobs?

And who'd be then doing what they ought to do? Educating for the sake of educating is nonsense, an idyllic utopia that would only lead to misery, empty factories and lazy workers."

options.name: Everyone deserves a chance.
Tell the … that they're right. Then continue with our plan.
They should consider it an act of charity.

events.title: Never One of Them

events.flavor: "The result of the inquiry, then, is, that there has been no particular outbreak or prevalence of cholera in this part of London except among the persons who were in the habit of drinking the water of the above-mentioned pump well. In consequence of what I said, the handle of the pump was removed on the following day."

options.name: We need to keep the filth off the streets.
Epidemiology is a promising field.
John Snow knows nothing.

events.title: On the Mode of Communication of Cholera

events.desc: Professors at the University of … believe new theories employing craniometry can be used to demonstrate racial differences, rallying support for ….
events.flavor: "There are of course individual differences which can provide some astounding insights into the nature of base and criminal traits, but the differences between larger groups are our current focus. I have here the skull of a normal … citizen, of sound mind and body in life, kindly donated to our institution. It represents the highest stage of humanity. Now, as I'm sure you can imagine, some of the other specimens in my collection are substantially less advanced."

options.name: Fascinating. Fetch the calipers!
Don't waste time on this nonsense.

events.title: The Measure of a Skull

events.desc: The debates around … have sparked discussion at the Art Academy in … about whether artistic movements influenced by … artists have a place in the … art world.
events.flavor: "In contemporary sculpture, painting and music alike, the corrupting influence of these so-called 'artists' can be felt. That this is taught in our schools and displayed in our museums is a slap in the face of the … soul. For the feelings and values of our people to be protected from … filth, it must be purged!"

options.name: It is distinctly un-…!
Their work is part of our artistic legacy.

events.title: Cultural Contributions

events.desc: … people have spoken out against the passing of … legislation, arguing that they deserve the same rights as any other citizens.
events.flavor: "What has possessed the leaders of this nation to think of us as enemies? Have we not toiled together, suffered together, eaten at the same tables and lived as brothers and sisters up until now? Our children will remember a country their parents helped build, a country that treated them fairly, as a country that turned its back on them when overcome with bigotry and malice. It is not too late to turn back."

options.name: They are a noxious and foreign presence!
They are part of … society, but must be segregated.

events.title: Second Class Citizens

events.desc: … has been championing the passing of …, starting in their own ranks. A … politician may take over leadership in the fight for the culture's acceptance in ….
events.flavor: "Sending a message to others is part of it, but it is not the only reason. We need to reevaluate who is truly capable and deserving of certain positions in our organization, who has been passed over and ignored in less enlightened times. If we succeed, all of … will have to do the same."

options.name: Equality starts here!
…'s leadership is needed in these uncertain times.

events.title: A … Voice

events.desc: The … has begun a propaganda campaign, painting … people as criminals who will be allowed to run rampant under the new … law.
events.flavor: "Yes, I've read the pamphlet. It's nothing new. 'The … are thieves, the … are violent thugs, the … culture is inherently corrupt and desegregation will be the end of …'. The picture of a … man in rags, vaguely resembling my father. Has it ever crossed their minds that the reason so many of us live in poverty is because the current laws force us there?"

options.name: We must take a stand against these vile lies.
Let them whinge.

events.title: Thieves and Liars

events.desc: Some Shopkeepers have expressed opposition to the equal treatment of … people under the … law, announcing that they will refuse them service.
events.flavor: "It's easy for those politicians to draft their plans for equality and brotherhood, but I have a business to run. If I start letting in the …, I'll lose half of my customers. They're not bigots, you see, just good … people who are used to things being done a certain way around here. We'll keep doing things that way."

options.name: Such discrimination is unacceptable.
They can do what they wish with their own businesses.

events.title: … Customers Not Wanted

events.desc: Despite our pessimistic expectations, our national kindred won their own struggle for independence—without our help.
events.flavor: /"The nation's soul is split in twain! The border between our lands is a cruel cut at the very heart of our people. It is obvious to all that now is the time for unification!/"

options.name: Annex the country
Leave them alone

events.title: Secession Prevails

events.desc: … holds vast potential - a large expanse of arable land, and a perfect climate for the growth of valuable cash crops. This wealth may hold the key to resolving the precarious situation of the … economy post-independence.
events.flavor: At full extent, the total area once controlled by Portugal stretched over a fifth of the continent. Brazil now stretches over those lands, with venous waterways feeding savannahs, wetlands, rainforests, rolling hills and mountains alike. Given the right field of life, anything known to man could grow somewhere here. But such vastness would need time, effort, and a river of blood to be tamed for use. Order and progress will not wait for long.

options.name: An export economy will bring us into modernity.
The efforts of our planters should be continued.

events.title: A Trickle of Beans

events.desc: Local governments in …, a highly wealthy state invested in the plantation economy, has embarked upon a program of reinvestment of proceeds from the coffee trade. This has boosted its development even further past other … states.
events.flavor:
"How many coffee plantations can one nation stuff into a single area? Seems every man and his dog either works or owns a coffee plantation here."

"You should see the next administration. Cows as far as the eye can see. Every decent Brazilian must have milk with his coffee."

"Explains why the air's so rancid there."

options.name: … is a beating heart of ….

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Middle Strata
Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: The central government must have its share.

events.title: Coffee's Coffers

events.desc: With a shortage of willing workers to man the … in …, local … have sought a solution to acquire more cheap labor for their fields.
events.flavor:
To P. M., harbor master,
Surely as I write this, I have no need to tell you of the crates of coffee flowing out of our ports and into the mouths of Americans and Europeans of every stripe. Tons, I am told, pass onto our ships to visit all corners of the globe. And surely, you would know, that picking these precious beans is backbreaking labor under our sun. Other plantation owners and I have come to a mutual understanding of sorts: we require more meat to feed the merciless sun, and our bloodthirsty crops. Surely what the British do not know will not hurt them.

options.name: Encourage European migrant labor.
Seek the expansion of slavery to make up the gap.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Pitiless Fields

events.desc: With the growth of … agriculture, the agrarian planter class has been greatly enriched. This class is exemplified by the "coffee and milk" barons of … and …, who now seek to expand their influence ever further.
events.flavor:
"You should know that it's less democratic than you think. It's more a matter of choosing which manner of slop we want more: cow pies or burnt coffee."

"How bad could it be, man? It can't be so bad as choosing between Tories in a rotten borough."

"Coronels across the states... er... enjoy a great many liberties with their power. They act more as robber-barons than as men of enlightenment."

options.name: The consequences of growth.

events.title: Café com Leite

events.desc: The successful development of … agriculture has grown our nation's economy greatly. The fruits of our trade can be seen on every continent, flavoring tea in London and being sipped from steaming mugs in New York.
events.flavor:
The latest taxation reports were incontrovertible: milk and coffee were most, if not all, of the products out of some administrations. Those same taxes and port tariffs were paying for no fewer than thirty Brazilian students abroad, and another four science institutes alone. Roads, hospitals and libraries bought and paid for by cows and coffee.

Or rather, the coronels who controlled the trade.

options.name: A toast to those who made this possible!

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: One day, we must expand from agriculture.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: The Money Tree

events.desc: The agricultural oligarchs of the less-prominent Northeastern state of … have objected strongly to the perceived domination of the … political system by … and ….
events.flavor:
"Seems anything we do these days is dictated by … alone. And for what? Coffee? Feh, what good is their coffee compared to food, let alone sugar and meat?"

"People are happy to pay for coffee. They aren't for sugar and meat. Besides, what's your point? You take the castaway cows and make shoes. People can survive just fine without shoes."

"My point is that the … should declaw … and … before they overwhelm us. And you'd think better of shoes if you had to walk barefoot in the sun, fool!"

options.name: They should learn to perform better.
We cannot have a government at its own throat.

events.title: Oligarchial Friction

events.desc: The formidable political machines of the states of … and … have asserted themselves in the ongoing election, supporting the candidates of the … for all federal offices.

options.name: The coronels will always come through.
We must have electoral integrity.

events.title: The Coffee Machine

events.desc: The governors of the powerful "Coffee and Milk" states of … and … have sought an agreement with the federal government of … to ensure the control of both their local oligarchies and our current administration.
events.flavor: The balances of power demand a slight recalibration. More palms greased with milk, honeyed with coffee, and all for gain in the end. The plantation and ranch owners would demand simple concessions: proliferation and support for their interests, at the cost of any real opposition. In turn, the flagging Senate would have more solidarity in its ranks. But it all ends the same: in a conspiracy against the public.

options.name: This policy will ensure the stability of ….

modifiers.label: Political Strength from the Votes of Aristocrats

options.name: The federal government must maintain some authority over the states.

events.title: The Governors Policy

events.desc: Widespread destitution in … has led to an outbreak of crime and "social banditry". In the hinterlands of the state, bandits gain infamy amongst the rural poor for their bold and violent actions.
events.flavor:
"'Lantern?' Huh, what kind of name is 'Lantern?' Doesn't exactly make a man terrified."

"You should be. The man can work a lever-action so fast that no machine gun can keep up. We'd be dead, and the boss would be fileted with a peixeira in minutes. Or knowing how much he likes money, make him watch as Lantern throws it to the poor, then filet the poor sod."

"Gives money to beggars? Doesn't sound all that bad. 'Lantern.' Tell you what, I'll oil him up and put a match to him if it will stop you wetting your pants."

options.name: Cangaceiros are useful for the coronel's... special tasks.
We must root out this plague!

events.title: The Cangaço

events.desc: The notorious bandit … has assembled a great band of cangaceiros and struck at the large … of …. … activities have inspired the rural poor to intensify calls for land reform.
events.flavor: Although it had taken the better part of a day, the photographer had finally convinced … to shoot. … suspected there was a gun in the camera. Reasonable, given the ludicrous methods the law had used in the past. Nobody in the gang had been photographed before. Now, they would have to get used to it: they were more than bandits. They were heroes, and they had more hearts and minds to win.

options.name: … is in utter chaos!
Send the police after … at once.
We know where … will run to.

events.title: The Lamp in the Dark

events.desc: A group of lieutenants in the state of … have launched an abortive coup to install a more modernized, liberal government. Whilst the plot has failed, the incident has revealed cracks in the structure of ….
events.flavor:
Fort Seized, Tenentes March!

Shock grips the city of Rio de Janeiro as a pack of officer cadets and some of their seditious higher officers seize a fort near the capital. Treasonous citizens, monarchist sympathizers and anti-republicans alike, have joined the revolt. Reporters close to the city say that the full strength of the revolt is unknown. They have captured the fort's artillery, and have begun moving into... (cont. pg. 4)

options.name: This is the fault of the … command!
We must keep a closer watch on ….

events.title: The Revolt of the Eighteen

events.desc: With the maintenance of the …' power over … politics, the Milk-Coffee oligarchy has been fully and firmly entrenched. The conservative political machines of … and … look to be the country's true rulers for the foreseeable future.
events.flavor:
And with the final slash of the pen, it was done: bosses sworn in for life, seats won and lost on principle of land alone, and the Senate made unassailable. The Army, having once helped depose the dying monarchy, was now brought to heel. As a final guarantee, states made armies of their police, and the humiliated Navy was all too eager to regain favor.

Glory to Brazil. Our brave breast shall defy Death itself!

options.name: To a century of order and progress!
Things will be different, one day.

events.title: The Coffee Kingdom

events.desc: The government's passage and enforcement of … has successfully reduced the influence of the … within … politics. The era of the Milk-Coffee oligarchy is slowly coming to an end.
events.flavor: Milk coffee sprayed from his mouth. The aide wiped it away with a sweat-stained handkerchief. He then repeated what he said to the coronel: reforms to voting and to governorship rendered his political worth no better than a mere librarian's. Invective spewed forth as the coronel crushed the coffee glass in his hand, milk and coffee mingling with blood.

options.name: The people shall rule!
We must reconcile with the former coronels.

events.title: Against Coronelismo

events.desc: The … government's policy of … has struck a grave blow against the …. The Milk-Coffee system has been rendered obsolete under the auspices of the people.
events.flavor: "Do you see here, now, good people of Brazil? This property once owned by a cattle rancher? This cattle rancher and his father were once brutal slave drivers. It doesn't matter what his name was, for he is gone now. But now, his ranch? Expropriated. All of these cows he left to starve? Expropriated. His lands? Expropriated. So it is from Minas Gerais to Amazonas. A big day has arrived in Brazil. May it be the only big day we ever need."

options.name: Down with the landlord class!

events.title: Expropriation with Cause

events.desc: In an increasingly common display of the violence known as the cangaço, bandits have raided the homes of several wealthy … in …. Their families have been slaughtered, and a portion of the loot distributed to the local rural poor.
events.flavor: At night, they came with fire and axes. Come sunrise, the coronel's men found the night watch's remaining pieces. By noon, they found suspicious lookalikes of some of the coronel's cheaper possessions in the market. After sunset, a dirty man smelling of Parisian perfumes beyond his station returned a donkey to a farmer. With a hand on the missing work overseer's pistol, the Cangaceiro winked at the coronel's men as he walked back into the forest.

options.name: They must have fallen behind on their payments.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: This terror cannot stand. Search the locals.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Cangaceiros Raid … Plantations

events.desc: Amidst the storm of bandit violence known as the cangaço, elements of the local … in … have been inspired by romanticized tales of cangaceiro communities. Calls for increased autonomy and discontent with the … threaten to spill into violence.
events.flavor:
"That's the fifteenth peasant we've ejected from these halls today. Honestly, the nerve of these dung shovellers. Does due process mean nothing to them?"
"Senhor?"
"Not now. 'Check the coronels or they'll do it for us.' Pah! We should draft fresh legislation to prevent them from returning-"
"Senhor!"
"What is it? Is it two dozen of the hooligans now? Fetch the guards and arrest this rabble too!"
"Senhor, look! Hundreds of them!"

options.name: The people of … have taken dangerous inspirations.
The terror holds all of … in its jaws.

events.title: Romanticized Terror

events.desc: With the establishment of …, we must decide the direction of our new colonial administration.
events.flavor: "Right, now take this down. And you remembered your pen this time? Ah, good. So it is in Darkest Africa, that we come to the now called …, where we can begin the beachhead of true civilization. From there, proper exploitation of resources for the glory of- My God, man, strike out me asking about your pen! This is for the annals!"

options.name: It will be administered by a chartered … Company.
The … missions will uplift the local populace.
In Darkest Africa, a new … shall emerge.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: The whip shall crack, and the colony provide.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Nature of Administration

events.desc: With our administrative ties to the metropole cut off, massive protests have erupted throughout …. Protest that our understaffed colonial forces are hard pressed to handle.
events.flavor: "… has created us free, and did not make us into heritage or estate. So by …, we shall be bequeathed or enslaved no more."

options.name: May … preserve ….

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Colonial governance is no longer sustainable. We must have majority rule.

events.title: The Severed Limb

events.desc: As we dismantle the institution of colonialism, the people of … expect to be granted independence as part of this ideological shift.
events.flavor: "You cannot dismantle colonialism without dismantling colonialism! It is not enough to simply promise not to establish new colonies, you must remove your vile grip from the people you have already encompassed within your tyranny."

options.name: They shall have the liberty they seek.
We have no intention of giving up ….

events.title: Decolonization

events.desc: The … is concerned that cheap colonial labor will be used to make their jobs obsolete.
events.flavor: "We'll all end up in the poor houses, I know it. How will we be able to sell our produce when we have to compete without thousands of acres of virgin lands, worked by dirt-cheap native labor?"

options.name: Alleviate their concerns.
Of course we will exploit the colonies!

events.title: Colonial Outsourcing

events.desc: The news that the government intends to pass the … law has created great enthusiasm among those that are eager to exploit new and distant lands.
events.flavor: "Profit and adventure lie in wait for all those brave enough to embark with us. An untamed world awaits us, just waiting for us to deliver some good … civilization. And if the natives object, make sure you have your rifle close at hand."

options.name: Slow down, the law isn't signed yet!
We will take our rightful place on the world stage.

rewards.name: A Place on the World Stage

options.name: Load the ships, we depart for distant shores!

events.title: Colonial Enthusiasm

events.desc: The government's attempt to pass the … law has brought the ethics of colonialism to the forefront of public debate.
events.flavor: "We have no right to interfere, control, or exploit. They say we bring 'civilization'; we bring misery and oppression, we rig the entire social economic structures of the colonies to serve our selfish needs."

options.name: … is morally correct.
We can concede to some of their points.

events.title: The Ethics of Exploitation

events.desc: … …'s personal habits are starting to get in the way of … role as a ….
events.flavor:
… smiles at the officer, exultantly, avidly. … eyes have obviously seen better days. Carefully recumbent on … leather armchair, … voice comes out as rubbery as the material:

"It's a stressful job, you know. No need to make it even more stressful."

options.name: Fire ….
… is too valuable.

events.title: All Play and No Work

events.desc: … has brought to light some questionable habits that … partakes in and is demanding they be fired.
events.flavor: "The very idea that I belong to the same institution as that scoundrel is unthinkable to me. They are a stain on the uniform that we share. I refuse to acknowledge that this is acceptable behavior for someone in their position. I won't work with them a day longer."

options.name: We can't fire ….
Fire …!

events.title: General Protest

events.desc: … has worked out how to improve upon the  invention of the repeaters.
events.flavor:
"… adjusts … spectacles filled with confidence.

"Well, it was rather simple, you see. I merely observed the technology the men currently worked with, and realized that we could change some things here and there."

There's something about the way … talks that gives … a graceful demeanor and a considerable popularity among the masses when … holds that rifle. Such confidence!

options.name: Focus on fire power.
Focus on precision.

events.title: War of Progress

events.desc: An affair between … and …'s spouse has reached our ears, threatening to affect … public image if we don't destitute the general.
events.flavor: As if being caught in the act wasn't enough, … stepped from the bath to see a telltale rash spreading. There was only one liaison … was seeing. Now, there was no denying it, not after the general's very flesh betrayed the affair.

options.name: We still need a general, and these are personal matters.
We cannot trust a … like this.
They should settle accounts on their own.

events.title: General's Misfired Cannon

events.desc: Speaking from …, … … has formally repudiated the so-called Two-Nation theory, pledging instead eternal brotherhood between all Indians, regardless of creed or conviction.
events.flavor:
The two women sat at their respective doorsteps, one wearing a blue saree and the other a colorful burqa. Each was busy cutting vegetables for dinner that night while their sons played gilli-danda on the street in front of them.

"Will it last?" Hasrat asked, looking over at Jaya.

But before she could answer, their sons started fighting. Unfazed, both mothers shouted sharply, and the sons stilled. "Apologise!" Jaya scolded. Both sons apologized to each other, holding their ears as they did. Satisfied, the women resumed the conversation, and the sons returned to their play.

"Will it last?" Jaya repeated. Looking at their sons, she said, "I hope so."

options.name: Long live Great India, united in diversity!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: With equal rights, comes equal responsibilites.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The One-Nation Theory

events.desc: With the division of India along ethno-religious lines an unfortunate reality, the adherents of the Two-Nation theory seem near-vindicated in their beliefs, as public relations between Hindus and Muslims deteriorate to the point of widespread violence.
events.flavor:
The two old politicians walked along the old Delhi road as the sun set. "You must be happy," one asked the other.

"Don't act like you didn't want this. Now you can rule without me blocking your every step."

"Ah but old friend, if you think you were my only problem you are sorely mistaken." The man looked up the road where a homeless woman begged and a fruit vendor tried to sell some of his poor wares. "No, I fear we haven't halved our problems, simply our resources."

options.name: This 400-year-old experiment has run its course. It is time to accept that they cannot stand united.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Perhaps separated, they will heal and, over time, unite again.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Great Divide

events.desc: Speaking at a protest rally in …, an … speaker urged the listeners to boycott the British lifestyle and return to their Hindu roots if they wish to build a free Hindu nation. This has sparked fears of religious oppression members of the … leading to further animosity between the two groups.
events.flavor:
Muhammad Khan couldn’t believe the audacity of the speaker. The man had dared to say, "I am glad to see Mr. Khan here, representing the Muslim branch of our party". He was here before him! He had fought the British in court! And won! And now he was just a representative of the Muslim Branch?

And then the upstart had dared suggest a Hindu nation. What did he think all the Muslims and Sikhs would do when they heard that? Convert?

options.name: They must both learn their place.
Better they direct their rage at each-other than at us.

events.title: A Dangerous Idea

events.desc: The … led a large and loud religious procession in …, stopping to perform in front of a mosque. Muslim youths responded to the taunts with a procession of their own. Matters escalated between the two groups leading to riots and violence.
events.flavor: She didn’t know who had thrown the first stone or drawn the first dagger. All she knew was that her son was dead. She held his body in her arms, her eyes dry and incapable of tears. Her husband approached her son, to take him away but she refused. No, he had already taken him once, he would not take him again. If he wanted love, he could seek it among the mob he had chosen to march with.

options.name: The Mahasabha is fuelling dangerous intolerance.
The Muslim youths should have reported this to the authorities.

events.title: An Eye for an Eye

events.desc: A new mosque was built in a populated area in … despite many Hindus expressing reservations against its construction. To reassert their dominance and faith, the … led a procession through the Mosque, quickly sparking violent conflict.
events.flavor:
Local conflict reaches new heights!
Yesterday saw the third day of communal violence in …, as Hindoos and Mohammedans fought over the presence of a mosque in what the Hindoos believe is their area. A British Agent who wished to remain anonymous had this to say, "We must not be surprised. It was our hard work that kept the locals in line. It is not surprising, that now as they struggle against us, like adolescent children, they act like petulant siblings amongst themselves. They simply do not know better."

options.name: Administration of the area should be handed over to the British Authorities
Administration should be handed over to committee consisting equally of of Hindus and Muslims
If the administration allowed Muslims to build the Mosque, Hindus should have respected this decision.

events.title: Our Way or No Way

events.desc: Despite the population of … in … consisting of a Hindu majority, most of its administrators are Muslims. This has sparked protest from Hindus who feel like their needs are being ignored.
events.flavor:
"We do not doubt that most Muslims mean well," the elderly Brahmin said to the crowd. "But at Bakri Eid, some people sacrificed a goat not far from my temple, and then ate it as they crossed our footsteps! I, of course, tried to speak to the authorities but here I was laughed away by Muslim men who told me to just enjoy the festivities. And here in lies the problem!"

Before the priest could continue, another man spoke up, "If this is true then where are these men? Who is to say that you're not lying just to ruin the name of a Muslim?"

And before the leaders could say anything, a thousand voices began shouting and cacophony followed.

options.name: Create proportional representations when hiring government officials.
Segregate areas as Muslim or Hindu only
Perhaps if the Hindus lead, they will feel safer in Hindu majority areas.

events.title: No Voice, No Right

events.desc: With socialist ideas sweeping across …, the … government has determined that drastic concessions to arrest its progress must be considered. There is sufficient momentum for a rapid policy change.
events.flavor: "The proletariat is everywhere assuming a threatening attitude, and is beginning to count the ranks of its enemy, far weaker in numbers than itself, and to demand the actualization of its rights. All people are filled with a kind of premonition, and everyone whose vital organs are not paralyzed face with shuddering expectation the approaching future which will utter the redeeming word."

options.name: Offer greater wages for their labor.
Put the last slavers out of their misery.
Guarantee better conditions for workers.
We will not capitulate!

events.title: A World to Win

events.desc: The workers of … have finally overthrown the bourgeois government and established a Council Republic. But there is still far more work to be done before socialism has been truly achieved.
events.flavor: "As long as human labor power, and, consequently, life itself, remain articles of sale and purchase, of exploitation and robbery, the principle of the “sacredness of human life” remains a shameful lie, uttered with the object of keeping the oppressed slaves in their chains."

options.name: The vanguard party will lead the way!

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: All power to the councils!
All power to the soviets!
No gods! No masters! Anarchy forever!

events.title: The Worker's Republic

events.desc: Reactionary elements within the … have at long last been purged. We can be assured that their new leader, …, will be loyal to the state and to socialism.
events.flavor: "The dictatorship of the proletariat, i.e., the organization of the vanguard of the oppressed as the ruling class for the purpose of suppressing the oppressors, cannot result merely in an expansion of democracy. It must impose a series of restrictions on the freedom of the oppressors, the exploiters, the capitalists."

options.name: Loyalty must be absolutely guaranteed.
They have an important role to play.

events.title: The Vanguard Advances

events.desc: … is fast becoming an anarchist utopia. Poverty has been completely eliminated, and a classless society based on mutual aid is taking root.
events.flavor: "A different conception of society is in the process of formation. Under the name of Anarchy, it seeks the most complete development of individuality combined with the highest development of voluntary association in all its aspects, in all possible degrees, for all imaginable aims."

options.name: Mother Anarchy loves her sons.

events.title: The Conquest of Bread

events.desc: Reactionary elements in the political landscape have been almost entirely eradicated or suppressed. The vanguard party reigns supreme.
events.flavor: "A party is the vanguard of a class, and its duty is to lead the masses and not merely to reflect the average political level of the masses."

options.name: Disloyalty is treason.

events.title: The Great Purge

events.desc: The Communist government has delivered on its promise to expand public institutions. All … citizens are guaranteed access to healthcare, social security, education, and a safe workplace.
events.flavor: "From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs. This is a core principle of communist society, and a foundational principle for our fledgling state. We stand as a shining example of what humanity can achieve by working together for the common good."

options.name: On such foundations is socialism built.

events.title: Our Revolution

events.desc: … of the … is rapidly gaining popularity among the people. The radical socialist message of equality … espouses is proving especially appealing to the lower classes.
events.flavor: "Comrades, the time for action is now! Why should we toil in squalor while the boss grows rich and fat off of our labor? Why should the meager pennies we earn go to the greedy landlord who tells us we should be grateful for our miserable shacks?"

options.name: Inspirational!
Radical!

events.title: Socialist Demagogue

events.desc: … has reorganized the … into the … Red Army. The military is now devoted to defending the dictatorship of the proletariat.
events.flavor: The international revolution will not be won through the jabbering of politicians, it will be won through force of arms. All the bourgeoisie of the world are assembled against us, the enemies of the proletariat are omnipresent. The Red Army is the only force standing between survival and annihilation.

options.name: For the motherland!

events.title: The Red Army

events.desc: The workers of … are running a successful cooperative in the …. They live happy, productive, and prosperous lives.
events.flavor: In a worker cooperative, the means of production are owned by the workers themselves. The workplace is democratic, self-managed, and collectively owned by its members. All share in the profits, so workers are highly invested in the success of the business. The good of one is the good of all.

options.name: A happy worker is a loyal worker.
… is a wonderful place to live.

events.title: The Means of Production

events.desc: As our industries have grown more and more crucial to the future of the … nation, so too has the working class. Disparate workers' movements have begun to unite under the cause for socialism.
events.flavor: "...the development of Modern Industry, therefore, cuts from under its feet the very foundation on which the bourgeoisie produces and appropriates products. What the bourgeoisie therefore produces, above all, are its own grave-diggers. Its fall and the victory of the proletariat are equally inevitable."

options.name: A storm approaches.
The world will be free, one day.

events.title: Oppressor and Oppressed

events.desc: Whether through the trust of our people or the truncheons of our soldiers, … has emerged unbroken from the wave of socialist agitation that threatened it.
events.flavor: They still saw the pamphlets, sometimes - decayed paper corpses, trapped in the gutters, caked in soot and mud, bold red and black ink abraded by rough stones and rougher footsteps. The police had not bothered to pick them up, viewing them as an affront to their gloves - or, perhaps, realizing that their fallen remnants made more of a statement than their complete disappearance.

options.name: A triumph for all of ….
Things will never be the same again.

events.title: Firebreak
