events.flavor: "Between you and me, there are far too many high-minded idealists involved in this. They find something noble in giving up their own influence, spreading it to the masses like alms to the poor. Perhaps they think it will save their souls, or their legacies. I am more practically inclined. I'm concerned with the immediate future of myself and my friends. I can count you among those. Can't I?"

options.name: They must be ousted from their positions if they try to stop the new law!
Perhaps we can collaborate with them in the creation of the new system.

events.title: The Old Authority

events.desc: Proponents of the … reform have called attention to past abuses of power by the current regime as a reason for why this change is urgently needed.
events.flavor: "Well, I barely remember it myself. It was a different time. Things like that simply happened, and I never expected to be interrogated about them. That's not to say it went unquestioned, but there are always complainers. You couldn't listen to them if you wanted to get things done. Of course, this was all with the …'s approval. Not officially, but I think you should know. That stays between us."

options.name: Power corrupts, which is why the powerful must be held to account by the voters.
The past is in the past. These issues have nothing to do with the reform.

events.title: Sins of the Past

events.desc: Proponents of … have argued that the ongoing reform to … is an insufficient compromise, excluding many people from their right to participate in democracy.
events.flavor: "'…'. Just the sound of it! As if that would mean we cast of the yoke of oppression, rather than shifting its burden. How are we supposed to rally in solidarity behind this reform when it still leaves so many without access to the franchise? As usual, they are expected to be glad that anything is happening at all. To have no expectations at all for their own lives. That is no way to treat a human being."

options.name: We should focus on our current reform, which is a clear improvement.
… is a stepping stone on the road to …!

events.title: Democracy Without the People

events.desc: Implementing a proper voting system for the upcoming … elections has put a strain on the … government's administrative capacities.
events.flavor: "Once we have the whole infrastructure in place, it will be much easier. We need to prove that we can do this. People need to be able to trust that their votes are properly collected and counted, or they will quickly dismiss the elections as a sham. The people are watching. Other nations are watching. We can't afford to take shortcuts."

options.name: We will use resources from other administrative branches, if necessary.
We will simply have to take our time.

events.title: The Paperwork of Elections

events.desc: Meeting at a secret location, a group of revolutionaries known as the Trinitaria has announced their intentions to liberate … from … mismanagement.
events.flavor:
"We are convinced that there is no possible merger between Dominicans and Haitians. We are and will be two different peoples. Our destiny is to be independent, absolutely independent.

Our society will be called La Trinitaria because it will be made up of groups of three and we will place it under the protection of the Holy Trinity.

Our motto: God, Country and Freedom."

— Juan Pablo Duarte, Excerpt from the first meeting of the Trinitarios

options.name: I want these traitors found, and I want them hanged. Now!
Increase the funding of our eastern departments.

rewards.name: Expanding the Cibao and Ozama Departments

events.title: The Oath

events.desc: Catching the … garrison completely by surprise, a group of revolutionaries have stormed Santo Domingo's main fortress and raised the … flag over its battlements, signalling the start of open hostilities against ….
events.flavor:
In the shadow of Santo Domingo's great fortress, the conspirators waited. Far fewer than those who had solemnly pledged their name to the cause days prior, and far less boisterous now. Suddenly, a runner stumbled in, breathless: "I think we have been discovered," he says, "a patrol has chased me, and I had to make a long detour just to get here."

Panic gripped them, but as the group looked like it might dissolve, a firm "No!" from Mella interrupted them. "There is no time to go back: we will have to be free or we shall die." Lifting his blunderbuss into the air he let out a loud cry: "Long live the Dominican Republic!" and pulled the trigger.

options.name: Are we blind? Deploy the army!
For God, Country and Freedom!

events.title: Rebels Seize the Puerta del Conde

events.desc: Our integration efforts have borne fruit, and the once-powerful 'Trinitarian' revolutionaries in … have lost most of their support base. The island is whole at last.
events.flavor:
To dominate a people is one thing, the aging general thought to himself. To win their hearts is another.

He had been able to do the former quite well. The fear of his fusillades had kept many an ansipiring rebel at home. But he had to admit he latter had always escaped him – a fact which … … was all too keen to remind him of.

As his battallion left the cantonment, ostensibly for the last time, he couldn't help but feel a pang of bitterness. The civilians may claim the glory of the peace as their own, but they owe their operational latitude to his methods.

options.name: Extend an olive branch to those willing to grasp it.
We must ensure nothing like it can emerge again.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status

events.title: Unity, Not Trinity

events.desc: … is free from Haitian tyranny at last, yet threats lurk around every corner. It may be wise to request the protection of a great power.
events.flavor:
"Does the gentleman from La Vega really suggest that we sell our hard-fought liberty this easily? Is the blood of our martyrs really worth less than a bottle of cheap wine?"

"Better the master we know and choose to the one that imposes himself by force. I venerate the sacrifices of our martyrs as much as you, sir. I would just ensure that our sons and daughters does not have to make the same ones."

options.name: Our independence is absolute, it cannot be compromised.
We shall become a Captaincy General of … once again.
The might of … will safeguard us.
The … will protect us.

events.title: Liberty and Security

events.flavor: "I am but a humble instrument of the Dominican people, sir. Every soul on that island yearns for the benevolent touch of …. There just remains the small issue of my status in the new administration."

options.name: Accept the … proposal.
Turn them down. This would just mean trouble.

events.title: Santo Domingo Requests Protection

events.desc: The … reports that a group of rascal academics have disguised themselves as visiting members of the … royal family. Officers at the … … believed the deception and offered them a tour of the fleet. The incident has caused great embarrassment to the ….
events.flavor: "The officers present welcomed the hoaxers with an honor guard and, lacking any knowledge of … customs or fashions, they were unable to see through the disguise and raised the … flag by mistake. The hoaxers then proceeded to speak in gibberish and perform fabricated … ceremonies to bless the fleet."

options.name: Arrest them at once!
Bunga bunga.

events.title: The Battleship Hoax

events.desc: Accused of disclosing classified military information to the … ambassador in …, the … officer … has been judged guilty of treason by the …, based off a handwriting analysis and the contents of a secret dossier.
events.flavor:
"Messieurs, I present the intercepted bordereau, addressed directly to the … ambassador. While the letter's handwriting is no "clear" match to that of M. …, no spy would ever compose a clandestine letter using their own hand.

The accused must, no doubt, have imitated or traced his own handwriting, leaving in it enough of its natural character for his correspondent to recognize it, but introducing into it, for greater safety, alterations borrowed from the hands of his brother and his sister-in-law, in one of whose writings I have discovered the very same double-s as seen in the bordereau!"

options.name: Cashier him, then ship the man off to Devil's Isle.
Treason? If only we still had the death penalty.
Autoforgery? Secret dossiers? Order a discreet inquiry.

events.title: … Convicted of Treason

events.desc: Insisting that … has been falsely convicted, his supporters have identified … as the likely culprit. … however, has now been acquitted by the … in a closed-door trial—subsequently shaving his mustache and fleeing the country.
events.flavor:
"In summary: Not only did we intercept a letter from the military attache addressed directly to Esterhazy, not only does his handwriting fit the bordereau much better than …'s, and not only is he neck-high in debt. But the man admit his contempt for France and her army in writ! Honorable Generals, do you truly not see what I see?"

"M. Capitaine, we see only a man overstepping his bounds.
The true culprit has already been caught, … treacherous nature exposed for all to see. Consider this a closed matter."

options.name: Highly suspicious.
Surely the … knows what they're doing.

events.title: The … Trial

events.desc: A scathing newspaper opinion has been published in the newspaper L'Aurore by …, accusing the French government and … of antisemitism and the unlawful conviction of ….
events.flavor:
"I accuse the three handwriting experts of having made false and fraudulent reports, unless a medical examination declares them suffering from vision and judgment disease.

I accuse the war offices of having carried out in the press an abominable campaign, to mislead public opinion and cover up their fault.

Finally, I accuse the first council of war of having violated the law, by condemning an accused with unrevealed evidence,

and I accuse the second council of war of having covered this illegality, by order, by committing in turn the legal crime of knowingly acquitting a culprit."

options.name: A spark lit. Now comes the blaze.
The truth is on the march, and nothing shall stop it.

events.title: J'accuse...!

events.desc: Servants at the home of the …ard vanguard … found their employer dead in … bedroom. A tragedy, wept one. Assassination, cried another. Natural causes, a third hoped. Whether one or the other, a blow against …'s case.
events.flavor:
The coroner confirmed that afternoon that no foul-play was involved. A special investigation was conducted upon the request of the surviving family. Monoxide poisoning was the culprit, from an improperly swept chimney.

Yet, rumors persist: skulduggery and assassination abound, strangely without anyone eager to claim the kill.

options.name: A tragedy.
Offer a state funeral.
Allow the rumors to persist. There may be truth to them.

events.title: At-home Asphyxiation

events.desc: Furious with what … considers the defamation of the …'s good name and reputation, … has charged the author of "J'Accuse...!", …, with criminal libel, demanding the … be jailed for … insolence.
events.flavor: Shouts of fury, indignance, triumph and loss drowned the judge's drones. His detractors said that a harsher punishment was due. His supporters cried martyrdom, same as they had done in Dreyfus. A scandal besmirching France, from one; a pity he wasn't around for a noose, from another. The one thing they all agreed on: Émile Zola had the wrong punishment.

options.name: The court rules: Guilty on all charges.
Guilty, but only a fine will be levied.
Not guilty. Freedom of expression is sacrosanct.

events.title: … Accused of Libel

events.desc: A well-to-do socialite associated with the … has recently produced a parlor game titled "The … Affair and the Truth", further promoting the idea that … was unlawfully convicted among … high society.
events.flavor:
"So how do I win?"
"Well, you see that naked lady at the end of the trail, climbing out that well? That's Truth. You move your piece towards it, through the broken law tablets, letters, landmarks, and newspapers."
"I see. And that broom, and those hideous masks?"
"Masks of prejudice, my friend. Swept into the dust bin of history where they belong."
"So why does one of them look like my dear mother?"
"I see your glass is empty, friend. Let me be of assistance."

options.name: It is only a game, why do you have to be mad?
That smells of libel. Throw the book at them.

events.title: …ard Board Game Spreads

events.desc: Spurred on by a particularly inflamatory opinion piece in the …-affiliated newspaper the … …, large crowds have taken to the streets, burning effigies of … and shouting anti-… slogans.
events.flavor:
"There they go again, screeching "Long live the Army" and "Down with the Jews" from the top of their lungs. Tonight comes the fires, tomorrow the clean-up. Same old song."

"All this trouble for one Jewish soul? I'm starting to think it would be better if we leave that man in jail, guilty or not."

options.name: The voice of the people is the voice of God.
Try to contain this hysteria.
Let the flics have a go at these brutes.

events.title: Anti-…ard Riot in …

options.name: In the end, truth always prevails.
A triumph for the forces of the Enlightenment.
It seems the Dreyfusian Spectre will haunt us for some time more.
An unsatisfying end, to an unsatisfying affair.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: It seems the march of "truth" has come to an abrupt halt.
A triumph for the forces of tradition.

events.desc: In an interview with a local journalist, …, now living in exile in …, and suspected by many of being the real culprit of the … Affair, has apparently admitted … guilt, confessing that he was the bordereau's true author.
events.flavor:
"I wrote the bordereau at the request of Colonel Sandherr, who died today. It is unfortunate that Colonel Sandherr died, as he knew the fact. But nevertheless, it is possible for me to prove that it was I who wrote the slip, despite the disappearance of this witness.

The bordereau was to be used to materially prove the guilt of …, the intelligence office having been able to collect against … only moral proofs. It was known, however, through the French spy service, that the … General Staff was in possession of documents that only … could communicate to it."

options.name: A light upon the … case, indeed.
Nothing but … lies, meant to sow discord.
This affair is larger than "truth" now. Heed not this confession.

events.title: … Admits Guilt in Interview.

events.desc: The great Indian Subcontinent has been brought completely under … rule. Those native forces which once threatened the security of our rule have been brought to heel.
events.flavor: "Colonial rule is held together by the collaboration of the Company and the Indian Princes. Over decades we have seduced the Indians with promises of wealth and prestige, of military ranks and noble titles. Their service has been rewarded, and by winning their favor the subcontinent is pacified."

options.name: Loyal princes will keep the peace.
Capital will cement our rule.

events.title: A Solid Frontier

events.desc: The economy of the Indies has been transformed under our diligent rule. With slavery and feudalism abolished, our vast territories are ripe for exploitation through private enterprise.
events.flavor: "Famines, uprisings, and epidemics have been a staple of life under … rule. But we are resolved to change that; we have liberated the peasants from their quotas so that they are not forced to hand over the meager handful of rice they need to feed their families. By replacing these harsh regulations with private employment we are sure that the wealth will trickle down to the locals."

options.name: Investors are beginning to show interest.
We should make greater use of local labor.

events.title: Reforming the Indies

events.desc: The … has superseded the old colonialism. The people under our rule now enjoy a high standard of living and have access to a solid education.
events.flavor: "Fifty years ago such a policy would have been unthinkable. Colonial administrators were concerned only with what they could extract, typically through coercion, from the wretches with the misfortune to live within colonial borders. We can proudly say that we have done better, that we have enacted an ethical policy of rule."

options.name: We should teach them good … values.
This is a land of opportunity.
Are we not merciful?

events.title: The Ethical Policy

events.flavor:
The youngest vizier, İsmail, shook as he spoke, his head bowed: "It can no longer be denied that unrest brews in our once-great empire. Secessionist supporters can supposedly be found in every coffee house in …."

The other viziers nodded, unperturbed. The eldest spoke. "We must press forward with our agenda, even if the … does not share our view. Our families' lives are at stake."

options.name: Carefully monitor the situation as it develops.

events.title: A Developing Crisis

events.desc: With strong Rumelian Integrity, … has contained a burgeoning crisis in the ….
events.flavor:
The viziers gathered in the coffeehouse. The youngest remarked, "This is exactly the sort of place we would have found separatists. Is it wise to celebrate in the lion's den?" 

"İsmail, you worry too much," spoke the eldest. "There are still lions out there, for certain, but the crisis has passed. Now, you see, we know where to lay the traps."

 "Nevertheless," İsmail muttered. "Perhaps there were circumstances in which it was loyal to rebel..."

options.name: … rule is not to be trifled with.

events.title: A Crisis Contained

events.desc: The once-great … was unable to contain the burgeoning unrest in the …. Unrest may continue to grow.
events.flavor:
İsmail was still shaking as he led the other viziers through the hookah smoke to the room at the back of the coffeehouse. 

"What has gotten you so afraid, young pup?" The eldest laughed. "I know our empire seems to have fallen on hard times, but it has lasted centuries, and will for…" The vizier trailed off as broad figures stepped out of the smokey corners. 

İsmail bolted the door. "There are those who disagree, pasha, and they insisted on meeting you."

options.name: This failure threatens the future of … rule.

events.title: A Crisis Unchecked

events.desc: The efforts of … to expand their influence in the Balkan region have alarmed the …. They have proposed a pre-empetive action against the … to prevent … from securing influence over ….
events.flavor:
"Allow me to make a proposition," … began.

… had cornered the General in a … restaurant, promised to cover the bill in return for half an hour of his time. The General set down his glass of the most expensive wine on the menu, and nodded.

"It pertains to the …, and their present endeavor. I presume you have been keeping an eye on the papers, and know of the precarious situation of the Slavs, and the aggressive rhetoric of the … in this regard..."

options.name: We will shoulder the burden of civilizing ….
This proposal tastes of war.

events.title: Moving the Frontier

events.flavor:
"I would recommend the following," said the Minister. "For our initial assessment, … in …, … in …, and … in …. We will dispatch administrative task forces on the basis of each region's particular deficiences."

…, sitting in the first row, raised a hand. "I have not yet had the Army's reports delivered. What may we expect?"

"A resentful populace, and officials fixated upon tax-farming. Dismiss as many as you need. The Turks have never secured a reputation for good governance."

options.name: Occupy the territory, and reorganize its administration.
Annex … as an integral part of our Empire.
Absorb … into our Empire under the auspices of the joint Finance Ministry.
Annex … as a component of ….

events.title: The Occupation Government

events.flavor:
The sounds of a brass band played as the newly-raised … regiments embarked upon their march. How interesting it was, thought …, that the new … uniforms looked near-identical to … own. Green-blue fabric, red piping. Endearing, in the way of a child imitating his father.

… mission, however, required more than endearment. One day, these soldiers may need to march in the name of … own country's interests. … would need an assurance from the …. There was military cooperation to arrange, Ottoman files to lay claim to. For each hour's joy, a day's business.

options.name: Offer … … our congratulations, and an embassy.
There is more opportunity further afield.
Offer … … our congratulations, and an embassy.
Perhaps an extended stay is in order.

events.title: Eastern Question Russia 1

events.desc: The central economic office has declared that our efforts to bring economic matters under government control has resulted in surprisingly positive growth.
events.flavor:
The man nervously adjusted his glasses. "Frankly, I'm amazed," he admitted. "I've run the numbers twice and had three clerks down in the office check my work, and wouldn't you know it? We're ahead of schedule and above our projected rates! Why, I think I might celebrate!"

He reached for his bowtie, and after a moment's fumbling, took it off. "Look out, world, I'm cutting loose tonight!" he gleefully cried.

options.name: Excellent! Proceed with the legislation.
Excellent! Let's support the clerks who made this possible.

events.title: Growth Exceeds Projections

events.desc: A faction of the government is objecting to the pace and approach to our changing economic policy, and wishes to discuss and revise our current agenda.
events.flavor: "While I know some accuse me of oppositionist tendencies, I can assure everyone gathered here that I am a loyal man of the party. All I am saying, friends, is that we need to consider whether our policy has matured enough to discard the outmoded social-economic system entirely."

options.name: Let party members debate the issue.
Push our stance at party conferences.
Have a little chat with our opponents.

events.title: Party Disputes

events.desc: Our efforts to push our reform of the economy through has caused shortages and mismanagement in ….
events.flavor: "It is a fact that we have overfulfilled our planned reform of the economy, and our friends among the … have become dizzy with success and for the moment have lost clearness of mind and sobriety of vision."

options.name: We must own our mistakes.
We have no failures, only successes!

events.title: Dizzy With Success

events.desc: An orator from the … has gone on a speaking tour across the nation, denouncing … and praising the value of Free Trade.
events.flavor: "When we consider that the theory of our great system guarantees to everyone the full enjoyment of all the fruits of their industry and enterprise, it is clear that anything other than the free flow of goods is an indefensible extortion and culpable betrayal of our values."

options.name: We work towards a common goal!
The … has a truly remarkable speaker among them.

events.title: Indefensible Extortion

events.desc: Opponents of our planned economic reforms have demanded the right to have their ideas heard as much as our own, and, gallingly, are using our Free Market rhetoric to justify their own right to speak.
events.flavor: "All we're asking is for free trade... of ideas."

options.name: We want free markets, not loose talk!
Competition is necessary, even in ideas.
In a free encounter, truth prevails!

events.title: The Marketplace of Ideas

events.desc: Competing goods from abroad have led to a slump in demand for products from …, which has raised concerns in the state about our planned reforms.
events.flavor: "Free foreign trade gives our money, and our markets to others, injuring our labor, our industry, and our people. What good are these policies if they do not benefit us?"

options.name: We must alleviate concerns in ….
We must try to convince … the merit of our reforms.
We must forge ahead with our plans regardless.

events.title: Industry Suffers in …

events.desc: The teachers of our higher institutions of learning have offered to advise the government in the implementation of the new ….
events.flavor: "There are certainly differences between teaching children the fundamentals and the more advanced education offered at our universities. Nevertheless, as architects of the upper floors of this towering structure of knowledge, we believe the least we can do is provide some insight into how the foundation should be built."

options.name: We'll be happy to have their help!
Their research work is more important.
They could be of help in finalizing the bill.

events.title: Academic Assistance

events.desc: The role of discipline in the new … has been raised by the … as an area of improvement in the plans for this new education system.
events.flavor: "This is not merely about keeping an orderly classroom so that knowledge can be imparted; it is about imparting character. After all, we have been given an enormous responsibility by the parents of these children, who do all they can to raise them as upstanding citizens. Too often, we find boys joining the military service whose character has already been almost irrevocably ruined by an unruly youth and a lack of respect for authority. It needn't be so!"

options.name: We should focus on the curriculum.
Working this into the school system is paramount.

events.title: Discipline and Punish

events.desc: Disagreements within the government about what should be taught in the new … have brought implementation of the reform to a standstill.
events.flavor:
"These classes may have been well suited for the tutoring of noblemen two centuries ago, but believing they would serve a broader range of students well in this day and age is outright lunacy!"
"And you mean to say your 'modern' alternatives would serve them better? You would have the classical subjects phased out in favor of ignorance and poor grammar?"

options.name: Force a compromise.
Take some time to work out the differences.
Rearrange the law to create an independent body for this.

events.title: Curriculum Disagreements

events.desc: Parents who have experience teaching children at home are offering to assist as teachers in rural areas to facilitate the new … system.
events.flavor: "Ask any of my neighbors and they will vouch for what I've done for the community, despite lack of formal qualifications! Any kids around here who already know how to read or write, I taught. For me, it is a greater source of pride than anything I made with my hands."

options.name: It is fortunate we already have educated people!
We must not let this distract from other work.

events.title: Extra Teachers

events.desc: Debate over whether the new … should have separate classes for male and female students, and perhaps different curricula as well, is causing disagreements over how to implement the new education system.
events.flavor: "Would anyone question the innate differences in disposition between the sexes, or their divinely ordained roles in our society? How could we expect to raise proper ladies and gentlemen if we make no such distinction in their education?"

options.name: Such ideas are relics of a past age.
We should work out two separate branches.

events.title: Boys and Girls

events.desc: The … have traditionally taken on some responsibility for the education in …. As the new system of … is built, the question of their role in organizing these schools has become central to the reform.
events.flavor: "The state would still be the highest authority on the priorities of the schools, of course, but there are many administrative duties to take care of on the local level. In any case, … texts are already part of the study plan, are they not?"

options.name: The organizational responsibility should be on the ….
We need to build a secular school system from the ground up.

events.title: School Organization

events.desc:
Egypt seized most of our Levantine provinces in 1833 after its governor tried and failed to overthrow the entire imperial government. The time to reclaim the lands we lost in that war is long overdue.

However, this is likely to draw the attention of any Great Powers in Europe.
events.flavor:
"What once was ours shall be ours again. The imprint we've left on Egypt and the Levant cannot be ignored. Like the lines that time carves on a mountain, we have also carved our fate on their land with the footprints of our ancestors.

Go, go now, children of the Sun!"

options.name: We must see to it that they are on our side.
We do not need their approval to take what is ours.

events.title: Reasserting Our Authority in Syria

events.desc: The Ottomans have begun their machinations to retake the lands we won from them in 1833. This is a violation of our sovereignty! However, this is likely to draw the attention of any Great Powers in Europe, giving us a chance to gain powerful allies in the conflict.
events.flavor: "I believe the Sultan and I have some unfinished business to attend to."

options.name: We must resist this aggression!

events.title: The Turkish Incursion

events.desc: The Ottoman Empire's attempt to take back control of the Levant from Egypt has become an international incident. Our involvement may tip the balance of power in the region.
events.flavor: At thirty minutes past midday came the messenger with a single, wax-sealed envelope. Chill winds followed in his stumbling, breathless gait. Every other general and advisor gathered around the … cried for decorum. The messenger brought it forward, with a choking gasp about its origin: Egypt. The Ottomans were coming for Egypt.

options.name: We need to keep an eye on the region.
We have no interest in this crisis.

events.title: The Egyptian-Ottoman Crisis

events.desc: The …'s endorsement of … has come under attack by the … campaign, arguing that a leader who rejects religion can not be trusted to keep promises or maintain a sound moral compass.
events.flavor: "Upon what does such a … swear? What punishment does … expect for breaking … word in secret? It appears the …, in their pursuit of liberty, have forgotten the virtues needed to hold the free accountable."

options.name: Those so poor in spirit cannot lead ….
Perhaps … sees things clearer unfettered by religious dogma.

events.title: Faithless Leaders

events.desc: In the light of the Devastation suffered by states like …, the … has campaigned on uniting … in this trying time behind traditional values.
events.flavor: "Our nation lies in ruins, but … has risen from ashes before and will do so again, as long as we do not forget who we are. This is not the time for radicalism or recklessness. This is the time for healing. We must look to what has made us persevere in the past and safeguard it from those who would see it destroyed. Until we have rebuilt, until we have healed, it is all we have!"

options.name: We must come together during this difficult time.
This seems like cold-hearted opportunism.

events.title: Unity in Tradition

events.desc: Pointing to the rampant Turmoil from radical activities in …, the … has campaigned on the platform of more policing.
events.flavor: "People seem to think the flimsiest of political pretexts can be used to justify the chaos we see in …. If they have not thought of a pretext yet, our opponents are more than happy to provide them with it. We will not! We must send a strong message to those who would make a mockery of … law that they can not escape justice."

options.name: This wound has been allowed to fester for too long.
The key to preventing crime is to prevent poverty.

events.title: Law and Order

events.desc: Our neighbors in … have become known for their ruthless foreign policy, a concern that the … has raised in their election campaign, promising to be harsher in turn to deter aggression.
events.flavor: "The suggestion has been brought to me that our diplomats study more languages to facilitate connections around the world. That is all well and good, but we all know there is only one language a … brute understands. They don't teach it in universities, but we better be ready to speak it if we want the border to stay where it is!"

options.name: The … menace must be deterred!
They are just looking for a target for their posturing.

events.title: The Best Defense

events.desc: With the price of … soaring across the country, the … is finding itself under relentless pressure from the opposition—accused of recklessly toying with the welfare of its citizens.
events.flavor: "High price of …? Humbug! In my youth we would make do with even less than what you have now, for double the labor! These 'outrageous' food prices are nothing more than the musings of hysterical housewives!"

options.name: They will just have to eat something else then!
Fund soup kitchens. A man with a full belly makes fewer mistakes.

events.title: Bread, Butter, Ballot

events.desc: Claims that the …'s policy of extensive money loaning has saddled future generations with an undue burden have caused the party to leak voters like a faulty sieve.
events.flavor: "Blessed are the young, for they shall inherit the national debt."

options.name: Loans are a cornerstone of any healthy economy!
Find a scapegoat, the public demands a sacrifice.

events.title: Swindling Futurity

events.desc: …, renowned pacifist and leader of the …, has launched a scathing attack on the sitting …, claiming that … troops engaged in the … War have committed grave atrocities under their watch.
events.flavor:
"We... I received orders to round up hostages, sir. Old faces, young faces—some not older than my own son. So-called free shooters had been harassing our lines. 'Murderers' my commander called them. 'Highwaymen' with malice in their hearts and rifles in their hands. The hostages were meant to deter them!

But after the third soldier fell that evening, the commander told me to take the hostages... he told me to take them into the barn... and... Lord, forgive me."

options.name: Our troops did what!? To whom!?
Interesting take. Let us censor it.
Interesting take. Let us censor it.

events.title: Pacifist Condemns the War

events.desc: The aged …, leader of the …, has unexpectedly expired mid-campaign—robbing the … of a cornerstone politician. The question of … replacement is now on everyone's lips.
events.flavor: "Unexpected? Bah! That old bag of bones was long overdue to meet … maker. It's about time that party saw some new blood!"

options.name: Go with the popular, but inept candidate.
The determined, but haughty youngster secures the chair.

events.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has been loudly accusing the … of misrule, given the country's low standard of living—claiming that only the … has the willpower to set things right.
events.flavor:
"On my way here today I witnessed scenes so bleak they almost defy description. I saw once-venerable soldiers growling for scraps in the mud —I saw desperate families crammed together on dusty tenement streets —I saw malnutrition, poverty, and despair.

Fellow citizens, this is the legacy of the …."

options.name: Why are we to blame? Have they tried being less poor?
Just a few bad eggs in the administration, nothing more.

events.title: A Land of Want

events.desc: The country's high standard of living has resulted in a widespread sense of contentment with the status quo, favoring … and the sitting … in the ongoing elections.
events.flavor: "Change? Why would I want change? I've got a full belly, a happy wife, and a good job. Why would I squander that chasing what might be?"

options.name: If it is not broken, why fix it?
Laud …'s achievements.

events.title: A Land of Plenty

events.desc: With the … war going well, the country is swept up in a frenzy of war. The sitting … has issued letters of endorsement to parliamentary candidates they feel support the war effort, drawing patriotic voters toward their cause.
events.flavor: "… didn't get the letter, huh? Go figure that coward's some spineless, good-for-nothing pacifist. Our boys are out there dying, and what does … do? Sits around shuffling stacks of paper, waiting for the opportune moment to squander the gains we paid for in blood. Nah, our men needs somebody who fights for them, as they fight for us."

options.name: Rally around the part... I mean flag!

rewards.name: Dove of Peace in Time of War

options.name: Are you for us, or for our adversaries?

rewards.name: Dove of Peace in Time of War

events.title: Coalition Coupons

events.desc: The …'s anti-alcohol policy is hurting their electoral prospects, as scores of thirsty voters flock to the …—hoping that a change in government will see an end to the country's temperance policies.
events.flavor: "Resist temptation? I'll tell you what tempts me: shoving this boot here up you moralizing teetotalers' you-know-wheres. I want a drink; I'll have a drink, and if you shan't let me I'll go to those that will."

options.name: No beer, no vote!
Run a smear campaign against these immoral bacchanalians.

events.title: A Torrent of Gin and Beer

events.desc: The ongoing election has drawn attention to the platforms of the various contending parties. Across …, the electorate debates which party is worth trusting with the next term in government.
events.flavor:
"The first thing I take into account is the safety of my investments. If a party would represent chaos, I may safely discount it."

The stockbroker tapped his cigar on the rim of the ashtray, and continued. The journalist took notes as he spoke.

"How will the incoming government's tariff policy affect my needed imports? Do they wish to impose taxes which may spur uncertainty? Do they wish to embark upon military adventures? Would these adventures be profitable, or would they be ruinous? There is much to consider."

options.name: The … makes decisive arguments.
The electorate trusts the …'s policy.
The …'s policies have merit.
The best arguments belong to the ….

events.title: Pressing Issues

events.desc: The eyes of the electorate have turned to the candidates that seek to acquire a position at the head of government. As the election approaches, voters debate who would provide the best leadership for ….
events.flavor:
"I quite like …," mused one of the men at the bar. "I couldn't say what it is I agree with … on, but I think … has a good head on … shoulders."

His neighbor spoke up, "Enough to look past the company he keeps?"

"Why not? … knows you could say the same about any of us. Nobody's better to handle a fool than his friend."

options.name: … is the … of the hour.
A term of … is what the country needs.
… has the character for the job.
… is worth hearing out.

events.title: The Popularity Contest

events.desc: In their campaign for the upcoming election, the … have directed criticism at the … for allowing … among their ranks, pointing to … far-right views as an example of the party accommodating extremists.
events.flavor: "They call themselves conservatives, in itself a void of values and ideals, but something even worse has grown within that void. Among their ranks there are those who would not only stand in the way of our country changing, but would want to shape its future to their own delusional ideas of a past that never existed—prepared to use any methods to achieve it. Do not cast your vote lightly, unless you want to take the first step on the road to war and genocide."

options.name: Far from the traditional … values they claim.
… is simply a dedicated patriot!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: An Extreme Reaction

events.desc: The anarchist political group …'s rise to prominence has been invoked in the … election campaign, casting themselves as the more reasonable alternative.
events.flavor: "The people want freedom, but from what? From laws, from governance, from organized society itself? Of course not; merely from unnecessary laws, bad governance and byzantine bureaucracy. Too many governments allow themselves to grow their excesses unchecked, like trees reaching their sprawling branches into every home and pocket until the people arrive with torches to burn them down. All this can be avoided with sensible pruning."

options.name: True liberty takes time.
A corrupt system cannot be reformed; it must be overthrown.

events.title: Liberty Without Anarchy

events.desc: …, a well-known pacifist, has campaigned for the … in the upcoming election on a platform of a more peaceful foreign policy than the warmongering … has become known for.
events.flavor: "When I go abroad, people tell me, '…, it's hopeless. The … are used to getting their way with violence and threats. Such people will never change.' I tell them the … people love peace, as do the people of all nations. That is why leaders use force and deceit to make them go to war. No more! The people will be heard and their reputation will be restored. If we can reclaim peace here, the whole world can!"

options.name: We are a peaceful nation now.
Our enemies should not stop fearing us, today or ever.

events.title: A Gentler …

events.desc: The high prices on … have become a prominent talking point in the … election campaign, arguing that their free trade policies would drive down the price.
events.flavor: "Don't be fooled! Trade restrictions are not called protectionism because they protect you. They protect a select few profiteers, not from starvation or poverty, but from competition. They protect them from the world! They'd have you think you are safer with a … boot on your neck than you would be free. It's time to stop protecting them."

options.name: This is the age of the global market!
Our current policies are needed to keep the economy stable.

events.title: Open Markets

events.desc: The rise of far-left and far-right political parties in … has led … to portray themselves as the voice of reason in the upcoming election, a moderate centrist alternative to extremism.
events.flavor: "Hearing some of the rhetoric used by my opponents, you would think they'd rather not have an election at all! For all their idealism, they hardly seem like they can wait to start spilling blood. What utopias can such hatred build? A road to heaven, paved with bad intentions."

options.name: A sensible and stable option for voters.
On the contrary, … politics could use some shaking up!

events.title: … of Conscience

events.desc: The rise of communism in powerful countries like … has become a talking point in the … election campaign, warning against a similar homegrown movement.
events.flavor: "It is no secret that the communists seek an international revolution. The … regime may topple any day now, but that does not mean we can take the threat of another government falling lightly. Whether they call themselves democratic socialists, or syndicalists, or any of these other products of leftist factionalism, they are all a threat to … values."

options.name: … streets will not run red, with blood or otherwise!
The international worker's movement cannot be stopped by parliamentarians.

events.title: The Red Menace

events.desc: …, a prominent member of the …, has been accused of gross corruption. … strenuously denied all allegations until damning letters surfaced signed by ….
events.flavor: "Yes, yes, I am willing to discuss the contents of these letters with the committee, if only I am given time to study the content of these letters in my personal chambers first. Of course, on my honor, I will not alter or destroy any of the evidence. Honest."

options.name: … should stand by … and deny everything.
… should be isolated to protect the rest of the ….
There are allies in the … who can speak in …'s defense.

events.title: Kindly Burn This Letter

events.desc: … … has made public statements in support of …, bringing into question the political neutrality of the military.
events.flavor: "It is my duty to defend the nation and its interests. Politics is as much a part of war as battles and logistics are—I don't see the problem with doing my duty and doing what I can to make sure those who are best fit to protect the nation end up being the ones in charge."

options.name: … can say what … wants.
Reprimand …—good soldiers don't give orders, they take them!
If … likes politics so much, … ought to get more involved.

events.title: Commander Commends Civic Coalition

events.desc: … intends to travel across … by train to campaign for the ….
events.flavor: "All I intend to do is present myself to the people—I'm just a simple … trying to get our party's message out by the best means available."

options.name: Campaigning by rail is a smart move.
It'd be a shame if that campaign train kept suffering delays.
The fate of the nation depends on that train running on time!

events.title: Whistle-Stop Tour

events.desc: The government's friendly relationship with …, an infamous country with a horrible reputation, has been the subject of sharp criticism and strong rhetoric from leading opposition candidates.
events.flavor: "To think that the name of …, not due to any real necessity, but purely from cynical diplomatic gestures, should be associated with ghastly crimes such as those perpetrated by …! I tell you now, we must pursue a new foreign policy, an ethical foreign policy! What good is all this if we cannot look at ourselves in the mirror without shame?"

options.name: Perhaps the speaker from … has a point.
If the government distances itself from …, the …'s argument will be undercut.

events.title: The … Campaign

events.desc: Supporters of … have gone beyond simply campaigning for their own party, harassing and sometimes physically attacking opposing partisans.
events.flavor: "I'm a simple party man, that's all. I know who I like, and I know who I don't like, and I know I want my people to win and their people to lose."

options.name: Crack down on … activities.
Let the … partisans continue unmolested.
Why should they limit who they target? Go forth and fight the good fight!

events.title: Overly-Enthusiastic Partisans

events.desc: Party-affiliated newspapers have been proliferating during this election season. Publications associated with the … have been particularly effective in spreading the party line.
events.flavor: "Read all about it! Honest politicians attacked by shameless cowards! Leading candidate for office issues heartwarming appeal to the common man's heart! Man on campaign trail pets a puppy! Read all about it!"

options.name: The … has used the papers brilliantly.
Newspaper circulation is through the roof! This is a boom for publishers.
It is in the State's interest to promote the truth.
It is in the State's interest to limit the spread of lies.

events.title: Partisan Papers

events.desc: Parties, particularly the …, are struggling to raise enough funds for all their campaigning needs this election.
events.flavor:
"Let's see what you men are charging... fees, yes, that's to the be expected, but what's this lodging charge? That fancy hotel room could house half a village! And there's enough … billed here to drown a fish!"

"Votes don't come cheap, sir. You do want to win, right?"

options.name: Some money can be spared for the ….
Every party can be provided with basic funding this election cycle.
If a party can't afford a campaign, should it be campaigning?

events.title: Campaign Financing

events.desc: The ongoing effort to implement … has captured the imagination of …, which has added fullthroated support for the new law as part of its central platform.
events.flavor: "The country yearns for change! For too long, we have watched the nation suffer. Is it not right to call for upheaval? Is it not right to call for the changes that are long-overdue? I tell you now, we must embrace the future!"

options.name: The … are the champions of change!
The People speak, and the nation shall listen!

events.title: The Crusade for Change

events.desc: Members of the … have expressed their concerns about technology replacing the independence and dignity of manual labor.
events.flavor:
"Would you trust the education of your children to a machine? Or the wellness of your body? Then why should we trust them with the labor of our land?

The food we eat, the fellowship, the hard work, the cooperation that comes from agriculture—those are the foundations of our society, and progress cannot, and shall not, replace them."

options.name: We shouldn't compromise the work of our people.
Progress always finds a way.

events.title: Man Over Machine

events.desc: …, of the …, has been seen preaching in favor of the …, convinced that their victory has been foreseen in …'s plans.
events.flavor:
"Do you think that … would not have a plan for our pious nation? Of course there is a plan! There must always be a plan! I've seen it myself, let me tell you, and I've seen it as clear as I see you all right now, just before my eyes.

And who else is to lead this adrift government other than those who can clearly read that plan?"

options.name: And who are we to stand against …'s will?
Such a shame the nation is not ruled by …, then.
But … surely wants the … to win!

events.title: God's Will

events.desc: Members of the … have loudly stated that the only way to lead us out of the … war is to leave the government of our nation in their capable hands.
events.flavor: "Desperate times call for desperate measures. Not that we are a desperate measure, of course, but that's how the saying goes—the natural order of linguistics. To each their own, ordo naturalis, we must play by those rules. And how could something be more natural than letting the … lead us through war?"

options.name: They are truly our most capable people.
Military populism? In my war?

events.title: The Natural Solution

events.desc: Members of the … have drawn attention to the rise of the …, expressing their willingness to offer a more moderate solution to their political extremism.
events.flavor: "Have you heard of that dangerous …? I've been told that their members meet at night, plot their next terrorist attack and eat babies! Babies!"

options.name: And thank … that they do.
Sounds a bit far-fetched, but the … is still the sensible option.

events.title: The Golden Mean

events.desc: The ideas of the … have been raising interest throughout the country, leading to potential turmoil.
events.flavor: "Those who profess to favor freedom and yet depreciate agitation, are people who want crops without plowing the ground; they want rain without thunder and lightning; they want the ocean without the roar of its many waters."

options.name: And they should expand even further.
They are compromising the unity of …!
Someone should convince them to stop.

events.title: A Radical Expansion

options.name: Traitors must not be rewarded for their crimes.
Japan will not be divided.
If it would mean a swifter reconciliation, it is a fair price.
Their initiative is worth following more closely.

events.desc: Foreseeing the imminent collapse of … power, … has assembled a force of several thousand loyalist soldiers and retainers to land on the island of …. … is faced with the decision to continue the war from Hakodate, or to petition the … government for a settlement.
events.flavor:
"We shall meet with difficulties; but these we are determined to overcome—by force of arms, if other measures fail. We abhor war, and if now we are compelled to fight, we fight only to secure our country's future peace. Our object is to remove the traces of weakness, indifference, and licentiousness which have been too evident in our country for some centuries past; and by making advance in civilization, to make our nation strive so as to be a fit ally to foreign nations in arts, in sciences, and in arms.

This is the work we have to do, and this work we will do! Attend! All high officers, and all you who are now living in retirement, attend to this our Manifesto."

—Manifesto of the Shogunate Navy in Edo, 1868

options.name: Send the petition. The Samurai will persist in the North.
No compromise. Our last stand will be at Goryōkaku.
Halt at Sendai. We will make no further retreat.

events.title: The Hakodate Expedition

events.flavor:
"A land of savages is what it is. Of swamps and mud. Of impoverished fishermen and flesh eaters. Whatever are you hoping to get in that godforsaken land that … cannot already grant you?"

"Purpose, mother. And something to make my own."

options.name: Hokkai-dō, in honor of the inhabitants of this land.
Its name shall be Hokkai-dō: The North Sea Circuit.
Kaitō-dō, the Sea-Island Circuit, is clearly the better option.
Hitakami-dō has a certain literary ring to it.

events.title: Hokkaido Events 1

events.desc: The question of how to best settle the region has preoccupied the minds of the … Development Commission for some time now. Impatient administrators now demand we reach a final decision.
events.flavor:
Growing up, his father often talked of their ancestors. Of the proud and noble warriors of the warring states period. Of their austere dignity and their great feats of war. The stories had captivated him as a child, but now that he was older they filled him with nothing but melancholy. The irony of his father, a paper-pushing, urbanite drunkard that had only carried a sword for the dignity it afforded him, extolling the virtues of the past was too much to bear.

So when his father asked him to assist in the administration of the business, he turned him down with contempt, and immediately set off for the north. Maybe there would he find salvation for his line?

options.name: Prioritize settlement by soldier-settler colonists.
The simple peasant is the backbone of ….
Restrict most … settlements to areas unused by the ….

events.title: The New Frontier

events.desc: Recent breakthroughs at the Sapporo Agricultural College have prompted proposals to introduce new crops to the fields of ….
events.flavor:
Personal Lab Log, 154
Grafts of western varieties now abandoned in favor of southern ones due to latest test results. The boys claim cultivation limit is expected to be pushed considerably northwards, perhaps even past Kamikawa. Further studies needed to assess yield potential, but feeling optimistic. Requested meeting with faculty head tomorrow. Need to buy new tie.

options.name: Focus our efforts on improving the crops already present.
Develop cold-resistant varieties to allow for local ….
The lowlands are well suited for Indigo ….
The poppy takes well here, … are the future.
Set up … using specialized grape strains.

events.title: Seeds of Progress

events.desc: The … Development Commission has reached another important milestone, with vast tracts of former wetlands converted to valuable agricultural land.
events.flavor: It was impressive, really. A decade ago the largest vessel capable of safely navigating the river in front of him would have been a small rowboat. Now he was watching a group of workers unload crates and burlap sacks from a massive steam pram billowing smoke into the crisp mountain air above. Material for the next lock perhaps? Or for the drainage project further upstream? Or just supplies from the new village in the valley beyond? He couldn't say, and in truth it mattered not, for whatever it carried, it was carrying the future.

options.name: With each swing of the hoe, we mould this land.
And with each new home, we grow it.

events.title: Growth of the Soil

events.desc: With the graduation of the first class of the …-staffed Sapporo Agricultural College, the alumni are eager to put their newfound skills into action. Meanwhile, the college board deliberates the institute's future direction and focus.
events.flavor:
"... be ambitious not for money, not for selfish aggrandizement, not for the evanescent thing which men call fame. Be ambitious for the attainment of all that a man can be."

—William Smith Clark, "Farewell Speech of the President of the Sapporo Agricultural College"

options.name: An agricultural college should primarily focus on agriculture.
We should prioritize expanding the engineering faculty.
Establish a faculty of humanities and start local cultural studies.

events.title: Boys, Be Ambitious...

events.desc: In an atmosphere of some domestic controversy, … has issued a new decree on the legal status of …, formally delineating an Ainu homeland and establishing limited institutions to exist in parallel with the official … bureaucratic apparatus.
events.flavor:
"Hinna! Hinna!" With a near-toothless grin, the old Ainu crone extended the bowl of soup to him. He looked at the assortment of game it contained, and thanked the heavens his parents were not here to judge him.

"The things I do for peace" he muttered to himself, accepting the dish with a forced smile.

options.name: "This land is large enough for both."

events.title: Ainu Mosir, Sisam Mosir

events.desc: Formally announcing the success of their government-mandated mission, the … Development Commission has elected to transfer its remaining responsibilities to the state.
events.flavor:
Proclamation No. 8
The … Development Commission is hereby abolished and the three prefectures of Hakodate, Sapporo, and Nemuro are established. The boundaries of their respective jurisdictions shall be promulgated at a later date.

options.name: A shining example for future colonial endeavours...
...and for the …, for that matter.

events.title: The Commission's Final Act

events.desc: The loss of … has forced the Development Commission to dissolve without having completed its mission. In response, outraged citizens have taken to the streets of …, protesting both the loss of national prestige and of their personal investments.
events.flavor:
Exhausted, the administrator emeritus slumped down into his office chair and poured himself a generous cup of sake. Emptying the cup in one go, he let his eyes rest on the maps laid out in front of him on the table. Full with scribbles, notes, and marks, each denoting a separate scheme he had poured his life energy into. Now neither scheme nor energy remained, and the implied optimism in each note carried a mocking tone.

To hell with it all, he thought, and poured himself another cup.

options.name: Regrettably, this outcome is outside the government's control.

events.title: Commission Without a Cause

events.flavor:
From somewhere out of sight, a musician gave the signal. Two ladies of the court opened the Throne's curtains. There was the Emperor, dressed in scarlet robes decorated with white and green dragons. Their volume swallowed up his seat, making him seem as if he floated on air. A curtain of beads descended from his crown. The shadows they cast hid his eyes from view.

Clothing rustled around …, … fellow attendees prostrating themselves in a great wave. … followed them, and the Emperor's shadowed face disappeared from view.

Days later, on the road back to Edo, … attempted to reconstruct what … had seen, yet found no purchase. … could recall the crown, the curtains, the boxes resting at the Emperor's side. Of the man himself, there was nothing to be found.

options.name: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.

events.title: Japan Monarchy 1

events.desc: Prince … has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. … accession has marked the beginning of the … era, named for the promise of enlightened rule.
events.flavor:
A gong sounded, and the curtain rose. For just an eyeblink, the audience saw the Emperor, clad in richly-decorated yellow silk, his face half-obscured. A green lacquered box rested on a stand to his left, concealing the sacred sword and jewel. And then the master-at-arms made his call, and they lowered their eyes to the floor. The herald spoke, voice strong and steady.

"From the times of old, in the age of the gods, the foundations of the realm were established, and thereafter, at Kashihara, the divine Emperor founded the Imperial dynasty. The Imperial line has hence continued unbroken. In keeping with the ancient ways, and the precedent of former reigns, We now receive the Heavenly Succession and assume the Great Imperial Throne."

options.name: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.

events.title: The Meiji Era

events.desc: Prince … has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. … accession has marked the beginning of the … era, named for the virtue of great righteousness.
events.flavor:
The joint groaned as a man passed along the scaffold. Yatarō held it as tightly as possible. Once the footsteps had passed, he set about locking it in place with his mallet.

He could hear similar sounds from all around him. Through the corner of his eye, he could see another crew assembling the black-wood plank walls of the next building over. A foreman shouted directions at a man carrying a teetering load of thatch.

In six days, the Emperor would pass through the passage he was building, part of a once-in-a-lifetime ceremony that would conclude in its destruction. He would not be able to attend. The best he could hope for was to witness its glow reflected off the clouds.

options.name: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.

events.title: The Taishō Era

events.desc: Prince … has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. … accession has marked the beginning of the … era, named for the promise of enlightened peace and concord.
events.flavor:
Four generations of the Takaishi family huddled around the radio set. The voice from it sounded as if it came from the bottom of a well, tinged with static. Giyō turned the dial one way, and then another. When it came through again, it was strong and steady.

"...Chief Cabinet Secretary has issued a rescript announcing the new era. From this day onwards, the era shall be changed to the first year of …..."

His mother's eyes darted over to the newspaper on the kitchen table. "Not Kobun? Is he telling the truth?"

Conflicted whispering filled the room, and Giyō turned up the radio's volume dial. It was in vain. If there was anything else, he would need to read about it tomorrow.

options.name: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.

events.title: The Shōwa Era

events.desc: With the political primacy of the Imperial Court restored, the Emperor has promulgated an edict reforming the system of eras. A new era will now be declared with the accession of a new Emperor, and last for as long as he rules.
events.flavor:
Imperial Edict

The establishment of a new era upon the sacred sovereign's receiving of Heaven's mandate constitutes the exemplary model of an enlightened age, and the standard for ten thousand generations. Having inherited the great lineage and personally attended to the myriad affairs of state, I now change the era name to mark a new beginning with the myriad subjects within the realm. The … shall henceforth be known as the first year of …. From this day forward, the old system shall be reformed, establishing the principle of one era name per reign as the permanent practice.

options.name: Those in authority shall implement it.

events.title: One Emperor, One Era

events.desc: The Retired Emperor, abdicated father of the sitting Emperor, has passed away. … is remembered for his efforts to restore imperial prestige, and has been granted the posthumous name of ….
events.flavor:
Tōhō dipped his brush into the ink. Its tip moved to the page, forming the characters for the day, year, and weather. It moved to the next column, and stopped.

What wording would be proper? How best to express the significance of what had happened? He had heard rumors of the retired Emperor's great efforts to restore the court—he recalled his reign, the reports of the ceremonies he had revived. And then he had received the Court's envoy, and had learned the truth of it.

The brush touched the paper. "Received a request for precedent regarding the Emperor's title. Consulted the Imperial Genealogy, and delivered advice..."

options.name: Will his descendants realize his wishes?

events.title: The Death of the Daijō Tennō

events.desc: The government has assembled a list of several ministers and officials suitable for the role of Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary. The chosen candidate will be sent to lead the expedition to the West for an expected period of ten months.
events.flavor: … stood before the mirror, checking and re-checking … tie. It had been some time since it had come to Japan—first as a trend, and then by state mandate—yet it had not yet come to feel natural. … would need to make do. If his deal broke through, if the government endorsed … bid, if he were to wake up in London and Boston and Paris, the end of the day would no longer mark a respite.

options.name: The matter demands the attention of ….
Appoint … to the role.
We may rely upon ….
… could benefit from the opportunity.

events.title: The Mission to the West

events.desc: With the … Mission's return to Japan, … and … fellow ambassadors have submitted their reports to …. Their reports contain observations of industrial society, and recommendations for new state policies.
events.flavor:
"Reflecting deeply, it is evident that that the success of the European and American nations stems from their proper application of principles. Those who traverse the world observe that, across the dozen-odd nations surveyed, the structures of governance may differ, yet all direct their strength towards education, uniting them under one banner. Thus, upon entering any of these lands, there is no place without schools, and no person without the spirit of enlightenment."

—Tanaka Fujimaro

options.name: The West has provided us a window into modernity.
…-styled industries will be the future of Japan.
There is much to learn from … politics.
A …-inspired land reform would revitalize the countryside.

events.title: The … Report

events.desc: After a long voyage across the sea, the … Mission has arrived in …. The Mission plans to travel along her railways to …, surveying … institutions and industrial facilities en route.
events.flavor:
"At dawn, the sea fog was so thick that we could scarcely see a few feet ahead, and the ship stopped, waiting for daybreak. Once it grew light, the mist gradually cleared, and before us appeared the coast of California. In due course, we reached the middle of two rocky headlands, where the mountains on both sides rose high; their surfaces met the sea, and smoke from steamships could be seen passing to and fro. This beautiful scene is what is called the Golden Gate.

For twenty-two days we had crossed the ocean, and at last here in the East we first beheld mountains and waters. As we looked upon it, there was no sound but joy."

—Kume Kunitake, The Iwakura Embassy, 1871-73

options.name: The knowledge of a continent lies upon to us.
America is merely the gateway to Europe.

events.title: The Golden Gate

events.desc: Having traversed from Pacific to Atlantic, the … Mission has arrived in …. The Mission seeks to establish diplomatic relations with the …'s Government, and tour the founding sites of the Industrial Revolution.
events.flavor:
"As America prospered, the port of Liverpool became ever more flourishing. A line of docks have been constructed at the harbor entrance, extending for six miles along the north shore. On the seaward side, stone embankments have been piled up like castle walls, and within them docks have been excavated in every direction. All vessels, entering and leaving, come into these docks and anchor there. Their masts resemble a forest of thick-growing trees, and the rigging resembles nets hung out to dry in a fishing village. These, we were told, were the largest docks in the world."

—Kume Kunitake, The Iwakura Embassy, 1871-73

options.name: Follow every lead presented to us.
Two months is time enough to see all of ….

events.title: The Belly of the Whale

events.desc: The … Mission has arrived in continental Europe, beginning in the country of …. Over the next months, the Mission intends to observe, assess, and establish relations with the numerous nations of the Continent.
events.flavor:
"This afternoon, we visited a cemetary, whose name we failed to ask. It lies on the eastern outskirts of Paris, extending over an area of forty acres. Outside of a single wide carriageway, there is hardly any room to spare.

Today, there was a funeral for what seemed to be a family of lowly means. A small procession accompanied a wooden coffin, which was lowered into a grave. When the priest finished reciting the prayer, those present, weeping, each cast in a handful of earth. Though every person in the procession had eyes filled with tears, not one raised a loud lament."

—Kume Kunitake, The Iwakura Embassy, 1871-73

options.name: We will take our time to compare and contrast.
The timetable demands an expedited tour.

events.title: Across the Continent

events.desc: En route to …, the … Mission has made a stop in the … colony of …. The Mission has spent several days observing both European colonial society and native … practices.
events.flavor:
"On our visit here, we were guided around by a monk who called us danna, and the temple a garan. We were impressed that the Sanskrit origin of these words is preserved even now. Ceylon is a sacred land of the Buddha's practice, and the native people still remain devoted to Buddhism. Since the life of the people is already simple, the lives of monks are simpler still. Their meals are meager, their hermitages overgrown with weeds, and everything has reached a state of extreme plainness.

Compared with the sacred sites of Christianity or Islam, the contast here is striking. Is this because the religion has cast off worldly adornments? Perhaps. Yet it may also be because it lacks the power to flourish."

—Kume Kunitake, The Iwakura Embassy, 1871-73

options.name: Could this fate have befallen us?

events.title: The Other Half

events.desc: Having spent months abroad and completed a full circumnavigation of the globe, the … Mission has returned to …. They have brought with them compilations of data, foreign goods, and firsthand accounts of Western technologies and political institutions.
events.flavor:
… stood on the deck of the steamer, gazing Westwards. In the distance, … could see the vastness of Mount Fuji, wreathed in a morning fog that had only half-lifted. A coterie of Westerners—traders, perhaps, or fresh-minted world travelers like …—clustered around the railing. A German man sat on a bench by the cabin door, drawing the scene on a sketchpad. … wondered if this was their first time, or if they, like …, had their breaths taken away whenever they saw this view.

How many could truly have been said to have done what he had? How many had crossed three oceans, visited four continents? More and more to come, … thought. The railway and the steamship would create more and more like …, but history would remember … as one of the first.

options.name: Home is the most beautiful sight of all.

events.title: Yokohama Port

events.desc: As modernist thinkers gain influence within the …, the limitations of the old courier system have become increasingly apparent. Whether through the dismantling of the feudal order or the spread of literacy among the population, the conditions now exist for a centralized postal service capable of supporting a modern state.
events.flavor: Messengers, marked with the government seal, ran through the streets with their pouches, carrying an unusual amount of letters. In the capital, officials bent over maps, adjusting routes and counting stamps throughout the night. Merchants grumbled at the disruption of old courier networks, while curious children pressed their first letters into the new post boxes. The country, once divided by custom, was beginning to speak with one voice.

options.name: Fully fund a national rollout.
Focus on major urban centers.
Rural areas take priority.
Entrust the reform to ….
Preserve the old courier system.

events.title: Letters for All

events.desc: Japan's centuries-old lunisolar calendar is increasingly out of sync with the Western world. Merchants have complained of difficulties in coordinating with foreign partners, whilst the populace has reported confusion over misaligned festivals, rents, and tax deadlines.

options.name: Proceed with calendar reform immediately.
Utilize the … to expedite changes.
Preserve the old system for now.

events.title: The Unequal Calendars

events.desc: The adoption of the new calendar has quietly shortened the year. With fewer counted days, wages, rents, and taxes no longer align with expectations formed under the old system. Workers discover their pay diminished, and officials struggle to explain the discrepancy.
events.flavor: Workers counted their coins again and again, shaking their heads in disapproval. Their hands had been roughened by labor, yet they saw little reward. The year had grown shorter, and each lost day had left its mark in tired arms and empty pockets.

options.name: The year is shorter. So be it.
Redistribute the burden across the population.
Absorb the loss for the sake of stability.

events.title: A Year Recounted

events.desc: As the … conducts diplomacy and trade with foreign powers, questions have arisen over how … names should be rendered in treaties, correspondence, and official documents. Western representatives increasingly expect names to follow their own conventions, placing the given name before the family name.
events.flavor: Clerks leaned over their desks, pens scratching across letters for foreign officials. They whispered among themselves, debating whether clarity abroad justified a change to long-held tradition. A hand holding a seal paused over a paper, lingering for a moment before the ink was set.

options.name: Adopt Western conventions in foreign correspondence.
Maintain the traditional order of names.
This is a new era—adopt the Western convention for all cases.

events.title: The Westernization of Names

events.desc: Decrees, regulations, and records have long relied on classical language understood only by the educated few. Reformers have argued that administration conducted in Vernacular Japanese would improve clarity and efficiency, while others have insisted that tradition itself has lent authority to the written word.
events.flavor: Bureaucrats worked late into the night, tirelessly rewording directives with quiet determination. One paused to rub his eyes, then pressed on, careful not to miss a single mark. Each scratch of the pen felt like a small battle against confusion and disorder.

options.name: Promote Vernacular Japanese in official administration.
Permit limited reform in internal correspondence.
Retain classical Kanbun in all state documents.

events.title: The Question of Kanbun

events.desc: A fire has burned down a popular kabuki theatre in …. While the theatre troupe makes plans to rebuild, … members—especially …—see this as an opportunity to regulate entertainment in … and force the performers to rebuild their theatre outside of city limits.
events.flavor:
Atop the platform of a fire lookout tower there is a restless watchman who diligently keeps an eye over …. Late in the evening, he spots the telltale signs of a fire from his vantage point. As smoke billows and the acrid scent of fire fills the air, he rushes to ring the alarm bell.

Unsuspecting townsfolk are alerted of the danger and fire brigades launch into action climbing roofs to control the flames. When the fires are extinguished, it is apparent much damage is already done. All that remains of one prominent kabuki theatre are cinders and ashes in the wake of this destructive blaze.

options.name: They must rebuild outside of city limits.
Allow the theatre troupe to rebuild.

events.title: Theatre in … Burns Down

events.desc: The work of a prolific ukiyo-e artist in … has inspired the imagination of artists both in … and abroad.
events.flavor:
A popular woodblock print depicts the lively theatre district in the outskirts of …. Silver moonlight shines down on the main street filled with people where their silhouettes cast shadows. The east side of the street is lined with teahouses and puppet theatres. Opposite, to the west, are three kabuki theatres with a drum tower above each.

"Only a master hand could make strokes so firm and true and so delicately shaded just where the shading should come. And only a master mind could conceive a figure so rhythmically organized throughout, so strong and at the same time so exquisitely dainty."
— F.W.G., Bulletin of the Art Institute of Chicago

options.name: No doubt … art will continue to gain global prominence.
Excellent. Encourage the production for more of these works.

events.title: Pictures of the Floating World

events.desc: The effect of Westernization on … culture is significant. As customs rapidly change, … … is sponsoring a Sumo wrestling tournament in … to combat public antagonism of the tradition.
events.flavor: Crowds begin to gather at the newly constructed Sumo Hall on temple grounds, filled with curiosity about this event that has the …'s endorsement. Among those present are some aristocrats and statesmen whose fixation with Western culture has left them skeptical of maintaining ties to this tradition. While the golden age of Sumo has long passed, … …'s attendance may re-establish the cultural importance of the sport in the eyes of the people.

options.name: The …'s efforts will restore the public image of the sport.
The tradition of this … sport will have great longevity.

events.title: Wrestling with Tradition

events.desc: A boat sailing off the coast of … has spotted two right whales—a mother and a calf. Driven by desperation after a season of poor catches, a whaling group has ventured out to sea despite bad weather conditions. More than 100 people have been reported missing.
events.flavor:
The bonfire on the boat has long disappeared out of view and the fleet can no longer be seen from ground causing great commotion in ….

"No matter how dire times have been, we have always avoided whaling a mother and her calf," one man argues. "We should have let the whales go."

"Nonsense," his cousin replies. "The whales are a blessing. I'm sure the expedition will return soon with a bountiful catch."

options.name: Whaling is a crucial industry in ….
Focus our future efforts on Fisheries in … instead.

events.title: Whaling Disaster in …

events.desc: The … have been concerned that the frequency of arson cases within the city limits of … has driven up prices of … in …. They have argued that doubling down on strict anti-arson measures is necessary.
events.flavor: The alarm bell rings out from the fire lookout tower alerting all to the imminent danger where another fire in … has set residences and businesses aflame. As the fire brigades arrive to extinguish the blaze, Chōnin gather in a large crowd in the street. Some regard their neighbors with suspicion and others begin to speculate whether this was an accident or if an arsonist is to blame. One thing is for certain, the prices for … will soon be multiplying.

options.name: Strict measures are warranted. Execute suspected arsonists.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: Pardon outstanding crimes of those who aid in arrests.

events.title: Anti-Arson Measures
