events.desc: Over the course of four days, three earthquakes outside the coast have caused damage across a vast area, with ensuing tidal waves exacerbating their impact in coastal areas.
events.flavor:
Within a very little time the whole village had noticed the phenomenon. Apparently no one had felt the previous motion of the ground, but all were evidently astounded by the movement of the water. They were running to the beach, and even beyond the beach, to watch it. No such ebb had been witnessed on that coast within the memory of living men. Things never seen before were making apparition; unfamiliar spaces of ribbed sand and reaches of weedhung rock were left bare even as Hamaguchi gazed. And none of the people below appeared to guess what that monstrous ebb signified.

—Lafcadio Hearn, A Living God

options.name: Request the assistance of neighboring Daimyō.
Let the local rulers handle the relief efforts.

events.title: … Great Earthquakes

events.desc: A great earthquake has struck near the coast in …, causing widespread damage to the city of … and its castle.
events.flavor:
When prints of the great catfish Namazu first started growing in popularity after the earthquake, they seemed in line with traditional stories. The creature was shown being subdued by the gods to prevent it from causing more earthquakes.

Yet over time, the portrayals evolved. One print showed Namazu cutting open its belly and bleeding coins. Another showed builders sharing drinks with it. A satirical edge had crept into the artwork, suggesting that despite the disaster brought by this beast, perhaps it was also setting something right.

options.name: Our vassals in … need aid!
Wealth must flow to those who can rebuild.

events.title: … … Earthquake

events.desc: A great earthquake has struck at the heart of …, killing thousands and creating unusually large fault breaks across the land.
events.flavor:
"The reaction of human beings has always been to perceive disasters as crimes, often asking 'who' and thereby giving rise to the host of monsters and demons of mythology said to be behind an earthquake.

The modern seismologist must reject superstition, but ironically sometimes finds himself in the role of a police detective investigating a crime scene. Which objects fell? How did they fall? All these questions ultimately in pursuit not of 'who', but of 'how' and 'why'."

options.name: Invite foreign scholars to study these faults.
Use this knowledge to set up more meteorological observatories.
Brace for possible aftershocks.

events.title: Mino–Owari Earthquake

events.desc: A great tidal wave has struck …, triggered by an earthquake off the Sanriku coast. In the wake of its devastating impact, monuments warning of future tsunamis have been suggested.
events.flavor: "Building monuments to the dead is not enough. Neither do the living need such reminders of the calamity visited upon them. Anyone who finds a message in stone will know that their ancestors were speaking to them something that must not be forgotten. These are monuments to those who are yet to be born."

options.name: … needs such monuments.
Raise these stones wherever the tsunami struck!
We must focus our efforts on the here and now.

events.title: Sanriku Earthquake

events.desc: A massive earthquake, unprecedented in living memory, has struck close to …. Within minutes, the disaster has razed much of the city and killed hundreds of thousands.
events.flavor:
If the wall of water that followed the tremors had seemed like the greatest threat, it was nothing compared to the fires. Soon, not only was the entire city set ablaze, but the earth and wind itself seemed to be on fire.

People who had managed to escape the burning buildings were trapped by a tornado of flames, as if the conflagration was determined to leave no one alive. … had become a vision of hell.

options.name: The Japanese people must stand united against such devastation!

modifiers.label: Acceptance from no shared Language Traits

options.name: This blow to our material wealth is a warning against decadence.
We must use this opportunity to rebuild a more modern ….

events.title: Great Kantō Earthquake

events.desc: The opening of … has rendered much of the school of Dutch Learning antiquated. Newer ideas have begun to sweep through the … intellectual community, first among them the school of "practical learning".
events.flavor:
"The important thing is that everyone regulate his conduct according to the principles of Humanity, study earnestly to acquire wide knowledge, and develop abilities appropriate to his nation. Thus, the government will be able to rule more easily, and the people to accept its rule agreeably, each finding his place and helping to preserve the peace of the nation. This should be the only aim."

—Fukuzawa Yūkichi, "An Encouragement of Learning"

options.name: Riches through learning.

events.title: Practical Learning

events.desc: With the industrialization of …, the … have diversified into the manufacturing economy. By leveraging their wealth and connections to the state, they have been able to concentrate much of the industrial base under their control.
events.flavor:
The Finance Minister watched from the balcony as the brokers made their bids. In the days of the rice exchanges, the end of trading would have been signaled by a man throwing a bucket of water into the throng.

Now, it was a gavel-wielding man with eyes fixated on the clock. Near his desk, half-buried by a sea of brokers reaching to purchase bonds at seven percent interest, he could see someone signing a contract with a bond secured firmly in his mouth. The cacophony was deafening, buys and sells merging into something that sounded like waves crashing on rocks.

The clock struck, and the man at the desk slammed his gavel against a bronze disk. Shouts of indignation rose from the crowd, and the sound of last-minute deals only increased in volume. Grumbling, he crouched under his desk, and retrieved the bucket.

options.name: Now, the bankers shall rule.

events.title: The Great Houses

events.desc: The erosion of the Edo class system has given rise to a civil society founded upon common nationality. Those once designated as … have come to view themselves, first and foremost, as patriotic citizens.
events.flavor:
Shizo slowly turned his head back and forth, studying his new haircut in the bronze mirror. It was shorter than it had ever been, missing the knot he had kept for as long as he had remembered. The ends of the freshly-cut hairs felt thick and rough, and he could not stop reaching up to feel it.

He abruptly shook his head, and felt the strands shift in a way they had not before. It was like the new clothing, with the high collars that irritated his neck. Uncomfortable, but beneficial. The new styles made a statement, and attracted others to his shop. His was a civilized business, and he was a taxpayer, a guardsman, a national—a civilized man.

options.name: The strength of the nation is the peace of its citizens.

events.title: The Common Citizen

events.desc: The world now knows that … is part of … and firmly under our country's total control. By establishing our presence in the peninsula, our success further demonstrates the prominence of our place on the world stage.
events.flavor:
With the vision of unification between nations now realized, the ambition of … … grows. From … seat in … … composes tanka poetry reflecting on the success of this endeavor and pleased with the developments in the peninsula.

At the same moment, out in Gyeonggi, a … bureaucrat suppresses public outcry from civilians who object to the new social order. Speaking to them with great equanimity, he insists this union will ensure the prosperity of all.

options.name: The future prosperity and safety of the peninsula looks bright.
Business has been integral to our agenda.

events.title: A Promising Future

events.desc: … is no longer under our control. The economic and diplomatic impact will be felt in … for years to come.
events.flavor:
… officials gather, feelings of frustration and displeasure abound, to discuss the government's failure to maintain order in the peninsula. Many refuse any compromise on how to move forward from this blow to the considerable power … has amassed in recent years.

A gentleman rises to speak over the din of discussion: "Surely … can take responsibility for this setback."

options.name: We must all shoulder the burden of the failure of our endeavor.
… and … must take responsibility for this failure.

events.title: A Lost Opportunity

events.desc: Whilst traveling in …, a … merchant was killed by the retinue of … for refusing to dismount as he passed. The Daimyō of … has asserted the legality of the killing under the right to strike any commoner who disrespects him.
events.flavor:
The foreigners broke the ranks of the musketeer squad, and shouts came from all around. Noticing the armed men surrounding him, the foreigner in the lead lashed his reins to the side, sending his horse into a rapid turn that very nearly knocked one of the musketeers off his own mount. … drew his sword, and his companions in the inner ring joined him.

… struck the first blow, opening a gash along the interloper's side. He shrieked, and lashed the reins once more. It was fruitless. The musketeer closest to him drew his own blade, and lashed out. An arc of red hung in the air like a cloud.

options.name: The … wish for nothing more than to cause us trouble.

events.title: The Right to Strike

events.desc: In retaliation for the … Domain's refusal to pay an indemnity for the death of …, … naval vessels have engaged in a multi-day artillery duel with the coastal defenses of ….
events.flavor:
The bay hung hazy with cannon fire, and … was burning. Across the water, one of the foreign ships was firing rockets into the foundries in the North of the town. With each launch, a hellish red glow drowned out the feeble light of the setting sun.

The last operational cannon at …'s battery roared—a long shot, in good conditions, and hopeless now. The ball impacted several lengths from the third vessel in the foreign column, sending a mighty gout of water into the air. … grabbed … sponge, and rushed to attend to the gun. Somewhere behind the rear wall, the men wounded by the last salvo were still screaming. Somehow, despite the ringing in … ears, … could still hear them.

options.name: A harsh price for their recklessness.

events.title: The Bombardment of …

events.desc: …, Daimyō of Chōshū Domain, has signaled … compliance with the Emperor's order to expel foreigners. … has ordered … navy to fire upon all foreign vessels passing through the Shimonoseki Strait, spurring exchanges of fire with a … warship.
events.flavor:
Daylit thunder rolled over the gentle slope of Hinoyama, and Masatake's head turned to the sky. He was greeted by a puffy, white cloud.

"Look!" cried Jiro. A hand entered his field of vision, pointing downwards. A ship at full steam was charging through the strait below, cannons blazing at something Masatake could not see. Splinters flew from her hull, and yet she continued. Above it all, another cloud was growing.

options.name: The foreigners do what we cannot.
Assist the Domain in reaching a settlement.
Offer the Westerners a port in exchange for an accord.

events.title: The Shimonoseki War

events.desc: Sonnō Jōi samurai of the … Domain have staged an attack on the in-construction … legation building in …. What would have been the first Western-styled building in the city has been burned to the ground, with the perpetrators nowhere in sight.
events.flavor:
Two men, hooded and masked, settled in atop the hill overlooking what would have been the legation. An orange glow still rose from its now-blackened shell. With all more accessible fuel extinguished, the flames struggled to sustain themselves on the dense inner beams.

As the glow faded to nothing, the two men remained. One spoke, voice quiet, staring off at the pillar of smoke left behind.

"Would it not be beautiful if its ashes were to fall on us like snow?"

options.name: … has become ungovernable.
Forbid the … from bearing arms in the city.

events.title: The Burning of the … Legation

events.desc: The Chief Minister of the Shogunate, …, has been assassinated at the gate of Edo Castle by rōnin of the … and … Domains. The manifesto left by the assassins expresses Sonnō Jōi principles, condemning the Chief Minister's concessions to foreigners.
events.flavor:
Chuzaburo watched Gorokuro step in front of the procession, and one of the … guards move to intercept him. Gorokuro gave him no more time to react. He drew his sword, and lunged. A great arc of blood flew from the … man's bisected face, and his companions surged forwards to avenge him.

Chuzaburo let his raincoat fall, and drew his pistol. He took aim at the exposed side of the palanquin, and pulled the trigger. The roar of a gunshot interrupted the sound of clashing blades and shouts, and then another. One of the guards wheeled to face him, and Jizaemon, the rōnin from …, swung his sword down towards his torso. Past the clashing duo, Chuzaburo could see a river of red trickling through the palanquin's doors, onto the snowy street. He drew his wakizashi, and ran towards it.

options.name: The samurai cross blades once more.

events.title: A Bloody Revenge

events.desc: Guided by information gained by the torture of a militant of the …, the … have launched a raid against a gathering of alleged conspirators at …'s Ikedaya Inn. The raid has transformed into a fierce sword battle in and around the inn.
events.flavor:
Otaka braced himself against the railing as the Shinsengumi burst through the door. He could see the bloodstains on the sleeves of their pale blue haori—black-on-white in the dim lamplight. He raised his sword into a guard position.

Two of them detached from the rest, charging up the stairwell he guarded, two abreast. He struck out with his blade, felt it be parried, compensated. Sparks flew from the impact. The second man was striking out. He took a step back, twisted his wrist to-

There was a flash of fire-lit steel, and then something cold in his chest.

options.name: Reward the Shinsengumi for their initiative.
This brutality only invites retaliation.

events.title: The Ikedaya Incident

events.desc: Soldiers of the …-aligned … Domain have attempted to storm the Imperial Palace in …, and restore the Emperor by force. They are opposed by soldiers of the … and Aizu domains.
events.flavor:
The Hamaguri Gate was choked with gunsmoke. All around them, Kyōto was catching light.

The Aizu soldiers were concentrated along the wall, sending out volleys of musket-fire that scattered off the road and the chassis of the … cannons. Every few seconds, one of the balls would strike flesh, spurring cries that briefly cut above the crackle of gunfire. Kōzō huddled against a wheel of a cannon, struggling to unjam his musket. A bare ken away, the leader of his squad lay face down, legless, armless. Somehow, he was still writhing.

options.name: The … and Aizu succeed in repelling the attackers.
The Imperial Palace falls under … control.

events.title: The Forbidden Gate

events.desc: As retaliation for the … assault on the Imperial Palace, the Shōgun has ordered a punitive expedition to expel the Sonnō Jōi faction from the Domain. Advisors sympathetic to the … have offered a plan to secure peace in return for the seppuku of the guilty parties.
events.flavor:
…, Daimyō of …, stood on the castle's balcony, gazing into the distance. Far away, the sky was tainted by streams of smoke—the campfires of the approaching army.

"The Shōgun demands the seppuku of the three senior retainers," said the retainer. "The beheading of the four staff officers. The exile of the five ministers."

… looked to the campfires. There were hundreds, at least. The once-blue horizon had become something sick. At last, he spoke.

"...… Domain will submit."

options.name: If they can be defeated without fighting, so be it.
The Domain must be cleansed from top to bottom.

events.title: The … Expedition

events.desc: Angered by the treaties forced upon … by the Western powers, the Emperor has bypassed the Shōgun and issued an edict to expel foreigners from … soil. Militants of the … have rallied to the Emperor's cause.
events.flavor:
The retainer stood abreast one of the cannons, looking out towards the strait. At this hour, the vessels steaming through were silhouetted by the setting sun. Off to the side, the lower samurai of Chōshū Domain busied themselves with ramrods and bags of black powder.

As looked up at the shape of Hinoyama and the town of Shimonoseki below, passage from the Edict came to mind. "Even if the land were to be reduced to ashes," it had stated, "we shall not permit the opening of ports for trade."

Was it justified? Would he permit for its gentle, green slope to be scorched black, for its fields of flowers to be burned, for his home to be leveled? Yes, he thought. Without hesitation.

options.name: The Shōgun must travel to Kyōto to discuss this.
This order is fraudulent—have it suppressed.

events.title: The Order to Expel Barbarians

events.desc: Whilst conducting business in …, a … merchant by the name of … has been murdered by the local lord …. The lord has claimed … justified under the law of … land, and refused to pay any sort of compensation for … crime.
events.flavor:
Editorial

Under the present circumstances, we repeat that … has no alternative but to make ready for a great war, or to bid farewell to Japan. To abandon the foothold she has obtained there will not be thought of, and so we may look out for a conflict between the two empires. Many … dislike this idea, yet the … … deems it not only inevitable, but justifiable, merely on the ground of the refusal of the Japanese to punish the assassins of …... (cont. pg.02)

options.name: Someone must pay. Raise the matter with the Tycoon.
Do we truly wish to get further involved in the East?

events.title: The … Affair

events.desc: The end of Sakoku has stirred a sense of powerlessness against foreign encroachment, undermining the authority of the … clan. The enemies of the Shogunate have rallied around the slogan of Sonnō Jōi: "Revere the Emperor, expel the barbarians".
events.flavor:
On the second floor of a Kyōto inn, far from any windows, a dozen black-clad rōnin huddled around a table. Outside, rain poured down with a fury that drowned out the sounds of the street. Angry whispers passed between them—complaints, then denunciations, then a sworn oath and an interloper's death warrant.

Far away, in a house overlooking Iso, a man in a green kimono watched a pillar of smoke ascend skywards. The hills cast long shadows over the constructions on the seashore. As the sun approached the horizon, the glow of the furnaces below grew more and more pronounced. Beyond them, reflected on the water, he could see the lights of ships. One day, he hoped, his cannon would banish them beyond the horizon.

options.name: We must adapt to our new circumstances.

events.title: Sonnō Jōi

events.desc: The Shogunate reformers are split between two theories of governance. The theory of Kōbu Gattai seeks to renew the legitimacy of the … through fusion with the Imperial Court, whilst the theory of Public Deliberation seeks to establish a parliamentary system headed by the … clan.
events.flavor:
The host placed a tray of higashi upon the table, and poured a bowl of thin tea for each of his guests. Three men sat around the table, the host and first guest with their hair bound in chonmage, and the second short-haired. Steam wafted from the bowls in front of them.

The host directed his gaze to the short-haired man, and spoke.

"I congratulate you upon your return, …-kun. I have found each of your letters more interesting than the last. Would you tell us more of your time with the barbarians?"

options.name: The Bakufu must be renewed.
Public deliberation is the enlightened way.

events.title: The Shape of the Shogunate

events.flavor:
The procession enveloped the entire Nakasendō. A train of thirty thousand laborers, retainers, and members of the Princess' household, guarded by a perimeter of soldiers of the Owari Domain, stretched from Iijima Town to Shiojiri Station. At the heart of the procession, the Princess rode atop a palanquin of gold and red silk. Alongside it rode samurai from a dozen domains—… and …, … and …, … and ….

Within her palanquin, the Princess stared out of the thin gap between its curtains. Town after town passed by, shutters closed and silent. She would have the next thirty ri to ponder her fate.

options.name: For the good of the country.

events.title: The Imperial Marriage

events.desc: Alienated by the seizure of … lands and titles, … … and … loyal retainers have risen in revolt against the Imperial Court. … seeks to reverse the restoration of Imperial power, and restore the Bakufu.
events.flavor:
"Your servant …, having earnestly considered the state of affairs since the ninth day of last month, finds that none of these events stem from the true intentions of the Imperial Court, but entirely from the conspiracies of the treacherous ministers of Lord …. This is known throughout the realm, particularly in Edo, Nagasaki, the provinces of Yashu and Sōshū, where disturbances have arisen.

As these are deeds detested by both heaven and man, we beseech Your Majesty to issue a decree for the surrender of the aforementioned treacherous ministers. Should this request not be granted, we shall have no choice but to proceed with their execution."

options.name: This is our wish: slay the traitor, and restore peace.
The Emperor has come under the sway of robbers.

events.title: The … War

events.desc: Facing increasing pressure from the opponents of the …, … has petitioned the Emperor to return … governing authority to the Imperial Court.
events.flavor:
"Unless power is reunited within the Imperial Court, the very foundations of our nation cannot be sustained. Therefore, at this juncture, we must reform the old ways, and return the administration to the Imperial Court.

After exhausting the public counsel of the realm, and seeking Your Majesty's final judgment, I sincerely believe that if all hearts are united in service to the nation, we can protect our imperial country together and stand as equals alongside the nations of the world."

—Tokugawa Yoshinobu, 1867

options.name: Naught but air beneath his feet.

events.title: Taisei Hōkan

events.desc: Opponents of the … clan within the Court have persuaded the Emperor to issue a decree formally restoring his own power. The decree abolishes the Shogunate, and establishes a government that excludes … from any official position.
events.flavor:
"… has requested that the administrative authority which had long been commissioned be restored, and now wishes to resign from the office of Shōgun. His proposal has been accepted. The country is threatened by incomparable dangers, with which, as it is well known, the late Emperor had seriously occupied himself. Accordingly, it has been decided by His Majesty's wise deliberation that the foundation for restoring imperial rule and reviving national dignity be laid.

Henceforth, the offices of Sessho, Kanpaku and Shōgun shall be abolished, and the three offices of Chief Councillor, Councillor of State, and Councillor of the Palace shall be established. Everything shall be decided through the reasonable deliberation of the people, without any distinction between civil and military officers, between nobles and common people."

options.name: Alone in the dark.

events.title: The Decree of Restoration

events.desc: With the Imperial Court lacking the practical expertise to govern, allies of the … clan within the Court have persuaded the Emperor to grant … the title of Taikun, placing … at the head of the Imperial Office.
events.flavor:
"As the various Daimyō gradually assemble and gather, deliberation will take place. The spirit of the times is focused upon public deliberation—this phrase is widely discussed—and it has been unavoidable to go along with public opinion. Therefore, I earnestly request that, as far as possible, these discussions be brought to agreement, and that measures be taken so that the purpose of the assembly is properly established.

Should discord arise in the course of deliberation, and conflict break out, even if it results in a victory for your house, it would be equivalent to brothers quarreling within the walls while foreign nations press upon us from outside."

—Nishi Shūsuke, "Draft Agenda"

options.name: On safe ground once more.

events.title: The Taikunate

events.desc: Through marriage into the Imperial Family and fulfillment of … vows to the Emperor, … has eased the tensions between Court and Shogunate. The Emperor may continue … secluded existence, assured that the Shōgun will ensure lasting peace.
events.flavor:
Even if stormy winds
Should rage through the country,
I shall wait for them
To return the sun in heaven
To its pristine radiance.

—Emperor Kōmei

options.name: The storm has come to an end.

events.title: Court and Shogunate

events.desc: Through confidence and deft maneuver, … has seen through both the restoration of the Emperor and the preservation of … clan. The … Taikuns will reign as first among the peerage of a modern Japan.
events.flavor:
The Emperor no longer sat behind a screen. His ministers were arrayed along the table before him, with the Taikun to his left. Each wore a new court uniform, their sleeves and breasts decorated with intricate arrangements of gold leaf. Medals clicked and rustled as they adjusted themselves in the unfamiliar seats.

The Taikun had moderated the discussion for the past hour, with the Emperor not speaking a single word. He had been content to listen in, directing his attention to each speaker in turn. On the far side of the room, a former disciple of sonnō jōi spoke of the necessity of a mission to America.

options.name: The Shōgun falls, the Taikun rises.
The Emperor is the Son of Heaven, and the Tokugawa his instruments.

events.title: First Among Equals

options.name: These fanatics must be repelled.
Sonnō jōi!

events.desc: The Emperor has issued his response to …'s petition to return governing authority to the Imperial Court. The Shōgun's petition has been accepted, and the political supremacy of the Emperor restored.
events.flavor: "The Emperor of Japan announces to the sovereigns of all foreign countries and to their subjects that permission has been granted to the Shōgun … to return the governing power in accordance with his own request. We shall henceforth exercise supreme authority in all the internal and external affairs of the country. Consequently, the title of Emperor must be substituted for that of Taikun, in which the treaties have been made. Officers are being appointed by us to the conduct of foreign affairs. It is desirable that the representatives of the treaty powers recognize this announcement."

options.name: A terrible thrill.

events.title: The Imperial Sanction

events.desc: The Emperor has issued his response to …'s petition to return governing authority to the Imperial Court. The response states that the Shōgun retains the confidence of the Court, and that governing authority may remain with the Shogunate.
events.flavor:
… Castle echoed with the sound of boots. Messengers and retainers had been in and out all day, bearing increasingly detailed retellings of the last week's news. … had personally received them, remaining resolutely silent through each meeting. His brow had grown heavier and heavier as he heard of the developments—the Shōgun's triumphal procession, the Aizu left guarding the Imperial Palace.

Outside the front palace, the sun had set. From his stage, … looked to the twenty assembled retainers. "Chōshū Domain shall not submit," … said. "Understand this well."

He rose, and exited the room.

options.name: The branches embrace him.

events.title: The Imperial Sanction

events.desc: Debug Text.
events.flavor: fishe

options.name: Debug Text.

events.title: Meiji Debug Event

events.desc: With tumult rising from within and without, the … has chosen to press for an immediate end to ….
events.flavor:
A crowd of merchants flooded the customs house. Facing them, a single harried official stood alone. "Yes, of course this means the country will no longer be locked down."

A dozen questions from the throng washed over the administrator like a roar. "What will it be instead? I'm... I'm not sure. Perhaps there will be- no, hold on, just because- this decision is not mine or yours to make, you can't just-"

Every answer he gave provoked a score more questions. Work was so much easier when the country was left alone, he thought.

options.name: The future of … lies with ….
… will free ….
… shall let us trade cautiously with foreign interests

events.title: Picking the Lock

events.desc: A merchant from … has attempted to ignore the strict protocols of … and trade at an unsanctioned port. Their vessel, the …, has been driven away under fire by coastal batteries. Relations, such as they are, with … have soured.
events.flavor: The commander grinned as a cannonball finally struck the ship. The law was very clear; the ship had no right to sail these waters. He did not care what the captain aboard that vessel thought. All he wanted was for that ship to turn around and leave.

options.name: The local garrison did what it was supposed to do.
We should apologize to … and compensate the merchant to smooth things over.
This is the opportunity we need to review the necessity of …

events.title: The … Incident

events.desc: Navigating pressures from within and without, … has been overturned. … has unlocked a new future for herself.
events.flavor:
The official looked out over the bay. New ships were at the docks. Unfamiliar ships, waving flags he had never seen before. What did they offer …? What did they seek to take from …?

His gaze lingered on the docked ships for a long, long time, before he finally turned away. His eyes would not be able to give him the answer he wanted, not today. Only time would be able to tell him what this new era would give to his homeland.

options.name: Today, Japan opens up!

events.title: The Picked Lock

events.desc: The continued observance of … in …, even as the country is rocked by seismic political shifts, bodes ill for any hope of breaking out of the country's self-imposed isolation. It seems like … is here to stay.
events.flavor:
The official looked out over the bay. Old ships sat at the docks, the same that his father would have seen, or his grandfather, or his ancestors for several generations back. Would his children see the same ships? His grandchildren? Would this vista ever change?

His gaze lingered on the docked ships for a long, long time, before he finally turned away. His eyes would not be able to give him the answer he wanted, not today. Only time would be able to tell if his homeland would truly remain the same forever.

options.name: The lock remains closed.

events.title: Rusted Shut

events.desc: As the new head of the … clan, … has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. The new Shōgun is viewed with derision by many …, having yet to establish personal authority.
events.flavor:
A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.

One by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.

options.name: Goshōshin, goshōshin!

events.title: The Appointment of …

events.desc: The ill health of the …'s eldest son, …, has raised concerns over whether he will be able to carry out the duties of …. Outsider Daimyō led by … have rallied behind … as an alternative candidate.
events.flavor:
…'s bedroom was empty. The screens were shut, and the veranda made clear. … sat beside his bed, facing a blank sheet of paper. … eyes were closed. Were a cat to tread through the adjacent hall, … would be certain to hear it—and yet … could not be certain that no one was listening. At such an early stage, it was best to keep … ambitions firmly within … own mind.

Would the Imperial Court see the matter the same way as …? … had reason to believe so, but this was the easiest question by far. … mind turned. How best to procure a decree? How best to ensure it did not disappear?

options.name: The inner … will have their way.
The situation requires decisive leadership.

events.title: The Succession Issue

events.desc: As the new head of the … clan, … has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Sickly since childhood, the state of the Shōgun's health has already spurred a race to succeed him.
events.flavor:
A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.

One by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.

options.name: Goshōshin, goshōshin!

events.title: The Appointment of …

events.desc: As the new head of the … clan, … has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. The new Shōgun's supporters in the reformist domains have high expectations for his rule.
events.flavor:
A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.

One by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.

options.name: Goshōshin, goshōshin!

events.title: The Appointment of …

events.desc: The factions that emerged around Shōgun Ieyoshi's succession have clashed once more over whom will succeed the childless …. The Hitotsubashi faction of outsider Daimyō and lower … support …, whilst the Nanki faction of insider … support ….
events.flavor:
The messenger, blank-faced, looked at the floor before the man on the dais. His brush hovered over the paper.

"A message for Yoshikatsu-sama", said the Magistrate. "Some among the Court have grown comfortable with unseemly speculation about the Shōgun's health. They debate as if he is voiceless. Inform me if any drafts drafted under this assumption surface."

options.name: The will of the Shōgun is that … rule.
The Imperial Court requires an experienced successor.

events.title: Hitotsubashi and Nanki

events.desc: As the new head of the … clan, … has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Though young, the Shōgun has already acquired a reputation for stoic, meticulous judgement.
events.flavor:
A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.

One by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.

options.name: Goshōshin, goshōshin!
… will govern under a loyal guardian.
Compromise with the Hitotsubashi—appoint … as … guardian.

events.title: The Appointment of …

events.desc: As the new head of the … clan, … has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Worldly and open-minded, the Shōgun is expected to patronize the …'s reformist factions.
events.flavor:
A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.

One by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.

options.name: Goshōshin, goshōshin!

events.title: The Appointment of …

events.desc: The heat of summer has sent the elderly …'s health into a sharp decline. Now bedridden, the … must fight one last battle against his failing heart.
events.flavor:
The Shōgun's bed had been moved to face the window. His attendants had hoped the cool air blowing in from the sea would supplement their fans. A chest of ice sat open at the foot of the bed, and a wet cloth across his forehead.

There was no wind, today. The air rippled beneath the setting sun. Merciless, all-enveloping. He could no longer make out the shape of the waves below.

options.name: This is the end.
Send for Dutch treatments.

events.title: Hot Summer

events.desc: Following years of adverse weather, Famine grips the land of the …. With the poor and destitute struggling to make ends meet, the Bakufu faces growing discontent from those who believe that the government could do more.
events.flavor:
His wife's woven textiles had always fetched a good price at the market, and in better days would even afford them the occasional piece of confectionary. Now they only fetched four or five gō of rice, if that. Barely enough to feed them for a day, he thought, much less the week they needed—even when supplemented with foraged leaves and weeds.

He took the path home, briefly stopping in view of old Tora's home. The pox had already claimed two of his children—and if the rumors about the rain coats were true, were likely to claim more in the weeks to come. Clutching his sack of rice tightly, he offered a silent prayer and left.

options.name: O Heaven, protect us!

events.title: Era of Heavenly Protection

events.desc: Disillusioned with the established order and its inability to deal with the Famine plaguing …, the magistrate and scholar … has revolted against the local authorities. Large parts of … are already in flames, as … supporters torch local government offices.
events.flavor:
"Though we do not have the might of Tang and Wu, nor the virtue of Confucius and Mencius, there is no help for it: for the sake of the realm, we have resolved to act—despite the curse it may bring upon our own bloodline.

We shall punish and execute the various officials who torment and distress the common people, and following that we shall likewise punish and execute the wealthy townsmen of Osaka who have grown fat on extravagance.

Then the gold, silver, and coins they have stored away in hidden vaults, and the rice bales they have concealed in their storehouses and estates, will be distributed and allotted."

—Ōshio Heihachirō, Excerpts from Manifesto

options.name: Drum up the militia and nail this traitor to a cross.
A desperate, yet righteous act.
The rebels overwhelm the local garrison and seize ….

events.title: Revolt of the Philosopher-Samurai

events.desc: Pleased with the pace of reforms, the … has congratulated the presiding councilors on their progress—believing the … nation to be able to overcome any coming challenge, be it foreign or domestic.
events.flavor:
"Twelve, sire.", the chief councilor said, setting the brush aside on the table. "And the reports from Kinai show much of the same, our reforms appear to take root."

From the dais, the … gave a curt nod. "Very well. I want the court informed in due course. Now, regarding the report from the Nagasaki magistrate..."

options.name: May this mark the end of … moral and political decay.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: From peasant to samurai, are we not all subjects of the Emperor?
The stability of the realm is paramount.

events.title: Mandatory Reforms

events.desc: Unimpressed with the results of the reform program, and facing growing public dissatisfaction with the chief councilors, the … has dismissed … from his post.
events.flavor:
Exile. The former councilor tasted the word, and did not much like it. Though perhaps it was preferable to staying in Edo given the events of yesterday. His remaining attendants were still clearing the pond and courtyard of thrown tiles and stones, and some of the threats he heard uttered that day could never be unheard.

He tasted the word again, and found it somewhat less repulsive. Besides, he thought, he had always desired to see Mount Gassan in the flesh.

options.name: I never want to see this fool again in my life.
Reverse his every decision, and make sure the public know it.

events.title: Action and Inaction

events.desc: Our move to confiscate the land in … and … has been met with widespread opposition from the local land-holders. The loudest complaints come from those whose lands were granted as reward for military service.
events.flavor:
"Military merit awarded my ancestor the land I now hold in my name. Since Sekigahara, each generation tilled the land—increasing its yield and rendering unto our masters their due, ever without complaint.

Does such service warrant the treatment we are now afforded? Is relocation without due recompense to be our reward?"

options.name: Cancel the centralization before this gets out of hand.
Offer those relocated additional land as compensation.
Remind them that this is the will of the …!

rewards.name: In the Name of the Shogun

events.title: Land-Holders Resist Centralization

events.desc: The victory of … against the … has greatly shaken our nation. Chinese junks and armies were easily routed by superior … forces, and many are now questioning the ability of … to resist a similar assault.
events.flavor:
"From Ganlu Temple in the west, to the Jinshan Temple in the east, the lands around Zhenjiang were full of black and white barbarians—like pieces scattered across a go board—and the locals wondered if they would ever go away."

—Mineta Fūkō, New Stories from Overseas

options.name: Heaven protect us, for our samurai may not.
Censor any negative reports from China.
We are the cliff against which the barbarian waves will crash.

events.title: Lion in the Dragon's Den

events.desc: Fearing for Japan's future in the aftermath of the Opium War, the Nagasaki magistrate … has organized a modern Dutch-model military unit, and urges the rest of the country to follow suit.
events.flavor:
"His men's gun hats resemble strange crowns, and their orders are barked in the harsh language of the Hollanders. Yet their formations are well-drilled and organized, and are able to deliver volleys nearly twice as fast as my own retainers, even if their accuracy is somewhat lesser."

"And of the artillery?"

"Unparalleled. I fear that the longer we wait with adopting it, the lower our chances of repelling a barbarian assault will be."

options.name: Authorize the adoption of barbarian arms and techniques.
Favor the traditional musketry houses instead.

events.title: The Takashima School

events.desc: Accusations of rice-hoarding and price-gouging has caused tensions between farmers and merchants in … to boil over. With the peasants' ranks swelled by brigands and beggars, local authorities now face a province-wide rebellion.
events.flavor:
He had been one of the first. Those merry few who had attacked the wicked merchant's home and distributed his ill-gained goods to the masses. But as his eyes wandered around the campfire, he realized how few of them were left. Eikichi and Matsuzō remained still, though they resembled little the men he once knew, beaming with righteous fury. Fukumatsu had lost his life on the second day, followed by Takeshichi on the seventh. The rest had scattered like leaves as the magistrate's men pursued them.

The character of the men who had replaced them filled him with shame and despair, but he saw no other way. For even poor company such as theirs seemed divine when compared to the executioner's saw.

options.name: Dispatch men to crush these villains.
Let the unrest die out on its own.
Ply local village headsmen to help quell the unrest.

events.title: For a Bowl of Rice

events.desc: The enduring partnership between the … state and the … has cemented the power of the conglomerates within …. The politicians may govern, but the generals and executives will rule.
events.flavor:
… looked down upon the bout from … covered box. … preferred wrestler's opponent had pushed … champion to the very edge of the rice-straw ring, and … had found … struggling to keep … knuckles from going white. At the Prime Minister's side, perfectly serene, stood ….

The referee pointed his fan, and cheer rose from the lower seats. A rain of seat cushions flew through the air, showering the ring. … turned his head towards …, and smiled. There, on the far side of the ring, stamped into one of the walls, was the mon of ….

options.name: Let … unfold like a sea of light.
Our supply chain could always be more secure.

events.title: The Corporate Empire

events.flavor:
A flock of executives filtered into the uppermost meeting room of the … headquarters. … was third to enter, after the secretaries. … took … seat by the door, and watched … seniors pass by. A weak trickle of steam wafted off the cup of tea before ….

… was the last to enter. … gaze passed over each of … employees in turn. There was a look in … eyes, … noticed, one that the Baron had never shown before. Exhaustion. The shadows cast on … face seemed deeper than before, and … silver hair ever thinner.

options.name: Sovereign power is ours alone.
Let the people know—… will not be bought.

events.title: Zaibatsu 2

events.desc: A minor noble of the House of Solomon has rapidly risen to power and popularity. Legally an outlaw, he has defeated every army sent against him and now he seeks to take the throne of … by force.
events.flavor: The legend of the outlaw who robs from the rich and gives to the poor is as old as time, and this rogue Prince exemplifies it. Robbed of his noble inheritance, the man born as Kassa Hailu has raised not only an army but also the hearts of his followers.

options.name: Tewodros will lead us to glory. Enthrone him!
We will show him how we deal with outlaws.

events.title: The Outlaw Prince

events.desc: Facing a dearth of popular support for … ideas, … has departed …, going into exile beyond our borders.
events.flavor: "Deeper study has now convinced me of the opposite. The … working class will never accomplish anything."

options.name: Some day, perhaps, things will change for the better.
Hope is the first step on the road to disappointment.

events.title: A Hopeless People

events.desc: After a chance meeting in a café and a thoughtful conversation, … has recommended that …, currently residing in …, be granted permanent residency.
events.flavor: "If you are in need of a place to stay, I could hardly neglect to offer you an invitation. It would be shameful for me to, following such a magnificent correspondence, to fail to pursue your talents further."

options.name: We could hardly ask for a more esteemed endorsement.
…'s decision-making is clearly questionable.

events.title: A Famous Café

events.desc: The leaders of the … have written to …, requesting that … return to the country to bring the movement forward.
events.flavor: "Ever since you were forced to take leave from …, chased by the government's hounds, the people have been slowly awakening... now is the time, more so than any other point in the past, to make your return, and see through the change that you nobly called for so many years ago."

options.name: There is no better time than now.
We will not entertain this possibility.

events.title: Support from Abroad

events.desc: Following a violent struggle for power over …, the … have ended up on the losing side of history. … has attempted to flee the country to escape retaliation.
events.flavor: It was a plan that … had hoped to never see through. Exiting … abode through a window, fleeing through a dark, muddy tunnel - and then, to the woods, and across the border far away.

options.name: … can rethink … life in a foreign hovel.
Harass … for every step of the way.

events.title: A Disgraced Exile

events.desc: Pleased by recent decisions made by our government, … has announced … intent to return to …. … remaining associates in the … are celebrating this.
events.flavor: "I, in my past endeavors, sought an extraordinary leader for …, one who could resolve the many ills that our people face... it was only my own stubbornness which prevented me from seeing what I do now. It was yourself who has become that extraordinary leader."

options.name: Accept … well-wishes, and … return.
Can we truly be so sure that … means well?

events.title: The Repentant Exile

events.desc: The rich and unstable political environment in … has proven attractive to political exiles and stateless people, who have begun to congregate in the coffee houses of ….
events.flavor: Oh, …, you flawed yet fiery jewel... where else could one see three different demonstrations within a five minute's walk?

options.name: They are welcome to join the sea of voices.
These people make a mockery of ….

events.title: Political Migration

events.desc: The relatively lenient … immigration system has long been attractive to those fleeing their home nations. Recently, … has petitioned to join the stream of people moving to ….
events.flavor:
It was one name on a very, very long list - one that had passed through multiple layers of bureaucracy before being noticed. One fateful day, however, one clerk, at the end of his shift, pointed at the name, and spoke those fatal words.

"I could swear I've heard of … before."

options.name: Eventually, …, too, will be ….
We will not have someone like this, regardless of precedent.

events.title: An Exile at the Gates

events.desc: The recently translated works of … have become popular within the …. The relationship has developed to the point of … openly endorsing the movement.
events.flavor: "And for a whole large class, there is no other road, especially for a nation so eminently practical as the …. The great thing is to get the working class to move as a class; that once obtained, they will soon find the right direction, and all who resist will be left out in the cold with small sects of their own."

options.name: Our struggle is an international one!
This foreign interference had ought to be punished.

events.title: A Foreign Manifesto

events.desc: The … have petitioned the government for amnesty for former dissidents abroad. This notably includes …, a former associate of theirs.
events.flavor: We have long since had the stance that the actions of past administrations have no bearing on the essential nature of the … nation. With this principle in mind, we ask that you grant forgiveness to certain figures who have been exiled overseas in the past, and put these actions behind us once and for all.

options.name: They deserve a reward for their faithful support.
If we had not exiled …, they would never have supported us at all.

events.title: Amnesty for Dissidents

events.desc: A prominent … political exile, … has fallen severely ill during … time overseas. … has petitioned to return home for enough time to seek medical treatment.
events.flavor: The character of a man matters not - pestilence may well come for them all the same.

options.name: … should face the consquences of … actions.
We can afford to display mercy to the sick.
… may feel free to stay after … is treated.

events.title: A Crisis of Health

events.desc: … has returned from exile in … with the support of their hosts' government. It seems that the … have reason to spread … ideology in ….
events.flavor: Second chances come rarely. The home once denied to … now opens its doors with a foreigner’s support. They cast … away before, preferring a false heaven of evermore tyrannical choirs. But a second chance for … meant a second chance for the dream. For true brotherhood. Perhaps … great work might bear fruit yet.

options.name: We exiled … for good reason.
Welcome home!

events.title: Repatriation

events.desc: With the nation under attack, … has offered … services to the country that once drove … into exile. The … is particularly excited by the idea.
events.flavor: "In these dire times, we must erase the differences between men. There can be no enemies within a besieged camp. Only brothers-in-arms can withstand the onslaught our nation now faces."

options.name: …'s return is welcomed!
… wants to serve our country? Give … a gun.
This is not the time for troublemakers in our ranks.

events.title: Patriotic Reconciliation

events.desc: The impasse over … has led to … to put … in the middle of the debate and force the issue to come to an end.
events.flavor: "Since you've all been deliberating so deliberately over this legislation, I suppose it's time for all parties with concerns—I speak here of myself, of course—to finally provide their own input. Now, as I was saying before being rudely interrupted by this exile, I—"

options.name: Fine, let … back in to talk.
… can have a say from afar, but … can't come back here!
… don't see eye-to-eye with … anymore.

events.title: Debatable Intervention

events.desc: Although … is still fighting for … cause, no one is following … anymore. Despondent, … has started publicly remarking that they may give up … activism altogether.
events.flavor: "What's the point? Speakers—when we have any—speak to empty halls and at empty chairs. There's no crowds, no banners. If anyone pays attention at all, they never understand anything we're preaching. What reason is there to stay here? We're all stuck doing nothing."

options.name: Perhaps … can find greener pastures elsewhere.
A little study and reflection might just vitalize the movement.
No time for timidity! The movement needs drastic changes.
There's no need to take rash actions like self-exile.

events.title: Cause Without a Rebel

events.desc: With … united under our rule, dignitaries and dissidents alike from our fractured predecessors have been drawn to our country. … now seeks to make … … home.
events.flavor: "My fellow countrymen! Through grace and fortune, our nation has been brought together under the auspices of …! Shall we let this unity of spirit lead to a death of thought? No, I say! No! If we seek to truly unite, we must accept that in this great mass of people there will be an ocean of odd ideas! I know this to be true, for I am one of those odd ideas. So, please, my kindred spirits, will you let me in?"

options.name: We welcome … with open arms.
We have no reason to invite troublemakers.

events.title: Uniting the People and a Person

events.desc: …, a experienced activist who has already spent time outside of the country, has reportedly been pondering exile again in the face of mounting challenges in ….
events.flavor: "The nice thing," … sighed, "is that it hurts to leave less and less, the more and more it happens." … smiled, but tears welled up in … eyes.

options.name: We bid … farewell.
Perhaps things can work if … tries one more time.

events.title: It Gets Easier

events.desc: …, an infamous exile still strongly connected with the …, has announced … return in melodramatic fashion. … leadership have expressed concerns that … may cause trouble for themselves and the nation at large.
events.flavor: "Fools! You dare meddle with …, the true master of the …? You shall rue the day you trifled with me! This great journey of mine is but the dawn of a glorious new beginning for the nation—nay, the world—the machinations of which began long before you ever meddled in my affairs. No matter the setbacks, I am inevitable. My glorious return shall echo throughout the annals of history!"

options.name: Tremble! … returns!

rewards.name: In the Thrall of a Villain

options.name: What need have we for … when we have …?
… shall rise higher than ever before!
Even from abroad, … influence can still be felt.

events.title: The Return of the Nefarious …

events.desc: Two former exiles, … and …, have found it difficult to not bring their old fights and troubles with them, and have drawn themselves into fights over their old problems over and over again while living here.
events.flavor:
The two figures stood on either side of the room, gasping for air while trying to smooth out the tears and scratches in their clothes.

"You... you fiend. How many times do you have to bring up that prattling doctrine of yours?"

The other figure spat onto the floor. "I didn't back down when I had the full force of the law after me, and I'll be damned if I'll back down just for you!"

options.name: Disagreements, no matter the vehemence, must be tolerated.
We must kick … out.
… is no longer welcomed here.

events.title: Bringing Their Problems With Them

events.desc: With the government's legitimacy at a low ebb and state functions paralyzed, reports have come in that … believes that … will not be challenged at the border if … tries to enter the country.
events.flavor: "Of course I'm going to try crossing the border! Who even listens to orders from the capital anymore? They're a bunch of jokes, like I've been saying all this time. This is going to be a cakewalk, trust me."

options.name: … would cost too much to stop.
The police still do their jobs!
The government could cut a deal with the … to stop ….

events.title: A Challenge to Authority?

events.desc: … has apparently decided that … would be an excellent place to live, given the influence of the … in the country.
events.flavor: "…, what a land of opportunity! Such a grand nation, so ready for my message... yes, I will set off at last for this grand country!"

options.name: There's no reason to stop … from coming.
Even if it upsets the …, we must prevent …'s arrival.
Oho? Sounds like … is fostering subversives!

events.title: Fertile Ground

events.desc: The presence of subversive figures such as …, even if … is not involved in the ongoing revolution, poses a serious threat to the government which cannot be tolerated in these perilous times.
events.flavor: They huddled in an alley. One of their number carefully peeked out to take a look at the raid. The men had come with no warning, armed like they were about to storm a fortress. Why had they attacked? What wrong had … done? Paranoia at the highest levels seemed like mere senselesses on the streets.

options.name: … must go. Now.
What we need is forgiveness and delicacy, not paranoia and brutishness.

events.title: Unstable Elements

events.desc: The famine in … has sparked criticism of …'s economic policy of Traditionalism, with its opposition to international trade and refusal to change with the times.
events.flavor: "For whose benefit does … let its economy remain in the past while the world around it barrels into modernity? Certainly not those who lie dead in the gutter. The beneficiaries might think that tradition has blinded us to who they are and what must be done, but the past they are holding onto no longer exists. If they choose to stay in it, neither will they."

options.name: Maintaining traditions should not cost lives!
Peasants have starved in every era. Such is the way of the world.

events.title: Outmoded Economics

events.desc: The famine in … has sparked criticism of …'s economic policy of Isolationism, with its refusal to accept goods from other countries.
events.flavor: "We have been told to take pride in our nation's independence from foreign produce; that everything we need, we can grow ourselves. At what point did this simple pride descend into delusions? How many more must die before our leaders admit we do not have food? It is time to swallow our pride, before it's the last thing in this country left to swallow."

options.name: We need to begin making exceptions.
We shall be self-sufficient, no matter the cost.

events.title: An Economic Prison

events.desc: The famine in … has sparked criticism of …'s economic policy of Mercantilism, with its focus on export-heavy trade.
events.flavor: "Some of our leaders seem to view … as simply a player at a table, trying to outsmart other nations to win some abstract game beyond the understanding of the common man. If they took their eyes off their balance sheets for a moment and looked at the people who are producing the goods on them, they might notice that those are flesh-and-blood humans, not pawns, and they need to eat."

options.name: Indispensable imports must be secured, even under mercantilism.
What do the poor know of national economy?

events.title: Unbalanced Trade

events.desc: The famine in … has sparked criticism of …'s economic policy of Free Trade, with its resignation to market forces.
events.flavor: "Freedom of trade, freedom of the markets, all poetic expressions to obfuscate what is really the freedom of those with money. For those without money, no matter how great the demand, there is no supply. To those who advocate this policy, fashioning themselves laissez-faire, I say this: You can lie to yourselves about death being visited on the poor by the invisible hand, but your victims will know on whose hands the blood truly is."

options.name: We can put our hand on the scales if it saves lives.
Markets set prices fairly; pay or die.

events.title: Freedom to Starve

events.desc: The famine in … has sparked criticism of …'s economic policy of Command Economy, with its reliance on government planning.
events.flavor: "Since the state seized control over our economy, we are often told that temporary shortages or even enduring problems are subordinate to grander plans for …'s future. That these failures would have been part of the plan was difficult to believe before. Now, as the famine claims lives every day, persisting in the belief that this is part of the state's grand design would be an even worse indictment of its moral bankruptcy than to declare it incompetent."

options.name: We must accept our failure and open our economy.
Famine? Sounds like opposition propaganda.

events.title: Failed Plans, Planned Failures

events.desc: Suspicions about an internal threat within our own generals and leaders have been on the rise, reaching …'s ears, and the necessity of exterminating threats against the fascist regime is palpable. Hasty words, elusive looks, they are everywhere. Everywhere.
events.flavor:
"Knives fell in the night—they were sleeping when we arrived.

"Get up!" The wooden floor was wet with their blood. "You have been accused of crimes against … and the regime, what do you have to say in your defense?"

And their voices were like horses snorting and thundering in the battlefield, gunfire, cannons. "This is nonsense!" "You have been charged with..." "Nonsense! This is all a mutiny! Hail …!" They are everywhere. Everywhere."

options.name: We must handle this with extreme caution.
Execute them publicly.
May they rot in jail.

events.title: Night of the Long Knives

events.desc: The fiery nationalistic speeches of …, an outspoken …, seem to have captivated certain segments of our populace. More and more people have adopted the symbols and slogans of the … movement.
events.flavor:
"Never was a city founded in just one day, or the oceans tamed in a couple of mornings, never were our ships the product of a lazy day, or the houses that shelter our families built in a fortnight.

Achieving the greatness that our nation deserves shall not and should not be an easy task. Like the architects of the past, we will raise wonders in our lands, immutable for eternity. Through passion, through strength, through power!"

options.name: Through power!
We don't need another agitator.
… has a much better vision.

events.title: Words of Encouragement

events.desc: Our streets are a safe haven for our people, with security officers ensuring their safety night and day, and seditionists marginalized from our fascist government.
events.flavor: "The warmth of the day makes the birds sing in a mandatory chant, rhythmically followed by the police alarms that patrol the streets. Children play in the park before the night curfew falls. A different—and safer—society is possible, and we're on the right direction."

options.name: We need to focus on the security.
People need to trust us.

events.title: The Organized Majority

events.desc: With fascist ideals taking root among other groups and discontent rising from the masses, members of the … have sought to influence the … into choosing more regime-aligned leaders.
events.flavor:
"Are you really going to let those scoundrels have no respect for our nation? The respect that the … had earned through so many years of hard work and reason is going to be forever lost under their incompetent rule.

Let them dream of a peaceful and equalitarian society like a naive child—there is only one way to achieve peace: dominion."

options.name: Indeed, there is only one way.
All roads lead to Rome.
Capitulation is death of a different kind.

events.title: Joining Our Cause

events.desc: The expansion of our nation's infrastructure has led to a more efficient and productive industry. Let this technological advancement be the first of many to come!
events.flavor:
"Those so-called "Great Powers" from outside our borders have tried to hinder us, to hurt our land and reputation, to hurt our people. But from this day forward they shall hurt us no more. There's nothing stronger than the … morale; not even the finest iron, the blades of antiquity or the steel from Damascus can compete.

And today we firmly prove that. The … nation cannot be economically sabotaged, for our infrastructure is now free of foreign predators."

options.name: We should use it to increase our construction speed.
Our shipyards will ensure us a place in the sun.

events.title: The Four Year Plan

events.desc: A union among our people is not only possible, but a reality. All the citizens of … are now united under the same banner, the same flag.
events.flavor: "The ancient legends of the past will soon find their counterpart in our own new legends. Our national heroes now gaze upon us with a smiling face. Our language, our culture, everything that makes us come together, sons and daughters of a common ancestry, we shall finally honor it."

options.name: Our nation, our culture!
We shouldn't let this victory disperse us.

events.title: National Myths

events.desc: A group of respectable musical composers teaching at the … in … have approached us. They have drawn attention to the alarming lack of a proper national anthem fit to invigorate our peoples' spirits.

options.name: Now, that's a cool anthem!

events.title: The Voice of the Nation

events.desc: The departure of the previous leader of the … has left a power vacuum in its leadership. It appears as if it will be filled by …, an open ….
events.flavor:
"…, of all people? … is, respectfully, a boor. To seat … alongside us would be insulting."

"The choice isn't ours to make, is it?"

"The … would veto it. … must veto it. Plenty of them can still see sense.

"I'm in two minds. Can we be certain that … truly believes anything at all? If we can become the ones who speak to … last... think on that."

options.name: There is no reason to interfere.
This … must not be allowed near government.

events.title: Open Succession

events.desc: The once-meteoric rise of the … movement seems to have plateaued. Whilst the ideology is certain to remain, it will face a less receptive public, and a much more seasoned opposition.
events.flavor:
There were those who had welcomed the rise of the fascist movement. It could be whatever they wished - laissez-faire, interventionist, paternalistic, libertarian, pious, secular. None of them had truly thought that its leaders believed in anything beyond dogged opposition to the communists, and every drop of blood spilled by a fascist truncheon was a drop that they would not need to shed themselves.

Perhaps they still did welcome it, and its millenarian promises of clean streets and no Reds. But it was too serious, now, too familiar - and it had become too unpopular. Those who cared about credibility had learned to stay silent, and to offer their token condemnations of the violence when they needed to. It was a peculiar aberration from the mean, they said, one that that had run its course. And that was all there was to it.

options.name: Good riddance.
This is not the end.

events.title: Falling Behind

events.desc: … has declared … intention to march on …, in the name of seizing power over …. … supporters are amassing at the outskirts of the city.
events.flavor: "We do not intend on coming to power through the back door. We do not intend to give up our formidable and ideal birthright for a miserable plate of ministerial lentils. Either they will give us the government, or we will take it ourselves!"

options.name: Authorize … to form a government.
We have every right to halt this coup.
Enough! Order this … deported.

events.title: The March on …

events.desc: The government of … has formally invited … to accede to the … of …. Whilst the … and … family will receive a government allowance, … time as an independent ruler will come to an end.
events.flavor:
"I, _______, Ruler of _______, in the exercise of my sovereignty in and over my said State Do hereby execute this is my Instrument of Accession and,

1. I hereby declare I accede to the … of India with the intent that the …, the Federal Legislature, the Federal Court, and any other authority established for the purposes of the … shall, by virtue of this my Instrument of Accession, but subject always to the terms thereof, and for the purposes only of the …, exercise in relation to the State of _______".

options.name: Sign the Instrument.
Our sovereignty cannot be bought.

events.title: … Offers Accession

events.desc: The last of the Princely States have been incorporated into the …. The authority of … now reaches across the entire subcontinent.
events.flavor:
"Thou art the ruler of the minds of all people,
dispenser of India's destiny.
Thy name rouses the hearts of the Punjab, Sindh, Gujarat and Maratha.
of the Dravida, Orissa and Bengal.
It echoes in the hills of the Vindhyas and Himalayas, mingles in the music of the Yamuna and Ganges
and is chanted by the waves of the Indian Ocean.
They pray for thy blessings and sing thy praise.
The saving of all people waits in thy hand,
thou dispenser of India's destiny.
Victory, Victory, Victory to thee."

— Rabindranath Tagore, "Jana Gana Mana"

options.name: Victory, victory, victory to You!

events.title: India Indivisible

events.flavor:
"The character of the Government which proclaims itself to represent all of India is fundamentally incompatible with that of the State of …. It has proved unwilling to reach equitable agreements with the other Indian States. I fear that, without a fundamental change in the diplomatic posture of the … Government, no constructive and enduring settlement, for … or otherwise, may be reached by any party.

It is thus that I, the sovereign … of …, in accordance with my peers amongst the other Indian states, announce my indefinite abstinence from the … in question."

options.name: India will be one, by pen or by sword.
There can be no revolution in silk gloves.

events.title: No Compromise

events.desc: The … of … has requested the accession of … state to the … of India.
events.flavor:
"I, … …, Ruler of …, in the exercise of my sovereignty in and over my said State Do hereby execute this is my Instrument of Accession and,

1. I hereby declare I accede to the … of India with the intent that the …, the Federal Legislature, the Federal Court, and any other authority established for the purposes of the … shall, by virtue of this my Instrument of Accession, but subject always to the terms thereof, and for the purposes only of the …, exercise in relation to the State of …".

options.name: A wise choice.
We have no need for another territory.

events.title: … Requests Accession

events.desc: A pamphlet in favor of … has been circulated illegally across most of our major cities.
events.flavor: "They print them faster than we can confiscate them, we've pretty much given up on containing it. No point now it's out there."

options.name: This will help our cause
We could use this to push a stronger message

events.title: Free Speech Pamphlets

events.desc: Members of the … have organized book burnings of material deemed anti-…. This is normalizing support for the … law.
events.flavor: "Books are the fangs in the poisonous snake of propaganda spreading their lies through the blood stream of society. Burning them is one very effective way of blunting those fangs."

options.name: This is excellent.
What if we organized state run book burnings?

events.title: Book Burnings

events.desc: The … law is having trouble gaining popular support as references to it are being suppressed by the current censorship apparatus.
events.flavor:
"Anything regarding censorship is immediately censored, so how on earth are we meant to have an open discussion about it?"

 "First time, eh? They're only as smart as what they understand. If they're none too literate, you can slip a few metaphors and similes past."

"What in blazes is a simile? Some crooked smile?"

options.name: Not much we can do.
Maybe we can skirt the laws a bit.

events.title: Overzealous Censorship

events.desc: We are having trouble drumming up support for the …. … are using the current lax laws to print and circulate thousands of propaganda leaflets and newspapers.
events.flavor: "They print a new leaflet almost every day, extolling the so called virtues of free press. It doesn't matter how good our arguments are, we can't be heard over all this noise."

options.name: This is out of our hands.
We could censor some of it... illegally

events.title: Overwhelming Propaganda

events.desc: The … has been caught reading a controversial censored book, sparking further questions over the debate about the … law.
events.flavor: "The … is meant to be the exemplar of our values and the fact … was caught reading anything as crass as 'The … … …' is frankly unacceptable."

options.name: Embarrassing, but this supports our cause!
We should make this go away as quickly as possible.

events.title: Lewd Literature

events.desc: A rude drawing of …, leader of the … has been distributed around the country.
events.flavor:
"Well, it's not exactly flattering, is it?" The aide said, contemplating the drawing. 

"Not exac-, It's a detailed drawing of me in congress with a donkey for heaven's sake! Why would it be flattering?" … replied, throwing his hands in the air. 

"That it is, but you can't deny they captured your likeness."

options.name: This is exactly our point!
Well this drawing *is* quite amusing.

events.title: An Insulting Drawing

options.name: Long live … …!
Long live the house of Orléans!
Long live … …!
Long live the heir of Saint Louis!
Long live … …!
Long live the house of Bonaparte!

events.desc: While the … cause of … has its fair share of opponents within the …, … has expressed an interest in aiding the movement, seeing within it a source of order well-suited to get … back on track.
events.flavor: "With the help of God, the devotion of our army, and with the support of all honest people, we will continue the work of restoring the morality of our country. We will preserve and protect the principles upon which our nation is based, and fight an uncompromising struggle against all enemies of society."

options.name: The … cause leaves little room for compromise.
Our goal is the religious reconquest of ….
Only the …s can shield us from radicalism.
Together we shall... ehr, sir, is this really us?

events.title: A Moral Order

events.desc: The efforts to promote the House of … as the sole legitimate dynasty of … are being obstructed by the prominent … …, who claims … … is nothing but an upjumped bandit.
events.flavor: "A orderly nation must be built upon solid foundations. There is nothing about that house which is 'solid'. Look at them... wrong-headed fools and opportunists, the lot of them!"

options.name: The "Legitimists" squandered their mandate in 1830.
And some beret-wearing Spanish shepherd is supposed to have a better claim?
Upjumped bandits? Have those amnesiacs forgotten the July Revolution?
Is the spawn of the Corsican Ogre meant to be more legitimate?
Authorize some counter-propaganda.
Lèse-majesté, you say? Well gag … then!

events.title: A House Divided

events.desc: Opposed to what they see as the artificially imposed political ideals of the Revolution, members of the country's traditional classes are coming out in support of the … cause.
events.flavor: "Have you been to the city recently? It's obscene how they carry on there. It's like order has been put on its head, with some of the things people do there. Out here, at least, everybody still knows how they're supposed to carry on and what they are."

options.name: A toast to the hardworking tiller and his family!
God bless the parish priest and the flock he leads.
Together, we shall safeguard … from Godless radicals.

events.title: The Real Country

events.desc: Three dynasties have claims on the French throne: the … line backs the constitutional July Monarchy, the … line supports the descendants of Charles X, while the … line seek to restore Napoleon's French Empire.
events.flavor: Three lines have risen to claim one crown. Once the arch-enemy of Rome, then the jewel of Christendom, and now... heirs to an uncertain future. The days of the Revolution are fresh in French minds. Another now, so soon, could spell disaster. Blood may run in the streets before this matter is truly settled.

options.name: Support the Bonapartist pretenders.
Stand by the House of Orleans.
Support the Legitimist pretenders.
Down with the monarchy!

events.title: Pretenders to the Throne

events.desc: The crisis throughout … has proven too much for … to handle. … has been forced to abdicate and flee the country, and a provisional republican government has been declared.
events.flavor:
"From that day, a thousand strange systems issued impetuously from the minds of the innovators, and spread through the troubled minds of the crowd. Everything was still standing except royalty and parliament, and it seemed that from the shock of the revolution, society itself had been reduced to dust, and that the new form that should be given to society had been put to competition."

— Alexis de Tocqueville

options.name: Long live the Republic!

events.title: The Provisional Government

events.desc: With the … monarchy restored anew, and a regent temporarily occupying the throne, the time has come to determine which dynasty will be entrusted with the restored crown of France.
events.flavor: The bells toll at Rheims, but no king sits upon the throne. The three great houses stood apart from each other, its pretenders unwilling to seize the throne. Should one move too quickly, it will face a war on two fronts. France itself seemed in no hurry for the 'right' king to take the throne, only that a king sat upon it.

options.name: The house of Bonaparte will lead us to glory.
The house of Orleans will grant France prosperity.
The house of Bourbon will avenge the crimes of the Revolution.
The dynasties of old have proven themselves all too fallible.

events.title: The New Monarchy

options.name: Long live … …!
Long live the house of Orléans!
Long live … …!
Long live the heir of Saint Louis!
Long live … …!
Long live the house of Bonaparte!
