events.desc: …, the eloquent leader of the …, has authored a vivid tract outlining the … political program.
events.flavor: "Friends! We must dream of a better tomorrow for all of France. What is the current regime but a cruel mockery of France's history, all it has ever fought for and all it has ever achieved? To rejuvenate the nation, to move forward, we must forge a new society, picking the very best elements of our history and our traditions to create an order which shall withstand the onslaught of modernity!"

options.name: Let us create a new tomorrow with the House of …!
The whole nation must hear what the … dynasty plans for the future!
… and … deserve plaudits for this work!

events.title: The … World

events.desc: Monarchists among the … are refusing to swear a loyalty oath to the current government. While ideologically pure, this may undermine their efforts to build political capital in the nation.
events.flavor: "How can I swear an allegiance to some pretender regime? To do so would be a betrayal of the crown, and grant this twisted caricature of France a recognition of legitimacy that it does not deserve. No, I say! I shall never serve this bastard regime."

options.name: … show an admirable commitment to their ideals.
Realistic compromise will help the cause, but upset hardliners.

events.title: Fidelity & Perjury

events.desc: The … … and … … recognize that they share one common goal: the overthrow of the current regime. Some partisans have gone further with that realization, and are supporting each other in courtroom cases, publishing tracts, and other opposition activities.
events.flavor: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend, is he not? Of course, all those bums over there came to the wrong conclusions about what is to be done, but we can burn that bridge when we get to it."

options.name: Destroying the establishment requires solidarity among all sorts.
It is better to be alone and correct than compromised with bad company.
Such unnatural collaboration cannot possibly maintain itself.

events.title: Strange Bedfellows

events.desc: The … and … developed a surprisingly close relationship during their mutual time in opposition. Following the … Restoration, … has announced … conversion to the monarchist cause of … old allies.
events.flavor: "I admired the determination and sheer grit of the … when they were hounded by the authorities, and I fondly look back on my time spent collaborating with …, a fine and capable figure. It has become obvious to be that their cause is my cause, and I urge my compatriots to follow my example."

options.name: The Damascene conversion of … is welcomed!
Once a republican, always a republican—spurn ….

events.title: Republican Apostasy

events.desc: The … dynasty has tightened its grip on the French crown to the point that no other claimants pose a serious challenge to its monarchist credentials any longer.
events.flavor: "Friends! Does our great sovereign, …, have any equal? No, I say! … is the center of the universe, the one true pillar of order and the nation. The House of … is without equal!"

options.name: … is without peer.
Supporters of the … dynasty deserve all the praise!

events.title: The Eternal House of …

events.desc: The good spirits of … soldiers in our current conflict brings rise to memories of the triumphant armies of Napoléon I. The … cause has enjoyed an increase in popularity along the frontlines
events.flavor: Stirrings among the people and soldiery alike rumbled through the streets. From the dampest inn corners to the trodden fields, the memory of Napoleon's first decisive victories rouse all. France's grand regiments might again march through … at the order of a new Bonaparte.

options.name: The … will lead us to many more victories.
Patronize the soldiers for their good showing.
This bodes well for the … cause.

events.title: The Heirs of the Grande Armée

events.desc: The prosperity of … trade has greatly benefited the wealthy patrons of the … cause. They have reinvested their funds in supporting their candidate's claims.
events.flavor: The more things change, the more they stay the same. The barons of old held forges and fields. Today, they hold machines and merchant warehouses. It makes no difference to a wise king which keys the barons keep, so long as the keys stay in the right hands.

options.name: The … is the patron of … prosperity.
Our magnates deserve praise for their hard work.
This bodes well for the … cause.

events.title: The Fruits of Industry

events.desc: The burgeoning prestige and influence of the … has led to a corresponding rise in the fortunes of the … cause. Nostalgic clergymen sing the praises of the kings of old.
events.flavor: The brass bells of Rheims were polished to a mirror gleam that morning. It is long since a coronation was held here. Once the bells heralded days of kings, named by God as the shining jewel in His crown. Now, only ghosts and cobwebs accompany the bells. But the Kingdom of God is eternal, and it is only a matter of time before the bells sing for a new king.

options.name: The … will remember their support.
The Church is the bedrock upon which we rest.
This bodes well for the … cause.

events.title: The Words of the Church

events.desc: … has pledged the … in full to the … cause. Whilst ambitious, … statements have aroused controversy both within the … and without.
events.flavor:
…: "My Heart for …!"

 An auspicious day arrives for House …. Prolific Royalist and outspoken pundit for the …, … voices support for the house's ascent to Charlemagne's throne. The people of … were quick to shout both support and slander for …'s announcement this morning. (cont'd pg. 2)

options.name: … had best preserve decorum.
What good is a reputation, if it cannot be spent?

events.title: … Endorses … Cause

events.desc: … … has made numerous statements in support of the … cause, using … position in the military to spread … beliefs far and wide.
events.flavor:
"My family bled for Napoleon and his grand dreams of Europe under France. And now a new pretender comes to ask me to bleed for the same dream."

"Not any pretender, General. Not any dream either. A throne restored, greater than any republic before or to come. And with you at its head. We will not have it any other way."

options.name: Our soldiers sing the praises of the … cause.
The …s would benefit from a consistent advocate.
… words threaten a coup. Dismiss him at once.

events.title: A … Army?

events.desc: …, an experienced and fiercely populist political advocate, has embarked upon a campaign to further the claim of … … cause amongst the common people.
events.flavor:
Rheims Tolls for House …!

A new king; a new Charlemagne! Long live France! Long live …!

Civil march in … behind …. Marchers are encouraged to wear the colors of ….

options.name: Quite the boon for … cause.
… work will place the … leaders in a new light.

events.title: The People for the …s

events.desc: …, a devoted …, has carried out a series of verbal attacks and accusations of opportunism against the leading … cause.
events.flavor:
"I presume you understand your summons today, monsieur. These delays have gone on long enough."

"Of course His Majesty's will be done, and with the utmost care and alacrity. But surely given the history of our glorious nation, should it not be His Majesty's interest for his decrees to be accepted by all?"

"We are not amused by your games, …."

options.name: Urge … to be silent, lest … escalate too far.
A fiery and entertaining display.

events.title: A Scuffle of Houses

events.flavor: France was no stranger to kingslaying. Its revolutions carried out by fire and shot, and a tidal wave of seething fury unleashed all at once. Likewise, its rulers have come to know the warning signs well. A spiteful scowl here, and a murderous stare there; tinder waiting for the right match.

options.name: The will of the people is fickle at best.
The …'s reign is worth some broken ribs.
We must brace ourselves and weather the storm.
These tides must be broken here and now.

events.title: Swirling Discontent

events.desc: King Charles X, the ruler of … before the July Revolution, has passed away whilst in exile in …. Supporters of the Legitimists have petitioned for the return of his body to … for burial.
events.flavor: The king was dead, but few were ready to cry the old refrain. Thousands called for the exiled king's body to return to France for interment. 'Tradition,' they said. Thousands of others swore oaths to burn the corpse. 'Cholera,' they said.

options.name: He waived his right in 1830.
We can make the effort to heal the rifts of July.

events.title: The Death of Charles X

events.desc: The body of Napoleon Bonaparte has been returned from …, and transported from Saint Helena to … soil. The interment of the Emperor's body presents an opportunity to rehabilitate the Imperial past.
events.flavor: "I count myself happy that it has been reserved for me to return to the soil of France the mortal remains of him who added so much glory to our pomp and to pay the debt of our common Fatherland by surrounding his coffin with all the honors due to him."

options.name: We have put the Empereur to rest at last.
Use this opportunity to court the Bonapartists.

events.title: Le Retour des Cendres

events.desc: Judging our struggle against … just, the Italian revolutionary and nationalist … has decided to align with our cause, offering up his services as a general.

options.name: Have … lead our armies.
We have no use for this rabble-rousing wildcard.

events.title: Garibaldi Offers His Services

events.flavor: "Where there are brothers who fight for Italian freedom – there we must rush."

options.name: Godspeed, General ….

events.title: Garibaldi Bids His Farewells

events.desc: Drawing on the Italian population of …, General … has organized a legion of like-minded compatriots to join the … fight against … tyranny.
events.flavor:
"My men!
We are few, the enemy are many,
more glorious will be the victory.
Be steady, reserve your fire until they are close on you,
then fire,
and at them with the bayonet!"

options.name: Their skills and zeal are sorely needed on the battlefield.
Use their expertise to train and recruit more men for the army.

events.title: The Italian Legion of Volunteers

events.desc: While …'s abilities to move the minds of commoners have proven useful in the fight against …, his radical preachings are starting to turn some of …'s … against our own rule as well—with several government ministers now demanding he be gagged.
events.flavor: "The day the peasants will be educated in the truth, tyrants and slaves will be impossible on Earth."

options.name: He is too important for the cause. Let us avoid antagonization.
Order him to tone down his language.

events.title: Garibaldi Riles Up the Peasantry

events.desc: The … demand the promotion of … …, touting … history of loyal and effective service.
events.flavor:
So many medals adorned … jacket that one could scarcely see the fabric beneath, but it was not yet enough. Chest puffed out with pride, the General smiled as … imagined the look on …'s face when the … learned of … imminent ascension; their rivalry was legendary among the officers.

At last … would have … due.

options.name: … has earned it.
The … will not force our hand.

events.title: Due a Promotion

events.flavor: From the scattered fiefdoms of the Holy Roman Empire to the chaos of Napoleon's wake, Germany has never truly been united. What the … state has achieved today is a step towards the impossible and the inevitable.

options.name: The statesmen responsible are national heroes.
The world will know of our achievement.

events.title: German Leadership

events.desc: With … now seen as the sole realistic option for German Unification, many minor German states have opted to join their banner. Should we give up our independence for the sake of greater German unity?
events.flavor: "By joining this confederation with …, we may be surrendering … sovereignty, but by doing so, we help to secure German sovereignty. The spirit of the times is undeniable; the German people desire unity, and the … seems set to be the ones to make it happen. To oppose the coming together of the German people would be utter folly."

options.name: For Germany!
Our sovereignty is inviolable.

events.title: Confederation with …

events.desc: A nobleman named … has risen to a prominent position among the … …. Advocating for German national unity and political pragmatism, he offers his services to the state.
events.flavor: "I shall soon be compelled to undertake the conduct of the … Government. My first care will be to reorganize the army, with or without the help of the Landtag. As soon as the army shall have been brought into such a condition as to inspire respect, I shall seize the first best pretext to declare war against Austria, dissolve the German Diet, subdue the minor States, and give national unity to Germany under … leadership."

options.name: Appoint Bismarck as Chancellor.
Realpolitik is not the right policy.

events.title: The Iron Chancellor

events.desc: The tireless efforts of statesmen and soldiers has been rewarded; Germany is united into a single state.
events.flavor: Through blood and iron, through diplomacy and guile, Germany is united. It is a day of triumph and of reflection. However the future unfolds, the German state will surely play a leading role in deciding the fate of mankind.

options.name: All hail the ….
This is a victory for the German people.

events.title: German Unification

events.flavor: "The German Confederation? The Confederation is a joke, a relic of a bygone era, a foreign imposition! For the German people to prosper and assume our rightful place in Europe, we must have a true German Nation!"

options.name: Momentous times are ahead of us.

events.title: German National Identity

events.desc: Gold has been discovered in …. People from all corners of the earth are converging there, confident that they will discover the next great lode and become incredibly rich.
events.flavor: It was a single, misplaced foot in the river. His son quick at his side, hoisting him from the water before the currents claimed him. Then, as the sediment rose with both his leg and his walking stick, they saw it: the unmistakable shimmer of Plutus' very blood. By next morning, they were both at the river with sieves and shovels. By that night, the whole town joined them.

options.name: Spread the word!
Mine! It's all mine!
Always spread the word.
It's always mine!

events.title: Gold Rush!

events.desc: The rich mineral deposits in … have been drained. Mines are being shuttered, and all the prospectors who moved in are beginning to drift away, in search of the next big strike.
events.flavor:
Alluvial Gold Dried Up: Miners Go Home

River dried up due to miner activity. Shafts condemned as threat to life.

Enter at own peril. Trespassers will be shot. Survivors will be shot again.

options.name: Unfortunate.
We cannot just let them leave!
Always let them go.
We should never let them leave!

events.title: Gold Fields Depleted

events.desc: The … have spoken out against the migrants moving into …, pleading with the government to support "native" miners by discouraging migration into the state.
events.flavor: "Do you really think that they're moving just because they want to work? Just take a look around! What do you see here? That's it! Gold! They have greed in their eyes, I tell you, they're coming to take it all from us and they won't leave a penny behind. What's even wrong with trying to protect the future of our people?"

options.name: We need every spare hand we can get in ….
Limit migration into ….

events.title: Foreign Influx Provokes Outcry

events.desc: Miners and mine owners are both scrambling to protect their interests in … by formally organizing themselves and their work. However, the approaches of the … and the … cannot work together.
events.flavor: "One of the … lightly taps the crystal of the window; the sound is amplified by the emptiness of the storage room. "Do you also want me to hand them the gold? Part of my house?" he asks generously, his back still facing the door. "What's mine is mine and what's yours is yours. The mines are what's mine.""

options.name: Support the ….
Support the ….

events.title: The Mines Get Organized

events.desc: A story has been making the rounds about a miner who struck it rich and became the wealthiest man in his town. People in … are beginning to live beyond their means, convinced they'll all become rich soon enough.
events.flavor: "Did you see his new house? The dining room is all paneled and framed in pine, and finished enamel white, with furniture of teak. An imported chandelier, made by some obscure artisan whose name no one can pronounce again. And all of it comes from the mines! All of it!"

options.name: It can't be that harmful.

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Middle Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: All that is gold does not glitter.

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Middle Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

events.title: The … Dream

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"You would understand my argument a lot better if you had read anything written in the last hundred years!"

"I refuse to read anything from an era in which uneducated people are taught to write."

options.name: Innovators should leave the 'why' to others and focus on the 'how'.
Nobles must accept that they are behind the times.
Intellectual and hereditary elites need to collaborate.

events.title: Breeding and Education

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"In my day, a suggestion like that would have cost you your head."
"Pray then that the price we exact from you will not be so steep, when my day comes."

options.name: The unions must show loyalty to their country.
Landowners must accept the power of the workers.
We cannot let class conflict tear this government apart.

events.title: All Hitherto Existing Society

events.desc: The … are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the … in the … government.
events.flavor: "You say that anyone can attain wealth, with enough skill, hard work and a bit of good fortune. No need then for virtue or faith, as long as you have faith in yourself. What do those who pass that bar have in common, besides greed and a love for material things?"

options.name: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
The power of money must be kept in check.
Prosperity and charity should be companions, not enemies.

events.title: Eye of the Needle

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"How can anyone put reason above faith, when surely reason is what opens ones eyes to divine providence acting upon the world?"
"What you fail to understand is that when your eyes are open, it is only with difficulty one can go back to being blind."

options.name: Superstitious nonsense belongs in the past.
Eschewing tradition is the height of arrogance.
Science determines fact, faith determines morality.

events.title: Faith and Reason

events.desc: The … are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the … in the … government.
events.flavor: "Poverty is a terrible plague upon mankind and must be fought with compassion and charitable hearts. To fight those more fortunate, to seek reward for your poverty in this life instead of bearing as we must bear all burdens, is to forsake one's own salvation."

options.name: All the charity in the world does not solve poverty.
The labor movement could stand to be a bit more humble.
Don't let different methods stand in the way of your common goals.

events.title: Pie in the Sky

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"It might seem radical to you, but if you read the theory, I'd be surprised if you can find a single flaw."
"One thing I've learned from running a business is that experience beats even a flawless theory when you try to put it into practice."

options.name: No progress was ever made without putting theory into practice.
So-called intellectuals should keep their feet on the ground.
We need progress, but at a safe and reliable pace.

events.title: The Man on the Street

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"How do you ever expect to be taken seriously when all you do is destroy things and demand a larger share of what other people have built?"
"If you think you have built anything by directing other people, you're ill suited to run a business, let alone a nation."

options.name: The workers should be led by workers.
Those who earn success deserve to reap its fruits.
The important thing is that work gets done, not how.

events.title: Hard Work and Hard Workers

events.desc: The … are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the … in the … government.
events.flavor: "Something tells me, when they've built all their factories and machines that are supposed to relieve us of our burdens, we'll still be harvesting the grapes and they'll still be drinking the wine."

options.name: Like it or not, industrialization is the future.
We must not forget those who feed the city-dwellers.
Factories and farms will be equally needed in …'s future.

events.title: These Dark Satanic Mills

events.desc: The … are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the … in the … government.
events.flavor: "At what point after you declare that you will dedicate your life to defending your country do you realize how absurd the lie is that you have told yourself? Is it when you aim your weapons at your brothers and sisters standing up to injustice, or only when you pull the trigger?"

options.name: The army keeps the peace. Disturb it at your peril.
The struggle within is more important than the struggle without.
Let us hope the conflict never escalates that far.

events.title: Country or Class

events.desc: The … are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the … in the … government.
events.flavor: "You keep talking about taking risks, to be bold, to dare to dream. Do you even know what it means? Have you ever risked anything but your own rotten reputation?"

options.name: Respect the soldiers who protect your right to pontificate.
Do what you do best, soldiers, and follow orders.
A nation needs protection from both armies and bad ideas.

events.title: Thought and Action

events.desc: Disagreements between the … and the … are causing conflicts in government.
events.flavor:
"Do you believe that you create value purely out of your own visions? You can only persist in those delusions because you never see the hands below you that do the work."
"Those hands would be idle, were it not for the minds at work which you never see acting above you."

options.name: Capital drives progress.
Workers deserve the fruits of their labor.
Try to set class conflict aside for the common causes.

events.title: Political Economy

events.desc: Following the … entering open insurrection, the power the … held over the … nation has been utterly broken. Loyal government officials have proposed the abolition of the party to preserve the state.
events.flavor:
"We have tied ourselves at the hip to them, and now find ourselves hobbled by their departure. We must act! We will salvage these scant few things, or we will salvage nothing."

The … regarded the reports of despair and defection coating … desk, and made … decision.

options.name: We must install an emergency government.
Offer an olive branch before it is too late.

events.title: The Party Wavers

options.name: We will see what we can do.
Offer them … as a compromise.
They must understand the present situation does not allow for this.
They must understand the present situation does not allow for this.

events.desc: The growth of … into a powerful, unified nation has inspired radical supporters of Simón Bolívar's ambition. These visionaries propose revisiting the Congress of Panama's goal of establishing a unified Federation stretching along the entire Andes.
events.flavor:
A united South America: no beast so fierce, and no man so great as a new patria. The scattered children of Spain brought under a single banner. A new confederacy built on brotherly blood, rather than a cannon-point covenant to a far-away king.

The path to union will be long and treacherous. But no thing worth doing was ever easy.

options.name: The peoples of South America will be stronger together.
This plan is reckless and arrogant.

events.title: The Federation Proposal

events.desc: Our years of effort have finally paid off, and the pan-Andean dream has finally been achieved. The strength of the … will assure that we cannot be conquered by any foreign foe.
events.flavor: The pen cleared the paper. The gavel struck, and the announcement came after. Cheers erupted across the continent, from the highest peaks to the deepest valleys. Though he would never live to see it, Simón Bolívar's grand dream has finally come to pass. The dream of a united, Hispanophone South American federation, unyielding and true. May the Federation of the Andes stand as firm as the mountains themselves.

options.name: Let us stand together and celebrate this achievement.
We must continue our work to deter foreign aggression.

events.title: A Grand Unification

events.desc: With recent developments, certain figures in the … government have taken interest in seeking the unification of the Northern Bolivarian states, and restoration of the former state of Gran Colombia.
events.flavor:
The embers of Simón Bolívar's dream are still in living memory. Stirrings of nationalism rouse in the eldest of …. Those with a keen enough ear to listen now turn to their neighbors. Perhaps it isn't so far-fetched to see one's neighbor as a brother.

Perhaps the time is now, with the fresh idea of a nation. All that needs to be done is the destruction of those who would oppose it.

options.name: Our strength, once lost, will be found again.
We respect the sovereignty of our neighbors.

events.title: Gran Colombia

events.desc: Through great effort, the state of … has been restored to existence. With its rise, the formerly independent states of the North Andes have become one indivisible nation.
events.flavor: Through countless days of turmoil and the blood of thousands, a new player on the world stage emerges. One nation, one purpose, brothers all finally divested of the Spanish crown. A new day has come in South America. In the eyes of God and men, let all know that Gran Colombia stands tall.

options.name: This day will be marked in history!
We have not forgotten our Caribbean friends.

events.title: Reforging the Dream

events.desc: The recent resurgence of …'s military power has given rise to nostalgia for solidarity of the wars of independence. Calls to seek the restoration of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata have begun to echo through ….
events.flavor:
"Is it really so foolish, father? La Plata is a big place, and we have bigger bullies around us. We will need each other before long, no?"

"No. The last time it happened, La Plata got too small for all of us. One of those bigger bullies smashed our door in with it. We keep them out by being small and smart, not large and quarrelsome."

"Your brothers failed, father. You failed too. But we can learn from your mistakes and do it right this time."

options.name: La Plata will be one.
Our neighbors have already chosen self-determination.

events.title: The Spirit of Tucumán

events.desc: With our restoration of a unified …, the formerly disparate Platinean nations have become one, indivisible whole.
events.flavor: Men in freshly sewn uniforms and well-oiled boots marched in lockstep. Cheers and waving flags of the newly fledged union greeted them along the streets and windows. The youngest in the company eyed his father at the edge of the road. In one of the old man's eyes was a tear of pride, and in the other was a tinge of regret. His lip wobbled as he joined the applause for his victorious son.

options.name: Let sacred freedom and union reign!
Our rule must extend to the Pacific.

events.title: From River to Straits

events.desc: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and by all accounts, rather disappointing.
events.flavor:
"A reflective umbrella, some form of diamond smaller and duller than the one you've seen your grandmother wear, a carriage that still smells like the streets.

"I traveled across half the country for this and for what?"

options.name: Oh well.

events.title: The Not So Great Exhibition

events.desc: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and has been very well received.
events.flavor: "Countless wonders were to be seen there: glass domes bigger than any I'd seen, diamonds as large as your fist. Kids would ask what kind of animal this and that was, and no one could even answer. I couldn't believe it, it felt like visiting another world."

options.name: This is great!

events.title: The Great Exhibition

events.desc: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and is being heralded as one of the greatest exhibitions of the age.
events.flavor:
"And this statue we rescued from the sea," and then it was displayed near the central fountain, still stained by the water. "If you dare to look through this glass, my dear, you'd be able to see the most forlorn constellations."

At the other side of the hall, … welcomed all visitors, dressed all in white.

There were trumpets and cheering, and music and smoke, and fascination and there was awe, and there was—life, so bright.

options.name: Wonderful. Just... wonderful.

events.title: The Greatest Exhibition

events.desc: The planning of the Exhibition causes controversy as its opening approaches. Members of the … have expressed their concerns about a mass of visitors becoming a potential revolutionary mob.
events.flavor:
"The folly and absurdity of the … in allowing this trumpery must strike every sensible and well-thinking mind, and I am astonished the ministers themselves do not insist on … at least going to … during the Exhibition, as no human being can possibly answer for what may occur on the occasion.

The idea... must shock every honest and well-meaning … man. But it seems everything is conspiring to lower us in the eyes of Europe."

options.name: Their concerns are unfounded.
The big influx of visitors may cause some problems.

events.title: Steaming Suspicions

events.desc: Members of the … have explicitly stated that installing public restrooms in the Exhibition will harm its good odor and reputation.
events.flavor:
"Mommy, mommy! I need to spend a penny! If only the government of this country had installed some public restrooms!"

Oh, goodness. We were not prepared for this.

options.name: Its good odor and reputation would be worse if we don't install them.
We should not compromise the Exhibition for this.

events.title: Spending a Penny

events.desc: With the imminent opening of the Exhibition, we must prepare ourselves for visitors wanting to return with a small piece of it.
events.flavor:
A perfume-soaked woman wanders around the Exhibition with pompous motion. "Little August would love this!" she says, while standing near any visible item. You doubt that little August will love the mechanisms of a fountain, but you won't contradict her. 

"Leeches!" you can hear her scream, remarkably elated.

options.name: Stereoscope cards will let them see the Exhibition once again.
A paper souvenir would be easily affordable for anyone.

events.title: A Dazzling Souvenir

events.desc: Suspicious gentlemen have been reported charging an extra fee for special items inside the Exhibition hall.
events.flavor:
There's a man with a tall hat—a very, very tall hat. He's pointing at one of the telescopes, this one looks specially important. "Would you, little sir, want to try it? For just one penny you can discover the wonders of the night sky!"

You pause. The machine shines. You swear you can see it pulsing beneath all that steel. The entrance cost you a whole shelling. Your pockets are ragged. The man has now a sharp smile—a very, very sharp smile.

options.name: We cannot let these men tarnish the good name of the Exhibition.
We can all use one or two extra pennies...

events.title: A Matter of Business

events.desc: Members of the Exhibition Committee have suggested that elements from the past expeditions should be featured prominently in the hall.
events.flavor:
It is difficult to resist his words, especially said in such a passionate manner. He throws his head back in laughter at something his companion mentions, so unambitious.

"It's about the distant jungles of Africa," he eagerly explains, "the barren plains of America, the unexplored mountains of Antarctica. So few of our citizens will ever visit a single one of these places—we shall bring these places to them."

options.name: An exceptional specimen of a rhino.
These photographs were taken on the Great Plains.
These exotic American flowers have never been seen before.
A necklace traded with an African chief.
A film recorded in the Niger River.
Maps that chart the Western Frontier.
A mysterious rock found in the Antarctic wastes.

events.title: An Exceptional Collection

events.desc: The rise of nationalism has created an irredentist desire among our citizens to incorporate all the lands of the … people under a single Greek state.
events.flavor: "We have cast aside centuries of Ottoman rule to bring the Greek state into being. Yet it is not enough. Many of our countrymen still live under the oppressive yoke of foreign rule, yearning for a country they can call their own. This dream can only be realized through the annexation of all the Greek lands, which we will achieve with or without the consent of their occupiers."

options.name: Our claim to this land is irrefutable.
Expansion is not a priority for now.

events.title: The Greek State

events.desc: The expansion of the Greek state has led some of the most fervent nationalists to propose an even more ambitious project: the restoration of the Byzantine Empire through the conquest of … and ….
events.flavor: "That which yesterday would have seemed an absurd pipe dream is now within our grasp. The purple phoenix will rise again!"

options.name: Byzantium will be restored.
This agenda is much too ambitious.

events.title: The Title of Eastern Rome

events.desc: Through careful negotiations, … has ceded the … to ….
events.flavor: "To promote good will between our nations and to bolster the spirit of the … people, the … has graciously ceded the Ionian Islands. Our amical protectorate, under which the Islands benefited from our true and just assistance, is deemed at an end and we trust that the people of these isles will prosper under the benevolent care of our trusted friends."

options.name: A most agreeable solution.

events.title: The Treaty of London

events.flavor:
The … of … delivers a speech that will resonate in the hearts of all … people for generations to come:

"A nation, which by its fall enlightened many other nations, today stands up again, and not as before, when it was divided into many small states, but as a united state with its own government, religion and political existence forever guaranteed by the constitution."

options.name: … will continue to flourish.
… has earned the respect it deserves.
Repatriate our people to ….

events.title: … Rises Again

events.desc: The aggressive pursuit of …'s irredentist project is no longer tenable.
events.flavor: The tension in the room is palpable. Politicians and advisors argue over the sustainability to pursue …'s ambitious agenda. Each demands a responsible party be held accountable for the mismanagement of … resources used in this irredentist endeavor that has failed to manifest.

options.name: Our failure is an embarrassment.
… must be held accountable.

events.title: Untenable Project

events.desc: … representatives have come to negotiate the terms of ceding … to ….
events.flavor:
The … representatives present their proposal before a meeting of the … Cabinet:

"To promote good will between our nations and to bolster the spirit of the … people, our … asks that … be released from the amical protectorate, under which the Islands benefited from your true and just assistance."

options.name: A most agreeable solution.
Our continued intervention is needed.

events.title: The Treaty of London

events.desc: Years of optimism and financial growth have come to a screeching halt, with blood-red numbers numbers reported across German stock exchanges as banks and speculative companies collapse like dominos.
events.flavor:
Bank Run in …
The announcement of the liquidation of a series of prominent companies triggered an avalanche, sweeping away not only small investors but also well-known financiers. All day, telegram couriers have been frantically dashing through crowds, and merchants were seen burning their worthless stock certificates.

options.name: Speculators and rampant economic liberalism is to blame.
This is the work of predatory agents in our midst.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Gründerkrach

events.desc: Following decades of economic prosperity, the intense drive and activity that defined them has now somewhat abated. These years will go down in … history as some of her most glorious.
events.flavor: "And they called it a bubble, pah! A bubble!? Only a fool would invest their spouse's inheritance in something like that, and I will tell you one thing, liebchen, I am no fool."

options.name: Three cheers to man's indomitable entrepreneurial spirit!
May these decades merely be the first of many.

events.title: Thirty Years of Progress

events.desc: Spurred on by innovations in financial law and the proliferation of the railway, the German lands are abuzz with activity, with new companies and business ventures springing up like toadstools.
events.flavor:
The foreman cracks his whip again, driving the exhausted team of horses forward. They had made decent progress today—most of the sand had been carried off the site. But decent is not good. And even good is hardly sufficient.

The whip cracks out again.

The foreman feels a pang of guilt for the poor creatures, but quickly pushes the thought away. Mercy will not transform this site into a new factory. Determination will.

options.name: Buy! Invest! Expand!
Let us not get too carried away.

events.title: The Age of Entrepreneurs

events.desc: With the death of the King, local business owners and foreign ministers seek to increase their influence in Hawaii.
events.flavor: "We have maintained our independence for a while now, but the eyes of greater nations are staring at us hungrily, waiting for the moment to pounce. I fear that that time is rapidly approaching."

options.name: We must take steps to maintain our independence.

events.title: Death of the King

events.desc: With our strength shown and local business owners placated, we can now look to increase our standing on the international stage.
events.flavor: "We have shown our resolve towards those who would want nothing more than to take control of Hawaii. Even though we are stronger now, we are still not out of the woods."

options.name: The worst is behind us.
Deport the disloyal.

events.title: Strengthening Our Position

events.desc: Groups of protesters and local militia led by a coalition of business owners and ambassadors from … have successfully taken over the Government and are now petitioning to have the country annexed.
events.flavor: "Our independence and freedom are now at risk. We lay helplessly at the feet of … and must accept the new reality we have been given. Our nation itself is being held hostage!"

options.name: How did it come to this?

events.title: A Foreign Coup

events.desc: Local business owners with the help of our ambassador to Hawaii have staged a coup against the local government and are requesting that we incorporate the islands before others take advantage of the situation.
events.flavor: "Hawaii is the keystone of the Pacific Ocean. Now that we have control over its future, we now also have control over the ocean. We will be able to more easily facilitate trade throughout the region."

options.name: Occupy the islands, but keep them autonomous.
If we don't, someone else might.
We will not be a part of this coup.

events.title: The Territory of Hawaii

events.desc: The Hawaiian Government has deported our citizens from their islands and seized their property. We must respond to this appropriately.
events.flavor: "How dare they deport our citizens and take control of private business. Such a seizure of land is not only unprecedented, but unacceptable. We shall not tolerate this humiliation."

options.name: It was their own fault.
This is unacceptable!

events.title: Deported Business Owners

events.desc: Farmers in … have been making appeals to the government about the dangers of the equipment they are using, and would like to have some sort of healthcare to reduce the hardships for them.
events.flavor: "Neighbor came over to my house the other day. As he stood there at my door grabbing his right hand with his left, I realized he cut three of his fingers clean off. I was no doctor, but he needed help so I did the best that I could. Just wish there was someone he could have gone to that knew better."

options.name: Try and offer help.
Focus on establishing Healthcare.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Agriculture
Mortality of Laborers employed in Ranching
Mortality of Farmers employed in Agriculture

options.name: This isn't for the poor anyways.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Agriculture
Mortality of Laborers employed in Ranching
Mortality of Farmers employed in Agriculture

events.title: Injured Farmers

events.desc: With the calls for some form of healthcare system, many are questioning where the money for setting up the new Healthcare System will come from. Some are suggesting simply taking it out of our tax funds, while others insist the government should find another way to cover the costs.
events.flavor: "Let me get this straight, you expect us to not only pay for our own healthcare but someone else’s as well? I don't want the money I pay in taxes to be used so some random farmers to be able to get healthcare. That is not my responsibility. I have my own health and family to think of. I can’t possibly afford to look after everyone else in … as well."

options.name: Take it from the tax funds.
The government should cover the costs.
We can get by without it.

events.title: Health Taxes

events.desc: As ironic as it might be, many members of the government seem to have caught a cold today, the day of the debate. Few members have enough strength to make it in for the debate.
events.flavor: "If that isn’t the kicker. The day we are meant to discuss national healthcare, half the cabinet is out sick and can’t so much as get out of bed. Maybe this is a blessing in disguise. Doesn’t look like we will be able to get anything decided today though."

options.name: We can’t hold a vote today.
Try and force the vote through anyways.

events.title: Bedridden Government

events.desc: Due to a shortage of public healthcare services, citizens around the nation who can not afford their own medical care have begun demanding more accessible and available healthcare.
events.flavor: "Have you spent a day harvesting crops or mining stone? I thought not. It's hard and backbreaking work, and occasionally accidents happen. We want assurances that if we are injured we can be taken care of. We have families to support. If we are badly hurt and can't recover, how can we take care of them?"

options.name: Free up some extra bureaucracy.
Focus on passing the law.

events.title: Not Enough Healthcare

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has brought up in today's debate the concerns of healthcare potentially becoming more accessible, but less available for those that already have it.
events.flavor: "What do you think will happen? You can’t seriously expect availability to be unaffected if we open up the accessibility to the public. People will be waiting days, weeks or even months for a chance to see a doctor. How will we prioritize different conditions versus the amount of time people have waited for. "

options.name: Their concerns are unwarranted.
Their concerns should be considered.

events.title: Availability Versus Accessibility

events.desc: It has been brought to the Government's attention that we might not have sufficient bureaucrats available for the establishment of a Public Healthcare System.
events.flavor: "The world does run on dreams and ideals. We have to face the facts, and we need to sort this now before it becomes a problem when this becomes law. Opening up the healthcare system to the public without being properly prepared could backfire as quickly as it could succeed."

options.name: Push it through anyways.
Scrape what we can together.

events.title: Insufficient Healthcare Support

events.desc: … missionary activity in … has begun to find new ears, as foreigners exercise their rights to access the region.
events.flavor: A deacon by any measure, given how ill-carved his rosary sat around his neck. Still, it was one made by his own hand and his pride and joy on many adventures. He gripped it tightly as he stepped onto the paths of …. God willing, he thought, even one receptive ear would be a welcome addition to Jesus' flock.

options.name: Voices from a distant world.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: They should leave their preaching with their opium.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Missionary Activity in …

events.desc: A group of … missionaries hailing from … have been caught several miles past the border of … province, which foreigners are forbidden to access.
events.flavor:
"That's the thirteenth one we've caught in as many weeks. This one is the first … that's come for a while."

"Wait... look at these papers. This one's protected. What can we do?"

"Does it matter? Just a lost Christian who cannot read. Our law applies; his does not."

options.name: Bring them to the border, and have them executed.
Enforce the Sixth Clause of our law against superstition.
Open the province to limited travel.

events.title: Border Violation in …

events.desc: … missionaries have opened several charity schools in …, offering education in Western religious and scientific practice.
events.flavor:
"St. Jude's, I'll call it. If no other shall answer prayers in the Orient, then let it reach the one who will search this far for prayers."

"And this Saint Jude? Who is he? I thought he was the one who betrayed your Jesus."

"No, the other Jude. But he is known to aid desperate causes. And this school, against all odds, stands all the same."

options.name: They are welcome to operate in the region.
Forbid our citizens from attending.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The … Missionary School

events.desc: … missionaries have opened a charity hospital in …, spreading their gospel whilst offering free treatment to the sick and wounded.
events.flavor:
God Welcomes All to His House of Healing! 

New hospital in … for those most in need. Jesus welcomes all.

And he called to him his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every affliction. (Matthew 10:1)

options.name: They are welcome to operate in the region.
Halt this unauthorized construction.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: Missionary Hospital Opens in …

events.desc: Local authorities in … have arrested several … … missionaries for inducing conflicts with the locals. They have requested guidance on how the foreigners are to be treated.
events.flavor: The green-clad constables brought forth a perfumed trunk and placed it in front of the manacled missionaries. One prised the lid open, and waved his hand around the documents inside. All except one of the missionaries furrowed their brows and shook their heads. The one in the middle winced: the neat, Latin handwriting was unmistakably his. Among the letters requesting cardinals for aid were reports detailing the habits of the local magistrate.

options.name: Return them to the nearest concession area.
They will be treated like any other criminals.

events.title: Missionaries Arrested in …

events.desc: Foreign missionaries based in … … have asked for permission to build schools and hospitals in …. They will surely use these as platforms to spread their faith.
events.flavor: "What better way to spread the word of the Lord than through healing? Those who find their way to our hospital will find their way to God."

options.name: Allow them to build schools and hospitals
We do not want their foreign faith.

events.title: Missionary Works in …

events.desc: A strange cult has emerged in …. Taking elements from local faiths as well as Christianity, their leader believes he is the younger brother of Jesus Christ.
events.flavor:
"My eyes see through beyond the west, the north, the rivers, and the mountains,
My voice shakes the east, the south, the Sun, and the Moon."

options.name: Curious, and concerning.

events.title: The God Worshipping Society

events.desc: The God Worshipping Society is rabidly evangelical, and has managed to attract a sizable following in ….
events.flavor: "They find eager converts among the poor and downtrodden, people ignored or failed by the state."

options.name: This cannot be a good thing.

events.title: God Worshippers in …

events.desc: The fanatics of the God Worshipping Society have risen up against us in response to our discrimination policies. They have established … as their base of operations and will shortly seize other states where the cult has a presence.
events.flavor:
"The glorious sword of authority was given by the Lord,
Poems and books are evidences that praise Yahweh.
Taiping unifies the World of Light,
The domineering air will be joyous for myriads of millenia."

options.name: We will crush them utterly!
God is on their side!

events.title: The Heavenly Kingdom

events.desc: The Heavenly Kingdom has been defeated. We must decide how to handle the aftermath of the rebellion; supporters of the cult are still active any may still cause trouble for us in the future.
events.flavor: "The supposed brother of Christ has been beheaded and burned. His ashes have been fired from a cannon. He will find no eternal rest, for he has disgraced our nation. He has been destroyed utterly, as will be the fate of all who oppose us."

options.name: Massacre the remaining heathens.
Show mercy and offer pardons to former rebels.

events.title: The Fall of Heaven

events.flavor: When people of this earth keep nothing for their private use, but give all things to God for all to use in common, then every place shall have equal shares, and everyone be clothed and fed.

options.name: Prioritize spreading the word of God to the people.
The reforms of the New Treatise will bring our state forward.

rewards.name: A New Treatise on Aids to Administration

options.name: …'s New Treatise will bring us forward.

rewards.name: A New Treatise on Aids to Administration

options.name: We shall prepare to war anew against the … devils.
Now is the time to build ties with the Western powers.

events.title: The Rise of Heaven

events.desc: The last franc owed to … for our emancipation is paid. Revelry grips the streets.
events.flavor:
To The Last Penny!
The financial fetters that chained us to our old colonial masters have been broken at last, as the final installment to our … creditors, with great fanfare, was deposited with the Caisse des dépôts et consignations earlier this afternoon, marking the end of decades of financial humiliation.

options.name: Let us be the only masters of the soil.

rewards.name: The Remade Pearl of the Antilles

options.name: For the Forefathers, for the Fatherland.

events.title: Decolonizing the Treasury

events.desc: … has paid its indemnity and debts in full. Per the terms of its agreement with us, it is now free of its obligations.
events.flavor: When the … indemnity was imposed in 1825, in truth, few Frenchmen expected it to ever be paid off in full. But against all odds, Haiti has achieved just that, making the final payment at the Caisse des dépôts et consignations in … earlier this afternoon.

options.name: Issue an official congratulation to the Haitian government.

events.title: The Miracle of Saint Domingue

events.desc: The country of …, suffering under a massive indemnity owed us for the exchange of their freedom, has requested a renegotiation of the terms.
events.flavor: "As a humble servant of …'s National Assembly, and the treasury of this nation, it is my duty to inform you that the indemnity we are bound to is beyond our means. The means to remove the iron manacles has only seen it become paper bindings instead. Surely you must understand having your wings crushed by debt. I beg of you, as … of …, ease our people's suffering."

options.name: Granted. Influence is a currecy of its own.
Denied. The Haitians will pay their due.

events.title: Haiti Requests Indemnity Renegotiation

events.desc: Our negotiations with … have borne fruit. In an official communiqué signed by … … …, one quarter of the owed indemnity is written off, though with certain diplomatic strings attached.
events.flavor: Your letter arrived to me in good faith, and I must say that I am dismayed. We had received full assurances your island nation was able to remunerate our lost costs. But rest assured that I, … …, have seen to it personally. Parliament has come to terms with a new deal for your people.

options.name: Trè byen, gras a Dye!

events.title: France Agrees to Indemnity Reduction

events.desc: In yet another display of colonial arrogance, … has refused any and all suggestions to reduce the indemnity—the … representative instead launched into a tirade about financial obligations and the horrors of Saint Domingue.
events.flavor:
"So what will we tell the people now? That we bleed them as badly as the French?"

"No... no, we cannot. They've suffered enough."

"We cannot default this payment, or we will invite the French back. Whoever we beg may put us in irons faster than them, too."

options.name: Bondye modi li!

events.title: France Refuses Indemnity Reduction

events.desc: Freshly returned after a three-year exile in Siberia, … has met with colleagues in the Trade Unions to discuss his next move.
events.flavor:
"Ilych! You look cold. And a fancy ring on your finger. Exile's done you wonders."

"Enough that I can see how much work has to be done. Nadya and I have had a great many discussions on where the Party could go next."

"Ha! You speak as if you'll lead the downfall of the Bourgeoisie tomorrow! It is good to see you again, old friend."

options.name: The Proletariat of Europe exists beyond ….
The Revolution will advance, with or without the Okhrana watching.
Iskra will benefit most from his direct supervision.

events.title: Back from Siberia

events.desc: Returning from time abroad to evade prison, … was caught trying to reenter ….
events.flavor: Saint-Pelagie, Belle-Île, and Carte. The threats of evermore degrading and hostile prisons mounted. And whispers of this new Devil's Island somewhere in Guyane sound as terrible as the name promises. Delescluze could have stayed away, but the people's revolution cannot wait.

options.name: Arrest him again. Hiding in another country is not true exile.
He spent his sentence somewhere not here. Let him be.

events.title: Caught Returning

events.desc: While serving a sentence for revolutionary sentiment, … quietly escaped from prison. He has rejoined the countless other revolutionaries across ….
events.flavor:
"Sir? The revolutionary is gone."

"Mon dieu, which one? We have entire prisons just for the treasonous rats!"

"Blanqui, sir. He's been smuggled out, and we believe since his friends arrived. He'll be halfway to Belgium by now, sir."

options.name: Recapture him and leave him on Devil's Island.
We have other political heads to collect.

events.title: Escaping the Law

events.desc: The rising feminist factions in … have suffered a schism. … has founded a new, militant organization in its wake.
events.flavor:
Affiliations with the Independent Labour Party, three separate bills, twenty years of work, and all the support of a dedicated community were not enough—not nearly enough—to affect even the slightest forward step on women’s suffrage. New measures would be needed. A woman’s right to vote would belong not only to the spinsters and the widows.

By fire, fist, and famine, all women will have the power to vote.

options.name: A few days in the country ought to soothe their woes.
Meet with her followers early.
Her charity in the workhouses does her credit.

events.title: Women Beyond Spinsters

events.desc: Dissatisfied with the lack of progress on abolition, … has begun drawing on every anti-slavery gunman to aid slaves fleeing their owners.
events.flavor:
"Off to bed, children. You surely must be tired."

"Mam, it's scarce noon. We haven't even married Juliet to Romeo yet."

"You get inside this instant and you stay away from that wagon! That John Brown and his sons are coming this way, and his crusade will drown us all in blood. You mark my words, boy!"

options.name: Let him walk with God's blessing
Let his earthly work continue unhindered.

events.title: A Feeling of Fatedness

options.name: A positive investigation on monarchy is due.
The only truth is Dreyfus' inherent guilt!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: A nation under dictator and king is the only way forward.

events.desc: … has officially arrived in … to a mixed reception. Some call him a pest, and others call him a visionary.
events.flavor:
A dream beckoned him: a league of independent states. Europe, whole and strong. Europe, together in fraternity. Europe, a bastion of democracy and enlightenment.

A dream crushed time after time. But always the dream beckoned, and always he answered. The only thing that would constitute this republic is the destruction of all that would oppose it.

options.name: University lectures and tours, and nothing more.
Watch closely for a Young … movement.

events.title: Young Joseph

events.desc: Chastened by his travels abroad and his failed coup, … has returned to … borders.
events.flavor:
"Papa, papa! Napoleon has returned!"

"Which Napoleon would that be, Jacques? Little Corporal, the reigning king, or the Swiss man?"

"The Swiss Officer, papa!"

options.name: He is not deserving of any special treatment.
Perhaps he has learned his lesson.

events.title: The Third Bonaparte

events.desc: A resident of the … region, …, has declared himself an Emperor. He has begun issuing his own decrees, and people have printed currency with his likeness.
events.flavor: "At the peremptory request and desire of a large majority of the citizens of these United States, I, …, formerly of Algoa Bay, Cape of Good Hope, and now for the last 9 years and 10 months past of San Francisco, California, declare and proclaim myself Emperor of these United States..."

options.name: Let him proclaim. It keeps the people laughing.
A foreign head of state cannot be allowed to walk free.

events.title: He Who Would Be King

events.desc: …, a disinherited son of a princely family, has returned to …. His activities seem subversive in nature.
events.flavor:
"A great pleasure to see you again, Dmitri. I see St. Petersburg has become lively again."

"Indeed Pyotr. Listen, this wasn't a courtesy call. I am happy to see you in the motherland again, and... I imagine some friends of mine would be too."

"Friends? Don't tell me it's Tchaikovsky... oh, you were serious."

options.name: Send him to Siberia with the rest.
What could a failed prince do?
He should stay well away from the cities.

events.title: Be Someone Useful

events.desc: … has left the military unfulfilled, and requested leave to study in Berlin.
events.flavor:
"Son, you are the first of my line, and you bear the burden of upholding it. I bid you stay and put your talents to use in service."

"And I would peel my forehead like a potato while I stamp forms. It's no future. What's in my forehead demands more."

options.name: The … needs great thinkers as well as great generals.
He will enjoy his education, and never bring it back.

events.title: Bakunin in Berlin

events.desc: A raid carried out in … has identified over 200 members of the South Russian Workers' Union. Among them, a young man named ….
events.flavor: There are whispers out of … of a printing press. Not just any press printing the local gazette or even approved books. This press was focused on a handful of ideas. Slogans championing the rights of the proletariat, and calls for the educated to spread the good word: revolution is coming.

options.name: Arrest them all and ship them to Siberia.
Arrest the ringleaders. The rest will fall into compliance.

events.title: A Man Named 'Lvov'

events.desc: Captain …, a former artillery officer arrested for sedition, has escaped detainment in Siberia. His captors believe he is fleeing south.
events.flavor: Is it truly patriotic to oppose a tyrant who dictates a beloved homeland, or is it only self-indulgent treason? A fine question that ought to be answered, if only there were time to stop and rest. South, somewhere, anywhere south of Moscow, would be the time. Right now, the …'s hounds were in the way.

options.name: Find him, before he spreads his treason.
Let the vastness of Russia claim him.
He is Poland's problem now.

events.title: Dąbrowski's Flight

events.desc: … has grown increasingly weary of operating the … Daily News, and has opted to spend his time abroad.
events.flavor:
"I dare say, John, the co-owners of the Daily News will be the death of me. This paper was meant to be so much more. I feel as if I have no time left, for want of love or money."

"And I should know when you want to hand something to me, Charlie. 'Tis your venture, and I give you my experience freely, but do consider what you're proposing. I will take it if that is what you want, but I shall not make your choice for you."

options.name: He should not be weighed by ignorance and want.
His work there is yet to be finished.

events.title: A Dickens Tale

events.desc: A disastrous strike in Poland has seen leaders of the Proletariat Party executed for treason. Some members, including …, have escaped.
events.flavor: Far fewer of the party survived the strike than anyone hoped. The survivors resolved to meet in secret after they were made outlaws. Everyone was made clear: they would be hunted by the law for their work. There was only so much of Poland they could hide in, and the …'s claws numbered in the millions.

options.name: There cannot be compromises, even for her.
It's excessive to punish a woman with her life ahead of her.

events.title: The Young Spartacus

events.desc: … has recently published Reflections on Violence, signaling both his alignment with radical leftism, and a break from orthodox socialist theory.
events.flavor: "Marx supposed that the bourgeoisie had no need to be incited to employ force; but we are faced with a new and very unforeseen fact: a bourgeoisie which seeks to weaken its own strength."

options.name: Get him out of France before he becomes a pest!
Socialism can only continue with the nation in mind.
Some concepts should remain concepts.

events.title: Destruction: A Creative Impulse

events.desc: Echoing sentiments across the Armed Forces, … has called for revenge against … to thunderous applause.
events.flavor: Vengeance, by and large, is the need to uphold besmirched honor. One might seek revenge as readily for a stolen treat as a gouged eye. When a nation's worth is tied to the majesty of its military, any defeat in the field could yet break its image. And woe betide them who attacks a nation's worth.

options.name: Vive la France! None may stand against her!
Any man has a right to avenge his country.
Get this saber-rattler out of his office.

events.title: The Ethics of Revenge

events.desc: Freshly reentering politics, … has been invited to make public addresses on the constitution of the … state.
events.flavor: Revolution, no matter how peaceful the intent or the amount of violence bestowed, collects its dues from all involved. One may find the cost is simple: boots and blood. Others find less obvious costs: passions stripped, joys faded, and ideals becoming nothing but memories. Yet with enough time and care, there is a chance of renewal.

options.name: Moral primacy of the law belongs to the worker.
Constitutional matters are merely questions of power.

events.title: Silk Merchant's Son

events.desc: Whispers around São Paulo mention a new newspaper, Diablo Coxo. This is only one of many publications that self-taught lawyer, …, writes for.
events.flavor: A new partnership between a freed slave and a foreign cartoonist have taken the city by storm. Sharp, witty, pleasing to look at; it was destined to ruffle the plumage of every peacock in São Paulo. … had a great labor ahead of him: no less than the freedom of every slave in ….

options.name: Democracia begins.
Death threats are all too common against a freed man.

events.title: Lame Devil's Partnership

events.desc: As … begins to accumulate more and more power, … denounces the … as a traitor to ….
events.flavor: Military boots came marching down the parade. Power changes hands once more. Every step tolled the death knell of yet another Republic. No man who spoke against the death penalty, against social injustice, and against poverty could be convinced to bow gracefully to the whims of an entitled heir. But what to do to affect that, and keep a family alive?

options.name: Better to quit the field than suffer a pointless death.
All Bonapartes have fallen. This one is no different.
France will no longer abide by the words of Orlean.

events.title: The Flight of Valjean

events.desc: Informants have learned of the existence of the Reform China Society. A leak has detailed plans of an uprising in …, and its members are now arrested. …, one of the leaders, has evaded capture.
events.flavor: "My brother, I wish I could write to you under better circumstances. The reforms have not gone so well. … remains in the …'s' hands, and I cannot take a living wage. I need what you can spare from your ranches..."

options.name: He would be wise to try for Japan or England.
If he evaded capture, he could be anywhere in China by now.

events.title: Under Atari

events.desc: A Chartist march in Newport turned to bloody violence. Armed Forces personnel captured the throng, including one of its commanders, John Frost.
events.flavor: £100 was the worth of John Frost's manacles, delivered alive and unspoiled. An auspicious day called for the oldest punishment: hanging, drawing, then quartering. And yet, the people would have a say here. A barbaric death while marching for a fairer vote was beyond all ken. A lighter sentence was due in the wake of the Enlightenment.

options.name: Mark him as the last traitor killed this way.
Banish him from Britain.
Van Diemen's Land is far enough.

events.title: Frosty the Traitor

events.desc: … has arrived in …, to a mixed reception. Bringing her pioneering work in nursing to the country has set off a wide spread gossip about her pursuit to change laws regarding women in the workplace.
events.flavor:
She is a "ministering angel" without any exaggeration in our hospitals, and as her slender form glides quietly along each corridor, every poor fellow's face softens with gratitude at the sight of her.

 When all the medical officers have retired for the night, silence and darkness have settled down upon those miles of prostrate sick, she may be observed alone, with a little lamp in her hand, making her solitary rounds.

options.name: The lady with the hammer! She broke into a locked storage to access medicine to treat the wounded.
Her proposals are gaining momentum in ….

events.title: The Lady with the Lamp

events.desc: The first heavier-than-air flight has been achieved! This technology will pave the way for the future of aviation.
events.flavor: "Never before have we commanded such mastery of the skies. With these bold new developments, the sky is the limit!"

options.name: Look, I'm a bird!

events.title: First Flight

events.desc: An outbreak of crop disease in … has begun to spread across much of the European continent. With a failed harvest looming, fears of famine have begun to circle.
events.flavor:
The doctor prodded the potato with his instrument, and leaned aside so his colleague could see. The tool's blunt tip had sunk a centimetre into a discolored patch on its flesh.

"It's the blight, I'm afraid. Were I to inspect any other tuber from the field, the result would likely be the same. As it stands, I would recommend extraordinary measures."

options.name: Calamity!
Set up funds for purchasing foreign grain.

events.title: The Hungry …

events.desc: The waves of crop disease that wracked the European continent throughout the "hungry …" have subsided. Whilst the blighted fields may never again be able to host the affected variety of potatoes, other crops are expected to make a full recovery.
events.flavor:
"Did you hear? They're selling a new kind of potato seed. One that isn't blighted, or so they say."

The man leaning on the other side of the fence raised an eyebrow "About time. Too late, even. I had to have my kids eating hay to make it through the winter."

"You got off easy. The family down the road lost theirs. Too damned late, indeed."

options.name: Thank goodness.
Can we be certain it's over?

events.title: Easier Times

events.desc: The rising pan-nationalist sentiment spreading across … has made its way to …. Dynastic unionists and internationalist radicals alike have come to call for the unification of … under their preferred form of government.
events.flavor:
"The union of Spain and Portugal is advantageous for both countries: it is natural, it is just, it is legitimate, it is necessary—indeed, we shall say more, it is inevitable. Anything that works against this union is harmful to both peoples; anything that strengthens it is beneficial. The difficulty lies only in finding the means to realize this great idea in a spontaneous, free, and honorable manner for both."

—Fernández Cuesta

options.name: We have been divided for too long.
Workers of the world, unite!
… is a sovereign nation, and that she will stay.

events.title: One Peninsula

events.flavor:
As the stones impacted the surface of the Douro, they sent up a great gout of water that soaked the barge-men to their skins. Clouds of silt and disturbed fish boiled up from the river-bottom, staining the water around the craft a cloudy green-brown.

In a week, they hoped, the pile would extend three meters above the water. In a month, five more would join it, each connected to their brothers by a lattice of support beams. By year's end, this would be a bridge, one of a dozen new constructions spanning the former border. Wearily, triumphantly, the barge-men watched the stones settle, and picked up their poles anew.

options.name: Raise the #tooltippable;tooltip:…,ibe_republic_1_tt flag of union!
Let fly the #tooltippable;tooltip:…,ibe_republic_2_tt tricolor!
We salute the #tooltippable;tooltip:…,ibe_republic_3_tt federal flag!
Peace among ourselves, war to the tyrants!
¡Viva Ibérica!

events.title: Iberian Sunrise

events.desc: Through the unification of …, we seek to form a new society upon the principles of proletarian internationalism. The constructed language of Esperanto, popular amongst Iberian socialists, may serve as a suitably international language of administration.
events.flavor: "It will be difficult," began the speaker. "We will need to embark upon a great endeavor to teach the language. Reactionaries will stubbornly cling to the old national languages, and camouflage themselves behind the masses who have not yet learned Esperanto. But the Revolution was also a great endeavor, was it not? And we did not cower from it because of the opposition we faced. I urge you, councilors, allow us to make this contribution to the course of the Revolution, and the dissolution of the old society. In the coming years, let our children say—proletoj de la mondo, unuiĝu!"

options.name: Declare Esperanto an official language.
National languages, bourgeois cultures... it all must go.
Hope, above all else, is what defines us.

events.title: All Men Are Brothers

events.desc: With pan-national sentiments rising across …, the government of … has declared unification of the peninsula to be official policy. With …'s position made clear, we must declare our own.
events.flavor:
"The union of Spain and Portugal is advantageous for both countries: it is natural, it is just, it is legitimate, it is necessary—indeed, we shall say more, it is inevitable. Anything that works against this union is harmful to both peoples; anything that strengthens it is beneficial. The difficulty lies only in finding the means to realize this great idea in a spontaneous, free, and honorable manner for both."

—Fernández Cuesta

options.name: We have been divided for too long.
Workers of the world, unite!
… is a sovereign nation, and that she will stay.

events.title: One Peninsula

events.desc: A dramatic scheme in our capital has just come to fruition. Now that it's been revealed, the plot obviously had its risks and flaws, but no one can deny that it's paid off handsomely for … this time.
events.flavor: "I've always known that I was destined for great things, you see, my own grandmother used to be very adamant about it. If only she was still around to see it... alas, at least the world will see it now, and especially you, my dearest friend."

options.name: The … will reap the rewards.
The nation will reap the rewards.

events.title: The Gamble: Success

events.desc: A dramatic scheme by the … in our capital has just come to a disastrous end. The risks were high from the beginning, but … decided it was worth pursuing nonetheless. The results have, of course, been calamitous for everyone involved.
events.flavor: A judiciary struck his gavel three times. The courtroom stifled their cries of outrage, if only for a moment. No ally of … was coming for a daring rescue. Then in the silence before the judge spoke, it all became clear to the defendant... this venture was doomed from the start.

options.name: The … cannot be trusted with power.
Make … take the blame.
Steady on, leave the … in charge.

events.title: The Gamble: Failure

events.desc: …, the methodical leader of the …, has been studiously working to increase the nation's credit. At last all … work has paid off, but for the … or for …?
events.flavor:
The … is so pleased with … acts that … looks like …'s about to burst into flames of contained emotion. How charming. Professionally speaking, though, not the most clever move.

"Yes! Just as planned!"

options.name: The … shall reap the rewards.
… shall reap the rewards.

events.title: The Grand Plan Pays Off

events.desc: The ruling …, led by the charismatic …, has initiated a great promotional tour. The decision to focus efforts domestically or internationally has been left to the last minute, however, and it's unclear if … will do more for itself or for the country as a whole.
events.flavor:
"Nothing wrong with a little self-promotion, if it's for a good cause."

"And how would you determine the character of a cause? By how it ripens your purse?"

"But by it's very nature! Why, a cause of ragamuffins might well have a healthy effect on the state if its heart is in the right place."

options.name: The tour should drum up support for the ….
The tour should drum up support for ….

events.title: Diplomatic Tour

events.desc: …, leader of the ruling …, has had enough of compromising with … coalition partners. … has demanded that either … collaborators follow … orders, or … will never approve of their changes.
events.flavor:
"That's what leaders are for, right? I lead, you follow. Sounds rather simple to me. If they wanted to lead they could have been leaders themselves, but I guess no one else thought they could.

It's my way or the highway!"

options.name: What a ridiculous thing to say.
Very well, … shall be the leading force.

events.title: It's Me or Them

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has made a remarkable play for power in the capital in order to secure a spot for … within the government. However, it's not entirely clear if they should be rewarded for their... novel tactics.
events.flavor:
There's only one light in the street that leads to the … headquarters. There's also only one light inside. There, … relaxes among the sumptuous mahogany furniture and velvet cushions. The lamp is identical to those that have been sent from the East.

"The ends justify the means, and our means are very, very justified."

It's difficult to not believe … when … offers an inviting seat by … side.

options.name: … shall be recognized for this.
Not all is fair in love and war.

events.title: The Play for Power

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has been openly preaching about the benefits that a mysterious and secret political gamble can bring to our government. When asked for details, … smiles coyly, refusing to elaborate.
events.flavor:
… has always had a taste for adventure and suspiciously tall hats. … closest friends don't seem to pay attention to these dangerous qualities, but the most respectable gentlemen have voiced their concerns in a mildly passive aggressive manner.

"Nobody would ever doubt a sterling citizen like myself, don't you think?"

options.name: How bad can it be?
What an utterly ludicrous idea.

events.title: The Gamble

events.desc: Men associated with the influential … have approached the government, seeking reforms. They argue that voting rights have expanded too much, too quickly, and ask the government to consider rolling back the passing of the … law.
events.flavor: "The masses can support their betters if they wish, but they should not be involved in matters that are none of their business."

options.name: We shall address their grievances.
Restricting the franchise? Out of the question!

events.title: Too Much Democracy?
