events.desc: Followers of the … have expressed their support to the government efforts to recognize the beliefs of the faithful as the one true church of the state and formally implement a ….
events.flavor: "In the darkest part of the night, faith shines, immaculate on its conception, like a mutating, everlasting candle. Now yellow, now orange, reddish. What other beacon will ever lead us? The priest has always been so fervent in his words. His whole body agitates, possessed by the sermon, his face gets brighter, brighter!"

options.name: This will greatly support our cause.
We cannot let the … become too influential.

events.title: The Faith of the Land

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has publicly supported the government efforts to pass the … law. However, there are some that think …'s only doing it for … own benefit.
events.flavor:
The scholar has been sitting all day in that velvet lined chair. He mutters about what's going on in the east. Something is always going on in the east.

"Stopping the people from talking does not stop the people from talking. It stops the people."

options.name: It would be good to ensure … gets the necessary support.
We cannot personalize the law in just one person.

events.title: Freedom of Expression?

events.desc: The … are already looking ahead to the next harvest. The draft regularly draws away the most able hands away from the farm just when they're needed most. A delegation has arrived, asking for a stop to the … law.
events.flavor:
Their sturdy hands are sweaty, sometimes they shake. "No, no, it was only your imagination, good Sir, we are quite calm here, you see, but we do worry. Calmly, of course, but we worry."

The war is always going badly, they say, doesn't have to be the same with the harvest.

options.name: We shall address their grievances.
The military needs men more than the farm needs hands.

events.title: Bring Our Boys Home!

events.desc: Representatives of the … have approached the government, expressing their disappointment in the passing of the … law.
events.flavor:
"They have brought their kids with them. Oh, …, that reminds me of why I hate children. So loud, my head, so loud. No amount of education will ever fix these ones, that's for sure.

"Yes, yes, we hear you, we absolutely hear you. Stay behind the desk, please, we're processing your petition."

Sigh."

options.name: We should calm these people before we go ahead.
We cannot let the public opinion have an impact in our decisions.

events.title: Restricted Education

events.desc: A group of influential … have approached the government, unhappy with the proposed tax system, which they say places an undue burden on the most successful members of society, and seek the repeal of the … law.
events.flavor:
"You are creating a nation of loafers and slackers, a nation where a Lazybones Plaza shall promptly be erected in honor of the proud habitants of our streets!"

The man's carotid is about to explode. A healthy blush now shines in his cheeks, like a modest dancer. A doctor watches in attentive silence. Fascinating.

options.name: Success should not be punished!
They only want the rich to get richer.

events.title: Tax Reforms

events.desc: Officers from the … have expressed their support to the enactment of the new … law. However, some have also raised their concerns about this lowering the overall quality of the army.
events.flavor:
"These officers have a different air to them. Everyone says so. And by everyone they mean the ladies from the countryside. The young ones, especially. Someone's niece ran away with one of them and the scandal reached even the capital. Her uncle was the earl, they say."

Military men watch, leaning against the railings that border the fields. They have absent eyes; gossip is a luxurious entertainment.

options.name: More men are more men.
We should invest in creating a reliable army.

events.title: Services to the Nation

events.desc: Members of the … have vehemently expressed their support for the … law, writing articles in its favor.
events.flavor:
"The Simplest, Most Practical, Most Effective Way of Ruling a Nation"

"It is essential for the wellbeing of a nation that its citizens conform, like in baking, an uniform mass. If one adds too many eggs, or salt, or water, the dough will be brittle, too stretchy or even soggy. In other words, in order to achieve a good cake, one cannot afford to have the wrong measurements."

options.name: Tighter restrictions on citizenship are called for.
No, anyone can become …!

events.title: Rights of Man

events.desc: The …, led by wily …, have threatened to join the revolutionary forces if their demands are not met. Although the concessions they demand are small, the power they will wield if we admit our weakness to them shall be tremendous.
events.flavor:
"In times of turmoil and struggle, the cautious always argue that some ideals must be compromised, some reforms must be put on hold, to keep the nation from unraveling. I ask them, what is the worth of a nation without ideals?

Let it unravel, I say! From the threads we shall weave a better nation, where our ideals are seen as a foundation rather than a threat."

options.name: Give them what they ask for.
We will give them nothing but cold steel!

events.title: On the Edge

events.desc: The … are on the precipice of revolt, threatening to join the revolution if certain demands are not met.
events.flavor: "Control of … is slipping through the fingers of this weak and listless government. Someone must reclaim it. We know how to rule, but if you will not heed our advice, the cause it lost."

options.name: Whatever satisfies their so-called 'dignity', let them have it.
Ridiculous! They have no right to ask for anything.
They can be dignified in handcuffs.

events.title: … Have Demands!

events.desc: The … are furious with the government, and it seems that they may join the current revolution if we cannot appease them.
events.flavor: "We know better than any the cost of war, the devastation of burned fields and ransacked cottages. We would not take up arms unless we had no other recourse. Do not not use this as an excuse to test our patience ― without us, … starves."

options.name: Let us hope concessions now can be the seed of peace for the future.
They will get nothing from us!
If they sow the wind, then they can reap the whirlwind!

events.title: … Are Sowing Discord!

events.desc: The … claim to have suffered under our 'amoral' government for far too long, and now have nailed a list of demands on the door of a government office.
events.flavor: "A … who rules without morality is nothing but a despot, no matter from whence … draws … worldly power. Do not underestimate how easily an regime which has lost its moral authority could be toppled."

options.name: Let us grant them these concessions and pray for peace.
I don't care a fig for what they want!
They can believe what they please in jail.

events.title: … Call For Intervention!

events.desc: Officers associated strongly with the … have publicly issued a list of grievances, and demand immediate action from the government. Dark rumors suggest they may join the revolution if they are not satisfied.
events.flavor: "We are sworn to defend …, but we must ask ourselves at which point the government itself is the greatest threat the integrity of the nation it is governing. There is a war coming. Trust me, you will want the real soldiers on your side."

options.name: We salute the sacrifices our soldiers have made and recognize their need for support.
Here's some orders for you: Get out!
I believe it's time for our boys in blue to serve the nation.

events.title: … Are Getting Bellicose!

events.desc: A disgruntled consortium of …, unhappy with the government, are demanding 'compensation'. If we refuse, they threaten to throw in their lot with the Revolution.
events.flavor: "An insurrection would be a setback, a stall on …'s road to becoming a modern nation, but perhaps an inevitable one. If there is to be a war, it would certainly be better for it to be quick. Could you make it quick?"

options.name: Let's settle for this deal.
Let's pass—their price is too high.
The only thing they'll get is time in prison.

events.title: … Are Steaming!

events.desc: The … have written a manifesto, demanding the government make certain concessions in order to protect the public welfare and preserve liberty. If not, they hint that more drastic actions may be taken.
events.flavor: "We prefer to win with words, but words can implore reason or extol action. Praxis follows theory. If you need ideas, we have them, if not, someone else is surely in need."

options.name: They make a strong case for concessions.
They make a strong case for nothing at all.
They make a strong case for their own imprisonment.

events.title: … Have Issued Demands!

events.desc: It seems that the … are determined to extract concessions from the government during this moment of crisis. If we refuse to bend, they threaten to throw in their lot with the Revolution.
events.flavor: "It's very simple—we need a strong hand at the wheel right now, and if … cannot provide it, we'll find someone who can."

options.name: We can accommodate their demands.
This is ridiculous! Let them try their worst.
If they want strength, we can show them that.

events.title: … Demand Action Now!

events.desc: Extremely unhappy with the government, representatives of the … have now escalated matters and are seeking immediate concessions from the government. If nothing is done, their representatives airily suggest that actions may escalate further.
events.flavor: "The time for negotiations is past. It is time for the workers to make demands! Our hands forge the steel of the gun barrel and the lead of the bullet. Join us! With these hands we will destroy, and with these hands we will rebuild."

options.name: Very well, let the … get their concessions.
We shall grant nothing to this rabble!
Times like these are what the police are for.

events.title: … Escalate Their Demands!

events.desc: The powerful clout that the … hold has become a menacing presence over our government. One of our agents has approached us suggesting a... less conventional solution.
events.flavor:
"The door has been opened without anyone noticing it until the wind spreads the documents resting on the wooden desk.

"Excuse me," a soothing voice announces, carefully picking them up, "I hope that my visit doesn't disrupt your important affairs. However, it has been observed that the … are in desperate need of a little guidance towards the right path, that will help both them and us."

options.name: They surely need our guidance.
This is utterly immoral!

events.title: With Friends Like These...

events.desc: Rumors about the sinful life of …, of the …, have been fabricated and are ready to be spread among the masses like wildfire.
events.flavor: "That they did what to whom? This cannot be believed! Such scandalous behavior cannot be tolerated in this pious country! And then they followed that by what? I cannot bear to hear this anymore! Please, spare me this suffering! End it already, I beg you! I beg you!"

options.name: The best rumor can never be traced.
This will feed more than one high-society ball.
People in the suburbs are avid for some social ammunition.

events.title: Rumor Has It

events.desc: With the rumors about … way of life reaching all social strata and … reputation undermined, we can certainly persuade … to step down from … position as the leader of ….
events.flavor:
"It was one of those days when the fires of the factories twinkled like little eyes through the windows, one of those days when … felt as if the whole city stared at …, accusing, demanding. But it was not … fault! … knew it, … had done nothing wrong... It was the government, it was obviously the government, spreading lies, they never liked …, did they? Oh, no, they never did.

"What are you looking at!?"

options.name: A little blackmailing never killed nobody.
Maybe we just need to make the scandal even bigger.
This has gone too far.

events.title: Persuasion

events.desc: Even after the tenacious efforts to undermine …'s reputation, … has proved reluctant to step down. Harder measures need to be taken.
events.flavor:
The door is open again, this time there's no wind to alert you, no sound, no disturbance of life can be perceived in this safe room. But there he is again. The same soothing voice approaches you, "Excuse me," you recognize that tone, "I hope that my visit doesn't disturb your important affairs. However, our objective has proved to be somehow resistant to our persuasion, so there's only one option left."

"We cannot kill …!"

The agent casts a perplexed look at you, "Kill …? Oh, no, I'd never suggest that! I was only thinking that we have so many empty cells..."

options.name: May … body rot in jail.
… just needs a little more convincing...
This has indeed gone too far!

events.title: Coup de Grâce

events.desc: We have heard that the … have been holding some very interesting meetings in their headquarters, which we happen to know extremely well. We could certainly pay them a visit.
events.flavor:
"Me? Oh, I was just passing by when I noticed such a little charming gathering you're having there, no? But it's not very friendly of you to have it restricted to your own group, one could even go as far as to say that that's a bit... sectarian, right?"

"Of course I'd never accuse you of such a thing, but maybe the best thing for everyone involved is that you kindly disperse this extremely illegal and filthy meeting at once."

options.name: Our agents will discreetly deal with this.
Break down that door!
Alas, if only they had a right of assembly...
We don't need a reason to just disperse it.

events.title: A Surprise Visit

events.desc: Rumors about the weak will of …, of the …, are more a fact than a suspicion. There are many ways in which one can take advantage of a weak opponent.
events.flavor: "So there are two metals before you, as you can see, right? And then you can choose, this kindly offered gold or this sharp—but equally beautiful—steel, do you understand what I'm saying?"

options.name: Toss a coin to your leader.
There are other... cheaper methods.

events.title: Self-Sabotage

events.desc: Our efforts to undermine the …'s reputation have been extremely successful. With their influence now weakened it is time for us to attend to more important matters.
events.flavor: "The door does not open this time. Minutes go by and nothing happens. It's almost a let down. There's a man in the hallway on the way out, though. He's wearing a velvet frock coat and you look at him expectantly. Another man goes to him and they leave together. Nothing happens."

options.name: People will know who to respect.
We shall never let them forget who achieved this.
A good moment to remind them about our laws.

events.title: The Final Word

events.desc: We have hired unscrupulous journalists to write damning articles about the …, harming their reputation.
events.flavor:
The reporter for the … … twiddled his thumbs nervously, "Just one article and you'll pay off all my debts?" 

 "Just one article but it has to be on the front page and it has to eviscerate the …."

options.name: The pen is mightier than the lord.
The pen is mightier than the gourd.
The pen is mightier than the sword.
The pen is mightier than the board.
The pen is mightier.
Shouldn't journalism include some ethics?
Why pay when we own the newspaper?

events.title: An Unflattering Article

events.desc: By intimidating the members of the … we can make actively supporting them a much less appealing prospect.
events.flavor: "Sure we might not dissuade the leaders, the ideological crusaders but the rank and file? They care much more about their wellbeing than some poxy cause."

options.name: If he can't walk how will he get to the polling station?
We're well equipped for this sort of thing.
This doesn't seem particularly moral.

events.title: Friendly Encouragement

events.desc: By eliminating …, the leader of the …, we could stop their momentum in its tracks.
events.flavor: "If you have one rabid dog, you don't let it spread it's disease. You put it down. The same concept applies here."

options.name: We shall attempt it.
Murder in the streets? Unthinkable.

events.title: A Change in Leadership

events.desc: …, in their capacity as our …, has issued a demand we reform our … towards ….
events.flavor:
"We do not demand," the ambassador begins, voice echoing in the grand hall. "We merely suggest, for the good of both our nations."

The document slides across the table, its implications heavy as lead.

options.name: Begin immediately, our relations with … are imperative.
Demands from … are more important than ….
Surely … must understand that this is not the time.
…? How dare they!

events.title: … imposes …

events.desc: After some consideration we have refused the … attempt to meddle in our politics by imposing … on us.
events.flavor: "… must chart its own course," … declares, pushing away the proposed law. The foreign delegate's eyes narrow; this act of defiance will not be forgotten.

options.name: How might they react to our refusal?

events.title: … Legislation Abandoned

events.desc: … has refused our demand they enact ….
events.flavor:
The ambassador returns, bearing the news of rejection. "They chose pride over progress," he reports.

The silence that follows lies heavy in the council chamber.

options.name: How ought we react to such insubordination?

events.title: Legislation Imposed on … Refused

events.desc: Our war for independence from … has sent the remnants of the colonial administration running for …. If we are to be independent, we must settle upon a structure to fill the vacuum.
events.flavor: "Do you hear the cannons? Does each shot sound closer and closer? Rejoice! It is a rare moment when a man may pick up his pen and decide his destiny. The occupiers are running, and we have a blank slate before us. Quickly, now! The shells are raining down, and it would not do for this venture to be aborted at its beginning."

options.name: Assemble a provisional government.
We will have a Republic, under the leadership of ….
… will have the Crown, if … wills it.
The union of classes will secure our victory.
The proletariat stand at the forefront of our struggle.
This endeavor is guided by ….

events.title: The War for Independence

events.desc: The old colonial structures which formerly governed our territory are woefully insufficient for an independent state. We must settle upon the foundations of a free and independent ….
events.flavor: The Governor did not have time to pack up his furniture before he left. Half a dozen fine European chairs graced his dining room, surrounding a table that had hastily been stripped of the silverware and its silken cloth by the fleeing prior occupants. Those fine chairs now hosted six fine gentlemen. Some of them, fortunate enough to warrant an invitation to the Governor's dinners, had been here before. The remainder were rougher, newer. If any here would were inclined to present something bold, it would be one of them.

options.name: … will be the supreme authority.
We will have a Republic.
… will have the Crown, if … wills it.
The union of classes will preserve our independence.
It was the proletariat that earned our victory.
… will be guided by divine providence.

events.title: Independence Day

events.desc: Following a long period of reform and negotiation with native Indian leaders, the … Parliament has passed a law reorganizing the former Raj into the Dominion of India.
events.flavor: "From this day forth, the colony of India, that was under Direct Crown Rule, will form the Dominion of India. This Dominion, under the crown of the United Kingdom of Great Britain, will have its own legislative authority. Insofar as it does not encroach, resist, or counter the authority of the crown itself."

options.name: We have seized our opportunity.

events.title: The Indian Home Rule Act

events.desc: Facing pressure from the Indian national movement, the government of the … has requested our approval to permit democratic elections to positions in the Indian administration.
events.flavor:
The request was met in the House of Lords with some amusement.
\"To vote," one lord remarked, "one must be literate. How does the Indian administration, with its abysmal literacy rates, expect the people to differentiate between Raj and Ram?"

options.name: Indians are incapable of responsible government.
A necessary step for stabilizing our administration.
Draw up the reform ourselves, and order it enacted.

events.title: Indian Administration Requests Government Reform

events.desc: Amidst a peaceful protest in … against our suppression of the Indian national movement, a … Army unit headed by … … has opened fire on the crowd. Hundreds of Indians have been killed, and thousands wounded.
events.flavor:
"The events in … may have quelled the rebellious sentiment in the city, but they have provoked a national outrage.

Everywhere I go, I see people protesting, united. They all repeat the same mantra, a single word, 'Azadi', 'Freedom'."

options.name: This must be covered up immediately.

events.title: Martyrdom

events.desc: Despite our efforts to contain the situation, the news of the massacre in … has spread across …. Riots have begun to break out in major cities as Indians protest the killings.
events.flavor:
In response to the suppression of the Amritsar rebellion this Sunday, the people of India have taken to rioting.

"Down with British imperialism! Down with British dirty dogs!", were the words hurled at British administrators as they made their way to their offices on Monday morning.

options.name: Detain …, and promise that justice will be done.
Dispatch the Army to pacify the riots.
Deploy the Air Force to disperse the crowds.

events.title: Downward Spiral

events.desc: As outrage grows over the …'s actions, a government commission has assembled to investigate the massacre in …. An interview with … … has revealed … claimed motive - to preserve … honor.
events.flavor:
"Do you think you could have dispersed the crowd without firing?"

"If I did disperse them without firing and they chose to come back, I would have seemed a fool. They would have laughed at me."

"Supposing the passage to the garden was sufficient to allow the armoured cars to go in, would you have opened fire with the machine guns?"

"I think probably, yes."

"In that case, the casualties would have been much higher?"

"Yes."

options.name: Recall … to … posthaste.
We must have this man disciplined.

events.title: The Disorders Inquiry Committee

events.desc: The former Brigadier General … has returned to …, following the conclusion of the inquiry into the … massacre. …
events.flavor: The barkeep had not expected his usual crowd to be so divided this Friday evening; for one, there was no game that day. Yet the subject of … had everyone up in arms. Half the people there wanted him dishonourably discharged; the butcher of Poonjab they called him. The other half were passing around a hat for donations. They wished to chip in for the Sword of Honor and purse that some newspaper was planning to give … next week.

options.name: We can consider this affair concluded.
A fundraiser and sword? How depraved are they?

events.title: Homecoming

events.desc: National consciousness in India is beginning to grow amongst …-educated … and … who find their financial interests clashing with … businesses. Their demands range from greater self-governance to full independence.
events.flavor:
Walking to the warehouse, I found my path barred by all the workers. They did not attack me but their intent was clear, no work would be done today. Aware of my frailty, I stood aside and went to have a second cup of tea. Here I overheard two workers, men who had served under me.

"We asked for food, and they made us starve. We asked to be heard, and they silenced us with bullets. And yet they ask us to serve? To obey? Well, no more. Let us see what they make of India without Indians."

options.name: We must keep an eye on this.
Their demands may have some merit.

events.title: The Indian National Movement

events.desc: National consciousness in India is beginning to grow amongst our native … and … who find their financial interests clashing with … businesses. Their demands range from self-governance to full independence.
events.flavor:
Indian Subjects turn Traitorous! Call for Complete Independence

While many bureaucrats remain loyal to the British government, the general public has turned treasonous. Many have justified their traitorous intent by claiming self-rule as a birthright.

The House of Lords debated the matter. Some believe that this is a natural escalation after the failed debates over Home Rule. Others argue that this is the work of a few rebellious instigators. A member who wished to remain anonymous said, "… will not lead India to capable self-government. The British Raj must continue, firm and unshaken in its administration of justice to all men."

options.name: Keep a close eye on this.
They revolt against responsible governance itself.

events.title: The Indian National Movement

events.desc: In response to growing nationalist agitation against … rule, the … has authorized a series of government reforms in the …. They establish several elected bodies to assist in the governance of India.
events.flavor:
"WHEREAS it is the declared policy of Parliament to provide for the increasing association of Indians in every branch of Indian administration, and for the gradual development of self-governing institutions, with a view to the progressive realization of responsible government in … India as an integral part of the empire:
And whereas progress in giving effect to this policy can only be achieved by successive stages, and it is expedient that substantial steps in this direction should now be taken..."

options.name: A show of beneficence.
Too little, and too late.

events.title: The …-… Reforms

events.flavor:
"How could you propose such a course? If we are to claim we wish them to govern themselves, we must give them an opportunity to prove themselves."

"You must see that if we include them, the entire purpose of the Commission will be compromised. It will become a disunified body, divided both by party and religion. If one places two Indians on any sort of governing body, they will return with three opinions and a black eye."

"The candidates I have assembled are all Oxford-educated, sir. If what you say is true, the blame lies with us alone."

options.name: They are … subjects, and they will have a … commission.
Indian people must have a role in their own governance.

events.title: The Indian Statutory Commission

options.name: Something may come of it yet.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Proclaim a boycott of this insulting spectacle.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: A positive step for …-Indian relations.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Will anything come of it?
We will settle for nothing but full independence!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: God save the …!
Advise … against this course of action.
"… of Great Britain, Ireland, and India" would make for an even grander style.

events.desc: The … administration has planned a grand durbar in … to officially proclaim … … as … of India. Dignitaries from across … India have been invited to attend.
events.flavor: "The guests being all seated, a flourish of trumpets by the heralds exactly at noon announced the arrival of the Viceroy. The military bands played a march, and … …, accompanied by … …, their daughters, and … staff, proceeded to the pavilion. … Excellency took … seat upon the throne, arrayed in … robes as Grand Master of the Star of India, the National Anthem was played, the guards of honor presented arms while the whole of the vast assemblage rose as one man. The chief herald was then commanded to read the proclamation. A flourish of trumpets was again sounded, and … Majesty was proclaimed … of India."

options.name: Shah in Shah Padishah. May God bless ….
A chance to offer … our loyalty, and one humble request.

events.title: The Delhi Durbar

events.desc: With the capture of … by … forces, we have acquired the legendary Koh-i-Noor diamond.
events.flavor:
"Milord, a detailed account of the … treasury is ready. Of note are the three gems, the Daria-i-noor, the Khiraj-i-alam, and of course the Koh-i-noor."

"Excellent. I much prefer these Indians than the ones across the Atlantic. After all, a diamond is a far better addition to one's cap than a feather, wouldn't you say?"

"Quite so, milord."

"Prepare them for transport. We must ensure they are present for the Great Exhibition. Proof of our conquest in the east."

options.name: Present the diamond as a spoil of war to … ….
Transport the diamond to our treasury in ….

events.title: The Mountain of Light

events.flavor:
"Mr. Prime Minister, the Crown did not find the Koh-i-noor attractive when it first claimed it. Surely they won't mind returning it?"

"High Commissioner, you will find that achieving independence is easier than trying to pry a jewel away from the Crown."

"But they have so many!"

"We had many colonies, too. Look how that went."

options.name: It is ours by treaty and right of conquest.
Valuable things are meant to be spent.

events.title: … Demands Return of the Koh-i-Noor

events.desc: Indebted … in … have launched a series of rebellions against local moneylenders, intended to destroy the records of their debts.
events.flavor:
"Sir, the farmers are burning records of their debt. In some cases, they're attacking the moneylenders themselves. Shall we send the police to intervene?"

The corner of the Governor's mouth twitched. "Well, it's hardly surprising."

"Sir?"

"The Hindi word for farmer is ryot. The ryots are rioting - why are we surprised?

options.name: Send in the Army to contain the rebellion.
Annul these debts before the riots worsen.

events.title: The Deccan Riots

events.desc: Our intelligence service has discovered a conspiracy involving Indian revolutionaries colluding with agents of the … government. They intend to orchestrate a pan-Indian rebellion against … rule.
events.flavor:
"Apparently, the conspirators called themselves the Ghadar party."

"That's amusing"

"How so, milord?"

"Ghadar means to rebel. But Gaddari means to betray. Odd, isn't it, how the difference really is a matter of perspective."

options.name: We must intervene at once.
Remain vigilant, but we must not be rash.

events.title: The Hindu-… Conspiracy

events.desc: In the city of …, several hundred members of Indian independence organizations have been put on trial for conspiring with … agents to subvert … rule.
events.flavor: The newspapers and the people followed the trial with great interest. For some it was a sign of the growing discontent. For others, it was proof that no gunpowder plot, whether led by Englishmen or Indians, could undermine the Crown. For most locals, however, it was simply what it was. A solemn procession of three hundred men, condemned one after another.

options.name: Let us hope this is the end of it.
Forty-two death sentences make forty-two martyrs.

events.title: The … Conspiracy Trials

events.flavor: Music thrums through the air, accompanied by the scent of thousands of flowers. People across the city gather, Hindus and Muslims. Their religion is not forgotten, but the usual tensions have been replaced with a mutual love for dance, prayer and food.

options.name: A beautiful show of harmony and color.
There is a clear danger of the festival being politicized.
Offer an official contribution to the displays.

events.title: Phool Walon Ki Sair

events.desc: The … has issued an order unifying the three … into a single body - the … Army.
events.flavor:
"It's been in the works for a good while. Irrational, or so they say, with quite a lot of redundancy. I'm surprised they made it past the telegraph."

"A Company relic, yes, I agree. Do you believe we retained too much of their structure?"

"What else could we do? India is hardly a flexible land. For reforms such as this, forty years is quite swift."

options.name: A victory for efficiency.
An opportunity to further incorporate native troops.

events.title: The Indian Army

events.desc: …, a Christian missionary active in …, has become well-known in the region for providing sanctuary to children forced into prostitution. She has founded a ministry to further her works.
events.flavor: "We are often asked to tell converts' stories; and certainly they would thrill, for the way of escape God opens sometimes is, like Peter's from prison, miraculous; and truth is stranger than fiction, and far more interesting. But we who work in the Terrible's lair, and know how he fights to get back his prey, even after it has escaped from him, are afraid to tell these stories too much, and feel that silence is safest, and, strange as it may seem to some, for the present most glorifies God."

options.name: Her cause warrants an official donation.
We cannot be seen sponsoring missionaries.

events.title: The Dohnavur Fellowship

events.desc: …, the child of a local judge, has been spotted participating in protests against the … Commission in …. Her and other child protesters face the police whilst dressed in the colors of the Indian flag.
events.flavor:
Their ages had not insulated themselves from the attention of the colonial police. A week ago, they had faced a lathi charge, dozens of grown men with batons scattering their picket line and casting down the flag they had made themselves. They had returned to their parents in tears, blood leaking from skinned palms and knees.

Now, instead of holding a flag which could be torn out of their hands, they draped themselves in its colors. Even if the children were knocked down once more, their clothing would show the the world their cause.

options.name: Such bravery at such a young age.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Her father will suffer consequences for this.

events.title: … Go Back

events.desc: …, a former socialist activist turned Theosophist, has announced her intention to depart … for India. She will soon join her Theosophist colleagues at their headquarters in ….
events.flavor:
"An imperious necessity forces me to speak the truth, as I see it, whether the speech please or displease, whether it bring praise or blame. That one loyalty to Truth I must keep stainless, whatever friendships fail me or human ties be broken. She may lead me into the wilderness, yet I must follow her; she may strip me of all love, yet I must pursue her; though she slay me, yet will I trust in her; and I ask no other epitaph on my tomb but:

'SHE TRIED TO FOLLOW TRUTH.'"

options.name: May she have a safe journey.
The Society needs her in ….

events.title: Through Storm to Peace

events.desc: Members of the Theosophical Society in … have declared the young … to be the likely future vessel of the divine entity Lord Maitreya. …, a Theosophist activist, has sought to adopt the boy.
events.flavor: The monsoon had yet to come, and the sky was still cloudless. The boy stood on the beach, staring aimlessly at the incoming waves. Lost, aloof, insulated from all around him by some intangible barrier. His father trudged through the sand, and placed a hand on his shoulder. The boy looked to him once more, and the memory of the sea silently passed away.

options.name: … will allow him to realize his full potential.
The boy belongs with his father, well away from the occult.

events.title: The World Teacher

events.desc: The Theosophical Society has founded an organization dedicated to prepare the world for the arrival of the divine Lord Maitreya. …, believed to be the future vessel of this being, has been appointed as the head of the organization.
events.flavor:
Declaration of Principles

1. We believe that a great Teacher will soon appear in the world, and we wish so to live now that we may be worthy to know Him when He comes.

2. We shall try, therefore, to keep Him in our minds always, and to do in His name, and therefore to the best of our ability, all the work which comes to us in our daily occupations.

3. As far as our ordinary duties allow, we shall endeavour to devote a portion of our time each day to some definite work which may help to prepare for His coming.

options.name: A means to inspire the world.
An Order to realise our earthly agenda.

events.title: The Order of the Star in the East

events.desc: Whilst on retreat in …, … has been struck by peculiar physical symptoms and a strong feeling of "otherness". … and … Theosophical Society chaperones believe this process to be mystical in nature.
events.flavor: "It's as though everything stood still. There's no movement, no stirring, complete emptiness of all thought, of all seeing. There's no interpreter to translate, to observe, to censor. An immeasurable vastness that is utterly still and silent. There is no space, nor time to cover that space. The beginning and the ending are here, of all things. There is really nothing that can be said about it."

options.name: Could it be true? Is he touched by the divine?
This man is troubled, nothing more.

events.title: Divine Inspiration

events.desc: In an announcement at the Order of the Star's annual convention in …, … has disavowed his following and proclaimed the Order dissolved. The Theosophical Society has been thrown into confusion by the announcement.
events.flavor: "I maintain that truth is a pathless land, and you cannot approach it by any path whatsoever, by any religion, by any sect. That is my point of view, and I adhere to that absolutely and unconditionally. Truth, being limitless, unconditioned, unapproachable by any path whatsoever, cannot be organized; nor should any organization be formed to lead or coerce people along a particular path. This is no magnificent deed, because I do not want followers, and I mean this. The moment you follow someone you cease to follow Truth."

options.name: The cause of freedom requires no leader.
Only the World Teacher could be so humble.
Perhaps it is time for him to retire.

events.title: A Pathless Land

events.desc: A procession of carriages through the streets of … has been interrupted by a bombing attack which killed two … women. One of the perpetrators, …, has been brought into custody.
events.flavor:
There was not a hint of trepidation on the young man's face, even with an armed policeman to his side and a hostile judge ahead of him. His back was erect, his shoulders were relaxed, and his face bore a beatific smile.

The outcome of the trial was not ever in doubt, even with a skilled counsel defending him. His mistake had been fatal, his end was certain from the moment the constables had laid eye on him. The worries of life had evacuated him, and left him unburdened. There was nothing to do but ensure he would be remembered.

options.name: His crimes warrant execution by hanging.
Life imprisonment will prevent him from becoming a martyr.

events.title: The … Conspiracy

events.desc: Citing the high levels of banditry and unrest in Berar, the … has requested to administer … on our behalf, in exchange for a substantial annual payment.
events.flavor:
"What is the bounty on that bandit leader's head?" the British officer asked.

"Five thousand rupees, sir."

"Five thousand! Surely this Gabbar is not worth so much?"

"Across all these villages," the official replied, drawing a large circle on the map in front of them, "if a child cries at night, their mothers tell them, "Sleep or Gabbar will come take you."

"If he and his ilk are such a terror, it might be best you allow us to handle the matter." the officer replied, smiling. "After all, we are experts at weeding out terrorists from our backyard."

options.name: Fine then. Let … deal with Berar.
Berar belongs to the … and no one else.

events.title: The Administration of Berar

events.desc: Unchecked unrest in the … has led to the outbreak of a civil war across the Indian subcontinent. Figures across … society have suggested abandoning the collapsing subcontinent to its fate.
events.flavor:
…, a senior politician and professor of Oriental studies, was asked about the state of India and if there was any hope for re-establishing governance. He had this to say:

"They are an ancient people, too old to learn the business of governance. Led as they are by their so-called leaders, chaos is the best we can expect out of them. We were their benevolent guides; without us, they are clearly lost."

options.name: Evacuate our personnel, and wash our hands of this affair.
India has been pacified before. It will be again.

events.title: The Anarchy

events.desc: The outbreak of open civil war across India has broken the resolve of the … government. They have ordered our administration abrogated, and all … citizens to evacuate India immediately.
events.flavor:
…
Imperial … Gymkhana Club
To all members,
It is with great sorrow that I must ask you to abandon your duty to India. Its ungrateful people have chosen to spit on the very hand that raised them. Say goodbye to our great works and make way for the ports our ancestors built; we will depart from them one last time.

options.name: Burn our papers, and make for the ports.
Announce an official transfer of power to ….
We will carve out a land of our own from ….

events.title: The Evacuation

events.desc: Indian independence activists led by … have marched to the seaside of … to protest the state salt monopoly. Upon arriving at the shore, they intentionally violated the law by harvesting salt.
events.flavor:
Salt Riot in …!

On …, a large group arrived in … with the clear intent of breaking the Imperial law. They collected seawater and boiled it to produce salt. Nearly all the people gathered were arrested.

We asked the march leader, a senior member of the …, what they intended to do with the salt. He explained that they deemed the salt tax untenable and wished to exert their right to self-rule through this nonviolent protest. If the reader is amused, then they are not alone! But at least one can rest assured that the nationalist movement is in harmless hands.

options.name: Our jails have space for them all.

Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Hail, law breaker!

Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: The Salt March

events.desc: An Indian lawyer by the name of … has founded the Natal Indian Congress, an organization dedicated to advocating for the rights of the … Indian population.
events.flavor:
Another Treasonous Voice

… saw the founding of the Natal Indian Congress—another organization in a series of rebellious groups unhappy with the current government. Led by the young Indian advocate, …, their focus seems to be the plight of Indians. Our more astute readers will find this unsurprising, as … was recently reported demanding the right to vote for Indian people. Perhaps we can take solace in the knowledge that despite their grand rebellious notions, these groups remain disunited.

options.name: The Indian community has found its champion.

Political Strength for the Cultural Erasure Status
Political Strength for the Open Prejudice Status

Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: We will see how he contends with the … mob.

events.title: The Natal Indian Congress

events.desc: After spending many years abroad, … has returned to the …. He has put his theory of Satyagraha, or "holding firmly to truth", to use in support of the Indian independence movement.
events.flavor:
As the advocate, recently returned from his travels abroad, speaks for the sixth hour, the convention is listless.

"Bright young man!" a Congress member quips.

"Who does he think he is?" another responds, "He seems to assume he is the smartest in the room; his every proclamation guarantees free ammunition for our enemies."

options.name: A hero returns to his native land.
Order the newspapers to keep this quiet.

events.title: Satyagraha

events.flavor:
"John, I was at high tea with the ladies, and a young woman approached us with the most perplexing petition. At first, I thought it was an odd prank played by Emma. You know how she is with her fancies. But it seems that this woman was quite serious. She said she is part of the India League, and they advocate for Indian independence. Once it was apparent that this was no prank, we asked her who they thought would lead the Indians in our stead. As if the whole idea wasn't ridiculous enough, she suggested they would lead themselves!

I don't know where these kids get those ideas. I imagine this is the cost of letting some of those Indians study and work here!"

options.name: A noble cause.
How... peculiar of them.

events.title: The India League

events.desc: The India League has published a brief on conditions in the …, highlighting extreme poverty and policies of repression against nationalist activists.
events.flavor: The officer eyed the telegram on his desk, a smirk tugging at his lips. The Governor-General had written to him to complain about the India League and their lengthy document about the treatment of Indians in India. The Governor was furious that the Home Office had allowed the League any room to breathe. The Governor had his sympathies, but the officer could not help but laugh. Surely, the Indian people knew their condition? What did the league hope to achieve? Only a traitor would support their cause. That they allowed some Indians to come study in this great country was kindness enough.

options.name: Something must be done about this.
Order the work banned in India.

events.title: The Condition of India

events.desc: The … trade of … is the target of … ambitions: … shall not remain the thrall of … and its commercial empire!
events.flavor:
The meeting hall was packed tight with men, and so cramped it seemed amazing that the speaker could stand upright without hitting the ceiling. Despite the awful conditions, his voice cut through the muggy air like a knife:

"Through self-reliance, we can gain our autonomy, and our independence. Our goals are simple: We want that which belongs to us, and we want to boycott that which does not belong to our country."

options.name: This movement must be carefully watched.
Perhaps some jail time will help … reconsider this movement.

events.title: The Non-Cooperation Movement

events.desc: Nationalist agitators in … have vowed to boycott our goods. Our coffers won't be damaged if they succeed, but our standing with the … will surely fall.
events.flavor: Smoke wafted through the rafters as the gray bespectacled figure droned through a report. The words '…' and 'agitation' were heard, but scarcely anything else in his murmurings could be understood. Did it matter, though? The empire was doing fine.

options.name: I'm sure someone will look into this.

events.title: Non-Cooperation in …

events.desc: Moved to action by the agitation of …, workers in … have put down their tools and left their workplaces. The whole region is on strike!
events.flavor:
The clerk burst into the magistrate's office, panting and gasping for air. "S-sir!" he stammered, "They've stopped working, sir!"

The old magistrate frowned. "Who's stopped working?"

"Everyone sir, everyone in …!"

"Good Lord! Is that allowed?"

options.name: This labor action is an affront to good government!
Perhaps it's time we negotiated with ….

events.title: Hartal!

events.desc: … leaders in … are encouraging people to produce their own goods and consume only locally-made products. Tariffs and taxes are plummeting!
events.flavor: "My nationalism is as broad as my self-reliance!" thumped the speaker. "I want …'s spirit to rise so that the whole world may benefit."

options.name: This action in … is insignificant.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Stop those agitators in … at once!

events.title: Swadeshi Protests

events.desc: Increasing radicalism has sparked a clash between followers of …'s Swadeshi Movement and the local police in …. Protesters were fired on, and in response a mob burned down the local police station. Representatives of the … appear visibly shook by the reports of violence.
events.flavor: The newspaper quivered in the man's shaking hands. He looked up at the men surrounding him. "This isn't what we wanted." A tear rolled down his cheek. "This isn't what I wanted the movement to be. We must stop the campaign."

options.name: Non-Violent Non-Cooperation is non-viable.
Perhaps it's time for soft-hearted souls to step aside.

events.title: The Blazing Chowki

events.desc: The …'s efforts to break …'s stranglehold on … trade has fizzled out, with no resounding successes.
events.flavor:
The meeting hall seemed half-empty despite its small size, and despite all the room available to sit in every man in there felt cramped, trapped. "Perhaps we asked too much," mused one figure glumly. "Perhaps we thought our oppressors weaker than they truly were. Perhaps the nation isn't really—"

"Silence, friend," quietly pleaded the man next to him. "We hurt enough right now, already."

options.name: Is the lack of victory truly a defeat?

events.title: Insufficient Self-Sufficiency

events.desc: The … has proclaimed a great victory today, praising the … for its triumph over … trade, and taking a monumental step forward together as a nation and a movement.
events.flavor: The port's warehouses stood empty now, but for once this was a good thing. … had faced the might of the … nation and had lost, with all its economic might and financial webs failing to defeat the simple strength of a united people. With the victory of non-cooperation and self-reliance, what was next for the …?

options.name: This is a great day for the national movement!

events.title: The Victory of Satyagraha

events.desc: International press has been reporting on a train robbery in … led by … agitators.
events.flavor:
"If they were dacoits, many more would have died. These young men were stealing OUR money back for US. They made mistakes but their intentions are noble."

"If they are so noble, then what were they doing waving guns at their fellow countrymen? Now an innocent man is dead. I will never forget the sound of his wife crying."

options.name: Deny our … guards were overpowered.
No use covering up our losses.

events.title: Train Robbery in …

events.desc: Deliberations have started in the train robbery trial where the accused revolutionaries are charged with robbery and murder.
events.flavor:
The roar of the crowd gathered outside the courtroom warms the hearts of the defendants. The same roar makes it hard to hear the prosecutor. Relentless, he strives on.

"Hijacking, possession of illegal firearms, and murder. These in itself are a terrible act your honor. But these shameless men did them all, only to commit an even more heinous crime. They tried to steal from the very crown that cares for them. The crowd outside would call them heroes, I believe the law would call them traitors."

options.name: Make an example - interrogate them.
Follow due process and order.

events.title: Stealing from the Crown

events.desc: Mass exports of grains and crops have left the people of … vulnerable during a regional famine.
events.flavor:
Dear Elizabeth,

I was escorting the Crown's collections across India the other day when I saw a most terrible sight. A man, thin as the stick he held, stood guard in front of his starving wife and two children. When I asked my mates, what he was guarding, they explained that the village had taken to cannibalism.

options.name: Use rail transport to supply food-surplus.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: We cannot afford such measures.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: A Regional Famine

events.desc: While many people are now embracing rail travel, tensions between communities are high as segregation holds strong.
events.flavor:
Two boys lean out of the train door, the fierce wind cooling them against the hot miserable day.

"I've heard that first-class has ceiling fans, and beds and their chairs are stuffed with cotton so you can sit for hours!"

"Well, I heard they get their own toilets."

"Well you heard wrong, Sirs and Madams don't need toilets."

"Is that why our compartment doesn't have one either?"

options.name: Social matters are not urgent.
More tea stalls will lessen the tension.

events.title: First-Class Accoutrements

events.desc: The grand railway project has finally been completed. The new railway opens up new opportunities for people to travel, work, and connect across the country.

options.name: Magnificent.

events.title: Railways for Prosperity

events.desc: … is in dire straits and does not have enough grain this year to feed itself, let alone pay its taxes. Of course, it has some reserves from previous years that are currently being used to feed the hungry.
events.flavor:
The Tax collector eyed the farmers suspiciously. They had all come to him as a group, hands joined as if begging. Usually, he would dismiss their pleas for tax relief. Every year was a tough year if you heard the farmers speak it.

But this time, he had seen the dead cows and the lifeless fields on the way in. Even if they had some grain stored away, it would likely not seem them all through the year. And then, who would he collect his tax from?

options.name: A deal is a deal. … must pay its taxes in full.
The state can pay reduced taxes till the famine lasts.
Let us hope they will remember this act of kindness. Forgive taxes and provide food relief instead.

events.title: Nothing Left to Spare

events.desc: In the face of the famine that plagued …, … has put forth a petition demanding that the … allow farmers to grow Food Crops in place of Cash Crops.
events.flavor: The aged farmer looked at … with a reverence that worried the officer. Zealous followers were dangerous and difficult to reign in. He was glad that, for now, they were simply putting forth a petition, yet he wondered what would happen if they ever decided to swing their sickles at flesh instead of grain.

options.name: A reasonable demand. Allow select farmers to change crops.
Everyone in the world can grow wheat. It is indigo and cotton that we came here for.

events.title: Can’t Eat Money

events.desc: … has begun a fast until death to persuade … to allow food crops to replace cash crops.
events.flavor: As the Governor General strolled the length of the office, his secretary couldn't help but smile. The general commanded an army of thousands, yet his biggest threat was a fasting man. If the man died, there would be terrible consequences. If he lived, he would bully them again just so. Only the lives of Kings and Queens mattered so much. How had they let a simple man get so important?

options.name: Perhaps the farmers can practice fasting too.
Let us compromise.

events.title: A Fast to End Hunger

events.desc: The famine in … has left many people destitute. To make ends meet, destitute farmers from … have walked all the way to …. They await entry at the city gates.
events.flavor:
The child yawned, he was sleepy, hungry, and the air in the city smelt bad. But his father had told him that they had to come here if they wanted to ensure his sister lived to turn two years old. So here they were after a whole week on the road.

And yet he could so see no food in sight. No fields to toil. Just large brick houses that looked cold, filled with even colder people. How was this going to help Ma and Didi?

options.name: The city is no place for a farmer.
The factories and godowns might be willing to hire them in return for reduced taxes.

events.title: A Plague of People

events.desc: Hardliners are demanding more vigorous enforcement of Anti-Catholic edicts that are part of our … laws. Persecutions may provoke a response from Catholic powers, however.
events.flavor: "Keep the country closed off! I beg of you, these people from overseas will only bring more trouble upon us if we let them stay here. We must jail their agents and drive out their influences if we want to remain strong and proud!"

options.name: Double down on the Anti-Catholic Edicts.
Perhaps a light touch is best here.

events.title: Anti-Catholic Edict Enforcement

events.desc: Religious and imperial interests have aligned to demand action in Indochina on behalf of the Catholic population in ….
events.flavor: "A higher calling drives our actions! It is with divine purpose that we must go forth and save our fellow man! And if we happen to acquire some territory along the way, who's to say that wasn't part of God's plan?"

options.name: Let us go forth and strike at …!
We should make peace, not war.

events.title: Intervention in Indochina?

events.desc: A brutal persecution of Catholics in … has caused both jingoists and the pious to demand a heavyhanded response immediately.
events.flavor: "Let's go—it will be quick, in and out, a simple two-month adventure."

options.name: … must be punished, and Indochina opened up!
We should make peace, not war.

events.title: Retaliation in Indochina?

events.desc: Our control of Indochina has grown and solidified to such a point that our territories there can be counted as a successful union of colonies and protectorates.
events.flavor: "With one unity of mind, body and spirit, we shall celebrate. The metropole and Indochina now move as one, speak as one, feel as one. Our nations are united together, and shall never be torn asunder. How could it ever be otherwise?"

options.name: Promote our values among the people.
Promote rubber production in the colonies.
Promote our loyal princes in Indochina.
Promote our glorious reign!

events.title: The Indochinese Union

events.desc: A deadly fire has killed many workers in …, due in part to dangerous working conditions and locked emergency exits. It has been revealed that …, a prominent member of the …, was the owner of the now-scorched factory.
events.flavor: One of the men who tried to put out the fire testified at the inquiry. "I thought the room was just full of charred machinery," he said, "but then I stepped on something soft."

options.name: This is just the price of progress.
… must be held responsible for these deaths!

events.title: The Great Garment Factory Fire

events.desc: Several workers dyed today at the … dyeworks, when an industrial-sized tub of hot dye accidentally spilled out over the workshop floor and the unsuspecting workers.
events.flavor: Locals are upset about the incident, claiming that the poor safety regulations in the hot and dangerous workplace are to blame for the accident, and are urging the government to take action. As rescue workers left the scene, several workshop employees were left dyeing.

options.name: We shall all dye sooner or later.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Manufacturing

options.name: They shall not have dyed in vain!

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Manufacturing

events.title: Dyeworks Accident

events.desc: A railroad accident in … only narrowly avoided heavy fatalities due to the quick thinking of the train's engineer, who perished in the crash. Only a few people died, but the wreckage will still take some time to clear.
events.flavor: "Come all you rounders, if you want to hear a story all about a brave engineer..."

options.name: Thank goodness for quick-thinking engineers!
Railmen should get more than a song for dying on the job.

events.title: The Brave Engineer

events.desc: A storage tank full to the brim with molasses intended for rum distillation has burst, flooding the streets of …'s commercial center, killing dozens and injuring hundreds of bystanders.
events.flavor: "The molasses, waist-deep, covered the streets and swirled and bubbled about the wreckage. Here and there struggled a form... whether it was animal or human being was impossible to tell. Only an upheaval, a thrashing about in the sticky mass, showed where any life was."

options.name: Close the distilleries while the wreckage gets cleared.
One tragedy must not stop progress!

events.title: The Great Molasses Flood

events.desc: A factory in … has been rocked by a tremendous boiler explosion, with dozens dead or injured. The story of this tragedy has quickly become a national event.
events.flavor: "The scalding steam rushed out of the burst boiler and into the faces of the men on the shop floor. If the blast itself or the flying debris didn't get them, then the steam surely did."

options.name: These events are simply the price of progress.
Workers should not be exploited and forced into such conditions.
Machines are dangerous! Industry itself is a cancer.

events.title: Boiler Explosion

events.desc: A mine in … has collapsed, trapping miners within the dark shafts below. The scale of the accident has made the tragedy a story across … and the nation.
events.flavor:
"They dug me out, but left my friend behind."

That was all the foreman was able to get out of the wretched boy. Sooty rags clung to him like wispy strands of a torn funeral jacket. Whether he held back his tears for fear of a beating, or to keep strong, the foreman did not know. He was spent for the day. The foreman hoped the manager had a mind for mercy.

options.name: This is a small price to pay for the march of industry.
This outrageous abuse of the common man cannot continue!
These mines are a blight upon man and countryside alike.

events.title: Mining Accident

events.desc: The disappearance of …, of the …, has raised serious concerns among the elites, given … recent opposition to the ….
events.flavor: "It was well past noon when the family reported to the pertinent authorities: … had gone missing all night, no warning or note was left behind. Relatives have expressed their concerns about it being prompted by … insistence on opposing the …, since a small knife had been left at their door a few days before, which they now interpret as a threat."

options.name: There's nothing to investigate here.
We cannot pass the law at the cost of our people's trust.

events.title: An Uncanny Disappearance

events.desc: While the government prepares to pass the … law, our agents have captured a … spy, damaging our already feeble trust in them.
events.flavor: "A list of all of our generals and their families, notes on the state of our barracks and ports, predictions about our imports, exports, production, ports, everything! I'm even surprised that they didn't get an inventory of our favorite …!"

options.name: Our people need to know!
This is very useful information that should remain... private.

events.title: An Accidental Discovery

events.desc: As the … law gains traction, many of our people have expressed concerns about their privacy.
events.flavor: "I have the right to not exist!," a worried citizen has reported to the …. "This is unheard of—an outrage! The lack of accuracy that this information may bring... imagine being accused of a crime you didn't commit just because they have put you in the wrong list, the wrong ideology, the wrong background."

options.name: They may have a point.
They have nothing to worry about!

events.title: The Age of Information

events.desc: A protest advocating for the … law was called in order to silence the detractors. However, the police force decided to take the law in their own hands and violently repressed the protesters.
events.flavor: "Ah! The irony of the situation! A protest against our current laws that fail to protect the citizen from the corrupted police is shut down by said police! My hands tremble with a feeling of indignation while I write this article. If the police are capable of this now, what else will they do in the future? We need the law to protect us."

options.name: Both parties need to calm down.
The police will have to publicly apologize for this.

events.title: A Cry for Freedom

events.desc: With the proposal to pass the … law, members of the government have voiced their concerns about it compromising the nation's internal security.
events.flavor: "How are we supposed to prevent reactionary attacks and schemes if we have no way to access public information? How are we going to keep our people safe if the only thing we're offering them is a false sense of security?"

options.name: That information is crucial for our administration.
We'll switch to other, less intrusive, methods.

events.title: A Matter of Security

events.desc: Members of the police force have been discovered organizing systematic attacks against supporters of the … law, vandalizing their business and meeting places.
events.flavor: "They destroyed the benches and broke down the doors. Threw stones at the windows and burned all the books. Left paintings on the walls where we were portrayed as animals, and they were ruling over us. They also made sure to leave behind some threats, so we knew it was them."

options.name: We shall make a public speech and make it clear that this is unacceptable.
The police force has become corrupted and immoral. It must be purged.

events.title: Unjustified Attacks

events.flavor:
… lit his pipe, and handed the swifly-fading match rightwards. His neighbor lit his own, and the smell of cheap tobacco began to infiltrate his nose.

The man who had joined him raised the pipe to his lips, and released a satisfied smoke ring. In the distance, on the edge of their hearing, a sharp sound rang out. Then another, then another.

"Did you hear that, too?", he asked, though he already knew the answer. And then, sooner than he expected, a hideous scream.

options.name: We must have reprisals.
Long live anarchy!

events.title: Messengers of Death

events.flavor:
For a brief, insane moment, … thought that the man was waving. And then she saw the object in the air, the man turning to run, … raising … hand to shield … face. And then it hit.

There was a terrible clap, a burst of pressure, a puff of smoke that seemed far smaller than it should be. A hideous ringing drowned out all other sound. She saw … step forwards, out of the smoke, and dumbly look down at where … hand had been. And then … knees gave way, and a slick of red ruin spilled across the cobbles.

options.name: … will be avenged.
Long live anarchy!

events.title: And Then, Nothing

events.desc: A militant of the … has carried out a terror attack in …, throwing two bombs into the orchestra pit of a packed theatre. Dozens of attendees have been killed or wounded.
events.flavor:
"You cannot be here," said the man by the door. "Do you understand that? Your actions will bring all of the state's hounds down on us."

…'s face split into a sneer. "You are a coward," he responded. "You snivelling, foolish coward. I have sacrificed myself in the benefit of human progress. You have a duty-"

"Keep your voice down. Progress... you are a butcher of children, and you cannot be here. Do you understand what you have done? Your indiscrimate slaughter has put the people's trust in us back by a century... You have pushed them into the arms of the state. You must leave. Now."

options.name: This terror cannot be tolerated.
There is no innocent bourgeoisie.

events.title: A Hellish Deed

events.desc: Viewing open political organization as unfeasible, the … has embraced the doctrine of "Propaganda by the Deed". Through public assassinations of politicians and businessmen, the movement hopes to inspire the masses to further revolutionary activity.
events.flavor:
The building's facade, scorched pitch-black, yawned before the detective like a the maw of a great beached sea monster. Display cases and clothes-racks, shattered and cast to the ground, formed its snaggled teeth.

A wind-tossed sheet of paper, corners charred, flattened itself against the side of his boot. "War!" it proclaimed in a neat copperplate font. He picked it up, and turned his back to the wind to stop its fluttering. "Class war," it continued, "sparked by you..."

He pocketed it. Now, he thought. Where was the nearest printers'?

options.name: Violent times await us.
All the more reason to be vigilant.

events.title: Propaganda by the Deed

events.desc: The … has taken up arms, launching a revolutionary struggle against the government from their heartland of ….
events.flavor:
"There's no more time. We need to go. Now."

Francisco swept his arm across the table in a mighty arc, sending its contents tumbling into his scuffed leather bag. Across the room, his comrade was pouring vials of gunpowder into the press' machinery. The sound of trumpets drifted in from outside. Marching men, some distance off. Two streets away? Three?

"Enough with that," he said. "Get the matches, we'll settle with what we have."

He shouldered the bag, and rushed towards the door, with spidery footsteps soon in tow. Excitement threatened to detonate his heart. … was so, so close, and a free world not much further.

options.name: Viva España!
A las barricadas!

events.title: The Black Tempest

events.desc: The spectre of anarchism has been exorcized from … soil. Order has been returned to the streets, and our citizens no longer need fear anarchist terror.
events.flavor:
The arcades of … shone with glass and gaslight. Silk-clad figures flitted from store to store, handing over a decade's wage for a necklace or a hat. Cashiers with frozen smiles filled their palms with pesetas destined for their employers' pockets.

In the fields outside …, scythes rose and fell in a hypnotic wave. A worker in the middle of the line, blinded by sweat and airborne chaff, took a clumsy step forwards. He fell, and the snap of his ankle resonated like a gunshot.

The print shop's window showed nothing but blue and brass. The first policeman through the door was hideously young—devoid of whiskers, acne-spotted, voice breaking as he shouted. Francisco looked into his eyes, and plunged the dagger into his own chest.

options.name: Peace reigns anew.
This is all there is, all there will ever be.

events.title: The Best of All Possible Worlds

events.desc: Drawn by interest in the growing … …, a representative of the International Workingman's Association by the name of … has crossed the border from ….
events.flavor:
The International … came at midnight. He slipped through the shop's back door like a breeze, greeting the waiting men with a nod and a whispered password, and then drifting upstairs.

There, behind the safety of a drawn curtain, they exchanged their aliases, their cover-stories, the tales of their battle-scars. The hard floor would suffice for now, said the International …. His hosts smiled at … bravado, and offered him pride of place on the loft's sole rug. The copyist would take first watch, settling down by the window with a shrouded candle.

By seven in the morning, the … was on a cart Southwards, and the locals congratulated themselves on a task well done.

options.name: Welcome to …, camarada!
Keep a close eye on this foreigner.

events.title: The Internacionalistas

events.flavor:
Colonel … lifted the tent flap, and slipped inside. The atmosphere was already heavy with smoke, and the other chairs filled. Maps were spread out across the table - terrain, government facilities, vital infrastructure. He saluted the … sitting at the end of the table, and took his seat.

He was not alone. Colonel … sat to his left, his pipe merrily contributing to the suffocating haze.

"I apologize for my tardiness," … began. "There was a new gate guard."

The … nodded. "Forgiven. Your report, please. Status of the Twenty-Fourth?"

options.name: Godspeed, … …!
The present regime must survive.

events.title: … …'s Endeavor

options.name: The military has spoken. Our mandate is done.
We will not capitulate!

events.desc: The conspiracy to overthrow the sitting … government has lost all momentum amongst the …. … …'s plot has been abandoned.
events.flavor: "The trouble with you, …, is that just because you have succeeded in inducing a handful of half-wits to disfigure the … scene by going about in black shorts, you think you're someone. You hear them shouting "Hail, …!" and you imagine it is the Voice of the People. That is where you make your bloomer. What the Voice of the People is saying is: "Look at that frightful ass … swanking about in footer bags! Did you ever in your puff see such a perfect perisher?"

options.name: Pray no one will find out what nearly transpired.
We know what plans … had in store. Justice will be served.

events.title: For Lack of Interest

events.desc: … … has become aware of the state's efforts to reduce the amount of military forces available to …. … has accused the government of recklessly meddling in military affairs.
events.flavor:
… … paced back and forth across the floor of … tent. Assembled before … were … loyal lieutenants—those who had not yet been forced to relocate. He had not been able to outright refuse the orders that had suddenly arrived from …, reducing him to a skeleton crew of crucial headquarters staff.

The government was onto him. There was little other explanation. No other command had been targeted so heavily. Were he to recover his positions, he would need to respond. He indicated to two of the men in the front row.

"Colonel …, Major …..."

options.name: "...inform your men to take positions."
"...relay the news to our far-flung colleagues."

events.title: Closing In

events.desc: Spearheaded by … …, the … has begun to maneuver towards establishing a pro-… government in … by force of arms. The scheme is backed by substantial foreign funding.
events.flavor:
Colonel … lifted the tent flap, and slipped inside. The atmosphere was already heavy with smoke, and the other chairs filled. Maps were spread out across the table - terrain, government facilities, vital infrastructure. He saluted the … sitting at the end of the table, and took his seat.

He was not alone. Colonel … sat to his left, his pipe merrily contributing to the suffocating haze.

"I apologize for my tardiness," … began. "There was a new gate guard."

The … nodded. "Forgiven. Your report, please. Status of the Twenty-Fourth?"

options.name: A … alignment could prove favorable.
The present regime must survive.

events.title: The … Scheme

events.desc: Emphasizing the underdeveloped state of the … economy, the Minister of the Treasury has sketched out an ambitious reform plan designed to re-establish the country among the world's premier economies.
events.flavor:
Economic Report on the General State of the Public Treasury to the Most Illustrious … of …
It should come as no surprise to the esteemed gentlemen of …, that the waves of industrial and commercial innovation, which have so transformed our brethren beyond the Pyrenees, have not as yet reached the shores of our own dominions in earnest. It is the opinion of the Hacienda, that in the absence of immediate policies intending to correct this growing imbalance, our country's path will be steered not towards civilization and prosperity, but rather towards barbarism and destitution. The following report will ...

options.name: Daunting, perhaps. But necessary.
We are not in a position to pursue this at the moment.

events.title: On the General State of the Public Treasury

events.desc: Intrepid reporters working for the … … have uncovered our attempts at manipulation and published a scathing report accusing the government of incompetence and deceit.
events.flavor: The coffee tasted better today. It always did when his mood was up. And his mood was up today. Nothing, at least nothing one could put in print, gave the old man greater pleasure than seeing the current government fumble their way from scandal to scandal. "Bloody idiots" he mumbled, sipping his coffee once again.

options.name: Damn them all. Reaffirm our committment to the original targets.
Run a massive press campaign to discredit their claims.

events.title: Government Manipulation Revealed

events.desc: The vast … mining investments have borne fruit, and the country's mine pits are abuzz with activity like never before. A particularly successful company has now approached the government with a proposal to improve the mining infrastructure of one of our principal mining districts.
events.flavor: Two sharp knocks on the door interrupted the miner's breakfast. He had lingered too long and the foreman's boy was making the rounds. That damned lickspittle. Kissing his wife goodbye, he slung his sack across his back and stepped into the chill of the early dawn. A somber procession snaked its way from the company town up to the pithead, silent save for the dull clank of metal on metal. Twelve hours of toil and darkness awaited.

options.name: Direct them to the rich … veins of the ….
The … pits of … could be expanded.
The older … mines of … are in need of modernization.
What else but …, the black gold of ….

events.title: Ere the Lark Wakes

events.desc: Referencing the economic reform program proposed some years back, the Minister of the Treasury now demands that we take immediate action to implement it, claiming that … will be relegated to the dustbin of history if the government's inaction persists.
events.flavor:
Economic Report on the General State of the Public Treasury to the Most Illustrious … of …
It should come as no surprise to the esteemed gentlemen of …, that the waves of industrial and commercial innovation, which have so transformed our brethren beyond the Pyrenees, have not as yet reached the shores of our own dominions in earnest. It is the opinion of the Hacienda, that in the absence of immediate policies intending to correct this growing imbalance, our country's path will be steered not towards civilization and prosperity, but rather towards barbarism and destitution. The following report will ...

options.name: Very well, make the necessary announcements.
We are still in no position to pursue this.

events.title: Hacienda Demands Action

events.desc: Having successfully carried out the Regeneration reform program, the government is receiving praise even from her most embittered opponents.
events.flavor: With a steady hand, the minister opened the great ledger and glanced once more at the figures within. To what degree they could be trusted he was not entirely certain, but that mattered little beside the public jubilation they were sure to inspire. No, he thought. That reckoning could be left to the children of tomorrow. Today belonged to him.

options.name: … marches proudly into the future.

events.title: Plus Ultra

events.desc: The government's inability to carry through the Regeneration reforms has provoked public outrage. Angry crowds gather outside the Hacienda, while the press proclaims the failure a national disgrace.
events.flavor:
