How many humiliations must this country bear? Were the events of the last century not enough? The minister drew the curtain aside and peered into the street, where the crowd had raised an effigy in his likeness—a crude figure dangling from a poorly knotted rope. Its face bore a twisted parody of the same mustache that greeted him every morning, bobbing up and down to the rhythm of the crazed lunatics below him.

He turned to face his valet. "Send for a coach, please. And send note to my barber that I must see him this afternoon."

options.name: The cards were stacked against us.

events.title: Degeneration

events.desc: With the beginning of the election season, the patronage networks that riddle rural … have roused themselves to readiness. The … await the marching orders of the provincial governors.
events.flavor:
The atmosphere in the casino hung heavy with smoke. In a corner booth, a man in a Panama hat waved a Cuban cigar in the air, a faux-melancholic expression on his face.

"We, the liberals, were convinced that we would win the elections. However, God's will has been otherwise."

He placed the cigar into his mouth, and let out a puff of smoke. A smile played around his lips.

"It seems that it is we, the conservatives, who have won the elections."

options.name: Lend the … our support.
The … could use a term in government.
Distribute offices amongst the ….
The … is in need of assistance.
Let the chips fall as they may.
Let the chips fall as they may.

events.title: Right Away, Boss

events.desc: Election season has begun in … - and, with it, the strategizing of the government's fixers. If we wish, we may wield the power of the state to ensure a favorable result.
events.flavor:
On the table, a map of … sprawled across books, empty mugs, and lost drawing-instruments. Four men formed a circle around it, chattering about the intuitive leaning of …. It was certain to go for the government, they decided - but by how much? Could they muster an extra thousand votes out of the suburbs? How would the recent accumulation of laborers in the area affect voting patterns?

Half an hour into what had been intended to be a lunch break, they reached their decision. The town would grant their party eight thousand votes, with a solid - but fruitless - opposition bloc in the working-class areas. Far more tasteful than 101% turnout.

options.name: The … is the natural party of governance.
Favor the ….
Change course - grant the … a term in power.
The … is in need of assistance.
The … shall have our support.
If we are to achieve anything, the elections must be free.
Let the chips fall as they may.

events.title: The Right Result

events.desc: Per the terms of the …, … … and … descendants have been restored to their rightful position in the … line of succession. Once … departs the throne, a … monarch will reign over … once more.
events.flavor:
The law of October 30th, before it was amended, had stated that no foreigner may hold the throne of Brazil. It had excluded Queen Maria from the line of succession, and split the house of Bragança in two—those of Portugal, and those of independent Brazil.

Could one truly claim that any Portuguese was a foreigner? Yes, said the nationalists, who pointed at Brazil's independent heritage, at the abuses of the Portuguese Cortes, at its hard-fought independence. No, said the unionists, who proclaimed the universality of the Portuguese identity, its pluricontinental history. How could the land which once held the Portuguese court ever consider itself a separate nation?

options.name: To have and to hold.

events.title: Back in Order

events.desc: Sensing the Republican threat to the Crown, agents of … have offered diplomatic assistance in support of … ….
events.flavor:
"We are well aware of the troubles you face," said the man in the Panama hat. "Brazil has long benefited from the magnanimity of her Emperor, yet some lack respect for his role. They desire a monopoly on power. And what will they do with it?

The functionary raised a Cuban cigar to his lips, and let out a puff of smoke. He waited a moment to respond. "Divide the country, I imagine. They presume the liberty of the individual to best be expressed in the liberty of the provinces."

The man in the Panama hat nodded. "Your words, then, not mine. Our Regeneração has greatly extended our capabilities. You need only give the word, and we will give you all we may."

options.name: Their goodwill is dearly appreciated.
We will stand on our own merits.

events.title: The Portuguese Connection

events.flavor:
Antônio stood with his arms behind his back, watching the artist scratch away at the drafting paper. What had been rough shapes were now resolving themselves into something more detailed—two women draped in the flags of the United Kingdom, the Southern Cross in the sky, a pair of angelic wings. When the charcoal pencil had finished the first pass over their faces, he cleared his throat.

"Hm?" the artist said, eyes still fixated on his work.

"Do they have to be kissing quite so... passionately?"

"Yes," replied the artist. "I assure you, it is absolutely imperative."

options.name: Let our bonds be stronger than ever before.
Ours is the Fifth Empire, and the greatest of all.

events.title: Pluricontinental

events.desc: On the eve of … …'s accession to the throne of …, the … … have made a grab for power. They have proclaimed a Republic, and sworn to defend the country against any would-be foreign ruler.
events.flavor:
The Ambassador's face twitched as he read the telegram. It was too cold. The fireplace blazed behind its pink marble hearth, but he could no longer feel it.

"Not here," he said to the empty room. "Not now. Not like this. It's been far too long..."

The cold was replaced by something white-hot. He stood up, strode across the room, and flung open the door.

options.name: Call for the Naval Minister.
Anchors aweigh! We end this here and now.
We have done all we can.

events.title: The Republic of the Sword

events.desc: After a series of rejected plans, a revised proposal by a newly hired architect appears to meet the criteria of both the government and the … to begin construction on Atocha Railway Station.
events.flavor:
The young engineer, a great connoisseur of iron architecture currently popular in France, presents the latest designs for Atocha Railway Station to the committee for review. Members of the … look on eagerly, greatly pleased with the revised plans after many years of debate.

The engineer reassures everyone of the project's viability: "Once the project is approved, work can begin immediately!"

options.name: This is certainly in accordance with everyone's interests.
The … have miscalculated the demand for such a structure.

events.title: A Revised Proposal

events.desc: In the heart of …, Atocha Railway Station is now operational. The aspirations of … have been realized.
events.flavor: The newly constructed railway is picturesque with its red bricks made of fine pressed sand and terracotta ornaments. The central nave of Atocha Railway Station's concourse greets the influx of passengers upon arrival to … and welcomes them to the bustling streets of ….

options.name: The benefits of the railway station are immesurable.
Atocha Railway Station is more than a railway; it is a work of art!

events.title: Atocha Railway Station Inaugurated

events.desc: … members of the … have issued a proposal to construct Grand Theater of Havana in the heart of … at the site of Teatro Tacón. The group has collected a significant sum of money to be used in this renovation endevour.
events.flavor:
"The celebrated Tacon Theatre faces the Paseo de Isabella, and is built on the corner of San Rafael Street. It is a capacious structure, but extremely plain and unimpressive in its exterior appearance. ... The frescos are in good style, and the ornamentation, without being excessive, is in excellent and harmonious taste. A large, magnificent glass chandelier, lighted with gas, and numerous smaller ones extending from the boxes give a brilliant light to this elegant house, which is one of the largest theatres in the world."

— Maturin Murray Ballou

options.name: The grandeur of Grand Theater of Havana will be indisputable.
… has no need for such a venture.

events.title: Expanding the Arts in Havana

events.desc: The construction and renovation proposed by … members of the … is now complete. Art flourishes not only in the newly built Grand Theater of Havana, but also in the streets of ….
events.flavor:
"Evening music in the open air is always attractive, but nowhere is its influence more keenly felt than under the mellow effulgence of tropical nights. Nowhere can we conceive of a musical performance listened to with more relish and appreciation than in the Plaza de Armas or the Parque de Isabella in Havana. The latter place on the occasion of the concerts is the resort of all classes. ... Even the humble classes are seen in large numbers quietly strolling on the outer portions of the Plaza listening to the fine performances of the band, and quietly enjoying the music, 'tamed and led by this enchantress still.'"

— Maturin Murray Ballou

options.name: Cuban arts will thrive in the region.
Surely this will place Cuban art on the world stage.

events.title: Palacio del Centro Gallego

events.desc: The Manila Cathedral is now in ruins after an intense earthquake struck …. … of the … have issued a proposal to rebuild the cathedral. The group has collected a significant sum of money to be used in its construction.
events.flavor:
"The destructive ravages and changes produced by earthquakes are nowhere more remarkable than in the Philippines. They have overturned mountains, they have filled up valleys, they have desolated extensive plains; they have opened passages for the sea into the interior, and from the lakes into the sea. There are many traditional stories of these territorial revolutions, but of late disasters the records are trustworthy. ... Successive earthquakes have brought upon Luzon a series of calamities."

— John Bowring

options.name: We must quickly rebuild the cathedral.
… has much more pressing issues.

events.title: Earthquake at …

events.desc: Despite the damage and damage to its predecessor, the Manila Cathedral is once more the cathedral of the Archdiocese of Manila.
events.flavor:
"Though the name of Manila is given to the capital of the Philippine Islands, it is only the fort and garrison occupied by the authorities to which the designation was originally applied. ... The palace fills one side of a public plaza in the fortress, the cathedral another of the same locality, resembling the squares of London, but with the advantage of having its centre adorned by the glorious vegetation of the tropics, whose leaves present all varieties of colour, from the brightest yellow to the deepest green, and whose flowers are remarkable for their splendour and beauty."

— John Bowring

options.name: The cathedral is a moving display of devotion.
The cathedral will serve as an enduring symbol of Manila.

events.title: The Sixth Manila Cathedral

events.desc: The spouse of … … has made plans to commission the restoration and renovation of Pena Convent.
events.flavor:
"Lo! Cintra's glorious Eden intervenes
In variegated maze of mount and glen.
Ah me! what hand can pencil guide, or pen,
To follow half on which the eye dilates
Through views more dazzling unto mortal ken
Than those whereof such things the bard relates,
Who to the awe-struck world unlocked Elysium's gates?"

— Lord Byron

options.name: The palace will be an artistic achievement for …!
How frivolous.

events.title: Glorious Eden

events.desc: The renovations for Pena Palace are now complete. The ruins of the former convent have been thoroughly transformed.
events.flavor: On a clear day, when the Sintra Mountains mist clears, the structure atop the hills can be seen from …. Born of a king's imagination and reimagined by a romanticist architect, the bright red and yellow facades of Pena Palace are resplendent—a true … treasure.

options.name: The beauty of the palace is undisputed.
The world will marvel at our artistic achievement.

events.title: The Jewel of Sintra

events.desc: The Association of Devotees of Saint Joseph have hired an architect who has conceptualized the design of Sagrada Família Cathedral in a Modernist style unique to Catalonia. Once approved, construction can start immediately.
events.flavor:
"There are no straight lines or sharp corners in nature.
Therefore, buildings must have no straight lines or sharp corners."

— Antoni Gaudí

options.name: Entrust this architect to oversee construction.
This undertaking is outrageous.

events.title: Modernist Architecture

events.desc: Steady progress has been made in the development of Sagrada Família Cathedral. Impressed with the architect's devotion to the project, the … now support the next phase of construction.
events.flavor: From afar, the east-facing Nativity Facade of Sagrada Família Cathedral shines when bathed in the golden rays of dawn. Rounded, botanical shapes depict the birth of Jesus Christ. Even in this partially constructed state, the temple is a marvel.

options.name: The … are sharp-eyed.

events.title: Nativity Facade

events.desc: Unfinished but not abandoned, construction for the Sagrada Família Cathedral continues even as the architect who originally designed the grand plans for the temple has passed away. His successor will take over so construction does not suffer a period of neglect.
events.flavor:
"There is no reason to regret that I cannot finish the church. I will grow old but others will come after me. What must always be conserved is the spirit of the work, but its life has to depend on the generations it is handed down to and with whom it lives and is incarnated."

— Antoni Gaudí

options.name: His legacy will live on.

events.title: Unfinished Masterpiece

events.desc: Another facade of Sagrada Família Cathedral has been completed, signaling the end of construction, for now. The Modernist architect's extraordinary vision is a cultural touchstone here in ….
events.flavor:
After so many years of construction, the ambitious architectural designs of another facade have been realized. Foreign travelers who come to Sagrada Família Cathedral marvel at the structure's unique style. Two visitors stand before the newest addition to the temple.

"Breathtaking," one traveler remarks, unable to conceal the awe in his voice.

His companion, however, looks on skeptically. "Perhaps this Modernist style is an acquired taste."

options.name: Such exceptional art!
A true architectural marvel.

events.title: The End, for Now

events.desc: Despite the doubting words of the radical opposition, the … government has managed the tremendous feat of paying off …'s debts. The victories of "Devorismo" may one day eclipse its grotesque corruption.
events.flavor:
The Finance Minister ascended to the stand, and swept his gaze across the chamber. He could tell at a glance which of them would be friendly, which would be much less so. How many of these deputies represented regions whose commons had been sold off to his allies? How many had faced petitions from desperate men and women who now needed to pay for firewood? Not a majority, and that was all that mattered.

"The government's first duty," he said, "has been to embark upon the path of economic management. And we have walked this path precisely as envisioned..."

options.name: The ends have come to justify the means.
The … cause has earned another victory.

events.title: Promised and Delivered

events.desc: The abuses of the "Devourist" government have become impossible to ignore. The masses of … and the National Guard have descended upon the Cortes Geraes, demanding … … hand over power to the opposition.
events.flavor:
"We are on the eve of civil war. Tomorrow, Your Excellency will command the …'s armies, and I will command those of the Republic. If the sword of Bouças clashes with the sword of Asseiceira, my friendship and regard for Your Excellency will not suffer the slightest break."

—Manuel da Silva Passos, to the Marquis of Sá da Bandeira

options.name: The Charter has run its course - long live the Constitution!
They will not return us to anarchy!

events.title: The … Revolution

events.desc: …, …, and a group of other left-wing politicians have formed a society to discuss radical reform in …. Members of the sitting government have denounced it as a seditious conspiracy, calling for its forced closure.
events.flavor:
"How is it possible that one may be both a patriot and a traitor?"

António reached out, and flicked the blinds shut. He looked back to the man across the table, and lowered his voice.

"So long as Dom Miguel is on the throne," he began, "the man who fights against him is a patriot. He may smash whatever he wants, such is a means to an end. But if he were to appoint a liberal to his cabinet? Ah, now the Kingdom is worth protecting, and all who continue the fight become traitors. Holding the throne makes reactionaries of us all."

options.name: Order this organization shuttered at once.
We were all revolutionaries, once.

events.title: The Camilos Club

events.desc: A fire in the Royal Treasury building has destroyed many documents pertaining to the … government's expenditures. Whilst the true perpetrators are unknown, opposition figures have accused the government of arranging the fire to conceal its corruption.
events.flavor:
"Purely coincidental-"
"A tragedy, for all the nation-"
"An investigation is underway-"

The Minister looked up from his blurry world of letter-writing, interrupted by a suddenly flickering light. The candle had run low again, and the evening sunlight vanished completely. He turned to the nearest servant, and gestured towards it.

"They wish of me to explain how the blaze broke out here, of all places," he grumbled. "They must understand that no fireproofing is perfect..."

options.name: Absurd conspiracizing!
Place the blame on the Finance Minister.

events.title: A Likely Story

events.desc: The policies of the "Devorismo" have consumed the vast majority of …'s former national properties. Whilst the pocketbooks of … politicians have seen great bounties, the state treasury remains destitute.
events.flavor:
"The Nation and the Courts have the right to know the truth and the whole truth, and, since our ills are so profound, it is necessary that they be known so that they can be remedied. The Nation was tired of civil war and bloody struggle, our fortune was squandered by the perpetrators of usurpation, and the government's first duty was to embark on the path of economic management. Unfortunately, this path was not followed: the ease of obtaining money through loans produced a kind of exaltation in favor of Credit, and its prodigies were exaggerated on several occasions in this Chamber."

—Francisco Antonio de Campos

options.name: We have walked this road to its bitter conclusion.
Private ownership is an ends in itself.

events.title: Eaten Through

events.desc: The instatement of direct elections and removal of the … government has created an opportunity to replace the unpopular Constitutional Charter of 1826. The … has called for a new Constitution, enacted through democratic means rather than royal fiat.
events.flavor:
"What is the difference between a Constitution granted and one enacted? It is the difference between charity and honest work, between infancy and adulthood. The former presents the nation as subjects of a sovereign, meakly grasping for scraps of goodwill. The latter embodies the nation as self-determining, a body of which the sovereign is representative."

The end of the speech transitioned into the furious scratch of the secretary's pen. A satisfying "clunk" marked its completion.

"Good," said the speaker. "Now, six more points..."

options.name: The … people will have their Constitution!
Our problems lie not with the system, but those at its head.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: Away With Charity

events.desc: The ideal of a great "Regeneration" which would reverse …'s long decline has long held sway over … liberalism. Capitalizing on its relative popularity, the … government has declared itself to be the first government of Regeneration.
events.flavor:
"Honours and rewards will be granted as the result of genuine service. Public education will render the youth virtuous and well-disciplined. The army will be the firm support of peace, both foreign and domestic, its strength balanced by the organisation of national legions under the control of civil authorities. The number of landowners will grow. The farmer will enjoy the fruit of his labour. Factories will supply the public with the goods necessary for consumption, and will employ the many hands that now wither in idleness and poverty."

—Manuel Borges Carneiro, Regenerated Portugal

options.name: For the good of the country.

events.title: The Spirit of Regeneration

events.desc: The Regeneration has brought modernity to every facet of … society. If it were once true that our nation was in decline, our successes have proved this need not be permanent.
events.flavor:
The space around the sick-bed was crowded with relatives, so much so that João could barely see a hair on his grandfather's head. His voice, once a strong baritone, had grown reedy over the years. Still, he projected the best he could, and those with tears running down their faces shushed themselves so he could be heard.

"...when I was young, I fought the French", he said, "and Évora had no streetlights. And now we have trains, and it can take all of you to me. What can I do but thank God that, of all times, He chose to place me here and now?"

options.name: Long live the regenerated …!

modifiers.label: Radicals and Loyalists from Standard of Living changes

options.name: Our heroes are those who dream of infrastructure.

modifiers.label: Radicals and Loyalists from Standard of Living changes

events.title: At Long Last

events.desc: The period of political and fiscal stability that allowed for the ambitious program of Regeneration has come to an end. … may no longer afford to dream.
events.flavor:
It was over. All the Minister had worked for, all the measures he had spent the past decade so carefully outlining. Perhaps the state of the country was simply irrecoverable. Perhaps it had been futile from the start, and there was never anything he could have done to restore its sunward ascent. Perhaps it was even worse than that, and it had been entirely salvageable, were it not for the egos of generals and other fools.

The academics would argue over it for the next century, he knew. He would need to contend with seeing books about the aborted Regeneration on the shelves, feeling the terrible desire to see what they had to say about him. What was there to do but weep?

options.name: To survive outweighs all else.

events.title: A Ladder for Icarus

events.desc: The agrarian reforms of the Regeneration have both increased productivity and transitioned to a more entrepreneurial ownership system. Harvest time is now accompanied by the clattering of machines, and a bountiful pall of smoke.
events.flavor:
"Now, António, tell me, how did you come by all of this?" Maria swept her hand over the marble-columned parlor, the paintings dotting the walls, the grand hardwood staircase.

"Ah, do you remember my father's vineyard? I placed it on the stock market, and was very fortunate to attract the attention of a consortium of English investors. Within two years, I had doubled my money. Within four, I had doubled it again. Now, I may hire a man to oversee it for me. And with the time I save..."

His fingers gently brushed against the back of her hand, and she felt her face grow warm.

options.name: The countryside, long unchanged, finds a new life.
Regeneration uplifts all that it touches.

events.title: The Color of Progress

events.desc: The Regeneration has brought the railway and telegraph to every province of …. Widely available transportation has opened once-isolated communities to the free exchange of goods and information.
events.flavor:
"I took the train to Porto last month."

Carlos turned to his neighbor, a skeptical expression on his face. Manuel's pearly white teeth shone through a coating of sweat and brick-dust. He pulled out the trowel, and slathered a layer of grout atop the next spot on the wall.

"Really?" Carlos said, "how much was the ticket?"

"Ah, do you take me for a millionaire? I was the fireman!"

options.name: We need no longer remain strangers to one another.
All politics may be reduced to transportation.

modifiers.label: Radicals and Loyalists from Standard of Living changes

events.title: A Thousand Miles

events.desc: The Regeneration has changed the face of … public administration. An unprecedented number of students enter school each year, and an abundance of fresh university graduates provide recruits for private enterprise and the state bureaucracy alike.
events.flavor:
The students sat in neat rows, books resting in their laps, eyes forward. None of them dared make a sound. The professor looked over them, before speaking. His voice echoed off of the tiled floor, the walls covered in paintings of century-old rectors.

"Describe how the enumerated responsibilities of the Cortes differ between the Constitution of 1822 and the Constitutional Charter of 1828."

All as one, a dozen pens set to work on their pages.

options.name: Our people will become the most sophisticated in Europe.
Lawyers for everyone!

events.title: Signed and Countersigned

events.desc: The heroic efforts of Crown and Cortes have established … as a thoroughly modern and liberal nation. The constitutional order has triumphed over all who would challenge it.
events.flavor:
A thick layer of smoke had collected around the ceiling of the officers' club, shifting the light of the lamps towards a reddish hue. It was nearly two in the morning, and all but the most diehard revelers had retreated back into their accommodations. A man in the uniform of a General sat in the corner, surrounded by his staff and enthusiastically chatting with a serving-girl.

"Some fool sent me a letter," he said, "and it was terrible. An affront to God, but worthy of laughter nonetheless. The gentleman used an alias, and seemed dead-set on enlisting me into some bull-headed plot. As if I would raise arms against my country! He ought to get with the times."

options.name: Long live the Constitution!
The spirit of Vintismo will never die.

events.title: Out of the Dark

events.flavor:
"Once the existence of the Crown becomes a matter of public debate," said the exile, "it could no longer fulfill its unifying role. And what other reason did it have to exist?"

The ambassador nodded along as he spoke. "And, in your words, is that why is fell?"

"A symptom, but not the reason. The Crown capitulated over and over again. To compromise with the Liberals was a doomed endeavor. Their Constitutions strip Kings of their divine right, and render them glorified clerks." Each word dripped with bitterness as it exited his mouth. "If only I had seen it sooner."

options.name: So begins a new chapter of history.
A Third Liberalism waits over the horizon.

events.title: The Highest Calling

events.desc: The restoration of … … to the … throne marks the ultimate defeat of the Constitutionalist project. No more will the Crown need to compromise its God-given power.
events.flavor:
"In a few months, from one corner to another of the Kingdom, the national spirit awakened; the most manifest abhorrence of revolutionary principles appeared with such intensity that only the reverence owed to the Mercy of My August Father, which the faithful Portuguese Nation rendered to Him, could prevent the people from sacrificing those who had promoted and sustained the Revolution."

— Manifesto of His Most Faithful Majesty, Our King D. Miguel

options.name: The liberal aberration has met its end.
One cannot simply ignore the present.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: The People and the King

events.desc: The staunchly conservative Archbishop of Toledo, …, has passed away. The … now has the opportunity to appoint a successor more amenable to the Isabelline cause.
events.flavor:
"I would like to say "good riddance", said …. "I truly wish that I could believe that this will be a boon to the Queen. Regrettably, there are all too many questions remaining."

"Is that so?" … raised an eyebrow. All around their boat, the Manzanares peacefully trickled on. … swung his fishing rod outwards. The hook sailed in a great arc before plunging into the water.

"The Pope won't have it, for one. Rome is friendly to the pretenders. Secondly... the deficits of the Church cannot be attributed to one man. A loyal replacement may spur further insurrection, God help us."

options.name: A constitutionalist Archbishop will serve us well.
Appoint a more conciliatory candidate.

events.title: The Bride of Christ

events.desc: The fall of the monarchy and proclamation of a … has raised the question of which flag the Republic shall adopt. The democratic left has rallied around the addition of a purple stripe, representing historical Castile and León.
events.flavor:
"The Republic shelters everyone. So too does the flag, which signifies peace and the cooperation of citizens under the rule of just laws. It signifies even more: the new fact in Spain’s history that the action of the State has no other motive than the interest of the country and no other rule than respect for conscience, freedom, and labor."

—Presidency of the Provisional Government of the Republic, 1931

options.name: The flag of the Republic shall be the #tooltippable;tooltip:…,spa_republic_2_tt red, yellow, and purple tricolor.
The #tooltippable;tooltip:…,spa_republic_3_tt red, white, and purple tricolor will make a bold statement.
The provisional #tooltippable;tooltip:…,spa_republic_1_tt bicolor should be made permanent.

events.title: The Banner of the Republic

events.flavor: The dispute over the … succession had caused the Papacy no shortage of headaches. Ferdinand VII, who had by all accounts been a good Catholic, had signed a decree which permitted his daughter, Isabella, to take the throne. Facing a rebellion by her uncle, Isabella's regent had decided to fall in with the liberals—a faction that was cold at best towards the Church. And so the Church was forced to choose—a pious rebel, or a hostile Queen?

options.name: The … … is a pretender. … has no right to appoint an Archbishop.
The government of … has proven itself non-hostile. Confirm the appointment.
Refuse the appointment, and demand the Bishop denounce it.

events.title: The Liberal Primacy

events.desc: The provisional government of … has offered the vacant throne of … to any member of the House of Bragança who is willing to pledge allegiance to the … Constitution.
events.flavor: "The Constituent Cortes of the Spanish Nation, upon concluding the grave and delicate charge entrusted to them by the free suffrage of the people, have, in solemn and public session of last …, elected Your Highness to occupy the Throne. By their honorable confidence we come to bring to Your Highness the vote of the Representation of a people master of its own destiny, and to invite you, by accepting such a spontaneous offering, to place upon Your Royal Highness's brow the Crown of Spain, which a hundred kings, by their glorious deeds, have so greatly adorned."

options.name: The … will accept a second crown.
Put forth a candidate from our House.
To hold the … throne would threaten our sovereignty.

events.title: The Spanish Throne

events.desc: Marshal …, hero of the Carlist War, has agreed to be enthroned as King of …. The house of Espartero, once humble workers, have become the most honored nobility of ….
events.flavor:
"Espartero! Can you believe it?"

It was the ninth time Francisco had heard it today, usually punctuated by a detailed spiel about how brilliant the old soldier was. Each instance drove the nails of dread deeper into his heart. An unpopular despot was all well and good - he could offer dictates all he wished, and get chased across the border for it. But one who could captivate the masses? He could govern. He could turn the population of Barcelona into a hundred thousand policemen. He could twist the populace to string him up, to string his co-revolutionist up, to...

Francisco forced a smile onto his face, and turned to the clerk who had spoken up. "I expected nothing less."

options.name: Long live Espartero, Marshal and King!

events.title: The Self-Made King

events.desc: The provisional government of … has offered the vacant throne of … to any Hohenzollern prince who is willing to pledge allegiance to the … Constitution.
events.flavor: "The Constituent Cortes of the Spanish Nation, upon concluding the grave and delicate charge entrusted to them by the free suffrage of the people, have, in solemn and public session of last …, elected Your Highness to occupy the Throne. By their honorable confidence we come to bring to Your Highness the vote of the Representation of a people master of its own destiny, and to invite you, by accepting such a spontaneous offering, to place upon Your Royal Highness's brow the Crown of Spain, which a hundred kings, by their glorious deeds, have so greatly adorned."

options.name: Put forth a candidate for the throne.
We shall not risk our blood in such an unstable country.

events.title: The Spanish Throne

events.desc: The provisional government of … has offered the vacant throne of … to any Savoyard prince who is willing to pledge allegiance to the … Constitution.
events.flavor: "The Constituent Cortes of the Spanish Nation, upon concluding the grave and delicate charge entrusted to them by the free suffrage of the people, have, in solemn and public session of last …, elected Your Highness to occupy the Throne. By their honorable confidence we come to bring to Your Highness the vote of the Representation of a people master of its own destiny, and to invite you, by accepting such a spontaneous offering, to place upon Your Royal Highness's brow the Crown of Spain, which a hundred kings, by their glorious deeds, have so greatly adorned."

options.name: Put forth a candidate for the throne.
We shall not risk our blood in such an unstable country.

events.title: The Spanish Throne

events.desc: With no other candidates forthcoming, the Cortes has elected …, the next member of the house of Borbón in the "constitutional" line of succession, as … of ….
events.flavor:
The street was lined with red-and-yellow streamers, yet there was no one to be seen. Francisco pressed his forehead against the dusty window, looking this way and that. The clattering of the press in the other room filled his ears, drowning out his thoughts. All the better, for to capture them and take a solid look would only send him further into the abyss.

"Did they expect a celebration?" he asked. "Damn them. Those traitors, gravediggers... damn them!"

Far away, a military trumpet sounded, and then the pattering of boots.

options.name: The rightful dynasty returns to the throne.

events.title: The Bourbon Restoration

events.desc: The Carlist-sympathetic Cortes has elected …, the current member of the house of Borbón in the Carlist line of succession, as … of …. Once more, a staunch traditionalist will rule over the country.
events.flavor:
Francisco rushed into the townhouse, pulling the door closed behind him. It took all he had to not slam it, to not alert the neighbors of his agitated state. The sound of scurrying feet sounded on the stairs. Pale, spidery fingers gripped the corner wall, and haunted eyes gazed down at him.

"Tell me it is not over," said the copyist.

Francisco shook his head. "You will need to look away," he replied, "for I cannot lie to your face."

The copyist's knuckles turned white. "The Revolution is dead, then, and so are we. God help us all."

options.name: The rightful dynasty returns to the throne.

events.title: The Bourbon Restoration

events.desc: The provisional government of … has offered the vacant throne of … to any Bonaparte prince who is willing to pledge allegiance to the … Constitution.
events.flavor: "The Constituent Cortes of the Spanish Nation, upon concluding the grave and delicate charge entrusted to them by the free suffrage of the people, have, in solemn and public session of last …, elected Your Highness to occupy the Throne. By their honorable confidence we come to bring to Your Highness the vote of the Representation of a people master of its own destiny, and to invite you, by accepting such a spontaneous offering, to place upon Your Royal Highness's brow the Crown of Spain, which a hundred kings, by their glorious deeds, have so greatly adorned."

options.name: We see that they've finally come around.
We shall not risk our blood in such an unstable country.

events.title: The Spanish Throne

events.desc: With no King forthcoming, the Cortes has declared itself as the legislature of a Spanish Republic, with … as interim executive.
events.flavor:
"We have the Republic!"

The call from the street below made Francisco explode to his feet, throwing a stack of papers every which way. He thundered up the stairs, across the loft's floor, to the edge of the rug pressed up against the wall. Atop it was a thin blanket, from which a pale hand was grasping for the pistol he knew was hidden in the rafters.

"We have the Republic!" he repeated, half-out-of-breath, and the hand stopped, threw the blanket aside, revealed a pair of wide, red-rimmed eyes.

"My God", said the copyist. "I nearly shot you."

"And I forgive you!" Francisco let out a burst of laughter. "Get up, Àngel! Didn't you say you would go dancing?"

options.name: Let us greet it like the sun.

events.title: The Proclamation of the Republic

events.flavor:
"How interesting it is," said the copyist, "that Señor … seems to wish to be Garibaldi."

The anxious movements of his fingers contrasted his slow, careful tone. They worked at the corner of a piece of paper, bending it back and forth. Quiet crinkling filled the air between his words.

To Francisco, it made all the sense in the world. He knew that his comrade understood just as well. "They wish to co-opt our cause. They see Iberia as a new Germany, or Italy. They know that we desire a free Iberia. They do not understand what "free" means, and so it fades out of their vision. They will find that, to the people, that word means far more than an extra scrap of land."

options.name: Confirm the …'s accession, and bring the Union into being.
A Bragança it shall be.
This is not what we desired.

events.title: The Iberian Wedding

events.desc: The nomination of a Hohenzollern prince for the … throne threatens to create a ring of … allies around …. The War Ministry has sounded the alarm, stating that such an arrangement would be of dire risk to our national integrity.
events.flavor:
"What are they thinking?" The Ambassador looked down at his copy of the Gaceta de Madrid once more. Scanning the Cortes' letter provided no more answers than it had the first time.

The Foreign Minister's lips twitched to the side, once-twice-three times, in a gesture that disturbed his prodigious moustache. He did not offer an answer. His gaze remained on the desk, fixated on the task of reading the paper upside down.

"The War Minister is insistent that I refuse to return to …", continued the Ambassador, "and I pass this question to you. He is insistent that this is an intentional provocation, yet I believe naïveté may serve as a more likely explanation..."

options.name: This is an outrage! Make ready the Army.
What is to be done?

events.title: A Loveless Embrace

events.flavor:
There were storm clouds building over Barcelona. Francisco lay with his back to the roof tiles, watching the ever-grey sky turn black as pitch.

He heard the clattering of feet on tiles next to him, and turned his head. There stood the copyist, arms spread wide to keep him steady. A fat raindrop, swollen with smoke from the textile mills, had left a grey streak running down his cheek. It was strangely beautiful.

"We're all going to die," he said, and looked back out in the direction of the distant Pyrenees. Francisco followed his gaze.

"...maybe", he said. "I almost wouldn't mind, if the King goes with us."

options.name: A Hohenzollern it shall be.
Withdraw the offer - we cannot risk another invasion.

events.title: The Bull and the Eagle

events.desc: The House of Savoia has accepted our offer of the … throne, dispatching a prince to … to formally stand for the position. The Cortes has elected their candidate as King by an overwhelming margin.
events.flavor:
There was all too much good cheer around, thought Francisco. The street was choked with berets and toques - the garb of the exultant middle-classes. He had been caught out when the news arrived, the streamers went up, and his journey tripled in length. Past another row of hats, he could see his objective, a two-story townhome that hosted two presses - one above-board, one covert.

He elbowed a reveler aside, jammed his key into the lock, and slipped inside.

"Rejoice!" he shouted up the stairs, "for we have our July!"

options.name: Long live Crown and Cortes!

events.title: The King-Elect

events.desc: The House of Bonaparte has accepted our offer of the … throne, dispatching a prince to … to serve as King of …. After his election, he has crowned himself before the Cortes.
events.flavor:
"Karl Marx said- well, he was quoting Hegel... that world-historic personalities appear, so to speak, twice."" Francisco paced around the room, staring furiously down at the book in his hand, ""And that Hegel forgot to add: the first time as tragedy, the second time as farce.""

The copyist, eyes rimmed with red, watched him as he paced. "You're going to wear a rut in my floor," he said. "We both know what must be done, and we'll do it."

Francisco halted his circuit, and placed the book down on a chair half-drowned in pamphlets. His eyes trailed over to the table, at the jars of powder forming its new centrepiece, at the packet of nails.

"So we do," he said. "So we do."

options.name: Hail, Bonaparte, restored at last!

events.title: The Bonaparte Restoration

events.desc: Taking an interest in the newly opening … economy, … has proposed a trade agreement that seemed initially equitable. On closer inspection it contains numerous unfavorable clauses that were never agreed upon.
events.flavor: "You needn't trouble yourselves with reading the fine print, I assure you that all is in order as we agreed. It's nothing more than trivial formalities about ownership of natural resources and harbors. Just sign right here."

options.name: This is outrageous!
Politely reject the treaty.
Sign the treaty, unfavorable as it is.

events.title: Unequal Treaties

events.desc: A visiting dignitary from … has been murdered in a … restaurant. It is suspected that this was an attempt to sabotage a trade agreement that would bring … out of its isolated state.
events.flavor: "We must think carefully on how to proceed. As soon as word of this gets out it will surely cause a scandal in … and threaten the signing of the treaty. There was a young man present at the scene, probably innocent but certainly a convenient scapegoat if we wish to hastily resolve the matter. It may not be just, but it will be expedient."

options.name: Convict a law student as a scapegoat.
We must get to the bottom of this crime.

events.title: … Dignitary Murdered

events.desc: Under the heroic leadership of … …, the Italian nation has been birthed into the world. Unified under a common banner, Italy will surely shape the future of Europe and the world.
events.flavor: "Yes, young men, Italy owes to you an undertaking which has merited the applause of the universe. You have conquered and you will conquer still, because you are prepared for the tactics that decide the fate of battles. To this wonderful page in our country's history another more glorious still will be added, and the slave shall show at last to his free brothers a sharpened sword forged from the links of his fetters."

options.name: Viva Italia!
We will never forget our brave ….

events.title: Risorgimento

events.desc: Inspired by our leadership of the peninsula, the government of the small Italian state of … has petitioned to join our efforts to unify the Italian people.
events.flavor: "The old city-states have a quaint romantic appeal; we can look back to the days of the Renaissance to see a thriving Italy. But to thrive again, we must look forward, not back. It is unity under a single state that will drive the Italian people to greatness once more."

options.name: Diplomacy has won the day!
It is not the right time.

events.title: Unification with …

events.flavor:
"Traitors! Traitors in the midst! Sound the alarm, call for the guards at once!"

"Do you mean the suited men beside me, senor? I should hope so, since you were foolish enough to announce your presence. Now, I shall make this plain, as your raving ineptitude forced our hand in the first place: a united Italy is rising. It demands a place on the world stage, and it won't be cared for by men of your ill-fitting ilk."

options.name: We will rise again, as part of a whole.
Long live Italia!
We will rise again, as part of a whole.

events.title: Tricolors Over …

events.desc: Inspired by calls for the establishment of a single Italian nation, nationalist rebels have seized … and pledged themselves to the unification of Italy under the banner of … ….
events.flavor: A unified Italy has never been far from the lips of the mad and the ambitious alike. Indeed, a splendid reawakening of the peninsula would give even the single God pause. Such attempts have been folly in the past. Yet in furtive whispers, there is a belief that there may be hope for a new Rome to rise.

options.name: We welcome our brothers and sisters.
It is best to not frighten our neighbors.

events.title: Italian Nationalists Seize …

events.desc: Inspired by calls for the reunification of Italy, nationalist rebels have seized … and declared a republic over its former sovereign territories.
events.flavor: What the aide brought to him was incredulous: another attempt at bringing the Italian peninsula under a single banner. It seemed impossible, divided between at least a half-dozen petty lords and city-states that would as soon strangle each other as Europe. But as the aide spoke, it became plain that this was no idle boast. No, this merited envoys, carrying either a gladius or an olive branch.

options.name: Offer our sympathies to the new regime.
We have no common cause with these terrorists.

events.title: Italian Nationalists Overthrow … Government

events.desc: Following unrest amongst the Italian population of Lombardy-Venetia, nationalist rebels have declared the formation of the …, a revolutionary state founded to seize independence from … rule.
events.flavor: A rider in white, astride a white mare, passed along the grounds near where the … took breakfast that morning. The footman who approached … with sweat seeping from every cracked pore carried a blood-red letter. The Italian holdings had entered revolt. The next sweating aide to enter carried another report: these revolting territories called for reinforcements. Reinforcements, … … knew, that would surely be coming.

options.name: Take to the Quadrilateral at once!
Viva San Marco!

events.title: Five Days in …

events.desc: Revolutionaries in … have declared the formation of a …, independent from the rule of …. They call for aid from all Italian states in their struggle.
events.flavor:
"Mother... my mind is made up. I am going to Venice, with or without your blessing."

"Good, fine, go! No son of mine would ever waste his life on something so meaningless as a flag. I've already lost brothers and uncles to this sort of useless adjudication of penne lengths. Stay here and be safe!"

"It's anything but useless, mother! We have a chance to be one Italy again. We could go anywhere, do anything again. We would have something again!"

options.name: They stand for us, and us for them.
We will not shed … blood for ….

events.title: The Italian War of Independence

events.desc: The winds of nationalism have begun to pass through the long-divided states of the Italian peninsula. … patriots and romantic scholars alike have begun to call for the unification of a single Italian state.
events.flavor: "No, signore. I am not a foreigner, and I am not …. I am an Italian, and an Italian in Italy is never a foreigner."

options.name: Italy must be restored from oblivion.
We will not throw ourselves to the winds for this.

events.title: Whispers of Risorgimento

events.desc: … has been arrested and put on trial for crimes related to … political agitation. … faces an unsympathetic judge, and a lengthy jail sentence if convicted.
events.flavor:
"… …, please stand and approach the podium."

… complied. There was little use in being obstinate. The trial had not been long, nor had it been fair by any reasonable standard. It was not a matter of whether … would be found guilty or not, but rather how tolerable the sentence would be.

"… …, you have been convicted of the crime of seditious libel. Following a thorough review of the circumstances of this case, the court hereby sentences you..."

options.name: A three-year sentence, to remind … of … place.
A five-year sentence will get … out of the public eye.
… has tested our patience for too long. Ten years.
We don't want a fiasco. Let … off with a warning.

events.title: Off to Jail

events.desc: At shrine temples, it is common for Buddhist monks to perform rituals alongside Shinto practices. With the separation of Buddhism from Shinto, the role of these monks is being called into question.
events.flavor: "What is the purpose of these rituals? To guide the kami to enlightenment? To improve their karma? The implication is clearly that, rather than being worthy of worship, they are lost beings in need of guidance. We will no longer abide such implications!"

options.name: Demand the monks convert and become Shinto priests.
Strip the monks of their titles.
Leave the monks to their duties.

events.title: Jingū-ji

events.desc: It is a well-established idea that Buddhas revealed themselves in Japan as kami, reflected in terminology such as Gongen, which considers them two parts of the same entity. Such terminology reinforces Buddhism's influence.
events.flavor: "It must have made sense, once. Amaterasu is the sun. Dainichi Nyorai, Vairocana, is the sun. However, the sun is not divided, nor is it a reflection or manifestation of the light of another. She shines alone and under her own power. And today, … has room for only one sun."

options.name: Ban the concept of Gongen.
Ban referring to Hachiman as a Boddhisattva.
Abstain from regulating the terminology.

events.title: Honji Suijaku

events.desc: The attempt to oust Buddhism's influence has mobilized general anti-Buddhist sentiment. Temple properties are being seized and damaged, with some being destroyed outright, while others are being stripped of Buddhist iconography.
events.flavor:
Approaching the shrine, he stopped in his tracks. The two Niō, powerful Buddha statues which had stood guard outside the entrance, had been removed. In their place was nothing.

As he passed inside, he couldn't shake the feeling that for all its purity, the shrine was no longer as safe as it had once been. An unguarded gate.

options.name: Smelt the temple bells for cannons!
Destroy or remove Buddha statues from the temples.
Leave the temples untouched.

events.title: It Tolls for Thee

events.desc: Efforts to standardize Shinto practices and ensure that state kami are a part of local rituals have been met with opposition from local monks and shrine priests, who consider these teachings a break with tradition.
events.flavor: "Shinto is not simply about continuing existing rituals and practices as they might exist at shrines around the nation, confused and contaminated by external influences. The traditions of the Imperial house, descendants of heaven, must be taught across … to return Shinto to its pure form."

options.name: Enforce the state interpretations.
Local priests know best what suits local rituals.

events.title: The Bureau of Shinto Affairs

events.desc: In the process of separating Buddhism and Shinto, Confucianism's role has been questioned. Many scholars consider the philosophy highly compatible with Shinto, while others dismiss it as another foreign influence.
events.flavor: "Confucianism may have arrived through similar channels as Buddhism, but there is no contradiction between this philosophy and the worship of kami. Rather, the two reinforce each other, encompassing the same principles of heaven and earth, ruler and subject."

options.name: Confucianism is an important complement to Shinto.
We must restore Shinto to its ancient traditions.

events.title: Confucianism and Shinto

events.desc: Although … has opened to foreigners, religion remains regulated. Christian countries may view the free import of their faith as equally important as the import of their goods.
events.flavor: "Christianity most loves its followers in death, a death for faith above all. Every missionary put to the cross or the fire becomes the next chapter in a story that started with a man on a cross. Perhaps it is time we stop giving them martyrs?"

options.name: Missionaries must be allowed to preach their faith.

modifiers.label: State Oriental Orthodox Standard Of Living

options.name: It may be practiced, but it should not be spread.

modifiers.label: State Oriental Orthodox Standard Of Living

options.name: Christianity was and remains a foreign threat.

events.title: Christianity in the Open Country

events.desc: … has a long tradition of different schools of Buddhism, many of which still wield influence today. With the … gaining in political power, one school stands out.
events.flavor: "New schools of Buddhism have arisen in … over centuries. There is no reason to think one would stamp out the others. However, the current moment requires leadership and political direction, and it is likely that some will seize it more than others."

options.name: The Pure Land School.
The Zen School.
The Nichiren School.
The Shingon School.

events.title: Lineages of Thought

events.desc: With … being opened to the world, Buddhist scholars have shown interest in translating more foreign texts to incorporate their ideas in modern Buddhism.
events.flavor: "We should not let orthodoxies developed through isolation hold us back, nor should we fear finding the truth in unexpected places. The teachings of the Buddha took a long road to reach us. Studying where they have passed, as well as where they might go, can only bring us further insight."

options.name: Sanskrit and Pali texts, the roots of Buddhism.
Chinese texts, closest to our own schools of thought.
Works of European philosophy for comparative study.

events.title: Words of the Buddha

events.desc: The ongoing war effort has led to debates among the … about the role of Buddhism in supporting the country during a violent conflict.
events.flavor: "The monks of old did not hesitate to defend their temples. Should we hesitate to defend our nation? A life should not be taken lightly, but would the … state pursue a war that would not lead to a longer peace, that would not save more lives than it takes?"

options.name: Force is necessary to establish lasting peace.
Non-violence above all.

events.title: Warrior Monks

events.desc: Since the end of Sakoku, meat-oriented restaurants have become increasingly common in port cities to cater to foreigners. This has called into question the standing ban on meat-eating in ….
events.flavor:
"Excuse me, but beef is certainly a most delicious thing, isn’t it? Once you get accustomed to its taste, you can never go back to deer or wild boar again. I wonder why we in Japan haven’t eaten such a clean thing before?"

—Kanagaki Robun, The Beefeater

options.name: We must lift this ban, for nutrition and culinary expansion!
We will not let this barbarian practice take hold!

events.title: Yōshoku

events.desc: The separation of Shinto and Buddhist practices has been a success. The influence of the old religious institutions is waning and a new era of devotion to the gods, the emperor and … dawns.
events.flavor: "… is home to many faiths, many rituals. Some old, some new. Our goal has not been to stamp out some in favor of others. It has been to draw a line between dearly held beliefs and unquestionable truths."

options.name: Divinity is absolute.

events.title: The Way of the Kami

events.desc: After navigating a tumultuous time of upheaval for …, the … have managed to reassert themselves as the country's religious authority and strengthened their ties to the ….
events.flavor:
"Men talk of the Gods' Way. If there be such,
'Tis not for men to tread it; none but gods
Can tread the holy pathway of the gods".
—Hagura Toman

options.name: The path is clear.

events.title: The Middle Way

events.desc: The Proclamation of the Great Doctrine, declaring worship of the kami and reverence for the divine Emperor as principles of the … state and the duty of its citizens.
events.flavor:
"Respect for the kami and love of our country are inextricably linked; they are the first teaching.

The Principles of Heaven and the Way of Man are inextricably linked; they are the second teaching.

Reverence for the Emperor and obedience to the will of the court are inextricably linked; they are the third teaching."

options.name: They must be heard throughout the country!

events.title: Taikyō Proclamation

events.desc: The increasing wealth disparity among our society has become as injurious and clear as a scythe's edge. A pamphlet named "The Communist Manifesto" and written by a socialist revolutionary has captivated the attention of the masses.
events.flavor:
"The history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles.

Freeman and slave, patrician and plebeian, lord and serf, guildmaster and journeyman, in a word, oppressor and oppressed, stood in constant opposition to one another, carried on an uninterrupted, now hidden, now open fight, that each time ended, either in the revolutionary reconstitution of society at large, or in the common ruin of the contending classes."

options.name: Our people could benefit from these teachings.
Unite, indeed! We have nothing to lose but our chains!
We want nothing to do with this insurgent individual.

events.title: The Communist Manifesto

events.desc: At the newly-constructed shrine of Hwangudan, the newly-crowned Emperor … has declared the end of the era of …, and the foundation of a new Empire of Korea.
events.flavor: Decades of whispers, years of plans, and months of preparation all came to this moment: a grand rebirth of the spirit of the people. Amidst the fireworks, fine silks and folk songs of home, the few foreign dignitaries to entertain the ceremony raised their cups with tacit acknowledgement and acrid glares.

options.name: A bright and glorious day.

events.title: The Gwangmu Era

events.desc: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many of our people in the state of …. The explosion of the Krakatoa could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the island was immediately devastated.
events.flavor:
"And the day was made night. Those enormous waterfalls of fire cascading down the mountainside. A black cloud, gargantuan, all the birds have long abandoned this field.

Years from now I will sit by the fireplace and the light will disturb me no more."

options.name: We shall help with all we have.
Nature is a capricious creature.

events.title: Days of Darkness

events.desc: Waves taller than chimneys have ravaged the state of …, a terrible consequence of the volcanic eruption.
events.flavor: "I will never forget that silence."

options.name: There are no words to describe this tragedy.

events.title: Nights of Waves

events.desc: Due to the drop of temperature caused by the volcanic eruption all the crops of … have been destroyed in the subsequent … and now the farmers have come begging for help.
events.flavor: "No food at home, sir, not a single root to be saved. Children ask questions, sir, the sky is always dark, always red. They're hungry, hungry and afraid, my lord—and so am I."

options.name: We can send them some food.
There's nothing we can do.
Open the state granaries!

events.title: Burning Ashes

events.desc: Vivid red sunsets were reported for several months across the country. Fire engines were even called out in … to quench the apparent conflagration. Many artists and academics have expressed their interest in this phenomenon.
events.flavor:
"A blue and sometimes green moon, its inflammable luminescence igniting the night with unnatural intensity. White moonbeams shining through the clouds emerge purple, and sometimes also blue, green.

Lavender suns, noctilucent clouds, a distasteful fascination."

options.name: Only a painting could capture such beauty.
Academics must ensure that we're prepared for the next eruption.

events.title: Smoke Streams

events.desc: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many … in the state of …. The explosion of the Krakatoa could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the island was immediately devastated.
events.flavor:
"And the day was made night. Those enormous waterfalls of fire cascading down the mountainside. A black cloud, gargantuan, all the birds have long abandoned this field.

Years from now I will sit by the fireplace and the light will disturb me no more."

options.name: We shall help with all we have.
Nature is a capricious creature.
We have nothing to spare...

events.title: Days of Darkness

events.desc: With our reunification of … and …, we have advanced far from our former status as a mere free city. However, a question presses - will … be a base for … unification, or will it embrace its multinational character?
events.flavor: If one focused on the fireworks in …, Kiril thought, one could almost forget the problem to the East. The only state that had ever claimed the name of "Galicia" was the old Habsburg Kingdom - a vessel for Polish landlords and German bureaucrats. The Polish nationalists would certainly replace the latter, but could they be trusted with bringing equality to his people? Kiril had taken a thorough circuit of the city upon his arrival, and he had seen little to reassure him. In their fervor to restore the Commonwealth, they were all too willing to forget its flaws.

options.name: … is …, and always shall be.
… and … will find unity under our rule.
We can be so much more.

events.title: The First Step

events.desc: As revolution breaks out in the free city of …, radical Polish nationalist figures have issued a manifesto calling for universal suffrage, the abolition of serfdom, and the reunification of Poland.
events.flavor:
Poles!

The hour of the uprising has struck - the whole of Poland is rising and growing together - our brothers in the Duchy of Poznań, in Congress Poland, in Lithuania, and in Ruthenia have already risen, and are fighting the enemy.

From now on, we do not know any difference between us. We are now brothers, sons of one Motherland, with one father, God in heaven! Let us call upon Him for help, and He will bless our weapons and give us victory!

options.name: We must reassert control over Kraków immediately.
We are bound to preserve the status of the Treaty of Vienna.

events.title: The Manifesto for the Polish Nation

events.desc: With the revolution in Kraków crushed, the former Free City has been integrated into the Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria as the Grand Duchy of Kraków. This act has spurred controversy in Europe for violating the Treaty of Vienna.
events.flavor:
"Any plan conceived in moderation must fail when the circumstances are set in extremes."

— Klemens von Metternich

options.name: Focus on mitigating the diplomatic consequences.
Continue to repress their radical ideology.

events.title: The Grand Duchy of Kraków

events.desc: … in … have become notorious for brutalizing their serfs. Peasants complain of harsh punishments, impossible workloads, and even sometimes torture and murder.
events.flavor:
"She got thirty lashes for dropping the tea."
"People have been going missing on the estate on the hill."
"There's a dungeon below the basements, my cousin swears upon it! They torture us and drink our blood!"

options.name: These indignities must end.
We will punish the aristocrats with the full force of the law.

events.title: Mistreatment of Serfs

events.desc: A group of influential … led by … are petitioning for the rapid abolition of serfdom.
events.flavor: "I could wax lyrical about the moral virtues of emancipation all day, and with good reason. But the simple truth of the matter is the serfdom is inefficient. It is economically ruinous, an obstacle to the rightful progression of our nation both in industry and society. Serfs who work the fields would be better put to use in factories, where they can be gainfully employed and properly industrious."

options.name: They make an excellent case.
Such an inspiring speaker!

events.title: Emancipators

events.desc: The … refuse to give up their serfs without adequate compensation. Their significant political influence makes this a difficult demand to refuse.
events.flavor: "We have relied on serf labor for generations. You cannot simply ask us release them without compensation! How are we to keep our estate profitable? How are we to maintain the standards of living we are accustomed to? Our relative poverty would make us the laughing stock of the … aristocracy."

options.name: The state will make up the cost.
Serfs must purchase their own emancipation.
You cannot own a human being.

events.title: Purchasing Emancipation

events.desc: Workers organized by the … are staging short strikes and work-to-rule periods in an effort to pressure the government to pass the … law. Though their methods seem effective, they are causing major damage to our industrial economy.
events.flavor: "We have the right to be safe at work! Nobody should have to clock in wondering whether today will be the day they lose an arm or an eye. Until our safety is guaranteed, we'll not work another day."

options.name: Let them strike!
Offer assurances and try to de-escalate.

events.title: Direct Action

events.desc: … have agreed to state-mediated negotiations with the … over the implementation of ….
events.flavor:
"Our profit margins are going to suffer, you must understand this. That won't be good for anybody, including you. Why we may even have to let some of you go, and how will you feed your families then?"

"Do you know what's really bad for business? Angry workers. Injured workers. Dead workers."

options.name: Support the ….
Make concessions to the ….

events.title: Worker Safety Negotiations

events.desc: The … are paying a group of armed thugs calling themselves a private investigation agency to break up … agitation for ….
events.flavor: "We're just making sure that everyone is following the law here. We don't want one of those angry workers firing a shot or starting a riot. We're just here to keep the peace, for the right price. And maybe in the process some legs get broken, some skulls get cracked. That's just the cost of public safety."

options.name: Arrest them for assault.
We cannot risk angering the … further.

events.title: Strikebreakers

events.desc: Threatened by the strengthening of workers' associations under …, the … have publicized numerous reports on the dangers of a unionized workforce.
events.flavor:
Is Union Life For Me?

• Dues deducted from your wages
• No guarantees on pay, benefit, or work rules
• No chance for individual negotiation

Your COMPANY provides your job and pays your wages - the UNION never has and never will!

options.name: They must be terrified.
Everyone has the right to pursue their interests.

events.title: Union Free

events.desc: The news of the government's efforts to enshrine the … has spread rapidly through working-class communities. The … have begun to complain of a corresponding uptick in illegal union activity.
events.flavor:
The moment the government announced its initiative, the posters started appearing. The vain efforts of the night-watchmen to catch the perpetrators bore no fruit, forcing the firm into damage-control. Every night, the walls were plastered - and in the morning, the company filled the bins with the last night's efforts.

The very next week, the garbagemen announced their new union.

options.name: Order the courts to disregard these complaints.
The present laws remain in effect.

events.title: Preemptive Strikes

events.desc: Following petitions from labor groups, … has assembled a commission on …. The commission has delivered two reports to the government - a majority report written by the …, and a minority report sympathetic to the ….
events.flavor: "In fact, the law as it stood is one-sided and unjust. For while nearly every combination of workmen in furtherance of their objects was held to be a conspiracy in restraint of trade, and therefore criminally punishable, precisely similar acts committed by a master escaped the notice of the law, as not involving the offence of conspiracy. But, in fact, the employer of some thousands of workmen was, in himself, a combination."

options.name: Adopt the minority report.
The majority report is more convincing.

events.title: The Commission on Trade Unions

events.desc: The government's attacks on the … have spurred riots amongst those who feel their livelihood is under threat. In …, rioting artisans and skilled laborers have smashed machinery and intimidated contractors.
events.flavor:
A curse on the God to whom our petition
We vainly address'd when in starving condition;
In vain did we hope, and in vain did we wait,
He only derided and mock'd our sad fate,—
We're weaving, we're weaving!

options.name: If they cannot compete freely, they may find a job elsewhere.
Send in the Army to protect property.

events.title: A Dying Industry

events.desc: The efforts of the government to enact … has been met with near-universal opposition from the …. Union leadership has called a general strike in a bid to make the government concede.
events.flavor:
The unions were out in force. Every light pole within a mile of … was draped in red streamers, and foot traffic was a hopeless endeavor. Several government legislators had elected to sleep in their offices rather than brave the human tides. Others, the radicals in the opposition, had elected to join it. They had found their way back cut off by a line of policemen which snaked all the way around the building.

Both sides now saw it as a state of siege. The protestors had worked out a truly impressive logistics system to distribute bread and water amongst themselves, whilst the legislators tapped …'s cafeteria and wine cellar.

"How long?" asked a junior member. His colleague could no longer muster the energy to answer.

options.name: Their reaction justifies the bill.
Offer to negotiate.
Intercept their means of communication.

events.title: The Last Ditch

events.desc: A book detailing the horrific conditions that industrial laborers are routinely subjected to has become an overnight success. The success of the book has raised public interest in …, whilst embarrassing the ….
events.flavor: "Thus the social order makes family life almost impossible for the worker. In a comfortless, filthy house, hardly good enough for mere nightly shelter, ill-furnished, often neither rain-tight nor warm, a foul atmosphere filling rooms overcrowded with human beings, no domestic comfort is possible. The husband works the whole day through, perhaps the wife also and the elder children, all in different places; they meet night and morning only, all under perpetual temptation to drink; what family life is possible under such conditions?"

options.name: The workers should be able to advocate for themselves.
We must not further upset the owners.

events.title: Intolerable Strife

events.desc: Emboldened by the government's turn against organized labor, the … have begun to preemptively crack down on labor unions within their shops. The … demand a response whilst the old laws still stand.
events.flavor:
It was an absurdity. The clerk knew it, his superiors knew it, and the union representative standing before him probably knew it as well. A last-minute petition relying upon a law which would vanish from the books before it could ever reach a judge.

And yet, it was perfect. It lacked any obvious error that would permit him to reject it out-of-hand. His only option was to let it clog someone else's inbox. The corners of his mouth tightened into a joyless smile.

"Thank you, sir. The Ministry will contact you by mail."

options.name: They no longer possess any standing.
We must uphold the existing legislation.

events.title: The Letter of the Law

events.desc: As the government takes steps to dismantle the …, emboldened … and … have begun to break into fields they were formerly excluded from.
events.flavor:
"I'm off. I meant to say earlier. I've found a job in …, at the factory. They've offered me a loan for transport, a bunk..."

He trailed off, looking at the face of his friends in turn.

"Thank you. For everything. I'll write, or I'll ask someone to. It's been... it's been wonderful. I'll see you again, someday. I promise."

options.name: Our efforts are well-rewarded.
A great victory for liberty.

events.title: The Free Market of Labor

events.desc: Sensing a chance to disadvantage their economic rivals in the cities, prominent members of the … have come out in favor of enacting ….
events.flavor:
"The unions are agents of disorder - but, crucially, agents which reserve their greatest hostility for our immediate competitors. They will demand concessions from their superiors, concessions which carve deeply into the pockets of …'s magnates. To compensate for these losses, they shall be forced to raise their prices, placing our own produce in a deeply favorable position."

"And what of our own populace? Need we fear a Union of Peasants?"

"They may breathe clean air and feel the sun on their necks. Many hold their own plots. What need have they for a union?"

options.name: A perfectly workable arrangement.
We must be wary of offers like these.

events.title: Ulterior Motives

events.desc: Claiming that …'s prime lands should be settled by virtous yeomen like themselves, the … law proposal is experiencing a surge of popularity among members of the … eying an opportunity in the frontiers—to the great chagrin of the … currently dominating the agricultural sector.
events.flavor: Debates raged for days in the courthouse. Accusations flew as fast as declarations of this ancestral heritage or that natural right. Theft, squatting and illegal possession were the weapons of choice. Rights of blood, family names, and obscure by-laws that amounted to proving whoever spotted it first were the shields.

options.name: Vote yourself a farm in …!
First the legislature shall be won over, then the frontier.
Promise the … that money still matters.

events.title: The … Homestead Act

events.desc: In a somewhat surprising move, claiming that … … has driven a wedge between the spiritual backbone of the country, the …, and an increasingly foreign-influenced upper class, a number of conservative thinkers have come out in support of …—breaking ranks with their more traditionally inclined fellows in the … and the ….
events.flavor:
"Our nation, in its current state, is made up of two social groups that have very little in common.
My fellow members of the …, who wear foreign clothes, follow foreign trends, some even speaking in foreign tongues, have become too detatched from their own … heritage—their …-ness little more than a family name and a sworn loyalty to the ….

So far removed have they become, from the essential … values of simple brotherhood, of community, that characterize the countrymen they hold in bondage."

options.name: … society must be reunited, the common spirit rekindled.
Let these tired old men bicker all they want.

events.title: The Shackled Soul of the Nation

events.desc: In a stormy parliamentary speech, …, leader of the …, and a chief advocate for the enactment of …, has claimed that "the end of the bloodsucking, fat farmers draws nigh." … radical message has spooked many members of the …, who fear they would be labeled as such, despite only owning a few acres more than their neighbors.
events.flavor:
"Dima, you heard the news from …? Apparently … has a grudge against farmers. I don't want … coming near my rye."

"Just the big ones, and only the kind the … … likes to entertain. … isn't the Baba Yaga."

"Still, I don't want … near my rye. My wife is making her sweetbreads again this harvest."

options.name: All wealthy farmers are class traitors...
...but only the most opulent shall face the judge's mallet.
Their fate have yet do be decided. Make no official statements.

events.title: An Acre Too Far

events.desc: With virgin land to award second sons becoming an increasingly rare commodity in …, many farmers engaged in the local … hope that a transition to … will yield the revenues necessary to provide for all their offspring upon death—or at the very least leave a single profitable farm that can be sold off for profit.
events.flavor:
The fields are not wholly sustainable within new models. Each farmer would be left to his or her own devices regarding each field. It is assumed that each subsequent harvest would overwork the soil. Middle-management to ensure a smooth transition process is required. Appropriate training for each farmer looking to exploit the new … laws is also required.

Recommendation: rezone land to those who can already afford to purchase it and company instruction on best practices.

options.name: Their concerns make for excellent talking points.
The … would be delighted to buy them out.
The … and the power of capital shall step in.

events.title: The Plight of the Second Sons

events.desc: Seeking to eliminate the need of middlemen by bringing together …, …, and … in a co-oporatively owned business, a newly formed farmers' co-operative in …—desiring to improve the lot of their constituent members—have used their considerable local influence to push for the enactment of ….
events.flavor: Each family had come together, whether they made chairs, picked fruit, or tallied who sold what. It was agreed that the best chance of a future was to wrest control of where everything went. Fruits and furniture would stay under everyone's reach. Vegetables and vanities would be sold at a fair price, with fair splits going to who stocked the shelves. It would never be "much", but nobody would go hungry either.

options.name: Peasants influencing …? How quaint.
Laud their model of business as a vision of tomorrow's world.
Countryside and city, farmers and workers, unite!

events.title: Farmer's Co-op Champions …

events.desc: The proposal to enact …, effectively redistributing plots of lands from … to …, has unsurprisingly led to massive protests among the …, being seen by many as but the first step towards the institution of ….
events.flavor:
