"Yer serious? Yer really serious? Hand over this land to some gull-brained cheat what don't know a mattock from a pick?"

"Government decree from the …. I'm sorry, sir, but you must vacate these premises."

"Pah! Watch that silken son kill everything in this field, and come crawling back to me to save it! Mark my words."

options.name: Peasants are mere sons of the soil, not its natural owners.
You want a Revolution? This is how we get a Revolution.

events.title: Land From the Tiller

events.desc: With the government's drive to enact … in full swing, a group of well-off farmers-turned-landowners from …, owing their affluence to their close proximity to the major grain markets in …, have offered to put their considerable political weight behind the law proposal, were they to be granted certain "concessions" from the government.
events.flavor: The issue of tying land to extractive wealth is simple: whoever controls the land with valuables will have a greater voice in an amassed society. Whether this comes in the form of wheat, cotton, or opium does not matter. It invariably leads to a desire to avoid losing that greater voice. And so come the impassioned compromises: a temporary sacrifice of pride to hold on to power that bit longer.

options.name: I'm sure we could cough up some agricultural "subsidies".
Grant them preferential land rights in ….
We can do without such skulduggery. The law looks secure as it is.

events.title: Barn House Dealings

events.desc: With the debate about the enactment of … looming large in …, a local dispute between a … landowner and several farmers has come to bloodshed. Faced with the possibility of their common grazing lands being bought up and closed off, one particularly irate farmer responded by gunning down the landowner in a fit of rage.
events.flavor: A death is a tragedy, and a million is a statistic. The statistics in this case being acres of land, and lives displaced by an act of greed. Killing a perpetrator is a swift fix. But the mere act of murder itself has condemned one party to hardship. So then the better question is to ask what the tragedy is: someone dying a preventable death, or hundreds starving for one person's greed?

options.name: Barbarous. This is the face of those who oppose the reform.
A sick deed from a sick mind. Nothing more.
This act is symptomatic of a greater disease. Deal with it.

events.title: A Tragedy in the Commons

events.desc: The government's push to introduce … has been met with disbelief and widespread protests across …, with free …, unwilling to silently enter into the bondage of …, allying themselves with urban reformers who see the institution as an artifact of a bygone age.
events.flavor:
"Free from a master's supervision the peasants will leave our fields uncultivated. While they are working them now, what are our guarantees they will do so tomorrow?

Only a firm hand can steer the peasant's fickle mind and ensure he plows with determined energy."

options.name: As … guides his flock, so shall the … guide theirs.

rewards.name: The Return of the Good Old Days

options.name: Oh, but they will not become serfs, merely "tenants in fee simple".

events.title: Enthrallment in an Enlightened Age

events.desc: Wealthy affiliates of the … in …, in response to …, have ordered their surplus livestock culled and their bumper crops burned.
events.flavor:
"You seeing this? They're just burning everything... could feed my whole family for a month on one of those fires."

"Reckon those rich milksops in the next town talked 'em into it?"

"Nah... the old man here is a mean bastard, but he ain't about this."

options.name: All the more reason to press ahead.
The process cannot continue if it courts a famine.

events.title: Farmhand Firesale

events.desc: … clerics are handing out pamphlets declaring … and … works on … are an affront to the world's natural order.
events.flavor: There are no true means to say which gods care on how a crop grows. Those with any true sense would place their faith in the soil they use. Fertilize good soil, care for it well, and grow only those plants that do not harm each other. And yet, those with earthly power will presume to know what their god demands when that power is threatened.

options.name: All the more reason to press ahead.
The process cannot continue if our … population revolts.
Seize these pamphlets and use them for lantern fuel.

events.title: An Affront to the Garden

events.desc: State planners have returned early from touring the farms converted to … in …. They believe the farms cannot support the heavy machinery properly.
events.flavor:
"Suppose we could manufacture redundant machine parts. Enough steel would outlast the muds. I'm sure of it."

"And you can assure these field-bred peasants their parts will always be on time? Without fail? I couldn't. And I won't have the city workers' lives ruined by farm mud. We'll have to think of something smarter."

options.name: Machines exist only to aid human labor.
An ad hoc steel mill should suffice.
Consult with … on what to do.

events.title: Late on Arrival

events.desc: Farmhands between harvests have organized to aid the collectivization process. The most dedicated go door-to-door, helping speed any process they can find.
events.flavor:
"Did you see these large men by the door? They smell of earth and brine, and yet they're marching through our parlor with... stationary, by the looks of it."

"I did. The strapping one was singing quite the tune. And he was a union man. Doesn't let any liquor pass his lips either. He seemed over the moon that I asked him to write to me."

"Good God, did... did you mention me at all, by any chance?"

options.name: We welcome their support.
Ensure they are paid for their efforts.

events.title: Rippling, Strong Aides

events.desc: An academic known for isolationist views has released an article condemning …. The article states that it would ruin the rural idyll.
events.flavor: "With no fields of their own to work, our working men will cease being men. They will be replaced by the groan of the machine, the racket of the engine, and the ceaseless, choking fog that permeates a factory district. A quiet life chased away by the endless march of urbanization!"

options.name: Stay the course.
Time to open a fresh barrel of ink...

events.title: Picturesque Community, Now Surreal

events.desc: Debates between … and … have spilled into the … news. The focal point: foreign investment in ….
events.flavor:
"With extraterritoriality about, what legal guarantees do we have that … laws affect … citizens here?"

"A fairer point would be who works on that land. It's … land, it should be worked by … hands!"

"But if they bring their own labor and laws, that could be better for the domestic markets..."

options.name: All foreign investors will answer to … civil laws.
… laws are what they are familiar with.
This overbearing caution serves nobody.

events.title: Foreign Farm Acquisitions, Inc.

events.desc: The … have taken an interest in …. Many industry leaders hope to secure the entire supply chain for their companies.
events.flavor: "Gentlemen, I present to you a model of the future: …landia. This diorama, sourced from pieces of this project, aims to capture the whole production chain. Cut out the middle-men, as the High Street peddlers like to say. We own the farms to feed the workers, the mines to supply our furnaces, and the cotton for our uniforms. One holistic chain, focusing on the sale and distribution of our final product. Questions?"

options.name: Middle-managers will be a thing of the past.
The workers will need additional protections.
An interesting proposal. We're taking it.

events.title: Total Top-Down Management

events.desc: A court clash over … erupts between a few families. The early-bird homesteaders each claim the same land in …. The dispute has called the legislation into question.
events.flavor: Three claims, all issued by the same office, crossed the magistrate's desk. The details were correct: all three had legal writs to the same plot of land. Each bore a different signature. The magistrate knew the pen strokes of those clerks well. Surely there was a mistake. Though such a simple explanation wouldn't satisfy the wild looks in the family matriarchs' eyes.

options.name: Void the writs and organize reparations.
Find the earliest signee and grant them the land.
Divide the land between all three.

events.title: Family Always Comes First

events.desc: A clash of thought has erupted in …. Rural firebrands have criticized the … laws for supporting a master-servant relationship with the ….
events.flavor:
"Feh. We work too much for that madame. All I'm saying is that if I wanted a woman to take all I work for, chain me to a bed, and call her mistress, I'd rather actually owe her money, first."

"The nearest bordello is three towns away."

"Oh, I were thinkin' of a marriage dowry."

options.name: Perhaps a revision is in order.
People will work what they are worth.
Concessions must not avert the Revolution.

events.title: Peasantry, Rebranded

events.flavor: "They say that the Dutch are the best engineers in Europe. They are wrong. The Dutch are the best engineers in the world."

options.name: The sea retreats before us.
We are the masters of land and sea.

events.title: Land Reclamation

events.desc: The … argues that citizens with moral or religious objections to violence should be exempt from ….
events.flavor: "Conscription is simply another form of forced labor, one of the worst in fact as it makes us raise arms against our fellow man, regardless of our personal moral views."

options.name: Objectors are excluded from the draft.
Everyone must fight.

events.title: Conscientious Objectors

events.desc: Several mine owners from … are requesting an exemption from the mining regulations.
events.flavor: "It is simply ridiculous to think we will be able to maintain a profitable mine on only a ten hour work days, not to mention the other extra costs we will incur implementing all these safety measures."

options.name: One small exception couldn't hurt.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Mines
Mortality of Machinists employed in Mines
Mortality of Engineers employed in Mines

options.name: No exceptions.

events.title: Unhappy Mine Owners

events.desc: The … have shown their unhappiness with the passing of the … law, arguing that education and religion should be separate matters.
events.flavor: "How can we expect our children to learn anything meaningful when they are being indoctrinated from the outset?"

options.name: We shall consider it.
Out of the question.

events.title: Secular Teachings

events.desc: This afternoon, …, leader of the …, delivered a fiery speech advocating for the enactment of ….
events.flavor: Making an appearance before the public in …'s main square, …'s powerful rhetoric left even … most embittered political opponents impressed. Excerpts from the speech are already being circulated across …, fanning the fires of an already roaring debate.

options.name: This should ease the path to reform greatly.
Performances like these reflect well on … and … cause.

events.title: Rousing Speech Captivates the Public

events.desc: Prominent members of the …, including …, have been exposed in a corruption scandal, having exchanged political favors for personal "gifts".
events.flavor: One aide was all it took. One boy squeezing acne from his face in the right place at the right time to overhear the howling laughter, smell the rich tobacco blend, and spot …'s new, golden cufflinks. One honest fellow's word to the right ears, and it was all uncovered.

options.name: Such is the nature of politics.
Corruption? I see no corruption...
What horror! We must confiscate those gifts at once.

events.title: Backroom Dealings Exposed

events.desc: More pragmatically inclined members of the …, currently opposed to the passing of …, have offered to change their stance were they to be offered certain political concessions. Such concessions would not be popular with the …, however.
events.flavor: "Compromise makes a good umbrella, but a poor roof; it is temporary expedient, often wise in party politics, almost sure to be unwise in statesmanship."

options.name: Acquiesce to their demands, the bill must pass.
Compromise is a tool of the weak.
A prime opportunity to break the bill from deadlock.

events.title: Opposition Members Put Forth Demands

events.desc: In the midst of the debate surrounding …, one of the country's leading playwrights, strongly associated with the …, has staged a widely acclaimed play whose politically laden theme makes no secret of the author's desire for the law to be passed.
events.flavor: "The man's viewpoints may be somewhat partisan, but sir, you cannot argue with his prose!"

options.name: … will be on everyone's lips now.
This sure puts the … in a good light.
Let us ensure the play gets a wider, international audience.

events.title: Popular Playwright Endorses Reform

events.desc: Lawmakers working towards the enactment of … have found themselves mired in a particularly complex set of bureaucratic proceedings, grinding the work towards reform to a near halt.
events.flavor: The fully developed bureaucratic apparatus compares with other organizations exactly as does the machine with the non-mechanical modes of production. That is to say, the teeth of its individual gears meet in accord, or its gears will gnash and churn until it eventually breaks.

options.name: Damn this labyrinthine legal system!
Cut through at least some of the red tape.

events.title: Bureaucratic Imbroglio

events.desc: The … has taken a personal interest in the ongoing debate concerning …, and have resolved to use … royal prerogative to ensure the law passes.
events.flavor: … seldomly intervenes directly in matters of law, relying instead on a system of delegation and personal influence for the efficient running of … realm. While legally, the … may exercise … royal powers at will, doing so is sure to rile up both republicans and opponents of the law in question.

options.name: The …'s assent is all that is required.
The …'s will be done!
Advise the … against it, it would do more harm than good.

events.title: … Intervenes in Political Process

events.desc: The political wills and desires of the lower classes will always remain an opaque matter. For whatever reason, support for … has spread like wildfire across …, spurred on by charismatic speakers and lively debates in small-time social clubs.
events.flavor: "They are backing what now? Well, who are we to complain. While their support was never a prerequisite for success, it sure does not hurt to have it either."

options.name: Public enthusiasm expedites reform!
Use this common ground to calm the masses.

events.title: Grassroots Support for Law

events.desc: What was meant as a routine speech about the merits of … by … has quickly devolved into a public relations disaster for the ….
events.flavor: Fumbling … way through a series of poorly presented talking points, …'s arguments have been viciously and convincingly picked apart by … political opponents. The question on everyone's lips now is merely if this mishap was due to the inherent failings of … or can be chalked down to the political incompetence of the ….

options.name: It is the fault of this poorly thought-through proposal!
… must take the blame for this setback.
Scrap the current draft, and make a show of a rewrite.

events.title: Public Address Goes Awry

events.desc: Claiming that the enactment of … would affect the country's … inhabitants in a disproportionately negative way, … firebrands have riled their communities against the current law proposal.
events.flavor:
"Give them a finger and they will cry for an arm.

Give them an arm and—before you know it—they will weaponize the arm, batter all you know to death with it, and pilfer their corpses for even more concessions!"

options.name: And their thoughts concern us how? Force the issue through!
Make some token amends.
Acknowledge and address their concerns.

events.title: Law Proposal Causes Uproar in … Communities

events.desc: An influential faction within the … has grown frustrated with their comembers' neutrality on the topic of …. Themselves in favor of the law, they have now resolved to form a separate political faction intent on passing it.
events.flavor: "How can you all stand idly by and watch the world pass before your eyes? Have you no sense of honor?—of duty to your fellow man? I say nay to such lack of ambition, and I dare say I am not alone in this."

options.name: With their support, the bill shall pass.
The … extend an open hand to these mavericks.

events.title: Discord within the …

events.desc: To outside observers, the … may appear firmly committed to the idea of …, but behind this facade of unity discord has long festered. Now, a clique of dissenters have finally had enough, and have officially broken with their fellow members over the issue of reform.
events.flavor: "For how long have we stood together? How many times have we lent a willing hand your way? Yet our own concerns are left unanswered, and our desires left unmet. If we shall not be heard here, we shall be so elsewhere."

options.name: Splitters! May the Devil take them.
Loosen our purse strings, perhaps we can lure some of them back.
Offer them custodianship over a new draft.

events.title: Dissenters Break Ranks

events.desc: Frustrated with the lengthy legal process surrounding …, … of the … has approached us with an offer to expedite the process, utilizing … personal connections within the state apparatus.
events.flavor: "A few words in the right ears is all I am asking for. Everything within the bounds of the law, of course, although I cannot guarantee our opponents in this matter will view such actions with much glee."

options.name: Grant … permission, time is of the essence.
No, we do this by the book, or not at all.

events.title: Crooked Connections

events.desc: Our beloved … … has narrowly survived an assassination attempt. The would-be assassin has ties to the …, who oppose the new powers that the … law would bestow upon the ….
events.flavor: Troubling news of a failed attempt on the life of the … has emerged from the capital. Carried out in the dead of night, the … was able to defeat the assailant with the aid of … young protégé. Speaking from a hospital bed, the … told the … that despite wounds that will surely leave lifelong scars, … resolve and dedication are stronger than ever.

options.name: For a safe and secure society.
This is how liberty dies.

events.title: … Evades Assassination

events.desc: An assassin's bullet narrowly missed a minister from the … this morning, prompting calls for the rapid passage of … laws. The …, opponents of …, are also being accused of implicitly supporting the assassin.
events.flavor: "This near-miss is just the latest in a long line of incidents. If we don't do something today, then when? How many have to be hurt before we take action?"

options.name: We must protect our own.
Those who oppose order must be censured.

events.title: Too Close a Call

events.desc: The national effort to implement … has become the subject of debate between partisan newspapers, and may disrupt the lawmaking process.
events.flavor:
"Dear editor,

As a private citizen definitely not connected with the ongoing national dispute over this law enforcement legislation, I, someone who is absolutely only a private citizen, have a few choice words I wish to write..."

options.name: Let the newspapers say what they want.
Issue our own editorials for the papers.
The papers have spoken freely enough on this matter.

events.title: The Papers' Police Polemics

events.desc: A largely peaceful demonstration for the … has been violently broken up by the local militia. The …, a major supporter of the movement, is particularly upset by the violence. The incident has led many to question the wisdom in establishing any permanent law enforcement with the right to use force.
events.flavor: "The wicked, the butchers, have drawn their axes that already reek with the blood of the innocent. Is this the 'justice' you seek to spread across the nation? Unless the government calls its ministers to account and relieves the people, it will surely be deposed."

options.name: Perhaps a period of reflection is necessary right now.
We can't let word of this get out- crack down on the ….
This is exactly why we need … instead of using these brutes!

events.title: The Rally Run Roughshod

events.desc: The …, under the leadership of …, has ushered in an era of liberal politics that promises a freer society where all citizens have a part in the political process.
events.flavor: "You will find many ideologues who claim to represent the will of the people, but who silence its voice when it cries out in opposition to their policies. Not we! We will remove the people's shackles, one by one, until they are freed of the yoke of the past. Only then can we see what the will of the people truly is, and let it shape the future."

options.name: … is a fearless visionary!
Other political leaders would be wise to follow this trend!
Perhaps a voice of reason is needed, before this gets too radical.

events.title: Freedom, Equality and Brotherhood

events.desc: The … market has grown famous worldwide for being welcoming and open to foreign trade.
events.flavor: "We will enjoy the most exotic goods from the most distant markets, not through conquest and subjugation of foreign peoples, but through offering them what we have in return. A nation which is confident in what it has to offer has no need for arms. Except, of course, if arms is what it is selling!"

options.name: Sell. Sell!
Buy. Buy! Buy!

events.title: Marketplace of the World

events.desc: Those who seek to think boldly and freely are increasingly finding … to be one of the safest places to explore their ideas.
events.flavor:
"Have you read the filth laid out in this supposed 'poem' about the … …? Outrageous."
"Outrageous!"
"Written by one of … countrymen, too. Can you imagine?"
"I got a copy for myself. Someone needs to keep an eye on these literary libertines. The … government certainly isn't!"

options.name: A utopia for the modern artist.
A place where research is unimpeded by tradition.

events.title: The Thought, the Word and the Ideal

events.desc: … has become renown around the world as a place that welcomes immigrants without discriminating.
events.flavor:
"Keep, ancient lands, your storied pomp!" cries she
With silent lips. "Give me your tired, your poor,
Your huddled masses yearning to breathe free,
The wretched refuse of your teeming shore.
Send these, the homeless, tempest-tost to me,
I lift my lamp beside the golden door!"

options.name: Come one, come all!
All will know us as a safe harbor!

events.title: Open Arms

events.desc: An article published in the … … has been making headways within the country's literary circles, enflaming the ongoing debate surrounding …. Claiming that machines are a kind of mechanical life undergoing constant evolution, it warns that, unless mankind acts prudently, machines might one day supplant humans as the dominant species.
events.flavor:
"We refer to the question: What sort of creature man's next successor in the supremacy of the earth is likely to be. We have often heard this debated; but it appears to us that we are ourselves creating our own successors.

Day by day the machines are gaining ground upon us; day by day we are becoming more subservient to them; more men are daily bound down as slaves to tend them, more men are daily devoting the energies of their whole lives to the development of mechanical life.

The upshot is simply a question of time."

options.name: The machines shall not replace us.
Sounds like someone has sat in his dank studio for a bit too long.
Fascinating idea. Really, quite fascinating.

events.title: Darwin Among the Machines

events.desc: …, the resolutely anti-modernist leader of the …, has lauded the … proposal, claiming it would steer the … people away from the depraved march of modernity, and back into the tender bossom of ….
events.flavor: "The men of today boast of the ever growing extent of the modifications they impose on the world, and the consequence is that everything is thereby made more and more artificial."

options.name: … words have merit, and our goals are alligned.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Let us not entertain fanatics.

events.title: Simple Living

events.desc: What began as a protest against the possible automation of certain work tasks in the … in … quickly devolved into a riot as a radicalized, mallet-wielding foreman unlocked the doors of the factory floor. Stories of broken machinery and broken bones are quickly spreading across …, souring the debate on ….
events.flavor:
"When the web that we weave is complete,
And the shuttle exchanged for the sword,
We will fling the winding sheet
O'er the despot at our feet,
And dye it deep in the gore he has pour'd."

options.name: An unfortunate incident, at an inopportune time.
Arrest both rabble and ringleaders. They do not represent us.

events.title: Furor Technophobicus

events.desc: A popular new book, filled with lavish descriptions of field work and rich details of …'s wildlife, has drawn great attention to the prospect of enacting ….
events.flavor:
"And the bush hath friends to meet him, and their kindly voices greet him
In the murmur of the breezes and the river on its bars,
And he sees the vision splendid of the sunlit plains extended,
And at night the wond'rous glory of the everlasting stars."

options.name: What a riveting read.
Offer a commission to the author, with our compliments.

events.title: Pining for Pines

events.desc: Opponents of the proposed … laws with ties to the … have infuriated the people they sought to influence. Many are calling for a harsh reprisal for this disturbance.
events.flavor:
"How are we to progress, if our nation is beset by bloodthirsty simpletons?"

"Simpletons? Yes, I'm a simpleton! Are you a simpleton? We'll build a town and we'll name it Simple Town, because by then all the smart bastards that threw us out of work, they'll be dead!"

options.name: If they're so smart, they can learn to live without machines.
Perhaps we can hear what … has to say.

events.title: Simpletons!

events.desc: News of the … laws have reached the … and the …. Rather than renegotiate contracts, they are trying to renegotiate the laws by force.
events.flavor: No worthwhile contender in the political scene dares countenance 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend,' as sound advice. There are coalitions, allies of convenience, and desperate agreements. In the direst of moments, even fire and stone may ally against its common foe. And should they marry, those nearest to the eruption would do well to escape by any means.

options.name: Perhaps we were hasty.
We need only coax one away from the other.
Money greases everyone's wheels.

events.title: Collective Antagonism

events.desc: People from the state of … have started massively migrating across the country, in the hopes of finding a better place to settle and escape the great famine that has been devastating their lives.
events.flavor:
"Along the deserted and rusty railways, the cry of children is the only sound that can be heard—no train will arrive until noon, but families have already gathered near the ruined station. Some of them have been walking for days, "where is brother?," they keep walking.

Rumors of a better life beyond their land are a foolish hope, they suspect, "where is brother?," rain falls, some men too."

options.name: Our Emergency Relief measures have toned down the number of victims.
These are the consequences that we must face.
We should activate the Emergency Relief in the original … now.

events.title: In Search of a Better Life

events.desc: After receiving notice of the horrors that the citizens of … have been enduring, solidarity among the nations has been raised, and there are many who want to donate to the cause.
events.flavor:
"And behold! Before us lies a once beautiful and prosperous city! Fertile lands, happy faces, simple lives. Alas, those times have long passed, people of my people, and now hunger harries their peace, as dreadful as the wolf itself! It is our duty to try to alleviate their suffering.

I see that this will make us hold a sanctuary in their hearts, and in the heart of their country, and in the heart of mankind. This will bring our nations closer!"

options.name: We should accept the donations of ….

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: We should accept the donations of ….

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: We shall rely on internal donations.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: Generous Donations

events.desc: An extensive railway line now connects … to …. The riches of Siberia are ours for the taking!
events.flavor: This is a triumph for the … nation. … trains shall carry … coal, … sulfur, and … iron across the vast expanse of Eurasia!

options.name: Mine, boys!
All aboard!

events.title: The Trans-Siberian Railway

events.desc: With the route between the Atlantic and Pacific complete, the door is open for greater settlement of the American West.
events.flavor: "With this golden spike, we call for the unity of our country, as this railroad unites the two great oceans of the world!"

options.name: We will settle the Great Plains.
The West Coast shall be just as prosperous as the East.

events.title: The First Trans-Continental Railway

events.desc: The Canada Pacific Railway has finally been completed, connecting the Atlantic and Pacific coasts. The new railway opens up new opportunities for settlement across the Western Provinces.
events.flavor:
"The stroke released the trigger for a burst
Of sound which stretched the gamut of the air.
The shouts of engineers and dynamiters,
Of locomotive-workers and explorers,
Flanking the rails, were but a tuning up
For a massed continental chorus."

options.name: The coast holds the most promise.
There is great potential in the Prairies.

events.title: The Last Spike

events.desc: We have wrested control of the American Southwest from the illegitimate clutches of Mexico. The … now stretches from the Atlantic to the Pacific.
events.flavor:
"O beautiful for patriot dream
That sees beyond the years
Thine alabaster cities gleam
Undimmed by human tears!
America! America!
God shed His grace on thee
And crown thy good with brotherhood
From sea to shining sea!"

options.name: This was our destiny!

events.title: The Mexican Cession

events.desc: The last vestiges of Native American rule have been stamped out, leaving only the dominion of the ….
events.flavor: "We have it in our power to begin the world over again. A situation, similar to the present, hath not happened since the days of Noah until now. The birthday of a new world is at hand."

options.name: This was our destiny!

events.title: The Frontier Wars

events.desc: The … people of … rely on bison for many of their basic needs. It would serve the interests of settlers in … if the bison population were to be depleted.
events.flavor: "Many thousands have been ruthlessly and shamefully slain every season by white hunters and tourists merely for their robes, and in sheer wanton sport, and their huge carcasses left to fester and rot, and their bleached skeletons to strew the deserts and lonely plains."

options.name: Encourage commercial hunting.
Have the army slaughter bison.
Protect the bison herds.

events.title: Bison Hunting

events.desc: The … has fallen from power, and … … has restored the political primacy of the monarchy. This momentous occasion marks the end of centuries of military rule in Japan, and heralds a new era of modernization and reform. The … must choose … political allies carefully.
events.flavor: The former Shōgun bows with respect and shame as he hands over his residence and seat of power, the mighty Edo Castle, to the restored Emperor. Renovations are set to begin at once; the old castle to be replaced by a glorious Imperial Palace. Though the exterior will appear much the same as the former imperial residence in Kyoto, the Emperor plans to combine Japan's rich decorative traditions with strange Western fashions. A metaphor, perhaps, for the future shape of Japan.

options.name: Industrial might will see us through.
We must look to the intellectuals.

events.title: The … Restoration

events.desc: A reformed army, an open and recognized country, a new society. … stands as an equal among the powers of the world, and will perhaps begin to pursue imperial ambitions of her own.
events.flavor: "By the blessing of heaven we sit upon the sacred throne on which our ancestors reigned from time immemorial. The civilization and institutions of Japan are so different from those of other countries that we cannot expect to reach the declared end at once. It is our purpose to select from the various institutions prevailing among enlightened nations such as are best suited to our present conditions, and adapt them in gradual reforms and improvements of our policy and customs so as to be upon equality with them."

options.name: The … Empire shall rise.
We will need powerful friends, for we shall make powerful enemies.
Railways are the key to our future success.

events.title: A Renewed Japan

events.desc: … has succeeded in reforming the armed forces and putting an end to the backwards system of feudalism. The … warrior caste seemingly no longer have a place within our modernizing society.
events.flavor: The Shōgun commanded the loyalty of the Daimyo, who in turn relied on their Samurai to help them enforce their rule over the enserfed peasantry. This was the basis of Japanese feudalism—now a relic of the past. There are those still loyal to Samurai ideals, the codes and virtues known as Bushido, and that legacy will surely endure. But the Samurai have fallen, and we will not see their like again.

options.name: Let them keep their status as officers and nobles.
The era of Samurai is over.

events.title: The Fall of the Samurai

events.desc: Taking interest in …'s modernization efforts, … has offered us the service of General … as a military consultant. The terms of this arrangement appear favorable, but we should be wary of indebting ourselves to foreign powers.
events.flavor: "This, sir, is a Gatling gun. Two hundred rounds per minute. There is nothing, neither man nor beast nor machine, that can withstand the hellish cacophony of ammunition that this device can unleash. We will teach your soldiers to operate such machines, to maintain modern military discipline, and to obey their superiors without question."

options.name: We welcome … assistance.
We do not want their poisoned chalice.

events.title: … Military Consultants

events.desc: As part of an ambassadorial voyage to the West, our dignitaries have met with …, a senior … politician. Interested in establishing good relations with the newly opening … state, they have drafted several treaties we may wish to enter with ….
events.flavor: "Nations these days all appear to conduct relations with amity and courtesy. But this is entirely superficial; for behind this facade lurks mutual contempt and a struggle for supremacy. While … may now have diplomatic relations with a number of countries, its friendship with the … state should be the closest of all, because of the true respect with which we hold the right of self-government."

options.name: Establish strong diplomatic ties.
… has much to teach us.
We have nothing to gain from ….

events.title: Embassy to …

events.desc: …, a wealthy and powerful industrialist from …, sees … as a lucrative and untapped market. In exchange for various political favors to be redeemed at an unspecified point in time, … is willing to share with us the industrial technology of … homeland.
events.flavor: "There are those among my colleagues who disdain interest in …, opining that its lack of valuable natural resources make it an unappealing place to do business. I, however, see the potential in this country. What today are virgin forests and fallow fields shall tomorrow become thriving urban centers, choked with the healthy smog of modern industry."

options.name: … ingenuity shall empower ….
We no not need foreign meddling in our economy.

events.title: … Investments

events.desc: In order to expedite our ambitions to build a railway network, it has been suggested that foreign advisors from countries with established railway systems could be brought in to help.
events.flavor: "I had only just made the gentleman's acquaintance when I asked him a question about his interest in locomotives, not expecting there to be that much to the topic. As it turns out, there is actually quite a surprising number of things to know about trains."

options.name: … could assist us.
… has excellent engineers!
… is familiar with railways.
We have no need of foreign advice.

events.title: Railway Advisors

events.desc: Being privy to the government's ambition to expand …'s railways, the … have offered to support these efforts in ….
events.flavor: "The military will benefit from the railroads in any case, but currently, they are one of many priorities. Allowing them to build their own lines would be quite different. In every era, a lot of power lies in the hands of those who get to draw certain maps. In our era, the railroad network may well turn out to be those maps."

options.name: An excellent collaboration between military and industry!
We will set the priorities ourselves.

events.title: Military Railways

events.desc: As the special privileges of the samurai class diminish, their special right to carry swords as a status symbol has been called into question.
events.flavor: "It is perhaps the fate of all countries to go through periods where the warrior class lose their special position in society, as their value is cast aside for contemporary priorities. However, to strip a warrior of his weapon, to take from him not only his status but the symbol of who he is and the honor of his forebearers, must be considered the height of humiliation!"

options.name: It's time for this right to be abolished.
The right could be extended to other citizens of status.
To take a samurai's sword would be to tear out his soul!

events.title: Students of the Blade

events.desc: … has begun organizing private military academies in …, not only teaching military theory, but … own political ideas.
events.flavor: "You may view it as a political organization, but how are we expected to instill the spirit of the samurai in our students if we do not teach them about the responsibility they have to lead and the importance of national ambition and expansion? How can we teach military tactics without discussing how an invasion of our neighbors might be undertaken? Indeed, the scope of what military force can be used for, up to and including its political applications, can and must be part of the curriculum!"

options.name: They provide a valuable service to our armed forces.
They must be shut down before this political faction gets dangerous.

events.title: Shi-gakkō

events.desc: … has attempted to force open one of our harbors, demanding access to the port in ….
events.flavor: "I saw the … sailors while they were still approaching the coast. By the time I'd gathered a group to drive them back out to sea, they were already at the shore. Most of us were peasants, not soldiers, but at the time I thought they might not be prepared to fight either. Prepared or not, blood was spilled. The rest of us fled. I don't know where they went after that."

options.name: Fight back! Sakoku must be protected.
Negotiate to meet some of their demands.
Perhaps … could help mediate this difficult situation.

events.title: The … Incident

events.desc: A recently published articles has debated where …'s future lies after the end of sakoku, weighing the benefits of aligning with other Asian counties or turning to the United States and the European powers.
events.flavor: "It may seem obvious a country's loyalties should be bound by the practicalities of geography, but that thinking lies in the past. The size of the world has changed. Who knows how it will be controlled in the future? The world will... keep getting smaller."

options.name: … must leave Asia behind and look to the Western powers.
We will stand with our neighboring nations.
The future is uncertain. We must be prepared for anything.

events.title: Which Way the Wind Blows

events.desc: Forced to open itself to the world, … must now contend with the economic interference of other powers. The authority of the … Clan and the … have, consequently, been greatly undermined.
events.flavor: The changing winds of time howl against our door and to preserve our establishement we must bend and open them to the whims of the world.

options.name: We must adapt to our new circumstances.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: The Opening of Japan

events.desc: Despite the heady promises of reform championed by the new … government, … has undergone no major changes. Critics lament that the state today is little different from the state before the Restoration.
events.flavor: An enormous engine huffed and chugged on the factory floor, spinning an enormous flywheel and powering tremendous lathes and drills. Those machines were carving new barrels, new locks, new triggers, for a vast new arsenal of weapons. A nation would soon wield this steam and iron to stamp their mark on the world—and that nation would not be ….

options.name: Today, the sun rests on a dream.

events.title: The Empty Restoration

events.desc: The grand opening of the … Metropolitan Railway was received with much celebration. In a speech, the … congratulated the engineers who made this possible.
events.flavor: "It is not only the railway that is electrified, but the whole city of …. The streets are abuzz with citizens marveling at the wonders of technology, speculating about what new innovation will come to transform our lives for the better."

options.name: The engineers deserve a reward.
Our railway will be the envy of the world.

events.title: The Metropolitan Railway

events.desc: With the accession of … … to the throne, the long-serving Chancellor … has announced … retirement. The chapter of history defined by … statesmanship has come to a close.
events.flavor:
"But, after all, the thought I secretly cherish is that ancient Europe is at the beginning of the end. My determination being to perish with it, I shall know how to do my duty; nor is this my my motto alone—it is that of the Emperor too. New Europe, on the other hand, has not as yet begun its existence, and between the end and the beginning there will be a chaos."

— Klemens von Metternich

options.name: The great conductor exits the stage.

events.title: The End of an Age

events.flavor:
"I am no longer anybody. I have nothing more to do, nothing more to discuss."

— Klemens von Metternich

options.name: … will no longer define us.

events.title: An Ingoniminous End

events.desc: Chancellor … has proposed a slate of reforms to the structure of the Geheime Staatskonferenz; improving the functioning of the body whilst instating … as its undisputed head. … has aligned with the Royal Family to arrest the measure.
events.flavor:
"There are few men who would benefit less from additional power than Metternich", began the messenger, "and I beg the Archduke forgive me for saying so. If you are available by month's end..."

The Archduke gestured for him to pause, an irritated look on his face. His boots were half-on, and he wished to give them his full attention. "Month's end? Where is Kolowrat now?"

"Bohemia, my lord. He sends tidings of the flu."

options.name: Kolowrat's meddling threatens the stability of the Empire.
The Chancellor had best limit himself to foreign affairs.

events.title: A Minor Coup

events.desc: Inspired by the ongoing reform to …, … of the … has penned a vision for a future where borders are abolished altogether.
events.flavor: "Borders are the scars of a map. Like scars, there are some who find them beautiful, in a way. Hard-fought, hard-earned. They find them so beautiful they forget that maps don't need scars, and so they start inflicting them. On maps, but more horrifyingly, on people. The day we can let go of the past and let the scars heal is the day when we can finally be free."

options.name: This is the future we want!
It has the right spirit, but seems naïvely utopian.

events.title: Citizens of the World

events.desc: The suggestion of … has caused debate among the … about whether immigrants will share the uniquely … religious sensibilities.
events.flavor: "Even if they are …, who is to say what strange foreign rites they might bring with them? A bastardized … faith, stained by folk practices from their homeland. What will happen to our own traditions if such things are to be accommodated?"

options.name: We should accept immigrants who do not practice their faith as we do.
Perhaps we can place some restrictions to prevent this.

events.title: Foreign Faiths

events.desc: People living in … under dire conditions are afraid that the … reform will increase competition in the job market.
events.flavor: "Whose idea was this? Probably someone who didn't have to worry every day if they would have work, so they would have pay, so they would live. A rich immigrant never seems to be a threat to those who are already well-off. But let me tell you, here down at the bottom, it's always crowded."

options.name: If they can't compete, they deserve to lose their jobs.
We will ensure that all are cared for, if it comes to that.
… job-seekers should be prioritized!

events.title: Foreign Competition

events.desc: The effort to institute … has been bolstered by a wave of antipathy towards our neighbors in …, arguing that the reform is necessary to stop migration from there.
events.flavor: "When you say border control, we all know which border you mean. You don't have to say it. You should say it, though. No shame in admitting who we're trying to keep out. We have nothing to be ashamed of. They should be ashamed!"

options.name: Those … swine are the exact reason for this law!
This is a general reform, which has nothing to do with ….

events.title: Keeping the … Out

events.desc: Some free-trade proponents are concerned that the immigration reform towards … is the first steps to closing off … from the outside world, not just to migrants but to markets as well.
events.flavor: "These may seem like separate issues and principles, but that is a superficial analysis. We are sending a message to the world: You are not welcome here. How can we reject the people of foreign countries and expect them to willingly share with us everything they have to give?"

options.name: Perhaps it is!
We will draft the law to make it clear it is not.

events.title: People and Goods

events.desc: In response to the proposal of …, … people living in … have pointed out that they once immigrated there as well and that future restrictions may prevent relatives from joining them.
events.flavor: "We have all arrived where we are at some point. Some yesterday, some in long-forgotten times. Perhaps forgotten for a reason. How much blood was spilled when your people claimed the land you now call yours? Where do you get the moral authority to tell us who has the right to join us here?"

options.name: Part of the point is to stop everyone from inviting their family here!
This is not about the … at all.

events.title: Plea of the …

events.desc: Although a situational weapon, the flamethrower is proving effective in the … as support in close range trench warfare.
events.flavor: "We humans may lord our mastery of fire over lesser creatures, but there is no starker reminder of how much of a fearful animal still lives in a man's heart than seeing fire fill the ditch he's hiding in. Few die from the flames; many die trying to escape them."

options.name: It should strike fear into the hearts of our enemies.
It should be deployed where it can efficiently flush out soldiers.

events.title: The Dragon of the Trenches

events.desc: The change in large-scale production from smoothbore muskets to rifles in the … in … has ushered in a new era for … production in ….
events.flavor:
"Even from one thousand yards you can still take the shot.

Forward artillery positions can be harassed, bayonet charges stopped before they have even commenced.

The advantages are innumerable!

Unless we develop sufficient manufacturing capabilities to produce these weapons, we are bound to face disaster on the battlefield."

options.name: The … Arsenal shall be famed throughout the world.
… shall be at the forefront of military innovation.

events.title: Modernizing the Arsenal

events.desc: … …'s use of dedicated machine gun teams in the … war has yielded advantageous results on the field of battle, leaving full platoons of enemies dead before they have even reached our lines.
events.flavor:
"If anyone had told me that it would be possible to make a gun that would: Pull a cartridge belt into position, pull a loaded cartridge out of it, move it in front of the barrel, thrust it into the barrel, close the breech in a proper manner, cock the hammer, pull the trigger, fire off the cartridge, extract the empty shell and throw it out of the mechanism, feed a new cartridge into position, and do all these things in the tenth of a second, I would not have believed it. 

But now I have seen it done with my own eyes."

options.name: Our foes fall like grass before the scythe.
Whatever happens, we have got the Maxim gun, and they have not.
…'s mastery of this tool is unparalleled.

events.title: The Devil's Paintbrush

events.desc: The introduction of vessels with metal-skinned hulls represents nothing less than a revolution in naval warfare. Near-impervious to traditional types of shot, … … assures us that … dominion of the seas will be absolute.
events.flavor: "While wooden ships with iron men might beat iron ships with wooden men, it sure does not hurt to have the armor on our side."

options.name: This will make our line of battle invincible.
Metal bows? Metal Rams! What could go wrong?
… rules the waves!

events.title: A Doctrine of Iron and Steam

events.desc: Designed for coastal defense operations, what monitors lack in oceangoing capabilites they make up for in cost effectiveness. … … has informed the Admiralty in … that … fleet will keep any foes away from … waters.
events.flavor: "Sir, while it might indeed look like a "cheesebox on a raft", I assure you that the 15-inch guns she carries in that box of hers are no laughing matter."

options.name: Secure shores means secure commerce.
Let us orient our naval doctrine around them.
We don't win by having the best ships, we win by having the most.

events.title: The Shallow Draft Solution

events.desc: This year's carnaval celebration is planned to be especially splendid in …. This could be an opportunity to appease the masses.
events.flavor:
Women painted in as spirits dance down the street, as the men drum bewitching beats to throaty tunes. Children wave flags and sticks of fried food alike. The streets, once drab with the everyday bustle, exalt glory in a sea of color and glee.
For one, small moment, the world seemed at peace.

options.name: A fine distraction.
Organize a truly magnificant festival.

events.title: Carnaval

events.desc: The plummeting price of … has prompted … in … … to advocate extreme action. They intend to burn surplus supply in an attempt to increase prices.
events.flavor:
The ledgers were two things: increasingly worrying, and increasingly clear. Not only were profits falling, there would be none left by the end of the year. Growing coffee would soon be a quaint hobby for the rich.

Or, as he found as he looked at his fireplace, a barbaric solution to a complex problem. An espresso, purpose-made for farmers and drinkers alike.

options.name: Burn it!
We could use the coffee as a fuel source.
Trust in the invisible hand of the market.

events.title: Medium Roast

events.desc: The influence of the philosophy of Positivism on … society has extended as far as the attitudes of the … towards state power.
events.flavor:
He had seen the slogan before, but never like this. It was emblazoned in gold on rich marble, at the door of the plantation's house, sparkling from the process of its installation.

"Love as a principle and order as a basis; progress as a goal."

options.name: Brazil evolves with the times.

events.title: The Modern Oligarchy

events.desc: A unified … nation has been achieved for the first time since the fall of Lan Xang.
events.flavor: Not since the final days of Soulingna Vongsa have we known peace. … is made whole once more. Families riven by the feuding of the old king's heirs now reunite under one banner. And with this, the … people stand ready to face a new, golden dawn.

options.name: We will restore the glory of Lan Xang.

events.title: Laotian Reunification

events.desc: The Baltic States have been unified into a single nation, bringing together the …, …, and … peoples under one banner.
events.flavor: The first stirrings of nationhood began in the cities, fields, and homes with numbers, songs, and history. Stirrings passed from strangers to invitations. Invitations gave way to meetings, meetings to agreements, and agreements to alliances. Sealing the alliance was but one linchpin: better to be beside equals against the world, than equals under another iron heel.

options.name: Unity will ensure sovereignty.

events.title: Baltic Unification

events.desc: With the restoration of …, our nation has laid claim to the legacy of Rome.
events.flavor:
He climbed the old curia, as the sky darkened with storm clouds. The tales of the old patricians said that the senators would climb the curia and wait for a sign of the gods' favor. He sat, but not for long. Lightning cracked the sky, and a golden eagle landed by the gutter.

And he wept: Rome would rise once more.

options.name: Rome will rise again.

events.title: Purple Phoenix

events.desc: The victory of … … brings the Age of Princes to an end, finally reunifying ….
events.flavor: The days of wayward princes were over. … would return to the fold of a sublime emperor, the champion of God upon this land. Stability and modernity may now follow under the eyes of God, in the duty of the emperor.

options.name: God was with us.

events.title: Ethiopian Reunification

events.desc: The union of Portugal with all the former kingdoms of the Spains has brought about a united Iberian Peninula.

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: Iberian Unification

events.desc: After years of disunity and turmoil, the nation of … rises once again from the ashes.

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: … Reunification

events.desc: Rising from the failed Austrian Empire, the … is an equal union of the …, …, …, …, …, and … peoples.
events.flavor: "Good people of the Danube, of homes far and near, my brothers: I see in you the hearts of a thousand scorned women and men with nothing to lose. Indeed, our once reigning overlords had set us down a path with which we lost our way. Our path to greatness in history. We were once holding the knife by the blade, bloodying ourselves for another's gain. No more. No more! This day, we dictate our own path. Our future. Glory awaits!"

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: The Danubian State

events.desc: The Arab states of the Middle East have become unified under a single … nation.
events.flavor: Once the font of learning and the bastion of thought in the world, the Arab world was brought under the yoke of a dozen hordes. Each of them traded the leash between each other. But the history was already written, and the memory was still alive. The Arab world may see gilded domes and gleaming spires once again. Cooperation would be the first, crucial step.

options.name: A glorious union.
All Arabs should unite under us.

events.title: Arabian Unification

events.desc: Having broken free from the yoke of the Ottoman and Austrian empires, the Slavic peoples of the Balkans have unified into a single nation.
events.flavor: Freedom. Not mere release from the shackles, but true freedom. No longer caught between hammer and anvil, hound and hunter, the time has come for a new union. A new pact between Slavs for all to see.

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: The Yugoslav Nation

events.desc: In contrast to the unequal unions of past Nordic hegemonies, the newly formed … state equally embraces its …, …, …, and … citizens.
events.flavor: Cheers lined the beer halls as a fresh layer of snow dusted the ground outside. On the walls above the roaring fire were five flags: one for each constituent, and one for the nascent union. Gone were the days of one king's dominion or another's empire. Today was a day of revelry and splendor: a new bear roused in the north, and may all know his glory.

options.name: A glorious union.
The … people should also become equal citizens.

events.title: Scandinavian Unification

events.desc: West Africa's greatest empire has at last been restored under the bold leadership of … ….
events.flavor: It is no simple task to assume the mantle of the great Malian kings of yore. But in the mind of … … only their legendary deeds have the potential to unify the diverse peoples of … realm in common reverence. For in the great nation building project that lies ahead no tool of statecraft is greater than the histories that binds our peoples together.

options.name: We will rise to the example of Mansa Musa.

events.title: The Mali Empire

events.desc: Through relentless struggles against far greater foreign powers, the nation of … has been forged in steel.
events.flavor:
"Why do we have a new flag now, mother? And why are those people talking like they're choking?"

"Child, be still. You do not speak of neighbours this way, not when they live near and trade with us. It is not them that takes from us; we give to them what we spare. We live together now, so that we might have a chance against the thieving devils who live away from us."

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: The Unification of Turkestan

events.desc: … has emerged to unite the many peoples of the Malay world and throw off the yoke of European oppression.
events.flavor: "Do you see this blade? Look, son. This very sword has been this family's responsibility for three generations now. And every time a new man in our family takes it up, it must never be put back until it takes another man's life. This is the price for what we now have. We must be ready to fight again. We cannot lose our homes. Never again."

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: Indonesian Unification

events.desc: … has emerged to unite the many peoples of the subcontinent and throw off the yoke of European oppression.

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: Indian Unification

events.desc: … has emerged from a long period of fragmentation as a stable and unified nation.
events.flavor:
"That tribe over there. Was your father's tribe not warring with them months ago?"

"A little civil dispute. It's good practice for whenever someone peddles a barrelful of sand as a miracle cure. Besides, who does not get angry about a brother's stubbornness?"

"I won't deny that is a feature of my tribe also. Yet I also won't deny their stew being a good reason to ally with them. Ha! I could be buried in it!"

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: The Reunification of Yemen

events.desc: … … has unified the … people under one banner.
events.flavor: "Prepare an envoy. I would have words with the Tsar. Now listen carefully. Our demands are simple: our independence is no longer for sale. Russia will cease all taxation efforts on our people, and will tear down their own fortresses. We are prepared to ride to war with the full might of every Shai'tan behind our horses' hooves."

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: Kazakh Unification

events.desc: … has emerged as a rising power in ….
events.flavor: A new day dawns, and a new nation rises to the world stage. … glory is the inevitable future.

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: … Unification

options.name: A glorious union.
The French proletariat cry for liberation.
The time has come to bury our feuds.

events.desc: For the first time since the Belgian Revolution of 1830, a single state has unified the territories of the Low Countries and declared a ….
events.flavor:
"I hear Flanders is to join us and our merry state soon. Ah, what splendid weather for a change. Something to mark the auspicious circumstances."

"The weather? You comment on the weather like some English schoolboy, when our holdings are threatened on all sides!"

"Very well. I'll speak on the important matters. How much cream would you like for the poffertjes?"

options.name: A glorious union.

events.title: The United Netherlands

events.desc: Opposing both Austrian and Prussian designs on their land, a confederation of German states has unified into a restored …. The Confederation stands united to assert its sovereignty in the face of its enemies.
events.flavor: Decades after Napoleon's defeat, his influence might still be felt across Europe. This confederacy is but one of many projects from his reign of blood. Perhaps, bereft of his mailed fist, it can be turned to a nobler purpose.

options.name: To the German Rhine!

events.title: The Confederation of the Rhine

events.desc: The mistake of 1712 has been reversed. North and South Carolina stand together once more, under the flag of a unified ….
events.flavor:
"Did you see? It's done. No more border. We can take the train to Charleston on a moment's notice- if so we wish."

"Oh, but what about the Southerners?"

"What about them?"

"Well, they have to contend with Fayetteville, now."

The word hung in the air like a particularly fat mosquito. The gentleman in red's face turned pale.

"...well, yes. There is that."

options.name: To be, and to hope.
Tennessee was ours, and will be again!

events.title: The Unified Carolinas

events.desc: A procession of activists in the capital have been joined by soldiers and civilians, all calling for monarchy. … has taken the opportunity to speak directly to the assembled crowd.
events.flavor: "Friends! The nation cries out for leadership, for justice, and for an end to chaos! If you want stability, if you want the will of the nation to be fully realized, then together let us vote for a king, and you will never have to vote again."

options.name: … is a figure who really knows … stuff.
… is clearly the home of monarchists, and therefore the nation.

events.title: Popular Acclamation

events.desc: … has been heard casually making positive comments about various secular governments. Some suspect that … is tiring of ruling … as a theocrat.
events.flavor: "Yes yes, of course I care for the souls of my flock. There is no greater calling than the salvation of man, the redemption of the wayward, the faith triumphant. But... be honest with me, is there anything wrong with a crown?"

options.name: … knows which way the winds are blowing.
… appreciates its ideas being endorsed.

events.title: Worldly Whispers

events.desc: The question of who should actually sit on the throne has prompted some monarchists to suggest inviting a member of the … royal family over to serve as our monarch. This idea has been received, to put it lightly, contentiously.
events.flavor: "It's simple, really. We need someone who not only symbolizes the strength and stability of our nation, but also already deeply understands the expectations, the role, of a monarch. Who better can play that part than someone who has already been raised up in a royal court?"

options.name: Let's not encourage these people to talk.
Every monarchist deserves to be heard.

events.title: Imported Bluebloods?

events.desc: Some monarchists have been discussing what the royal regalia ought to be, and it has led to a realization that the country has nothing that really seems appropriate for a monarch. One attempt at a homemade crown, made from tin and gold foil, has been seized as a symbol of the proposed monarchy's 'innately tawdy' nature.
events.flavor: "Our beautiful monarchy—for a monarchy we must have—calls for the certain dignity of modest and charming regalia. To this end, I have already contacted several goldsmiths, gemcutters, jewelers, and a shop that can make a proper throne seat with what they tell me is fine Corinthian leather. In the meanwhile..."

options.name: That crown is just a symbol! Er...
That crown IS a symbol! A symbol of the nation's love for monarchy!

events.title: The Gold-Foil Crown

events.desc: The Great Powers have negotiated for the … to return some of our homelands to us if we agree to stop raiding.
events.flavor:
"He dreams of the erection of a great national empire, the centre of which shall be Montenegro... Is not such an ambition open madness? Shall a lunatic with impunity strike a spark which might set the whole world in flames?"

–Anonymous author, Ost Deutsche Post

options.name: Take the deal.
"Death before peace!"
Sure, we'll totally stop raiding.

events.title: A New Life

events.desc: After a considerable wait for a visa, … was permitted to visit Moscow, where … managed to garner sympathy for our cause.
events.flavor:
"Senators, captains, the Gvardija, the Perjanici, all await … nod. I don't believe that any other country in the world exists where the orders of the ruler are carried out so precisely and so quickly from the lowest to the greatest." 

–Russian Envoy Ozeretskovsky, report to St Petersburg. 

"Rather unmonkish a clergyman, I hear." 
"I admire …. There's no bishop with finer swordsmanship." 
"Yes, the ladies at the public house all said so."

options.name: Purely a diplomatic mission.
At least visit St Basil's.

events.title: Visiting Russia

events.desc: Petar I has been officially canonized by order of … and the Serbian Orthodox Church.
events.flavor:
"What miracles did he perform exactly? "
"When my father lost his head to a Turk, Petar I brought him back to life." 
"He did not!" 
"Well, maybe not my father, but a friend of his." 
"It doesn't matter. We ain't dramatic Italians. Our saints don't need miracles." 
"Miracles are nice though." 
"My uncle saw him in a dream, does that count? There was a great Serbian empire, retaking Constantinople." 
"Empire? First give me a decent meal once a day, then we'll talk empire." 
"Seriously, šef. We aren't ruled by the Turks. Isn't that a miracle enough?"

options.name: Welcome pilgrims into his tomb.
Emphasize his vision for ….
"The greatest miracles are on the battlefield."

events.title: A New Saint

events.desc: Montenegrin vessels once again sail the Mediterranean from the port town of Cattaro, returned to us by our new allies ….
events.flavor:
"So generous, is it not, for our friends to give back to us what was always ours?" 

"A toast! I swear I’m the only man from the mountain who knows how to tie a knot, and damn it's good to be useful."
"Just pour already. You know there were thousands of good Serbs living under the Austrian occupation, yes? They’re with us now, and their boats."
"Well, yes. To them! And to your health!"
"To Montenegro! And to you not going around styling yourself as our sole sailor."
"Mmm. Not the only one, no no. Just the most grateful."

options.name: Welcome the world's traders to ….
Internationally praise ….
Ask our new friends for arms.

events.title: The Montenegrin Coast

events.desc: With a shared border, our free states have the opportunity to reunite the Serbian people into a single nation.
events.flavor: “They say Montenegro was founded by Serbian knights who got lost in the carnage of the battle of Kosovo, made their way to the black mountain, and held it from the Turks. Their sons fought on, and their sons, and their sons… So Montenegrins have held the mountain for centuries, never scared to come down and aid their fellow Christians. Now, finally, the battle has turned, and those brave knights who never surrendered can rejoin the main host, perhaps to lead it, till the fight ends in death or victory!”

options.name: We are Montenegro.
We are Serbia.
We are Serbia and Montenegro.
One people, but two states.

events.title: Serbia and Montenegro

events.flavor:
Oh, that these eyes of mine could only see 
Montenegro regain what it has lost! 
It would then seem to me indeed as if… 
My soul would be truly contented then 
like a peaceful morning in the springtime, 
when the sea winds and even the dark clouds 
slumber upon the bosom of the sea. 

 Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: Canonize … as a saint.
… will style himself as a monarch.
Let us unite in grief.
We will harbor no dissidents at this time, or ever.

events.title: Death of a Poet-Prince

events.desc: … wishes to be known as a monarch, but the … insist on calling him a Bishop. He wonders how to best prove them wrong.
events.flavor:
"Father, is it possible to perform a confession on behalf of another?" 
"What has Danilo done this time?" 
"Well, it started with him missing his own ordination–" 
"Again? Tomorrow I'll drag him to the altar myself." 
"Oh Father, you don't understand. He didn't stop there."

options.name: Bishops don't forget to wear their vestments.
Bishops don't get married.
Bishops don't patronize working women.
Bishops don't drink the blood of beheaded Turks.
Bishops don't plan to do all this on the same day.

events.title: Less Bishop and More Prince

options.name: Marry Princess Kleopatra Karadjordević from Serbia, for duty.
Marry Baroness Anastasia von Sina from Vienna, for money.
Marry Darinka Kvekić from Trieste, for love.

events.desc: … has ordered construction of a twenty-five room residence, complete with a round defensive tower. The master builders want to know what to emphasize in the palace's decor.
events.flavor: "On a rock, immediately above the convent, is a round tower, pierced with embrasures, but without cannon, on which I counted the heads of twenty Turks, fixed upon stakes, round the parapet, the trophies of Montenegrin victory… a strange spectacle in a Christian country, and in the immediate vicinity of a convent and a bishop's palace." #–John Gardner Wilkinson, visitor to Montenegro

options.name: Have some strong men carry a billiards table up from the sea.
Bless the chapel with a fragment of St Haralambos's skull.

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Middle Strata

options.name: Why only stick heads on the tower? Put them in every room!

events.title: Building the Biljarda

events.desc: … has been shot dead while visiting the coast. … ascends to the throne.
events.flavor: "Todor Kadic was the assassin, shot him right there. His wife took him inside and tried to nurse him to health, not trusting anyone. He was missing for days, so we went to the port, you know? Asking what the hell they had done with our šef. When we finally learned he was dead, the Austrians fired their cannons in a salute, and the whole town took to the streets to hear the news. Some say it's a sign invaders are coming, others believe the enemy is already here."

options.name: The enemy is within. Let the loyal prove themselves!
It was clearly ….
"… died a sinner, but there's hope for …."

events.title: … … Assassinated

events.desc: … has personally seen to the establishment of the first school in Montenegro.
events.flavor: "I remember when the … welcomed us to class. We didn't know what a book was, much less a school. Not even the priest could read. But this man, for all his talk of bravery and war, also fancied himself a poet – or a son of a poet. He spoke of things like a nation. Of pride. I had no idea what was happening, but I remember feeling that something was starting. That I got to be a part of something greater. The first buds of a tree in a garden that would never die."

options.name: … should organize the curriculum.
… could personally train more teachers.
… will ensure the kids learn to fight.

events.title: First School

events.desc: After slaying Ottoman tax collectors for many years, the people of … are resistant to the very concept of paying taxes, even if the money goes to the ….
events.flavor:
"So …'s robbing us?" 
"No, …'s taxing us." 
"What's the difference?" 
"Well, the taxes are going to be spent for our benefit." 
"So they'll give us flour, or fix our roof?" 
"No… Look, if we don't pay, armed men will come and–" 
"So … is robbing us!"

options.name: Agree to ease the taxes in gradually.
Hear out everyone's concerns.
Threaten anyone who resists.
"No, not taxes. I said axes!"

rewards.name: Axe the Rich, Axe the Poor

events.title: Taxes?

events.desc: The people of … are incredibly proud of their first ….
events.flavor:
My dzeferdar, old but good, I mourn more 
than my own arm if it had been cut off. 
I mourn it as I would my only son. 
I mourn it as I would my own brother, 
because it was a gun above all guns. 
It brought good luck, and it was so deadly. 
Never had to clean it or tend to it. 
 It was always like a shiny mirror. 
 When it was fired, you could recognize it 
 e'en among a thousand other guns. 

–Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: Make good guns.
Make cheap guns.
Make lots of guns.

events.title: True Aim

events.desc: The rebels in Montenegro have finally been brought to heel.
events.flavor:
What is all this, Montenegrin brothers? 
Who has fanned this ugly flame of discord? 
From where did come this unfortunate thought 
of conversing about changing our faith? 
Aren't we brothers despite differences? 
Didn't we fight the same battles together? 
We share the good and the bad like brothers. 
Doesn't both Turkish and Serbian maidens' hair 
cover in grief the graves of slain heroes? 

–Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: Let this be a lesson to any who resist.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: Punish all … people for Montenegro's sins.
To err is human, to forgive…

events.title: Goliath Slays David

events.desc: … … seeks to forge a nation out of the tribes on the rebellious black mountain.
events.flavor:
Dearest professor... Yes, I am the Bartolomeo Biasoletto who accompanied Augustus II into the region, assisting his botanical studies. But I don't recall much of the Serbian Phoenix Flower. The plants were the least of my concern. I had stepped into a land where women labored in the fields, while the men sharpened their knives and fought – amongst themselves if there was no raid. A Turkish head on a spike was the epitome of architecture, and its gaunt, illiterate, impoverished people thought only of their next meal. 

 The Prince-Bishop himself, under instructions from the Tzar, vacated his own rooms for my King. The man's eyes almost glowed green, such was his envy. I could tell, even then, the young man had aspirations to wrangle together these rebels on the hill, dress their chiefs in something that looked like government, and forge a nation that could shake the world.

options.name: Shake the world, or die trying.

modifiers.label: Radicals and Loyalists from Standard of Living changes

events.title: The State of Montenegro

events.desc: …'s violent and aggressive reputation has forced the Great Powers to withdraw their support. It now must rely on its own strength in forming a Serbian nation.
events.flavor:
The world has now become a hell for me, 
people have turned into hellish spirits. 
O my dark day! O my black destiny! 
O my wretched Serbian nation snuffed out! 
I have outlived many of your troubles, 
yet I must fight against the worst of all! 

 Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: We have everything we need here, in our hearts!
Ok, but would … consider giving our port back?

events.title: Barbarians!

events.desc: Our precious … has been vassalized by … overlords.
events.flavor:
May God strike you, loathsome degenerates,
 why do we need the Turk's faith among us? 
What will you do with your ancestors' curse? 
With what will you appear before Milos 
and before all other Serbian heroes, 
whose names will live as long as the sun shines? 

 Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: We must appeal to other nations.
If you can't beat them, join them.

events.title: Conquered!

events.desc: Our …'s civilized young wife is suggesting we take the severed heads down from the Biljarda.
events.flavor:
"How do they decorate where she comes from, šef?"  
"I don't know, Mirko. Columns and statues and flowers and rubbish like that."  
"Seems dull." 
"Very dull! How's a column help me fight Turks?"  
"Yeah it's very encouraging to point at the Biljarda and say, 'that one, that one was mine.'"  
"Though the smell…"  
"Yeah, better to change 'em with fresh ones."  
"True... The answer is always more heads."

options.name: It is time for … to become civilized.
No! … cannot lose face in front of the men.
If anything, we need to hang more heads.

events.title: Redecorating

events.desc: Our nation has outlasted our greatest enemy. The Ottoman Empire is no more!
events.flavor:
Listen, people, you all take off your caps!
 I want to hold memorial service
 to the souls of
 our nation's great heroes.
 This day will be the most priceless to them. 

 Petar II Petrović-Njegoš, The Mountain Wreath

options.name: Let … become a paradise on Earth.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Full Acceptance Status

options.name: Let us inspire the end of all tyranny!

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Full Acceptance Status
Standard of Living for the Second-class Citizen Status
Standard of Living for the Open Prejudice Status
Standard of Living for the Cultural Erasure Status
Standard of Living for the Violent Hostility Status

options.name: All we know is war.

events.title: … Rapture

events.desc: … … has proposed to officially change our nation to a Kingdom.
events.flavor:
There, over there... beyond those hills,
Lies a green grove, they say,
Under which rises up Holy Dečani:
A prayer said within Paradise claims.

There, over there... beyond those hills,
Where sky of blue bends down her arch;
On to Serb fields, on to battle fields,
There, brothers, prepare to march!
–Nikola I Petrović-Njegoš, Onamo, 'namo!

options.name: Let the people know.
Let all the nations know!
Let the soldiers know.
Let no one know.

events.title: … … or King …

events.desc: Smail-aga Čengić of the … has lured our raiders into an ambush! … …'s own brother lies among our innumerable fallen.

options.name: We will unite in mourning.
Let the dead bury the dead. We must rebuild.

events.title: Death of a Brother

events.desc: Soldiers from the … have arrived to harass our people and cease our raids.
events.flavor:
"A direct charge, son. Fearless, unrelenting. That’s the only way to stop them." 

"Straight into their cannon? With respect, šef, it would be better to draw them into the peaks. Then Cerović can sneak through the pass and raid their baggage train." 

"No. They’ll sack every monastery and farm in their way. The Lord may forgive you for letting that happen, but I won't." 

"Šef, which would you rather bleed, the land or its people?"
