options.name: Meet them head on.
Use the land to our advantage.
It's hopeless! Surrender to the Sublime Porte.

events.title: Ottoman Counterattack

events.desc: Time-honored tribes around the corners of our nation have become increasingly difficult to control. If we don't demonstrate our authority, they might slip out of our grasp.
events.flavor:
"...secondly, asking for that much mahr is somewhat untraditional and quite rude. My nephew is thinking about withdrawing if she insists.

"Ayrad, my old friend, since when do you judge our marriage contracts by the customs of urban people? At my age, I have yet to hear a shaykh lecture fiqh about limits on a bride's demands from the groom."

Seeing the failure of his attempt, Elder Ayrad reconsidered his options.

options.name: They shall face the might of Makhzen.

events.title: Lands of Anarchy

events.desc: All lawless tribes have surrendered to our authority, willingly or not. Our rule over the mainland remains undisputed, allowing us to invest more in these lands.
events.flavor:
The Makhzen is not the only beneficiary of recent changes in Moroccan society. Old hatreds and cultural gaps have mostly disappeared, giving way to new neighbors, shared traditions, and experts in all fields, contributing with an innate disposition to urban life.

Those who refused to be a part of the central crowd and stayed rural have also found communal bliss through modern communication methods provided by the government. Merchants, tax collectors, and armed forces, among others, are safer to roam the lands to carry out their tasks.

options.name: This was a good lesson on coffers and how to fill them.
A civilization is defined by its ways.
Let the light of knowledge shine upon our people.

events.title: Lands of Harmony

events.desc: As we failed to maintain control, several tribes have gone rogue, making them almost unreachable to our authority.
events.flavor:
"...the state did not have complete mastery over its territorial space, making it exceptionally difficult to manage outlying areas, with the countryside presenting a particular set of problems. The cliché of a "tribal mosaic" contains more than a grain of truth.

Molecularized by vast regional differences in terms of climate, language, ethnicity and geography, the rural world was a universe unto itself."

— Prof. Susan Gilson Miller, Cambridge University

options.name: Focus what's left on education.
No matter what happens, we must always build.
Let's at least guard our tax collectors.

events.title: Embedded Chaos

events.desc: Within the last few weeks, the advisors have collected reports regarding connections between several interest groups and certain well-known tribal families.
events.flavor:
The couple, isolated from the hall's conversations, had sincere insecurities, growing up among the uncivilized.

Listening to a dull oud performance, the scent of mint tea and perfumes of royalty brightened their senses as they waited for their sly contact. They had never been whispered to so much compared to city life in recent months.

options.name: The tribes of … are known to fight well.
Who is the most knowledgable alim of …?
Noone knows these lands better than …'s natives.
We are here to govern them, not the other way around.

events.title: Tribal Gesture

events.desc: A plea for our aid has been sent out by a specific tribe in … regarding an incurable pandemic by their means.
events.flavor:
A smoke of despair rises from a central fire of distress, attempting to lure in foreigners for aid.

Recitations of duas believed to ease the pain of the sick from different suffering families can be heard easily through the coughs of the weak, as they ask the Creator for a way out of this test of faith.

Unaffected young men occasionally climb to the nearby dunes to see if a royal party is arriving to bring glad tidings, though so far, there has been no success.

options.name: Do not hesitate.
Let the privileged take the hit.
They have the ways of alternative medicine after all.

events.title: Urban Medicine

events.flavor:
On the …'s Policy

The great speech delivered before the esteemed … Society for Reform in Mid-October.

ERROR IN MAKE UP - After reading first page of speech pass to page 5 and then page 4 and 6.

options.name: We must respect the principle of free expression.
Confiscate this pamphlet wherever it emerges.
Begin an inquiry into the identities of its authors.

events.title: On the Policy of the Government

events.flavor:
"It bears mentioning, then. In the case that we succeed, what are we to do? This structure we are building may endure for generations. To allow it to dissolve would be a tragedy."

"We cannot depend upon all who join to continue to bear the torch going forwards. Our camp contains many people, all with their own reasoning for lending their ears. We must not imply to them that we demand their compliance on any other matter."

options.name: They are harmless at worst.
Send them a firm reminder of our disapproval.
… is a … worth watching.

events.title: The … Reform Society

events.desc: Organizers affiliated with the … have founded an organization devoted to fostering popular participation in politics in the … region.
events.flavor:
"The direct cause of our land's woes," the speaker proclaimed, "is the concentration of power within a class which is predisposed to idleness and conspiracy. It is our duty, then, to collect the efforts of the industrious classes against their manipulations, and bring them to a great moral confrontation - a contest of political truth and right against political despoliation and wrong."

It was a good sentiment, thought one listener, if one was predisposed to charity. If one was not... he dreaded to think of how poorly one could interpret such a conspiracy.

options.name: The people have begun to make themselves heard.
Order this shuttered before it grows out of control.

events.title: The … Political Union

events.desc: Several prominent supporters of the … have approached the government with an ambitious petition to see through their agenda. The petition has been promoted as a necessary starting point amongst the movement's membership.
events.flavor:
There were at least a hundred signatures on the paper, some unintelligibly ornate, others generic names that the official would have to do some incredible feats of deduction to narrow down. This was the benefit of a petition - past a certain point, it became infeasible to punish every signatory.

If one person dissented, it would be easy to scoop them up, but when it was a thousand, things became much more difficult.

options.name: Permit debate on the raised issues.
The formal procedures of government must be upheld.
Order an investigation into this convenient list of names.

events.title: Petitioners Approach Government

events.desc: The … has convened in … to rally support and publicly discuss the specifics of …. The event has attracted much attention from locals.
events.flavor:
"Good to see you again. Did you have a good trip?"

"I did. The roads are dreadful, this time of year. I was very nearly late, in fact... my compliments to my driver."

"Good for him. Worth a raise?"

"I would wish! If my pockets have anything left in them by the time the hat comes around, perhaps."

options.name: What a lively discussion!
Order this interdicted at once.

events.title: The … Citizens' Convention

events.desc: The … has organized mass protests across the … region. While the protests have remained peaceful for now, local authorities have raised concerns about possible violence.
events.flavor: It was more people than he had every seen. …, once quiet and known for an almost pastorial character, had come alive with shouting voices and waving flags. He wondered if any of his neighbors were in that crowd. He had always thought that he shared nothing in common with them. Perhaps he had been wrong.

options.name: Allow them to air their concerns.
The authorities must act to halt these displays.

events.title: Protests Across …

events.flavor:
Sunday: Gathering for …

Meetings at ALL COMMUNITY HOUSES, 7 to 8PM. SHOW YOUR SUPPORT for the JUST CAUSE of …!

Refreshments available at 7:30 for all attendees. Subscribe to the local "Advocate" for further information.

options.name: They will wash away with the rain.
Order these walls cleaned at once.

events.title: Walls and Wheatpaste

events.desc: The arrest and alleged ill treatment of a disorderly protester affiliated with the … has sparked resentment amongst his compatriots. Further demonstrations have been arranged, urging his release.
events.flavor:
Prison was a miserable place. Iron bars, stone walls, and cold floors. In the past few weeks, the guards had taken to casually tapping their batons against the bars when they passed by, making sleep impossible. He could not even escape in his dreams, as the tension he felt in the waking world began to bleed into his sleep as well.

And all this for pushing a policeman away? He had regretted it, at first. Now, though, perhaps he could say that every one of them deserved that, and more.

options.name: Perhaps an early release for good behavior can be arranged.
We will not make exceptions because of some hooligans.

events.title: Behind Bars

events.desc: A wave of workers' strikes inspired by the … have wracked industries in …. Striking workers have joined protests in several cities across the region.
events.flavor: The officer had expected the workers to be different than they were. Unwashed, stained with industrial effluvia, soaked in sweat. They were none of those things. They wore the same clothes they would on the weekends, fresh and clean. There was pride in their eyes. Instead of the cowed expression of exhausted men, they stood defiant, their faces hard, their hands gripping signs that called for the world and more.

options.name: Make it known that we recognize their demands.
Get them back to work!

events.title: Strike Wave in …

events.desc: A demonstration organized by the … in … has been violently dispersed by police, leading to several fatalities and serious injuries. Memories of the incident have become a rallying cry for dissidents.
events.flavor:
He had been smiling, when he ordered his horse through the crowd. His expression was etched in her mind as if by acid on a metal plate. What kind of man could maintain such a hideous serenity amongst the screams, the broken bones, the spurts of blood? As people fled around him, he had ordered his officers forward... and then what?

Amidst the blur of human terror, she had found herself sheltering in a haphazardly shuttered bar. Many others had not been so lucky. When she walked through the place where the demonstration had been held, she could not tell how many of the people sprawled across the flagstones were still moving.

options.name: Censure the officers responsible.
They were ordered to disperse. The police are not to blame.

events.title: Trampled Underfoot

events.desc: An explicitly partisan newspaper founded by members of the … in … has published its first issue. Between advertisements and political cartoons, it hosts ruthless critique of government policy.
events.flavor: There was a certain brilliance to it. By printing it on the cheapest paper, by skimping on ink, by flooding it with advertisements and large text, one could produce a profitable paper for only a penny per copy, whilst its competitors sold for five to ten times that amount. By making that paper relentlessly and shamelessly endorse a certain viewpoint, one could have every working person in their city aware of it by evening. If one's competitors refused to stoop that low, they would become responsible for their own suffocation.

options.name: How long can a partisan paper last?
Is that so? Deny them a printing license.

events.title: The … Advocate

events.desc: A series of perceived poor decisions by the … has led to a notable decrease in its ability to raise money. Numerous wealthy sympathizers have quietly halted their support for the movement in its current form.
events.flavor:
"We do not wish to appear partisan." Always the same refrain. The organizer paced back and forth within his tiny office, fist clenched until it felt as if his knuckles were about to burst through his skin. Occasionally, he stole a glance at the unopened envelopes on his desk, all of which he knew would repeat a variation on the same.

"Partisan" - what did that mean? That they cared for something? That they had chosen to do something beyond count the money in their vaults? He had something important to do, something which would improve society itself. They had a chance to do the same. In that light, how could partisanship possibly be bad?

options.name: Perhaps it will find alternative sources of funds.
Everything dies in the end, some faster than others.

events.title: Empty Pockets

events.desc: Organizers affiliated with the … have embarked on a focused campaign to inspire support for … in ….
events.flavor: Residents of every region in the world like to say that their home has a long and unique history of tight-knit community. The organizer almost agreed. The problem was, of course, was that said community often did not extend to outsiders. He had been thrown out on his ear more times than he could count, but he persisted nonetheless. If he could introduce the right phrase into the right circles, perhaps even an idea that had been rejected out of hand at first would begin to find purchase.

options.name: There are plenty of willing ears in ….
They must be concerned with far more grounded things.

events.title: … Organizes in …

events.desc: A group of students attending the … in … have arranged a demonstration in support of the …. The display has inspired other students to join the cause.
events.flavor: The lecture hall was barren. There were always one or two students missing, for illnesses, travel, or family occasions, but nothing of this scale. There were three or four students per row, each thrown into sharp contast by the empty seats to their sides. It was material for a lecture of its own, he thought. Like a heap of sand whose grains had blown away one after another until its form suddenly changed, so followed what had once been a class.

options.name: The youth will lead … into the future!
They had ought to focus on their studies.

events.title: Students Rally to the …

events.desc: An event organized by the … transformed into a brawl as opponents of the movement infiltrated the crowd. When the police arrived, no participant was willing to give a consistent statement.
events.flavor: Most of them had at least one bruise, a cut lip, or a bloody nose. His was much less honorably obtained than most of theirs. He had whacked his hip against the corner of a table while rushing for the exit, only to nearly run headlong into an approaching gendarme. Two conflicting stories rose to mind. One that he would tell to the detective, and one that he would tell to his friends.

options.name: Give them all a day in jail to cool off.
Seek charges for the event's organizers.

events.title: Contentious Topics

events.desc: In 1835, British agents insisted that … … recognize … … as … heir, despite the …'s wish to name Mirza Salim, … sickly eighth son, as heir apparent. Elements within the court have urged … to contest the decision one last time.
events.flavor: "Look at you!" thundered the courtier, exasperated. "Look at this place! Hundreds of years of power and glory rest here! The blood of Timur courses through your veins! Yet here you sit, meek, and let some agent in Calcutta name your own succession! Are you not an emperor? Great men must do great things!"

options.name: …'s decision is final.
… opinion be damned, Mirza Salim will be the heir.

events.title: Heiring Grievances

events.desc: Delays in the passage of … have caused immense frustration within the court. It is possible to ask for the intercession of … for aid, but that would essentially mean ceding more lawmaking powers to ….
events.flavor: The …'s agent simply stood right there, saying nothing at all while saying everything that needed to be said. … … kept nervously eyeing him while holding the contentious decree in … hands. It would be so simple to ask him a single request! It would cost … nothing—but … knew it would cost the empire everything.

options.name: Ask for a ruling from …
This law is for … and will be made by … alone!

events.title: An Appeal to Interlopers

events.desc: Theoretically, … still controls a number of lucrative territories that can be taxed, but in practice it scarcely has any influence beyond the confines of Delhi. The only way to increase revenues is, much to the embarrassment of the court, to request a higher stipend from …'s coffers. It may be a trifle for …, but it a serious sum for ….
events.flavor:
"Taxes!" … … laughed, "Taxes!" … rocked on … throne, chuckling for a moment more.

… waved at the marble walls around …. "What have we got to tax? Stones?" … shook … head. "No, things here turn to dust, not gold. We need to look elsewhere." … gestured for a scribe. It was time to debase … before … again.

options.name: A stipend is necessary to keep our finances sound.
It is better to be penniless than to be indebted to ….

events.title: Pressing for a Stipend

events.desc: Reformers from … have expressed an interest in our affairs, …'s treatment of us, and the welfare of India more broadly. Engaging with them could get us support in …, but if they are active here they may foster some radical thoughts among our intellectuals.
events.flavor:
The … man shifted nervously, ill at ease under the marble vaults of the audience hall. "I have traveled the breadth of India, …," he began, "and have found that the magnitude of inequity, the sheer callousness of …'s rule"—…'s smile faltered—"calls for the utmost cooperation and support from every willing member of … society to aid the cause of Reform and Emancipation in India."

… … studied the figure before …. He could very well be a potent ally, but it was quite possible he'd simply stir up passions in … with his reformist talk and make matters worse for the government. Was this … man worth the risk?

options.name: Let us encourage contacts with … reformers.
The … cause would create more trouble than it'd solve.
Use … connections to draw attention to our cause in ….

modifiers.label: Weekly Liberty Desire for all Subjects

events.title: The … India Society

events.desc: Through politicking, intrigue, and intervention from on high, … has won its freedom from …. … is awhirl with festivities, celebrating … …'s rule.
events.flavor:
"Sir, look! Goodness and faith, fidelity and love, have all returned to this blessed land!" cried the aspiring poet.

An old man in the audience smiled weakly as the youth bounded through his composition. It was all well and good that … was free, but he knew the realm was still far from safe. Fathers and sons were at each other's throats, brother fought brother, and unity was undermined across India.

Still, he mused, shifting on the cushions as the bard continued to drone, despite this ominous air, doomsday had not come, and the last trumpet hadn't sounded. Who knew who held the reins of the final catastrophe, after all? Better to celebrate what joys there were now than to worry about all that.

options.name: All of India shall be welcomed in the new ….
King of Kings, Most Mighty of Sovereigns, we will remember you!
The flame of ambition, long smoldering, now roars!
Now is the time to fix all that … left to rot.

events.title: The Peacock Throne Flies the Coop

events.desc: The efforts of the … state to foster national fervor have led to a cultural renaissance. Even in the remotest villages of …, our citizens now understand their place as part of the … nation.
events.flavor:
The census-taker watched as the door to the hut swung open. It was the most remote village he had yet visited, a place of two horses and a single winding road. A man stood in the doorway, and crisply saluted at the sight of his brass buttons.

"What is your name?"

"…," answered the man in the doorway.

"And where are you from?"

"I am a …, sir, like my father and his father before him."

options.name: Long live the … people!
A great nation deserves a great army.

events.title: The … Revival

events.desc: … on the payroll of the government have founded village schools across the countryside of …. These village schools seek to increase literacy rates and foster a sense of … national identity amongst the peasantry.
events.flavor:
"Our nation has had bad luck," the teacher began. "It has not yet been completely united. In these lands, our people are dependent on foreigners."

She indicated towards the map on the wall, at the several regions shaded in black.

"In these provinces, the foreigner rules, and it is very difficult for our brothers..."

options.name: An excellent initiative.
Offer them additional funding.

events.title: Village Schooling

events.desc: A recently-released compilation of traditional … poems and songs has captivated …'s increasingly literate populace. A well-read copy of … may now be found on every bookshelf in ….
events.flavor:
The print-shop had never been so busy. Workers bearing palls of warm paper bustled to the stations at which they would be glued and bound in leather. In the back, the vast presses churned out page after page, each decorated with elegant knotwork and images of flowers. This stack of fifty was bound for …, this for …. Letters from private individuals and book-sellers alike were stacked atop a counter, awaiting entry into the ledger.

A shout rang out from the front, from which a man in uniform has just departed. "An order from the Ministry - they want two hundred by Friday!

options.name: A work to bind our nation together.
A toast to our luminaries!

events.title: The National Epic

events.desc: The famed scholar … has translated the New Testament into the … language. The growing corpus of …-language works has spurred an increase in the language's prestige amongst priests and intellectuals.
events.flavor:
"I've ordered a copy of the Principia in …, and one of my colleagues has requested a full Bible in the same. If we can have one work of merit translated per year, and each translation done by a student that goes on to teach others, we shall have a sizable corpus by the end of the century. Far more than that, if the suppliers recognize the demand."

"An ambitious undertaking, indeed. Do you believe you could manage to change the department over?"

"I dream of a future where our language is one that others desire to learn - where a Swede may request essays from a … publisher. And, furthermore, I dream that one of my own students shall be the author of those essays."

options.name: Soon, all of Europe will publish in …!
We must strive to produce original works as well.

events.title: In Vernacular

events.desc: Inspired by the rising tide of … nationalism, the … … has recently produced a magnificent romanticist painting portraying our nation's founding myth.
events.flavor:
The personification of the … nation stood in the foreground, clad in robes and bearing a … flag. A broken chain leading into the shadow of the inglorious past trailed from her ankle. In the background lay a background of a beauty that could only be found in …, lit by a radiant rising sun whose light shone in the national colors.

It bore a message that anyone could understand, yet few could replicate. Out of the dark past, a radiant new spring. Out of oppression, freedom.

options.name: A work to surpass the masterpieces of Paris.
Let this become the newest symbol of our nation.

events.title: National Romanticism

events.desc: The search for a shared national identity has turned the interests of the … to the countryside. Studying the traditions of the … is widely seen as a glimpse into a primordial … culture, untouched by foreign rule.
events.flavor:
"They say Alexander the Great was the first …. That when his empire splintered, his generals formed the first … kingdoms."

"Is that so?"

"That they say it, or that it's true?"

"The latter."

"There's no difference, is there? If enough people say it, we will make it true."

options.name: So grow the seeds of the nation.
We have much to learn from the real country.

events.title: Folklore

events.desc: The state's efforts to define the nation by a shared … identity have spurred a feeling of alarm amongst its … population. Many … people fear that they will be forced to assimilate into the dominant culture.
events.flavor:
"If he wishes to graduate, he is to learn the … language, and pass an exam written in …. We cannot make allowances at this time."

The woman replied in …. Her son, an apologetic look on his face, relayed her statement in the official's own language.

"And what of learning …? There are many of us here, and that is what we speak at home. Without … classes, he will forget it once he leaves home, and lose all connection to his family."

"My advice to you, madam, is to learn …. You are a … citizen, are you not?"

options.name: They must, indeed, become ….
There is nothing for them to be afraid of.

events.title: One Nation, One People

events.desc: … … has defied the ruling of the Supreme Court and ordered the removal of the … people to the ….
events.flavor: "What does the Supreme Court's opinion matter? All we need to do is build a fire under them, and when it gets hot enough, they'll move, and what's ours will be ours."

options.name: Is that even legal?

events.title: Worcester v. Georgia

events.desc: Chief John Ross, one of the principal … chiefs, has presented a petition to Congress asking them to void the treaty which will compel the … nation to relocate to the …. His petition has almost as many signatures as the entire eastern Cherokee population.
events.flavor: "By the stipulations of this treaty, we are stripped of every attribute of freedom. Our property may be plundered before our eyes; violence may be committed on our persons, even our lives may be taken away, and there is none to regard our complaints. We are denationalized; we are disfranchised. We are deprived of membership in the human family!"

options.name: A treaty is a treaty. We cannot rescind what we have signed.

rewards.name: Rejected the Petition of John Ross

options.name: Our conscience compels us to void the removal treaty.

rewards.name: Accepted the Petition of John Ross

events.title: John Ross' Protest Petition

events.desc: In accordance with the removal treaty, it is time for the … of … to relocate to the …. Some holdouts refuse to leave their homes, and many are poorly equipped for the journey.
events.flavor: "My friends, circumstances render it impossible that you can flourish in the midst of our community. You have but one remedy within your reach, and that is to remove west. And the sooner you do this, the sooner you will commence your career of improvement and prosperity."

options.name: Coerce them by bayonet-point.
Offer some assistance for their journey.

events.title: The Indian Removal

events.desc: Our efforts to remove the … from eastern lands has led to the deaths of many during their overland march westward.
events.flavor: "Measles, cholera, starvation—this removal has created a trail of tears and death for our people."

options.name: We did what we could.
Their blood is on our hands.

events.title: The Trail of Tears

events.desc: The removal of the … to the … is complete. For good or ill, the matter is settled.
events.flavor: "Who lived here before us? What name did they give to this place? Will any of us know? Does anyone still remember?"

options.name: Let us pray that this shall never happen again.

events.title: The Clearing of the East

events.desc: With the passing of the … Law, the Indian Removal Act is annulled and the … people are free to live on their ancestral lands.
events.flavor:
Some bard shall lift a voice in praise of thee,
In moving numbers tell the world how men
Scoffed thee, hissed thee, charged with lunacy!
And who could not give 'nough honor when
At length, in spite of jeer, of want and need,
Thy genius shaped a dream into a deed.

options.name: Great suffering has been averted.

events.title: The Cherokee Nation

events.desc: Our victory in Florida has compelled the … people to surrender their last refuges to the government. Now is the time to build a new future for these vast lands.
events.flavor: They fled deeper into the swamp, among the marl prairie and the cypress trees. The Bluecoats thought they'd all left, but they were wrong. Someday, they hoped, it would be safe to live outside of this sweltering shelter. For now, they lived.

options.name: The Treaty of Payne's Landing is fulfilled at last.

events.title: The Seminole Peace

events.desc: The notion of 'natural borders' has become popular among supporters of the … regime. French patriots demand the expansion of the … state into bordering regions.
events.flavor: "The limits of France are marked by nature. We will reach the edge of the horizon, from the banks of the …, to the mountains of …, to the coast of …. The boundaries of our nation must be there."

options.name: Our borders must reach the Rhine.
This is an absurd notion.

events.title: The Limit of the Nation

events.desc: With … now extending to the far corners of the Rhine and Alps, we have achieved what champions of this project have termed our 'natural borders'. We must now administer our newly-acquired territories.
events.flavor:
The Rhenish official greeted the newcomer. Plenty of folks were coming from further west nowadays. He pulled out his form and began writing.
"Yes, herr—err, monsieur. Your name, please?"
"Jean Robert."
"Your age?"
"Thirty-one."
"Occupation?"
"Ah non, mon ami! Just visiting."

options.name: They must learn to be French.
Glory to the heroes of …!
We are the liberators of Gaul.

events.title: The Natural Borders of France

events.flavor: "The most powerful motives of political necessity, the exigencies of the future of Italy, the sentiment of gratitude towards our powerful ally, and, finally, the exceptional circumstances of our country, have decided, although with regret, our beloved … to separate the provinces which have been for so many centuries intimately bound up with our nation. All opposition should fall powerless before the interests of the country and the sentiment of duty."

options.name: Incorporate Savoy post-haste.
Conduct a plebiscite to assuage the people.

events.title: The Treaty of Turin

events.desc: … has announced its ambitions to extend its borders from Savoy to the Rhine. This puts … in considerable danger of invasion.

options.name: Muster every able man to defend their homes.
Perhaps appeasement is the best approach.

events.title: The Watch on the Rhine

events.desc: … has wisely agreed to our terms for the purchase of …. The territory has returned to its rightful place as part of the … nation.
events.flavor: The remarkable things one can do with money—purchase land, silence critique, hire labor—are limitless with the right mindset. With enough of it, one might purchase a country.

options.name: A natural extension of our borders.

events.title: The Purchase of Luxembourg

events.desc: With the signing of a new Rheinbundakte under … supervision, a … has once more coalesced out of the disparate German states.
events.flavor: In the face of an uncertain future, unity is a ready medicine for the myriad threats at our door. This river—our life, our home, our very heart!—should be our example as we march into a new era. We will move as one to a greater end. We shall raise and feed each other until that end. And should we be beset by slings and arrows, we shall find shelter within its bosom.

options.name: … power expands ever Eastwards.
A new dawn for Germany.

events.title: The Second Rheinbundakte

events.desc: An earthquake has hit the state of …, destroying buildings, injuring people and even taking some lives.
events.flavor: "It felt like the whole world was ending. Luckily none of us were hurt, but our house was destroyed."

options.name: The state will have to figure it out on their own.
We should put some more money into relief.

events.title: The … Earthquake

events.desc: The local river banks have burst in … destroying homes and taking lives.
events.flavor: "The banks had been swelling for days, but we didn't expect the deluge last night. We weren't prepared."

options.name: The state will have to figure it out on their own.
We should put some more money into relief.

events.title: The … Flood

events.desc: The river banks have burst all across the state of …, destroying homes and taking lives on an unprecedented scale.
events.flavor: "It swept away everything: homes, belongings and of course lives. How can one calculate the sum of this tragedy?"

options.name: The state will have to deal with it on their own.
We should put some more money into relief.

events.title: The Great … Flood

events.desc: The state of … has been reduced to ruins by an earthquake of unprecedented scale. Countless buildings have been destroyed and the amount of lives lost is impossible to tell.
events.flavor: "We thought the world was ending when it happened and we weren't exactly wrong. Whole towns destroyed, entire families lost. It'll never be the same here."

options.name: The state will have to deal with it on their own.
We should put some more money into relief.

events.title: The Great … Earthquake

events.desc: The state of … has been struck by a blight. Crops are dying left and right and the harvest is sure to be less than expected this year.
events.flavor: "We noticed some crops dying a few weeks ago, but we didn't think anything of it. We always lose a few. We didn't expect this."

options.name: This will affect the harvest.
We will help how we can.

events.title: The … Crop Failure

events.desc: A cyclone has hit the state of … from the sea, tearing through homes and people alike.
events.flavor: "It destroyed our home and wrecked my fishing boat. My family might be safe but how am I going to feed them?"

options.name: A tragedy, but what can be done?
We should put some more money into relief.

events.title: The … Cyclone

events.desc: A violent eruption has shaken the state of …. Fragments of tephra and volcanic ash have destroyed buildings and crops, taking some of the lives of our people.
events.flavor: "The dense column of smoke was followed by a clear explosion. Shepards who worked at the base of the mountain aimlessly turned their eyes at the now bright and clear cloud. The landslide came after."

options.name: We cannot predict an eruption.
Our people need us!

events.title: The … Eruption

events.desc: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many in the state of …. The explosion could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the mountain was immediately devastated.
events.flavor:
"And the day was made night. Those enormous waterfalls of fire cascading down the mountainside. A black cloud, gargantuan, all the birds have long abandoned this field.

Years from now I will sit by the fireplace and the light will disturb me no more."

options.name: Unfortunately, we have no funds to allocate.
We absolutely need to help these people.

events.title: The … Great Eruption

events.desc: … has successfully deployed our impressive dreadnoughts in the ongoing conflict, proving that they are not mere vanity projects for the navy.
events.flavor: "At first, onlookers were shocked, as it appeared from a distance that the ship itself had exploded. In fact, the flames engulfing it were from its first full broadside. The ship itself was  quite unharmed, although I have heard later that it is inadvisable to keep any fragile objects on board for such an occasion."

options.name: More impressive now than ever.
Now we know how to use them effectively, even in peacetime.

events.title: Guns and Steam

events.desc: … has made use of destroyer ships in the ongoing conflict, teaching us much about how they are best utilized.
events.flavor:
"So I understand 'Torpedo Boat Destroyer' is the more accurate name?"

"Not at all. I believe they can be designed to destroy all kinds of things."

options.name: No one will dare to attack our convoys now!
They make up an important part of our fleets.

events.title: Destroyer and Protector

events.desc: …'s use of battleships during the ongoing war has demonstrated that these massive constructions may still serve a purpose in modern naval warfare.
events.flavor:
The young girl looked wide-eyed at the ship floating in the harbor.

"It looks like it took all the world's steel to build! How many such boats are there?"

"Of this immensity, only one," the admiral replied, "but you can be sure that as soon as our enemies find out about it, there will be two, miss."

options.name: Their presence will be a compelling argument.
By their might we will rule the seas!
We will put this tactical experience to good use.

events.title: Giants of the Seas

events.desc: Our growing use of submarines in warfare has created a new generation of commanders, exemplified by the likes of …, who understand the nature of underwater warfare very well.
events.flavor: "The sea is infinite, and yet we merely bob along its surface, oblivious of the depths below. Can you imagine the power in our hands if we could turn that vast abyss into our own domain, and strike the fools on the surface whenever we chose?"

options.name: Our submarines shall strangle our foes!
Learn how to defend ourselves from these vessels.
Promote …'s skills as a commander.
Promote … as the dashing hero of a new age.

events.title: Supreme Submarines

events.desc: A prominent proponent of naval air power, …, has orchestrated a series of naval exercises, effectively bombing derelict hulks from high above with aircraft launched from other ships.
events.flavor: "No ship can escape the devastation of aircraft attacking from above—the most effective naval munition of the future shall be a bomb from from the skies, not a shell blasted from a deck. This exercise has shown beyond a shadow of a doubt that planes shall be the sword and the shield of tomorrow's navy."

options.name: No navy shall be as advanced as ours!
That officer has embarrassed the service! Fire ….
… could advance … cause better in government.

events.title: The Bombing Demonstration

options.name: Place their members in administrative positions.
Commit to increasing the size of the army.
Vow to pass … next.
Perchance if we invested in more ….
We must invest in ….
Lowering taxes could help the economy.
Let's add some fine print about ….
Vow to improve the lives of the common people.
These offers are not in …'s interest.

events.desc: The … wish to strengthen our ties to … through our shared faith.
events.flavor:
He stopped for a moment, wiping his brow, when he noticed the … farmhand on the adjacent field seemed to be knelt down in the furrow.

Confused, he peered over, finally noticing that the man was deep in prayer. He should have recognized it, but it had never crossed his mind what they might have in common: A few hard years and a faith that things would get better.

options.name: Despite differences, we must cherish our shared values.
We are … first, … second!

events.title: Faith Knows No Borders

events.desc: The … suggest a more hardline foreign policy towards … due to our poor relations.
events.flavor:
"If half of what you're saying is true, I wouldn't want you anywhere near that border," she said, "but I don't think it is."
"Mother, you've always said not to trust the …. Why would you trust them to respect our borders? No one wants their son to do it, because they know it's dangerous. That's exactly why we need to do it."

options.name: Set aside polite formalities. They are the enemy.
Despite our mutual dislike, there is no need to escalate this.

events.title: If You Want Peace

events.desc: Internationalist sentiment within the … has generated suggestions to reach out to workers in ….
events.flavor:
"I don't understand how you could let someone like him into our home. Are we to host people from all four corners of the world now?"
"This man has my life in his hands every day in the mine. I already trust him with my life. For that matter, I'd much rather welcome him here than any of the … bastards who send us down there.

options.name: Class above nation!
These unpatriotic ideas will fade.

events.title: Workers of the World

events.desc: … … are interested in making investments in neighboring … industries.
events.flavor:
He stood up, put on his hat and headed towards the door. At first it seemed he would leave without another word, but then he turned around and spoke with barely suppressed anger.
"Being accused of lacking patriotism for where I try to make money isn't just insult. It betrays a complete lack of understanding of how money is made. Do you think I made what I already have by thinking provincially?"

options.name: An excellent investment!
Strong-arm them into investing domestically.

events.title: Cross-Border Investments

events.desc: A newspaper banned under … law has started being printed again under the permissive laws of … and smuggled across the border.
events.flavor:
"You still have your copy, right? I'll pay you half of what you gave for it in …."
Her friend reluctantly handed over the paper.
"You know, my dad says it's all rubbish, what it says about the …."
"Yeah. Well, he can't read, can he?"

options.name: We can look the other way, just this once.
Crack down hard on everyone spreading this filth!

events.title: Stop the Presses

events.desc: A book rejected for publication in … due to their restrictive laws has been accepted by a … publisher.
events.flavor:
The printer's devil picked up an unfamiliar typeface. His master noticed his curiosity and nodded towards it.
"That's for a … book we're printing."
"Why are we printing … books here?"
The printer shrugged.
"It's a free country."

options.name: The publisher should show more tact and respect our neighbors.
By the laws of …, they have the right to print it.

events.title: …, Unredacted

events.desc: People have been complaining about the difference in living standards between us and our neighbors in ….
events.flavor:
After the shop door swung shut, they exchanged a meaningful glance.

"She didn't even notice you gave her the wrong change."

"Why do you think I do it? Her sort, they can afford it. I'll be damned if the … think they can come here and flaunt their wealth expecting us to just tolerate it."

options.name: This is simply an example of global economic inequality.
Clearly, they are liars who cheat foreigners out of money.
It is the way things are, not worth thinking about.

events.title: The Other Side of the Fence

events.desc: Despite many attempts to navigate it, the full course of this river remains a mystery. Shall we send an expedition to attempt to plot the course of the river?
events.flavor:
"Members of the Trade Societies have expressed their interest in promoting a "New Africa" policy, based on an increased commerce, and the divulgation of … values in the land.

They have emphasized the necessity of plotting the Niger River for its use as a commercial avenue, and have proposed an expedition for the cause."

options.name: I know the person for the job.

events.title: Expedition to Plot the Niger River

events.desc: A group of strong candidates have expressed their interest in leading the expedition. However, this is not a decision we should make lightly.
events.flavor: The first to arrive was a well-dressed, fresh-faced, almost young gentleman whose keenness to impress was only matched by his willingness to oblige. His smile, as wide as one can imagine, was fashionably put together: "If I may...," he politely said, presenting his credentials.
events.title: Choosing a Leader

events.desc: After a few weeks of preparation and travel, the expedition to plot the course of the River Niger led by … has arrived at their starting point.
events.flavor: "The tide was low, so early in the morning. Our steamboat slowed its pace as the first glimpses of vegetation carbuncled among the port buildings like modest emeralds. The salt-filled air was gently replaced by grains of paradise, anise seeds, cloves. On one of the roofs, a young girl dried her laundry."

options.name: Onward!

events.title: The Expedition Embarks

events.desc: … has returned triumphantly, the course and termination of the Niger River has been plotted.
events.flavor:
"I had always imagined I'd feel an immense happiness. A happiness so bright and loud that you'd be able to almost hear it. All the rivers converge here. Maybe I was expecting a torrent of water, a force so obvious that couldn't be ignored.

But the Niger diverged in smaller streams, almost losing its identity. Which one was the real river? Wouldn't all of them be the real rivers? Perhaps none. As the ship of Theseus, when does a thing stop being a thing?"

options.name: Excellent news!

events.title: Successful Expedition

events.desc: After not receiving any reports for many months, it has become clear that your expedition to find the source of the Niger River has failed and … has been lost along with it.
events.flavor: "I think that deep down we all knew this was coming. Even now, we still talk about getting to the mouth of the river. "Just a few more days," we tell ourselves and we keep going. At first, some men commented on the rationed food. They've stopped talking about it now. We've long lost the river. "Just a few more days.""

options.name: Blast!

events.title: Failed Expedition

events.desc: One member of the expedition has suggested that we stop at some of the nearby settlements and try to hire some local guides. Other members of the group have expressed concerns this might take a while.
events.flavor: "The flatlands extended as far as our eyes could reach. There was no possible mountain or elevation where our fatigued expedition would stop and find its way. Nothing—and then the jungle. Always the jungle. Sometimes the river (sometimes). And then the jungle. Viridian silk; the appetizing, prismatic sheen of wet flowers over forgotten streams."

options.name: Excellent idea.
No, it will take too long.

events.title: Local Guides

events.desc: After a few hours, some guides have been found and payment has been settled on.
events.flavor:
"The guides seem to know what they're doing. More importantly, where they're going."

"Keen observation, and one my young boy could make. What was their asking price? Gold? Provisions? Golden provisions?"

"Well, sir, er... they didn't have any. They were going that way anyhow."

options.name: Great news.

events.title: Local Guides Found

events.desc: Not a second passed two hours did it dawn on … …'s navigator that they were utterly, irrevocably lost. An eager footman then quickly put forth the idea of abandoning the search for local guides in favor of finding the river bank again.
events.flavor: "A terrible idea through and through."

options.name: This will set us back.

events.title: Local Guides Not Found

events.desc: In the night a member of the expedition fell off the boat. We could spend time looking for them, or we could move on.
events.flavor:
"The screams came first. Then the drowning. And that long and succulent stain on the water. Red as strawberry syrup or the last moments of dawn, when the horizon is clear and the clouds look like worn out bandages.

"I'm not a very good swimmer, you know?," he had looked over the river with a crooked smile, days ago, "good it's almost over"."

options.name: Tell them to push on.
Find him!

events.title: Expedition Member Drowns

events.desc: The latest report from the expedition informs us that several of the crew have come down with malaria.
events.flavor: "At dawn, they weren't there. Most of our men were still in their tents, and the few that came to me were too afraid to even approach them. "They've got the illness, …." The befog air around their silhouettes made me think of a ghost. Their pale faces shivered with fever, and there was nothing in their voices that seemed remotely alive."

options.name: Tell them to push on.
Tell them to rest for a while.

events.title: Expedition Beset by Malaria

events.desc: While the expedition is traveling by river they are attacked by locals.
events.flavor:
"Careful, …!" A sharp sound deafened the noise of the crew. An arrow was now trembling, stuck in the wooden wall just next to my head. "Down! Everybody down!"

A line of men stood at the edge of the jungle, like guardian statues they held spears and bows, pointed directly at us. Their careful movements, that slow shuffle there—we had trespassed their limits. "Down!," I heard the men shout."

options.name: Stand and fight.
Run!

events.title: Attack on the River

events.desc: The expedition manages to successfully defend from the attack.
events.flavor: "Recover! Hm... it seems their crude weapons were no match for our firepower. Let us not rest on our laurels yet. Two men, set to cleaning the powder out of our weapons. I want another three on watch, and the remainder to prepare our position for another visit from the riff-raff."

options.name: Good work.

events.title: Successful Defense

events.desc: The expedition fails to defend from the attack and has to retreat.
events.flavor: "You! You're the fastest runner we have. Get to the nearest sea port and prepare the following letter for the …. We came under spontaneous attack from ambushers of an unknown enemy. We attempted to shy them away from us, but there were too many. We lost several men before we could finally get away down the river. Their names are as follows..."

options.name: Damn shame.

events.title: Failed Defense

events.desc: The expedition leaves the area as quickly as it can.
events.flavor: "We rushed to get out of there, took a fork in the river, it wasn't the right way but it was the safe way."

options.name: At least everyone is alive.

events.title: Tactical Retreat

events.desc: A member of the expedition has requested that they pause for a day, so that they can film some of the local wildlife.
events.flavor: "Muddy houses emerged like chocolate puddings extracted directly from the river. Streams braided like a young girl's long hair; marshes, large lakes. The greenery of the riverside covered their silhouettes like a layer of diaphanous mint. Water was everywhere—our own private ocean."

options.name: Good idea.
We can't spare the time.

events.title: Expedition Film

events.desc: The latest report from the expedition is that several of the crew have come down with cases of dysentery. One member has even died.
events.flavor:
"We can barely make any progress with half the expedition in and out the bushes every quarter hour. We ought to leave them and continue."

"Leave them? Only our batman, farrier, navigator, tailor, cobbler, two riflemen and three oarsmen left behind? And how do you plan to brew your tea when you dare not touch water?"

"Your point is well seen."

options.name: Tell them to push on.
Tell them to rest for a while.

events.title: Dysentery in the Expedition

events.desc: A hippopotamus has been sighted further along the river. It might be safer to wait for it to move on than to try to row past it.
events.flavor: "It's rotund appearance may imply a jolly nature, but don't be fooled, the Hippo is a vicious beast."

options.name: We will try to go past it.
We will wait.

events.title: Hippopotamus Sighted

events.desc: The earlier sighted hippo has rammed one of the expedition boats, flipping it. Two crew members died and some supplies were lost.
events.flavor: "It happened so fast. The monster flipped the boat like it was nothing. Some were lucky, others less so."

options.name: Oh dear.

events.title: Hippopotamus Attacks

events.desc: The hippo did not move as we continued down river, and we managed to pass on without incident. Its eyes apathetic to our presence.
events.flavor:
"What a magnificent creature. Tell me, would that have been a glint of ivory I spied in its mandibles?""

"Its teeth have value and use, if that is an answer you're looking for."

"Just so! Rifles, to me. I will have the next hippopotamus head that I spy. And aim low: don't spoil the mouth."

options.name: Thank goodness.

events.title: Hippopotamus Sleeps

events.desc: The expedition waited for a few hours, and eventually the Hippo moved on.
events.flavor: "This little distraction cost us our daylight though, we'll have to make camp here."

options.name: What a relief.

events.title: Hippopotamus Leaves

events.desc: The expedition comes across some graves dug at the side of the river. The trinkets and items left atop them indicate it is all that remains of a previous expedition.
events.flavor:
"A small framed picture of a kid, covered in dirt. A familiar name engraved in the back. A reliquary with a lock of fair hair. Some pages of a journal that we kindly avoided reading. A letter. Maybe we should take it. It's not finished. One of the men speaks softly, "that man I knew." He takes it and folds it into his pocket.

Even here I can still hear their lively, vibrant voices. "We shall find the source in less than one month!" Yes, even here."

options.name: Even in Arcadia, It is still here.

events.title: Grave of the Fallen

events.desc: Word arrives from the expedition that several of the members including … have been kidnapped by a local king who is demanding a ransom.
events.flavor:
"A light in the night rarely is a good sign. The medieval imagination that made those people speak of  will-o'-the-wisps, ignis fatuus, dangerous creatures leading them into death wasn't mistaken.

The torch became a lantern, and the lantern became a man. The man became a dozen and soon after they were holding us captives. The metal of their guns also shined in the night, we couldn't oppose them, not in those conditions."

options.name: We will pay.
They will need to figure it out.

events.title: Kidnapped

events.desc: After organizing the payment of the ransom, the expedition crew is released unharmed and even sent in the correct direction.
events.flavor: "It wasn't the most pleasant experience, but we dined on roasted yams, and were generally well treated."

options.name: Excellent.

events.title: Kidnapped Crew Released

events.desc: Despite not paying the ransom, a few members of the expedition have managed to secure their freedom. However many more of the crew were left behind.
events.flavor: "We waited in cold cells of wet stone. They fed us without saying a word, and then left before we could even try to bribe them. When the darkest hours came, they started a fight. One of our men said they were arguing about the night shift. And money. When the door opened again, we finally made our escape."

options.name: Unfortunate.

events.title: Kidnapped Crew Escapes

events.desc: During a small skirmish, a musket ball embedded itself in … leg. The wound itself was fine but the infection wasn't. … has taken over as the new leader.
events.flavor:
"The warmth took me by surprise. So did the pain. I couldn't walk after the shot, and I knew I wouldn't walk later, either. This is the last chance I have to write about what I've done. Like Marco Polo I lay on my bed speaking of invisible cities, immortal wonders; what I have seen no one will believe. That saddens me. As a sane man, I shall stop my pen.

The jungle may take you by surprise, just like the bullet, but wise as you have become, says the poet, you'll finally understand what the journey means."

options.name: Lets hope the new leader is competent.

events.title: Death of a Leader

events.desc: At their arrival to a village by the riverside, one of its habitants quickly runs to the expedition, mumbling something about "one of their kind".

options.name: We found him!
He seems happy here.
Taking him with us would be a risk to our expedition.

events.title: Dr. …, I Presume

events.desc: As the expedition encounters a group of suspicious traders, one of the men claims to be a … ambassador, kidnapped by these "mercenaries".
events.flavor:
"Their hands were stained with the color of earth, grass, and rusty blood. Their faces smiled when they saw us, and I looked at my men with a severe expression—no man smiles this deep in the jungle.

One of them approached us, spoke in a foreign language that one of our younger boys could recognize, "they're merchants," he said, "they want to know if we want to sell anything." "Explorers?," another voice shouted, coarse, desperate, "These men kidnapped me months ago! Thieves, mercenaries, criminals! I'm the … ambassador! Free me from this treacherous fate!"

options.name: We need to get this man to safety.
How do we know he's not lying?

events.title: An Unexpected Guest

events.desc: When reaching one of the enclaves, a letter was waiting for …, stating that his fiancee back in … has married another man.
events.flavor: "Oh, how sorrowful the heart and heavy the mind! This traitor has bewitched my intelligence and poisoned my soul! Oh, how miserable! Oh, how desperate! If the gods of fate are fair and just they will get this despicable woman her well deserved end!"

options.name: Let the man mourn.
He'll find another one.

events.title: Bad News

events.desc: One of the expedition members has been caught stealing more provisions than needed under the excuse that he's ill and needs more food.
events.flavor:
"Rations had started to run low, and rumors and mistrust were spreading among the group. One of the men accused another one of stealing bread and beans, sneaking out in the middle of the night. "Sir!," he cried, his face yellow and slender, "I needed the food! My body was starting to falter and I couldn't follow the rhythm of long marches into the jungle."

However, many were the men who were suspiciously doubting his words.

options.name: We need every single man.
A thief is of no use to us.

events.title: Among Us

events.desc: After hearing about the many perils that the expedition was facing, and its little progress, word has been sent from … that the mission must immediately return.
events.flavor:
"Those snotty bureaucrats comfortably sitting in their oaken desks, smoking cigars and drinking old whiskey, only worried about which form they'll be sending their next victim, to what infernal odyssey of never ending paperwork they'll be subjecting them to.

A letter arrived at noon: "Mr …, we've been informed that your expedition hasn't been achieving our expected results...," God knows that if I could burn it, I'll immediately do so. I'm prepared to go anywhere, provided it be forward!"

options.name: This is a waste of time.
We cannot go back now!

events.title: An Insolvent Business

events.desc: An anti-clerical and anti-monarchist movement known as Nihilism has taken hold among the …. Led by …, these dangerous thinkers are sure to be a thorn in the side of the status quo.
events.flavor:
"They are an affront to all that is righteous about our nation! All that escapes their lips is treason of the highest order! Never before have we seen such brazen disregard for our divine right to rule. They are the greatest possible threat to society."

"Do not worry, my liege, these men are nihilists. There's nothing to be afraid of."

options.name: Perhaps they have a point.
This is treason! Heresy!
The state must ban Nihilist literature.

events.title: Nihilism

events.desc: The rigorous suppression of the nihilist movement has finally borne fruit, as the word "nihilism" becomes nothing but an obscenity once more.
events.flavor:
"Your worst sin is that you have destroyed and betrayed yourself for nothing."

—Fyodor Dostoevsky, Crime and Punishment

options.name: They were more trouble than they had any right to be.
Use this to reassert our control over the academia.

events.title: Nothing Ends

events.desc: The conflict within the nihilist movement has finally led it to burn itself out, but the spirit of radicalism is not gone. Former nihilists have flocked to other radical movements in droves.
events.flavor:
"...you think I am attacking them for talking nonsense? Not a bit! I like them to talk nonsense. That's man's one privilege over all creation. Through error you come to the truth! I am a man because I err! You never reach any truth without making fourteen mistakes and very likely a hundred and fourteen. And a fine thing, too, in its way; but we can't even make mistakes on our own account! Talk nonsense, but talk your own nonsense, and I'll kiss you for it. To go wrong in one's own way is better than to go right in someone else's."

— Fyodor Dostoevsky, Crime and Punishment

options.name: Only a taste of the conflict to come.
Let them fade into the past.

events.title: Into Oblivion

events.desc: A popular member of the …  … has released a novel condemning the trend of nihilistic excess amongst the youth. The main character, professing vocal nihilism, bears a resemblance to ….
events.flavor:
"The fact is that previously they were simply dunces and now they've suddenly become nihilists."

—Ivan Turgenev, Fathers and Sons

options.name: At least one of them has some sense.
Isn't the main character dashing, though?

events.title: Condemnations of the Children

events.desc: Students embracing the aesthetic and attitude of nihilism have become more and more common at … …, and numerous parties have raised concerns about radicalism in academia.
events.flavor:
"The tiny space I occupy is so infinitely small in comparison with the rest of space, in which I am not, and which has nothing to do with me; and the period of time in which it is my lot to live is so petty beside the eternity in which I have not been, and shall not be... And in this atom, this mathematical point, the blood is circulating, the brain is working and wanting something... Isn't it loathsome? Isn't it petty?"

—Ivan Turgenev, Fathers and Sons

options.name: The only education these people deserve is from the school of hard knocks!
This is a matter for university authorities.

events.title: Black Coats and Feuerbach

events.desc: A woman affiliated with the … of the … has angrily reported an incident of a group of students refusing to stand aside for her on the side of the road, and teasing her as she walked by.
events.flavor:
"Have you no respect at all?"

"What does it matter if your skirts must trail in the snow? Their worth is the same whether they're stained or not—the same value as any such garment."

"The authorities will hear of this!"

The sneers of the students with their shaggy hair and black coats followed her as she hurried away, red-faced.

options.name: How far can these nihilists' depravity go?
Hardly a matter for the legal system.

events.title: A Deficit of Respect

events.desc: In visiting … …, … has stirred up an impressive crowd of students, and disrupted the activities of several people affiliated with the ….
events.flavor:
The performer on the soapbox turned their attention to several unlucky souls in the clothing of the upper class, and stretched out an arm.

"See them as they walk by, those agents of nefarious superstition? Yes, see how they hide their faces in shame? The truth is that they're no better than any one of us!"

options.name: Enough with this nonsense! Break up the demonstration.
We cannot deny it was a good show.

events.title: Chaos on the Courtyard

events.desc: A group of nihilist students has carried out an obscene and outlandish protest in front of a church, prompting demands by the … to halt these activities by force.
events.flavor:
The vicar, standing outside to sweep the path to the entryway of his church, could only stare in shock as the exultant students dressed as clergy untied and flung their frocks into the air. Dark cloth formed brief clouds in the air. At the sight of their bare flesh he turned his head and shielded his vision with his hands.

"Do you have no sense at all?!"

options.name: Track down everyone involved, and charge them with blasphemy!
How do they expect us to identify the perpetrators?

events.title: Unholy Activities

events.desc: In the dead of night, a group of nihilists have committed arson against a … in …, leading to it being severely damaged by fire.
events.flavor: "You cry out with rage when empty buildings burn, but where are your tears when men and women with full hearts perish from hunger?"

options.name: The perpetrators will rebuild what they destroyed in prison.
The classrooms will be shuttered until that building is restored.

events.title: Taxes and Torches

events.desc: With the rise in discontent amongst the academia, a new, proudly … leader of the … has come to the fore.
events.flavor:
"The life of a limited person almost always flows more smoothly and pleasantly than the life of a genius or even just an intelligent person. Clever people do not get along with those phenomena to which the masses become accustomed without the slightest difficulty. Intelligent people, depending on the various conditions of temperament and development, are in the most heterogeneous relationship to these phenomena."

—Dmitry Pisarev

options.name: Keep a close eye on ….
Perhaps … is simply a product of our actions.

events.title: The Wedge in the Academia

events.desc: … and … have found themselves in a spontaneous public argument about the merits of their respective ideologies.
events.flavor:
"How are you to ever acquire support for your movement beyond the gullible scions of the bourgeoisie?", the man in the red scarf shouted. "You have nothing but aesthetics behind you, the very thing you condemn!"

With a turn of a black coat, the nihilist's eyes met their opponent. "You clearly possess no faith in the will of the people once awakened..."

options.name: … comes to a victory over his opponent!
… clearly possesses stronger arguments.
They have potential for something larger than the sum of its parts.

events.title: A Forum Argument

events.desc: Spurred by close ties between their respective agitators, the … and … have begun to cooperate against the influence of the ….
events.flavor: They formed an odd pairing, the bright-eyed students clearly trying to ape the ragged style of the workers, and yet they seemed to complete one another. In the flickering candlelight of the basement, the shabby clothing of the nihilists almost seemed to possess an authentic nature, for here they knew they had signed a compact to suffer equally if they were caught.

options.name: The product of zero times two is still zero.
Surely the … cannot actually be united behind this absurdity.

events.title: The Red and Black Unite

events.desc: The ascendant nihilist sympathisers in the government have arranged a gambit to abolish and forcefully liquidate all property of the …, and immediately enact ….
events.flavor:
"What can be smashed must be smashed. Whatever withstands the blow is fit to survive; what flies into pieces is rubbish. In any case, strike out right and left, no harm can come of it."

—Dmitry Pisarev

options.name: The … will perish, for it stands against reality itself!
This path is doomed to fail!

events.title: Spiraling Ascension

events.desc: The deaths from disease amongst the wounded soldiers has skyrocketed.
events.flavor: "Imagine a quart, you know how much a quart is right? No? Well picture two cups of tea, now imagine instead of tea they're full of maggots. That's how many we pulled out of this one poor fella after he was left to fester."

options.name: This is troubling.
Offload some of the strain to the civilian medical sector.

events.title: Disease Among the Wounded

events.desc: It has been suggested by some of the nurses working on the frontlines of the … war, that by adopting new cleanliness procedures we could reduce the number of deaths.
events.flavor: "Keep the ward clean, keep your hands clean and most of all keep the wounds clean. Do even one of these and the results are frankly astounding."

options.name: What an excellent idea.
This knowledge must be spread.

events.title: Medical Cleanliness

events.desc: It has been suggested that a prefabricated hospital be constructed and then transported to just behind the frontlines of the … war to help treat the wounded.
events.flavor: "It can be constructed here at home and then taken out piece by piece and reassembled. All the benefits of proper hospital but without the long construction time."

options.name: Great idea.
These resources are better put into research.

events.title: Prefab Hospitals

events.desc: A group of experienced nurses has reformed the practices at the … war front resulting in markedly less deaths.
events.flavor: "The lady with the lamp they call her, visits the wounded soldiers at night checking in on them. Real heart of gold that one."

options.name: What a revolution for the medical profession.

events.title: Modern Nursing

events.desc: … owing us a obligation could be used to pressure them to include the … in their government.
events.flavor: "Far be it from me to tell the fine … how to run … country," … said, waving … hand, "I simply want to mention that … is a very reasonable … who deserves to be heard!"

options.name: They just need a small push in the right direction!
We should stay out of their internal politics.

events.title: A Favored Party

events.desc: The obligation we owe to … is being used as pretext for a request to include their friends in the … in our government.
events.flavor: "As embarrassing as it would be to let another country dictate our politics, it would also be quite unseemly if they put more trust into our opposition than our government."

options.name: … helped us once. We will take their advice.
The mere suggestion is an outrage!

events.title: Foreign Interests

events.desc: … owing us a obligation could be used to request a propaganda campaign making the world see our nation in a more pleasant light.
events.flavor: "It is well for a nation to be respected, feared even, but can we truly expect them to support us in the future if most … children grow up hearing stories about how we will eat them if they don't behave?"

options.name: Everyone should remember how we came to their aid.
Why, when we are a nation to be feared?

events.title: Feared, but Not Loved

events.desc: The obligation we owe to … is being used as pretext for a request to portray their country as less of a threat to the world.
events.flavor: "It would not be propaganda, exactly, to portray the … as a nation with everyone's best interests at heart. They helped us once, did they not? It would simply be a reminder of our past."

options.name: A misunderstood country. They deserve a second chance!
They are a threat. We will not lie to our people.

events.title: A Kinder Image

events.desc: We see an opportunity to call in the obligation … owes us by requesting the service of their commanders, ….
events.flavor: "Not everyone is afforded the opportunities they deserve in their home country. We are an ambitious nation, one that will make better use of … skills than they ever could."

options.name: Just what our military needs!
The obligation is worth more than the skills of one ….

events.title: … Talent

events.desc: … is calling in the obligation we owe them by requesting our commander … be sent to serve in their military.
events.flavor: "A lot of talk about serving one's country in the military, as if it was a simple choice. What if the best service you can provide to your country is by serving another?"

options.name: A small price for what they did to earn it!
They may have our military aid, but not our military leaders.

events.title: A … in Demand

events.desc: The discovery of oil in … is causing people to flock to the state, hoping to find jobs in this booming industry.
events.flavor: "Gold? Silver? Diamonds? For what? Trinkets and finery for the gentry, glamor to hide that their time is past? Listen, my friend, nostalgia may be gilded, but the future—the future runs on oil."

options.name: Encourage this trend. Oil is the future!

modifiers.label: Oil Industry Employee Standard of Living

options.name: Progress is best tempered with caution.
Always! Always encourage an oil rush, wherever it is found.

modifiers.label: Oil Industry Employee Standard of Living

options.name: Caution is always wise, no matter the time or place.

events.title: Oil!

events.desc: With the groundwork of the … oil industry complete, its appeal and promise is waning among those seeking to carve out their own fortune.
events.flavor: "The nature of these operations is that eventually, a few people will hold all the cards. The industry lives on, but our hands are played. We were not among the few."

options.name: But oil will last forever...

modifiers.label: Oil Industry Employee Standard of Living

options.name: Shuffle the expertise into manufacturing.

events.title: Oil Rush Subsides

events.desc: Blowouts, oil fires and other lethal accidents are becoming more common as the hunt for oil in … grows more ruthless.
events.flavor: "You think you've seen fire, but you have never seen fire like this," he said, giving the young man a stern look. "And you better pray you don't, because if you haven't been out on the oil fields, the only place you'd ever see it is hell itself."

options.name: Where there is oil, there will be blood.
Pressure the owners to take a more careful approach.

events.title: Wild Wells

events.desc: Oil companies operating in … have requesting government assistance in funding a pipeline, promising that its construction will be accompanied by other infrastructure improvements.
events.flavor: "Putting a liquid inside a solid, putting that solid inside another solid and propelling the whole mess across a railway—trust me, in the future they will laugh at how we once did this. Now let me show you how simple it could be. It'll be just like turning a tap."

options.name: We will contribute to the funding of this project.
This is not in budget for …

events.title: The … Pipeline

events.desc: An inquiry has revealed that government politician …'s recent wealth has been accumulated through bribes from oil companies, allowing them to lease land without bidding.
events.flavor: "In an investigation like this, there's a way to know you're on the right track. It's that records of what you look for starts to go missing. The harder you look, the more disappears, until it appears as if a man conjured his fortune from nothing. Once you've forced them to make it look like magic, you can start figuring out the trick."

options.name: We must make an example of all parties in this scandal.
An elected official abusing … position is a severe crime.
Corporate leaders undermining our government cannot be allowed to walk free.
Even great people make mistakes. This can all be settled with some fines.

events.title: Black Gold, Black Money

events.desc: Production at the … is booming and foreign demand for opium could hardly be higher. The … people of … have become so enamored with the stuff that it has all but become the national passtime.
events.flavor: "The seeds of this flower, seemingly innocuous, are in truth the seeds of the fall of empires. Men will fight bloody wars to sate their gluttony for opium, they will sell their own mothers for another taste. And we will be there to sell it to them."

options.name: Keep the opium coming!
Take my pipe, my … friend.

events.title: Opium Barons

events.desc: Opium addiction is ravaging …. Vast numbers of … people have become opium fiends, causing a wave of crime, poverty, and idleness. Despite the obvious harm, … continues to flood the market.
events.flavor: Every household has a bed-bound opium fiend, every street corner has an opium den, and every port welcomes … merchants pouring a glut of opium down the throats of any who will pay for it.

options.name: We have to do something!
We cannot risk the ire of ….

events.title: Opium Crisis

events.desc: The … government has announced its intent to put an end to the opium trade in …. As … is a major exporter of opium, this is a matter of great economic concern.
events.flavor: "There are some who decry the so-called moral evils of the opium trade; I say to them, who are you to stand in the way of free trade and the free choices of the consumer? The demand exists, and so we provide—if not us then some other nation would grow rich off the backs of … opium fiends. Should every man be deprived of opium simply because some irresponsible ninnyhammers abuse it? And should every … family be deprived of the wealth that opium brings to our country?"

options.name: They will eat their opium and they will like it!
We have other matters to attend to.

events.title: Opium Wars

events.flavor: Just as the opium fiend shall break his addiction and rise from his idler’s bed, so shall our nation cast off the unwelcome yoke of foreign influence and rise as a sovereign state. No longer inundated with opium, our rivers shall flow with silver and our people shall return to virtuous living.

options.name: The sovereignty of … is absolute.
Harmony shall return to ….

events.title: The End of Addiction

events.flavor: Where is the nation that ruled for centuries over a harmonious land? We are slaves to opium, at the mercy of foreign greed. We cannot control our ports, the foreigners show no respect to our …, and in every household the whispers of dissent grow louder. Dark days are coming; our mandate may be at an end.

options.name: They may herald the end of ….

events.title: Opium Wars: Defeat

events.flavor: "It’s over, ambassador. Tell your … to sign the treaty, or else the repercussions will be severe. You will open your ports to us, you will cooperate with our officials in all matters of trade, you will pay the wages of the soldiers presently engaged in bringing ruination to your land and your people. You will submit."

options.name: … rules the waves!
Let them eat opium.

events.title: Opium Wars: Victory

events.desc: … patrols have caught a group of … smugglers carrying opium into …. This is a flagrant attempt by … to bypass the opium embargo.
events.flavor:
"Smugglers? Not at all! We are honest merchants legally carrying our wares to your fine country."

"Of course we have the proper documents. You want us to submit to an inspection of the vessel? I’m afraid that won’t be possible. There’s a terrible infestation of... umm... man-eating badgers in the cargo hold."

"I assure you this is all a misunderstanding! Get your hands off me! I demand to see the … ambassador!"

options.name: Execute the smugglers.
Return them in shackles.

events.title: Opium Smugglers

events.desc: The measures … has taken to address the opium crisis are paying off. Citizens in … have made a full recovery, and similar progress can be observed throughout the region.
events.flavor: "I had been numb to all thought and feeling, bed-ridden and oblivious. To be able to move again, to think and feel and love all the joys the world has to offer...and yet I still feel its allure. I must resist."

options.name: Redouble our focus on caring for the sick.
Their love for opium shall be replaced by love for ….

events.title: Addiction Recovery

events.desc: … people are experiencing severe effects of opium addiction. The use and abuse of the substance has spread throughout ….
