events.flavor: The opium eater lies under the weight of incubus and nightmare; he lies in sight of all that he would fain perform, just as a man forcibly confined to his bed by the mortal languor of a relaxing disease, who is compelled to witness injury or outrage offered to some object of his tenderest love: he curses the spells which chain him down from motion; he would lay down his life if he might but get up and walk; but he is powerless as an infant, and cannot even attempt to rise.

options.name: Tragic!
Perhaps we can treat this as a medical matter.

events.title: Opium Addiction

events.desc: The … have proposed a reasonable compromise on the Oregon border dispute. They propose that they annex …, …, and …, while we retain our claims to the northern regions.
events.flavor:
"If the Americans settle on the mouth of the Columbia it would in my opinion be necessary to abandon the Coast south of the river. This matter must be settled posthaste."

"So long as the traders of the British Fur Company have free access to the region of the Rocky Mountains from the various posts, they will in great measure monopolize the Fur Trade West of the Mississippi, to the almost entire exclusion in the next few years of our trade."

options.name: A most agreeable compromise.
We will not surrender an inch of British land!

events.title: The Oregon Border Dispute

events.desc: … has agreed to our reasonable terms, and has ceded control of …, …, and … to the ….
events.flavor: "The present treaty shall be ratified by the … of the …, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate thereof, and the ramifications shall be exchanged at London, at the expiration of six months from the date hereof, or sooner, if possible."

options.name: A most amicable agreement.

events.title: The Oregon Treaty

events.desc: … has rejected our reasonable compromise on the Oregon border dispute. The …'s claims to the region are indisputable, and so a more violent transition of power may be an inevitability.
events.flavor: "The British Empire stands in the way of our Manifest Destiny! Our great nation must stretch from sea to shining sea."

options.name: If they will not hand it over, we will seize it by force.

events.title: Failed Oregon Treaty

events.desc: The infamous dandy playwright … has been sentenced to two years of hard labor on a charge of homosexuality. If … doesn't receive a pardon, we may as well have sentenced the arts in … along with ….

options.name: A genius deserves an exemption.
We cannot be seen undermining our judges' verdicts.
It is barbaric for this to be a criminal act at all...

events.title: Each Man Kills the Thing He Loves

events.desc: Members of Bâb-ı Âli have been initiating a coup against … …. The culprits have already informed the new ruler.
events.flavor:
Early morning recitations of … … were abruptly interrupted by the sound of cülûs cannons. He anticipated what would happen next as the Eunuch barged into the room to deliver the unfortunate news.

The palace was surrounded by those who had saluted his commands the day before, and a boat was prepared for a journey into seclusion. Officers were already beginning to ascend the stairs to escort him.

options.name: Vallahi, this is the work of kâfirs...

events.title: Coup of Bâb-ı Âli

events.desc: Members of Bâb-ı Âli have decided that a new ruler must rise to rule our nation due to … …'s lack of sanity.
events.flavor:
After episodes of public acts of shame to his name, the … was found shaking in the bed with fear and paranoia.

The reported murder of former Sultan Abdulaziz after his dethronement worsened the mental state of … ….

Attempts to jump into the palace pool and flee from clergymen during the allegiance ceremony undoubtedly showed that his reign would be short.

options.name: Get away from me!

events.title: Reign of Lunacy

events.desc: With the death of Doctor Francia, all of … is in motion, with civilian and military cliques maneuvering to secure for themselves the reins of power.
events.flavor:
"That's it? The paranoid wreck is finally dead?"

"As dead as El Cid and my grandmother, both. God rest their souls."

"About time. The underserving have had their day. Now, the right people can steer Paraguay back to glory."

options.name: The … garrison secures the city for ….
Sr. …, the unloved secretary of Francia, clings to power.

events.title: A Meeting in …

options.name: One day, this 'Napoleon' shall lead Paraguay to greatness.
A general should know his station, and his is the barracks alone.
There's something off about that man, have him dismissed.

events.desc: With great fanfare, … … has officially inaugurated the new industrial complex at Ybycuí, stressing the site's modernity and tremendous industrial potential to the assembled crowd.
events.flavor:
Directors Log: On the Iron Works of Ybycuí
The iron thus produced has proven of the best quality, and, for some time past no other iron has been used for the public works. Iron smelted with charcoal is, as is well known, much stronger and better than iron smelted with coal.

There is reason to hope that when the mines of Paraguay are properly exploited and worked on a suitable scale, she will be able to supply La Plata with the best quality of iron at a cheaper rate than is now paid for an inferior quality imported from Europe...

options.name: Its charcoal smelters shall ensure the highest quality of ….
Iron is all well and good, but the future belongs to ….
Our prisons are full of purposeless men, let us 'offer' them one.

events.title: The Ruhr of the Tropics

events.desc: Commanding a hairpin bend in the River Paraguay, the formidable fortress of Humaitá has been established as the well-guarded key to … and the upper rivers.
events.flavor: "Sixteen ominous apertures pointed their gloom, and whatever else they may contain, upon us; and, like the eyes of the figure in the picture, seemed to follow the vessel's motion ... These apertures are those of the casemate battery, constructed of brick, but very deep, and defended by the very formidable battery of sixteen eight inch guns."

options.name: ¡No pasarán!

events.title: The Sebastopol of South America

events.desc: For too long have diseases like the pox robbed our nation of its men and women. While it may continue to do so for decades to come, the establishment of vaccination programs led by foreign doctors will lessen the severity of future outbreaks.
events.flavor: She was riddled with ringed scars. Forever-wounds and forget-me-nots left by smallpox. It claimed her two eldest, and they breathed their last, rattling gasps in her arms. Her youngest, untouched by the plague, may yet survive it's next incursion. All from just one, little needle.

options.name: Health is wealth.

events.title: What the Doctor Ordered

events.desc: Wearing their distinctive red and white uniforms, the men of … …'s new battalions march proudly on …'s Plaza de Armas. Meanwhile, their generals bicker incessantly amongst themselves about how best to actually use them.
events.flavor:
"You may support the motion to use cannons upon high ground, but we have neither the cannons nor the high ground for it."

"As if we do not have the means to make either. Perhaps your lip has grown as weak as your chin?"

"Not any softer than your dome. We promise what we don't have."

options.name: Matter over mind.
Mind over matter.

events.title: To Win or to Die

options.name: Glory to the heroes of the fatherland!

events.desc: Personally leading the ragtag remains of the … army, … … has been killed in action, having refused all calls to surrender.
events.flavor: It was not hard to find the wake of the …: the path of looted villages and slaughtered cattle heads ended in a shoddy fortification. The enemy soldiers approached on all sides unhindered. The battle was over barely after it started; an inglorious end to the … of ….

options.name: And with … death, so dies … dream of a Greater Paraguay.

events.title: The Battle of Cerro Corá

events.desc: Like David struck down Goliath, … has triumphed over her neighbors, with a … peace now enforced from the arid Chaco to the shores of the Atlantic.
events.flavor:
… sat at … desk, lit by a single, ensconced candle. Beside a filled inkwell and a clean pen was an untouched victory drink. Libations could wait, as could the hollering men and swooning women outside.

 Paraguay needed a rousing address. But where to start?

options.name: Give salutes, to that invincible bastion of heroism...
... the magnificent Eden of riches.

events.title: Peace and Justice

events.desc: Our armies routed, … has done what few observers initially thought possible. It has won the war. The international press is already reporting on a new South American balance of power.
events.flavor: Generals and admirals reached for cues. For every man they pulled away, ten thousand men had died. For every ship they pulled away, a squadron sank with most, if not all, hands lost. Paraguay, an ant who fought the sun. Paraguay, a wolverine who fought jaguars and serpents. Paraguay, the new colossus of South America.

options.name: God have mercy.

events.title: … Triumphant

events.desc: Having amassed significant military might under … …, … now stands poised to strike … in a bid for greatness. It seems only ready muskets may temper … ambitions now.
events.flavor:
"Sir, word from the … borders. Banners raised and cannons entrenched."

"So quickly? Do they plan to-"

"Attack now, yes, sir. The captains are already organising their men."

options.name: We must act.

events.title: The Paraguayan War

events.desc: Years of arduous labor has born fruit. With the … army stronger than ever, and with the backing of native industrial might, Paraguay stands ready to seize its destiny as one of South America's principal powers.
events.flavor: "Good people of …, and …s abroad, I, … …, come bearing a sword in one hand and scales in the other. Today, I speak of a dream for …: a golden future, one free of the yoke of imperialist neighbors. By hammer, by musket, and by the will of these brave men, our people will take our rightful place upon the world's stage!"

options.name: ¡Adelante!

events.title: The …'s Dream

events.desc: A minority group of … has recently settled in the state of …, seeking a better future. However, the local … elites are stirring up resentment, claiming the … newcomers will destroy the traditional way of life.
events.flavor: "They don't belong here! Our … customs, our way of life... they'll be lost if we let the … settle!" The words, spoken by a prominent landowner, echoed through a … tavern. The next day, they spread through the market, and on the next, they were on the lips of the town hall's secretaries. As the newcomers filed through the streets, they were met with closed doors and cold stares.

options.name: The … people must accept their lot.
We must foster harmony between peoples, whether … or ….
The old … ways cannot continue to dominate our modern nation.

events.title: New Neighbors, New Grudges

events.desc: A long period of discontent over the government's demands of the … in … has escalated into open rebellion within the city. Revolutionaries have executed several Army officers and declared a rival government, under the ….
events.flavor:
"The proletarians of Paris, amidst the failures and treasons of the ruling classes, have understood that the hour has struck for them to save the situation by taking into their own hands the direction of public affairs. They have understood that it is their imperious duty, and their absolute right, to render themselves masters of their own destinies, by seizing upon the governmental power."

— Karl Marx, The Civil War in France

options.name: This madness must end!
Paris armed is the Revolution armed!

events.title: The Paris Commune

events.desc: Forces loyal to the … government have marched upon Paris, conclusively defeating the …'s forces over the span of a week-long battle within the city limits. Mass executions of captured National Guardsmen loyal to the Commune have already been reported.
events.flavor:
"The Commune, surrounded from every direction, had only death on its horizon. It could only be brave, and it was. And in dying it opened wide the door to the future. That was its destiny."

— Louise Michel

options.name: There is to be no mercy for a commune of murderers.
We must conduct ourselves lightly, lest Paris never forgive us.

events.title: The Bloody Week

events.desc: A several thousand-strong force of National Guardsmen loyal to the … has marched upon the palace at Versailles, capturing the ministers of … government. The flag of the Commune has been raised over the main bastion of conservative resistance.
events.flavor:
"The communal revolution, begun by popular initiative, begins a new era of experimental, positive, scientific politics.

It is the end of the old governmental and clerical world, of militarism and functionarism, of exploitation, speculation, monopolies and privileges to which the proletariat owe their servitude and the Fatherland its misfortunes and disasters."

— Manifesto of the Paris Commune

options.name: The Versailles government will be trialed as criminals.
We must celebrate our victory, and reconcile.

events.title: The March on Versailles

events.desc: Long-running tensions between the … people and the … government have reached a boiling point. Revolutionaries across the country have declared loyalty to the …, marching against the embattled central government.
events.flavor:
"Make way for the People, for fighters with bare arms! The hour of revolutionary war has sounded! To arms, citizens! To arms!"

— Louis Delescluze

options.name: Death to the traitors!
Long live the Commune!

events.title: The Communards' Revolution

events.desc: Discontent in … has led to the seizure of the city of Paris by revolutionaries. France is now split between two rival governments - that of Paris, and that of Versailles.
events.flavor:
It was now midday, and the whole affair wore a most strange and incomprehensible aspect to one not brought up to making barricades. Instead of a government blocking every street as was the case in the morning, a hostile cannon was now looking down every street.

— Anonymous Times of London correspondent, 1871

options.name: The Paris "government" has no leg to stand upon.
… could use a change in government.
We have no interest in this.

events.title: Crisis in Paris

events.desc: … guardsmen attached to the … have seized another prominent church. They have asked the Central Committee for direction.
events.flavor:
The National Guard arrived to a deserted church.
"Proof of their treachery," mutters one. "Cowards," tuts a second. Each guardsman riffles through the steeple for trophies, loot, and timber for the barricades.

If God indeed claimed dominion of this structure, it is His no longer. It is now the people's.

options.name: Close the church until the commune is better established.
Find all the gold and silver.
Turn it over to … for their meetings.

events.title: Seizing Church and State

events.desc: The Communards have shot General … multiple times outside of Paris. Though Versailles has a faint hope he survived, the Communards have claimed a moral victory.
events.flavor:
One by one, his men deserted him.
Two by two, the guard leveled their rifles.
Three by three, the rifles cracked.
Four by four, the holes stacked.
Five by five, nobody could have survived.

options.name: They did their duty by killing an enemy general.
Conduct a fair trial. We are not barbarians.
Put them in the Enfants Perdus for their bravery.

events.title: Forty Warning Shots

events.desc: With the promise of counter-revolution under way, Parisian arrondissements argue over who needs more fortifications.
events.flavor:
"You claimed the last 40 wine barrels! You have enough wood to survive the winter after the counter-revolution. Meanwhile, I must make do with sand."

"That sand is worth its weight in gold, and you're using it to blow glass. Likely you'd use the wood to feed your furnaces!"

"You four-eyed bullfrog, that's what coal is for!"

options.name: The people know their districts best.
Centralize the defenses.
Buffer the outer arrondissements.

events.title: For Want of a Nail

events.desc: Public buildings, statues and homes associated with the monarchy are set ablaze. Witnesses have assigned culpability to the women in the ….
events.flavor:
Fires blacken the skies over Paris. Many call this a great triumph of the Commune.
Others, a reckless desecration of France's long history.
The pall of ash is incontrovertible: havoc reigns as people indulge in destruction.

options.name: Collateral damage happens in war.
Men's tempers get fiery in times like this.
The women want to vent their fury too.

events.title: Petrol Maidens

events.desc: The government in Versailles has allowed the … to trial and sentence captured Communards within 24 hours. In retaliation, the Central Committee in Paris has decreed that it will execute three men for every death by a military tribunal.
events.flavor:
"Thus we citizens of Paris are placed between two terrible laws; the law of suspects brought back by the Commune and the law on rapid executions which will certainly be approved by the Assembly.

They are not fighting with cannon shots, they are slaughtering each other with decrees."

options.name: Shoot to kill. They are enemy combatants.
They are traitors. Execute any who arise suspicion.
This is barely sedition. Imprison unarmed suspects.

events.title: Enemy Combatants

events.desc: National Guard cadres have captured a group of priests who refuse to leave Paris. They are preparing to move the clerics to prison.
events.flavor:
"Tell us where you keep your gold and we'll blow your head off, priest!"

"Non, non, Jacques, you're supposed to say ‘or.'
Tell us where the gold is, or we'll blow your head off."

"Did I stutter? If he didn't tell us, I was going to beat him to death."

options.name: Reactionaries cannot be tolerated. Seize them all!
Permit them to leave Paris with one bag.
Entomb the clerics with their church's rubble.

events.title: A Priest for Your Captain

events.desc: Skirmishes around Paris' outskirts have led to French Army forces capturing members of the … National Guard.
events.flavor:
Men in navy blues and reds were taken on sight. They were clearly National Guard.
Some had cast off most of their effects and tried to run back to the city. They were less clearly National Guard.
The army had a simpler rule. It didn't matter if it was a butter knife in one hand and a single shot in the other: if they had a weapon, shoot them.

options.name: They have surrendered. Begin the tribunals.
No mercy for treason.

events.title: Clapped With Irons

events.desc: Hundreds of bronze field guns in Paris are left unclaimed. The Versailles government urges caution. General … assures that … has enough men to seize the guns.
events.flavor:
"Do you understand how much damage four-hundred cannons could wreak? How many of our men would die?
Yes, they're obsolete. Yes, they're a pain to load. But one wrought-iron ball will shatter formations and weaken fortifications.
Load it with enough langrage, and you have enough shrapnel to turn an army to sausages.

Does it make sense, or will the Communards give you a close demonstration?"

options.name: Leave now, while we have the element of surprise.
There are too few men to seize them.
We have better guns lying around.

events.title: Four-Hundred Gun Salute

events.desc: The Women's Union have rallied numbers around the city to put an end to the city's legal brothels. Many cite the strict law around them as the cause.
events.flavor:
The purpose of legal constraints of prostitution is to limit venereal disease, avoid abusive master-servant relations, and ensure that legal consent is enforced.
While sound in theory, most prostitutes are well aware of the risks of their profession.
Except now the laws force them through poor treatment, poor healthcare, and invite legal abuse.

options.name: A woman's body is her right.
Men's urges are best contained in those walls.
They have a point. Make dens of sin illegal in totality.

events.title: Our Bodies, Our Rules

events.desc: Clashes at one of the forts surrounding Paris have led to an offer of surrender. The garrisoned Communards have agreed to vacate the fort and return to the city.
events.flavor:
"We can't fight them here. They outnumber us three to one, and they have more food, shot, powder, knives and uniforms than we do."

"Feh. And what would you do, exactly? Soil your trousers?"

"Fight them where we have more guns and people, for starters."

options.name: Permit the garrison to retreat.
Crush them all. No escape.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

events.title: A Fortress Falls

events.desc: A decree by the Central Committee allows employees of a business to take it over if the previous owner abandons it. Some are eager to accelerate that process.
events.flavor:
"Finally, a true co-operative. We could do anything. We could work four hours of a day, and leave for pints at 12."

"And don't forget fresh tools every year."

"Pierre, nobody ruins as many tools as you in a year, you slack-wristed grease puddle."

options.name: Workers are entitled to their browsweat.
We should encourage other owners to leave.

events.title: Working Co-op

events.desc: The … Central Committee has decreed that children will not be allowed to work. Divisions continue on what they should do with their newfound free time.
events.flavor:
A cheap source of unquestioning labor was the thought behind working the young. Of course, those who thought of it were not working their children. No, who would wilfully condemn their own child to hip deformities, out-of-shape spines, and various cancers from coal dust inhalation?

Naturally, when the chance came, the Commune scrapped it. Now everyone's children have a chance to grow.

options.name: Give us the child; we will return an adult.
The barricades will make men of them yet.
Perhaps a broken clock is correct twice a day.

events.title: Off to School

events.desc: Despite a decree from the … Central Committee that the death penalty has been nullified, many clerical hostages fear the rule will not apply to them.
events.flavor:
Pray. That was what the bishop said in this time, as the clergy were thrown into flea-infested cells and handed rotten food.
Outside were the cheers and cries: the death sentence was no more.
Inside the prison, though, were the leering eyes of men hungry to watch the priests die.

options.name: They are valuable trading chits. Leave them where they are.
We could stand to give them better conditions...
It is our duty to speed them on their way to God.

events.title: Capital Punishments

events.desc: After a by-election in the Paris Commune, the National Guard organized a parade through the main boulevards.
events.flavor:
Jean-Pierre got his boots. Jean-Pierre got his coat. Jean-Pierre got his gun. A grand revolution was on the way. And Jean-Pierre was with friends and family he had known for as long as he could remember. Paris had a fine history of glorious revolution, and his heart was giddy for it.

Except, Jean-Pierre wasn't quite sure if it dawned on anyone else yet: they use the same bullets as the French Army. And the French Army would be shooting at them soon.

options.name: Our allegiance is to the Committee and the Commune.
For France, and the Internationale.
We march for Paris.

events.title: First in, Best Dressed

events.desc: Elections for leadership in the arrondissements have revealed a flaw: some electees are also members of the National Assembly. … has declared that Republicanism is incompatible with the commune.
events.flavor: "You are either with the Commune, or you stand against it! Paris cannot, will not, shall never again abide by the terms of the landowners, the industrialists, or the petite bourgeoisie. No true Parisian would ever be content with such. And these men are opponents of the Revolution! If they are not traitors now, they are traitors to be!"

options.name: The way forward will not be determined by clerks alone.
The will of the people must be upheld.

events.title: Recusing the Republicans

events.desc: The … Committee for Public Safety has forbidden women from entering the battlefield. The Women's Union has released a manifesto asserting that many Parisian women would be glad to fight.
events.flavor: "It is not peace, but all-out war that the working women of Paris claim! Conciliation today would be treason!"

options.name: Allow them in auxiliary roles.
Keep them off the battlefield in totality.
Hand them a rifle and a bayonet.

events.title: Go and Fight!

events.desc: Several … chiefs have accepted the Frenchman … as King in the desperate hope that this will invite international recognition and an end to the colonization of their homeland.
events.flavor: "At this moment, the peoples who have acclaimed me not only as their king, but also as their saviour, are only awaiting my return among them to rise en masse and follow me on the great path of progress. My Estates are open to me from all sides and my peoples call me through the voice of their caciques."

options.name: Absolutely ridiculous.
Recognize them in exchange for loyalty.

events.title: An Unlikely Kingdom

events.desc: We have completed our long campaign to conquer the Patagonian south. Settlers are beginning to seek out promising sites from which to establish new towns and exploit the region's natural resources.
events.flavor: "The Mapuche fought long and hard for centuries to protect their country. Now at last they are defeated, and that land belongs to us. To the victor, the spoils. Now we must set ourselves to the task of populating and governing what we have won."

options.name: At last, the south belongs to us.

events.title: The Conquest of the Desert

events.desc: We have discovered that our rivals in … have been arming the … natives in …. This is likely to impede our efforts to conquer the region.
events.flavor: "The … natives have never welcomed our presence, but without the means to mount a truly effective resistance we have paid little heed to their objections. The addition of … munitions into the equation comes with the frightening possibility that we must face them on equal terms."

options.name: We should de-escalate the situation.
If they want a fight, they'll get one.

events.title: Arming the Natives

events.desc: The Triumviral Regency of the … and … was recently overthrown and replaced by the democratically selected … Regency. Until … … comes of age, Brazil will likely be engulfed by political turmoil.
events.flavor:
Chess, lauded as the game of kings for over a thousand years, stresses strategic acumen. Long strategies require sacrifice, cost calculation, and a keen sense of literacy. And as one player slips, another gains control of the board.

But the board of this game was the young emperor himself. Who knows what scars these intrigues would leave on a boy?

options.name: Will they never cease their squabbling?

events.title: The Emperor's Regency

events.desc: The … have suffered many grievances under the reign of … …. Many now openly oppose the … in favor of an … ….

options.name: A worrying turn of events.

events.title: The Case Against Monarchy

events.desc: Hoping to gain political capital, the … regency has decided to crown … as … of … significantly earlier than planned.
events.flavor:
"The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb,
The leopard shall lie down with the young goat,
The calf and the young lion and the fatling together;
And a little child shall lead them."

options.name: So begins his reign.

events.title: An Early Coronation

events.desc: … … is no longer the young, healthy man he once was. His ability to perform his functions as monarch are in decline. Speculation and scheming surrounds the matter of succession and the future of … government.
events.flavor: Entropy comes for all things, great and small. Whether by sword or decay, the Emperor of Brazil was destined to meet an end. Decades of delayed stress, forced action, and dynamic industry have finally damned him. Sickness would have its dues soon, and the vultures in his court would gladly feast on such a grand carcass.

options.name: No man lives forever.

events.title: The Emperor's Ill Health

events.desc: The …, once a great potential threat to the … of … …, have become politically marginalized. This is surely a positive omen for the future stability of the … government.

options.name: Excellent.

events.title: Just a Setback

events.desc: The growing resentment of the … is becoming difficult to ignore. These powerful elites wield great sway in …, and their lack of inclusion in government further turns them against …'s ….

options.name: This warrants careful attention.

events.title: A Powerful Enemy

events.desc: With the solemn passing of Emperor Pedro II, a week of mourning has been declared across …. His reign will surely be remembered as one of the greatest periods of our nation's history. Plans must now begin for the coronation of …, who the people look to with admiration and respect to lead them onwards.
events.flavor:
Old tales once held that Heaven weeps when a great man dies. When Dom Pedro of Bragança died, there was scarcely a moment without rain. Tens of thousands lined his funeral procession, wearing black and flying Brazilian flags. Dignitaries from as far as Japan bore witness to the event, each laying forth their own tokens of respect.

The heavy crown that once harrowed …'s father now loomed over …. … would have a near impossible task ahead: to fill the shoes of Dom Pedro II the Magnanimous.

options.name: The Emperor is dead. Long live the ….

events.title: Enduring Empire

events.desc: In a bloodless coup, the … and … have overthrown the … of … and proclaimed a …. Though many wished to fight to defend the government and the …, the former monarch has urged peace and abdicated the throne.
events.flavor:
"So that is that, is it?"

"Yes, Pedro. You and your family are no longer in power. There's to be a republic. The new powers that be want you... removed to Europe, while they consolidate new power."

"Very well. If it is so, it will be my retirement. I have worked too hard and I am tired. I will go rest then."

options.name: I love the Republic.

events.title: The Proclamation of the Republic

events.desc: In a private audience with …, Minister … has suggested that the … could peacefully transition … to a republican form of government. The … could be granted the honor of being the nation's first President after abdicating the throne.
events.flavor: The proposal was as intriguing as it was preposterous: dismantle the monarchy and replace it with a republic. Not any republic, but one with a head as powerful as a dictator. The constitution would be rewritten to accommodate the shift in power, but little would ultimately shift in Brazil's politics. Pedro would still be shackled to leadership, lest someone less competent took the reins.

options.name: The monarchy will endure.
If it is the will of the people, we shall have a Republic.

events.title: The Republican Proposal

events.desc: With the ratification of …'s first republican constitution, … has been confirmed as …, guaranteeing popular support for the new government.
events.flavor: "Good people of Brazil: today, I do not speak to you as Emperor. No, I will no longer speak to you as Emperor, as a King, or of any man bearing a crown. As of this morning, I have ratified a new proposal from the Cortes. The monarchy is to be no more. It is time we divest ourselves of such old notions as kings."

options.name: Long live the President.

events.title: President Pedro

events.desc: … has become the first to ratify …'s republican constitution, at the same time announcing to the public his intention to aid this transition by serving as the nation's first President.
events.flavor: "From today forth, I shall only be your president, until such a time as you, the people of Brazil, deem me unfit for my duties. I do not take lightly these duties put upon me, once entrusted as Emperor and now as President, for the responsibility is great indeed. But I ask you all: trust in me now as you did before."

options.name: Soon the Republic will stand strong.

events.title: A Magnanimous Constitution

events.desc: The unfortunate passing of … has left … without a male heir. Though Princess Isabel is by law next in line many citizens, including the conservative elite, do not relish the thought of a woman on the throne.
events.flavor: "This has been the most fatal blow I could have received, and I certainly would not have survived had it not been that I still have a wife and two children whom I need to educate so that they can guarantee the happiness of the country in which they were born."

options.name: Women are not fit to rule.
Isabel must be groomed to take the throne.

events.title: The Brazilian Succession

events.desc: Years of grooming have at last prepared … … to take her father's throne. Even those most staunchly opposed have come to accept that the line of succession is secure.
events.flavor: "Though many have said that it is not my place, I will serve my country to the best of my ability, continuing the esteemed legacy of my beloved father."

options.name: The succession is secure.

events.title: Heir to the Empire

events.desc: … … expects the same level of competence and meticulousness from … ministers as … applies to … own work. Now the … turns … attention to overseeing a particular cog in the machine of government.
events.flavor: Hand-picked clerks, both of them. Both impeccably dressed according to their means, though the hallmarks of their benefactors shone through. Leftover cigar smoke, a faint brandy stain on a collar corner; little vices leveraged to another's benefit.

options.name: The …'s decrees must be followed through.
The bureaucracy of trade could be more efficient.
The expansion of the economy must proceed more quickly.

events.title: To the Highest Standards

events.flavor: "I understand there is some concern that weaponry used in the … revolution might find its way into neighboring countries and end up in the wrong hands. I fear not the gunpowder, but what might ignite it. Not every man desires power for its own sake, but if he is convinced he has been cheated out of his share, he may view it as his duty to claim it. What could be more dangerous than the idea that power belongs to the people?"

options.name: Who will lead … to the future?
We will not let these ideals divide us!

events.title: The Spark of Revolution

events.desc: A current of radical liberal thought is spreading internationally and has recently reached ….
events.flavor:
"Why should I concern myself with the freedom of the press? All they print is rubbish!"

"If you knew what sort of rubbish doesn't make it to print, you may find the distinction between varieties more important than you'd think."

options.name: Let's hear what they have to say.
Sounds like a menace.

events.title: Echoes of Revolutions

events.desc: A voice for the liberalism currently on the rise has resonated with the ….
events.flavor:
"I don't know what to make of this new style of politics. It seems tactless to make demands this recklessly."

"When one argues that the premises for what constitutes political tact are themselves flawed, a bit of tactlessness can help drive home the point."

options.name: It must be heard.
This is far too extreme for … politics.

events.title: A Revolutionary for Our Time

events.desc: Proponents of liberal reforms are looking to spread their ideas to our neighboring countries.
events.flavor:
"What if the revolution fails? What if the … people are not ready for these ideas?"

"Then we will have planted a thousand seeds, and when … is ready, the fruit of those trees will seed our future."

options.name: What we are, they will be!
This contagion must be contained!

events.title: The Good Word of the Revolution

events.desc: The radical liberal currents in parts of … are causing local revolutionary activity.
events.flavor:
"So this is only local groups causing a ruckus? No nationwide coordination?"

"Well, the only thing we can know for certain is that if there is nationwide coordination, it's coordinating to conceal itself."

options.name: It could happen anywhere.
It resides at the heart of our nation.

events.title: Stirring Radicalism

events.desc: The international trend of radical thought and revolutionary sentiments is coming to an end.
events.flavor: "Perhaps it is too early for us to agree whether our attempts ended in success or failure. I would like to believe we have set in motion forces which will continue to advance our goals long after the fires of this era have gone out."

options.name: The world is changing.

events.title: End of Spring

events.desc: The Revolution has brought an end to monarchial power, and crushed the counter-revolution before it could arise. The … people shall have their Republic.
events.flavor: "This is not a time to rest and admire our work! How many a revolutionary has not failed to seize their moment, only to find their achievements swept away like sand castles by the tides of history? Power has slipped from the hands of tyrants and we must assure they can never seize it again."

options.name: The … cabinet will bring greater liberties yet!
Our people are our strength!

events.title: The Revolution Victorious

events.desc: The effort at a liberal revolution led by Radical leaders in … has been suppressed by the powers that be reasserting their power and pushing the Radicals into obscurity.
events.flavor: "There have always been efforts by the lower and middle classes to seize power, but they rarely manage to hold onto it once they have it. It is fortunate that this attempt has been brief and fruitless, or untold damage could have been done to the traditions and social order of …."

options.name: … will rule firmly, but justly.
The people will not be swept up in such rabble-rousing!

events.title: The Revolution Vanquished

events.desc: Inspired by the revolutionary wave spreading across Europe, revolutionaries in … have assembled to make demands of the …. They call for …, a democratic constitution, and the establishment of a ….
events.flavor: The crowd was spilling towards the …'s residence, now, kept back only by a thin wall of stone-faced soldiers. Insults and street detritus flew towards the row of bayonets and cannon, sending the horses' tails lashing. In the commercial districts, the retailers which had elected not to join the march were boarding up their shops. Further yet behind the impromptu lines, the workers had uprooted lamp-posts to batter down the city gates. The broken pipes cast an ominous half-glow over the streets.

options.name: We cannot risk a civil war.
Compromise on suffrage, but see this done.
Send in the Army immediately.

events.title: The … Revolution

events.desc: The revolutionary surge in Europe has swept a liberal government into power in …. This fragile liberal order is threatened by both conservative forces who wish to reverse their gains, and radicals who threaten a new revolution.
events.flavor:
"I found in the capital a hundred thousand armed workmen formed into regiments, out of work, dying of hunger, but with their minds crammed with vain theories and visionary hopes. I saw society cut into two: those who possessed nothing, united in a common greed; those who possessed something, united in a common terror. There were no bonds, no sympathy between these two great sections; everywhere the idea of an inevitable and immediate struggle seemed at hand."

—Alexis de Tocqueville, The Recollections of Alexis de Tocqueville

options.name: Long live the Constitution!
This travesty must come to an end.

events.title: Red …

events.desc: The liberal government in … has successfully overcome the twin threats of renewed absolutism and social revolution. The period of revolutionary upheaval has come to a peaceful end.
events.flavor:
"There is nothing more fruitful in wonders than the art of being free; but there is nothing harder than apprenticeship in liberty."

—Alexis de Tocqueville, Democracy in America

options.name: The age of liberty dawns in ….
The … people have earned their freedom.

events.title: Peace, Liberty, and Concord

events.desc: Despite the machinations of our rivals, the Peru-Bolivia Confederation has endured for a decade. The possibility now exists for the true unification of our nation under a single, rationalized government.
events.flavor:
The mountains are only a distant knife piercing through the evening sky from here. Their jagged blade, pale between the clouds.

"As successors of the Inca Empire, we must annex its former territories, follow the line of the sea and go on, go on, go on."

options.name: Sign for the Union!

events.title: The Pact of …

events.desc: With the capture of the self-proclaimed Supreme Chief of Peru, … … has finally consolidated … control over both Peru and Bolivia. …'s capture represents the final act of the Peruvian civil war.
events.flavor:
Brought before the …, manacled and with charged bayonets at either side, … held … head as high as … could. Execution was all but guaranteed now.

…, however, saw opportunity. A fresh chance at a confederation was at hand with … defeated. The only question was what path would bring Peru into the fold the quickest.

options.name: The penalty for … treason is death.
… will never be permitted to return to Peru.

events.title: The Capture of …

events.desc: The loss of the majority of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation's states has led to the collapse of the proposed nation. With the formal secession of the last remaining state from the Confederation, all hope has been lost for the Supreme Protector's grand project.
events.flavor: Beset on all fronts, from within and without, the Supreme Protector was finally put to rout. The dream was dead, dead and they had killed it with malice for their brothers. Peru-Bolivia was never to be, it seemed. And yet, hope remained in those that stayed within Peru: the Confederation may return anew.

options.name: It comes tumbling down.
A chapter of our history ends before it starts.

events.title: The Fall of the Confederation

events.desc: The defeat of Felipe Salaverry's coup attempt has led to complete consolidation of Bolivian domination over Peru. … … has declared the imminent formation of a Confederation between the two nations.
events.flavor:
"So that's that, then? Then the Confederation is guaranteed."

"We already have one gluttonous neighbor. God help us all if they both come for us."

"So we will go for the Confederation first. Send word to our friends, and tell them to fix bayonets."

options.name: This Confederation must disappear forever.
There is yet potential for a fruitful partnership.
We have no interest in this affair.

events.title: The Fall of Salaverry

events.desc: With the dissolution of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation, a nascent rival to … interests in the Andes has been defeated. The balance of power in South America has been set right once more.
events.flavor:
Santa Cruz Capitulates: Confederation Crumbles!

The confederacy along our northern border, so bedeviled in its intended birth that God Himself ordained its capitulation, has at last fallen. A champion's welcome in … awaits those brave men who slayed it.

options.name: A terrible thing has been smothered in its crib.

events.title: Scattered to the Winds

events.desc: With the establishment of lasting diplomatic ties with the rising Peru-Bolivian Confederation, the mutual security of both … and the Confederation has been ensured.
events.flavor:
"Now we make peace with the Confederation? And what of our trade? Two burgeoning neighbors? A consolidated threat on the northern border?"

"Someone has decreed that their trade does not threaten us, and their armies are more comforting than the British. Ah, there are the first wagons of cocoa. Perhaps you’ll think better of them with chocolate in your belly?"

options.name: Will the arrangement hold?

events.title: Reigning Peace

events.desc: The … has successfully consolidated its power, stabilizing its politics and passing a constitution. Standing against the burgeoning titan appears to soon be futile.
events.flavor: Spies sent letters—furious, defeated, and horrified alike—that any tumult within the new confederation was long since spent. Without lingering resentments to stoke, uncertainties to raise, or division between its legislatures, the people of Peru-Bolivia would see … only as one thing: jealous invaders.

options.name: We are forced to face a new rival.

events.title: The Triumph of the Confederation

events.desc: Our state has acquired its independence from the Confederation. With our newfound sovereignty, we may choose to restore our previous Constitution and seek the restoration of a unified Peru, or forge our own new path as an independent ….
events.flavor: Some would say that revolution which leaves a nation split asunder must be considered incomplete. Others say that independence is worth whatever sacrifice it may require. With half of Peru remaining out of our grasp, this question has come to weigh heavily upon the brow of our nation.

options.name: Peru will be one, and indivisible.
Our nation will be united under our current constitution.
A Peruvian nation was never meant to be.

events.title: For a Free Peru

options.name: Bolivia is all that remains.
Peru is all that remains.

events.desc: Amidst growing tensions more people seek greater representation in government while others call for independence from …. Will … rule prevail or will the people of the … succeed in gaining greater liberties?
events.flavor:
"The Philippines, then, will remain under Spanish domination, but with more law and greater liberty, or they will declare themselves independent, after steeping themselves and the mother country in blood.

As no one should desire or hope for such an unfortunate rupture, which would be an evil for all and only the final argument in the most desperate predicament, let us see by what forms of peaceful evolution the Islands may remain subjected to the Spanish authority with the very least detriment to the rights, interests and dignity of both parties."

—José Rizal, The Philippines a Century Hence

options.name: Gaining independence is crucial.
Ultimately, we answer to ….

events.title: … Identity

events.desc: Independent and thriving, the … will be a stalwart presence in the Pacific for many years to come.
events.flavor:
"Land of the morning,
Child of the sun returning,
With fervor burning
Thee do our souls adore."

–José Palma, Lupang Hinirang

options.name: The future of the … is bright.

events.title: Beloved Country, Chosen Land

events.desc: We continue to benefit from our ties with the metropole, as … and … affairs become increasingly intertwined.
events.flavor:
… rule in this archipelago remains steadfast as it has for centuries and the people of the … have shown a growing committment to strengthening ties with ….

For some members of the … this is a victory and a promise of great things to come. For others, these firm bonds are troubling and a threat to the future of the country.

options.name: This indeed marks a new chapter for our country.

events.title: Reliance on …

events.desc: A newspaper article written in protest of an old decree from the … government argues that … friars should wield the same authority as … friars.
events.flavor:
The newspaper circulated all around in …, rousing the ire of … friars and government administrators alike.

"For decades, … friars managed local parishes," the anonymous writer argued. "Why must we cede control once more to the …?"

options.name: … friars are just as capable of managing local parishes.
Contributions of … friars have been invaluable.

events.title: Local Clergy Clash

events.desc: Thanks to our efforts, the Ilustrado have secured more of a foothold in the … government.
events.flavor:
"A numerous enlightened class now exists within and without the Islands, a class created and continually augmented by the stupidity of certain governing powers, which forces the inhabitants to leave the country, to secure education abroad, and it is maintained and struggles thanks to the provocations and the system of espionage in vogue. This class, whose number is cumulatively increasing, is in constant communication with the rest of the Islands, and if today it constitutes only the brain of the country in a few years it will form the whole nervous system and manifest its existence in all its acts."

—José Rizal, The Philippines a Century Hence

options.name: The influence of the Ilustrados will continue to grow.

events.title: Ilustrado Reforms

events.desc: … …, on behalf of … administration, has introduced the … to the … archipelago.
events.flavor:
"Yet in spite of so many adverse circumstances the Spanish authority has been upheld for more than three centuries and, though it has been curtailed, still continues to rule the destinies of the Philippine group."

—José Rizal, The Philippines a Century Hence

options.name: But will the officers abuse their new-found authority?
Very well, the … has everything well in hand.

events.title: Guardia Civil in the Philippines

events.desc: With ports opened to foreign trade, the archipelago has more potential to develop into a thriving region. Port cities and the agricultural sector have the most to gain.
events.flavor:
On the right bank of the river Pasig lives the … of the … who oversees the development of these islands on behalf of the … administration. And on the very same river bank three miles down are the wharves and warehouses of the accomplished merchants who bolster the economy by no inconsiderable amount.

…, one of the most frequented harbors of the region, is rich with opportunity for those who seek it.

options.name: We must focus our efforts on our ports.
It is crucial we focus on developing the agricultural sector.

events.title: A Fruitful Future

events.desc: The stage has now been set for a burgeoning middle class to gain more political influence. Steady progress has been made in the development of the archipelago.
events.flavor:
In …, the … is impressed with the development of the agricultural sector and thriving ports in the ….

As the country's development impresses the …, the lives of many improve and money lines the pockets of a rising middle class. These upwardly mobile families now send their children to universities both in … and abroad. Domestic prospects certainly are looking up.

options.name: … will surely thrive for generations to come.
… will continue to develop into a prosperous region.

events.title: Impressive Development

events.desc: Our great work towards the education of the … peoples have resulted in the creation of a pan-Philipinic nationalist identity.
events.flavor: "The creation of an independent state is merely the first step towards true national liberation. Only when all its constituent peoples speak with one voice is our work truly complete."

options.name: We march together towards the future.

events.title: An Insular Identity

events.desc: Comprehensive education efforts and our unwavering ties to the … nation has resulted in the formation of a new, distinct, and Hispanophone pan-Filipino identity.
events.flavor: "Mother Spain, your tongue is a key: with it we open offices, newspapers, and university doors."

options.name: Our cultural link to Spain is a source of strength.

events.title: Beloved Child of the Metropole

events.desc: The … in … have seen an increase in workplace injuries due to increased mechanization and poor safety regulations.
events.flavor: Accidents have always happened, but I felt like I used to have time to react. Not this time. I grabbed his arm to pull him out of the way, but I'd barely got hold of his wrist before the arm was all I held onto.

options.name: Slow down production while the staff adjusts to this new machinery.
We cannot pull the brakes on the engines of progress!

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Manufacturing
Mortality of Machinists employed in Manufacturing
Mortality of Engineers employed in Manufacturing

events.title: Dangerous Equipment

events.desc: Children working in the … in … have suffered injuries trying to operate the machinery used in production.
events.flavor:
After examining the boy's hand, the doctor sat back down, turned to the mother and sighed deeply.

"Well, I'm afraid your son is never going to become a great musician," he said, "but then again, perhaps that was never one of his more likely prospects."

options.name: Keep children off the factory floor!
These new industries need all the employees they can get.

modifiers.label: Mortality of Laborers employed in Manufacturing

events.title: Untrained Hands

events.desc: Protesters from the Temperance movement are objecting to the production of liquor in ….
events.flavor: "They say that it was weakness of character that killed my husband, like any man who takes to the bottle. I can live with the shame of these accusations, but why must my children grow up hearing such things about their father when those who fill the bottles are utterly unashamed of ruining so many families and lives?"

options.name: We must stop distilling this poison!
Let us cease production of the strongest spirits.
… should take pride in its liquors!

events.title: Eternal Vigilance

events.desc: Pacifists led by … are protesting against the weapons manufacturing in …
events.flavor:
"Some may tell you that … is at peace," … told the crowd. Then … gestured towards the workshop and with genuine anger in … voice, continued:

"I tell you, as long as these rifles are fired in any country in this world, we are not at peace! The blood of these wars is also on our hands and will not be washed clean before we cease to make these instruments of death."

options.name: Halt production of the rifles until this settles down.
Significantly reduce weapon production as a compromise.
We shall not be shamed for our good craftsmanship!

events.title: War Profiteering

events.desc: The wine produced in … has been lauded by sommeliers as outstanding.
events.flavor: "When people say that something ages like wine, they don't always make the distinction between wine and wine. So let me make that distinction. If you can get your hands on a bottle from …, that bottle can be more than just a good time—it can be an investment."

options.name: Make this an exclusive product for export.
Increase production to meet the booming demands.

events.title: A Good Vintage

events.desc: The … communities of … patriots and exiles are both large and well-motivated. By giving them aid and clear directions we can ensure that their zeal does not go to waste.
events.flavor:
"Word from the homeland, finally. We might have a chance at finally returning. Good food, songs, dance; everything!"

"Let's not hope for more than we can reach. What did the messenger say?"

"To the streets. We chant, we march, and we refuse work. And if it comes to it, we brawl."

options.name: Have them foment unrest in ….
Instruct them to ….
The Poles of … yearn for freedom.
Smuggle them across the … border.

events.title: Poland is Not yet Lost

events.desc: Large protests have erupted throughout the … communities in …, advocating for Polish statehood. Advisors believe the unrest may be connected to the actions of government-affiliated groups in ….
events.flavor: Peoples of a torn land will, invariably, pine for whatever glories and identities they once had. Such is the wisdom of empires of old: subjects of conquest kept their lands and their customs, but for a tribute and agreement to hold new laws. The consequences of stripping a people of their identity is, also invariably, catastrophe.

options.name: … must answer for this.
Infiltrate and try to break up their groups.
Call up the gendarmes, promptly.

events.title: Is Poland Not yet Lost?

events.desc: Calls for a political union between the two … states of … and … have grown widespread as of late. An official proposal has now been issued from …, with the … delegation eagerly awaiting our response.
events.flavor:
"You accuse us of being pretenders, yet nobody of yours has any connection to the old royalty. Bah, a People's Revolt and you've forgotten many a key person!"

 "And yet, we both sit, squabbling like babes at the teat for legitimacy. We should be focusing on common struggle, together!" 

 "We are struggling together!"

options.name: Together, for Poland!
This does not serve the interests of …

events.title: The …-… Union

events.desc: Defying the partitions, Poland has made a miraculous return to the world stage. But as the eyes of the nation are fixed upon its future, … … looks to its past. A Poland has been reborn, but which?
events.flavor: … … sat in the half-darkness, … face lit by a single candle almost burnt to its stump. If hope had a taste, it was victory; victory was jubilance; jubilance, in this case, was a rye aged thirty years in old wine barrels. But it could not dampen the anxiety of a new future. To harken the days of Jadwiga or Bolesław, … thought, was to set the stage of Poland's next hundred years. … sipped the rye, as … pondered the specter of a thousand years of history.

options.name: Like in the days of Piast the Wheelwright, Poland is for the Poles.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: We are the heirs of the crowned republic, our destiny lies in the east.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

events.title: A Second Advent

events.desc: A great … rebellion has broken out against the … yoke. Our … brethren cry out for aid. How shall we answer them?
events.flavor:
Street Clash: Polish Partizan Push!
Polish nationals have taken to the streets in … in an attempt to reunify the old Polish country. Multiple persons have since perished in the fierce wars on the streets, with many a brave constable sacrificing life and limb to put down this revolt. Authorities in … believe the rebellion may soon be crushed in a matter of weeks. (cont. pp. 7-8)

options.name: Provide them with moral support.
Send them volunteers, weapons, and supplies.
Dig deep. We shall send them whatever they need.

events.title: The … Rebellion

events.desc: The Commonwealth of … has been restored, undoing decades of subjugation and partition. While the … and … people now enjoy freedom from Russian and German rule, we must consider whether to extend our dominion to liberate … and … lands as well.
events.flavor: A grand restoration, centuries in the making. Hussars with polished armor and silken wings stood at attention as the new government swept into the halls of power. The first order for the knights of the new commonwealth was thus: defend the borders, no matter the cost. But which borders were they to follow?

options.name: Poland and Lithuania are enough.
We will restore the borders of the old Commonwealth.

events.title: The New Commonwealth

options.name: Welcome, brothers.
Our empire grows.

events.desc: Members of the … have been promoting the idea of founding a private literary club called "Grémio Literário." They have petitioned for financial and political backing to bring this vision to life.
events.flavor:
"…, by the Grace of God, … of …, and all Her Dominions,

Be it known to all who receive my Charter: that, considering what was represented to me by the Council of State through the Honorary Minister and Secretary of State, Rodrigo da Fonseca Magalhães, in his capacity as President of the Commission entrusted with drafting the statutes governing the society named Grémio Literário..."

options.name: You have our generous approval.
Imploring is not the way to seek knowledge.

events.title: Construction of Grémio Literário

events.desc: The secular … has been discomforted by the news of the Asylum for the Disadvantaged Childhood of Horta indoctrinating minors with religious zealotry. They demand action to protect the youth from religious dogma.
events.flavor: "We liberals are told to hold our tongues—that this is charity, that it feeds the hungry, that moral improvement is inseparable from the Gospel according to Saint Anthony. We reply: there is charity that liberates and charity that binds. This is the latter."

options.name: The … has every right to shape the next generation of … patriots.
True, this has gone too far.
Sort it among yourselves.

events.title: Asylums of …

events.desc: Multiple reports have been made regarding a serial killer known as "The Aqueduct Murderer". Allegedly, he has killed dozens of victims, throwing them off the Águas Livres Aqueduct. The public demands immediate action.
events.flavor: Lantern light flickered in the damp pre-dawn, reflecting off the slick stone. Boots echoed hollowly against the aqueduct's arch as the river wind stirred the stillness below. Then, a pale figure, motionless, appeared where the darkness' edge met the drop.

options.name: Dispatch experienced law officers immediately.
We have trained experts for exactly this kind of case.
Assemble a public stunt to sacrifice a brave soul.
Murder?! Everyone knows that the aqueduct is where you follow the call of the void.

events.title: The Aqueduct Murderer

events.desc: A mildew epidemic has struck the … vineyards, crippling the production of the famous Madeira wine. Foreign merchants have begun a panicked exodus from the island.
events.flavor: "Among all wines made in the last five hundred years, Madeira wine stands out as the most characteristic of its time and location, being an extraordinary beverage created through fire and heat. Its vines, fed by the ashes of an ancient forest burned five centuries ago, are rooted in rocky soil formed from volcanic eruptions that happened approximately 14 million years ago."

options.name: Send scientists to research and come up with a hasty solution.
Compensate the merchants before they leave.
Let us raise our hands and gaze to the sky.

events.title: The Wine Blight

events.desc: A group of passionate doctors has prepared detailed plans for …'s first zoo. They desire the government's approval and support to realize the project.
events.flavor:
The boy held his mother’s gloved hand tightly, eyes flicking from the sway of an elephant’s trunk to the shimmer of green-and-gold feathers above. Each cage seemed like a doorway to another world. Monkeys jumping like living fireworks, a lion’s yawn echoing through his chest.

In that moment, … felt as vast as the maps in his schoolbook.

options.name: The … approves.
What's next, a parliament for parrots?

events.title: Zoological Garden

events.desc: Two folk healers from … have been working in a hotel in …, claiming to cure vision problems with alternative methods. The governor, a physician himself, tried to stop them, but the locals' objections have become a matter of public order.
events.flavor:
"They say it is one of those eastern incantations that ask for help from demonic imps, dark magic, and the like. I would rather stay blind than see the devil every day after that. Yes... No, thank you."

Glória snapped back. "Do you not already see the devil next to you every morning, Mara? What's the difference, for God's sake?"

options.name: Brand them as witches and do whatever is necessary for such individuals.
Force the governor to let go of the ladies to ease the tension.
Let … deal with them, deport the duo.

events.title: Women of the Worms

events.desc: Successfully colonizing … has reignited centuries of expertise and ambition. The government sees building strong foundations along the African coasts as an excellent opportunity.
events.flavor:
It had been nearly a month since Fr. Duarte left. The trip was fairly smooth, though the days went by quicker than he expected as he worked to organize various records about pagan religious sites, rock art, and megaliths with ritual carvings.

He couldn't wait to show his documents to his fellow brothers and start planning the work schedule for potential missionaries heading to the new colony.

options.name: Yes, this is the course of action we should undertake.
We have other issues that require our attention.

events.title: Coastal Strongholds

events.desc: We have established several colonies along the eastern and western coasts of Africa, and several exploration missions are currently being organized to explore the central region.
events.flavor:
"Why do we have dozens more compared to yesterday?"

"A whole new tribe, sir. They were discovered behind the steep ravine to the west by the field patrol, near hand-carved caves."

"Odd... I want them presented in front of my tent this afternoon. Include the elders."

options.name: We must rapidly populate these colonies.
Let our objectors know that the old … is back.
The whole world shall realize our greatness.

events.title: Mirrored Triumph

events.desc: Our attempts to colonize the African coastlines have ended with an unfortunate blunder. We have failed to establish or hold a single colony around the landmass we initially aimed for.
events.flavor:
"N'wananga, the hounds have gone, at last. Chased by lions, they ran without turning back."

She raised a hand to shade her eyes, squinting eyes to face her husband, said:

"And will they ever return, Mwanapwesi?"

"As this earth is the witness of their cowardice, and these trees of their greed, my sons—our sons—will show them the strength of the pride, if they ever try."

options.name: Most unfortunate.
We have misjudged our capabilities

events.title: A Fruitless Establishment

events.desc: Suspicious of our potential ambitions in southern Africa, emissaries from … have arrived to seek accord regarding a document called "The Pink Map." They aim to connect their coastal colonies of … and … with an inland corridor.
events.flavor:
"And you will deliver this... to Lord Salisbury himself?"

"Absolutely, sir. Should the … dispute, I will remind them that we bring not only trade but civilization and the preservation of history to those lands."

"They only listen to gunboats and gold, Pereira, trust me."

options.name: This is of no harm to us.
We may do so, with a caveat.
This is an unacceptable request.

events.title: The Pink Map

events.desc: … has given us their blessing for The Pink Map campaign. We shall begin the preparations.
events.flavor:
Pereira adjusted his attire one last time before entering Visconde Duarte's room. He knew the news of his success had spread faster than he could arrive in these halls, but he was still excited to share his achievement, expecting the proud look of a father towards a son.

And that is precisely what happened. Duarte was thrilled that his pupil finally experienced a diplomatic triumph after years of performing simple tasks.

options.name: They have our gratitude.
Dispatch something of value in return for their good will.

events.title: … Recognizes the Pink Map

events.desc: … has refused to give us their blessing for The Pink Map campaign. What will be our response?
events.flavor:
The proprietor of the gazette press waited anxiously, remaining still at the scheduled time of the officer and his personnel's arrival.

After issuing the warning, he realized that describing the events in Britain as a "failure" in tomorrow's paper could cause trouble. Still, he was prepared to counter the profiteers' attempts at using his position of power.

options.name: We should not poke the beast.

rewards.name: Backed Down from the Pink Map

options.name: Well, at least we tried.

events.title: … Rejects the Pink Map

events.desc: The Pink Map is now a reality. We have reminded the world of the might of ….
events.flavor:
“It was Portugal, small among the nations of Europe, that first brought to the world the idea of a universal civilization, connecting peoples and continents through commerce, the Christian faith, and scientific curiosity. Not with the destroying sword, but with the cross, the language, and ingenuity, the Portuguese opened routes across unknown seas, revealed unknown peoples, and extended European influence to the farthest reaches of the globe.”

— Oliveira Martins, História da Civilização Ibérica, Chapter X

options.name: …, a Nação dos Heróis!
I am the supreme … of Africa!

events.title: A Dream Fulfilled

events.desc: Though the Pink Map initiative has long been a national dream, we have overestimated our ability to make it a reality.
events.flavor:
The lone colonial officer stood beneath the burning African sun before his hut, clutching a crumpled copy of a torn Pink Map.

Behind him, the … flag had been lowered from a makeshift wooden pole, with native porters looking on silently, some with hidden smiles, others with contempt.

The vision of a vast Lusophone Africa, stretching unbroken from coast to coast, crumbles like the brittle paper in his grip.

options.name: How did we fail this?
It was the …' incompetence.

rewards.name: Blamed for Failing the Pink Map

events.title: The Pink Map, Refuted

events.desc: … has requested concessions in return for their approval of the Pink Map campaign.
events.flavor:
"Your Excellency, they are unlikely to oppose our Pink Map claims if we offer some concessions. As they say, … can draw the map, but the … controls the brush. Saying no could lead to isolation; agreeing ensures their support but will render us weak in the eyes of our subjects.

We await your verdict."

options.name: Let them have their way, this time.
This is starting to feel like a pointless aspiration.
What are they even thinking?

events.title: …'s Demand

events.desc: The recent census of … has made it clear that it deserves an official act of recognition from the government to incorporate it as a … state.
events.flavor:
Goa’s Carnival, a lively pre-Lenten festival, is a legacy of our rule that brings two cultures together.

Entrudo— People splashed water, eggs, and sometimes colored liquids on each other in the streets.

Masquerades—Participants wore colorful costumes and masks, and danced to Portuguese and Goan music.

Rex Momus —A “King Momo” figure presided over festivities, declaring days of revelry before Lent.

options.name: Keep working on Lusitanization.
Let our people prosper.

events.title: The State of India

events.desc: There has been a significant increase in reports of … achieving impressive economic feats for such a small state.
events.flavor:
Businessmen from all cultures and walks of life have flocked to …'s markets and meeting halls in recent years, trying to seize trade opportunities with local proprietors. Portuguese adventurers and Cantonese brokers mingled in narrow alleys and busy waterfronts.

The aroma of spices and salt air accompanied fierce negotiations over rice wine.

options.name: Send experienced administrators to oversee trade.
What they need are architects and builders.

events.title: Funding Macao

events.desc: Despite years of warnings from royal doctors, … … died during her thirteenth childbirth at the age of ….
events.flavor:
"Her Majesty the … began to notice announcements of childbirth at nine-thirty of last night. Difficulties appeared in the progress of the same childbirth, which forced the doctors to resort to operations, through which the extraction of an Infante was obtained, of time, who received the baptism before being extracted.

The result of these operations took place at ten o'clock in the morning. Unfortunately, after an hour and a half, Her Majesty, exhausted from all strength, surrendered her soul to God, after having received all the sacraments.

— Francisco Elias Rodrigues da Silveira, Dr. Kessler, Ignacio António da Fonseca Benevides, António Joaquim Farto."

The Government Gazette

options.name: Her legacy will carry on through her offspring.

events.title: The Good Mother

events.desc: Fanatical culprits have managed to take the life of … … and the heir apparent while the royal family was enjoying a peaceful journey in their carriage.
events.flavor:
The … was ambushed by Alfredo Luís da Costa and Manuel Buíça while travelling in an open carriage. Tragically, gunshots fatally struck him and his heir, injuring his younger son, who would soon be crowned.

Some perceived the motives for the regicide as a bold stand against a repressive monarchy, while others regarded it as a frantic effort to spark political transformation.

After investigations took place, it was revealed that the assassins were part of a larger revolutionary group called the "Carbonária", which aimed to establish a republic in ….

options.name: The crown weighs heavily on the new …'s temple.

events.title: Out of Nowhere

events.desc: The centuries-long reign of the Most Serene House of Bragança has ended in …. The residents have successfully demonstrated that true nobility resides in their hearts and hands.
events.flavor:
There once was a man who began life as the future founder of a house that produced many kings and queens, to the very soil where his grave was dug.

He was bestowed the name Alfonso by his father, the monarch of Portugal, in the Gregorian year of 1337.

Today, that legacy has reached its conclusion.

Tomorrow will mark the triumph of the common folk against those who claimed to be the chosen ones.

options.name: We shall take off, one last time.

events.title: Flight of the Wyverns

events.desc: There have been news of a cholera epidemic in …. People are openly requesting aid from the officials.
events.flavor:
"...yes, my …, the newspapers have been a crucial source for spreading scientific information to our subjects in the region. Those who cannot read are encouraged to ask friends and family for the latest progress on protecting themselves from the unseen. Town criers have also been directed to most streets.

As with all catastrophes, however, profiteers of evil and good nature have emerged from all corners of the state to fill their coffers with fear, but that is to be expected in such times."

options.name: Send them aid.
We need to visit them on site to boost morale.
They are on their own.

events.title: Outbreak in …

events.desc: The philosophy of Positivism has spread beyond the Positivist Church, with many …, …, and … adopting its scientific principles in order to fulfill their reformist ambitions.
events.flavor: Natural law was one of the first things to go under this new judge. One gavel stroke, and thus ended any claims to the "naturalness" of any man seeking recompense for damaged goods. If there was no explicit command from governance to do so, it was no law to be followed. Merely guidelines to be interpreted, until commands are set forth.

options.name: A great benefit to the reformist cause.
There are surely more reasonable forums for politics.

events.title: Practicing Positivists

events.desc: The practical and scientific nature of Positivism has led to the growing popularity of Positivist thought in the …. Many professors and officers in … military academies have begun to embrace the philosophy.
events.flavor:
Through rational observation and a personal understanding, a leader can whittle the engines of war to a finely tuned calculation. A precise calculation of which artillery can put the right amount of ammunition on a target, with variables accounted for, for maximum effect and minimal casualties. Men supplied and armed with exactly what they would need, plus a little extra, and just enough motivation to storm a fort.

Wars of the far future may become bloodier, but they will at least be efficient.

options.name: A foundation for a new military doctrine.
The Academy should embrace this trend further.
This sentiment could bolster …'s reform proposals.

events.title: Military Science

events.desc: The prevalence of Positivist teachings in … military academies has led to a generation of officer cadets in the … being educated in its principles.
events.flavor:
"Captain, I hope you can explain a few things to me. You have your men reading about republicanism instead of drilling. Rather than practice for parades, they crow about theory. When given leave for worship, they paint. Why in God's name are you turning my soldiers into Sunday school debutantes?"

"To be more flexible in the field, sir. I wish for the men under my command to survive without me. They must be able to think, if I am too dead to think for them."

options.name: They had ought to stick to military affairs.
They could only improve the ….

events.title: The New Generation

events.desc: Several prominent Positivist reform advocates have become entangled in a dispute with the Positivist Church over their political activities. The orthodox stance of the Church is that its members should not be carrying out political activities outside of itself.
events.flavor:
Two stacks of letters were on the Director's desk: one from the clerics of the Positivist Church, and the other from a loose assortment of practitioners somewhere in government. All of them were in one of a small group of subjects: denouncement of this rival, support of this ally, a plea for support, or a warning to stay out of a ploy.

He reached for the decanter of rum. Politics, it seems, is inherent to any Church.

options.name: The Church is not the sole arbiter of the cause.
Their practices represent a breach of Positivist principles.

events.title: Theory and Practice

events.desc: The Positivist Church of … has petitioned to be allowed to construct an additional church in …. The proposed "Temple of Humanity" will serve as an important node of Positivist activities.
events.flavor:
"There's already a temple in …, and now they want another in …? Surely there would be an inquisition upon us all for this."

"I wouldn't worry. They sound like Catholics anyway. If there's an inquisition at all, they'll just take the priests and baptize them. Maybe that would be a real reason to attend Mass on Sunday."

"You don't attend Mass on Sunday? What does your mother think of this?"

options.name: There is no harm in it.
They will not spread disorder to ….

events.title: Temples of Humanity

events.desc: …, a philosopher of the sciences at the École Polytechnique in …, has published a treatise on the reorganization of society along positivist principles.
events.flavor:
"Viewed from the moral, scientific, or poetical aspect, it is equally valuable; and it is the only principle which can bring Humanity safely through the most formidable crisis that she has ever yet undergone. It will be now clear to all that the force of demonstration, a force peculiar to modern times, and which still retains much of its destructive character, becomes matured and elevated by Positivism."

—Auguste Comte, A General View of Positivism

options.name: A curious boon to … academia.
His idea of social physics should be given a closer look.
If he wishes to change society, he is welcome to try.

events.title: To Venerate Mankind

events.desc: …, a student of the philosophy of Positivism, has founded the Positivist Church of … in …. The Church's events have become a meeting place for Positivist intellectuals.
events.flavor: Pamphlets flitted from hands and into the streets of a new church. One side promises the end of moral anarchy, and the other heralds a new age of emancipation through learning.
