Armchair scholars, actual scholars, clerks and bankers alike found a forward-facing ideal. An ideal of progress as a goal, order as a foundation, and of love as a governing truth.

options.name: An intriguing institution.
Another eclectic, short-lived cult.

events.title: The Positivist Church

events.desc: The work of the Positivists has deeply enshrined their principles within professional circles in …. The principles of Positivism are assured to guide … professional institutions for many years to come.
events.flavor: "A big day. A glorious day! One collective, one purpose. We have here today in this temple librarians and laborers, shopkeepers and spinsters, carpenters and clerks. What a big day to see so many working towards the betterment of our fellow man. So let us change the order of today's events: let us begin by offering each other the sign of peace."

options.name: We are nearing the next stage of our evolution.
There is more they may do to lead us forward.

events.title: The Positive Epoch

events.desc: After a brief period of prominence, the Positivist trend in … has begun to decline, as middle-class reformers seek other frameworks to analyze their problems. With its fading popularity, the Positivist Church will soon be regarded as just another ephemeral cult.
events.flavor:
For Sale: Temple of Humanity, deconsecrated.

Beautiful location in the heart of …. Sturdy design and spacious, can host hundreds of like-minded people for any gathering. Perfect for an up and coming school.

Open for inquiries.

options.name: Another grand design, faded into obscurity.
They will chase their impossible dreams forevermore.

events.title: A Peculiar Cult

events.desc: With our acquisition of …, we have established the Baluchistan Agency to coordinate the governance of the region. Proposals have been put forth to return regions of Baluchistan to native rule.
events.flavor:
"A single state would increase our administrative responsibility. Let these small men rule their little pockets. Meanwhile we can focus on garrisoning our frontier. Ensure no Afghan, Persian, or Russian dreams of approaching us."

"Give five men five states to rule and you create five rulers who dream of uniting them all. India already has more princes than all of Europe, do you truly wish to add to that number?"

options.name: Distribute the Southern regions to our loyal princes.
Partition the region, with Kalati authority over Makaran.
Establish a nineteen gun salute state of Kalat.
The High Commissioner may take full control of the province.

events.title: The Baluchistan Agency

events.desc: Prior to our acquisition of …, the region was split between the various branches of the Talpur Dynasty. Proposals have been put forth to establish a princely state in Sindh, under compliant Talpur rulers.
events.flavor:
"Peccavi", the telegram said. The adjutant looked to his principal, and raised an eyebrow.

"Message follows: "Peccavi". A code phrase?"

The officer pulled his eyes upwards, away from the report he was reading. "I have sinned", he said.

"He has Sindh?"

"Yes, he has Sindh."

"I see."

options.name: Allow the Northern Talpur dynasty to remain in place.
Establish all of Sindh as a nineteen gun salute state.
Fold all of Sindh into the Bombay Presidency.

events.title: The Capture of Sindh

events.desc: Our acquisition of … has brought our border to the Pamir Mountains. Proposals have been made to delegate the administration of this remote region to compliant native rulers.
events.flavor:
"Princely states so close to enemy borders? Irresponsible and foolhardy. We have won the territory, now let us keep it."

"Guarding territory and administering them are two different matters. Why expend men and resources running the state when we can let the locals rule and let their taxes fund our garrisons?"

options.name: Grant autonomy to the region's loyal rulers.
Expand the territory of Chitral to the entire North.
The native rulers have proven to be unreliable.

events.title: The North-West Frontier

events.desc: Our newly-acquired province of … was once a powerful kingdom in its own right. Proposals have been made to establish a new, powerful princely state to administer the region.
events.flavor:
"The Hindoos don't like the Mohammedan, the Mohammedan don't like the Sikhs and the Sikhs don't like anybody. What prince could possibly wrestle them all?"

"So instead of letting some foolhardy prince try to keep them all in check, you would make it our problem? Do you care so little for sleep?"

options.name: Establish Jammu and Kashmir as a twenty-one gun salute state.
No such treaty is necessary.

events.title: The Treaty of Amritsar

events.desc: The newly acquired … are organized as a complex patchwork of various Shan principalities. Proposals have been made to organize them as a confederation of princely states under their current forms of government, with a shared Resident.
events.flavor:
"These frontier areas are a great source of revenue but a nuisance to administer. Fragmented, and mountainous, it will be a while before our people are familiar with the terrain."

"Perhaps we can borrow a page from history. Bind the Shan Saophas under a federation. They can rule as they wish so long as the central fund gets its share. As time goes by, our collectors will learn the roads and we won't need for the Federation."

options.name: Grant them autonomy under their own rulers, with a shared Resident.
Incorporate them as a Shan District.

events.title: The Shan States

events.desc: The desire for independence can be felt in all corners of …. … … must decide on how to act at this juncture.
events.flavor:
A longing to break free from …'s rule grows steadily. It is on the minds of … from all walks of life. That restlessness among the people begs the question of how … might take charge of its own destiny.

A traveler passing through … cannot escape the whispers of how the people no longer wish to live under …'s thumb.

options.name: … will one day be free.
Someone must stand up to ….

events.title: Divergent Destiny

events.desc: After a hard fight for independence, … is no longer a mere Princely State. The people celebrate, and the … looks to expand …'s power.
events.flavor:
Mubarak Ho!

On …, … celebrated … newfound power with a lavish parade that concluded with a gun salute. There was a general sense of merriment in the air as food was distributed among the people, promising a new age of plenty. Only time will tell if the … will deliver on … promises!

options.name: We have a bright future under the …'s leadership.
…'s achievements will be grand!

events.title: Princely State No Longer

events.desc: The … plans to send some of our finest camels to aid the …, who are experiencing a shortage of pack animals.
events.flavor: The court had spent hours debating the matter. The … listened quietly, putting on a somber expression and nodding along to … advisors' arguments. But to …, the choice was an illusion for those in denial of who was really in power. Aiding the British or not was not a choice between loyalty to former allies and money; it was a choice between struggling and thriving.

options.name: So long as they pay us, this is fine.
Their fight is not our fight.

events.title: Shortage of Pack Animals

events.desc: … … will honor … by appointing … Knight Grand Commander of the Order of the Indian Empire.
events.flavor: The … strolled the halls of … family palace. Paintings of … ancestors loomed around …. What would they do if they were in … stead? These fierce men and women who recognized no authority but that of the gods? Would they tell … to bow? Or would they remind … that somebody has to start. Somebody has to step forward and say no.

options.name: Heaven's light our guide.
Such an honor means nothing.

events.title: The Most Exalted Order of the Star of India

events.desc: By the use of the doctrine of lapse, … has taken over another princely state.
events.flavor: Growing up, … tutors had encouraged … to play chess. Looking back, the game captured one aspect of being a ruler well. The ruler never got to move more than a step at a time. And yet, if … fell, no one else would matter. Today, as another one of … neighbors fell to …, the … felt like the king on the chessboard, surrounded by enemies but unable to do much. But even then, … had one move left. … just had to make sure it was the right one.

options.name: The policy is abhorrent!
Perhaps there is wisdom in this.

events.title: … Annexes a Princely State

events.desc: The recent expansion of the … in … has yielded extremely promising results. … threatens to lead the world in rubber production.
events.flavor: "The question is not what can be done with rubber, but rather what cannot be done. There is no end to its potential utilization, and it will surely become the foundational material of the modern world. Our finest minds are developing new applications for this versatile material."

options.name: We need more rubber!
What other uses could we find for rubber?

events.title: Rubber Boom

events.desc: The development of more stable … has led to an uptick in demand for explosive materials. Our military and industrial sectors have entered a bidding war to secure shares of our production.
events.flavor:
\"\"Civilian applications?\" Really? What does a civilian firm want with two thousand tonnes of dynamite?\" The Quartermaster-General paced back and forth, clutching the dossier to his chest. \"If I had two thousand tonnes of dynamite, I could equip an artillery corps for the year. I could fill warehouses with shells.\"

\"It is... regrettable,\" said the clerk, cautiously testing each word. \"A bidding frenzy has erupted over the material. Our current budget would buy us a fraction of what it should.\"

Not ideal, thought the Quartermaster-General, but survivable. \"Place the order, and tell me the figure. I will petition the Cabinet for twice as much.\"

options.name: Increasing supply will lift all boats.
The industrial sector will make best use of it.
The military must have their cut.

events.title: Exploding Demand

events.desc: With the invention and implementation of motor transportation the question arises. Shall we focus on public or private transportation?
events.flavor:
"Why should I have to sit on a bus or a train with a stinky peasant, I should have my own mean of transportation"

"The speed of the nation should not be left in the hand of the rich few, we need to keep the poor in mind."

options.name: More automobiles are needed!
More Public Transportation!

events.title: Roaring Engines

events.desc: The switch to plastic in our Glassworks is set to revolutionize the industry.
events.flavor: "Ladies and Gentlemen I present to you, a world first. Behold this perfectly carved ivory chess piece? Beautiful no? What if I were to tell you it is not ivory at all but a new material known as plastic!"

options.name: Plastic is the future!
We should spread this knowledge.

events.title: Plastic Production

events.desc: The production of radios in our factories has led to a boom in employment and profit.
events.flavor: "Telephones? No, no, no, who wants a telephone? One person talks to another person? Useless! What you want is a radio! One person talks to hundreds, nay thousands, and the best part? They can't talk back!"

options.name: More Radios!
We should spread this knowledge.

events.title: Radio Production

events.desc: The invention of the telephone has opened the door to great improvements in our communications... or in our electricity industry.
events.flavor:
"A shiver ran down the assistant's spine when he thought he was hearing his master's voice in that cold, dusty cellar.

"Do you understand what I say?" The man stopped, almost dropping the wooden box he was carrying, dimly lit by the candles carefully placed around the revolutionary device, half machine, half human. "Y-Yes."

"Come here immediately! We have something in our hands, kid."

options.name: We should improve our communications.
Just write a letter! Electricity is for the industry!

events.title: Do You Hear That Too?

events.desc: The efficiency of our … in … has proved to have a dangerous counterpart and death has become common to almost every voyage. It is a high price to pay, but the profit is equally high.
events.flavor:
The body of the whale lies as wide as the sky. Its head has been emptied and the barrels of oil are stained with blood.

A voice resounds throughout the wharf, "We lost a dozen of men," and then he starts to list them, and their towns; a few of them are from the capital, one of them has your brother's name.

The oil shimmers—the liquid gold-like blood of a siren, luring men to their deaths.

options.name: We need to ensure the safety of the sailors.
But it shines!

events.title: A Dangerous Business

events.desc: The recent expansion of the … in … has boosted confidence in …'s future as an oil producer.
events.flavor: "If our ancestors had seen machines powered by a black, flammable liquid bursting forth from the earth, they would surely have called our technological marvels the work of the Devil. Thank God we live in such enlightened times!"

options.name: Get every drop from those wells!
We'll find more things to put oil in!

events.title: Booming Oil Industry

events.desc: The recent expansion of the … in … has inspired faith in a future where all of … is electrified.
events.flavor: "Trapping the power of the roaring rivers and waterfalls by transforming it to the power of a thunderstorm must be a sign that we are approaching the final stage of man's mastery of nature. Are we ready? Morally, intellectually, spiritually? It matters not. It is coming."

options.name: Unlimited power!
All technology must be leveraged towards better trains.
There must be other ways to produce electricity.
With the light on around the clock, why should the work ever stop?

events.title: A Stable Supply of Power

events.desc: The growth of branch lines along the main rail routes has been immensely valuable to the growth of our burgeoning rail industry.
events.flavor: "A child has been arrested for picking up coal alongside newly-laid tracks. If the youth had been smart enough to steal the whole railroad, he would've been hailed as the Napoleon of industry."

options.name: The railroads of … shall prosper.
The locomotive-builders of … should benefit from this boom.
Let us not rest on our laurels, but anticipate the future!

events.title: Railroad Boom

events.desc: The grand project of mechanizing agriculture throughout … is complete. Never before have such abundant yields been tallied.
events.flavor:
"I got a brand new combine harvester!"
"That's fantastic! Do you think I could borrow it once you have finished your harvest?"
"Of course! I'll give you the key."
"I'm glad we can work together in such a perfect harmony."

options.name: Distribute surplus food to the poor.
But could yields be even higher?

events.title: The Mechanization of Farming

events.desc: Through the widespread introduction of the atmospheric engine in the mining industry, productivity is at an all-time high.
events.flavor: "When steam first began to pump and wheels go round at so many revolutions per minute, what are called business habits were intended to make the life of man run in harmony with the steam engine, and his movement rival the engine in punctuality."

options.name: I'm sure we can squeeze a little more from these machines.
This has great implications for transport.
Perhaps there is an even better way.

events.title: The Atmospheric Engine

events.desc: The manufacture of steam engines has become a profitable industry in … thanks to our sound investment in locomotive technology. These engines are already being employed across new … railway lines.
events.flavor: "All aboard for …! Courtesy of the good folks at the … Steam Locomotive Company, getting out of … has never been easier. The dining cart is restricted to first class passengers only, stowaways will be prosecuted!"

options.name: All aboard!
More engines! More locomotives!
We're on the track for innovation.

events.title: The Engines of Progress

events.desc: Both the … and the … have expressed their desire to stop the alarming consumption of liquor present in our nation, petitioning the government to ban it.
events.flavor: "I neither drink nor smoke, because my schoolmaster impressed upon me three cardinal virtues: cleanliness in person, cleanliness in mind, temperance."

options.name: Alcohol is a poison to the mind.
Nothing makes a man smile more than a glass of whiskey before bed!

events.title: Prohibition

events.desc: …, of the …, has been discovered to have established an illegal distillery in his own house. During the apparently innocent party of … son, guests opened the wrong shed.
events.flavor: "This is madness! How could I, a model, law-abiding citizen, be accused of such treachery—such...  disgusting behavior. Treason! Blackmail! I'm being framed!"

options.name: Excuses! Send the men to that damned party!
… has always had a troublesome character.
… is clearly being framed.

events.title: From Within

events.desc: Members of the … have expressed dissatisfaction with the recent Temperance Movement, complaining about the liquor industry being an important part of their income.
events.flavor: "What am I meant to do now? Sell toys? Should I visit my grandma now? Ask her to teach me how to knit so I can make small, cute sweaters for fancy dolls? For goodness sake, we're all grown men here, aren't we?"

options.name: Then … should call … grandma immediately.
They can still use the vineyards.

events.title: Bad for Business

events.desc: Reports of unusual sounds and suspicious behavior have been raised in …. A local pet shop—recently opened—has been attracting lots of clients.
events.flavor: "Pet shop, eh? Well, I just have one question. What kind of pet shop is filled with rambunctious yahoos and hectic music at 1:00 am?"

options.name: It's probably just those loud pet shop boys.
Well, then we shall see those pet shop papers.
Who do they think they're fooling!? Officers!

events.title: The Best Damn Pet Shop in Town

events.desc: Members of the … have been caught using the … in … to produce a surplus of alcoholic beverages that they've been illegally selling for their own profit.
events.flavor: "It was the potatoes! What else are we supposed to do with them? A puree? If it's in their nature to produce alcohol, how are we expected to prevent it?"

options.name: This should be immediately dismantled.
It's just a farm.

events.title: Beer Barons

events.desc: Members of the … have declared that there is no use in banning liquor, if people can still access wine.
events.flavor: "If a man wants to get drunk and become a monster of a human, he's still free to do so! It's useless to pretend that they're not still out there, drinking wine and feasting like nothing was happening!"

options.name: They do have a point.
There is only so much that our people can handle.

events.title: Teetotalism

events.desc: Members of two rival gangs have been murdered in broad daylight during a liquor related altercation. One of their leaders has been finally identified and citizens demand protection.
events.flavor: "But he's such a good egg! He's always been very charitable, even with all the bootlegging and the fishy stuff. He donates to the poor and opens soup kitchens for those in need. A modern Robin Hood, I tell you!"

options.name: This is over. We're taking him to court.
People hate him. People love him. There's a deal to be made here.
We shall teach him and his gang a lesson.

events.title: A Daylight Massacre

events.desc: After the government's efforts to ban alcoholic beverages, … is now clear of liquor.
events.flavor: "Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments, throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue. And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them."

options.name: Finally, our people are free of evil.

events.title: The Blue Ribbon Badge

events.flavor: "These fallen women are an affront to moral propriety. They must be contained and treated, lest they spread their sinful diseases across the nation."

options.name: Enact a Contagious Diseases Act.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: These laws are inhumane.
Medical science shows the futility of such measures.

events.title: The Contagious Diseases Acts

events.desc: Feminist groups led by … demand the repeal of the Contagious Diseases Acts in …. They decry the brutal treatment of women by police and inhumane conditions in lock-hospitals. Even women with no connection to prostitution are routinely confined against their will.
events.flavor: "Men police lay hands on us. By men we are examined, handled, doctored. In the hospital it is a man again who makes prayer and reads the Bible for us. We are had up before magistrates who are men, and we never get out of the hands of men till we die!"

options.name: Repeal the Acts.
Repeal the Acts across the nation.
Renew the Acts.

events.title: Repealing the Contagious Diseases Acts

events.desc: Police have shut down a notorious male brothel. The arrested proprietor has revealed that … is part of his clientele, and this information is leaking to the press.
events.flavor: "An indescribably loathsome scandal has struck …! The captured boys were made to confess, and the … reports that another sensation about this affair will soon burst. Twenty-two men implicated, blue bloods and others, have fled from …."

options.name: … must resign immediately.
Try to cover up the story.
Our propagandists will minimize the impact.

events.title: A Scandal in …

events.desc: The use of extreme force is becoming increasingly common among police officers in …. The working class and the socially conscious are rallying against the police as an institution.
events.flavor: "Scarcely a week passes without their committing some offense which disgusts everybody but the magistrates. Boys are bruised by their ferocity, women insulted by their ruffianism; and that which brutality has done, perjury denies, and magisterial stupidity suffers to go unpunished. Police brutality is becoming one of our most venerated institutions."

options.name: We cannot tolerate this behavior.
The use of force is warranted.

events.title: Police Brutality

events.desc: There have been reports of …, leader of the …, not attending meetings or fulfilling his obligations. We can no longer ignore … absence.
events.flavor: "… barely even responds when we call … name. A blank stare, … almost doesn't blink. "Let's go for a walk," we'd tell …, and … nods in silence, and in silence we walk."

options.name: A doctor needs to see ….
… can get the help … needs in an asylum.
Psychoanalysis has become a very promising trend.

events.title: An Absent Mind

events.desc: Concerns about the wellbeing of … … have been increasing throughout the country after … lack of public appearances. … spouse has tearfully confessed that no doctor seems to be able to cure ….
events.flavor:
"I tried everything! But … illness comes from... the inside. No broken bones, not even a sore throat!

I'm afraid we'll have to switch to other methods, and a good friend of my cousin, he was able to cure her! Just snapped his fingers, read her future in the cards and voilá! She was just as fine as when she was young, happy, full of life."

options.name: Nonsense! A real doctor should treat … with proper hypnosis.
It's worth a try.
An experimental treatment has been offered by the Philosophy Department.

events.title: Desperate Measures

events.desc: After his return from duty, … … has not been the same. … avoids the barracks like the plague, refuses to use a weapon and … has stated damn clearly that … doesn't want to hear a damn word about war.
events.flavor:
"… wakes up in the middle of the night, drenched in sweat, screaming, … looks at me and doesn't recognize me, just points and asks about … brother, … dear brother.

Sometimes … even tries to get something to throw at me, "Where am I?!," … yells, … eyes seeing past me."

options.name: Those memories would wreck any man. This needs to be treated.
… would get the appropriate treatment in an asylum. Far from the public eye.
This is just another instance of cowardice. Send … back to service.

events.title: The Soldier's Disease

events.desc: Released patients from the … Asylum have steadily denounced the practices involved in their, supposedly, medical treatments. Mistreatment of the sick, withholding of personal letters, and disproportionate punishments were among the charges.
events.flavor: "They would make us sit in a chair for hours, if not the whole day. In silence. We couldn't talk to any other patient, not even read a book. They would only excuse us to go to the restroom, if we were lucky. Otherwise, it was just a rusty chamber pot. No food, no water. If we were not sick when we were admitted, we would be within just a few weeks."

options.name: Their judgement cannot be trusted.
We need to entirely revise how asylums work.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Standard of Living for the Middle Strata

options.name: The … can take over the asylum administration.

events.title: Questionable Practices

events.desc: A respectable doctor from the … of … has been conducting newfangled investigations in the camp of psychiatry, emphasizing the role that the unconscious mind and buried childhood memories play in psychological pathologies.
events.flavor:
"In the following pages, I shall demonstrate that there exists a psychological technique by which dreams may be interpreted and that upon the application of this method every dream will show itself to be a senseful psychological structure which may be introduced into an assignable place in the psychic activity of the waking state.

This accomplished by investigation will terminate as it will reach the point where the problem of the dream meets broader problems, the solution of which must be attempted through other material."

options.name: He may continue his investigations at university.
A mind this brilliant deserves a prominent role!
This sounds highly unconvincing.

events.title: The Interpretation of Dreams

events.desc: Members of the philosophy department from the … of … have signed a formal petition for governmental funding of their next project: a scientific journal.
events.flavor: "With the foundation of our Philosophical Studies, we welcome a new era in the scrutiny of the mind! An era of rigorous research and serious experimentation, an era of scientific collaboration among our foreign colleagues, a safe haven in which all investigations pertaining to this topic can be shared."

options.name: We have no resources for this.
Fund this journal!

events.title: The Journal of Philosophical Studies

events.desc: The rise of the communist regime in … has spurred a sense of terror and mistrust across … society. Many fear that … will be the next to fall to communism.
events.flavor:
Every newspaper on the stand bore a title more extreme than the last. Shrill newsboys hawked them on corners, sending competing claims of atrocity and terror across streets.

"Assassins and madmen claim power in …!" cried one of them. "Recovered "Red Bible" reveals agenda of world revolutionists!" shouts another. And amidst all of them marched ten thousand wide-opened ears, soaking up each sensational word as they hurried along to their stations.

options.name: It could happen here!
A panic would be wholly unwarranted.

events.title: The Red Scare

events.desc: Following government hearings into the activities of the communist regime in …, newspapers across … have reported sensational stories about all adult women in … being nationalized as common property.
events.flavor:
"I saw it myself, before I fled. The Red authorities have mandated collective orgies, within which there is no respect for virtuous women. The Ministry of Free Love forces them all to participate under threat of bayonet."

"To be clear, you are saying that a girl in …, having reached her eighteenth year, at once becomes state property?"

"Yes, yes. Their names are placed on a bulletin board in their towns, and all eligible men are permitted to marry them at will, as many as they wish..."

"But, even married, they must still attend the orgies?"

options.name: The Communists are coming for our women!
This testimony seems highly suspect.

events.title: The Nationalization of Women

events.desc: Rumors about the atrocities of communists in … have reached the … press, with reports about crimes against humanity and stacked corpses filling the front pages of newspapers.
events.flavor:
"Did you hear of the bombings the other day? This time it was a lawyer. One of the big ones advising the government."

"Another one? Heavens, that's the third this month. This is supposed to be a safe country."

"Safe? Bah, not with these Communist rats running around. They'll kill us all if we don't kneel down first."

options.name: Who knew that people could be so barbaric?
They had ought to publish something else, for once.

events.title: Communist Criminality

events.desc: Newspapers sympathetic to the interests of the … have printed numerous stories about the revolutionary desires of communists in …. The articles paint lurid pictures of strikes and planned terrorism.
events.flavor:
The Red Plague Festers 

Correspondents from across the world have reported the unnatural stirrings of a thought most foul: that man no longer be entitled to the sweat of his brow. That many hard working … citizens no longer have natural rights to his property. And that his privacy be no more than a fleeting desire.

This thought is Communism, and it is coming for everyone in ….

options.name: We must get this situation under control!
We cannot have a panic on our hands.

events.title: Red Revolution; Yellow Headlines

events.desc: …, a particularly prominent figure within the …, has issued scathing accusations of communist infiltration within the … press and government itself.
events.flavor:
"What do you propose we do? We're losing the people. I'm sure I don't need to dictate their sentiments to you."

"No... no, you don't. My kingdom for a worthy distraction from the ills of our government. Preferably one more credibly bloodthirsty than ours."

"By Jove, that's it! What was the name of that dreadful ideology? Whichever it is, summon the papers at once!"

options.name: Call those accused before an investigatory committee.
… should provide some evidence for these claims.

events.title: Dangerous Hours

events.desc: Nativists within the ranks of the … have issued statements declaring … people in … to be communist infiltrators. This rhetoric has already led to crimes against … people.
events.flavor: They were innocent. All six of them were acquitted. Or, at least half of them were before they heard cries of a mistrial. Now a miscarriage of justice by vigilante hands would kill them here. If they weren't shot in their cells, they were dragged out by the neck and hung before being shot. Executed for the crime of being … by birth. And the country would thank the crowd for it.

options.name: What is there to be done about it?
Halt this behavior before it spreads.

events.title: Nativist Discontent

events.desc: Riding the wave of the Red Scare, a new and fiercely reactionary political movement under the ardently anti-communist … has coalesced in …, calling for relentless opposition to the depradations of communists both abroad and at home.
events.flavor: The crashing of the drums was a new feature of the weekends. The jeering shouts and shows of force in the streets were growing louder and larger by the month. At its head was a rising star of some political faction too small to garner much attention. But … garnered swift attention from an outrage-addicted media.

options.name: … is a true … patriot!
This rhetoric seems to be just as extremist.

events.title: Red-Baiting

events.desc: Protesters inspired by the fierce rhetoric of … have carried out a march in …, calling for military intervention against the communist regime in ….
events.flavor:
What began as a few-dozen shouting men in the streets swelled to a corpus numbering the thousands. What began as a peaceful demonstration grew to chants of fire and fury, all baying for blood. What began as a show of fear transformed into a call for action.

Their demands were simple: tear out the … menace, no matter the cost.

options.name: We must save the … people from themselves.
The people's energies are best spent on something more constructive.

events.title: Marching Against Peace

events.desc: Policemen chasing rumors of an allegedly planned communist uprising in … have stirred significant fear amongst the area's public. Local skeptics decry the disturbance as terrorism in itself.
events.flavor:
"Not sure I understand, superintendent. You want us to go to this block in the dead of night, while everyone's asleep, to raid this warehouse on suspicion that it might be a communist meeting place?" 

"That is exactly what I want you to do, sergeant. Now, might I count on you to carry out this task, or shall I volunteer some men for you?

options.name: If it doesn't materialize, then we'll have done our jobs.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: There is no reason to believe this is credible.

events.title: In the Face of Revolution

events.desc: A stream of wealthy … émigrés fleeing the communist regime in … have sought shelter in …, bringing with them tales of revolutionary terror and unbridled proletarian excess.
events.flavor:
"The worst was these new secret police, just like the old ones. They would round up people they didn't like, usually when all was dark and quiet. Sometimes the day too. And if we ever saw liquor trucks going to their offices... well, we never saw our neighbors again. We had to get out."

"Very brave. We'll take good care of you here. Anything for …'s most upstanding citizens."

options.name: Give them a platform to tell their stories.
A tragic procession.

events.title: The White Émigrés

events.desc: The backlash against the policies of the … communists has led to mounting pressure on the progressive leaders of the … to explicitly denounce the government of ….
events.flavor:
They loomed over him, at least a half-dozen and all built to lift cisterns. At first, it was a courtesy call to the watering hole. Some boy fresh off the fields recognized him over a pint. Then the barmaid remembered his praise about …'s government. Now, it was a sizable crowd with six strongmen at the helm.

"Well... the thing with … is..."

options.name: For the … cause, not the … one!
This road leads to nothing but more extorted concessions.
The socialist cause in … is hopeless.

events.title: Progressive Dilemmas

events.desc: A particularly bloody armed robbery in … has led to the arrests and convictions of two … men known to be anarchists. The evidence against the men is tenuous, and the judge has been accused of both racial and ideological prejudice.
events.flavor: Spent bullet casings at a robbery: that was what law enforcement determined was the culpable link. Finding anarchist literature was the cream on top of the mash. Anyone would have done, but these … men were a convenient bow tie. It wouldn't take long for a jury to convict them.

options.name: Murderers deserve a taste of their own medicine.
A lengthy prison sentence will suffice.

events.title: Anarchists on Trial

events.desc: As the execution of two … anarchists convicted of murder draws near, protests from both skeptics of the conviction and … communities across the nation have sprung up in major cities.
events.flavor: Cities from around the globe raised banners far and wide for the two convicted murderers. Even cities across … have risen to protest the ruling. Headlines and letters from every center of protest have one common thread: violence. Violence to meet violence. And more violence is all but certain if the executions are not stayed.

options.name: Protests will not change what they did.
Grant them a stay, and a retrial.

events.title: Facing the Chair

events.desc: With arrested communists beginning to stream into … prisons, figures within the government have suggested deporting the noncitizens among them to … aboard a chartered cargo ship.
events.flavor: "Just as the sailing of the Ark that Noah built was a pledge for the preservation of the human race, so the sailing of the … Ark is a pledge for the preservation of …."

options.name: A wonderfully poetic suggestion.
They will serve their sentences on our soil.

events.title: The … Ark

events.desc: A group of local representatives in the assembly of … have been threatened with expulsion from the body due to their association with the …. Their defenders have denounced the measure as inimical to democracy.
events.flavor: "The five men before us have been elected on a platform that is absolutely inimical to the interests of both this body and that of …. They are supporters of revolutionary tyranny, foreign agents, and consorts of hostile nations. It is because of this that they have no right to stand in a position of power. I am immediately calling a vote on their suspension from this body..."

options.name: The … deserve everything that they get.
It is a mistake to deprive them of opportunities for peaceful discussion.

events.title: Leftist Representatives Threatened

events.desc: After years of competing propaganda and social mistrust, the Red Scare has ebbed to a more manageable level. Whilst many remain watchful for communist activity, the days of unmatched fear in … have come to a relative end.
events.flavor:
"We have passed beyond the stage in political development when heresy-hunting is a permitted sport."

— Charles Evans Hughes

options.name: Our nation will be made safe.
We must repent for our own excesses.

events.title: A Subtler Terror

events.desc: The title of … has passed to …, who has yet to reach the age of majority. The task of assembling a regency has fallen to the sitting government.
events.flavor:
"Your task will, foremostly, be to maintain the stability of … for the span of the …'s minority. The royal family is prepared to assume responsibility for raising the child. You may rest assured that you are not being drafted as a surrogate parent."

The emissary paused, awaiting the minister's response.

"I understand," came the reply. "On the matter of education, … is prepared to discharge the necessary sum. What else do you require?"

options.name: … is the obvious choice.
… can be trusted to uphold the monarchy.
We may compromise with ….
Appointing … will be the popular choice.

events.title: The Regency

events.desc: For reasons of ill health, … has declared … unable to discharge … duties as …. The government must determine who will replace ….
events.flavor:
"It is with deep regrets that I..."

… looked at the half-sentence one more time, neatly folded the paper, and slid it into the fireplace. No, unacceptable. It could be misinterpreted, used to slander him as power-hungry. It had to be more neutral. Something that his worst enemies would be unable to spin. He picked up another piece of paper.

"I have felt it my duty to wait upon the Sovereign..."

options.name: Appoint a new candidate from the ranks of the ….
… best reflects the current government.
… has a proven loyalty to the Crown.
Choose the popular candidate - ….

events.title: Indisposed

events.desc: … has reached the age of majority, and may now take the … throne. …'s regency has come to an end.
events.flavor:
… watched as the priest carried out the final anointments. The difference between the … of today and of yesterday was starker than … could ever have imagined. … stood taller than before, with a practiced look of determination on … face. The crown appeared weightless when placed upon … head.

The priest stepped away, and a fanfare played, accompanied by the rumble of cannons from outside the palace walls.

"The things which I have here before promised, I will perform and keep," the … recited. "So help me …."

options.name: Long live the …!

events.title: Coronation Day

events.desc: … … has missed a cabinet meeting of … government and their cabinet members were unable to come to any conclusions on how to proceed.
events.flavor: "How can we expect our citizens to have any faith in the government if our … is not even showing up to cabinet meetings to decide the future of our nation? Apparently, he was out partying with other nobles and only just went to bed a few hours before the meeting was scheduled to begin."

options.name: This is unacceptable behavior for our ….
Maybe he just accidentally slept in.
Print it in the presses.

events.title: … Misses Cabinet Meeting

events.desc: … of the … has asked what is to become of the … should the Government become a ….
events.flavor:
"The Monarchy is one of the core pillars upholding this country. We can't seriously consider the idea of simply getting rid of it."

"We can't have a fair and equal nation if we intend to keep one person elevated above the rest. If he wants to keep his nobility we should send him somewhere far away. The … has no place in our society anymore."

options.name: Have the … abdicate.
Send the … into exile.

events.title: Fate of the …

events.desc: … … delivered a roaring speech in an attempt to forestall the progress of … becoming a ….
events.flavor: "Members of the … government, I plead to you to look into  your hearts, and ask yourselves, should we be the reason for this decision? Do we even have the right to make this decision? Are we really willing to end all these years of tradition? The role of the … is attached to this country as much as anyone here."

options.name: This could complicate things.
Challenge the speech.

events.title: The …'s Speech

events.flavor: The reactions to the announcement were myriad. The …'s supporters, struggling to hold back their defeat and apprehension. The opposition, split between displays of sympathy and excitement over the prospect of claiming … seat. For the house staff, however, all that it meant was another long week of dodging reporters and shuffling furniture.

options.name: Wish … successor good health and good fortune.
A long series of disasters has come to an end.
Call an immediate election to assemble a new cabinet.

events.title: Letters of Resignation

events.desc: With the collapse of civil order in …, … has announced … resignation from the office of …. A power vacuum has emerged in …, and both revolutionaries and loyalists scramble to fill it.
events.flavor:
"The mob have passed through the central district an hour ago. They have lanterns now, but it is a prelude to rifles and bludgeons."

"So that's that. Our rule is lost. Very well then, we shall go to them with our formal surrender. But stay with me for a final drink, old friend. We'll need the courage for what's to come."

options.name: … has surrendered, but … has not.
We are helpless before the coming storm.
There is no time for half measures. Issue emergency powers.

events.title: Hands Thrown Up

events.desc: With the collapse of civil order in …, … … has announced … abdication from the throne of …. A power vacuum has emerged in …, and both revolutionaries and loyalists scramble to fill it.
events.flavor: It was plain to see from the third-storey balcony of the palace that the mandate of heaven had passed to the mob. … was … no longer. Better, … thought, to have stepped down now when the crowds would accept surrender than to be dragged to a noose.

options.name: Our hopes must rest with … ….
Flee across the border whilst there is still time.
… successor must reign with the strength … lacked.

events.title: The Abdication of …

events.desc: A surprise police raid has uncovered a list of radicals associated with the …. There are several ways this list can be used to the government's advantage.
events.flavor:
"They came for us too quickly! We didn't have time to hide everything!"

"Thanks to that, now we need time to hide everyone !"

options.name: Hunt down every member on that list.
Publicly expose the connections between the … and the radicals.
There's only one name on this list we need: ….

events.title: Membership Lists Discovered

events.desc: Climbing losses at the front have led to murmurs of mutiny spreading among the soldiery. If action isn't taken soon, the situation may become critical.
events.flavor: "Sir, have you heard the new threatening chant in the barracks? 'Light out! Knife out! Let him have it!' It's getting ugly, sir. I fear the front itself no longer believes in success."

options.name: Arrest the grumblers and fight on.
We cannot afford to detain any soldiers.
We must stop and let the men rest.

events.title: Anger at the Front

events.desc: A committee of publishers, associated with the …, that produce incendiary pamphlets has been brought before the courts.
events.flavor: "This agglomeration of dangerous men must be stopped! We must take from them the means of provoking the mob, and reduce these arrogant fools to their true proportions, to their real role as little more than obscure conspirators and criminals!"

options.name: Push for their trial in the courts.
Quietly muzzle these publishers.
Let them go. They're harmless.

events.title: Publishing Committee Prosecutions

events.desc: An attempt on the life of the … has killed many, but spared our ruler. A complex device, itself damaged in the attack, is the only trace of the revolutionary left at the site of the attack.
events.flavor: "It's hard to say what happened. I heard a slow explosion, like a ragged platoon fire, and there was smoke and chaos all around. The people to my right and left were cut down where they stood, but I was untouched. I looked off towards the …, and there was just as suddenly a bloody void surrounding …."

options.name: Limit …'s public appearances for a while.
This crime is obviously the fault of ….

events.title: The Infernal Machine

events.desc: Struggling people in … have been desperately trying to get their hands on any food they can. Dire warnings of a 'Turnip Winter' have been speading throughout the region.
events.flavor: "Last week, all we could get was pig's feed. This week... I'm not actually sure what this stuff is. Is that sawdust?"

options.name: At least food substitutes fill people's stomachs.
Try to increase local food production by any means.
We cannot do anything for ….

events.title: Ersatz Food

events.desc: With war consuming the nation, we can and must try to bury our differences. A call to defend our nation may do much to calm down the unrest at home, although we will have to offer something to our opponents to get them to fully buy in.
events.flavor: "In our great struggle, the nation calls upon all her sons to step forth and defend their families, and calls for all party leaders to come forward and pledge that we shall strive on together until the day of victory. This sacred union will not falter, will not break, in the face of hardship and hostility!"

options.name: In war, we shall find peace.
There is no reason to embolden our opponents with empty promises.

events.title: The Sacred Union

events.desc: … …, an associate of the revolutionary …, is known to have some doubts about … convictions. It may be possible to use that hesitancy to the government's advantage.
events.flavor: "Friends! I-it's not that I don't want the uprising to happen, I'm concerned about, you know. It's. I, uh. I'm in a good position, just... oh, what do I do? What do I do?"

options.name: Press the … to support the government.
… cannot be trusted. Arrest …!
… cannot be trusted. Arrest …!

events.title: The Waffling Revolutionary

events.desc: Sailors in … have refused to embark for any voyages out of port. The scope of the mutiny calls for a delicate approach to the situation.
events.flavor: "It's very simple. We have demands. We don't sail until those demands are met."

options.name: Detain the men and keep the incident contained to ….
Force the men onto their ships.
Try to talk it out with the sailors.

events.title: Sailors Stay Ashore

events.desc: With revolutionary support growing in …, it's been suggested that the national gold reserves be moved out to …, where it will be unlikely that rebels can seize the money.
events.flavor: "We do this now, or we lose our last good chance to maintain a stable financial footing should everything come to blows. Yes, I know there's a chance they'll catch us in the act, but that's a chance we have to take."

options.name: Try to smuggle the reserves out of the capital.
Leave the gold reserves in the capital.

events.title: Endangered Gold Reserves

events.desc: The number of revolutionaries in … have made members of the government nervous, and provoked proposals to temporarily move the organs of state to somewhere friendlier, like ….
events.flavor: "Every day I jump at the shadows on the way to my office. I see people staring at me as I go down the street, and I swear I see daggers in their eyes. I can't handle it here anymore! Please, we need to be safe somewhere! "

options.name: Move some government functions to ….
Show confidence in the cause by staying in ….

events.title: Fleeing the Capital

events.desc: A doctor in … has been caught aiding wounded dissidents and revolutionaries. His aid isn't just helping his patients, but it's emboldening the entire rebel movement.
events.flavor: The doctor's defense attorney leaned back, nursing a small headache. The medical man had proven impossible to work with—his attempts at defense had just dug a deeper hole for himself. His waffling was painful, and his refusal to trust his counsel or even his kinfolk had ruined his chances of getting a lighter sentence. His persistent denials had served to only make his name mud.

options.name: Investigate the medical profession in … for sympathizers.
The one doctor was obvious a lone wolf—there's no need to follow up on this.

events.title: The Rebel's Doctor

events.desc: …, a notorious troublemaker, has established … in …. … has used the country's independent law enforcement to avoid arrest by our own lawmen.
events.flavor: A knock on the door still made … tense up, even though … knew … was safely beyond the reach of the law here. At least, … thought … was. Hoped … was.

options.name: Demand …'s extradition from ….
Raid …'s home in … with our own men.
If …'s out of our sight, …'s out of our mind.

events.title: Over the Border

events.desc: Law enforcement from … has requested we hand over …, a dissident living in our country.
events.flavor: "Oh for—! We already pay our taxes to them, salute their flag, and let them boss us around in so many ways, and on top of all that they want this? At this point, why even call ourselves an independent country?"

options.name: We will arrest … for ….
No, we will deal with people in our lands on our terms!

events.title: Extradition!

events.desc: Agents from … were caught attempting to covertly kidnap … and send … back to their country.
events.flavor: "Those guys? Please, they were practically out of some sort of romantic comedy, try to quietly enter the bedroom of someone living on our soil. We have every right to shoot them, if we so choose, the way they were violating our laws. … can go to hell."

options.name: Let the agents free to do their work.
No one but our lawmen act on our territory.

events.title: Illegal Extradition

events.desc: Mobs have surrounded an arsenal in …, threatening to seize the arms and munitions stored within. While the guards are staving off attacks for now, if no relief is sent then the arsenal will fall to insurrectionists.
events.flavor: "I couldn't sleep last night. The commander refuses to accept terms, and firing continues from both the arsenal and the emplacements that now surround it. After one loud blast, I sprung out of bed and went onto my knees to pray, pray as I've never prayed before."

options.name: A relief column could escalate tensions a little, but it's necessary.
The mob could be emboldened by a surrender, but we need to take that risk.

events.title: A Fort in a Sea of Anger

events.desc: Belligerent crowds have been getting increasingly provocative when confronted by troops in …. Hardliners in government are demanding tougher responses, while doves are calling for troops to stand down as the first hopeful step in de-escalation.
events.flavor:
"A 'whiff of grapeshot' saved the day once, and it can be done again—I'm telling you, we need to show strength right now!"

"Strength? Hah! Bullets are an admission of weakness. We need to talk, show that we're not afraid. That's how we'll get them."

options.name: Disperse the crowds by force.
Order the troops to stand down.

events.title: The Mob Approaches

events.desc: Dissidents in … have announced plans for a major march around government offices in the near future. While they profess peaceful intentions and claim everyone will be unarmed, the march itself will obviously serve as a rallying point for those unhappy with the government.
events.flavor: "That damn parade and that infernal music! I can't even see them from here, but I can hear them loud and clear."

options.name: Stop that march by any means necessary!
Let the procession go ahead.
Proclaim a curfew and make sure it's enforced.

events.title: The Procession of Provocations

events.desc: … …, noting severe unrest in …, has proposed using the army to suppress agitation in the area. While … political allies support …, there is a heavy risk to following … plan.
events.flavor: "It's simple—we have an army, and there is the enemy. Let me deploy my men and do what is needed, and the enemy shall be vanquished. That's all there is to it!"

options.name: Reprimand the … and reject the plan.
We must use the tools we have to solve the problems we have.
Perhaps the … can consider a kinder plan?
Brute force may be the best option here.

events.title: When You Have A Hammer

events.desc: Troops in … have reported more and more confrontations with belligerent mobs. Fighting will likely break out soon even if nothing is ordered. There's only two ways to control the situation: Either pull the troops back, or tell them to engage.
events.flavor: The soldier shuffled nervously where he stood, shifting the weight of his gun back and forth as he stared at the crowd stirring far too close by. He thought he recognized some of those faces—or he would have, if they weren't twisted in utter loathing of him and his uniform. What was he even doing? Was he standing with the right people here?

options.name: Order a withdrawal from ….
Order our men to advance on the mob.
Our men are professionals! They can maintain discipline where they are.
The army and the people are one and the same! Let them talk it out.

events.title: The Streetside Standoff

events.desc: With violent sentiment rising amongst the …  …, several … communities have begun to form armed militias to keep their populations safe.
events.flavor: "The soul of the ancient … heroes, wandering in the world of chaos, has finally found its place."

options.name: The authorities have far more important things to worry about.
The … are out of line, and must be disciplined.

events.title: National Self-Defense

events.desc: Following a recent bombing carried out by a radical supporter of the … in …, a copy of the works of … has been found in the possession of the responsible parties.
events.flavor:
"...and if the tragic hour strikes and we must give ourselves up to it, the consciousness of this will support and strengthen us. We do not merely say "no" but from the depth of our hearts we declare ourselves ready to sacrifice everything."

— Jean Jaurès

options.name: The … represent a menace to civil society.
Publicize this incident as … calling for terrorism against innocents.

events.title: Stochastic Terror

events.flavor: "One may say flatly that the … government exists only for as long as the people's council permits it."

options.name: The … state has sole authority over …!
The people of … have learned to stand together against the government's tyranny.
Place … under the direct control of the military.

events.title: Dual Power

events.desc: The … of the …  … have begun organizing into a council in order to advocate for higher wages and better treatment. The … views this as an active threat to their legitimacy.
events.flavor:
Slipping the handwritten pamphlet out of the pocket of his uniform coat, he handed it to his comrade.

"The Sergeant and I have talked about the pay we're getting- and I know you feel the same way. How are we supposed to do our jobs if the generals are feeding all of the money we're owed to their nice white horses?"

options.name: Discipline them all, and bring in replacements from other regions.
Our … should be able to stand for their own interests.

events.title: The Common Soldiery

events.desc: Revolutionary-sympathetic figures amongst the … in … have begun to form peasants' councils to oppose the power of the … in the region.
events.flavor:
"I want to burden the conscience of the affluent with all the suffering and all the hidden, bitter tears."

— Rosa Luxemburg

options.name: The … must learn to stay in their place.
The … must make concessions to keep the peace.

events.title: Self-Organization

events.desc: The crew of the battleship …, formerly stationed at the … in …, have mutinied and fled with their vessel to …. The government of … has refused to extradite the sailors.

options.name: Negotiate with the … government to recover the ship.
The … state is collaborating with the traitors!

events.title: The Flight of the Battleship …

events.desc: A group of petitioners representing the …, led by …, have carried out a march on the …'s currently vacant residence in …. They are refusing to leave the residence until the … agrees to meet with them.
events.flavor:
"Sovereign, this is what we face and this is the reason that we have gathered before the walls of your palace.
Here we seek our last salvation.
Do not refuse to come to the aid of your people; lead it out of the grave of poverty, ignorance, and lack of rights; grant it the opportunity to determine its own destiny, and deliver it from them the unbearable yoke of the bureaucrats."

options.name: Dispatch a representative of the royal family to appease them.
Disperse this clear threat to the …'s life by force!
The … shall embark upon a fast train to ….

events.title: The Petition March

events.desc: A group of revolutionaries have carried out a robbery of a … state bank in …. A significant amount of money has been stolen, and redirected into the revolutionaries' coffers.
events.flavor:
A shot rang out, and the marble ceiling was marred with a new crack. The screams of the bank officials accompanied dust and splinters hitting the floor.

"In the name of the revolutionary executive committee, I declare everyone under arrest! Hands up! Otherwise, everyone will be killed!"

options.name: Order increased security around banks across ….
Rely upon the locals to report those suspected of the robbery.
Dispatch the … to apprehend these criminals.

events.title: The People's Wealth

events.flavor:
"The state has forsaken every right it has to order your blood shed, you must realize this. Even beyond …, people like you and I are organizing to demand an end to this nightmare."

"And it starts with you and I! Us common soldiers, the ones they trust to do their will... what will happen, when they finally see that no one will stand behind them?"

options.name: The … must be loyal to the state above all else.
Those who control the soldiers control the nation.

events.title: Covert Agitation

events.desc: With revolutionary sentiment boiling over across the nation, …  …'s advisors in the … have recommended a package of reforms to appease the revolutionaries.
events.flavor:
"The situation is serious. The capital is in a state of anarchy. The Government is paralyzed. Transport service and the supply of food and fuel have become completely disrupted. General discontent is growing ... There must be no delay. Any procrastination is tantamount to death."

— Mikhail Rodzianko

options.name: This proposal shall save … from the radicals' depredations.
The … will serve as our greatest defenders against revolution.
The revolutionaries cannot be sated - they must be crushed.

events.title: Reforms at Gunpoint

events.desc: Disillusioned members of the … have begun to write poems and stories honoring the comradeship experienced in the recent war with …. They endorse this shared martial spirit as a solution to the present social turmoil.
events.flavor:
"The brutal and bloody apprenticeship of the trenches will mean something. It will mean more courage, more faith, more tenacity."

— Benito Mussolini

options.name: This is the spirit that we need to face our enemies.
Nothing but the ravings of people maddened by war.

events.title: Trenchocracy

events.desc: Despite the revolutionary agitation of …, the … still has certain leaders with strongly reformist sympathies. Assisting them in getting control over the … will serve to combat the revolutionaries.
events.flavor:
"No highly developed proletariat will accept dictatorship, however proletarian its colors, as an instrument of emancipation."

— Karl Kautsky

options.name: It is better our enemies seek reform than revolution.
A socialist is a socialist, no matter how welcoming they try to appear.

events.title: The Yellow International

events.desc: With discontent amongst the … on the rise, ununiformed … members in … have formed detachments to directly repress the revolutionaries.
events.flavor:
The newspaper rested on the table like a dead bird, one of its corners soaked through with spilled coffee. "The masses must not sit quiet for one minute longer...", said the bold black ink on the front page, "...all principled working people must show their support today..."

Its reader rose from his chair and turned to face the door, before reaching for the homemade truncheon that rested beside the paper.

options.name: Plausible deniability is appreciated in this difficult times.
Direct them to show … the error of … ways.
It is the state's power alone to wield the stick against its foes.

events.title: Free Assistance

events.desc: The recent unrest in … has led to a group of citizens in the … to form a nationalist organization dedicated to defending the nation and the … from revolutionary activity.
events.flavor:
The speaker's words burst forth from his mouth in a torrent of fire, issuing the strictest condemnations against the Reds, against the enemies of …, against those peoples deemed unworthy by the black-clad men at the flagpole, their lapels littered with symbols of reverence.

"And how will you make it known that you stood by the … and the righteous …, against the tide of filth?"

Flinty eyes drilled into the crowd, looking for the first onlooker to flee.

options.name: The … people have made a stand against revolution.
We have no care for this demagogue's grift.

events.title: The Union of the … People

events.desc: With revolutionary activities seeming to grow ever worse in recent days, an opportunity exists for the government to draw closer to …'s nationalist movement, and further welcome … influence over the ….
events.flavor: "This meeting does not need to be one between adversaries, but rather between people whose love for … extends beyond all mortal bounds. Even if we have different visions, I would hope that you can recognize that what threatens our nation threatens us all..."

options.name: With … aid, we will bury the revolution.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: We do not require the assistance of rabble-rousers.

events.title: Leaning In

events.desc: Amongst opponents of the revolutionaries, different currents of thought have come to the surface regarding the future of their movement. Radical elements of the … have begun to call for the establishment of a new totalitarian nationalist government to defend against the communist threat.
events.flavor:
"In two weeks the sheeplike masses of any country can be worked up by the newspapers into such a state of excited fury that men are prepared to put on uniforms and kill and be killed, for the sake of the sordid ends of a few interested parties."

— Albert Einstein

options.name: The nation's protectors must take a newer form.
These ideas are simply another modernist aberration.

events.title: Innovation and Loyalty

events.desc: Placing blame upon the … people for the present state of revolutionary turmoil, supporters of … amongst the … have carried mass acts of violence against the … population of … and its neighboring regions.
events.flavor: "What kind of beast cultivates mobs out of common citizens, using fear as bait? In the real world, these weren't the traits of monsters. They were the traits of men seeking power."

options.name: The … culture is, indeed, a threat to ….
These lawless activities have gone past the point of usefulness.

events.title: A Monstrosity of Opportunity

events.desc: As …'s nationalist movement gains prevalence, former socialists who have grown disillusioned with the 'anti-national' tendencies of the … have begun to defect to the nationalist cause. The values of Fascism have become more solidified amongst counter-revolutionaries in ….
events.flavor:
"The rights of the State as expressing the real essence of the individual. And if liberty is to be the attribute of living men and not of abstract dummies invented by individualistic liberalism, then Fascism stands for liberty, and for the only liberty worth having, the liberty of the State and of the individual within the State. The Fascist conception of the State is all-embracing; outside of it no human or spiritual values can exist, much less have value."

— Benito Mussolini

options.name: The fascists can be controlled. The socialists cannot.
Fascism is the future of ….

events.title: The Weapon of the Enemy

events.flavor: "The politicians and the capitalists claim that they can ensure that this crisis is calmed, and the … nation can be saved from the scourge of socialism. At the best, they are foolish idealists. At their worst, they are no better than the Reds themselves. Only an immediate restoration of national strength can save … in this hour of peril..."

options.name: Hail to …, true hero of the nation!
Hail to …, first among the people!
Expel these upstarts from the streets of …!

events.title: The Methods of Modernity

events.desc: In order to avert revolution, … has issued a petition to the … to restore autocratic rule. The assembled … have already signaled their support for these emergency measures.
events.flavor:
"What is the root of …'s glory? It is the willingness of our past leaders to make difficult decisions, and take charge in hard times."

… swept … hand towards the window, pointing out the plumes of smoke in the distance.

"That spirit has been temporarily weakened. But it can be brought back to life..."

options.name: … will be the savior of our nation.
This proposal will do more harm than good.

events.title: The Past's Ideal

events.desc: A minor member of the … nobility has been assassinated by revolutionary forces at his estate in …. The surviving members of his family are demanding reprisals.
events.flavor: There was a shot, a cry, and then everything was still, but for the anguished woman's sobs that would emerge from the parlor a moment later.

options.name: We must not allow this terror to divert us.
Declare a state of national mourning.

events.title: The Spilling of Noble Blood

events.desc: One of the …'s trusted ministers, …, has been abducted by rebels and spirited away to a hidden location. The rebels have declared that … will be executed if the government does not offer them a ransom.
events.flavor:
UNDERSTAND THIS: …'s life is in your hands alone. If … is to die, … blood will lie on your hands alone, along with the blood of so many others of the people of ….

You will have forty-eight hours from the time this letter is delivered to provide to us the needed concessions. Fail to do so, and we cannot guarantee the minister's safety.

options.name: We must pay the ransom that they demand.
If they wish to martyr …, so be it.
Dispatch the Army to rescue the ….

events.title: Minister Taken Hostage

events.desc: An investigation of the … in … has revealed credible evidence of revolutionary activity among the students, aided and abetted by at least some of the faculty.
events.flavor:
"The guilt that we bear is infinitely old, that of the people's oppressors. It is our duty to make amends for such, by devoting the whole of our lives, every act we make, to empowering the peasantry..."

The opinions of the professors were more openly shared, here, in this basement, thought the young student, but they were no more subversive than they always were.

options.name: Shutter the university, and arrest the faculty.
There is no proof for these allegations.

events.title: Tears of the Ivory Tower

events.desc: At an event to commemorate the opening of an ornamental garden in …, a revolutionary detonated an explosive device near …. The … survived, but the assassin died of his wounds before testifying.
events.flavor:
As soon as the bomb detonated and the explosion split the air, the crowd was already on the would-be assassin, heedless of their own wounds, bearing him down, beating him with their bags and fists.

"People of …! I did it for you!", shouted the assassin, but it was to no avail.

options.name: Vengeance upon all traitors and murderers!
We know exactly who arranged this, and exactly who must die.

events.title: Assassination Attempt on the …

events.desc: Whilst … … was riding in a carriage between … and one of … country estates, a revolutionary threw himself under the carriage with a live grenade, slaying both the … and himself.
events.flavor: Then, as if in a dream, a fog, it seemed to me that some young man, of small stature, was in a hurry to get off the sidewalk onto the pavement towards the Sovereign's carriage, and hurled himself towards it, after which there was a deafening explosion. As soon as the crash rang out, the Sovereign, the officers surrounding him, and the observers on the pavement nearby - they, all at once, fell, and a cloud of white smoke obscured them all.

options.name: Scatter the murderer's ashes in a river, and mourn our beloved ….
… will have vengeance upon … …'s murderers.

events.title: Gone in a Flash

events.desc: Prominent members of the … have been found to be using their privileged position in society to encourage radically anti-government activities.
events.flavor: "… is split between two irreconcilable camps.", said the priest. "One of them pursues a policy of anti-… and anti-religious terror! The other side pursues a policy of respect for …, and seeks to restore national order. With this in mind... who else could any good-hearted person stand behind?"

options.name: They are not sacrosanct, as long as they continue to meddle in politics.
We cannot become known as executioners of priests.

events.title: Sedition Amongst the …

events.desc: A group of militants in … have locked themselves in a church, with a stockpile of ammunition and firearms. They have fired upon all government personnel attempting to seize the building.
events.flavor: The church's wood was scarred by bullets, and yet its oaken doors stood firm. Tangled corpses rested on the street outside, from where they had caught the brunt of the first volley. From every window, gunfire blazed, forcing policemen and soldiers to lower their heads below the barricades. A man in uniform turned to another, searching for an answer to the situation.

options.name: Make an example of them - shell the building.
Dispatch a negotiator to make an arrangement with the occupiers.

events.title: Revolutionary Standoff in …

events.desc: A group of women affiliated with the … in … have founded an organization with the purpose of arranging medical and material support for anti-government revolutionaries.
events.flavor:
"The hateful tyrant …, has no authority in our temples, and no place beside our god!" said the veiled woman on the stand.

"We do not recognize the laws of man, for they are as fallible as the men who create them!"

options.name: We cannot afford to make martyrs of women.
Crack down on women's religious organizations.

events.title: The Feminine Order of …

events.desc: The reactionary leanings of many … affiliated with the … have given rise to demands to curb the political influence of … religious organizations.
events.flavor: "I have made my opinions on this clear. All of the monasteries in … are not worth the life of a single … citizen."

options.name: They are holy men and women, and they can say what they will.
Bolt their temples shut, and arrest clergy who resist.
A righteous nation is best found through the revolutionary path.

events.title: Crime and Divinity

events.desc: Armed workers affiliated with the …'s progressive factions have volunteered to assist government forces in countering reactionary forces that would threaten ….
events.flavor: One by one, they took up the gun, father and son, and lo, under a sky without a sun, another page of history comes, as yet more blood runs.

options.name: We will need all of the support we can get.
Demand that this organization disarm at once.

events.title: The … Workers' Brigades

events.desc: Mass mutinies in … within the … under …'s watch have led to officers marching for a new government.
events.flavor: What began as a few disgruntled supply officers and colonels'-in-laws swept through the ranks. Whether strong-armed by their leaders or willing accomplices, entire brigades have joined the mutiny. Their oaths lie trampled in the mud with any who stand in their way.

options.name: Arrest the traitors.
Send them home. Remind them of their duty.
Shoot every tenth man.

events.title: Martial Laws

events.desc: In …, … devotees under … have called for a violent revolt, with … people scapegoated for their current woes.
events.flavor: To be sure one cannot misinterpret the voice of the people for the voice of God, one should mind that the Arch Enemy knows scripture better than they do. Indeed, it is these sweet, silver-tongued sermons that stoke strife. The cost is, invariably, a tidal wave of blood.

options.name: Gag the ringleaders.
Post soldiers outside of … congregations.
Address some of the … concerns.

events.title: Vox Diaboli

events.desc: …, and the … of … have delivered a declaration of intent: all industry production to cease until an amenable government is installed.
events.flavor:
A hostile takeover, in the simplest terms, is when a large company acquires a smaller company against the small company's wishes. To a big enough business, an obstructive government is just another company to be incorporated. Except, now that business can write all the rules.

Just look at the East India Trading Company.

options.name: Negotiate for some subsistence operation.
Open new factories, with our own administrators.
Send in the jackboots.

events.title: Greed Is Good

events.desc: The headline of …'s newspaper announces that every writer, artist, performer and educator in … has quit. The … population has one outlet left for their woes: revolt.
events.flavor:
"Enlightenment" was the name given to the time of great thinkers and artists. Its promise was the advancement of all peoples from the shackles of ignorance and superstition.

Now, there is "Endarkenment," the time of violent ignorance and fearful mysticism. Its promise is the doom of culture, the death of hope, and, perhaps to the survivors at its end, the chance of a fresh start.

options.name: The government will run its own presses.
Perhaps it's time to give more money to the arts?
The university must be restaffed.

events.title: A New Endarkenment

events.desc: Every tenancy of the … in … has rental prices beyond reasonable limits. Their tenants direct their ire at the government for not protecting them.
events.flavor: Humans have two reactions in times of strife: seek culpability for their woes, and address it accordingly. A sign of strength, or fatal stupidity—philosophers could debate until the end of days. They do agree it is not a sign of intelligence. The blame can be shifted, and those culpable profit most of all.

options.name: Seize the ringleaders!
They ought to be charged with extortion.
Rent needs a stern limit.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: Troubles of the Commons

events.desc: Falsified reports from every private and public arm in … have set the government against itself. … has a simple demand: hand over government to the people who know how to get things done.
events.flavor: Not all resistance is based on applying a cudgel to a skull, or a torch to a machine. An effective means is to simply not honor the gentlemans' agreement that is legal bookkeeping. A few fudged numbers here, some out-of-order submissions there; all innocent mistakes in the eyes of a supervisor. When taken together, it may be read as a brainless error or measured destruction.

options.name: We must replace these reports.
They ought to be charged with fraud!
Restart from these falsified numbers.

events.title: Buried in Red Tape

events.desc: With a rich harvest in …, … has a delivery report—zero of everything—with a stern ultimatum: a new order that serves the …, or mass starvation.
events.flavor:
"We're bloody starving. The rats are starving too. Can't even go out and hunt rabbits."

"Look at all that fruit... it's just sitting there, winking at us. Waiting to be picked."

"Why won't the government do something? Rather take my chances with them than Old Man Jenkins' shotgun."

options.name: Seize every farm complicit in this.
Send for supplies from ….
Sell seeds and guides for at-home cultivation.

events.title: Rot of the Vine

events.desc: After raiding army barracks in …, the … under … have begun turning their weapons against the government of ….
events.flavor:
"See, that's just the thing with this nationalist saber-rattling. Most believe their guns only come from this particular law. But what the book's saying is that the Unions aren't going for your guns. In fact, it says to get more."

"You know you can't read!"

"It's Engels, you get credit for trying."

options.name: Concentrate on defending the cities.
Chase them into the hills.
The constabulary must be better armed!

events.title: Under No Pretext

events.desc: Opportunistic members of … have defected to the …'s cause.
events.flavor: Carrion crows pluck from fresh deaths, no matter the cause. Some, however, sense when a still-living beast is about to die. The creature will wait, however long it takes, for said meal to die. But better to be the first there with the choicest pick of meat, than hoping for scraps.

options.name: So be it.
Try to coax some back.

events.title: Vultures Upon a Carcass

events.desc: … mistook an enemy in the …. After accusing them with false charges, moderates in … defected to the …'s cause.
