events.flavor: The briefest flash of anger can make an enemy of a friendly face. It can make even the staunchest allies split each other over a misunderstanding. And once it is cast, there is no going back.

options.name: Their bedfellows may not be so accommodating.
… should stand down.

events.title: Heavy Handedness

events.desc: Stressing the importance of staying up to date with recent military advancements, the government has proposed sending … on a military fact finding mission to …—a thinly veiled plot to distance the quarrelsome general from … increasingly insurgent supporters.
events.flavor: At the approximate moment when the steam lifted away from the mirror, it dawned on … that the government might as well have asked … to find snow in a desert. Had that realisation come earlier, … might have had the good sense to just say, "No." Saying so now would only make … out to be a fool.

options.name: Have … pack … bags. Actually, pack them for ….
Funding … to gallavant around …? No thank you.

events.title: In the Interest of the Nation

events.desc: Returning from the fact finding mission to … with a head full of ideas and a suitcase full of expensive liquor, … is once again free to pursue … domestic ambitions.
events.flavor:
If one chases a wild goose for long enough, one is bound to learn a few things: firstly, that most beasts tire before a human will. And secondly, there's more than just the one thing to hunt. In this case, everything asked for and more upon a silvery platter.

And with a splash of the right drink, any sensible leader would want to hear of these new and terrible wonders.

options.name: For better or for worse, … is back.

rewards.name: Results of the Fact Finding Mission

events.title: An Officer and a Gentleman

events.desc: As the flames of revolution encroach on …, a violent strike has engulfed the … …. Fearing escalation and a further loss of profits, a cabal of … shareholders have petitioned the government for immediate aid, offering the assistance of off-duty … gendarmes stationed across the border.
events.flavor: I've got two hundred men on standby.

options.name: This is getting out of hand. Accept their aid.
Our own law enforcement is capable of handling this.
Let us avoid bloodshed. Adopt a conciliatory approach.

events.title: Our Friends Across the Border

events.desc: Protesting the payment of wages in the form of scrips—credit only exchangable at a company store—workers of the major … in … have commenced a riot, torching the controversial store and marching on the company's main offices, demanding the institution of cash wages.
events.flavor:
"You load 16 tons, what do you get?
Another day older and deeper in debt
St. Peter, don't you call me 'cause I can't go
I owe my soul to the company store"

options.name: The nature of payments is a company matter, break up the riot.

rewards.name: Sided with Industrialists in Credit Matter

options.name: Let us not fan the flames. There is merit to the workers' demands.

rewards.name: Sided with Workers in Credit Matter

events.title: Scrips Scrap Ravish …

events.desc: Ordered to violently suppress a popular riot in …, a battalion of the … garrison have refused their orders, claiming that the execution of such a command would run contrary to the laws of men and … alike.
events.flavor:
"Patriotism? I will gladly raise my rifle against the enemies of …. Should the … come knocking, I will do my duty, as shall we all.
But to raise arms against kin? Against brothers in blood and faith? Sir, this, this we cannot do."

options.name: Insubordination! String up the ringleaders, and jail the rest.
Hush this down. We shall rotate the garrison eventually.

events.title: … Garrison Refuses Order

events.desc: The attempted arrest of a local … in …—charged with inciting violence against the government should his demands for increased worker's rights not be met—quickly went awry as as the local populace rallied around the upstart and threw the dispatched sheriff in a local river.
events.flavor:
"Lettin' the sheriff run off with the …? I think not. I say the sheriff and the rest of his ilk in … can go stuff it.
If you wanna' get to the …, you gonna' get past me. And no offense lad, but I've got thirty pounds on that scrawny husk of yours."

options.name: Send in the army, let them try that stunt again.
Let the … be, and pray this remains a local matter.

events.title: The …'s Feud

events.desc: Emboldened by their earlier success against the law, the … and hundreds of his supporters turned up to confront the army dispatchment now arriving in … - much of their earlier enthusiasm wavering as they spy the soldiers set up two cannon facing the crowd.
events.flavor:
"We promised we'd keep you away from that blasted sheriff, and we did. But this'd be suicide. We've got thirteen men with rifles, and six scores with farm tools. It wouldn't hold against a determined mob, much less the bloody army.
You've gotta' run. We'd fight for you, the lot of us, but I'm not sure we'd die for you too."

options.name: Open fire. Sound the charge. Disperse the rabble.
Give them one day to surrender the criminal and disperse.

events.title: The …'s Stand

events.desc: Did he smash his head into the cell wall? Was he tortured to death? The official story that the …-affiliated revolutionary died from cholera convinces only the gullible and the willfully blind. Only one thing is for certain: his supporters are livid, and they are out for blood.
events.flavor:
"It was the freemasons, I tell you. I've heard it from the butcher down the road that the warden's a member of that accursed cabal. It's them or the …s. Or both. The … is one too, it's why they offed him."

"The … is …?"

"Listen, kid." he says, blowing a cloud of thick smoke into the dimly lit room."There's a lot of things they don't teach you in school."

options.name: "Murderers", cries the crowd.
Only … and the warden knows for sure. Let us kindly ask the latter.

events.title: In the Hands of the State

events.desc: A band of revolutionaries rumored to affiliate with the …, have overwhelmed a minor garrison in …, leaving two dozen soldiers dead, and running off with crates full of rifles and ammunition - even wheeling off a small caliber cannon.
events.flavor:
Wanted: Armory Thieves 

Over 30 men believed involved with theft of artillery and ordinance in …. £200 per man captured or killed; £50 for information leading to the capture or death of culprits.

Believed armed and dangerous. Collaborators will be considered equally guilty.

options.name: Scour the countryside for them.
Scour the cities instead.

events.title: Revolutionaries Raid Arms Depot

events.desc: In a legal case that has grabbed the attention of the whole country a judge has ruled that domestic violence is grounds for divorce.
events.flavor: "He struck her again and again simply for dropping a plate. This was only the latest in a series of beatings, stretching from honeymoon to present day. How can we commit any woman to this endless punishment? Divorce for women in violent situations is not just fair, it is the very embodiment of justice."

options.name: This supports our case immensely.
Let us not celebrate too loudly in case we upset the ….

events.title: A Landmark Case

events.desc: A popular set of travel writings by a female author have been published, lending support for the … law.
events.flavor: "She has traveled all over on her own, it is said she even rides her horse frontwards, like a man!"

options.name: What a great boon for our cause.
Maybe we could get a bigger publisher.

events.title: A … Woman's Travels

events.desc: A recently published paper on 'Hysteria in Women' has been gaining traction in the medical community. The paper is being used as anti-women's rights propaganda against the … law.
events.flavor: "There is no real evidence that 'hysteria' is anymore prevalent in women than it is in men, but for some reason we are the ones who keep getting diagnosed with it."

options.name: This is troubling.
Maybe we can do our own research?
Take the time to release a comprehensive rebuttal.

events.title: A Hysterical Claim

events.desc: The editor of the … … has come forward and offered to support the … law if we help them out with some funding.
events.flavor: "Having articles written in support of it, day in day out obviously is a boon. The true advantage though is not having articles written against it."

options.name: Too expensive.
This is great.

events.title: Newspaper Offers Support

events.desc: Rallies in support of the … law have been taking place around the country, but some of them have been turning violent.
events.flavor: "Of course 95% of the protesters are peaceful, but all it takes is one radical element to set things off and before you know it we have a whole mob whipped up into a frenzy."

options.name: Scale back the rallies.
We will risk a little violence.

events.title: Suffrage Rally

events.desc: Violence by a small group within the suffragist movement is threatening to turn the general population against it.
events.flavor: "Violence and mayhem is their trade and if we let them keep plying it, it's going to do more harm to the cause than good. We cannot stand idly by and let this happen."

options.name: Nothing to be done.
We need to shut this down.

events.title: Fringe Group Violence

events.desc: A grand suffrage protest is meant to take place at factories across the country. It will increase the popularity of the … law but would likely upset many workers.
events.flavor: "It might annoy some of the workers. But a little dissatisfaction among the populace is worth it to get these important issues on everyone's minds."

options.name: Ignore the workers.
We can move our protest.

events.title: Daily Disruption

events.desc: … has proclaimed itself the unifier of Romania, and is seeking to establish a union over the other Romanian principalities in the region.
events.flavor: "We proclaim ourselves to be the true representatives of the nation, the heirs of a rich land and vibrant history. This fulfillment of a holy desire will see us blessed by posterity, and we will brook no resistance from any other state—this is our land, and this is our destiny."

options.name: We welcome this union and will honor our agreements with ….
We did not approve of this! … must be condemned for its actions.

events.title: The Romanian Declaration of Union

events.desc: By our strength and wits, we have taken the first steps in uniting the Romanian nation. The future beckons!
events.flavor:
The reporter began writing the day's experiences down. "Nothing but the liviest demonstrations of joy could be heard throughout the capital. It was the only show that could be seen on all the streets, on all the sidewalks, in all the public places of the city. Our peasant brothers were now shouting with all the energetic power of their souls: 'Long live the nation! Long live Romania!'"

A single joyous tear rolled down his cheek. "Everyone threw themselves into each other's arms, regardless of their station, as if all, in general, had freed themselves from the most oppressive yoke."

options.name: Toți în unu!

events.title: Our Declaration of Union

events.flavor:
"Wake up, Romanians, from your sleep of death," roared the crowd.

"Into which you've been sunk by the barbaric tyrants.
Now or never, sow a new fate for yourself
To which even your cruel enemies will bow!"

Tricolors flapped in the wind. Children were being hoisted into the air to etch the moment into their memories. Together, people were singing a song they had never heard before, but knew the words in their hearts already.

options.name: Unity through life and brotherhood through death!

events.title: Awaken Thee, Romanian!

events.desc: Backed by a great power, … has requested a sliver of territory in …—a territory previously ruled by Moldavia—to grant it access to the Black Sea. Envoys have informed us that we would enjoy the thanks of a grateful Romanian nation if we agreed to this request.
events.flavor: "What sort of state would we be without access to the sea? Cahul, Bolgrad, and Ismail would do much for our prosperity and for your posterity."

options.name: Ceding … is something we can afford to do.
… is and will remain ours, not theirs!

events.title: The South Bessarabian Retrocession

events.desc: The nation celebrates the marital union of … Most Gracious Majesty … … and the charming … of … … of ….
events.flavor: "Today the most august ceremony of the marriage of … Most Gracious Majesty … … was performed in …. It is not to be wondered that these circumstances should make the people of this country, who are naturally and intrinsically a loyal people, suspend their ordinary avocations to join in keeping holiday, and publicly to demonstrate their attachment to the Throne."

options.name: Invite only those of the highest social standing.
A grand public wedding will placate the masses.

events.title: The Royal Wedding

events.desc: … … seeks a match with a partner of suitably distinguished birth.
events.flavor:
"Mother, why can't I marry the …? Why does … have to marry some foreign toff?"

"We're commoners, dear. It simply wouldn't do for the high and mighty to stoop to our level."

options.name: A member of the … house of … would be fitting.
The … of … has a suitable relative.
The … royal family would be an excellent match.

events.title: Seeking a Spouse

events.flavor:
"They say the …'s gone mad. Tried to marry his horse or somesuch."

"What drivel are you reading in the …? These are loftier matters, obviously to do with the … situation."

"It's nothing so complicated. Everyone hates the …, so he's got to go. Simple democracy."

options.name: Host a private, elite coronation.
Hold a grand public coronation.

events.title: Abdication

events.desc: Rubber has been successfully grown in …. The fragile nature of these trees and their difficult to meet conditions make this achievement exceptionally important.
events.flavor: The Amazonian rubber monopoly is finally over! Those beautiful trees have decided to grow elsewhere after multiple unsuccessful attempts, those stubborn little things, and now it is our duty to end those greedy tycoons' empires.

options.name: Bring everyone to … and get to work.
A reason for our existing … to work harder.
Let rubber always drive new growth.
Always concentrate on our existing plantations.

events.title: Rubber Rush

events.desc: The most crucial of … …'s reforms have been passed. The liberal bureaucrats celebrate them as paving the way for modernity in ….
events.flavor: "In the most remote towns, where until now all of the vital interests have consisted of cards, vodka, bribes, and gossip, public libraries, magazines, and newspapers have appeared. Intellectual life has been awakened and revived everywhere."

options.name: The Tsar must be honored for his work.
After reform, revolution.

events.title: The Great Reformer

events.desc: With the end of Nicholas I's reign, … has ascended to the … throne as Alexander II, Tsar of all the Russias. … reign is hoped by many liberal bureaucrats to hail a new era of reform.
events.flavor:
"In the face of God invisibly co-present with us, we accept the sacred vow to always have the welfare of our Fatherland as one goal.

Yes, guided, patronized by the Providence that called us to this great service, let us establish Russia at the highest level of power and glory, may the constant desires and views of our august predecessors, blessed and unforgettable, be fulfilled through us."

options.name: Long live the Tsar!

events.title: The Accession of Alexander II

events.desc: Whilst on holiday, … … has been struck by a bout of rapidly worsening health. Doctors fear for the life of the rapidly weakening ….
events.flavor:
He had been beset by illness whilst traveling amidst the shore of the Mediterranean, betrayed by the salt winds which had been praised for their medicinal nature. He lay wrapped in blankets, shivering despite the sweat that dripped from his brow and soaked the pillow beneath him.

The nurse standing by the bed could hear his words, squeezed through convulsing lips, but could make no sense of them at all.

options.name: His last days must be made warm and comfortable.
Treat him with our most innovative medicine.

events.title: A Bout of Weakness

events.desc: The former Tsesarevich … has ascended to the … throne as Nicholas II. The new Tsar's former tutors have praised … erudite outlook, which promises a liberal and enlightened reign.
events.flavor: "Lord God of our fathers, and King of Kings, who created all things by Thy word, may there be with us the wisdom which belongs to Thy throne; send it from Thy Holy Heaven, that we may know what is well-pleasing in Thy sight, and what is right according to Thy commandment."

options.name: For our guardians of truth, God, do save them!

events.title: The Accession of Nicholas II

events.desc: Tsesarevich by virtue of the tragic death of his elder brother, … has ascended to the … throne as Alexander III. … reign is expected to mark an age of fierce patriotism and anti-revolutionary conservatism.
events.flavor: "Amidst our great sorrow, the voice of God commands us to stand up cheerfully for the work of the Government in the hope of Divine Providence, with faith in the strength and truth of our power, which we are called to affirm and protect for the good of the people from any enroachments on it."

options.name: To the subduer of the proud, grant everything!

events.title: The Accession of Alexander III

events.desc: … has succeeded his father as the Tsar of …. The reign of the newly enthroned Nicholas II is anticipated to bring both economic modernization, political centralization, and reinforcement of the power of the monarchy.
events.flavor: "Let everyone know that, devoting all my strength to the good of the people, we will protect the foundation of our rule as firmly and unswervingly as our unforgettable, late parent guarded it. May the merciful Lord God help us in our task, may he strengthen us, and may he bless us for a long and fruitful life."

options.name: God save the Tsar, and Orthodox Russia!

events.title: The Accession of Nicholas II

events.desc: The wife of … … has birthed a son at last. The newborn … will be raised as the new … of ….
events.flavor: "The baby lay on a pillow of cloth of gold, slung to the Princess's shoulders by a broad gold band. He was covered with the heavy cloth-of-gold mantle, lined with ermine, worn by the heir to the crown. He wept loudly, as might any ordinary baby, when old Father Yanishev dipped him in the font."

options.name: A Tsar is born.

events.title: The Birth of Alexei

events.desc: The difficulties facing the … nation have weighed heavily on … …. … has fallen severely ill of pneumonia, and is refusing treatment.
events.flavor:
"He will not hear our objections. He has traveled to survey his soldiers, through more and more severe frost. He has fallen ill the first and second times, and yet refuses to rest. He can be found in his study, or on the field."

The doctor's eyes flicked to the side, untrusting of the confidence of the hallway.

"This- this is worse than death - I fear that this is suicide!"

options.name: There is no time to waste lying on a sick-bed.
Cajole … into seeking treatment.

events.title: The Illness of …

events.desc: … …, known for his sickly constitution, has disappeared into the countryside astride his motor-cycle. The household staff fear for his health.
events.flavor: The sound of the engine grew fainter and fainter as the bike summitted one of the rolling hills, and vanished behind it. Into the green abyss disappeared the …, racing to escape the slow, warm trickles of pain in his chest.

options.name: Find him, and return him home.
Have him rushed to our new hospitals.

events.title: A Terminal Ride

events.desc: With the end of Nicholas II's reign, his first and only son, … has ascended to the … throne as Alexei II. The young and militant Tsar has declared his intention to expand the long rolls of … military glory.
events.flavor: "Lord God of our fathers, may our heart be in Thy hand, to accomplish all that is to the profit of the people committed to our charge and to Thy glory, that so in the day of Thy judgment we may give Thee account of my stewardship without blame."

options.name: He will drive away the unworthy, and grant us strength!

events.title: The Accession of Alexei II

events.desc: The end of Nicholas II's reign has brought … to succeed his elder brother as Tsar of …. The reserved Michael II's reign is anticipated to herald cautious constitutional reform and responsible governance.
events.flavor: "Inspired, in common with the whole people, by the belief that the welfare of our country be set above everything else, we call upon the Russian people the blessing of God, and accept the sacred vow to protect our Fatherland through the power invested in us."

options.name: To the keeper of the weak, grant everything!

events.title: The Accession of Michael II

events.desc: With the end of Nicholas II's reign, … has ascended to the throne of …. Despite his perpetually ill health, the newly enthroned George I has seen fit to firmly advocate for scientific advancement and modernist reform.
events.flavor: "Lord God, who created all things by Thy word, and by Thy wisdom has made man, that he should walk uprightly and rule righteously over Thy world; Thou hast chosen us as Tsar and judge over Thy people. We acknowledge Thy unsearchable purpose towards us, and bow in thankfulness before Thy Majesty."

options.name: May he be granted long days.

events.title: The Accession of George I

events.desc: With our present leverage over the … government, we have proposed a treaty to draw a formal border in Manchuria, formally transfering … to ….
events.flavor: The articles of this treaty will come into force from the day they are exchanged by the representatives of one and the other state, and must be performed for all eternity sacredly and inviolably.

options.name: Open the territories to greater settlement.
There must be no delay in the expansion of our ports.

events.title: The Beijing Treaty

events.desc: We have begun to negotiate with representatives of …, in order to define a border between our nations in the West. There is much opportunity for territorial gains in the Central Asian region.
events.flavor: It is our imperative to ensure that the lands of the Kyrgyz and Kazakhs, those loyal subjects of Russia, are united under a nation which is capable of providing security from the present state of banditry and petty theft within the region.

options.name: … and … will be sufficient.
The territory of … is also a necessary acquisition.
… territory will be made whole under our protectorate.

events.title: The Chuguchak Protocol

events.desc: By securing …, the dream of … naval dominion over the Pacific has come closer to reality. The city of … will become our new primary port in the East.
events.flavor:
"This port can be considered the best of all. It reminds many of Olga, but only smaller than it, warmer and more pleasant. However, there are the same oaks all around, and the same picturesque mountains. In the lowlands the rivers murmur; there are many springs on the banks. Our post set up the other day, with its white tents, looks good in a group of oak trees that have not yet been cut down and have only just been cleared."

— Sergei Maksimov

options.name: Rebase the Siberian ships, with all due haste.
The port of Vladivostok shall be the finest in our nation.

events.title: The Ruler of the East

events.desc: An intense military buildup in Siberia has spurred negotiations between diplomats representing the … and … states. A treaty has been constructed which will ensure mutual navigation rights on the Amur River, and transfer the territory of … to ….
events.flavor:
"The left bank of the Amur River, starting from the Argun River to the mouth of the Amur River, shall be the possession of the … state, and the right bank, downstream to the Ussuri River, shall be the possession of the … state.

The areas and lands from the Ussuri River to the sea, until the determination of the boundary between the two states, shall be jointly owned by the … and … states. Only vessels of the … and Russian states may navigate the Amur, Sungari, and Ussuri rivers; vessels of all other foreign states shall not navigate these rivers..."

options.name: Let this be carried out exactly and inviolably, for eternity.

events.title: The Treaty of Aigun

events.desc: … increasingly favors …. In response, … has hastened her own diplomatic efforts, providing tokens of respect while quietly reinforcing the obligations of …'s tributary relationship.
events.flavor: Sealed boxes had been set with great care in the Ryukyuan hall. Courtiers whispered behind screens as letters were read aloud: one sealed with the red-stamped script of China, another bearing the careful calligraphy of Japan. With every phrase, they outlined duties and promises, as two powers tried to pull the kingdom their way.

options.name: Issue a formal protest to the ….
Leverage our established ties in ….
Remind the court of our long-standing patronage.
This matter does not warrant intervention.

events.title: Tributary Deliberations

events.desc: The presence of … envoys at …'s ports has drawn the attention and cooperation of many … merchants, strengthening their position in the eyes of the court. Our own sway has diminished in turn.
events.flavor: Merchant ledgers had closed and reopened under different seals. Those who once sought our assurances now lingered in other reception halls, speaking of revised tariffs and safer passage. Coin, it seemed, had found a more persuasive steward.

options.name: Foul play.

events.title: Rivalry at the Ports

events.desc: A general, …, with a retinue of officers, has arrived at …, seemingly to inspect the coastal defenses. Their presence has been acknowledged with respectful submission, strengthening …'s influence at court while subtly eroding our own.
events.flavor: The general strode along the ramparts with … officers, taking note of every cannon and watchtower. The Ryukyuan forces fell into formation, well-aware of evaluating eyes. Every gesture and salute would help tighten the invisible threads woven between the two powers.

options.name: A dangerous escalation.

events.title: Visiting General in …

events.desc: A general, …, with a retinue of officers from … has been received in …, eager to inspect our coastal defenses. Their presence has been acknowledged with respectful submission.
events.flavor: The general strode along the ramparts with … officers, taking note of every cannon and watchtower. The Ryukyuan forces fell into formation, well-aware of evaluating eyes. Every gesture and salute would help tighten the invisible threads woven between the two powers.

options.name: Keep a close eye on them.

events.title: Visiting General

options.name: So it is decided.

events.flavor: Officer Kaimon ran between watchtowers and storehouses, passing orders to the guards. Every command shouted, contradicted, and repeated in quick succession. Though calmness eventually returned, Kaimon had been reminded of how competing missions between foreign powers could expose Ryukyu's fragile situation.

options.name: Tensions are escalating.

events.title: Confrontation in …

events.flavor: Seals and tribute registers had been torn and scattered across the polished floors of Shuri Castle. In the audience halls, the influences of foreign powers were still felt, but no longer dictated action. Ryukyu's path would unfold in the form of a fragile neutrality, gained through patient diplomacy.

options.name: The question of allegiance is settled.
The use of force remains available to us.

events.title: The Ryukyuan Decree

events.desc: With … opening its ports, the long-dormant question of  …'s allegiance has resurfaced. For generations, the kingdom has walked a careful line. Outwardly a tributary of  …, yet quietly maintaining allegiance to …. Both powers must now consider how to assert their influence.
events.flavor: Lanterns glowed along the corridors of Shuri Castle, casting light on vermilion beams which the kings of Chūzan had raised in their great days. Beneath the painted ceilings, clerks laid tribute beside Satsuma decrees. The court had long balanced between investiture from the Middle Kingdom and the shadow of Kagoshima. Calmness endured for now, but the question of allegiance would soon demand its full attention.

options.name: The matter remains unsettled.

events.title: The Hidden Domain

events.flavor: "… by gaslight can be a treacherous place. The papers would have you believe that danger lurks around every corner. But all of that is set to change; with a Peeler patrolman on every street, our citizens will be able to stride confidently in the knowledge that they are protected from the criminal element."

options.name: Medals for all of our brave Bobbies!
…'s finest are on the case.

events.title: The Metropolitan Police

events.desc: A manifesto laying out the arguments for … independence has started to spread in ….
events.flavor: "Should this sort of thing be illegal? It's not arguing for an armed revolution. … independence could be an entirely peaceful process. However, I will say this: If such a revolution comes, this is what they'll be shouting from the barricades."

options.name: Start a propaganda campaign to counter these arguments.
Ban the manifesto.
Pay it no mind.

events.title: Secessionist Manifesto

events.desc: The government has received requests from the … to provide translations of some official documents to their language.
events.flavor: "When you speak of the … as uneducated, you are seemingly referring to those of us who do not speak two languages, but only one—like you."

options.name: It is important that these documents are accessible to all.
They should learn the official language.

events.title: Official Translations

events.desc: A … politician with secessionist sympathies has risen to prominence in the ….
events.flavor: "Have you heard who spoke at their last rally? To think that the opposition gives credence to … propaganda now! The sitting government would never host a speaker like that. Which, incidentally, was the exact argument made in the speech itself."

options.name: A … political leader? Unthinkable!
Anyone can make it in ….

events.title: … Leadership

events.desc: Proponents of the … secession movement have gathered for a public protest.
events.flavor: As the crowd began to gather, a tension seemed apparent among onlookers and passers-by, more than that which would usually be expected at the sight of a political rally. Perhaps the agenda of national independence stirred up thoughts about civil war, or perhaps—more likely—it was simply the unfamiliar feeling of finding themselves outnumbered even momentarily by … people.

options.name: Break it up.
Let them be heard.

events.title: Secessionists Protest

events.desc: …, leader of the …, one of our nation's most prominent … figures, has spoken out in favor of an independent … nation.
events.flavor: "My political goals may have been shaped by my upbringing, but I have never let my … background define them. However, it looks increasingly like it is the only criteria by which … intends to define me."

options.name: Tell the … to keep this traitor in check!
Ignore these pointless ramblings.
Perhaps it's time that this movement is heard.

events.title: … Politician Speaks Out

events.desc: Pointing to the discrimination … people suffer under … laws, the … argue they should have the right to self-determination.
events.flavor: "There are those who say this question is tearing our nation apart, but who can call a nation whole which does not treat its people as equal before the law? Who can blame those who would rather die as first-class citizens of a … state than live as second-class citizens of …?"

options.name: Treasonous slander of our justice system!
It's undeniable that they are not treated equally.

events.title: … Support … Secession

events.desc: The performance of an opera with nationalist revolutionary themes at an upcoming festival is being openly associated with the … secession movement by its proponents.
events.flavor: "Monday, the 23rd, fireworks; Tuesday, the 24th, illuminations; Wednesday, the 25th, revolution."

options.name: Cancel the fireworks.
Cancel the illuminations.
Cancel the revolution.

events.title: Nationalist Opera

events.desc: The militant wing of the … secession movement have claimed responsibility for an explosion at a government building, announcing that the time for open war is rapidly approaching.
events.flavor: "Perhaps we cannot decide if there will be a war. Perhaps we cannot even decide when there will be a war. But perhaps our decisions, while trying to exercise control over these issues, will determine who will be on our side when war comes."

options.name: Our very nation is threatened by the … menace.
We will not let this loathsome act ruin the fragile peace we have.

events.title: Secessionists Bomb Building

events.desc: …, a prominent … political leader, has become a symbol for their independence movement. Senior intelligence officials have devised a plan for dealing with … quietly to set back their cause.
events.flavor: "You may feel certain methods are unacceptable, which is precisely why I would advise you to worry less about methods and more about results. Surely a united …, including its … subjects, is the only acceptable result? Then let me worry about the methods."

options.name: A convenient end to an inconvenient ….
… is not in the business of murdering its citizens.

events.title: Death to Secessionists?

events.desc: Ruling as the hereditary prime ministers of the Maratha Empire, the Bhat family were second only to the Chhatrapati in prestige and power. Now …, the adopted son of the last Peshwa comes offering his sword, promising to expel the British and restore the Empire.
events.flavor:
The soldier cleared his throat but it did nothing to dislodge the lump stuck in there. His forebears had been the thorn in Aurangzeb's side. A mighty force that the Chhatrapati had led to freedom against the Mughal's tyranny.

But it seemed it had all been for naught, for here they were, preparing to fight another fierce foe. Would he make his ancestors proud, or would his actions fall short? The thought fell from his mind as his captain yelled, 'FORWARD MARCH.'

options.name: Lead us to victory, Peshwa.
He may serve the …, but only on the battlefield.
Send him away, the age of the Bhat Peshwas is over.
Baji Rao lives still, offer the position to the last rightful Peshwa.

events.title: In the Name of the Peshwa

events.desc: The catastrophic victory of the Indian mutineers has spurred heated debates within the offices of the Company administration. … … must now decide whether to abandon India alltogether, or to focus dwindling resources on maintaining a foothold on the continent.
events.flavor:
The Governor-General paced the length of his office, the walls barely containing his wrath. His aide stood perfectly still. He did not wish to land up like contents of the general's tea tray, plastered across the map of India.

India, the golden goose they had pinned by the wings, the head, and the tail had imploded on them and all their options reeked. If it were up to him, he would take Calcutta, their first foothold, and leave the rest. Then again, Bombay had cost them dearly, and Madras had much left to offer. A tough choice -BANG!
The aide flinched; the general had fired his pistol into the wall. Perhaps it was time he went to see if there were more messages for the general.

options.name: India is lost. Let Whitehall squabble over our remaining assets.
Fort William must not fall. Redirect all forces to Calcutta.
Company rule will persist in the south. Pull back to Madras.
Bombay holds! Direct all remaining forces to the West.

events.title: The Final Blow

events.desc: The breaking point has been reached. Across India, sepoys are striking their regimental colors and taking up arms against the Company. Joined by disaffected locals of all ranks, they have seized power in cities across the continent.
events.flavor: As the sepoy from Poona fires at his captain, a Muslim lad hands him more bullets. A Sikh sepoy, bleeding out from his wounds, takes in the sight. What would their forefathers say if they saw them fighting together instead of against each other? And then, as the life leaves him, a more pressing thought occers to him; what will their grandchildren say of their actions today? Waheguru, will they be proud? Ashamed? Will they even remember?

options.name: Muster all loyal troops. Strike these rebels down.
… Zindibad! Long live the rightful Emperor!
Har Har Mahadev! Advance the banner of the Chhatrapati!
Vande Mataram! Drive the Lal Patan from our shores!
Khalsa Ji Di Sarkar! The Sikh Empire will rise again!
Forward, let us cleanse the Deccan of the firangi scourge.

events.title: Mutiny!

events.desc: Sepoys in the employ of the … have mutinied against their old masters, throwing British India into disarray. Hawkish members of the … court loudly argue for us to join the rebel cause, so we may oust the British from India together.
events.flavor: Few understand the burden of a crown. Even as every member of his court argues, the Prince knows they await his decision. They might call for war or wish to sue for peace, but they do so freely because they know that if it fails, they can always blame it on him. And who can he blame it on? Who will console him as he lies awake hearing the screams of soldiers who died for his promise of liberty?

options.name: Together we shall drive the firangi into the sea.
Pledge our fealty to the Emperor in Delhi.
The Marathas will rise again, raise the banner of the Chhatrapati.
This is a mistake. Reaffirm our loyality to the Company.

events.title: India in Flames

events.desc: Ever since the adoption of the new, standard-issue Enfield rifle-musket, soldiers across the presidency armies have been complaining that the new gunpowder cartridges taste disgusting.
events.flavor: As the Lieutenant Colonel of the 13th Regiment of Bengal Native Infantry, I faced a conundrum. As the regiment leader, I expected my troops to follow orders as and when I gave them. But, I had bit into the new cartridge myself and barely suppressed a gag. Would it be right to punish them when even I could not rise up to the task?

options.name: A soldier’s life is hard enough, research ammunition improvement.
If they can’t stomach this, how will suffer the trials of war?

events.title: A Matter of Taste

events.desc: Beeswax has been suggested as an alternative to the grease used on the cartridges. The troops are happy with this change. However, some are asking what changed.
events.flavor:
The soldiers sat around the canteen that night, pleased that the company had provided them with better cartridges.

"So, if these new cartridges use beeswax" asked a sepoy, chewing his roti, "then what did the old ones use?"

"What does it matter" replied a young sepoy, "so long as they don’t smell like your mother, I’ll bite into them."

options.name: Explain to the troops that beeswax replaced a factory-made grease.

events.title: A Tasteful Solution

events.desc: Soldiers in the Bengal Presidency have heard rumors that the grease used on the cartridges is animal fat.
events.flavor: The young subedar had not slept all night. He threw up again, panic twisting his gut, 'What if the rumors were true? Had he really bit into cow fat?'' He looked at the temple across the road, 'Would he still be welcome there? What about home? What would happen to his wife? Their son? Or perhaps there was no cause for worry, the Captain had assured them it was just a chemical. The Captain wouldn’t lie to them!'

options.name: Reassure the soldiers it is not animal fat.
Suggest soldiers use their hands to open the cartridges if the taste offends them.

events.title: First Signs of Trouble

events.desc: The rumors have taken root and some soldiers believe the cartridges were, or are, an attempt at forced conversion. They are refusing to fire weapons during drills.
events.flavor:
The Captain was worried, he was sure he had seen some off-duty soldiers following him as he exited the church. A tense air hung over the camp, the native regiments had been acting odd, breaking curfew, sticking together in large groups, carrying their rifles off-duty, and apparently some had refused to follow orders.

He counted the other British officers in the camp, a fair number, could they hold their own if the natives rebelled? A nervous laugh escaped his mouth. No, if it came to that they would be dead before their first reload.

options.name: Punish soldiers with hard labor.
Relieve them of their duty but let the rest continue

events.title: An Unavoidable Mess

events.desc: On hearing that troops have been sentenced to hard labor, sepoys from other regiments have broken rank and attempted to break their fellow soldiers free.
events.flavor:
Cawnpore Garrison.
To General …

Urgent.

Some 50 sepoys have barred themselves in the ammunition hold and are firing at any officers that approach. Trouble began at midnight when they got drunk and attacked their superior officer. Remaining regiments have been disarmed and asked to stay in their barracks. The loyal among them have advised that the mutineers intend to free the troops sentenced to hard labor.

Please Advice!

options.name: Punish all who participate.
Punish all troops.

events.title: The First Domino Falls

events.desc: The benevolent despotism of the … has led to marked improvement in every aspect of public life. The immediate threat of native rebellion has been vanquished, and the Company's rule firmly cemented.
events.flavor:
"Few governments, even under far more favorable circumstances, have attempted so much for the good of their subjects, or carried so many of their attempts to a successful and beneficial issue. A government of foreigners, over a people most difficult to be understood, and still more difficult to be improved, has a right to take pride in itself for having accomplished so much; and most certainly cannot be reproached, by any existing Government or people, with not having effected more."

— John Stuart Mill, Memorandum of the Improvements in the Administration of India during the Last Thirty Years

options.name: By command of … and Parliament.

modifiers.label: Legitimacy from including the Head of State In Government

options.name: Let our rule never be threatened again.

events.title: The Honorable Company

events.desc: The scale of power shifts between the … and the ruling … families. Allegiances have been promised left and right without much thought. Who is the rightful ruler of …?
events.flavor:
"Indubitably, my … our support is to you. As we were bound by your hallowed speech under the oak tree for revolution, we shall stand by you once again for the glory of Serbia."

Bootlicker as he was, his confidence was effortless. The … wondered how he could manage it. His unreliable nature had been public information for some time, now - it seemed that he was the only person in the room who believed in his own credibility.

options.name: The price of loyalty is everchanging.

events.title: A Throne of Thorns

events.desc: Secondborn to a revolutionist, … has been crowned as the new prince of …. The masses think he has more in him than his elder brother.
events.flavor:
"...and our struggle extends beyond worldly matters, as we hold in our hands the divine right to rule and not be ruled." The new prince glanced over to gauge reactions. "I will carry the torch of those before me until the burning light of my soul leaves this mortal shell."

"Time and my right!"

options.name: May his reign be memorable.

events.title: Mihailo's Succession

events.desc: The … has offered us aid in our sacred cause to weaken …'s influence on people. Descendents of deserters shall not have a voice in ….
events.flavor:
In a quiet valley of the village of Takovo, … and his fellow folk walked out of the congregation, as he declared a Serbian uprising against the Ottomans.

The year was 1815. Those who named themselves "heroes" have already fled to find shelter under the wings of their foreign masters. One of them was Karađorđe, …'s father.

options.name: This should be sufficient.
In unity, there is strength.
Philanthropy is the essence of faith, isn't it?

events.title: Clerical Publicity

events.desc: We have been given the opportunity to produce pamphlets to defame the ….
events.flavor:
There is a fine line between propaganda and slander. And for sure, the former has the potential to be a politician's deadliest weapon. A pamphlet sample made by a renowned artist and calligrapher was presented to the Prince that morning.

Holding the paper, he observed that under many mischievous 'facts' written on top, there was the patriarch of the … on all fours, chewing on thigh meat that was captioned as 'a Serbian Peasant' in the local tongue while being ridiculed and commanded by an Ottoman pasha.

options.name: Ingenious.
Start the production, now!

events.title: Slander Pamphlets

events.desc: It emerges that …, leader of the … has been working secretly to persuade other politicians in favor of …'s vile campaign.
events.flavor:
Banquets serve as important gatherings where various unspoken dynamics unfold. They often involve negotiations, displays of influence, slurping sounds of gluttonous megalomaniacs, and the ever-present competition to maintain prestige among peers. 

Navigating the complexities of individuals who present different facets of themselves is both a challenging and rewarding endeavor.

options.name: Make him disappear.
Force him to work for us.

events.title: Exposing Hypocrites

events.desc: Irregular troops under the command of … have been harassing … and … neighborhoods.
events.flavor: "You know how they are, my …. They used to enjoy raiding Ottoman trade caravans and aristocrats, but all they have left now are peasants without anyone to protect them." the advisor shooed the messenger with a swift gesture before proceeding "Karađorđe was one of them during the years of rebellion, now his son is trying to keep his father's friends happy."

options.name: Let them be, or they will turn to their own for loot.
This cannot continue.

events.title: Renegade Hajduks

events.desc: A band of rebels in … have been demanding us to abdicate the throne to …. They pose no critical threat, but how they're dealt with will send a message.
events.flavor:
Empathy is an attribute all remarkable leaders must possess. Having rebelled against undesired oppression, the Prince knows very well the meaning of taking back what's actually yours.

"Nothing short of a group of young, gullible rascals they are." he murmured while peeking out the window. "We were at least fighting for the future of our nation, not for a man."

options.name: Make sure they're properly silenced.
Arm loyalists and send them in as a show of strength.
No need for bloodshed, everyone has a price.

events.title: Urban Rebels

events.desc: Dire news of Magyarization in … has reached us recently. Certain Serbian villages await support from their brethren over the river. This is a valuable opportunity to bolster our stance against ….
events.flavor:
The aidant untied a string that tightened all envelopes together, before opening the top-most one to read aloud.

"To his Most Excellent Majesty, … of House …, … of all honorable Serbs.

May it please your greatness,

I am writing humbly on behalf of our unworthy, but loyal village to ask for a return of favor. As you might recall, yet not in actuality, but we were there during your revolutionary victory against the Ottomans with whatever we could send..."

options.name: Send them help to resist back.
Invite over to their real homeland and help them rebuild.

events.title: Plea for Aid

events.desc: One by one, the lackeys of the … have betrayed them on their path to a terrible fate. All have seen the indisputable; … belongs to the …!
events.flavor:
"Is this how you treat your saviors?" panic and desperation echoed throughout the hall "My father led this country to freedom while you were all hoarding riches. You will never understand what it means to carry the blood of a hero!"

Loyal hounds were awaiting judgment.

"Never!"

options.name: You shall share the fate of your father.
Do not ever set foot on Serbian soil.
Mercy is a gift given only to true leaders.

events.title: Here to Stay

events.desc: Just as their father delivered them from the brink of destruction, the … has reigned supreme against the … tyranny. The throne of … now belongs to them.
events.flavor:
"Comrades! Sacred mothers! We are now free from the grasp of nesting politicians who do nothing for the sake of our homeland..." exclaimed the new … of …. 

Recalling his father's heroic pursuit of freedom, the crowd kept on cheering, eager to heed the final judgment. 

"...and what say you for the fate of betrayers?" the Prince paused briefly, confident that whatever next came out of his mouth, they would comply without question.

options.name: "...shall we send them to meet the Lord?"
"...are we to keep feeding them?"
"...will mercy be their final judgment?"

events.title: The Reckoning

events.desc: The protagonists of the infamous blood-feud between the houses of Obrenović and Karađorđević are no longer a threat to each other. Now is the time to move on as a united nation without petty quarrels.
events.flavor:
"It is unwise to divide a realm for the sake of transient discords of families. That is why solidarity is the essence of progress as distractions have always been known to lead men astray from the straight path.

Besides, infighting ordinarily causes suffering to those whose only responsibility is to pay taxes. 

Gentlemen, we have a nation to build!"

options.name: Long live Serbia!

events.title: No Reason to Fight

events.desc: Preparations for a nationwide campaign have commenced to boost our popularity and tarnish the … in the eyes of the general public. We need to decide on the level of expenditure.
events.flavor:
"...and the honorable … … is sending his gracious regards to all of his subjects.

We will now begin to choose volunteers for the parade."

Strapping young men, followed by overly hopeful town gals, eagerly set forward to gather at the established grounds. This was an unrepeatable opportunity to be noticed by royalty and perhaps get saved from carrying hay or riding mules to fields for a life.

options.name: What's the point if we're the ones to pay?
Pay what is necessary.
Spare no expense.
Perhaps this isn't a good initiative after all.

events.title: Campaign Planning

events.desc: Our campaign organizers have brought up the idea of supporting an interest group to gain more loyalty.
events.flavor:
One by one, representatives from certain circles entered the court to discuss their shortcomings. It was always the same ones, too.

A peculiar circumstance the …'s advisors noticed during these meetings was the hectic competition among the groups. They quickly realized the potential to exploit this race for greater political power and were fully aware that this was a transaction, not a gift.

options.name: We shall promote ….
Let's bring … with us.
Endorsing … will benefit us in the long run.
That honor belongs only to us.

events.title: …'s Accord

events.desc: We have arrived at … to address the common folk's needs and paint them a brighter future. They eagerly await to heed our promises paid by the campaign funds.
events.flavor:
The officers delivered carefully prepared and memorized speeches that ignited national pride in the hearts of listeners.

Their goal was to engage the crowd before … …'s brief final address, concluding the event with a gift to the community to solidify his position in the hearts of the people and on the throne.

Supporters of … will not be pleased with this.

options.name: Well-being of everyone, before all else!
… deserves a better foundation.
All should be able to read the treacheries of Karađorđe!
Together, we are stronger!

events.title: Campaigning in …

events.desc: After an exhausting campaign, the royal entourage have brought us back to the palace. We may proceed with our daily affairs.
events.flavor:
The creaking of the wagon wheels turning on the stone road slightly muffled the cacophony of cheers from the people as their supreme … returned home.

He allowed himself to close his eyes and daydream about sleeping in bed for a while. However, it quickly morphed into a nightmare, reminding him of the snakes beneath it working for ….

options.name: They must've remembered who their real … is.

events.title: Back to the Palace

events.desc: The … is in a period of steady decline. If we do not reassert … sovereignty and reclaim our place among the Powers of the world, we risk catastrophe.
events.flavor: We have fallen, but we can rise again. In an Auspicious Incident we deposed the Janissaries who had maintained their miserly grip on power for centuries, finally allowing reform to be possible. There is much more to do. First, of course, we need to replace the Janissaries with a truly modern military force. But in addition, we must restore the place of the Sublime Porte as the very height of civilization. Education, urbanization, and sovereignty shall be the top items of the … agenda.

options.name: Great reform is needed.

events.title: The Sick Man of Europe

events.desc: The … has successfully modernized and re-asserted itself on the world stage. A new era begins for the … state.
events.flavor: Sublime. That is the only word for it. To walk the streets of Istanbul and see modern factories and schools, to see the guards practicing their military drill. A landscape once dominated by peasant farmers is now littered with shining cities. And to think that only a few decades ago the empire was on the brink of collapse! Where once the European powers looked upon us with pity and greedily sought to partition our lands, now we see their diplomats gazing in awe at our accomplishments, forced to recognize us as equals. God is good!

options.name: The army could use additional reforms.
We should re-conquer the Balkans!
Follow through with urbanization.
We will reap the benefits of education.
Our empire runs on paper.

events.title: Tanzimat: The Reorganization

events.desc: The … has failed to modernize and re-assert itself on the world stage. The vultures begin to circle as the last days of the … draw near.
events.flavor: The Sublime Porte falls silent. Just days after announcing … intention to abdicate, most likely under the duress of … ministers, the … has been found dead in … chambers. Much like our precious empire, the … had been suffering from a long, creeping sickness that ultimately made … unable to bear the weight of the crown. A broken and deranged shadow of … former self.

options.name: We belong to Allah, and to Him do we return.

events.title: The Dead Man of Europe

events.desc: In a great feat of diplomatic and political performance, the … has invited the country's elite and foreign representatives to a lavish wedding for the prince.
events.flavor:
The courtly chronicler in the Maharaja's employ records the festivities in great detail:

"Fireworks of all kinds were displayed. A moving throne and 'Shalabagh' which were adorned and decorated with various kinds of flowers ... were carried over the shoulders of about 100 men.

options.name: Welcome the foreign delegates.
Secure our role on the global royal stage.

events.title: More Than a Wedding

events.desc: Whilst our generals attended the royal wedding, forces from … have made an attempt to seize territory in ….
events.flavor:
I was in Lahore when word reached the Maharaja about the Emir’s attack on his fortresses. I could tell you the hour of the day for the festivities came to a sudden end. For a moment, the whole city fell quiet.

And then, I heard a loud, commanding voice shout the war cry that had terrorized enemies of the Sikhs for decades, "Jo bole so Nihaal"; those who say it are blessed. And every soldier in the Khalsaji replied with the familiar answer, "Sat Sri Akal", God is the ultimate truth.

options.name: Encourage more soldiers to join our forces.
Have the Khalsaji strategize our next move.

events.title: … Attacks

events.desc: The Maharaja has passed away suddenly in … sleep. The nation mourns our loss.
events.flavor:
In the courts of … …, the news of …’s death was celebrated. "The lion is dead," the ministers cheered, "Punjab will be ours."

But many noted that the … did not partake. "The Lion of Punjab has left behind strong cubs, but will they hold against the Company?", one of … wives heard … ponder, "Or will we soon have the British knocking at our doorstep?"

options.name: May the Maharaja's legacy live on.

events.title: Death of the Sher-e-Punjab

events.desc: … has been vocal in … disapproval of … …'s rule.
events.flavor:
For hours, men have been debating the reports from across the Sikh border in the offices of the British East India Company in Delhi. The committee head has grown tired but then an idea comes to him.

"Or perhaps... we do nothing," he suggests.

"Nothing?" a young man asks.

"As we have recently learned, few moments are more precarious for an empire than transitions of power. This is true for the Sikhs as well. The head of their pride is dead, the cubs have much to prove, and the hyenas are already biting at their feet. Why should we play our hand? Let them wear each other out."

options.name: Suppress … criticism.
Let … express … disapproval.

events.title: Threat of Rebellion

events.desc: A mysterious, crippling illness has rendered … unable to keep … throne. Intense speculation about the circumstances is circulating among the ruling elite.
events.flavor:
The young palace servant returned home to find his whole family present. Everyone had questions for him.

"Did the … drink … to death?" asked his judgemental mother.

"It must be an assassination," proclaimed his zealous father.

But the man cared neither for these questions nor those of his siblings, uncles or aunts. He wished only to sleep and never wake. Only then would his mind stop asking him - what was in the drink the wazir had him deliver?

options.name: The people will mourn this loss.

events.title: Untimely End

events.desc: … … has been hit by falling masonry on … return from … father's funeral. The Wazir insists the … is gravely injured and nothing can be done.
events.flavor: The people gathered on the streets. The same thoughts running through all their minds. Maharaja Ranjit's death was dismal, but he was old. Kharak's death was concerning, but Waheguru must have deemed it so. But if … died a day after … father, then it was time for despair. How would a child protect them? Would they fall to the Afghans or the Company first?

options.name: Listen to the Wazir.
Do everything to save the Maharaja.

events.title: A Grave Injury

options.name: Alas, the legacy of the lion is no more.

events.desc: Our country has survived years of turbulence and is not a subject to another nation. The Sher-e-Punjab's legacy will live on.
events.flavor:
"I wonder what Maharaj Ranjit Singh would say if he were to see us now," the young soldier in the Khalsaji asked. "Would he be proud of our steadfastness? Or would he be disappointed in our achievements?"

"Our people have a home and a future, hopefully, a peaceful one." The captain replied, "I think the Lion would be proud that his work has secured a home for his children."

options.name: More days of glory are ahead.

events.title: Legacy of the Lion

events.desc: The young … who was deposed after the fall of the Sikh Empire, has now resurfaced.
events.flavor: The court was abuzz with the arrival of the Landless Prince, though they dared not call him that to his face. The young lad was handsome and polite and had the court’s sympathy. Raised without parents, he was a prince with nothing to rule. But he never seemed to let this bother him. Then again, some wondered if he understood the true extent of all he had lost.

options.name: Perhaps he will find his purpose.
He's sure to be welcomed someplace with open arms.

events.title: The Last Maharaja

events.flavor: "Waheguru, Waheguru, Waheguru", over and over, was all that could be heard across the palace grounds. The sound of grieving by those loyal to the now faceless …. The rest were quiet. Those who had detested the man were scared of the ramifications. Those loyal to Duleep, worried for his safety. And the rest were tired, tired of the ceaseless death that seemed to haunt them.

options.name: "What treachery!"

events.title: Blown Away

events.desc: The brutal court intrigue consuming the … has claimed another victim. The short-lived … … has been found dead in … chambers, …
events.flavor:
"What do you mean, no one wants to work here?" the palace cook shouted. His servant, a mother of two, met his eyes, unflinching. "They think the place is cursed," she replied, "and, well, you can hardly blame them. No amount of gold can rid the stench of death that hangs over these stones."

The cook let out a deep breath, "No, no it can't. What do you suggest we do then? Starve the new King?"

"Everyone may eat at a Langar, king or peasant," the woman replied. "If the food won't come to the King, maybe he can go to the food."

options.name: An untimely end.

events.title: Cut Short

events.desc: The … in … have begun experiencing an epidemic of pébrine, a lethal silkworm disease. With the disease decimating entire silkworm farms, this outbreak puts the entire … silk industry at risk.
events.flavor:
"Yes, every single one of them from the latest batch. Covered in brown spots, and dying one by one. There's not a strand of silk among them."

The same report had begun to trickle in from nearly every farm in …. Thousands upon thousands of silkworms afflicted. Shrunken, lethargic, poor development - and not a wisp of vital, priceless silk spun.

options.name: We must act at once.

events.title: The Pébrine Epidemic

events.desc: The ongoing pébrine outbreak has spread to the … in …. The rapid spread of the disease through … silkworm farms is presenting more and more danger to the silk industry.
events.flavor:
The first round of eggs that had hatched this week had a slightly elevated rate of mortality, which had partially inoculated those charged with watching over their invertebrate flock.

It had not, however, prepared them for the next one. Where before high-grade silk was spun, now withered, brown-spotted larvae struggled in their cells, on an inevitable track to eternal stillness.

options.name: Invest further into a potential solution.
The disease will burn itself out in time.

events.title: Pébrine Outbreak in …

events.desc: The outbreak of the silkworm disease pébrine in … has spread to … soil. The … in … have begun experiencing mass deaths amongst their silkworms.
events.flavor:
"Yes, every single one of them from the latest batch. Covered in brown spots, and dying one by one. There's not a strand of silk among them."

The same report had begun to trickle in from nearly every farm in …. Thousands upon thousands of silkworms afflicted. Shrunken, lethargic, poor development - and not a wisp of vital, priceless silk spun.

options.name: We must act at once.
Damn this … negligence!

events.title: Pébrine Outbreak in …

events.desc: The … which own the … in … have approached the government, requesting reimbursement for the losses of profit they have suffered due to the pébrine epidemic.
events.flavor: "For much time, now, we have had to expend great sums of money and labor ensuring the successes of our endeavors, only for them to be afflicted, through no fault of any man, by a malady which threatens the very foundations of …'s natural environment. To fail to act in this time would be singularly catastrophic to the future of the common welfare..."

options.name: Their industries are vital to our nation.
We do not reward negligence.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

events.title: … Request Reimbursement

events.desc: A group representing the … has requested state investment in developing a process to create synthetic silk, as an alternative to the pébrine-wracked silkworm industry.
events.flavor:
"...and in the case that the cause for this malady is not found before our entire industry is upended? I ask you to, at least, consider it."

"One day, we will be able to produce whatever we wish from a chemical still - and we should not abandon the opportunity to begin that course with all due haste."

options.name: A worthy investment in this time of crisis.
We will not threaten our silk industry further.

events.title: The Synthetic Solution

events.desc: The … of the … in … have been affected significantly by the loss of their silkworms to pébrine. They have petitioned the government for financial assistance to replace lost wages.
events.flavor:
"Man becomes great exactly in the degree in which he works for the welfare of his fellow-men."

— Mahatma Gandhi

options.name: Who are we to deny them aid?
They can find alternative employment soon enough.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: Aid for Silkworm Farmers

events.desc: Following research into the nature of pébrine, we have successfully discovered both the fungus that is the cause of the disease, and a method to prevent it from spreading through silkworm farms. We are now capable of applying the discovered methods to clear our farms of the infection.
events.flavor:
"...it is created there again by the bad seeds that are prepared there or that are imported there, and the day when we raise, in a locality of great culture, only seeds deprived of corpuscles, almost all the generations there will be guaranteed against pébrine and will become, not to mention consider that this disease, clear to reproduce."

— Louis Pasteur

options.name: We are once more at the fore of world science.
Share the cure with other affected nations.

events.title: The Root of the Problem

events.desc: After discovering a method of reliably separating out pébrine-infected silkworm eggs, … has publicized the process internationally. By following the steps outlined in the released papers, we are now capable of replicating the … successes in the field.
events.flavor:
"From 4 to 6 o'clock in the evening, all the couples are arranged separately on the small cloths, then immediately afterwards they are discarding throwing the males, without worrying about their more or less corpuscular state. After the females have laid eggs, they are each locked up in a corner of their linen with the aid of a pin, preferably passing it through the wings, so that the moth cannot travel."

— Louis Pasteur

options.name: Send their scientists our thanks.
We will not become obligated to them.

events.title: … Shares Pébrine Solution

events.desc: With diligent effort on the part of both our scientists and the silkworm farmers who applied their solution, our silk industry has recovered from the pébrine epidemic affecting it. Our new knowledge of the cause of the disease will benefit us for many years to come.
events.flavor:
Finally, the cells were filled once again with cocoons, the worms within unwittingly undergoing the metamorphosis that would soon be cut short by a bath of boiling water. A worker passed between the racks of wooden cells, the shadow of stress almost removed from his brow.

His list of tasks had been lengthened, of course, and his pay raised only fractionally - but it was certainly better than not having a job at all.

options.name: A toast to our scientists!
Reactivate our silk industries - there is no time to waste.

events.title: The End of the Pébrine Epidemic

events.desc: As a show of support and national unity, the … have come to endorse the …'s slate of candidates for all upcoming elections, rather than their own party's.
events.flavor: "In this time of ever-present crisis, there is no one that I would rather stand behind than the …, and no party that I could support over the …. So say we all."

options.name: They will all come to stand behind us in time.
Uplift the … as an example to us all.

events.title: The Party of …

events.desc: As the process of building a … continues, many members of the … have begun asking questions about how best to increase popular participation in party work.
events.flavor: "We must have faith in the masses and we must have faith in the Party. These are two cardinal principles. If we doubt these principles, we shall accomplish nothing."

options.name: We must focus on establishing a framework, before we can expand.
It is crucial that the Party incorporates the whole people.

events.title: The People and the Party

events.desc: Condemning the efforts of the … to establish a …, protesters largely affiliated with the … have begun a multi-day occupation of the streets in cities across ….
events.flavor:
The streets of … were a sea of voices, slogans waxing and waning as the organizers conducted the chorus. Their voices would echo through the streets, reverberating through windows, reflected in the badges of the policemen which formed their lines in front of them.

Tonight, the streets of … were alive - but something else could be seen in the eyes of every protester. Grim determination, and the fear that this night would be the last.

options.name: Call upon our loyalists to demonstrate support.
Such things demand the truncheon, and little else.
We must spend more time educating the people on our system.

events.title: The Streets Alive

events.desc: The efforts of the … to liquidate the remaining bourgeois parties in … have been frustrated by fierce resistance from far-right elements sympathetic to the ….
events.flavor:
The soot had covered the front of the …'s headquarters, deposited from the short-lived inferno released by the flaming oil that had been thrown against the facade. Broken glass crunched underfoot, as militiamen moved to secure the building once more.

It was clear that this was not a simple act of vandalism. This was a reaction to the ongoing revolution - an act of war against the proletariat.

options.name: We must focus on our own agenda, first and foremost.
Tear the fascists down, before they can hide!

events.title: Halting the Revolution

events.desc: The attempts of the … to consolidate their rule over … have been frustrated by fierce resistance from socialist elements sympathetic to the ….
events.flavor:
"We must not accept this reckless empowerment of reactionary forces in society! The task of the party of the proletariat is to bring together the working peoples, towards a cohesive front of the whole proletariat. Come, workers, peasants, lovers of freedom and democracy... stand against the fascist tide, and save yourselves!"

The torn poster was only visible for an instant through the grimy water of the puddle it rested in, before yet another boot drove it beneath the surface.

options.name: The nation's path is ours alone.
Repress the Communists, whatever it may take!

events.title: For the People Alone

events.desc: With many affairs of state frozen by the …'s efforts, communist militias under the command of … have seized important buildings across …, proclaiming the end of "bourgeois dictatorship".
events.flavor:
It is our task to abolish the old and institute a higher form of democracy, one which will arouse the masses of the exploited proletariat to making new history.

Those who employ others for profit; those who live on incomes not derived from their own work – interest on capital, industrial enterprises or landed property; private business men, agents, middlemen; monks and priests of all denominations; ex-employees of the old police services; lunatics and criminals... all of these are not welcome within the party of the people.

options.name: All power to the proletariat!
Avert this coup at the gates!

events.title: Reform Through Revolution

events.desc: The … have locked the doors of … with the legislators inside, and immediately put forward a motion to radically expand the powers of the present government. Opposition has been silenced by brown-clad fascist paramilitaries in the galleries.
events.flavor:
Section 1:
In addition to the procedure prescribed by the constitution, laws of … may also be enacted by the government of ….

Section 2:
Laws enacted by the government of … may deviate from the Constitution as long as they do not affect the institutions of …. The rights of the … remain unaffected.

options.name: Only the … can save …!
Damn the consequences, this is not democracy!

events.title: The Enabling Acts

events.desc: Our architects and engineers have identified … in … as the optimal site to begin construction of a Skyscraper.
events.flavor: "Gentlemen, we are going to erect the tallest building in the world. The foundation alone will need hundreds of men, more if they will not work twelve hour shifts. Every day we will need to transport thousands of bags of cement into the heart of a metropolis. We must secure an immense quantity of steel that must, like Atlas, hold the weight of a whole world. The task ahead of us is monumental."

options.name: Lay the foundations.

events.title: Skyscraper Site Identified

events.flavor: "My skyscraper would not have been possible without the hard work and grit of the thousands of people who dedicated themselves to its construction. Of course as Chief Architect I had perhaps more impact than most. One might even say the lion's share of the credit is mine. In fact, this pinnacle of human achievement, this new Babel, was borne entirely from the machinations of my mind. Look upon my works all ye mighty, and despair!"

options.name: A magnificent achievement.
… architecture is second to none.

events.title: Touching the Sky

events.desc: A small group of people have been caught instigating a slave revolt in …. However, local slaveholders believe this to be signs of a much wider-reaching conspiracy and demand suspects punished.
events.flavor: "We may only have found two men, one gun and a lot of talk, but give it some thought. Wouldn't a unprovable wide-reaching conspiracy, spreading its tendrils invisibly throughout the city, be exactly the sort that could precipitate a successful uprising? Is the possibility itself not reason enough to make examples of those who may be involved?"

options.name: We cannot take any risk with such subversive activities.
Such ruthlessness would be better applied to exorcising your own demons.

events.title: A Small Conspiracy

events.desc: Small communities of fugitive slaves, hidden away in remote areas of …, have become targets of local slaveholders fearing they could assist in potential uprisings.
events.flavor:
He took the first watch. Soon, small nighttime sounds became distinguishable from what had at first felt like complete silence. Sounds of the trees and the marshland, wind and water; safe sounds.

He had always liked to listen to the night. Even back at the plantation, this silence, or as close to it as you ever got, had been a source of solace. Now, however, it meant something more: Every night of silence was another night of freedom.

options.name: The very existence of such places undermines the authority of our institutions!

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: What would they expect to accomplish by hunting down people in the middle of nowhere?

events.title: Hidden Communities

events.desc: … from the … has been touring … recently, both gathering testimonies for and propagating the abolitionist cause. Slaveholders in the state view this as an attempt to agitate a violent revolt among slaves and demand … be expelled from the state at once.
events.flavor: "Oh, you consider … a 'moderate'? Have you heard … speak? … may not openly talk of the slaves rising up against their masters, but in every speech, the indictment of the institution itself and everyone who supports it is so severe that it is difficult to imagine an audience sympathetic to the cause drawing another conclusion. Slaves may not be permitted to listen, but even hearing that such speeches are being held here will embolden them. It is but a matter of time, mark my words."

options.name: Well-founded concerns. … is a troublemaker.
Speaking about liberty and justice must always be permitted.

events.title: Visiting Abolitionist

events.desc: For centuries the … people have toiled under the yoke of the whip, ever while yearning for freedom. With the establishment of an independent …, that faint hope is now a mere pen-stroke away from becoming reality, as a proposal for an emancipatory constitution have been presented to the ….
events.flavor:
(1) The people inhabiting … hereby agree to form themselves into a free state sovereign and independent of any other power in the universe.

(2) Every resident person in the territory of … is free in full right.

(3) Slavery in … is forever abolished.

options.name: Freedom from slavery shall be enshrined in the constitution.
Who then shall work the fields? I think not.

events.title: A Constitution of Freedom

events.desc: Slaves on one of our nation's mercantile ships have risen up, seized control of the ship, and sailed to nearby …, where slavery is illegal.
events.flavor: "It is not up to foreign courts to decide the status of these people who sailed under the flag of our nation. Never can this right justly belong to another country, no matter the cause!"

options.name: Issue a strong protest.
It's out of our hands now.

rewards.name: Did Not Protest Slave Ship Loss

events.title: Slave Schooner Mutiny

events.desc: A significant group of slaves have risen up and made for the borders of …, where slavery is illegal.
events.flavor: "It is the duty of this government to seize and arrest fugitives and remove them to the territory from which they fled. Now go out there, and do your duty!"

options.name: We shall fund the capture of all fugitives.
We will pay for nothing.

events.title: Escaping Fugitives

events.desc: Slaves have risen up in …. They are not a significant force yet, and there are multiple ways to approach them.
events.flavor: "We want freedom! We want retribution! Does that really surprise you? Those who deny freedom to others, deserve it not for themselves."

options.name: Negotiate with the revolt's leaders to defuse this.
We do not negotiate with insurrectionists.

events.title: The … Insurrection

events.desc: A group of escaped … from our colony of … have successfully reached the … mainland after stowing away on a trade vessel. By law, all enslaved people who touch … soil are made free.
events.flavor:
… sat on the edge of the dock, swinging … feet over the surface of the water. The sunset tinted the water red. Fitting, given today's news. … had seen it in the paper, plastered on walls, on the lips of the passers-by.

A voice sounded from behind …. … recognized it—…, another clerk at the courthouse.

"What are you thinking about?"

"In …, they recoil at the idea of people in chains. But they do not spare a thought for those beyond that horizon. One day, … will punish us all."

options.name: They are entitled to all rights of free men.
Free or not, they must return to ….

events.title: On Home Soil
