events.desc: …, the leader of the …, has delivered a well-received speech regarding the classical basis of … and its historical legitimacy.
events.flavor: "From the very birth of civilization, man has enslaved man. This has thus always been the natural order of things, and I see no reason why we should abandon nature just yet."

options.name: Promote … as a leader of men.
Praise the … as cultivators of great minds.

events.title: The Classical Case for Chains

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has voiced … interest in arguing for slavery in a public debate. The theoretical debate may not go so well as … hopes, however.
events.flavor: "Debate me! Let's say, hypothetically, that I was to argue for slavery and, for the sake of argument, you could oppose me, although you would be wrong to do so. Debate me!"

options.name: There is no need to stage a public debate.
… can have … public debate.

events.title: Slavery, Hypothetically

events.desc: A surge of books written by former slaves abroad have recently been published in …, detailing the horrific conditions they faced. This has shaken public confidence in the efforts to implement … here.
events.flavor: "It has been suggested that an account of my life and misfortunes in chains would not be uninteresting to the public. Since gaining my liberty, I have not failed to perceive the increasing interest in regard to the subject of Slavery..."

options.name: This is just a minor, tolerable hitch in our plans.
We must publicly challenge this slanderous material!

events.title: Imported Slave Narratives

events.desc: …, leader of the …, has written a sensational story about life on a slave plantation.
events.flavor: "Late in the afternoon of a chilly day in February, two gentlemen, with chairs close together, seemed to be discussing some subject with great earnestness. For convenience sake, we have said two gentlemen. One of the parties, however, once he began to speak of his plantation, did not appear to truly merit being called a 'gentleman'."

options.name: Celebrate … as a worthy author.
Promote … as a publisher of anti-slavery works.

events.title: Life Among the Lowly

events.desc: … has proposed staging a series of debates arguing the merits of abolition. If … debates go off well, … and the cause of Abolition will prosper.
events.flavor: "It is the eternal struggle between these two principles—right and wrong—throughout the world. This slavery is the same wrong tyrannical principle, no matter in what shape it comes."

options.name: A public debate risks too much. We cannot allow it.
Permit public debates on the merits of abolition.

events.title: The Great Debates

events.desc: Defenders of continued slavery have published a wave of diatribes, treatises, and sensationalized fictional narratives all to support their cause. The quantity, if not the quality, of these works has shaken public confidence in abolitionism.
events.flavor: "It is my duty, and it is indispensable to the public interest, that I should remove prejudices against our nation's peculiar institutions as soon as possible. To do away with an institution which has existed throughout all ages—why! The presumption of such an effort can be equaled by nothing but its folly."

options.name: Let the slavers speak empty words, full of nothing.
These publications are full of evil and lies, and must be challenged.

events.title: Plantation Proponents Publicize Policies

events.desc: With years having passed since the passage of …, pro-slavery ideals among the … have faded significantly.
events.flavor:
In the echoing manor halls of the …' domain, the words which had once lambasted the government for their tyranny in taking their slaves had begun to shift. Now, instead of open condemnations and calls for the restoration of the institution, there were suggestions for alternatives - sharecropping, the use of prisoners, a dozen different means of disenfranchisement to restore what they saw as the natural order.

But none dared to raise the idea of openly flaunting the decree - not now, at least, when the government seemed vigilant, and the formerly enslaved were still wary. For now, at least, they would simply work with what they had.

options.name: Now is the time to come together and forgive.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status
Political Strength for the Violent Hostility Status
Political Strength for the Cultural Erasure Status
Political Strength for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: We cannot forget the perpetrators of this crime.

events.title: A Peculiar Reconciliation

events.desc: The use of filing cabinets in the … has drastically increased the effectiveness of state bureaucracy.
events.flavor: "The future isn't in flying like a bird, nor in roaring along in a train. No... the future is in filing."

options.name: I love bureaucracy.
Store information about our citizens.

events.title: Filing Cabinets

events.desc: We have secured funding for philosophy departments in all of our institutions of higher learning. The … of … has chosen to focus this funding on advancing Hegelian dialectics.
events.flavor: "Now that we're more or less seated, we can begin. Everything you do at this institution begins and ends with this portmanteau: 'philo', meaning the love of, and 'sophia', meaning wisdom. The love of learning and thought is what Philosophy is. Underpinning Philosophy is the outlook by which we perceive life, the world, everything in essence. We can't necessarily teach you how to do a specific task here. What we can do is teach you how to learn, and how to think about learning on your own."

options.name: Thesis, antithesis, synthesis!
Investigate dialectical materialism.
We need a more pragmatic approach.

events.title: The Philosophy Department

events.desc: The … of … has become a major center of the Realist movement, producing some of the finest works of our generation.
events.flavor: Realism depicts the world as it is, warts and all, rather than the world as we might like it to be. It seeks not only to be true to how objects appear to the eye, but also to be true to the everyday experiences of ordinary people.

options.name: Finally, art we can all relate to.
Can we capture reality even more perfectly?
The world is grim and mundane.

events.title: The Realist Movement

events.desc: The … … has officially opened the … of …. Academia is beginning to flourish in ….
events.flavor: Philosophy is the highest calling of mankind. Through philosophy we can come to understand the very foundations of metaphysics, the nature of the divine, and the essence of virtue. It stands to reason then, that only the most enlightened of wisdom-seekers are fit to hold power.

options.name: Society should be ruled by philosopher-kings.
Modern institutions should employ modern methods.
Formalize the medical profession.

events.title: Higher Learning

events.desc: With the introduction and implementation of elevators into daily society, we can now reap the benefits of our increased industries.
events.flavor:
"It goes all the way up and it goes all the way down. Why walk up ten or twenty flights of stairs when you can simply just take an elevator to the top floor."

"In the future we will have buildings with hundreds of floors and the sky will be the limit."

options.name: Keep boosting the industries.
Keep providing for our citizens.

events.title: Rising to New Heights

events.desc: Now that we have more publicly traded companies we should now focus on what comes next.
events.flavor:
"I don't see the problem. What is wrong with more money? Are you telling me that if they offered you more you would say no?"

"It's not about getting more money. It's about who is getting more money. The rich get richer it would appear."

options.name: This might affect our politics.
Maybe we can use this elsewhere.

events.title: Mutually Beneficial

events.desc: The … airship has been selected as the very special venue for an upper class ball. The most distinct members of the nation have expressed their opinions on this grandiose machine.
events.flavor:
"From this height, the horizon is but a golden necklace, carefully tight around the vibrant blues of the sea. Dinner is coming, and the restaurant is filled with light smoke and deep voices.

"May I offer you a seat, Miss...?"

I shall not dare to write down my name, for some of us have secrets that cannot follow beyond land. The brassy sound of cutlery follows the last heartbeats of the Sun in a rhythmic valediction. Systole, diastole."

options.name: Such a shameful eccentricity. This is a scouting war machine!
Look at those velvet cushions! And the painted silk walls!
If only all this space was used for goods instead of passengers...

events.title: Up in the Air

events.desc: The … of … has experienced an increasing interest in the Romantic movement, with some of our greatest artists producing genuine masterpieces.
events.flavor:
"In Xanadu did Kubla Khan
A stately pleasure-dome decree:
Where Alph, the sacred river, ran
Through caverns measureless to man
Down to a sunless sea. 

–Samuel Taylor Coleridge, Kubla Khan

options.name: We will show the world how Romanticism is done!
But could you make it a bit more... realistic?

events.title: Isn't It Romantic?

events.desc: Despite the overwhelming odds, Piratini has managed to win the Ragamuffin war, and with it their independence.
events.flavor: "Their faces were molded into expressions of victory and tiredness. Like smudged figures in a canvas, they resembled men of the past. In a time of dreamless apathy and defeated nations, they still fought. And won."

options.name: We will have our revenge.
Peace is the better option.

events.title: Victorious Ragamuffins

events.desc: Tempted by generous offers of land and work, … people from … have begun to migrate to ….
events.flavor:
SILVER LININGS IN EVERY CLOUD

Vast tracts of fertile land!

Fields wanting workers!

Factories needing strong arms!

… encourages all European immigrants to begin a new life. No taxes, tariffs or other financial burdens upon arrival. Enough work for everyone.

options.name: Welcome to …!

events.title: Come to …

events.desc: … is a vast and fortunate land, though it is sparsely populated. We must look beyond the seas, particularly to troubled Europe, for potential settlers to work our fields and factories.
events.flavor: The Federal Government will encourage European immigration, and it will not restrict, limit or burden with any taxes the entrance into … territory of foreigners who come with the goal of working the land, improving the industries and teach the sciences and the arts.

options.name: Give me your tired, your poor, your huddled masses.
We're doing fine on our own.

events.title: Populating the Americas

events.desc: Great masses of people now inhabit the … nation, thanks to our efforts to attract migrants and grow our population.
events.flavor:
"Peculiar accent you have there. Ah, not to worry: I’m Belgian, myself. I’m sure our hosts don’t care to know as much either."

"Saxon. My friend is a Tuscan. We came over with a Spaniard."

"Thought my ears were burning. Apologies, I was fishing the Irishman from the well. Caught him pondering the immortality of a crab. You wouldn’t care for a drink later, would you, Belgian?"

options.name: Our words are the voice of a multitude.

events.title: Multitudinous

events.desc: The Industrial Revolution in … has created a shortage of jobs, making migration to … a very attractive prospect for many … people.
events.flavor: Farmers, farriers, navvies, and retiring troops alike shuffled off the latest barge. Tens of thousands had already come before them, with tens of thousands more on the way. Men were needed now more than ever in Upper Canada. Rome wasn't built in a day, and neither will be Toronto.

options.name: More settlers are an opportunity to grow our economy.
Try to limit the influx of migrants.

events.title: The Great Migration

events.desc: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, … intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Catalan as a literary and cultural language.
events.flavor:
"Catalonia can still aspire to independence – not political, as it weighs too little compared to other nations with vast armies and navies, but literary, beyond the reach of political balance."

— Joaquín Rubió y Ors, 'Lo Gayter del Llobregat'

options.name: Most interesting...
Subversiveness must be stamped out.
What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.

events.title: La Renaixensa

events.desc: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, … intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Galician as a literary and cultural language.
events.flavor:
"Poor Galicia, you must never
call yourself Spanish,
for Spain forgets you
when you are oh so lovely.
As if you had been born in disgrace,
she, in her folly, is ashamed to claim you,
and the mother who despises her child
is a heartless mother indeed."

— Rosalía de Castro, The Galician Bagpipe

options.name: Most interesting...
Subversiveness must be stamped out.
What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.

events.title: O Rexurdimento

events.desc: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, … intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Asturleonese as a literary and cultural language.
events.flavor:
"O fountain of Fascura!
my brow is white already,
and still, when I think of you,
I do not know what happens,
whether I sleep or wake,
whether it’s truth or dream.
Dreaming! Ah, if happiness,
even if only dreamed,
could last on without end,
may I never wake from it!"

— Xuan María Acebal, La Fonte de Fascura

options.name: Most interesting...
Subversiveness must be stamped out.
What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.

events.title: El Surdimientu

events.desc: Tribesmen of … has been relentlessly raiding our side of the border, harassing travellers and caravans. Their assault on a military garrison was the final straw. The … insist that this is the perfect moment to take long-awaited action against ….
events.flavor:
Overlooking the encampment in his saddle, Chief Rashan assessed dim prospects while dusk nearly concealed their presence on this side of the hill.

"Rumors are true, my Chief, Uqban is martyred, possibly with his mare. Do we try once more tomorrow?"

"May he rest easy in al-Barzakh." He paused briefly before turning his steed to face the scout. "We return at dawn, after fajr prayer. This is not the night."

options.name: Let us demonstrate who we are.
We must not kindle the fire.

events.title: Border Harassments

events.desc: Subduing … and ensuring our dominance over the northern coast has reassured our people. However, the … seek further glory. They urge us to shift our focus southward, toward the wild expanse of ….
events.flavor:
Vendors and workshops in Tetouan, run by local families for generations, felt a collective uneasiness about the future of their businesses. Even before the Spaniards' official arrival, bazaars were affected by the idea of the industrious juggernauts hailing from northern countries with their mass-produced goods.

They quickly realized that endlessly increasing taxes issued by the Makhzen or inflating local economies should've been the least of their concerns, compared to what might await them under the 'protection' of the Andalusians.

options.name: No point in stopping now, let us keep the momentum.
We should rather settle and focus on our internal struggles.

events.title: Retribution

events.desc: With … brought under our rule, we have obtained a new foothold that can be utilized to connect the mainland to the core of Africa. The … urge us to keep up our present momentum by expanding our presence South of the Sahara.
events.flavor:
Accustomed to nomadic traditions, some clans could not envision living under the rule of infidels and began their hijra toward the vast ocean that is the Sahara.

Among them was Banu Khezzan, a small group of families with herds to protect. Unaware of the political complexities of recent events, Saleeh, a young member of the clan, felt something difficult to articulate in his small mind.

Something that reeked of vengeance and fury toward those who had forced him to move once again.

options.name: Begin preparations, now!
We must not stray too far from our homelands.

events.title: Into the Heart of Africa

events.desc: Emboldened by the success of our recent forays into Africa, the … suggest maneuvering our now-experienced soldiers to seize control of what is between the mainland and ….
events.flavor:
"How about the chapel?", asked the governor, pointing towards the center of the plan on the table beneath the makeshift tent.

"How about it, Gobernador?", replied the puzzled architect, recalling the moment of him even explaining the casting of its bell.

"Are we using stones or wood?"—the smell should've given it away. He was clearly still tipsy. 

"Stones, sir? Stones. From the homeland herself."

options.name: It makes perfect sense.
We should not act on the whims of soldiers.

events.title: Tying Loose Ends

events.desc: At long last, we have taken the Rock of Gibraltar back from the British, restoring the Strait of Gibraltar as an integral part of our dominions. The … has declared a new national holiday to celebrate the reconquest.
events.flavor:
Plus Ultra—With this motto, the Spanish Empire had always aspired to an unimaginable journey across all coasts beyond its peninsular homelands.

Further Beyond—In the esteemed Latin tongue, its meaning signifies our duty as a nation to uphold the gates of wonder and courage for those who wish to take risks and strive for excellence beyond the Mediterranean.

Once again, we are the rightful guardians of the East and West.

options.name: Hercules would be proud.

events.title: The Pillars of Hercules

events.desc: An envoy from … has been awaiting our diplomatic response regarding a request to surrender …, asserting their claim as the rightful owners of the island.
events.flavor:
Even as an experienced one, the diplomat from …'s arrival in … for the first time was an unforgettable memory. From bustling boulevards to neatly walled parks and intricately built bridges, there was something awe-inspiring about this place, unlike any other, he thought.

Unfortunately, it was not the time to linger, as the appointment was set for the same day.

The message was clear; and his … would hardly accept a refusal for an answer.

options.name: They have the right, evacuate the island.
Never!

events.title: Lease of …

events.desc: … has accepted our request to revoke the lease of …. … forces will soon withdraw from the island.
events.flavor:
"Where are we going mamá?"

"To Fernando Pó, cielo."

"Will we be happy there?"

"Of course we will, they say it's a beautiful island."

"But we are already happy here? And, why is papá not coming with us?"

"We do as our … says, cariño. Everything will be fine. You don't need to worry."

options.name: Excellent.

events.title: … Returns …

events.desc: … has rejected our request to revoke the lease of ….
events.flavor:
Agnign—an expression the indigenous people of … uses, roughly translates to the European tongues as "to live," or "to experience".

Once they lived, unaware of civilized people's intentions of their sacred soil.

And they experienced freely, cherishing every moment unfettered from foreign distractions.

options.name: How dare they?

events.title: … Occupies …

events.desc: Our great nation has successfully achieved all the goals set concerning Africa. Who knows what lies beyond the horizon now?
events.flavor:
Today was an extraordinary day for the field commander—one that would fill his remaining years with pride and glory for his country.

Nothing compares to the recognition that comes with a successful service to one's country and the honor of receiving a medal after a challenging campaign, particularly overseas.

options.name: Long live …. Plus Ultra!
We have something tangible to promote here.
Let's dedicate the victory to our people.

events.title: Return to Glory

events.desc: Failing to achieve our expansionist prospects in Africa have made the … and its supporters intensely agitated.
events.flavor:
"Gentlemen, a nation that does not expand dies a slow and painful death. I am sure you all agree with me on this. We must secure our destiny by force if need be.  What they call our ambition as "recklessness," we call vision and a justified thirst for glory that … has deserved for a long time. Today is not that day, but let me tell you, it is nigh."

Seasoned officers nodded to each other, digesting the words. One could almost believe they would not shoot one another in the back for a promotion.

options.name: They should know their places.
Perhaps there is a compromise?

events.title: An African Blunder

events.desc: A massive outbreak of an especially deadly strain of flu has broken out in …. It threatens to spread rapidly, potentially escalating into a global pandemic.
events.flavor: "The epidemic of influenza, like a specter of death, was upon us almost overnight, and three days after the disease was made reportable by the Board of Health our hospital was full to overflowing with victims of the pestilence."

options.name: We must hope it doesn't spread!

events.title: The … Flu

events.desc: The deadly … Flu has appeared in …. The pandemic is quickly becoming a global crisis.
events.flavor: "It was truly like unto the rush of the wounded from the field of battle, and the house was filled to capacity almost at once. Within a few days it was necessary to open a ward in the College gymnasium, which was equipped with beds from our students’ dormitory."

options.name: When will this plague end?

events.title: The … Flu Spreads

events.desc: The terrible plague continues in …, with a new wave infecting many more of the population.
events.flavor: "About 12 o'clock I began to feel hot. I was so feverish I was afraid I would ignite my clothing. I had a cough that tore my very innards out when I could not suppress it. It was dark; I surely had pneumonia and I never was so forlorn and uncomfortable in my life."
events.title: A New Wave of … Flu

events.desc: A massive outbreak of an especially deadly strain of flu has broken out in …. It threatens to spread rapidly, potentially escalating into a global pandemic.
events.flavor: "The epidemic of influenza, like a specter of death, was upon us almost overnight, and three days after the disease was made reportable by the Board of Health our hospital was full to overflowing with victims of the pestilence."

options.name: I hope it doesn't reach …!

events.title: The … Flu

events.desc: The government must determine its response to the flu pandemic that threatens to engulf the nation. Stricter measures will surely have a cost, but will save lives.
events.flavor: "BY AUTHORITY AND DIRECTION OF THE STATE BOARD OF HEALTH there will be NO CLASSES in the University beginning at NOON today. Students are FORBIDDEN to leave the town; to do so would help spread infection."

options.name: Impose a strict lockdown and close non-essential businesses.
Mandate health measures such as distancing and protective masks.
We can't risk harming the economy.

events.title: The … Flu: Government Response

events.desc: Reports of the many deaths resulting from the … Flu in … are harming popular support for our war efforts.
events.flavor: "It is madness that we send men to war while this plague ravishes our homes. Should the state not prioritize the lives of its citizens over their deaths?"

options.name: We will not interfere with the free press.
Distribute reassuring propaganda backed by medical science.
Censor news of mortality rates and infections.

events.title: Flu Reports Creating Anti-War Sentiment

events.desc: With many unable to work due to our anti-pandemic measures, poorer citizens in … are struggling to pay rent. Newly unemployed laborers face eviction as landlords refuse their pleas for reprieve.
events.flavor: "They told me I could not work because the factory is overcrowded. Every factory is overcrowded! The landlord, may he burn in the eternal fires, cares not a jot for our plight and demands rent before the end of the week on pain of eviction. My family shall surely be forced from our home."

options.name: Institute a rent freeze and eviction ban.
Temporarily increase social security.
There is nothing we can do about this.

events.title: Pandemic Measures Contributing to Poverty

events.desc: … has formed the Anti-Mask League in opposition to our pandemic measures. They dispute the effectiveness of our policies and demand that we revoke them for the sake of the struggling economy.
events.flavor:
"Wear a mask and save your life! The emergency that now confronts our country is beyond the facilities of the Health Department.
Those who do not wear them get sick. The man or woman or child who will not wear a mask now is a dangerous slacker!"

options.name: Ignore the League.
Abandon anti-plague measures.
Discredit the League with medical science.

events.title: The Anti-Mask League

events.desc: The terrible plague continues in …, with a new wave infecting many more of the population.
events.flavor: "About 12 o'clock I began to feel hot. I was so feverish I was afraid I would ignite my clothing. I had a cough that tore my very innards out when I could not suppress it. It was dark; I surely had pneumonia and I never was so forlorn and uncomfortable in my life."
events.title: A New Wave of … Flu

events.desc: The terrible plague continues in …, with a new wave infecting many more of the population.
events.flavor: "About 12 o'clock I began to feel hot. I was so feverish I was afraid I would ignite my clothing. I had a cough that tore my very innards out when I could not suppress it. It was dark; I surely had pneumonia and I never was so forlorn and uncomfortable in my life."
events.title: A New Wave of … Flu

events.desc: With order restored at home, … must decide her stance toward her former rebellious colonies in the Americas, whose independence remains unrecognized by ….
events.flavor:
"Gentlemen, it is imperative that we follow in the footsteps of England. When she realized the Thirteen Colonies were lost for good, she forged a strong commercial and cultural bond with them. To this day, it remains one of her greatest sources of strength.

Why should we throw away such an opportunity for the sake of misbegotten glory or revenge? Especially considering our present condition is what it is?"

options.name: The old empire is gone. It is time to face the reality of our situation.
Cowards. Send for the war minister, treason shall not be rewarded.

events.title: The Spanish Main

events.desc: The impossible made manifest: …'s dominion over the New World has been restored. To mark this momentous occasion, large triumphs have been arranged in the capitals of the restored Audiencias.
events.flavor:
When the bugle sounded and the … flag was hoisted over the Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas that morning, the young corporal's heart was filled with pride. Even in the sleepy Asturian village of his youth, the memory of the defense of Cartagena loomed large. Now, the … banner fluttered proudly from its battlements once more.

With a silent vow to himself and to the Almighty, he swore that so long as breath remained in his body, that standard would never fall again.

options.name: Once more, our Empire stretches from shore to shore.
All must know the strength of the … legions.

events.title: Our American Empire

events.desc: With the signing of the last treaty, … diplomatic relations with her former subjects have been clearly defined, with the voices of cordiality and mutual benefit triumphing over those of revenge.
events.flavor:
As the last delegate departed, the ambassador's mind drifted from practical matters. A century ago, such a meeting would have been between master and servant; now, they met as equals. He lingered on the thought, uncertain whether it stirred pride or sorrow. How would his grandsires judge this turn of fate, and how would his grandchildren? And above all, how would the Almighty? Were Spain's dominions not once held as God-given?

No matter, all he focus on for now was one simple thought:

options.name: A mother and her children, reconciled at last.

events.title: Of Masters and Servants

options.name: Leave the current administrations in place.

events.desc: With the legal status of … no longer in question, the country's presence on the international stage is bound to increase.
events.flavor:
While true independence was won at the point of a bayonet by the valiant fighters of the wars of liberation, it was through the labors of men of letters like himself that … legal sovereignty would be secured.

As glorious as a heroic defense or a glorious charge? Perhaps not.

The squares and plazas of … would likely never bear his name, yet he took great comfort in knowing that in the storied history of … he had left a mark.

options.name: This date will go down in … history.

events.title: Recognition

events.desc: Arriving in … by carriage at the stroke of twelve, a tall, pale man introducing himself as Count … has offered up his services to the …, claiming descent from Attila the Hun and the mighty voivodes of old.
events.flavor:
The man's handshake was cold and vice-like. Repressing a wince, the government representative raised his eyes to meet the Count's. "We have prepared a room and a meal for you, sir, while you await the …. You must be tired from the long journey."

"That will not be necessary" the Count said with a thin smile. "I just enjoyed a late supper. In any case, it has been too long since I last set foot in …. And I am so much interested in seeing all that has changed."

options.name: One can hardly turn down the services of such an illustrious gentleman.
Of course, my Count, a private audience will be arranged at once.
Politely refuse the Count, and show him to the city gates.

events.title: Nocturnal Overtures

events.desc: Having inconspicuously arrived at the residence of …, … strides past its languid guards, into the long, dark corridors leading towards her study, where a solitary light still shines over piles of correspondence.
events.flavor:
… did not recognize the man that stood at her doorstep, nor did she recognize the words that came out of his mouth, even as they were clearly in her own tongue. Scenes of formal dinner parties and gallas briefly flickered in her mind, until her mind and gaze were both seized by the stranger's eyes.

They blazed with such terrible light that she could not bear to look at them, but nor could she look away. As the stranger took one step forward, slowly baring his teeth, she made one final effort to avert her eyes, trying to will words, any words, to escape from her mouth.

options.name: And then, …'s mind is swallowed by a creeping fog.
What... wait. Who are you, and what are you doing here? Guards!

events.title: A Midnight Visitor

events.desc: Pondering the ever-changing world around him, … wonders if he, too, must change with it.
events.flavor:
… turns the pages of the … …, absorbing the information as a sponge takes blood. Wars, atrocities, and murders dominated the headlines, as they always did. There was a certain comfort, he mused, in knowing that some matters still had solutions as simple in this world as they had in the one of yore.

Yet such observations only held true in part. Amid the familiar chaos, there were signs of a different world—a world in motion, driven by pistons, electric lights, and political unrest. But despite his old age, … felt no pang of sentimentality. Let lesser creatures weep for the old world, he thought. For I intend to shape the new.

options.name: Through capital comes power.
Men are but children, and like children respect only the rod.
Why forgo true and tested methods for untried ones.
The old must make way for the new.

events.title: Mastery of Old and New

events.desc: A young Genevan student by the name of … has approached the government with a petition for a modest stipend and a workspace. In return, he confidently claims he shall breach the very boundary between life and death itself.
events.flavor: "If lifeless matter can be animated, one could perhaps renew life where death has taken its toll. How many of you have lost a dear one to disease, or to the cruel hand of man? What if that could be undone? Or what if something new could take its place? A new species that would revere us as creator and master."

options.name: Most intriguing. Inform him he has our support.
Scorn this unchristian charlatan and commit him to an asylum.

events.title: Promethean Visions

events.desc: …'s research has borne fruit. With visible unease he outlines his methods to the assembled dignitaries and claims he is ready to expand his operation. As evidence he presents his first creation as proof of concept.
events.flavor:
The massive creature lumbers in, its movements jerky and convulsive, as if it was learning to use its limbs for the first time, yet with watery, inquisitive eyes, almost like those of a child.

"In the name of God! What is that thing?""

"This, gentlemen, is the future. A homo novus in the most literal meaning of the phrase."

options.name: I am sure we can find use for a creature of such... caliber.
Very well, but give that poor wretch a mate.
This has gone too far. Shut it all down, now!

events.title: God and the Machine

events.desc: Frightened by the growing … presence in …, a rabid mob has rampaged through the streets of …. … has refused to comment on the situation.
events.flavor:
The crowd had surrounded the creature near the old fountain, a ring of torches and pitchforks forming a menacing wall and trapping the tall pale figure in its midst.

"Kill it! Strike the monster down!"

"Monster? How dare you name me monster, you who hunt my kin down without reason or remorse? What harm have we ever inflicted on you unprovoked? Lift a hand against me, and know that I shall strike you down, but this makes me no more a fiend than the man who protects himself from a criminal's vicious assault."

options.name: Rabble does what rabble is.
… and … company must be held responsible.

events.title: Ecce Monstrum

events.desc: A woman has started a protest in the center of …, stating that her children have nothing to eat but rats. People have gathered around her, joining her desperate pleas.
events.flavor: "I hope you never have to look at your children's face when you serve them a carbonized rat and tell them it's just pork, lie to them so their innocence is preserved for a bit more time, just one more day, forbidding them to play hide and seek so they don't get hungrier by the effort, telling them that, if they move, the boogeyman will find and catch them."

options.name: No one deserves a life like that.
Poverty is just a fact of life.
Seize these agitators immediately.

events.title: Signs of the Times

events.desc: The living conditions of our people have been steadily increasing during these past times, bringing hope to the most dispirited parts of our cities—even so, we still have a long way to go.
events.flavor: "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity, it was the season of light, it was the season of darkness, it was the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair."

options.name: Our people shall never forget what we've done for them.
This will help us advance even further!
The satisfaction of their welfare is enough for us.

events.title: A Tale of Hope

events.desc: Members of the … have been seen walking around the slums of …, offering some charity food to the poor. However, they now request state funding for their efforts.
events.flavor:
"Walking through those alleys makes the soul feel as if it was entering the devil's acres: nostrils filled beyond endurance with the stench of the bugs, eyes closed beyond compassion after seeing hell's gates wide open.

If we don't get the support that we need, divinity's light may never be strong enough to illuminate those ash-covered faces."

options.name: It is a good cause to support.
We do not need them holding any more power.

events.title: The Bitter Cry

events.desc: Housing in the slums of … has reached such a miserable state that whole families have been reported to live on the stairs of several buildings
events.flavor: "Upon our arrival we found a grim cluster of houses packed together as gears in the indigence machinery; dirty and steaming entire blocks of dwellings, dilapidated, old, dingy courts and dingy cellars, rented by so many families that they messed together as if they were so many pigs. All sign of a dignity of life was gone."

options.name: These people deserve some dignity.
We cannot cover these costs.

events.title: Crowded

events.desc: A … article about the living conditions in …'s slums has been released to the public. The consequent outrage, of course, did not take long to spread.
events.flavor: "When we look at this great city, our minds can easily get unduly elated by its great pomp and splendor—the brightness of its palaces, temples and mansions, its courts of justice, academies of science, and institutions of philanthropy. Surely we mourn that such a city has so much wickedness, degradation, heathenism and profligacy... The swarms of wretched, filthy, haggard, dissolute, careworn outcast masses that have been pushed to the very edges of society."

options.name: This place needs to be sanitized as soon as possible.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: Article? What article?

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: …, As It Is

events.desc: The shortage of food supplies and the low—if not nonexistent—wages in the slums have led to a series of riots among the women in …, where they have vandalized several storefronts.
events.flavor: "We have no food, we have no money, we see these wealthy bastards hoarding food as if they were about to starve when one of their fingers is fatter than our arms. We are entitled to be just as well-fed as they are."

options.name: We can surely find something to give them.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: They shall pay for their own food like everyone else.

events.title: Bread Riots

events.desc: As we pass the … Law, there are fears that without the … faith to provide spiritual fulfilment, the huddled masses may fall to into despair.
events.flavor: Religion is the sigh of the oppressed creature, the heart of a heartless world, and the soul of soulless conditions. It is the opium of the people.

options.name: God is dead.
We'll nourish their bellies, not their souls.
Opium is the opium of the masses.

events.title: The Opium of the Masses

events.desc: … at the … of … are strong supporters of the … Law. They have founded the Society of the Godless as a means of promoting anti-religious thought.
events.flavor: "I have heard us denigrated as thugs 'encroaching on the highest achievement of human culture'. If that is the highest that humankind has achieved, then I must laugh—to reach a greater height, all I would have to do is hop over a puddle."

options.name: An enlightened initiative.
Accost the theists on the streets.
Elevate the Society in the universities.

events.title: Society of the Godless

events.desc: Charities associated with the … have come under fire by supporters of the … Law for being staffed by clergy and pious laity. Many people have rallied to the defense of these popular charities, threatening the success of ….
events.flavor: "I don't care how many people call it a 'charity'. It's a religious sect, and it has as much an agenda as any other sect out there. It doesn't matter if they say they've changed—you and I both know they haven't! The public be damned, we have to go after these people."

options.name: Maintain the attacks on the charities.
Promote state welfare to undercut them.
Set up competing relief charities to undercut them.
Just let the charities be.

events.title: Works of Charity

events.desc: Attempting to expel missionaries, clerics, faith healers and the like has caused an uproar abroad. … has resisted the forced extradition of their citizens in ….
events.flavor: "No, I will not abide these laws! I am a man of …, and I will not be bullied out of my noble purpose. You could drag me out in manacles and I would still be legally entitled to enter this place. If I am forced to, I shall invoke extraterritoriality upon this farce!"

options.name: We should rethink this, before we have a war.
Force them out if you have to.
They can stay if they swear off their faith.

events.title: Extraterritoriality in God's Nation

events.desc: As … embarks on a quest of questioning traditional religious morality, members of the … present their theses.
events.flavor: "Furthermore, I should note that if God is to be truly dead, God must be absent from worship. Let us be doomed to freedom, that we may write our history. Not in stone or in blood, as our history under God has been, but in ink and in deeds. God cannot be—and should not be accepted any longer as—a convenient excuse, a lie to embolden the whims of the powerful!"

options.name: Tradition still yet has a place in society.
Away with faith. Away with all of its trappings.
There is nothing at all that should not be questioned.

events.title: A River's New Bearing

events.desc: The … have begun carrying out seizures from every … place of worship in …. Every structure, artwork, and piece of gold kitsch are being tallied for liquidation.
events.flavor:
"Right, that's just what's in the presbytery. What's he got in his quarters?"

"Sir, we pulled all this from one of the ambulatory chapels."

"Bugger me, there's enough gold in there to start a new mine. Call up four more men and search the remaining chapels, on the double!"

options.name: Melt the gold and re-mint it.
Allow our brave forces some 'danger pay.'
Give the clerics a stipend to start new lives.

events.title: Golden Indulgences

events.desc: Workers in the … have had enough of their poor conditions. Working with the …, they have initiated an industry-wide strike in ….
events.flavor: "To rescue the toiler from the grasp of the selfish is a work worthy of the noblest and best of our race. Are you willing to accept the responsibility, and, trusting in the support of pledged true Knights, labor, with what ability you possess, for the triumph of these principles among men?"

options.name: Open negotiations with the strikers.
The strikes must be suppressed.

events.title: Strike!

events.desc: After thorough discussion with union leaders, they have agreed to suspend the strike if any of their major demands are met.
events.flavor: The … that rob us on a large scale also have the power to control the government and legalize their robbery. We who work hardest and produce the most have the least; we can run the mills without them but they cannot run them without us!

options.name: Promise to pass the Old Age Pension law.
Promise to pass the Wage Controls law.
Promise to pass the Regulatory Bodies law.
Promise to pass the Workers' Protections law.
Promise to expand Workplace Safety.
Promise to expand Social Security.
Their demands are unacceptable.

events.title: Strike: Labor Negotiations

events.flavor: Workers of the world unite! You have nothing to lose but your chains!

options.name: Disastrous!

events.title: General Strike!

events.desc: Unwilling to negotiate with the unions, the government has proposed measures aimed at ending the strike.
events.flavor: The government certainly has the right for its own preservation to discourage and prevent the use of force and violence to accomplish that which ought to be accomplished, if at all, by parliamentary or political methods. There is no time to waste on hairsplitting over infringement of liberty.

options.name: Grant special powers to police.
Promote strikebreaking.

events.title: Strike: Anti-Strike Action

events.desc: The policy changes promised to the striking workers are being seriously considered by the government. It seems likely that the union's demands will be met.
events.flavor: It's working, lads! What did I tell you? Direct action gets the goods! Now let's celebrate with a pint, we've all more than earned it.

options.name: Good for them.

events.title: Unions Celebrate Strike Success

events.desc: In a violent clash, police used their newly-granted powers to fire upon striking workers in an attempt to disperse them. Many workers were killed and several officers were wounded, but the crowd was ultimately broken up.
events.flavor: The firing was unjustified and cruel, and to say it in plain language, it was cowardly, premeditated murder.

options.name: Fire!

events.title: Police Attack Strikers

events.desc: Our policy of promoting strikebreaking is proving remarkably successful. Many striking workers are losing their fighting spirit and abandoning their cause.
events.flavor: Our man will come to your factory and get acquainted, infiltrating the union and rising within its ranks. He asks for unreasonable things and keeps the union embroiled in trouble. If a strike comes, he will be the loudest man in the bunch, and will counsel violence and get somebody in trouble. The result will be that the union will be broken up.

options.name: Just as planned.

events.title: Unions Demoralized by Strikebreaking

events.desc: With the passing of the new law, the government has met the demands of the striking workers.
events.flavor: With all their faults, trade-unions have done more for humanity than any other organization of men that ever existed. They have done more for decency, for honesty, for education, for the betterment of the race, for the developing of character in man, than any other association of men.

options.name: The unions should be more involved in politics.
This should keep them happy for a while.

events.title: Strike: Keeping Promises

events.desc: The spirit of the strikers is utterly broken. They no longer have the will to continue their struggle, and the strike has been formally called off by the unions.
events.flavor: You've had your fun. Now get back to work; your pay has been docked accordingly and you will work whatever hours the company deems appropriate.

options.name: They have learned to fear the truncheon.
Round up the instigators. This will not happen again.

events.title: Strike: Breaking the Strike

events.desc: A heavily-armed party of Boer trekkers have successfully fended off a large … amabutho raid, crippling their power. With … supremacy shaken by this defeat, their king, …, has ordered a withdrawal from … and for the whole nation to move northward.
events.flavor:
The warriors beat on their shields, soothing their rattled nerves, before they charged once more at the laager, crying the name of their …. As they did, the fire and thunder from the laager intensified. Muskets emerged from behind the wagons firing bullets, loose buckshot, anything that could be frantically loaded and flung at the charging enemy. Any warrior who cleared this hail of fire and scaled the thornbushes to reach the wagons was met with the swing of hatchets. The smoke of the guns mixed with spilled blood to create a thick haze, making attackers and defenders alike breath death.

When the cries of battle ended and the smoke cleared, among the mangled bodies strewn on the battlefield laid the ambitions of …, as dead as the warriors who had charged the laager that day.

options.name: Raid the … as they flee north.
Bring some of the … into our fold.
The Boer threat has been revealed! We must help, not hurt, ….

events.title: The Battle of Vegkop

events.desc: The entire … realm is migrating north after faces losses against … and armed Trekboer parties. … is open for claims!
events.flavor: The stories trickling in from the High Veld were confused and contradictory. Some claimed that a single Boer camp destroyed …'s whole army in one battle, while others say that … forces managed to break the … hold on … through persistent raids and attacks. Whatever the cause, the effect is clear: … is leading the … people north, leaving … open for anyone with a pioneering spirit.

options.name: Move to ensure … belongs to us!
Leave it be! The strain of governing that land is too much for us.
Encourage settlement of …, but do not claim these lands all at once.

events.title: In …'s Wake

events.desc: … believes that …, the … of …, can be convinced to cede the southern half of … to …. … believes a deal can be made if … negotiates personally at … …'s court. Some warn that the … is dangerous to treat with.
events.flavor:
"It's simple," chuckled …, waving a letter in his hand. "We just have to show the … we can be trusted, and we'll soon have a port of our own!"

The crowd around him murmured equally in excitement and concern.

"A new home! Land, ours for the taking!"

"I'm not sure … … is that easy to deal with."

"Pfah! That's for … to find out, not us!"

options.name: … will gain … for …!
… is dangerous—… must drop this idea.

events.title: The Natal Cession

events.desc: A delegation of Boer settlers, led by …, have arrived at …, demanding that we somehow cede the lands south of the Thukela, half of all …. This proposal is an insult and provocation, but there are many other well-armed Boers where this delegation came from.
events.flavor: … stood before the … grinning, with nary a flicker of diffidence on … face or in … stance. … was saying something about friendship and respect, a translator told …, but reports were already coming in of missing cattle and enigmatic scout parties that fled when anyone approached them. The cattle could have been taken by some rival chiefs—or by the figure speaking before … now. Trust was in such rare supply these days...

options.name: This demand is preposterous. Kill …'s entire delegation.
Bear the insult, but send … home empty-handed.
Ceding half of … is the only path to peace!

events.title: Boers Demand the Thukela

events.desc: Tensions between migrating Boer Voortrekkers and … have been steadily rising. An attempt to dislodge a large Boer party on the banks of the Ncome River has ended disastrously. … … believes the southern part of … can be ceded to the Boers in exchange for peace, but this will not happen if … remains ….
events.flavor: Another army—shattered. How much blood had been spilled? How many men were left to command? How many men left would accept a command from their …? … … was suggesting outlandish ideas, wholly out of the question, they'd be the death of the realm... or at least the death of the ….

options.name: Make … … the new … and sign the treaty.
… is a traitor! Seize …—only … can lead us.
There is no need for panic! Call on our allies to help us.

events.title: Blood River

events.desc: Overcoming countless trials and tribulations, we are now unquestionably the supreme power in South Africa.
events.flavor:
Above the triumphant crowds on the streets, a voice pierced through the tumult.

"May the heavens bless Africa and hear our prayers!" the voice cried, "And may our nation be protected, all conflicts and troubles ended! Protect us, protect our nation, and let us live and strive onward in …, our land!"

options.name: May …'s horn rise up high!

events.title: Highest on the Highveld

events.desc: Despite our best efforts, … is now unquestionably the supreme power in South Africa.
events.flavor: A new flag was waving across South Africa—the flag of …. … might still persist, but the future was ….

options.name: We weep for thee, ….

events.title: Lowest on the Highveld

events.desc: There are several potential types of candidates that we can consider for the head of administration in …. What type of leader are we looking for?
events.flavor: "Governance is a very delicate thing. Every state has its own precise pressures, its lobbies, and its concerns. It's our job to ensure that all these issues are effectively swept off the board, never to interfere with our aims again."

options.name: Mr. …, the … will take charge.
Let us go with a …: Mr. ….
Award the office to Mr. …, the ….
Mr. …, the …, is the best choice.
The … … … will ensure stability.

events.title: Appointing a Governor

events.desc: Deeming … …'s handling of … affairs inadequate, the political establishment of … has requested that … appoint a new governor more aligned with its objectives.
events.flavor: "Governance is a very delicate thing. Every state has its own precise pressures, its lobbies, and its concerns. It's our job to ensure that all these issues are effectively swept off the board, never to interfere with our aims again."

options.name: Mr. …, the … will take charge.
Let us go with a …: Mr. ….
Award the office to Mr. …, the ….
Mr. …, the …, is the best choice.
The … … … will ensure stability.

events.title: Requesting a Governor

events.flavor: The people of the village had long been loyal subjects of the …. Certainly, there had been troubles - tax evasion, individual rebellions, the typical grumbling of disaffected peasants - but they had been loyal, in the end. And then the news from … came, and a great feeling of unease accompanied it. The government would now issue its decrees in …, a language few of them spoke and even fewer of them read. The … language would no longer be good enough. "Learn", it seemed to say. "Speak in our tongue, or say nothing at all".

options.name: Why must they insist upon resisting progress?
One may be both … and ….

events.title: From Many to One

events.flavor:
"Major … is conspiring, again."

… swivelled his head to follow his friend's thumb. There, indeed, was the Major, clad in the same uniform as ever. He was leaning in to discuss something with his companion, more for appearances than any genuine desire for secrecy.

"So he is. "Honor and loyalty", he always says, "honor and loyalty". We talked the other week about what makes for a good citizen, and he said the same thing."

"And what did you say?"

options.name: "To be a good citizen, one must be a good …."
"That he was right, of course. But loyalty, most of all."
"To be … is a nationality of its own."

events.title: The Ideal Citizenry

events.desc: Encouraged by the government's efforts to enact …, … nationalists have ceremonially offered … … the title of "… of the …". To accept the title would legitimize the claim that … power ultimately derives from the nation.
events.flavor:
"When Napoleon took his crown, he swore to govern in the "sole interest, happiness, and glory of the French people". This is what granted him his power, and allowed him to triumph over all of his foes. If the … wished, … could do the same, with the … people in mind."

The … regarded the petitioner with a thoughtful expression on … face.

"And what became of Napoleon?"

"He became immortal, my …."

options.name: Hail, … of the …!
Power is derived from …, not the nation.

events.title: … of the …

events.flavor:
"And what do I mean when I say "to be a …"?", asked the teacher.

One of the students rose to answer. "To be a … is to be proud, it is to be honorable, and it is to defend our people. It is to serve … and the … nation, and to respect our … and … ministers."

The student stood stock-still, until the portrait-artist in the corner of the room peeked out from behind his canvas.

"Well done, …. You may sit."

options.name: Grant all the funding needed for these changes.
A slower process would ease the burden on our treasury.
The history of … can be their first lesson.

events.title: Subjects to Citizens

events.desc: The government's citizenship reform has awakened the spectre of revolutionary excess amongst … and …. They fear their traditional titles being stripped away in favor of equal citizenship.
events.flavor:
"It is utterly unnatural. Sinful, I would say - sinful, and it is foreign. My ancestors have presided over this land for a thousand years, and those meddlers in … wish to overthrow the entire order of things. Do they wish for me to be known as "Citizen …"? That is the end of all of this."

The driver nodded, his eyes fixed firmly on the road ahead of them. Perhaps the next pothole would swallow them both.

"I would say," the lord continued, "that the … has been utterly led astray by those damned new ministers. This is what comes of appointing commoners!"

options.name: All too typical of them to faint at phantoms.
They are first amongst the … nation.
Yes, all of those things will go.

events.title: Memories of the Guillotine

events.desc: Activists led by … have gathered to protest the lack of voting rights for women in ….
events.flavor:
"I read about these in the paper," the young man proclaimed. "They call them 'suffragettes', you see. This demonstration, this so-called demonstration, it's a sort of playing at political activism, not unlike what a child might do when they are first taught the workings of democratic society. It must be understood in such a context..."

His voice trailed off. One of the women in the passing crowd had turned to look directly at him. His friends nodded in quiet agreement, but no one said anything else.

options.name: This protest must be heard.
Round up and arrest these troublemakers.

events.title: Suffragists March

events.desc: Proponents of women’s suffrage have come to speak before … to argue for their cause, prompting ridicule from …, who argues women have no place in the halls of governance.
events.flavor:
Realizing that waiting for the room to go quiet would be a fruitless exercise in patience, … spoke forcefully:

"We are here today not only to claim our rightful share of political power in our nation, but to declare that if you wish to govern wisely and justly, you will need us. Who can claim that … today is so free of suffering and strife that men have proven themselves especially suited for governance?"

options.name: Who could deny these brave souls the chance to set our country right?
Such a hostile tone is a sign that the fairer sex is not ready for political discourse.

events.title: Suffragists Speak in …

events.desc: …, a prominent opponent of voting rights for women, has been the target of an act of arson by proponents of this cause.
events.flavor: "There were headlines today about bombs mailed to …'s office. Where were these headlines when we sent letters? Were they read? Were they even opened? It was inevitable in face of such cold arrogance that someone would, eventually, send a package which could not be ignored."

options.name: Arrest the leader behind this dangerous movement!
Prosecute those directly responsible for the attack.

events.title: Arson Attack

events.desc: An activist seeking to bring attention to the cause of women’s suffrage has died in an incident at a derby, killed by a race horse belonging to ….
events.flavor: "Some are truer warriors than others, but the perfect Amazon is she who will sacrifice all even unto the last, to win the Pearl of Freedom for her sex."

options.name: No one would have had to die for this cause if these basic rights had been granted!
We won't extend political sympathy to such reckless behavior.

events.title: Suffragist Killed

events.desc: Many suffragists who have been arrested during their political activities have gone on hunger strike to protest their imprisonment.
events.flavor: "They deny us a voice in the world of politics on account of our gentleness, our fragility, claiming to protect us from the horrors of the world. It only takes the smallest act of defiance for that illusion to be shattered by the brutal, humiliating treatments to which men subject women who won't suffer unjust punishment quietly."

options.name: Implement a policy of force feeding hunger strikers.
Release prisoners until they return to better health, then return them.

events.title: Hunger Strikes

events.desc: The practice of releasing prisoners who go on hunger strike and arresting them again when their health improves is being criticized as cruel and absurd.
events.flavor: "They think they can toy with us, that we will go happily back to our cells and play along with this feigned concern for our well-being, that we will stay out of view to avoid being arrested again. We shall do the opposite: We shall dare them to come for us, we shall speak out, we shall band together. The whole nation, nay, the whole world will know what cruelty these supposed guardians of morality are capable of."

options.name: We stand by the decision.
The act should be abolished.

events.title: The Cat and Mouse Act

events.desc: … has written a work arguing for the political and civic rights of women, presenting a vision for equality between the sexes in the political sphere.
events.flavor: "Woman, wake up; the tocsin of reason is being heard throughout the whole universe; discover your rights. The powerful empire of nature is no longer surrounded by prejudice, fanaticism, superstition, and lies. The flames of truth has dispersed all the clouds of folly and usurpation. "

options.name: This tract should be widely disseminated.

rewards.name: Treatise on The Rights of Women

options.name: The publication should be banned.
Other political leaders should study this.

events.title: Declaration of the Rights of Woman

events.desc: A convention on the rights of women is being held in …. The organizers are determined to pursue extended property and social rights for women, but are debating whether to extend their ambitions to the political arena.
events.flavor: "In this denial of the right to participate in government, not merely the degradation of woman and the perpetuation of a great injustice happens, but the maiming and repudiation of one-half of the moral and intellectual power of the government of the world."

options.name: Voting is a fundamental right which must be pursued!
Incremental change is a safer path to progress.

events.title: Convention of Women's Rights

events.desc: Women in … have begun organizing to campaign for their right to vote in general elections. … of the … has emerged as a leading figure of this movement.
events.flavor: "If democracy is to live to up to its own ideals, it cannot simply be an emulation of ancient republics. It must be an ongoing project, always asking the question: Who is not heard? Whose wisdom is discarded? … has already recognized women as capable of ruling themselves. Why should we not aid in ruling the nation?"

options.name: A worthy cause!
Sounds like opposition talk.

events.title: Votes for Women

events.desc: … is holding its first election since the voting franchise was extended to women, marking the beginning of a new era in … democracy.
events.flavor:
Dropping her vote into the ballot box was, in a way, an anticlimactic moment. Getting there had felt like a real political struggle. It had been loud, disobedient, sometimes violent. The reward was this quiet, orderly exercise of power. Once again, she was a loyal citizen; only the expectations had changed.

Then again, perhaps this was what power felt like. Perhaps that was what made it insidious. She wondered if this had been how those who had denied her this up until now had felt. For a fleeting moment, she hoped she would not get used to it.

options.name: The worker's movement must continue to fight for equality!
Equality is part of our intellectual tradition.
Everyone must change with the times.
A great victory for the suffragists!

events.title: The First Election

events.desc: The … State Institute for Racial Biology has been tasked with finding the cause of crime, alcoholism, and mental issues. The Institute's claims have led the Riksdag to pass through policies controlling the births of … people.
events.flavor:
In the lecture halls of Uppsala, professors hold up calipers as if they are oracles. They unfold charts of physiognomies, and point to each in turn. 
This one is a pure-bred Swede, long of limb and sound of mind. This one is tainted by interbreeding, doomed to a fate of alcoholism. The former is the future of the nation. The latter is fated to quietly disappear. 
It would be the humane thing to do, continues the professor.  Look at the graphs, at the well-arranged figures. The nation demands more of us than he is able to provide.

options.name: Three generations of imbeciles are enough.
We need to control this situation.

events.title: Racial Biology

events.desc: The poor conditions in … have made migration to … a very attractive alternative. Thousands of … people have set off across the sea for America.
events.flavor:
… peasants gather off the latest ship. Tens of thousands had already come before them, with tens of thousands more on the way. 
To the Swedes, Minnesota appeared as an earthly paradise, its dark and bountiful soil yielding harvests enough to banish want and gladden the heart.

options.name: A better life is what we need right now.
New York will do quite nicely.

events.title: Swedish Migration

events.desc: With the end of Karl Johan's reign, … has ascended to the … throne as Oscar I, King …. … reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
events.flavor:
The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:

"The Almighty God pour out his Holy Spirit into your soul and mind, plans and undertakings, by whose gift may you so rule land and kingdom as to redound to the honour and glory of God, maintain justice and equity and be for the good of the land and people." 

 The king then rose and resumed his seat on his throne. 

" Now … has been crowned king of the Swedes, Geats, and Wends. He and no other."

options.name: Long live the King!

events.title: The Accession of Oscar I

events.desc: Oscar I's reign has come to an end, after suffering from an illness, it steadily became worse, leading to paralysis and death. … has ascended to the … throne as Charles XV, King …. … reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
events.flavor:
The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:

"The Almighty God pour out his Holy Spirit into your soul and mind, plans and undertakings, by whose gift may you so rule land and kingdom as to redound to the honour and glory of God, maintain justice and equity and be for the good of the land and people." 

 The king then rose and resumed his seat on his throne. 

" Now … has been crowned king of the Swedes, Geats, and Wends. He and no other."

options.name: Long live the King!

events.title: Death of a King

events.desc: Charles XV's reign has come to an end. … has ascended to the … throne as Oscar II, King …. … reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
events.flavor:
The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:

"The Almighty God pour out his Holy Spirit into your soul and mind, plans and undertakings, by whose gift may you so rule land and kingdom as to redound to the honour and glory of God, maintain justice and equity and be for the good of the land and people." 

 The king then rose and resumed his seat on his throne. 

" Now … has been crowned king of the Swedes, Geats, and Wends. He and no other."

options.name: Long live the King!

events.title: A Unexpected Death

events.desc: For centuries our administration has depended on tax farming for collecting revenue, but this highly inefficient system leaves much to be desired. Proposals for reform have flooded the Grand Vizier's desk, and the nation eagerly awaits our response.
events.flavor:
Ever since the reign of Mehmed II, taxation rights have been auctioned off to the highest bidder, who in turn retain a part of the revenue for personal use. Over time, this has created a cadre of powerful, autonomous, and oftentimes corrupt …, significantly reducing state revenues.

While most agree that the system must change, few agree on how, and fewer still want to antagonize the landholding elite.

options.name: Abolish tax farming, but leave the … in place.
Let sleeping dogs lie.
Abolish the system in fact as well as in name.

events.title: The Iltizām System

events.desc: Our existing system of land ownership is old, inconsistent, and in dire need of reform. Proponents of modernization demand action; how shall the High Porte respond?
events.flavor:
Land ownership in the Ottoman Empire is a complicated affair, consisting of an overlapping patchwork of tenured and communal lands, tax-exempt villages, grants of conquest, and a slew of other land categories. Recognizing the current situation's negative impact on state administration and revenue, key figures in Constantinople push for reform. 

Fearing conscription and increased taxation however, the Empire's rural population are sure to disapprove of any change to the status quo.

options.name: Reform the system, but recognize traditional land categories.
The old system has served us well.
Enact a truly modern land code.

events.title: An Ottoman Land Code

events.desc: With our move towards a more professional bureaucratic system in motion, demands have been put forth to nominally elevate the legal status of non-Muslims, enabling them to serve as civil servants.
events.flavor: The preservation of the Sublime State in the face of unrest, insurrection, and foreign intervention is a, if not the, primary concern of the …. If we are to achieve this however, steps to appease our minority subjects might be necessary, lest they become pawns of malicious foreign powers.

options.name: Equal rights under the law! On paper at least.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: Promise reform, but let us not get carried away.

modifiers.label: Radicalism increases for the Violent Hostility Status
Radicalism increases for the Cultural Erasure Status
Radicalism increases for the Open Prejudice Status

options.name: These are mere concessions masqueraded as reform. Denied!

events.title: Islâhat Hatt-ı Hümâyûnu

events.desc: A climate of paranoia has enveloped the city of …, after a local imam accused the … community of conspiring with … to undermine the authority of the ….
events.flavor: "Are God's adversaries to be the equal of Islam? Some corrupt Pashas in … may think so, but we true believers know better. As we speak, the unbelievers in our midst are busy plotting our doom, conspiring with their foreign masters to carve up our great empire like the confectioner carves up baklava."

options.name: They are just rumors, right?
Crack down hard on suspected traitors, better safe than sorry.

events.title: Whispers of Insurrection

events.desc: Outraged by the High Porte's decision to elevate the legal status of Dhimmis, and spurred on by rumors of foreign-backed insurrection, a large … mob has rampaged through the … quarter of ….
events.flavor: "They came following noon prayer, wielding sticks and clubs—no-doubt egged on by some militant local preacher. Only some bruises and material damage so far, thank God, but I do not like the look of that crowd over by the western gate."

options.name: This is for the local governor to handle.
Muster the army, intervene immediately.
Let the mob run its course.

events.title: Riot in the … Quarter

events.desc: Horror! In a fit of merciless fury, a large crowd of … rioters have turned on their … neighbors. The streets of … run red with blood, and large parts of the city is ablaze.
events.flavor: "But whoever deliberately slays another believer, his requital shall be hell, therein to abide; and God will condemn him, and will reject him, and will prepare for him awesome suffering."

options.name: Break up the crowds, with bullet fire if need be.
That should keep those would-be traitors in line.

events.title: The … Massacre

events.desc: A sense of normalcy has returned to the streets of …. Storefronts are being rebuilt and restocked, and statements of distrust and hatred are gradually being replaced with ones of reconciliation.
events.flavor: "The bastards ruined my store and insulted my name! But at the very least that was the extent of my injury. My son saw at least two of the men who partook in the riot dragged away by soldiers, apparently outed by their own community. Perhaps there is some justice to be found here after all. Now pass me the sugar, this tea is as bitter as uncured olives."

options.name: Allah'a şükür!

events.title: Order Restored in …

events.desc: With the possibility of increased taxation and military service looming large, peasants from … have refused to register their land, depriving us of much-needed tax revenue.
events.flavor: "For two hundred years my family has worked this land; paying our dues as we have according to tradition. But now the Pashas of … have devised yet another insidious system for bleeding us dry, and my sons will be called on to perish on some distant battlefield."

options.name: Let local Sheiks purchase their land, the tax must flow.
… and … men will quell this unrest.
Leave them be, who cares about …?

events.title: Peasants Resist Land Registration

events.desc: With the establishment of a military draft, the state must now decide the role, if any, of non-Muslims in our army.
events.flavor: The Empire's non-Muslim subjects have traditionally been exempt from military service, substituting their blood with a special 'cizye' tax paid to the High Porte. Proponents of army modernization have now suggested the extension of the draft to all Ottoman subjects, however, this would rob the imperial coffers of an important source of income.

options.name: Those who can afford it may pay a draft exemption tax.
The draft applies to all subjects, regardless of creed.

events.title: Drafting Dhimmis

events.desc: A fringe group of the … has gained remarkable traction. They advocate for the abolition of all taxation, equating it to an act of theft by the state. Their intent seems to be to block any tax reform other than total abolition.
events.flavor: "As a private and sovereign … citizen, I do not consent to the pillaging of my hard-earned coffers by the so-called 'government'. It is a violation not only of my rights, but of the free market, the very foundation of basic economics."

options.name: But who would build the roads?
Promise short-term tax cuts.

events.title: Taxation Is Theft

events.desc: The … are rallying support for the … law, promoting the idea that the new tax is vital to support … in the ….
events.flavor: "The sinews of war are infinite money. We cannot hope to be successful in our struggle to assert our sovereignty if we cannot raise the necessary funds to support our brave servicemen; would you send our boys out with nothing but sticks and rags?"

options.name: Dissenters have no sense of loyalty.
Commend the … for their patriotism.

events.title: Patriotic Taxation

events.desc: … has suddenly died while drafting legislation for the … law.
events.flavor: "A human being is dead! The body is barely cold and you speak of passing legislation. Can you not put politics aside so that we can mourn in peace?"

options.name: Let us mourn the loss of a great leader.
We should honor … dying wish.

events.title: Death and Taxes

events.desc: The people of … tell the story of a highwayman who robs from the rich and gives to the poor. The legend is spreading quickly throughout …, damaging support for the … law.
events.flavor: "He's so dashing! Even as he stole the pearls from around my neck I couldn't help but feel flustered. He left a single red rose upon my lap as he vanished into the night with a flourish of his cape."

options.name: Hunt down the bandit.
The police will make an example of the bandit.
Attempt to relieve poverty in ….

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

options.name: Redouble poverty relief measures.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata

events.title: Social Banditry

events.desc: The Upper Strata have decided to donate generously to the poor. Many among them even advocate for the … law, agreeing that it would be a fair means of redistributing wealth.
events.flavor: "We have so much, and they have so little. We are still wealthy even when we give generously, are you really going to miss a few thousand Pounds? Think of how little that money means to you, and how much it could mean to a starving mother and her children."

options.name: Encourage charitable giving.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: Leverage their support for ….

events.title: Philanthropy

events.desc: Ambitious Middle Strata citizens are opposing … on the grounds that when they inevitably become wealthy capitalists, they will be excessively taxed.
events.flavor:
"Why are you opposing the law, my friend? You're not rich!"

"Not yet, but as soon as my next business venture takes off I will be a wealthy man. And when that happens, I surely would not want to be taxed so highly."

options.name: They should be more realistic.

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Middle Strata

options.name: Sway them with a tax cut.

events.title: Temporary Embarrassment

events.desc: Following a series of poor business decisions, … has taken to lashing out against … detractors in the tabloids. These screeds have served to destroy … public reputation and damaged support for ….
events.flavor: "Low passions be praised in this theater of the damned! An era of unenlightened barbarism and puritanical populism. Only the truly mad could ever reject the benevolent rule of the enlightened few. Damned, lost sheep I name you all! Perhaps you should remain there, while I and my fellows would reap the benefits of a matrix so utopian that all would quake beneath its magnificence. And you will beg to be part of it then! Mark my words, gentlemen!"

options.name: A public bailout will resolve the matter.
Disgraceful behavior.
Have … committed to the asylum.

events.title: Public Meltdown

events.desc: A group of influential Engineers have greatly improved productivity in the … of … through the application of scientific principles. They suggest that under … they would be able to apply these principles to the mechanicisms of government.
events.flavor:
A salient point of intelligence is understanding one's limitations. Through this comes the recognition that one's experience is finite and subject to perspective. Without this pillar, human intelligence is prone to hubris.

For example, someone may conceive the idea that it is possible to treat bureaucracy as a machine, rather than the cluster of skills that it is. Thusly, treat humans as problems to solve, rather than independent variables with experience and intelligence of their own.

options.name: The industrial sector needs them most.
A fascinating proposal.

events.title: The New Machine

events.desc: Debate rages between Academics at the … of … over the issue of popular governance versus rule by an enlightened elite. The argument has captured public attention due to the ongoing effort to establish a ….
