events.flavor: "Unless, said I, either philosophers become kings in our states or those whom we now call our kings and rulers take to the pursuit of philosophy seriously and adequately, and there is a conjunction of these two things, political power and philosophic intellgence, while the motley horde of the natures who at present pursue either apart from the other are compulsory excluded, there can be no cessation of troubles, dear Glaucon, for our states, nor, I fancy, for the human race either."

options.name: The people need great minds to see what is best for them.
We can at least agree on our distaste for Aristocrats.

events.title: Elitists!

events.desc: … has experienced a period of internal stability and consistent improvement under … governance. Formerly-skeptical segments of society have widely come to accept … as the ideal form of government.
events.flavor:
"In Technocracy, we see science replacing an economy of scarcity with an economy of abundance.
In Technocracy we see functional competence displacing grotesque and wasteful incompetence, facts displacing guesswork, order displacing disorder, industrial planning displacing industrial chaos.
Technocracy is the attempt of science to build a civilization worthy of the intelligence of Man."

— Howard Scott, "Technocracy: Science vs. Chaos"

options.name: A new world has never been closer.
Our methods must extend to every facet of society.

events.title: Improvement Under Science

events.desc: Due to a spate of accidents, there have been calls to regulate automobiles.
events.flavor: It is being reported that …"Faster than a horse and twice as heavy. If people don't see why that's dangerous, I don't know what to tell you."

options.name: Stricter laws make safer streets.
People merely need to adjust.
Automobiles should have the right of way.

events.title: Unregulated Automobiles

events.desc: It has been suggested that by establishing a cross border telephone exchange with …, we could improve relations more easily.
events.flavor: "It certainly cuts down on misunderstandings when we can just pick up the telephone and work out what's going on across the border."

options.name: Sounds like a great idea.
I don't think so.

events.title: International Telephone Exchange

events.desc: … … has decided to use the new and exciting radio technology to connect more directly with the people.
events.flavor: "It's like … is there in the room with me. It is hard not to be convinced."

options.name: It should express authority
It should make us look good.
Let me tell you about this new wonder drug.

events.title: Fireside Chat

events.desc: An article has been published by the … … about some of the weapons which our country uses in the ongoing … war.
events.flavor:
… Members of the public are calling for the use of such weapons to be restricted.

"Such foul instruments of pain and torment have no place on earth."

options.name: Don't restrict them.
Coverup their usage.

events.title: Weapons of War

events.desc: It has been suggested that we take and distribute some pictures of our country's most famous landmarks.
events.flavor: "So many wonderful places all across our country! It just seems right that the world gets to see them too."

options.name: We should distribute them internationally.
We should distribute them domestically.

events.title: Photographs of …

events.desc: Soldiers are complaining that they have no way to open their canned food.
events.flavor: "Sure the food's a bit better, but what's the point if we can't get at it, eh? Some lads use rocks, others knives. The only reliable thing is how bloody annoying it is to eat."

options.name: Spend some money to develop a way.
They'll figure it out.

events.title: Can-Do Attitude

options.name: Cancel

events.desc: … stands, after a hard-fought and bloody war, independent. There are many within the Republic that advocate for statehood within the …. The …s, by all accounts, would welcome us into their union.
events.flavor: The war with Mexico has ended, and our brave citizens have begun to lay down their arms and return to peacetime life. But what good is independence if we must spend every day watching our backs, waiting for the return of our oppressors? Texas can be stronger still as part of a greater union, one of like-minded states that will not infringe upon our God-given rights.

options.name: We'll join the union!
Full statehood is unnecessary.
We don't need help from the Yankees.

events.title: The Lone Star State

events.flavor: "The people of Texas having, at the time of adopting their constitution, expressed by an almost unanimous vote, their desire to be incorporated into the Union of the United States, and being still desirous of the same with equal unanimity, in order to provide more effectually for their security and prosperity; and the United States, actuated solely by the desire to add to their own security and prosperity, and to meet the wishes of the Government and people of Texas, have determined to accomplish, by treaty, objects so important to their mutual and permanent welfare."

options.name: Welcome to America!
An acceptable compromise.
Outrageous!

events.title: Texan Statehood

events.desc: …, the ruler of Mexico and one of its leading generals, has been captured in a swamp wearing a dragoon's uniform by our forces. He is offering to immediately sign a peace with us in exchange for his release.
events.flavor: "Santa Anna, alive, can be of incalculable benefit to Texas; Santa Anna, dead, would just be another casualty."

options.name: Use Santa Anna to press for a deal.
Let him run back to Mexico, we fight on!

events.title: General Santa Anna Captured

events.desc: The Grand Collapse has begun. Political disloyalty had never been this rampant since the time of Çelebi Mehmed, during the first interregnum. Our lands will shatter to pieces if order is not restored.
events.flavor:
"Estağfurullah, I will never fathom the profit of taunting … … like this."

"It is a game, Salih. Excites the reader, as you are right now, and paves the way to appease new governors in case of a downfall. Vallahi, these people break fast with our blood."

Inhaling the fragrance of mint from his nargile brightened its embers, as Salih glanced outside, folding his mecmua.

"Downfall of what...whom?"

options.name: We will turn this around.

events.title: Fetret

events.desc: Our subject … is offering its loyalty in exchange for a tribute in these dire times.
events.flavor:
The diplomatic papers presented by the Hariciye Nezâreti indicated conspicuous arrogance disguised under royal recognition. Like hyenas encircling a fatally wounded lion, our subjects keep attempting to chew whatever they can while the opportunity is nigh.

Upon gazing through the documents, … … closed his eyes and murmured a prayer before making the final decision.

options.name: Grant them economic independence.
Redraw their borders.
Give them more autonomy.
Opportunists do not deserve our attention.

events.title: Any Port in a Storm

events.desc: In the search for potential folk leaders to persuade to our side, several options have been presented by operatives.
events.flavor:
Ziyâfet-i Hükûmet—or the Government Banquet, in foreign tongue—is when the … gets to show off his grandeur to all important guests.

Proficient servants, musicians and cooks from all parts of the world strive to leave a lasting impression in the name of their master.

It is also an unmissable opportunity for the invited notables, as they delve into an unspoken war of conveniences.

options.name: Praise …, leader of the ….
Approach …, leader of the ….
Entice …, leader of the ….

events.title: Desperate Measures

events.desc: Order has been restored, and none shall oppose our right to rule as we have done for centuries. The grand collapse has been averted, and we will reap the fruits of our acumen.
events.flavor:
"Ah, how dear thou art, O hope of unborn days—
Thou dost free the world from sorrow and despair.

Thine is the age of empire; spread might across the earth.
May the Almighty guard thy fate from each hidden snare.

The deserts once thine are claimed by tyranny's hounds.
Rouse, O wounded lion, from this heedless sleep!"

—Namık Kemal, "Ode to Freedom"

options.name: Glory to our banner!
We should not have strayed from the straight path.

events.title: The Sublime Porte

events.desc: Chaos has emerged from every corner of our nation. Being reduced to our mainland, it is now impossible to stop the spiral of revolution all around us. We must move on.
events.flavor:
"As all things, death and decay are the ultimate endings, son. Graveyards are filled with folk who were once ambitious and vigorous for the temporary, now they are being watched over by a keeper. 

Such is the destiny of nations once built by those under the dirt, desperately beautified by the living. The keeper, too, will join them soon as nothing lasts."

"Nothing?"

"Except Him."

options.name: It had been decreed upon us, so let it be.

events.title: The Grand Collapse

events.flavor: "Think first of the good of others before yourselves. To give is divine, to cultivate a generous spirit is true virtue. Follow the path of righteousness not out of fear, but out of love."

options.name: Religious institutions are the backbone of the state.
The … are true followers of the divine.
… will fill our hearts with faith.

events.title: Miracle Workers

events.desc: As part of the transition to …, the … have introduced and enforced a series of harsh anti-blasphemy laws in …. These measures are polarizing even among the faithful.
events.flavor: "It is as the scriptures say: ours is the only path of the divine. We can suffer no deviation from this path, no defamation of our edicts or of our church. For the faithful the reward is eternal; so too is the punishment for the blasphemer."

options.name: We must uphold the law.
The laws should be relaxed.
Blasphemers shall be put to death.

events.title: The Blasphemy Laws

events.desc: Pogroms targeting … people living in … are being perpetrated by fanatical … supporters of the … law.
events.flavor: "They came at night. We were lucky; they came for our neighbors first and we heard them smash the glass and ransack the shop, so we hid under the floorboards. Huddled in the dark, I pressed my hand to my children's mouths so they would not cry out. We were silent and still. We didn't dare emerge until dawn."

options.name: We cannot interfere.
This is not the … way.
This will not stand. Arrest the perpetrators.

events.title: Religious Pogroms

events.desc: We have decided to venture into Tibet and secure these lands for our own interests. We will have to survey a route into the Himalayan region, then make a show of strength, and then force the Tibetans to the negotiating table.
events.flavor: "It's simple, really." Cigar smoke lingered as the man gestured at the map on the wall with a smouldering stoagie. He jabbed at a cemtral spot. "That is our weak point. If anyone else holds that point, they have a dagger to our throats. We need to secure, uh..." He paused as he tried to peer through the haze of tobacco, "Tibet! We must secure Tibet to save ourselves."

options.name: I know just the fellow for the job!

events.title: To Tibet!

events.desc: A group of strong candidates have expressed their interest in leading the expedition. However, this is not a decision we should make lightly.
events.flavor: The first to arrive was a well-dressed, fresh-faced, almost young gentleman whose keenness to impress was only matched by his willingness to oblige. His smile, as wide as one can imagine, was fashionably put together: "If I may...," he politely said, presenting his credentials.
events.title: Choosing a Leader

events.desc:
With … … in charge, our expedition to Tibet is ready to commence.

Since … is in charge, if … dies the expedition will end in failure.
events.flavor: … scowled as … went through the reports. If every rumor about a vital mountain pass was true, the Himalayas were riddled with more holes than Swiss cheese. There was nothing to do but go out and figure out which one was real.

options.name: Onwards, to Tibet!

events.title: The Expedition Sets Forth

events.desc: A group of local yak herders crossed the border, and only realized their mistake when a Tibetan patrol intercepted them and herded them back. The herders have complained of rough treatment, prompting … … to declare this an acton of wanton aggression that must be answered in kind.
events.flavor: "It's the principle of the matter, nevermind the details! An international border was violated, and appropriate measures must be taken to address this insult to diplomacy and our sovereignty! I could have a regiment of men marching over there right now if you just gave me the word."

options.name: We must be prepared for bold action.
This talk of aggression is ludicrous!

events.title: Cross-Border Yak-cident

events.desc: Surveyors have begun studying the mountains and passes that surround Tibet. Diving into uncharted terrain and climbing unexplored mountains is hazardous work, but … … wishes to get involved all the same.
events.flavor:
"Have you seen that peak? We must climb it!"

"But why"

"Because... it's there!"

options.name: We cannot risk …, send someone else.
Andrew Scott Waugh is eminently qualified for the job.
No peak is too formidable for Charles Granville Bruce!
… is our man on the spot and should take charge here.

events.title: The Great Mountain Survey

events.desc: The foothills of the Himalayas are filled with treacherous flora and fauna. One promising route into the Tibetan Plateau involves delving into a region full of unsavory wildlife. If the route is to be used, … … will have to inspect it ….
events.flavor:
"Nope."

"Nope. Nope nope nope."

The scout looked at the swamp water one last time. A giggle escaped his lips. "Hahahahahaaa, nope!"

This was going to be someone else's problem, not his.

options.name: … can do it and must do it.
Perhaps resting among the mountain air would be better.

events.title: Leeches!

events.desc: With an adequate knowledge of the land ahead, … … has declared that … is ready to assemble the troops and proceed ahead into the Tibetan Plateau.
events.flavor:
It shouldn't have been this difficult. It was a job, just like any other, but somehow... somehow just getting the right men for the job was proving more difficult than anyone expected. There were plenty of regulars on hand, of course, but why not use the cream of the crop? Should any artillery come along? What about horses? Officers?

After much dithering, … finally picked out … favorite pewter models and placed them on the table. …'d get to figuring out the expedition's problems later that evening.

options.name: The expedition must not, cannot, lack for men.
Only the hardiest soldiers can face what's to come.
We need an unorthodox approach here.

events.title: Building an Expeditionary Force

events.desc: With maps prepared and men ready, … … can venture into Tibet at last.
events.flavor:
"We are here to neither find glory nor gold." The officer paced slowly down the line of assembled here. "Not for ourselves, at least. No one will remember us."

He thrust a finger towards the vast mountains in the distance. "Now that will be remembered. Do we want to stand here, on this forgotten tuft of grass, or stand tall there, atop rocks that will last beyond all memory?"

options.name: To the roof of the world!

events.title: Into the Himalayas

events.desc: Our envoy in Lhasa has passed along reports that a … force, led by …, has violated Tibet's borders and is making its way towards the capital.
events.flavor:
The ambassador's calm voice was betrayed by his sweaty brow. "I assure you," he dictated to the messenger, nervously drumming the table with his fingers, "that everything is absolutely under control in Tibet."

He paused, marshalling his next words with the care of a master tactician. "However, it would behoove the government to respond quickly to this action by whatever means it sees fit, in the most timely fashion possible."

He let out a deep breath. Now it was their turn to figure out this mess.

options.name: This disturbance is a mere trifle. No action is needed to save Tibet.
Issue a protest to …'s embassy.
This is unacceptable! Send reinforcements to Lhasa and tell them they have our support.

events.title: … Interference in Tibet

events.desc: Reports are coming in of a … force that has crossed the border and is making its way to the capital. This is a blatant violation of our sovereignty, but resisting … may be too much for us to handle ourselves.
events.flavor: "No, we didn't dare shoot at them!" stammered the guard. "You weren't there! You didn't see how many men were coming! You didn't see their guns! There were only a dozen of us—we had to fall back!"

options.name: We must look the other way for now.
Regardless of their strength, we must resist now!

events.title: The … are Coming!

events.desc:
The … incursion continues to advance towards our capital. To buy time, we could instruct patrols to set up simple roadblocks along the most obvious routes of the … force.

This may lead to incidents with ….
events.flavor: It was a simple proposal, on the face of it. If the enemy were to be stopped, they had to meet some actual resistance. But... could we afford a direct confrontation? That was the question that haunted the minds of every minister and general dealing with the problem.

options.name: We cannot risk a fight. Let them proceed.
A roadblock can't hurt. Delay them at the next opportunity.

events.title: Blocking the … Force?

events.desc: A … patrol has set up a roadblock along the route of … …'s expedition. Any delay in the expedition's progress could be disastrous for the project.
events.flavor: … scowled at the sight before …. The mass of Tibetan soldiers standing across the road ahead of … looked formidable, but … knew what weapons … had brought with the expedition. Getting through the roadblock wasn't the problem—the problem was the price of doing it.

options.name: Make as big a bag as possible! Forwards!
This would be a slaughter—pull back.

events.title: The … Expedition is Blocked

events.desc: Reports have come in of a bloody clash between the … expedition and local Tibetan forces. Our duty to … behooves us to relieve it, but some ministers have expressed discomfort at the idea of strengthening the government in … at all.
events.flavor:
"What happened in that pass is a disgrace, a tragedy!"

"It's a grievous insult to them and to us!"

"So then, gentlemen, what is our next step? Shall we assist them directly? March to the frontier? Supply arms?"

The awkward silence that followed was interrupted only by a dry cough.

options.name: We cannot give any material aid.
We shall support the … military.

events.title: … Clash in Tibet

events.desc: … …'s expedition has been held up by vicious and unexpected weather along one of the more treacherous paths on the way to …. Delays could be costly, but forging through the weather could be costlier still.
events.flavor: The frozen wind was blowing under …'s boots and around his toes. The frost was biting the ground below. It was well below zero, and yet … could hear a soldier cry out. … assumed it was about the snow, but … could barely see beyond the tip of … nose and couldn't tell where the soldier was, much less what was happening around them.

options.name: We must brave the snow and push on!
Better play it safe and weather this storm.

events.title: Himalayan Blizzard

events.desc: A vast fortified monastery thrusts out of the Tibetan stone ahead—Gyantse Dzong, granite guardian of the Tsangpo Valley and one of the key approaches to Lhasa. There can be no safe route to the capital as long as this fortress is not held by the expedition's soldiers.
events.flavor:
The impregnable fortress towered over the surrounding landscape. The nearby villages were specks of dust compared to the stone giant that loomed overhead. The venerable walls and ancient halls echoed with centuries of struggle, of pride, of countless prayers and battles and intrigues. It stood as a persistent testament to the wills of generations of leaders.

A barrage of …'s guns could end it in a day.

options.name: Storm that fort now!
We are not here for bloodshed—negotiate their surrender.

events.title: Gyantse Dzong

events.desc: As …'s soldiers approach …, some soldiers have gotten unruly. Reports have come in of gangs of our men going into houses and monasteries, taking whatever they fancy.
events.flavor: "I assure you, sir, this is completely within acceptable bounds. We were opposed, after all, and it's to be expected that actions would be taken afterwards. Although, of course, the reports from that one monastery must be exaggerated."

options.name: So? That's just how armies are.
Discipline the soldiers and offer an apology to local officials.

events.title: Unsanctioned Pillaging

events.desc: With our expedition near …, it's time we deal with the thorny issue of diplomatic channels. We need to speak to whoever has ultimate authority over these lands.
events.flavor:
He found the officer slumped over a table, screaming into his hands.

"You talk to one official, and he passes you on to the next. Then you talk to that fellow, and he says you've got the wrong man, and points you to a third person. Then that fellow— that fellow says you have it all wrong, and the first fellow is the one with all the authority."

"Oh, where does it end? Who's in charge? Am I even in charge?"

options.name: Issue our demands to …, of course.
Speak directly with ….

events.title: Issuing the Ultimatum

events.desc: The … expedition has, despite our best efforts, reached our capital. Their costly demands are straightforward: submit to their authority.
events.flavor: "It's quite simple, really," grinned the … envoy. "You already know the scorpion. Why not turn to us instead? Cut off relations with other foreign powers and let us handle the rest."

options.name: We will submit to ….
Your show of force means nothing! Leave here now, emptyhanded!

events.title: The … Ultimatum

events.desc: The … expedition into Tibet has undercut our authority in the region, and now they demand we formally cede control to them. This is a grievous insult, but dare we stand against them now?
events.flavor: "It's quite simple, really," grinned the … envoy. "You have been the scorpion, but now it's time for us to wield the stinger. Let us manage this parcel of Himalayan rock, and we can leave you be and let this matter finally come to an end."

options.name: We will submit to …'s demands.
Your show of force means nothing! Leave here now, emptyhanded!

events.title: The … Ultimatum

events.desc: The … expedition has directly approached … officials and forced them to acknolwedge … suzerainty. They are now subjects of ….
events.flavor: "It's quite simple, really," grinned the … envoy. "We had a simple discussion with the people who mattered, and now they are ours. They knew the scorpion, and now it's time to know us." He chuckled, waving the … officials away.

options.name: … land will always be ours!
… must return … now.

events.title: The Convention of …

events.desc: … …'s expedition to Tibet has been a resounding success, and this strategic region is now under our thumb. … is already being feted in …, and … has a bright future ahead of ….
events.flavor:
"It's simple, really." Cigar smoke lingered as the man gestured at the map on the wall with a smouldering stoagie. "That was our weak point. It was of vital necessity that we pour whatever men and gold was needed to secure, uh..." He paused as he tried to peer through the haze of tobacco, "Tibet! We had to secure Tibet to save ourselves."

He turned back to the other men in the club. "Now! Who's ready for some billiards?"

options.name: Three cheers for …!

events.title: The Convention of …

events.desc: Our expedition has come across an animal den while traversing a treacherous mountain pass. Investigation revealed that it is inhabited by a rare animal - the Pallas's Cat.
events.flavor:
When he lowered the lantern to peer into the den's depths, baleful golden eyes stared back at him. Their round pupils and the markings surrounding them gave off a peculiar sort of humanity, like an mustachioed man with furrowed brows. The cat was judging him, thought the expeditionary, and it was dug in as adeptly as any soldier in their trench.

He shifted the light's angle, and three smaller sets of eyes glared back. A mother in her den, guarding three kittens that were just old enough to hiss at the light. The botanical gardens would pay handsomely for them, but would that make up for the fingers it would cost?

options.name: Capture them, and have them shipped to ….
A magnificent pelt, ready to be claimed!
Make our notes, but let them be.

events.title: A Fierce Face

events.desc: …, of the …, has determined to sponsor the construction of a memorable ocean liner in the shipyards of …. It will be like nothing ever seen before.
events.flavor:
"The majesty, the perfect reflection of the light against its four black funnels was sufficient to itself. A number of us who enjoyed the crisp air were promenading about the deck. There is a sense of emptiness that comes over us at evening. A kid stood silent. We couldn't talk after that.

The ship, the sunset—and the shameless dream of the future, crystallized."

options.name: People will talk about the luxury of this ship!
We should make its construction more efficient.
We have no time to follow a maniac's delusions.

rewards.name: Did Not Build an Ocean Liner
Opposed the Construction of an Ocean Liner

events.title: Titanic 1

events.flavor: "As I was put into the boat, he cried to me, 'It’s all right, little girl. You go. I will stay.' As our boat shoved off he threw me a kiss, and that was the last I saw of him."

options.name: This is a tragedy.

events.title: A Mournful Disaster

events.flavor:
"What are men compared to the waves and the ocean? That ship was the only proof we had of man establishing his dominion over the sea. Sages of antiquity would crumble and curse, for we have bewitched their gods and surpassed their liquid monsters.

We are here, now—and awe springs eternal."

options.name: It was the ship of dreams.

events.title: An Impressive Voyage

events.desc: The Armed Forces are questioning the wisdom of relying on weapon imports from …, an acknowledged threat to our nation.
events.flavor: "It's not that I would question the reliability of … rifles," said the general, "but we can scarcely count on them continuing to supply us with them if they expect to be staring down the barrels themselves!"

options.name: We will set up a domestic arms industry in case of a betrayal.
The … menace has been exaggerated.

events.title: Dangerous Gunsmiths

events.desc: The more advanced weapons we import from … could provide valuable insights into our current military research project.
events.flavor: "It would not be military espionage, exactly, nor industrial espionage. It'd rather be an innovative homage to our … friends, who have provided us with such elegant examples of gunsmithing."

options.name: Take them apart and find out how to put them together!
We will carve our own path to the future of weaponry.

events.title: Borrowing Designs

events.desc: The … has questioned the morality of importing luxuries to our capital while the high price of Grain is a cause of concern for many poor citizens.
events.flavor:
He put down the crate with more force than necessary, to emphasize the point.

"We know better than anyone how many shipments get hauled on these docks every day. Don't tell me the price of a loaf of bread has nothing to do with this fancy stuff we're hauling today!"

options.name: We shall endeavor to import this basic good as well.
Let them eat brioches!

events.title: Decadent Priorities

events.desc: The Industrialists find the high price of Steel in the capital an impediment to their ambitions and would like us to prioritize importing it.
events.flavor: "My business associates abroad say I run my business with an iron fist. It may sound intimidating, but it is in fact a rather humiliating joke at my expense; they're looking to imply that I am getting rusty!"

options.name: We will find a source of this vital material for the modern age.
Their ambitions should first be to make steel, not use it.

events.title: Industrial Grade Materials

events.desc: The Intelligentsia find it difficult to find the cheap Paper they need to immortalize their thoughts.
events.flavor: "The only upside of this wretched state of affairs," the professor said with an exasperated sigh, "is that when someone says an idea is not worth the paper it's printed on, they at least mean it!"

options.name: We will secure the pages of tomorrow's classics!
Learn brevity.

events.title: The Canvas of Ideas

events.desc: An enterprising entertainer has arranged for two aging locomotives to run into each other at a local fair. The resulting collision may pose a danger to the crowd, although that hasn't stopped …, leader of the …, from declaring that … will have a front-row seat at the event.
events.flavor:
"For crying out loud, why? Why do you want to see a crash so badly?"

"Honestly? I believe that somewhere in the makeup of every normal person—myself included—there lurks the suppressed desire to smash things up."

options.name: Everyone, enjoy the spectacle!
Forbid … from risking … life attending this!

rewards.name: Denied Attendance to the Smashing Event

events.title: The Great Train Smash

events.desc: Since the secession of … in 1830, … efforts to reunify the country have all met with failure. Weary of the effects of the current, uneasy truce, many are now urging the … to commit to a final, negotiated settlement.
events.flavor:
"The revolution of 1830 is and will remain the greatest state error of this century, but our efforts to reclaim these lands by force have failed and our prospects are looking bleaker by the day.

We currently stand to gain more from arbitration than we do through force of arms. Sir, I implore you to dispatch a mission to Brussels as soon as humanly possible."

options.name: Agreed. Call for a conference to settle the matter at last.
We do not negotiate with rebels.

events.title: The Belgian Question

events.desc: Weary of the uneasy truce existing between our two countries, the … government has approached us with a proposal for a conference to resolve our current territorial and legal disputes.
events.flavor: "So now the Dutch desire arbitration? No doubt they have their eyes firmly fixed on rightful Belgian soil. Though their ambition lie bare for all to see, we may have little choice in the matter. A refusal to compromise might harm our standing in Europe in ways we cannot easily amend."

options.name: Very well, agree to great power mediation.
We shall not give an inch to the damned Dutch!

events.title: The Hague Call for a Conference

events.desc: The unsettled nature of …-… relations have threatened European stability ever since 1830. A conference to settle the issue for good has now been called in London, with the great powers of Europe all invited to arbitrate.
events.flavor: "For nearly a decade we have sought to bring these two parts to the table, and for nearly a decade we have been frustrated in our efforts. Now, be it by providence or by a stroke of luck we have them right where we want them. Let us not waste this opportunity, the stability of Europe depends on our success."

options.name: Let us settle this matter once and for all.
We have no interest in this squabble.

events.title: London Calling

events.desc: The conference has concluded, and …
events.flavor:
European Powers Guarantee Peace and Stability
The newly ratified Treaty of London is a cornerstone of European peace; it solidifies Belgium’s neutrality and independence and marks a new chapter in European diplomacy, one that prioritizes peace and mutual respect among nations. While the Dutch delegation... (cont. pp. 3-6)

options.name: For peace in our time, hurrah!

events.title: London Conference Concludes

events.desc: With negotiations between … and … having broken down in full, it would appear that a diplomatic solution to the Belgian question has eluded Europe once again.
events.flavor: As the delegations made their way out of the Foreign Office and onto King Charles Street, the air of amicability that they so deperately tried to maintain could not even fool the doorman—much less each other. What this would mean for future Dutch-Belgian relations they could still not say, but that it would be bad? Now at last, there was something they could agree on.

options.name: What a waste of everybody's time.

events.title: Failure of the London Conference

events.desc: With the old regime swept aside, the treaty ports it once granted to … have passed into our keeping. Their merchants still raise a foreign flag over our harbors under agreements we never signed. We may honor what we have inherited, or cast the foreigners out and reclaim these ports for ….
events.flavor: "The ink was dry long before we took power, yet the chains it forged are now ours to wear or to break."

options.name: Honor the agreements
Reclaim our harbors

events.title: An Inherited Concession

events.desc: There has been an upheaval in the lands about our treaty ports. With the previous regime gone, … has chosen to honor the agreements struck with those who came before. Our merchants may continue to fly our flag over their harbors.
events.flavor: "A change of masters, yet the same old bargain. How refreshingly reasonable."

options.name: A wise decision

events.title: Concessions Honored

events.desc: There has been an upheaval in the lands about our treaty ports. With the previous regime gone, … has torn up the agreements struck with those who came before. Our ports have been seized and our merchants turned out into the street. This insult shall not soon be forgotten.
events.flavor: "They would deny us what was promised by those who came before. Let them remember that our guns have long memories."

options.name: An outrage!

events.title: Concessions Revoked

events.desc: Heavy usage of trenches in … by … has turned the land into a blasted hellscape. The stalemate cannot last forever, but it's not clear what the best way forward is.
events.flavor: "Have you ever been there, in the trenches? It's less lonely than you'd think. You have friends everywhere—the rats will be with you every day and night, and even when your mates die, they'll stay right there with you, just down below in the mud."

options.name: We must entrench further in ….
We can't let our defenses stagnate.
We need a breakthrough.

events.title: The Entrenched Front

events.desc: A massive explosion resounds across the region of Tunguska in …. Scientists believe that a celestial object has collided with the Earth.
events.flavor: "I lost my senses for a moment, but then my wife ran out and led me to the house. After that such noise came, as if rocks were falling or cannons were firing, the Earth shook, and when I was on the ground, I pressed my head down, fearing rocks would smash it. When the sky opened up, hot wind raced between the houses, like from cannons, which left traces in the ground like pathways, and it damaged some crops."

options.name: Fascinating, but irrelevant.
This warrants scientific investigation.
It is an omen!
Can we mine it?

events.title: The Tunguska Event

events.flavor:
In a cottage on the outskirts of Barcelona, a woman with blistered hands wraps a woolen thread around the pegs of a loom. The factory required five meters by the end of the week, and as it demanded, it would receive.

In Andalucía, a man swings his hoe into the unforgiving soil. A line of a hundred stands on each side of him. None of them would ever know anything more.

Outside a tent in Toledo, an officer walks along a line of conscripts. His head is full of gunsmoke, and theirs contain nothing at all. They would need to learn, he knew. How to forage, how to make one cartridge do the work of ten. If the moral truly outweighed the material, it would be proven here.

options.name: Crown or Cortes—which future will come to be?

events.title: The Two Spains

events.desc: The spirit of urban, enlightened … has triumphed over the … of Crown and Church. Wherever the future takes us, we shall follow unburdened by tradition.
events.flavor:
"The world never saw nobler audacity,
Nor ever saw a day of greater valor,
Than the one when, inflamed, we felt the fire,
Excite in Riego love for the homeland.

Soldiers, the homeland calls us to the fight,
Let us swear for her to conquer or die."

— Evaristo Fernández de San Miguel, Himno de Riego

options.name: Libertad!
The spirit of Colonel Riego stands tall.

events.title: The Most Exalted

events.desc: The spirit of rural, traditionalist … has triumphed over the … of Enlightenment and Constitution. The Godless future once thought inevitable has been banished from our shores.
events.flavor:
"Through Catholicism man recognized the law of order, and through man this order entered into society. The redemption regained for the moral world the laws which it had lost through prevarication and sin. Catholic dogma became the criterion for the sciences, Catholic ethics the guide for human actions, and Catholic charity the standard for the affections. Human conscience, freed from the corrosive action of error and sin, was thus enlightened in its interior, as in its exterior darkness. And, guided bv the light of these three criterions, was restored to the felicity of lost innocence."

— Juan Donoso Cortés, Essays on Catholicism, Liberalism, and Socialism

options.name: For God, Fatherland, and King, we stand triumphant.
Revelation will set the world right again.

events.title: The Spirit of Don Carlos

events.flavor:
"Is this it? Do we have the Republic?"

Francisco looked up at the open window, at the pale copyist leaning out of it. The scent of ink and candle wax wafted out after him.

"Not yet, but soon," he replied. "We can hope! That's more than we could say last week!"

options.name: And now, to govern.

events.title: Two Spains 4

events.flavor:
"Is this it? Do we have the Republic?"

Francisco looked up at the open window, at the pale copyist leaning out of it. The scent of ink and candle wax wafted out after him.

"Not yet, but soon," he replied. "We can hope! That's more than we could say last week!"

options.name: And now, to govern.

events.title: Two Spains 41

events.desc: Despite many efforts on the part of the government to successfully revive … from its present imbroglio, the law has come to be regarded as nothing but an inevitable failure.
events.flavor:
"That bill? Please, don't talk to me about it."

"I would say it's better to just pretend it never happened, don't you agree?"

"Certainly, but that won't stop that fool from asking about it every day..."

options.name: We must sponsor a complete rewrite of the bill.
Off to the fire with the entire notion, then.

events.title: Legislative Failures

events.desc: After a series of costly and embarassing setbacks, the sitting … government has decided to halt its pursuit of …. It will be some time before political will exists to try again.
events.flavor:
Defeat lingered in the air, along with the stench burnt tobacco and spoiling liquor. Hopes crushed, ideas splintered, and desire spoiled. For better or worse, the message was clear: nobody wanted … but the men in the room.

A long, treacherous path lay ahead to reingratiate the idea.

options.name: Unfortunate, and embarassing.

events.title: The Legislative Graveyard

events.desc: The … have expressed their satisfaction with the direction being taken by the country and its newly built factories.
events.flavor: "There's only one possible direction: forward! Progress is like a train that doesn't stop, doesn't wait for anyone, you're either in or out."

options.name: We've done this for our people.
And we shall support that train.

events.title: Road to Progress

events.desc: The most prominent members of … high society have been seen organizing luxurious parties in the new and lavish urban buildings.
events.flavor: "Marble walls, shimmering stone. The noise of people coming and going brings the city back to life, when we didn't even know it was dead. Tall buildings cover the sunset, kids play with bricks, smoke blends with the clouds; a distant bell announces the next train. Progress is coming."

options.name: Let them celebrate.
The party will never end!

modifiers.label: Minimum Expected Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

events.title: Oh, City of Plenty

events.desc: The … have expressed their concerns about government decisions clearly favoring the interests of the ….
events.flavor: "Choosing is always hard; not because the decision is difficult to make, but because the consequences can be a bit... inconvenient. Rumors are spreading like smoke from a factory, staining the clear air of … with a dense and vicious poison."

options.name: This needs to be addressed.
They need to accept that we cannot always please everyone.

events.title: Raising Concerns

events.desc: … has come a long way since our attention was first brought to it, going from small houses and scattered farmlands to being on its way to become a blooming metropolis.
events.flavor:
The woman sighs, her old hands stop crocheting for a second. "When I was younger all of this was farmlands. Us kids would just play freely in the fields, not having to worry about getting hit by a cart or those criminals coming to get us. And we still had time to work!"

"Well, grandma, now people will have even more places to work at."

options.name: Finally, … shines like never before.
This is not the end!

events.title: Winds of Change

events.desc: The … have started complaining about the wasteful inefficiency of Subsistence Farms in ….
events.flavor: "The fertile soil of our people suffers, relegated to tired and callous hands, too exhausted from manual labor to perform at a decent level. Too poor to be able to use more advanced tools that would make them more profitable... This industry is just a useless investment."

options.name: It won't matter if everyone comes to the city.
Then we should modernise the farms.
Looks like the perfect ground for an army base.

events.title: Inefficient Agriculture

events.desc: The principles of … ideology now play a central role in … policymaking. The administration has been reformed to function like a well-oiled machine.

options.name: The future looks happy and bright.

events.title: Good Governance for All

events.desc: The chaos engulfing the … serves as a testament to the failure of the … project. Its proponents have been accused of irreversibly destabilizing the administration.
events.flavor:
The promise of a Utilitarian approach to colonial administration has not come to fruition. The failure has left the project's staunchest supporters disillusioned with mocking remarks directed towards them.

"I always knew the project would fail. The whole approach was fundamentally flawed from the beginning. There is no space for such an absurd agenda."

options.name: They have no utility here.

events.title: False Promises

events.desc: While a … approach to colonial administration was promising, it did not take root here in ….

options.name: Our people will prosper regardless.

events.title: A Project Without Progress

events.desc: The … claim that public opinion and the press in … are negatively influencing … policy.
events.flavor:
"Of course, The Times has an opinion. I'm sure John the baker and Jane the seamstress have one too. The … should listen to them all. Who cares how ill informed their ideas about India are? Maybe every policy can be decided by general election."

"When will they learn that to govern India, one must be in India?"

options.name: Take control of the narrative in the press.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

options.name: The opinions of the … public are harmless.

modifiers.label: Suppression impact on Political Movement attraction

events.title: Undue Influence

events.desc: The attitudes and actions of the … administrators in … towards the … people threaten our … mission.
events.flavor:
… attests to recent reports of violence towards … people in …:

"The unrestrained behavior of the … administrators who have come to … to make their fortunes undermines the efforts of our … mission. The … people are in need of protection from the injustices perpetrated on them by the … fortune seekers."

options.name: These administrators must exercise restraint.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: Why interfere now?

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

events.title: Imperial Liabilities

events.desc: The … is actively increasing their efforts to fortify the ties … has with ….
events.flavor:
The portrait of … … looms large over the two distinguished figures as they argue late into the evening.

"We are all loyal subjects of the Empire, …. No policy will change that. But while we work to aid all subjects, you wish to aid only your prospects."

"If the … trusts me, I will be able to call for … aid."

"If the people trust you, then you will never want for aid."

options.name: We need more autonomy right now.
See that the …'s efforts are undisturbed.

events.title: Strengthening Ties

events.desc: Letters from … have arrived with new governing guidances for … officers and officials.
events.flavor:
Often, the day-to-day actions of this … official have little oversight in his corner of …. His actions have long been unchecked. The letters from … outline new guidance on reporting paperwork discrepancies.

"What a nuisance. My officers work hard. A discrepancy here and there can surely be overlooked."

options.name: We must follow orders.
Let local officials use their own judgment.

events.title: Delayed Decisions

events.desc: The … has received a formal dispatch from … recommending the expansion of education in ….
events.flavor:
The telegraph had arrived late at night. Having read it, the … wished he had left it for the morning.

"So they want us to educate the masses?  That is bound to shake things up. Either my successor will have many clerks to do his bidding, or he will have a well informed, articulate opposition. We will have to be careful with how we go about this."

options.name: The … can help enact these changes.
It is disadvantageous to respond to the dispatch.

events.title: Equal Opportunities

events.desc: Colonial administrators adhering to … philosophy have developed ambitious plans for a wholesale rationalization of … society. Their critics call it an impossible, extraordinarily demanding vision.
events.flavor:
"This is a grand undertaking, one of utmost importance. It will require the combined efforts of every loyal subject as we work to shape this nation into something resembling order. The people, and those they look up to, must heed our advice."

"But who to turn to first? Will the people turn their leaders to our cause? Or should we plead our case with them and hope they can show their followers the value in our path? After all, everything we do, we do for the benefit of all."

options.name: We must persuade the public.
Persuade more officials to join our cause.

events.title: An Extraordinarily Demanding Vision

events.desc: An organized census has been proposed to create a comprehensive understanding of the population in ….
events.flavor:
"The study of India must be as much a profession in itself as law or medicine."

"To govern one must know the governed. It is a miracle that we have got this far without completing a census. But to go any further would be foolish. Worse, it would be akin to wandering a trap laden maze, blindfolded. No, we must know the language, caste, religion, and sex, of everyone!"

options.name: Proceed with the census.

modifiers.label: Cultural Acceptance for the Kshatriyas Social Class
Cultural Acceptance for the Vaishyas Social Class
Cultural Acceptance for the Shudras Social Class
Cultural Acceptance for the Dalit Social Class

options.name: What purpose would it serve?

events.title: The Study of Indian Society

events.desc: A group of people inspired by the … theories of … have established an experimental colony in rural …. The colony styles itself as a window into an idyllic future society.
events.flavor:
"The title of "page" is given to those who serve kings. It belongs more rightly to those who serve a Phalanstery, for a Phalanstery is God in action. It is the spirit of God, since it is composed of the twelve passions harmonised; by passional attraction, practical truth, mathematical justice, and unity of action.

Hence to collectively serve the Phalanstery is to serve God, and it is thus that domestic duties are envisioned in harmony. If this primitive branch of industry were disparaged as it is today, passional equilibrium would become impossible."

options.name: Inspiring.
Nothing will come of it.
Insurrection in the making.

events.title: A Window to Utopia

events.desc: Amongst the current generation of socialists, a mode of analysis based upon class conflict has supplanted the multitudinous … ideas of the past. To dream is no longer sufficient.
events.flavor: "To the Utopians, Socialism is the expression of absolute truth, reason, and justice, all of which are different with the founder of each different school. And as each one's special kind of absolute truth, reason, and justice is again conditioned by his subjective understanding, his conditions of existence, the measure of his knowledge and his intellectual training, there is no other ending possible in this conflict of absolute truths than that they shall be mutually exclusive of one another."

options.name: Socialism has evolved, and so must its proponents.
The liberation of the individual will bring forth utopia.
A new society will be birthed from cooperation between classes.
In dark times, one must cling to what inspires them.

events.title: Without Illusions

events.flavor:
"Do you not think that there are things which you cannot understand, and yet which are; that some people see things that others cannot? But there are things old and new which must not be contemplated by men´s eyes, because they know—or think they know—some things which other men have told them.

Ah, it is the fault of our science that it wants to explain all; and if it explain not, then it says there is nothing to explain."

options.name: Just another case of rural superstitions.
A couple of professors have expressed their interest in the matter.
The … would like to investigate the bodies.

events.title: A Strange Superstition

events.desc: A growing populist and pro-modernization trend amongst the … have led them to challenge the hold of the … over the … political system.
events.flavor:
"And what are you all doing here? This is a shop stewards' meeting about the coronels' stocks. Theaters are more fitting for you university-whelped layabouts."

"Well, a few birdies told us of your radical idea of, uh, exporting something other than coffee and milk. Perhaps a change in management with it?"

"Ah... very well then: a shop stewards and journalists' meeting."

options.name: The … have a new challenger.

events.title: Freedom Without Distinction

events.desc: Inspired by the Tenetist revolt in …, Captain … has begun a sizable insurgency, marching … troops through several states to evade government forces.
events.flavor: The order came as the government troops began fortifying their positions. Along with the promotion, the direction was clear: march north and find the insurrectionists at Paraná River. Marching was the easy part. Marching with over 14,000 troops at … heels was almost infeasible. But nothing is gained without anything ventured. It was time, … decided, for a breakout.

options.name: We must corner and destroy the rebels.
Chase the column to the interior border.

events.title: The Coluna …

events.desc: Through the efforts of our institutions, the rising populist movement has dissolved into nothing. The reign of the … will continue over … for the foreseeable future.
events.flavor:
"Coronel, the last reports have come through. Most policing and military efforts have put a stranglehold on every major hub. Any active dissidents won't be able to move without us knowing."

"Excellent, tenente. Tell your men to single out the ringleaders. Don't harm the others. I'm sure there are coffee fields that could use their... ‘community service.'"

options.name: There are still those who know who benefits them.
Another threat has been quashed, for now.

events.title: Fallen Hopes

events.desc: The depressed price of Coffee has led to widespread destitution in the heavily coffee-dependent state of …. Concerns about the spreading depression have risen throughout ….
events.flavor:
Osvoldo,

I write to you with the humblest of intentions, and the heaviest of hearts. As coffee prices tumble across the world, I have been left destitute. As if selling the family silverware wasn't enough, I have had to divide more of my plantation for sale. I would ask you, as the president of our country club, to call a meeting. We must stop the freefall of coffee prices around the world, before it drags us all down with it.

options.name: Let them eat coffee.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Standard of Living for the Middle Strata

options.name: The people must have relief.

events.title: An Ocean of Coffee

events.desc: The urban "liberal classes", represented by the … and …, have begun to organize to overturn the monopoly of the … over … politics.
events.flavor:
A Greater Republic, In the Name of Progress!

Secret ballots! Lawyers for all! Compulsory primary education!

Order and progress demand it!

A diet of milk and coffee can only serve us so well. Brazil demands steel, service, salt, and more! Vote away from milk and coffee!

options.name: They bear the seed of a new Brazil.
It will never amount to anything.

events.title: The Liberal Classes

events.desc: … supporting the modernizing ideology of tenetism have seized the city of … and several outlying towns in …. The rebels demand secret ballots and independent courts.
events.flavor:
Fresh Outbreak of Tenentist-itis

Another military formation has broken faith with the Government, and has begun issuing the selfsame list of demands as the other crushed traitors. Sympathizers in … have urged that they be heard fairly this time. Some reports under investigation detail that this group may be similarly disposed to violence as the previous groups. Witnesses close to …... (cont'd pg. 2)

options.name: Send in loyal troops to quash this revolt.
Bomb the rebels into submission.

events.title: Tenetist Revolt in …

events.desc: The recent election has led to a firestorm of accusations of fraud passing between the … and …. These claims have greatly escalated tensions between classes.
events.flavor: Accusations of fraud and manipulation were to be expected. Since the coronels commanded fealty for so long, a supported challenger seemed unheard of. Doubly so that some outlying states offered this challenger 100% of the vote. Some numbers had to be fudged. After all, only someone guilty of the same tactics could possibly get 100% of a state's vote.

options.name: We are unbowed by empty words.
Silence these spurious allegations.

events.title: A War of Fraud

events.desc: Several smaller parties representing the urban middle classes have chosen to endorse … and the … in their bid to unseat the … oligarchy from government.
events.flavor: A regime held up solely by tradition is especially susceptible to rot. This rot can take many forms, but the rot this time was expectation. It was expected that coffee would change to milk, and milk back to coffee. One simple break with that tradition was all it took to fray the alliance. The spurned half of this deal turned to a new face from a relative backwater. Perhaps he could reclaim what was rightfully theirs.

options.name: The people stand together behind ….
Send the coronels' men after their printers.

events.title: The Liberal Alliance

events.desc: The tenetist-sympathetic … garrison in the state of … has seized the city of Manaus and issued several radical populist decrees. The Commune's government has rapidly gained immense popularity amongst the locals.
events.flavor:
Grandfather,

I remember fondly your stories of great-grandfather fighting against the old emperor's men in the Amazon. Now, my friends and I are set to do the same here. One of the captains here heard tell of a city in France doing something like what we're doing.

We know what we're doing this time. It won't be like the old war. It won't be like France. We'll get this right. I know it.

options.name: We must be careful to not spur further revolts.

modifiers.label: Standard of Living for the Lower Strata
Standard of Living for the Middle Strata
Standard of Living for the Upper Strata

options.name: The Commune must be crushed with all due haste.

events.title: The Manaus Commune

events.desc: After a swift seizure of power by elements of the military sympathetic to the reformist cause, … has been declared President of …. … agenda calls for modernization and a swift restoration of order to the nation.
events.flavor: It began in a small state, divested of a share in the oligarchy. Then, by clever words after an assassination, it blossomed. But only after the oligarchy itself was cheated by one of its halves did the revolt grow strong. Now, its actors were assembled: the First Republic was ready to fall. Only swift action would stop a bloody civil war.

options.name: A new Brazil comes into being.

events.title: The New …

events.desc: With a series of crackdowns against the left wing, and numerous decrees reinforcing the power of the state, … … has fully solidified … rule over ….
events.flavor:
…: His Excellency for Life

The sun shines on a Brazil transformed: President … has instituted a new constitution. In its wake, the dissolution of the National Cabinet and the expulsion of all ministers. First among his agendas were an expansion to his characteristic labor protection laws. (Cont'd pg. 3)

options.name: Long live the Brazilian nation!
We must give credit to our Integralist partners.

events.title: The Estado Novo

events.desc: The removal of … from power has promised a new era for …. Whether this new era is one of liberty or continued dictatorship under another name remains to be seen.
events.flavor:
"So that is that, is it?"

"Yes, …. Ironic, isn't it? You ever wonder what the old emperor was thinking when he was deposed? Any last orders? Regrets about his rule?"

"No. No wonders or regrets. I will be like the old emperor: I will stand aside. I will not run for presidency next election."

options.name: We will strive towards a freer era.
We must learn from … lessons.

events.title: Revolution's End

events.desc: The unrest in the state of … has grown beyond any acceptable limit. The government of … … has petitioned to dispatch a federal intervenor to restore order.
events.flavor: "I imagine, senhores, that you're confused as to my presence in these halls. Allow me to elucidate my purpose: you may think of me as an executor. I find troubles, and I eliminate them. Your local government has grown selfish and inward of late, according to the federal men who dispatched me. Have your aides report to me on the morrow: I will begin with a thorough audit."

options.name: Dispatch the best bureaucrat we can find.
Appoint the …-affiliated candidate.

events.title: Federal Intervenors

events.desc: Dissident forces have revolted in …, demanding … … restore constitutional rule and democratic elections.
events.flavor: History never repeats, yet it often rhymes. It is by this paradox that revolution begins in …, like so many before and many still to come, by the blood of students. The demands were enviably simple: a non-military state governor, a Constituent Assembly, and the Federal Government to abide by a fresh constitution. Yet, the rhyme is always the same: a river of blood, to follow the first trickles.

options.name: Restore order, but promise future concessions.
There can be no mercy, now.

events.title: Constitutionalist Revolt in …

events.desc: … has founded the … Integralist Action, a far-right and traditionalist party that aims to repress leftism and enshrine Catholic teachings into the structure of the state.
events.flavor:
"The Revolution of the Self cannot begin for Brazil while the regime of selfishness still rules. We, the vanguard of Integralism, will crush the selfishness of Marxism and transcend the bounds of materialism. We must, for Brazil demands it!"

Amidst the rapturous applause of the true believers was a single man with a notebook. While outwardly a journalist, his true patron was one more concerned about allies of convenience. These rabble-rousers would form such allies.

options.name: … would make a useful ally.
A fortuitous development.

events.title: Integralist Action

events.desc: A coalition of left-wing organizations in opposition to the government of … … has formed and issued its manifesto. The movement's primary proponent is …, a noteable ….
events.flavor:
"We must act now! The country is fit to be captured by the fascistas. We have the Comintern's support. Anything's possible with them."

"You forget yourself. We may be for the workers, but the workers haven't given us their blessing."

"Would every single lathe turner and brick layer matter? Half of them can't even find their way out of a pub! Now, or never!"

options.name: For bread, land, and freedom!
They are enemies of the state.

events.title: The National Liberation Alliance

events.desc: Integralists under … have marched in …, in response to a strike spurred by left-wing unrest. The march has left many wounded strikers in its wake.
events.flavor: The army of green-shirted marchers were alike in uncouth dignity with their European analogs. Chanting rhetoric in the streets was as common as their militant handwaving. The object of their ire today was a group of industrial strikers. The Integralists believed the striking workers were the government's greater foe. But no such promise of allegiance was ever guaranteed to them.

options.name: They go where our policemen fear to tread.
Prosecute them for this senseless violence.

events.title: Integralist March in …

events.desc: … has secured dominion over …. This state of affairs is quickly becoming known as the Veiled Protectorate, for by a technicality Egypt remains legally subject to the … …, who helplessly observes the situation.
events.flavor: Today the Nile was inundated with blood. Those who opposed the new regime were quickly put down. … diplomats and politicians have fire in their eyes as they discuss, under the shadow of the pyramids, how they will bring civilization to the lands of Egypt.

options.name: None can deny the power of the … Empire.
Assure the new … … of our support.

events.title: The Veiled Protectorate

events.desc: Arguing in favour of the universalisation of the … language, prominent politicians and intellectuals have pushed for harsh assimilation measures targeting …'s regional language speakers.
events.flavor:
While it would be genuinely liberating for a single global language to exist, that is not politically feasible, but a single language inside the state would be a viable project.

— Henri Grégoire, Report on the Necessity and Means to Annihilate the Patois and to Universalise the Use of the French Language

options.name: Speak …, be clean.
No. Work towards granting the … co-official status.
Continue existing policy, no need to rock the boat.

events.title: On the Status of the Regional Tongues

events.desc: The assimilation efforts have borne fruits, and once-dominant … are now merely found on the lips of rural hermits and stubborn old crones.
events.flavor:
"My grandfather once told me about this village, having passed through it much the same way I do now: to catalogue every man, woman, babe, and beast known to God Almighty and the state. 'Back then', he said. 'the beasts and the babes were more comprehendible than their elders'. Hah! How much can change in the span of a generations or two, good sir. How much indeed...

"..."

"What?"

"Comprehensible, sir.

options.name: One people.
One language.

events.title: In …, One Speaks …

events.desc: With the status of regional languages of … now recognized and protected by law, the country's uneasy relationship with regional identitarianism has been settled at last.
events.flavor:
Processing local petitions had never been an easy task, but after the introduction of the new regulations it had turned nightmarish. Any country bumpkin with a penny to his name was now sending their thoughts to him in writ: a confounded cacophony of words and expressions no gentleman of … would ever deign to utter!

'No' he thought to himself and shook his head. In the good old days, such men would never dare to engage with the state apparatus.

options.name: In diversity, unity.
In unity, strength.

events.title: A Realm of Many Tongues

events.desc: The King is dead. With the ascension of his son …, the realm rejoices. Long may he reign!
events.flavor:
"I have lost my best friend and the best of fathers ..." 
"I never had a bad word with him in my life." 
"I am heart-broken and overwhelmed with grief but God will help me in my responsibilities and darling May will be my comfort as she has always been." 
"May God give me strength and guidance in the heavy task which has fallen on me."

options.name: God save the King!

events.title: The Coronation of King George V

events.desc: The King is dead. With the ascension of his young niece …, the realm rejoices and the crown of Hanover passes outside of British control. Long may she reign!
events.flavor: "Since it has pleased Providence to place me in this station, I shall do my utmost to fulfil my duty towards my country."

options.name: God save the Queen!

events.title: The Coronation of Queen Victoria

events.desc: The King is dead. With the ascension of his young niece Victoria, the crown of Hanover passes outside of British control. Her uncle, …, now rules Hanover.
events.flavor: "I would shed the last drop of my blood for my niece."

options.name: God save the King!

events.title: The Coronation of Queen Victoria

events.desc: The … have submitted a proposal to construct a grand Terminus in …. The group has collected a significant sum of money to be used in its construction.
events.flavor:
Pipe smoke fills the small office as a group of officials consider the designs for a new train terminus.

"This is setting up to be a rather costly affair. Is rebuilding the station, really the best use of our resources?"

"My dear fellow, it is the era of the locomotives. Our earnings are proportional to the rate of delivery. And our current rate of delivery is comparable to a horse drawn cart."

options.name: Begin construction immediately.
This funding should be redirected where needed.

events.title: A Terminus Like No Other

events.desc: The completed Victoria Terminus is a fusion of architectural influences and marks a new chapter for both … and India as a whole.
events.flavor:
Two British men in suits stand outside the newly built terminus while a coolie carries their luggage.

"Well if it wasn't for the months long ship ride, I would have thought we were back in London."

"And therein lies the genius of its design. Our fellow countrymen see it as an expansion of British culture. While the locals see it as a respectful continuation of their Mughal heritage. Everyone is happy and no one is offended and business, above all, booms."

options.name: This Terminus will serve all of India well.
The world will marvel at our novel achievement.

events.title: An Architectural Marvel

events.desc: …'s use of mustard gas against the civilian population of … has branded … a war criminal. There are widespread calls to institute laws outlining acceptable conduct in warfare.
events.flavor: "Great mustard-colored blisters, blind eyes, all sticky and stuck together, always fighting for breath, with voices a mere whisper, saying that their throats are closing and they know they will choke."

options.name: All's fair in love and war.
… will be tried for … crimes.

events.title: War Crimes

events.desc: The establishment of … in … ensures an abundant supply of … for ….
events.flavor: "I resent the term 'arms dealer'. It implies that I am no more than a cynical profiteer, benefiting from the suffering of my fellow man. Nothing could be farther from the truth; what I do guarantees peace and security, not only in … but throughout the civilized world."

options.name: If you want peace, prepare for war.
Let's see some rapid-fire gains in research.

events.title: Dealing in Arms

events.desc: The fall of the Qing dynasty has ended China's long standing period of imperial rule and ushered in a new age of warlordism.
events.flavor:
"Empires, like dreams, are made of an intangible material, so fragile they can end at any given time, no previous warning. They hold, however, the same insane appeal. Even if the thread that holds together their seams is invisible, and every suture hides a wound.

Thousands of years of imperial rule, ended in just a moment."

options.name: … … will reform China!
… … will earn great victories!
… … assures our freedom!
… … is the people's hero!
We must salvage this situation.

events.title: China Shatters

events.desc: Through the diligence of our people and the bravery of our soldiers, the last warlord armies have been defeated or brought into compliance. … has been reunited, stronger than ever before.
events.flavor:
She had never seen so much light in the sky. A sea of red, yellow, and pink sparks transformed night into day, interspersed with the detonations of yet more fireworks. In the streets beneath her home, her neighbors released lanterns in great glowing flocks that met the fireworks at their height.

The festival would end eventually, of course, for limited supplies and need for sleep, but the occasion it symbolized would not. China was one again - indivisible, sovereign, and eternal.

options.name: Our nation must be forever indivisible.
Let us dedicate all of our efforts into rebuilding.

events.title: Chinese Reunification

events.desc: It is at risk of becoming public knowledge that … … entertains … by smashing in the skulls of prisoners with a sword.
events.flavor:
"You know why some people call me Old Eighty-Six? It's because of the size of my..." 

 The rest of the …'s words are drowned out by the sounds of screams and bone crunching as … brings … sword down on a prisoners head.'

 "...exactly eighty-six Mexican silver dollars."

options.name: The people should know.
Best to cover this up.

events.title: Melon Smashing

events.desc: A period of diligent modernization and centralization efforts has finally put an end to the risk of petty warlordism shattering the state. Despite the efforts of enemies internal and external, … stands unbowed and unified.
events.flavor: There at the edge of the horizon, lit by a setting sun, were the last of the foreign ships. Their colors flew at half-mast, a sure sign that they fled with their tails between their legs. Against them at sea was a Chinese flag flying high on Chinese soil. The message for the world was clear: China's mandate remains in its own hands. Its people alone will drive its future.

options.name: A state to endure until the end of time.
The ingenuity of our people will lead us ever further.

events.title: A Century of Triumph

events.desc: Our great … has devised an elaborate new ideology intended to unify the nation. Drawing from many sources, it is complex and may be difficult to convey to the masses.
events.flavor: "Our glorious new ideology is entirely comprehensive, combining everything of worth from militarism, nationalism, anarchism, democracy, capitalism, communism, individualism, imperialism, universalism, paternalism and utopianism."

options.name: Spread the word of …!
This doesn't make any sense. Focus on legitimizing the state instead.

events.title: … Thought

events.desc: The prospect of workhouses including religious instruction in their work has allowed the proposal of … to gain favor with the ….
events.flavor: "What is the difference between the man who is pursued by poverty to his own destruction and the ascetic who pursues poverty for the betterment of his soul? The answer surely lies not in the nature of material poverty, but in poverty of the spirit. This is the form of poverty that the workhouses most desperately need to alleviate."

options.name: Religious practices are key to the moral discipline the poor need!
Moral principles can be instilled without the help of the ….

events.title: Houses of Faith

events.desc: Some intellectuals are warning that if the … are not passed, an increasing population of unproductive poor will become an unmaintainable burden on society.
events.flavor: "A growing poor population is an inevitability in a society which does not attempt to control it. Some measures may seem callous to the short-sighted, but if the poor are not discouraged from multiplying, we shall soon have more starving mouths."

options.name: A firm hand is required to stave off such disaster.
This fearmongering makes the law seem outright inhumane.
We must take the time to make better arguments known.

events.title: The Principle of Population

events.desc: Some social reformers among the … have spoken out against the proposed …, viewing them as an attempt to make poverty itself a crime.
events.flavor: "If I may bring your attention to the design of the most ambitious workhouse plans, you may notice a striking similarity to our most modern attempts at constructing ideal prisons. This is because they are prisons. Prisons intended to house people who have committed no crime, where the purpose is not justice, but punishment and exploitation of the weak for its own ends."

options.name: The poor are a burden on society, a crime in itself.
There must be ways for this new system to respect personal liberty.

events.title: Prisons of the Poor

events.desc: A child who grew up in a workhouse institution spoke before … today, detailing the conditions there and urging the abolition of the Poor Laws.
events.flavor: "Most of you listeners would, I am sure, hesitate to bring your child to visit such a place. Yet children are nevertheless there, every day, although they learn quickly to be less like children, to be less a part of a family and more a part in a machine. Family being, like food, merely another luxury that no amount of work seems to make an inmate deserving of in these places."

options.name: More of these children must be heard!

rewards.name: Outrage Over Treatment of Workhouse Children

options.name: This makes the point well enough.

events.title: Child of the Workhouse

events.desc: The … are concerned that, without the workhouses watching over the poor, they will be lacking the guidance they see as necessary for the lower classes.
events.flavor: "In any society, the aristocracy has a certain responsibility towards the lower classes, as they too have a responsibility towards their betters. When we abolish an institution designed to facilitate such a responsibility, we must take care that we do not abolish the responsibility with it."

options.name: The poor are no more in need of guidance than the rich.
The whip cracks out of love!

events.title: A Guiding Hand

events.desc: The closing of workhouses with the abolition of the Poor Laws has some citizens concerned about increased crime rates as the poorest members of society will no longer be contained in these institutions.
events.flavor: "If someone suggested the abolition of a leper colony, surely the first question they'd be expected to answer would be: Where will these people go? Yet we are expected to assume that the destitute and desperate pouring out from closing workhouses should not be cause for such concerns. These are people who could not make an honest living. What dishonest living will they make once they're out?"

options.name: This fear of the poor is exactly what caused this inhumane law!
These people have a right to feel safe from indigent drifters.

events.title: Idle Hands

events.desc: Old veterans have spoken out in favor of …, rallying many in the … to support the reform.
events.flavor: "I cannot emphasize enough how much of the brutality of war on the human mind comes down to uncertainty. Uncertainty about when the enemy will attack, uncertainty about where you will wake up days from now, uncertainty about if you will wake up days from now and about who will still be with you if you do. Many feel uncertain about what will happen to them if they die. All we ask is the relief of having some certainty about what will happen to us if we live."

options.name: Military veterans are our highest priority in this new pension system.
All workers serve their country in their own way.

events.title: The Price of War

events.desc: The … are concerned about the proposed … reform giving the … leverage in benefits negotiations.
events.flavor: "Charity is all well and good, but the idea that there are certain forms of charity one is entitled to simply by existing can be quite insidious. A fair negotiation allows the parties to come to an agreement based on what they need from each other. If one party is already guaranteed certain provisions, well, you've already given them an inch for free, haven't you? And you know what they say about giving them an inch."

options.name: All the better. These should be rights, not benefits.
We will work with business owners to draft acceptable reform.

events.title: Unionized Leverage

events.desc: … … has recently held a speech warning against government overspending, making … supporters in the … more skeptical of the proposed ….
events.flavor: "…'s institutions must be built to last, through good and bad times alike. We must take care that we do not, during a mild winter, gain the ambition to expand our house so that we cannot afford to heat it during a harsh one."

options.name: This proposal is about sharing the wealth, not diminishing it.
It is important for … to live within its means.

events.title: … Urges Caution

events.desc: Send out an expedition to map the unknown geography of the Western Frontier.
events.flavor: "On our very doorstep is a land bursting with promise! We should seize that promise while we can. And if not now, we will be overtaken by eagles and lions and, heaven forbid, snails!"

options.name: I know the person for the job.

events.title: Expedition to Map the Western Frontier

events.desc: A group of strong candidates have expressed their interest in leading the expedition. However, this is not a decision we should make lightly.
events.flavor: The first to arrive was a well-dressed, fresh-faced, almost young gentleman whose keenness to impress was only matched by his willingness to oblige. His smile, as wide as one can imagine, was fashionably put together: "If I may...," he politely said, presenting his credentials.
events.title: Choosing a Leader

events.desc: After several weeks of silence, the expedition to map the Western Frontier led by … has come back, empty handed.
events.flavor: "We wait a day in the encampment. The men are tired and we've already walked so much. We wait for another day.
